name: Adi Parva

shlokas.0:
nArAyaNaM namaskRRitya naraM chaiva narottamam |
devIM sarasvatIM chaiva tato jayamudIrayet
shlokas.001: lomaharShaNaputra ugrashravAH sUtaH paurANiko naimiShAraNye shaunakasya kulapaterdvAdashavArShike satre
shlokas.2:
samAsInAnabhyagachChadbrahmarShInsa.nshitavratAn |
vinayAvanato bhUtvA kadAchitsUtanandanaH
shlokas.3:
tamAshramamanuprAptaM naimiShAraNyavAsinaH |
chitrAH shrotuM kathAstatra parivavrustapasvinaH
shlokas.4:
abhivAdya munI.nstA.nstu sarvAneva kRRitA~njaliH |
apRRichChatsa tapovRRiddhiM sadbhishchaivAbhinanditaH
shlokas.5:
atha teShUpaviShTeShu sarveShveva tapasviShu |
nirdiShTamAsanaM bheje vinayAllomaharShaNiH
shlokas.6:
sukhAsInaM tatastaM tu vishrAntamupalakShya cha |
athApRRichChadRRiShistatra kashchitprastAvayankathAH
shlokas.7:
kuta Agamyate saute kva chAyaM vihRRitastvayA |
kAlaH kamalapatrAkSha sha.nsaitatpRRichChato mama
shlokas.8:
sUta uvAcha||
janamejayasya rAjarSheH sarpasatre mahAtmanaH |
samIpe pArthivendrasya samyakpArikShitasya cha
shlokas.9:
kRRiShNadvaipAyanaproktAH supuNyA vividhAH kathAH |
kathitAshchApi vidhivadyA vaishampAyanena vai
shlokas.10:
shrutvAhaM tA vichitrArthA mahAbhAratasa.nshritAH |
bahUni samparikramya tIrthAnyAyatanAni cha
shlokas.11:
samantapa~nchakaM nAma puNyaM dvijaniShevitam |
gatavAnasmi taM deshaM yuddhaM yatrAbhavatpurA
pANDavAnAM kurUNAM cha sarveShAM cha mahIkShitAm
shlokas.12:
didRRikShurAgatastasmAtsamIpaM bhavatAmiha |
AyuShmantaH sarva eva brahmabhUtA hi me matAH
shlokas.13:
asminyaj~ne mahAbhAgAH sUryapAvakavarchasaH |
kRRitAbhiShekAH shuchayaH kRRitajapyA hutAgnayaH
bhavanta Asate svasthA bravImi kimahaM dvijAH
shlokas.14:
purANasa.nshritAH puNyAH kathA vA dharmasa.nshritAH |
itivRRittaM narendrANAmRRiShINAM cha mahAtmanAm
shlokas.15:
RRiShaya UchuH||
dvaipAyanena yatproktaM purANaM paramarShiNA |
surairbrahmarShibhishchaiva shrutvA yadabhipUjitam
shlokas.16:
tasyAkhyAnavariShThasya vichitrapadaparvaNaH |
sUkShmArthanyAyayuktasya vedArthairbhUShitasya cha
shlokas.17:
bhAratasyetihAsasya puNyAM granthArthasa.nyutAm |
sa.nskAropagatAM brAhmIM nAnAshAstropabRRiMhitAm
shlokas.18:
janamejayasya yAM rAj~no vaishampAyana uktavAn |
yathAvatsa RRiShistuShTyA satre dvaipAyanAj~nayA
shlokas.19:
vedaishchaturbhiH samitAM vyAsasyAdbhutakarmaNaH |
saMhitAM shrotumichChAmo dharmyAM pApabhayApahAm
shlokas.20:
sUta uvAcha||
AdyaM puruShamIshAnaM puruhUtaM puruShTutam |
RRitamekAkSharaM brahma vyaktAvyaktaM sanAtanam
shlokas.21:
asachcha sachchaiva cha yadvishvaM sadasataH param |
parAvarANAM sraShTAraM purANaM paramavyayam
shlokas.22:
ma~NgalyaM ma~NgalaM viShNuM vareNyamanaghaM shuchim |
namaskRRitya hRRiShIkeshaM charAcharaguruM harim
shlokas.23:
maharSheH pUjitasyeha sarvaloke mahAtmanaH |
pravakShyAmi mataM kRRitsnaM vyAsasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.24:
AchakhyuH kavayaH kechitsampratyAchakShate pare |
AkhyAsyanti tathaivAnye itihAsamimaM bhuvi
shlokas.25:
idaM tu triShu lokeShu mahajj~nAnaM pratiShThitam |
vistaraishcha samAsaishcha dhAryate yaddvijAtibhiH
shlokas.26:
ala~NkRRitaM shubhaiH shabdaiH samayairdivyamAnuShaiH |
ChandovRRittaishcha vividhairanvitaM viduShAM priyam
shlokas.27:
niShprabhe.asminnirAloke sarvatastamasAvRRite |
bRRihadaNDamabhUdekaM prajAnAM bIjamakShayam
shlokas.28:
yugasyAdau nimittaM tanmahaddivyaM prachakShate |
yasmi.nstachChrUyate satyaM jyotirbrahma sanAtanam
shlokas.29:
adbhutaM chApyachintyaM cha sarvatra samatAM gatam |
avyaktaM kAraNaM sUkShmaM yattatsadasadAtmakam
shlokas.30:
yasmAtpitAmaho jaj~ne prabhurekaH prajApatiH |
brahmA suraguruH sthANurmanuH kaH parameShThyatha
shlokas.31:
prAchetasastathA dakSho dakShaputrAshcha sapta ye |
tataH prajAnAM patayaH prAbhavannekavi.nshatiH
shlokas.32:
puruShashchAprameyAtmA yaM sarvamRRiShayo viduH |
vishvedevAstathAdityA vasavo.athAshvinAvapi
shlokas.33:
yakShAH sAdhyAH pishAchAshcha guhyakAH pitarastathA |
tataH prasUtA vidvA.nsaH shiShTA brahmarShayo.amalAH
shlokas.34:
rAjarShayashcha bahavaH sarvaiH samuditA guNaiH |
Apo dyauH pRRithivI vAyurantarikShaM dishastathA
shlokas.35:
sa.nvatsarartavo mAsAH pakShAhorAtrayaH kramAt |
yachchAnyadapi tatsarvaM sambhUtaM lokasAkShikam
shlokas.36:
yadidaM dRRishyate ki~nchidbhUtaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
punaH sa~NkShipyate sarvaM jagatprApte yugakShaye
shlokas.37:
yathartAvRRituli~NgAni nAnArUpANi paryaye |
dRRishyante tAni tAnyeva tathA bhAvA yugAdiShu
shlokas.38:
evametadanAdyantaM bhUtasaMhArakArakam |
anAdinidhanaM loke chakraM samparivartate
shlokas.39:
trayastri.nshatsahasrANi trayastri.nshachChatAni cha |
trayastri.nshachcha devAnAM sRRiShTiH sa~NkShepalakShaNA
shlokas.40:
divasputro bRRihadbhAnushchakShurAtmA vibhAvasuH |
savitA cha RRichIko.arko bhAnurAshAvaho raviH
shlokas.41:
putrA vivasvataH sarve mahyasteShAM tathAvaraH |
devabhrATtanayastasya tasmAtsubhrADiti smRRitaH
shlokas.42:
subhrAjastu trayaH putrAH prajAvanto bahushrutAH |
dashajyotiH shatajyotiH sahasrajyotirAtmavAn
shlokas.43:
dasha putrasahasrANi dashajyotermahAtmanaH |
tato dashaguNAshchAnye shatajyoterihAtmajAH
shlokas.44:
bhUyastato dashaguNAH sahasrajyotiShaH sutAH |
tebhyo.ayaM kuruva.nshashcha yadUnAM bharatasya cha
shlokas.45:
yayAtIkShvAkuva.nshashcha rAjarShINAM cha sarvashaH |
sambhUtA bahavo va.nshA bhUtasargAH savistarAH
shlokas.46:
bhUtasthAnAni sarvANi rahasyaM trividhaM cha yat |
vedayogaM savij~nAnaM dharmo.arthaH kAma eva cha
shlokas.47:
dharmakAmArthashAstrANi shAstrANi vividhAni cha |
lokayAtrAvidhAnaM cha sambhUtaM dRRiShTavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.48:
itihAsAH savaiyAkhyA vividhAH shrutayo.api cha |
iha sarvamanukrAntamuktaM granthasya lakShaNam
shlokas.49:
vistIryaitanmahajj~nAnamRRiShiH sa~NkShepamabravIt |
iShTaM hi viduShAM loke samAsavyAsadhAraNam
shlokas.50:
manvAdi bhArataM kechidAstIkAdi tathApare |
tathoparicharAdyanye viprAH samyagadhIyate
shlokas.51:
vividhaM saMhitAj~nAnaM dIpayanti manIShiNaH |
vyAkhyAtuM kushalAH kechidgranthaM dhArayituM pare
shlokas.52:
tapasA brahmacharyeNa vyasya vedaM sanAtanam |
itihAsamimaM chakre puNyaM satyavatIsutaH
shlokas.53:
parAsharAtmajo vidvAnbrahmarShiH sa.nshitavrataH |
mAturniyogAddharmAtmA gA~Ngeyasya cha dhImataH
shlokas.54:
kShetre vichitravIryasya kRRiShNadvaipAyanaH purA |
trInagnIniva kauravyA~njanayAmAsa vIryavAn
shlokas.55:
utpAdya dhRRitarAShTraM cha pANDuM vidurameva cha |
jagAma tapase dhImAnpunarevAshramaM prati
shlokas.56:
teShu jAteShu vRRiddheShu gateShu paramAM gatim |
abravIdbhArataM loke mAnuShe.asminmahAnRRiShiH
shlokas.57:
janamejayena pRRiShTaH sanbrAhmaNaishcha sahasrashaH |
shashAsa shiShyamAsInaM vaishampAyanamantike
shlokas.58:
sa sadasyaiH sahAsInaH shrAvayAmAsa bhAratam |
karmAntareShu yaj~nasya chodyamAnaH punaH punaH
shlokas.59:
vistaraM kuruva.nshasya gAndhAryA dharmashIlatAm |
kShattuH praj~nAM dhRRitiM kuntyAH samyagdvaipAyano.abravIt
shlokas.60:
vAsudevasya mAhAtmyaM pANDavAnAM cha satyatAm |
durvRRittaM dhArtarAShTrANAmuktavAnbhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.61:
chaturvi.nshatisAhasrIM chakre bhAratasaMhitAm |
upAkhyAnairvinA tAvadbhArataM prochyate budhaiH
shlokas.62:
tato.adhyardhashataM bhUyaH sa~NkShepaM kRRitavAnRRiShiH |
anukramaNimadhyAyaM vRRittAntAnAM saparvaNAm
shlokas.63:
idaM dvaipAyanaH pUrvaM putramadhyApayachChukam |
tato.anyebhyo.anurUpebhyaH shiShyebhyaH pradadau prabhuH
shlokas.64:
nArado.ashrAvayaddevAnasito devalaH pitRRin |
gandharvayakSharakShA.nsi shrAvayAmAsa vai shukaH
shlokas.65:
duryodhano manyumayo mahAdrumaH; skandhaH karNaH shakunistasya shAkhAH |
duHshAsanaH puShpaphale samRRiddhe; mUlaM rAjA dhRRitarAShTro.amanIShI
shlokas.66:
yudhiShThiro dharmamayo mahAdrumaH; skandho.arjuno bhImaseno.asya shAkhAH |
mAdrIsutau puShpaphale samRRiddhe; mUlaM kRRiShNo brahma cha brAhmaNAshcha
shlokas.67:
pANDurjitvA bahUndeshAnyudhA vikramaNena cha |
araNye mRRigayAshIlo nyavasatsajanastadA
shlokas.68:
mRRigavyavAyanidhane kRRichChrAM prApa sa Apadam |
janmaprabhRRiti pArthAnAM tatrAchAravidhikramaH
shlokas.69:
mAtrorabhyupapattishcha dharmopaniShadaM prati |
dharmasya vAyoH shakrasya devayoshcha tathAshvinoH
shlokas.70:
tApasaiH saha sa.nvRRiddhA mAtRRibhyAM parirakShitAH |
medhyAraNyeShu puNyeShu mahatAmAshrameShu cha
shlokas.71:
RRiShibhishcha tadAnItA dhArtarAShTrAnprati svayam |
shishavashchAbhirUpAshcha jaTilA brahmachAriNaH
shlokas.72:
putrAshcha bhrAtarashcheme shiShyAshcha suhRRidashcha vaH |
pANDavA eta ityuktvA munayo.antarhitAstataH
shlokas.73:
tA.nstairniveditAndRRiShTvA pANDavAnkauravAstadA |
shiShTAshcha varNAH paurA ye te harShAchchukrushurbhRRisham
shlokas.74:
AhuH kechinna tasyaite tasyaita iti chApare |
yadA chiramRRitaH pANDuH kathaM tasyeti chApare
shlokas.75:
svAgataM sarvathA diShTyA pANDoH pashyAma santatim |
uchyatAM svAgatamiti vAcho.ashrUyanta sarvashaH
shlokas.76:
tasminnuparate shabde dishaH sarvA vinAdayan |
antarhitAnAM bhUtAnAM nisvanastumulo.abhavat
shlokas.77:
puShpavRRiShTiH shubhA gandhAH sha~NkhadundubhinisvanAH |
Asanpraveshe pArthAnAM tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.78:
tatprItyA chaiva sarveShAM paurANAM harShasambhavaH |
shabda AsInmahA.nstatra divaspRRikkIrtivardhanaH
shlokas.79:
te.apyadhItyAkhilAnvedA~nshAstrANi vividhAni cha |
nyavasanpANDavAstatra pUjitA akutobhayAH
shlokas.80:
yudhiShThirasya shauchena prItAH prakRRitayo.abhavan |
dhRRityA cha bhImasenasya vikrameNArjunasya cha
shlokas.81:
gurushushrUShayA kuntyA yamayorvinayena cha |
tutoSha lokaH sakalasteShAM shauryaguNena cha
shlokas.82:
samavAye tato rAj~nAM kanyAM bhartRRisvaya.nvarAm |
prAptavAnarjunaH kRRiShNAM kRRitvA karma suduShkaram
shlokas.83:
tataH prabhRRiti loke.asminpUjyaH sarvadhanuShmatAm |
Aditya iva duShprekShyaH samareShvapi chAbhavat
shlokas.84:
sa sarvAnpArthivA~njitvA sarvA.nshcha mahato gaNAn |
AjahArArjuno rAj~ne rAjasUyaM mahAkratum
shlokas.85:
annavAndakShiNAvA.nshcha sarvaiH samudito guNaiH |
yudhiShThireNa samprApto rAjasUyo mahAkratuH
shlokas.86:
sunayAdvAsudevasya bhImArjunabalena cha |
ghAtayitvA jarAsandhaM chaidyaM cha balagarvitam
shlokas.88:
samRRiddhAM tAM tathA dRRiShTvA pANDavAnAM tadA shriyam |
IrShyAsamutthaH sumahA.nstasya manyurajAyata
shlokas.89:
vimAnapratimAM chApi mayena sukRRitAM sabhAm |
pANDavAnAmupahRRitAM sa dRRiShTvA paryatapyata
shlokas.91:
sa bhogAnvividhAnbhu~njanratnAni vividhAni cha |
kathito dhRRitarAShTrasya vivarNo hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.92:
anvajAnAttato dyUtaM dhRRitarAShTraH sutapriyaH |
tachChrutvA vAsudevasya kopaH samabhavanmahAn
shlokas.94:
nirasya viduraM droNaM bhIShmaM shAradvataM kRRipam |
vigrahe tumule tasminnahankShatraM parasparam
shlokas.95:
jayatsu pANDuputreShu shrutvA sumahadapriyam |
duryodhanamataM j~nAtvA karNasya shakunestathA
dhRRitarAShTrashchiraM dhyAtvA sa~njayaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.96:
shRRiNu sa~njaya me sarvaM na me.asUyitumarhasi |
shrutavAnasi medhAvI buddhimAnprAj~nasaMmataH
shlokas.97:
na vigrahe mama matirna cha prIye kurukShaye |
na me visheShaH putreShu sveShu pANDusuteShu cha
shlokas.98:
vRRiddhaM mAmabhyasUyanti putrA manyuparAyaNAH |
ahaM tvachakShuH kArpaNyAtputraprItyA sahAmi tat
muhyantaM chAnumuhyAmi duryodhanamachetanam
shlokas.99:
rAjasUye shriyaM dRRiShTvA pANDavasya mahaujasaH |
tachchAvahasanaM prApya sabhArohaNadarshane
shlokas.100:
amarShitaH svayaM jetumashaktaH pANDavAnraNe |
nirutsAhashcha samprAptuM shriyamakShatriyo yathA
gAndhArarAjasahitashChadmadyUtamamantrayat
shlokas.101:
tatra yadyadyathA j~nAtaM mayA sa~njaya tachChRRiNu |
shrutvA hi mama vAkyAni buddhyA yuktAni tattvataH
tato j~nAsyasi mAM saute praj~nAchakShuShamityuta
shlokas.102:
yadAshrauShaM dhanurAyamya chitraM; viddhaM lakShyaM pAtitaM vai pRRithivyAm |
kRRiShNAM hRRitAM pashyatAM sarvarAj~nAM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.103:
yadAshrauShaM dvArakAyAM subhadrAM; prasahyoDhAM mAdhavImarjunena |
indraprasthaM vRRiShNivIrau cha yAtau; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.104:
yadAshrauShaM devarAjaM pravRRiShTaM; sharairdivyairvAritaM chArjunena |
agniM tathA tarpitaM khANDave cha; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.105:
yadAshrauShaM hRRitarAjyaM yudhiShThiraM; parAjitaM saubalenAkShavatyAm |
anvAgataM bhrAtRRibhiraprameyai;stadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.106:
yadAshrauShaM draupadImashrukaNThIM; sabhAM nItAM duHkhitAmekavastrAm |
rajasvalAM nAthavatImanAthava;ttadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.107:
yadAshrauShaM vividhAstAta cheShTA; dharmAtmanAM prasthitAnAM vanAya |
jyeShThaprItyA klishyatAM pANDavAnAM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.108:
yadAshrauShaM snAtakAnAM sahasrai;ranvAgataM dharmarAjaM vanastham |
bhikShAbhujAM brAhmaNAnAM mahAtmanAM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.109:
yadAshrauShamarjuno devadevaM; kirAtarUpaM tryambakaM toShya yuddhe |
avApa tatpAshupataM mahAstraM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.110:
yadAshrauShaM tridivasthaM dhana~njayaM; shakrAtsAkShAddivyamastraM yathAvat |
adhIyAnaM sha.nsitaM satyasandhaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.111:
yadAshrauShaM vaishravaNena sArdhaM; samAgataM bhImamanyA.nshcha pArthAn |
tasmindeshe mAnuShANAmagamye; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.112:
yadAshrauShaM ghoShayAtrAgatAnAM; bandhaM gandharvairmokShaNaM chArjunena |
sveShAM sutAnAM karNabuddhau ratAnAM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.113:
yadAshrauShaM yakSharUpeNa dharmaM; samAgataM dharmarAjena sUta |
prashnAnuktAnvibruvantaM cha samya;ktadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.114:
yadAshrauShaM mAmakAnAM variShThA;ndhana~njayenaikarathena bhagnAn |
virATarAShTre vasatA mahAtmanA; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.115:
yadAshrauShaM satkRRitAM matsyarAj~nA; sutAM dattAmuttarAmarjunAya |
tAM chArjunaH pratyagRRihNAtsutArthe; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.116:
yadAshrauShaM nirjitasyAdhanasya; pravrAjitasya svajanAtprachyutasya |
akShauhiNIH sapta yudhiShThirasya; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.117:
yadAshrauShaM naranArAyaNau tau; kRRiShNArjunau vadato nAradasya |
ahaM draShTA brahmaloke sadeti; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.118:
yadAshrauShaM mAdhavaM vAsudevaM; sarvAtmanA pANDavArthe niviShTam |
yasyemAM gAM vikramamekamAhu;stadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.119:
yadAshrauShaM karNaduryodhanAbhyAM; buddhiM kRRitAM nigrahe keshavasya |
taM chAtmAnaM bahudhA darshayAnaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.120:
yadAshrauShaM vAsudeve prayAte; rathasyaikAmagratastiShThamAnAm |
ArtAM pRRithAM sAntvitAM keshavena; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.121:
yadAshrauShaM mantriNaM vAsudevaM; tathA bhIShmaM shAntanavaM cha teShAm |
bhAradvAjaM chAshiSho.anubruvANaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.122:
yadAshrauShaM karNa uvAcha bhIShmaM; nAhaM yotsye yudhyamAne tvayIti |
hitvA senAmapachakrAma chaiva; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.123:
yadAshrauShaM vAsudevArjunau tau; tathA dhanurgANDivamaprameyam |
trINyugravIryANi samAgatAni; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.124:
yadAshrauShaM kashmalenAbhipanne; rathopasthe sIdamAne.arjune vai |
kRRiShNaM lokAndarshayAnaM sharIre; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.125:
yadAshrauShaM bhIShmamamitrakarshanaM; nighnantamAjAvayutaM rathAnAm |
naiShAM kashchidvadhyate dRRishyarUpa;stadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.126:
yadAshrauShaM bhIShmamatyantashUraM; hataM pArthenAhaveShvapradhRRiShyam |
shikhaNDinaM purataH sthApayitvA; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.127:
yadAshrauShaM sharatalpe shayAnaM; vRRiddhaM vIraM sAditaM chitrapu~NkhaiH |
bhIShmaM kRRitvA somakAnalpasheShAM;stadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.128:
yadAshrauShaM shAntanave shayAne; pAnIyArthe choditenArjunena |
bhUmiM bhittvA tarpitaM tatra bhIShmaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.129:
yadAshrauShaM shukrasUryau cha yuktau; kaunteyAnAmanulomau jayAya |
nityaM chAsmA~nshvApadA vyAbhaShanta;stadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.130:
yadA droNo vividhAnastramArgA;nvidarshayansamare chitrayodhI |
na pANDavA~nshreShThatamAnnihanti; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.131:
yadAshrauShaM chAsmadIyAnmahArathA;nvyavasthitAnarjunasyAntakAya |
sa.nshaptakAnnihatAnarjunena; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.132:
yadAshrauShaM vyUhamabhedyamanyai;rbhAradvAjenAttashastreNa guptam |
bhittvA saubhadraM vIramekaM praviShTaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.133:
yadAbhimanyuM parivArya bAlaM; sarve hatvA hRRiShTarUpA babhUvuH |
mahArathAH pArthamashaknuvanta;stadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.134:
yadAshrauShamabhimanyuM nihatya; harShAnmUDhAnkroshato dhArtarAShTrAn |
krodhaM muktaM saindhave chArjunena; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.135:
yadAshrauShaM saindhavArthe pratij~nAM; pratij~nAtAM tadvadhAyArjunena |
satyAM nistIrNAM shatrumadhye cha tena; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.136:
yadAshrauShaM shrAntahaye dhana~njaye; muktvA hayAnpAyayitvopavRRittAn |
punaryuktvA vAsudevaM prayAtaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.137:
yadAshrauShaM vAhaneShvAshvasatsu; rathopasthe tiShThatA gANDivena |
sarvAnyodhAnvAritAnarjunena; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.138:
yadAshrauShaM nAgabalairdurutsahaM; droNAnIkaM yuyudhAnaM pramathya |
yAtaM vArShNeyaM yatra tau kRRiShNapArthau; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.139:
yadAshrauShaM karNamAsAdya muktaM; vadhAdbhImaM kutsayitvA vachobhiH |
dhanuShkoTyA tudya karNena vIraM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.140:
yadA droNaH kRRitavarmA kRRipashcha; karNo drauNirmadrarAjashcha shUraH |
amarShayansaindhavaM vadhyamAnaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.141:
yadAshrauShaM devarAjena dattAM; divyAM shaktiM vya.nsitAM mAdhavena |
ghaTotkache rAkShase ghorarUpe; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.142:
yadAshrauShaM karNaghaTotkachAbhyAM; yuddhe muktAM sUtaputreNa shaktim |
yayA vadhyaH samare savyasAchI; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.143:
yadAshrauShaM droNamAchAryamekaM; dhRRiShTadyumnenAbhyatikramya dharmam |
rathopasthe prAyagataM vishastaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.144:
yadAshrauShaM drauNinA dvairathasthaM; mAdrIputraM nakulaM lokamadhye |
samaM yuddhe pANDavaM yudhyamAnaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.145:
yadA droNe nihate droNaputro; nArAyaNaM divyamastraM vikurvan |
naiShAmantaM gatavAnpANDavAnAM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.146:
yadAshrauShaM karNamatyantashUraM; hataM pArthenAhaveShvapradhRRiShyam |
tasminbhrAtRRiNAM vigrahe devaguhye; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.147:
yadAshrauShaM droNaputraM kRRipaM cha; duHshAsanaM kRRitavarmANamugram |
yudhiShThiraM shUnyamadharShayantaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.148:
yadAshrauShaM nihataM madrarAjaM; raNe shUraM dharmarAjena sUta |
sadA sa~NgrAme spardhate yaH sa kRRiShNaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.149:
yadAshrauShaM kalahadyUtamUlaM; mAyAbalaM saubalaM pANDavena |
hataM sa~NgrAme sahadevena pApaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.150:
yadAshrauShaM shrAntamekaM shayAnaM; hradaM gatvA stambhayitvA tadambhaH |
duryodhanaM virathaM bhagnadarpaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.151:
yadAshrauShaM pANDavA.nstiShThamAnA;nga~NgAhrade vAsudevena sArdham |
amarShaNaM dharShayataH sutaM me; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.152:
yadAshrauShaM vividhA.nstAta mArgA;ngadAyuddhe maNDalaM sa~ncharantam |
mithyA hataM vAsudevasya buddhyA; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.153:
yadAshrauShaM droNaputrAdibhistai;rhatAnpA~nchAlAndraupadeyA.nshcha suptAn |
kRRitaM bIbhatsamayashasyaM cha karma; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.154:
yadAshrauShaM bhImasenAnuyAtena; ashvatthAmnA paramAstraM prayuktam |
kruddhenaiShIkamavadhIdyena garbhaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.155:
yadAshrauShaM brahmashiro.arjunena; muktaM svastItyastramastreNa shAntam |
ashvatthAmnA maNiratnaM cha dattaM; tadA nAsha.nse vijayAya sa~njaya
shlokas.156:
yadAshrauShaM droNaputreNa garbhe; vairATyA vai pAtyamAne mahAstre |
dvaipAyanaH keshavo droNaputraM; paraspareNAbhishApaiH shashApa
shlokas.157:
shochyA gAndhArI putrapautrairvihInA; tathA vadhvaH pitRRibhirbhrAtRRibhishcha |
kRRitaM kAryaM duShkaraM pANDaveyaiH; prAptaM rAjyamasapatnaM punastaiH
shlokas.158:
kaShTaM yuddhe dasha sheShAH shrutA me; trayo.asmAkaM pANDavAnAM cha sapta |
dvyUnA vi.nshatirAhatAkShauhiNInAM; tasminsa~NgrAme vigrahe kShatriyANAm
shlokas.159:
tamasA tvabhyavastIrNo moha AvishatIva mAm |
sa~nj~nAM nopalabhe sUta mano vihvalatIva me
shlokas.160:
ityuktvA dhRRitarAShTro.atha vilapya bahuduHkhitaH |
mUrchChitaH punarAshvastaH sa~njayaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.161:
sa~njayaiva~Ngate prANA.nstyaktumichChAmi mAchiram |
stokaM hyapi na pashyAmi phalaM jIvitadhAraNe
shlokas.162:
taM tathAvAdinaM dInaM vilapantaM mahIpatim |
gAvalgaNiridaM dhImAnmahArthaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.163:
shrutavAnasi vai rAj~no mahotsAhAnmahAbalAn |
dvaipAyanasya vadato nAradasya cha dhImataH
shlokas.164:
mahatsu rAjava.nsheShu guNaiH samuditeShu cha |
jAtAndivyAstraviduShaH shakrapratimatejasaH
shlokas.165:
dharmeNa pRRithivIM jitvA yaj~nairiShTvAptadakShiNaiH |
asmi.Nlloke yashaH prApya tataH kAlavashaM gatAH
shlokas.166:
vainyaM mahArathaM vIraM sRRi~njayaM jayatAM varam |
suhotraM rantidevaM cha kakShIvantaM tathaushijam
shlokas.167:
bAhlIkaM damanaM shaibyaM sharyAtimajitaM jitam |
vishvAmitramamitraghnamambarIShaM mahAbalam
shlokas.168:
maruttaM manumikShvAkuM gayaM bharatameva cha |
rAmaM dAsharathiM chaiva shashabinduM bhagIratham
shlokas.169:
yayAtiM shubhakarmANaM devairyo yAjitaH svayam |
chaityayUpA~NkitA bhUmiryasyeyaM savanAkarA
shlokas.170:
iti rAj~nAM chaturvi.nshannAradena surarShiNA |
putrashokAbhitaptAya purA shaibyAya kIrtitAH
shlokas.171:
tebhyashchAnye gatAH pUrvaM rAjAno balavattarAH |
mahArathA mahAtmAnaH sarvaiH samuditA guNaiH
shlokas.172:
pUruH kururyaduH shUro viShvagashvo mahAdhRRitiH |
anenA yuvanAshvashcha kakutstho vikramI raghuH
shlokas.173:
vijitI vItihotrashcha bhavaH shveto bRRihadguruH |
ushInaraH shatarathaH ka~Nko duliduho drumaH
shlokas.174:
dambhodbhavaH paro venaH sagaraH sa~NkRRitirnimiH |
ajeyaH parashuH puNDraH shambhurdevAvRRidho.anaghaH
shlokas.175:
devAhvayaH supratimaH supratIko bRRihadrathaH |
mahotsAho vinItAtmA sukraturnaiShadho nalaH
shlokas.176:
satyavrataH shAntabhayaH sumitraH subalaH prabhuH |
jAnuja~Ngho.anaraNyo.arkaH priyabhRRityaH shubhavrataH
shlokas.178:
avikShitprabalo dhUrtaH kRRitabandhurdRRiDheShudhiH |
mahApurANaH sambhAvyaH pratya~NgaH parahA shrutiH
shlokas.179:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
shrUyante.ayutashashchAnye sa~NkhyAtAshchApi padmashaH
shlokas.180:
hitvA suvipulAnbhogAnbuddhimanto mahAbalAH |
rAjAno nidhanaM prAptAstava putrairmahattamAH
shlokas.181:
yeShAM divyAni karmANi vikramastyAga eva cha |
mAhAtmyamapi chAstikyaM satyatA shauchamArjavam
shlokas.182:
vidvadbhiH kathyate loke purANaiH kavisattamaiH |
sarvarddhiguNasampannAste chApi nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.183:
tava putrA durAtmAnaH prataptAshchaiva manyunA |
lubdhA durvRRittabhUyiShThA na tA~nshochitumarhasi
shlokas.184:
shrutavAnasi medhAvI buddhimAnprAj~nasaMmataH |
yeShAM shAstrAnugA buddhirna te muhyanti bhArata
shlokas.185:
nigrahAnugrahau chApi viditau te narAdhipa |
nAtyantamevAnuvRRittiH shrUyate putrarakShaNe
shlokas.186:
bhavitavyaM tathA tachcha nAtaH shochitumarhasi |
daivaM praj~nAvisheSheNa ko nivartitumarhati
shlokas.187:
vidhAtRRivihitaM mArgaM na kashchidativartate |
kAlamUlamidaM sarvaM bhAvAbhAvau sukhAsukhe
shlokas.188:
kAlaH pachati bhUtAni kAlaH saMharati prajAH |
nirdahantaM prajAH kAlaM kAlaH shamayate punaH
shlokas.189:
kAlo vikurute bhAvAnsarvA.Nlloke shubhAshubhAn |
kAlaH sa~NkShipate sarvAH prajA visRRijate punaH
kAlaH sarveShu bhUteShu charatyavidhRRitaH samaH
shlokas.190:
atItAnAgatA bhAvA ye cha vartanti sAmpratam |
tAnkAlanirmitAnbuddhvA na sa~nj~nAM hAtumarhasi
shlokas.191:
sUta uvAcha||
atropaniShadaM puNyAM kRRiShNadvaipAyano.abravIt |
bhAratAdhyayanAtpuNyAdapi pAdamadhIyataH
shraddadhAnasya pUyante sarvapApAnyasheShataH
shlokas.192:
devarShayo hyatra puNyA brahmarAjarShayastathA |
kIrtyante shubhakarmANastathA yakShamahoragAH
shlokas.193:
bhagavAnvAsudevashcha kIrtyate.atra sanAtanaH |
sa hi satyamRRitaM chaiva pavitraM puNyameva cha
shlokas.194:
shAshvataM brahma paramaM dhruvaM jyotiH sanAtanam |
yasya divyAni karmANi kathayanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.195:
asatsatsadasachchaiva yasmAddevAtpravartate |
santatishcha pravRRittishcha janma mRRityuH punarbhavaH
shlokas.196:
adhyAtmaM shrUyate yachcha pa~nchabhUtaguNAtmakam |
avyaktAdi paraM yachcha sa eva parigIyate
shlokas.198:
shraddadhAnaH sadodyuktaH satyadharmaparAyaNaH |
AsevannimamadhyAyaM naraH pApAtpramuchyate
shlokas.199:
anukramaNimadhyAyaM bhAratasyemamAditaH |
AstikaH satataM shRRiNvanna kRRichChreShvavasIdati
shlokas.200:
ubhe sandhye japanki~nchitsadyo muchyeta kilbiShAt |
anukramaNyA yAvatsyAdahnA rAtryA cha sa~nchitam
shlokas.201:
bhAratasya vapurhyetatsatyaM chAmRRitameva cha |
navanItaM yathA dadhno dvipadAM brAhmaNo yathA
shlokas.202:
hradAnAmudadhiH shreShTho gaurvariShThA chatuShpadAm |
yathaitAni variShThAni tathA bhAratamuchyate
shlokas.204:
itihAsapurANAbhyAM vedaM samupabRRiMhayet |
bibhetyalpashrutAdvedo mAmayaM pratariShyati
shlokas.205:
kArShNaM vedamimaM vidvA~nshrAvayitvArthamashnute |
bhrUNahatyAkRRitaM chApi pApaM jahyAnna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.206:
ya imaM shuchiradhyAyaM paThetparvaNi parvaNi |
adhItaM bhArataM tena kRRitsnaM syAditi me matiH
shlokas.207:
yashchemaM shRRiNuyAnnityamArShaM shraddhAsamanvitaH |
sa dIrghamAyuH kIrtiM cha svargatiM chApnuyAnnaraH
shlokas.208:
chatvAra ekato vedA bhArataM chaikamekataH |
samAgataiH surarShibhistulAmAropitaM purA
mahattve cha gurutve cha dhriyamANaM tato.adhikam
shlokas.209:
mahattvAdbhAravattvAchcha mahAbhAratamuchyate |
niruktamasya yo veda sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.210:
tapo na kalko.adhyayanaM na kalkaH; svAbhAviko vedavidhirna kalkaH |
prasahya vittAharaNaM na kalka;stAnyeva bhAvopahatAni kalkaH

shlokas.1:
RRiShaya UchuH||
samantapa~nchakamiti yaduktaM sUtanandana |
etatsarvaM yathAnyAyaM shrotumichChAmahe vayam
shlokas.2:
sUta uvAcha||
shushrUShA yadi vo viprA bruvatashcha kathAH shubhAH |
samantapa~nchakAkhyaM cha shrotumarhatha sattamAH
shlokas.3:
tretAdvAparayoH sandhau rAmaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH |
asakRRitpArthivaM kShatraM jaghAnAmarShachoditaH
shlokas.4:
sa sarvaM kShatramutsAdya svavIryeNAnaladyutiH |
samantapa~nchake pa~ncha chakAra rudhirahradAn
shlokas.5:
sa teShu rudhirAmbhassu hradeShu krodhamUrchChitaH |
pitRRinsantarpayAmAsa rudhireNeti naH shrutam
shlokas.6:
atharchIkAdayo.abhyetya pitaro brAhmaNarShabham |
taM kShamasveti siShidhustataH sa virarAma ha
shlokas.7:
teShAM samIpe yo desho hradAnAM rudhirAmbhasAm |
samantapa~nchakamiti puNyaM tatparikIrtitam
shlokas.8:
yena li~Ngena yo desho yuktaH samupalakShyate |
tenaiva nAmnA taM deshaM vAchyamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.9:
antare chaiva samprApte kalidvAparayorabhUt |
samantapa~nchake yuddhaM kurupANDavasenayoH
shlokas.10:
tasminparamadharmiShThe deshe bhUdoShavarjite |
aShTAdasha samAjagmurakShauhiNyo yuyutsayA
shlokas.11:
evaM nAmAbhinirvRRittaM tasya deshasya vai dvijAH |
puNyashcha ramaNIyashcha sa desho vaH prakIrtitaH
shlokas.12:
tadetatkathitaM sarvaM mayA vo munisattamAH |
yathA deshaH sa vikhyAtastriShu lokeShu vishrutaH
shlokas.13:
RRiShaya UchuH||
akShauhiNya iti proktaM yattvayA sUtanandana |
etadichChAmahe shrotuM sarvameva yathAtatham
shlokas.14:
akShauhiNyAH parImANaM rathAshvanaradantinAm |
yathAvachchaiva no brUhi sarvaM hi viditaM tava
shlokas.15:
sUta uvAcha||
eko ratho gajashchaiko narAH pa~ncha padAtayaH |
trayashcha turagAstajj~naiH pattirityabhidhIyate
shlokas.16:
pattiM tu triguNAmetAmAhuH senAmukhaM budhAH |
trINi senAmukhAnyeko gulma ityabhidhIyate
shlokas.17:
trayo gulmA gaNo nAma vAhinI tu gaNAstrayaH |
smRRitAstisrastu vAhinyaH pRRitaneti vichakShaNaiH
shlokas.18:
chamUstu pRRitanAstisrastisrashchamvastvanIkinI |
anIkinIM dashaguNAM prAhurakShauhiNIM budhAH
shlokas.19:
akShauhiNyAH prasa~NkhyAnaM rathAnAM dvijasattamAH |
sa~NkhyAgaNitatattvaj~naiH sahasrANyekavi.nshatiH
shlokas.20:
shatAnyupari chaivAShTau tathA bhUyashcha saptatiH |
gajAnAM tu parImANametadevAtra nirdishet
shlokas.21:
j~neyaM shatasahasraM tu sahasrANi tathA nava |
narANAmapi pa~nchAshachChatAni trINi chAnaghAH
shlokas.22:
pa~nchaShaShTisahasrANi tathAshvAnAM shatAni cha |
dashottarANi ShaTprAhuryathAvadiha sa~NkhyayA
shlokas.23:
etAmakShauhiNIM prAhuH sa~NkhyAtattvavido janAH |
yAM vaH kathitavAnasmi vistareNa dvijottamAH
shlokas.24:
etayA sa~NkhyayA hyAsankurupANDavasenayoH |
akShauhiNyo dvijashreShThAH piNDenAShTAdashaiva tAH
shlokas.25:
sametAstatra vai deshe tatraiva nidhanaM gatAH |
kauravAnkAraNaM kRRitvA kAlenAdbhutakarmaNA
shlokas.26:
ahAni yuyudhe bhIShmo dashaiva paramAstravit |
ahAni pa~ncha droNastu rarakSha kuruvAhinIm
shlokas.27:
ahanI yuyudhe dve tu karNaH parabalArdanaH |
shalyo.ardhadivasaM tvAsIdgadAyuddhamataH param
shlokas.28:
tasyaiva tu dinasyAnte hArdikyadrauNigautamAH |
prasuptaM nishi vishvastaM jaghnuryaudhiShThiraM balam
shlokas.29:
yattu shaunakasatre te bhAratAkhyAnavistaram |
AkhyAsye tatra paulomamAkhyAnaM chAditaH param
shlokas.30:
vichitrArthapadAkhyAnamanekasamayAnvitam |
abhipannaM naraiH prAj~nairvairAgyamiva mokShibhiH
shlokas.31:
Atmeva veditavyeShu priyeShviva cha jIvitam |
itihAsaH pradhAnArthaH shreShThaH sarvAgameShvayam
shlokas.32:
itihAsottame hyasminnarpitA buddhiruttamA |
svaravya~njanayoH kRRitsnA lokavedAshrayeva vAk
shlokas.33:
asya praj~nAbhipannasya vichitrapadaparvaNaH |
bhAratasyetihAsasya shrUyatAM parvasa~NgrahaH
shlokas.34:
parvAnukramaNI pUrvaM dvitIyaM parvasa~NgrahaH |
pauShyaM paulomamAstIkamAdiva.nshAvatAraNam
shlokas.35:
tataH sambhavaparvoktamadbhutaM devanirmitam |
dAho jatugRRihasyAtra haiDimbaM parva chochyate
shlokas.36:
tato bakavadhaH parva parva chaitrarathaM tataH |
tataH svaya.nvaraM devyAH pA~nchAlyAH parva chochyate
shlokas.37:
kShatradharmeNa nirjitya tato vaivAhikaM smRRitam |
vidurAgamanaM parva rAjyalambhastathaiva cha
shlokas.38:
arjunasya vane vAsaH subhadrAharaNaM tataH |
subhadrAharaNAdUrdhvaM j~neyaM haraNahArikam
shlokas.39:
tataH khANDavadAhAkhyaM tatraiva mayadarshanam |
sabhAparva tataH proktaM mantraparva tataH param
shlokas.40:
jarAsandhavadhaH parva parva digvijayastathA |
parva digvijayAdUrdhvaM rAjasUyikamuchyate
shlokas.41:
tatashchArghAbhiharaNaM shishupAlavadhastataH |
dyUtaparva tataH proktamanudyUtamataH param
shlokas.42:
tata AraNyakaM parva kirmIravadha eva cha |
IshvarArjunayoryuddhaM parva kairAtasa~nj~nitam
shlokas.43:
indralokAbhigamanaM parva j~neyamataH param |
tIrthayAtrA tataH parva kururAjasya dhImataH
shlokas.44:
jaTAsuravadhaH parva yakShayuddhamataH param |
tathaivAjagaraM parva vij~neyaM tadanantaram
shlokas.45:
mArkaNDeyasamasyA cha parvoktaM tadanantaram |
sa.nvAdashcha tataH parva draupadIsatyabhAmayoH
shlokas.46:
ghoShayAtrA tataH parva mRRigasvapnabhayaM tataH |
vrIhidrauNikamAkhyAnaM tato.anantaramuchyate
shlokas.47:
draupadIharaNaM parva saindhavena vanAttataH |
kuNDalAharaNaM parva tataH paramihochyate
shlokas.48:
AraNeyaM tataH parva vairATaM tadanantaram |
kIchakAnAM vadhaH parva parva gograhaNaM tataH
shlokas.49:
abhimanyunA cha vairATyAH parva vaivAhikaM smRRitam |
udyogaparva vij~neyamata UrdhvaM mahAdbhutam
shlokas.50:
tataH sa~njayayAnAkhyaM parva j~neyamataH param |
prajAgaraM tataH parva dhRRitarAShTrasya chintayA
shlokas.51:
parva sAnatsujAtaM cha guhyamadhyAtmadarshanam |
yAnasandhistataH parva bhagavadyAnameva cha
shlokas.52:
j~neyaM vivAdaparvAtra karNasyApi mahAtmanaH |
niryANaM parva cha tataH kurupANDavasenayoH
shlokas.53:
rathAtirathasa~NkhyA cha parvoktaM tadanantaram |
ulUkadUtAgamanaM parvAmarShavivardhanam
shlokas.54:
ambopAkhyAnamapi cha parva j~neyamataH param |
bhIShmAbhiShechanaM parva j~neyamadbhutakAraNam
shlokas.55:
jambUkhaNDavinirmANaM parvoktaM tadanantaram |
bhUmiparva tato j~neyaM dvIpavistarakIrtanam
shlokas.56:
parvoktaM bhagavadgItA parva bhIShmavadhastataH |
droNAbhiShekaH parvoktaM sa.nshaptakavadhastataH
shlokas.57:
abhimanyuvadhaH parva pratij~nAparva chochyate |
jayadrathavadhaH parva ghaTotkachavadhastataH
shlokas.58:
tato droNavadhaH parva vij~neyaM lomaharShaNam |
mokSho nArAyaNAstrasya parvAnantaramuchyate
shlokas.59:
karNaparva tato j~neyaM shalyaparva tataH param |
hradapraveshanaM parva gadAyuddhamataH param
shlokas.60:
sArasvataM tataH parva tIrthava.nshaguNAnvitam |
ata UrdhvaM tu bIbhatsaM parva sauptikamuchyate
shlokas.61:
aiShIkaM parva nirdiShTamata UrdhvaM sudAruNam |
jalapradAnikaM parva strIparva cha tataH param
shlokas.62:
shrAddhaparva tato j~neyaM kurUNAmaurdhvadehikam |
AbhiShechanikaM parva dharmarAjasya dhImataH
shlokas.63:
chArvAkanigrahaH parva rakShaso brahmarUpiNaH |
pravibhAgo gRRihANAM cha parvoktaM tadanantaram
shlokas.64:
shAntiparva tato yatra rAjadharmAnukIrtanam |
Apaddharmashcha parvoktaM mokShadharmastataH param
shlokas.65:
tataH parva parij~neyamAnushAsanikaM param |
svargArohaNikaM parva tato bhIShmasya dhImataH
shlokas.66:
tato.ashvamedhikaM parva sarvapApapraNAshanam |
anugItA tataH parva j~neyamadhyAtmavAchakam
shlokas.67:
parva chAshramavAsAkhyaM putradarshanameva cha |
nAradAgamanaM parva tataH paramihochyate
shlokas.68:
mausalaM parva cha tato ghoraM samanuvarNyate |
mahAprasthAnikaM parva svargArohaNikaM tataH
shlokas.69:
hariva.nshastataH parva purANaM khilasa~nj~nitam |
bhaviShyatparva chApyuktaM khileShvevAdbhutaM mahat
shlokas.70:
etatparvashataM pUrNaM vyAsenoktaM mahAtmanA |
yathAvatsUtaputreNa lomaharShaNinA punaH
shlokas.71:
kathitaM naimiShAraNye parvANyaShTAdashaiva tu |
samAso bhAratasyAyaM tatroktaH parvasa~NgrahaH
shlokas.72:
pauShye parvaNi mAhAtmyamutta~NkasyopavarNitam |
paulome bhRRiguva.nshasya vistAraH parikIrtitaH
shlokas.73:
AstIke sarvanAgAnAM garuDasya cha sambhavaH |
kShIrodamathanaM chaiva janmochChaiHshravasastathA
shlokas.74:
yajataH sarpasatreNa rAj~naH pArikShitasya cha |
katheyamabhinirvRRittA bhAratAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.75:
vividhAH sambhavA rAj~nAmuktAH sambhavaparvaNi |
anyeShAM chaiva viprANAmRRiSherdvaipAyanasya cha
shlokas.76:
a.nshAvataraNaM chAtra devAnAM parikIrtitam |
daityAnAM dAnavAnAM cha yakShANAM cha mahaujasAm
shlokas.77:
nAgAnAmatha sarpANAM gandharvANAM patatriNAm |
anyeShAM chaiva bhUtAnAM vividhAnAM samudbhavaH
shlokas.78:
vasUnAM punarutpattirbhAgIrathyAM mahAtmanAm |
shantanorveshmani punasteShAM chArohaNaM divi
shlokas.79:
tejo.nshAnAM cha sa~NghAtAdbhIShmasyApyatra sambhavaH |
rAjyAnnivartanaM chaiva brahmacharyavrate sthitiH
shlokas.80:
pratij~nApAlanaM chaiva rakShA chitrA~Ngadasya cha |
hate chitrA~Ngade chaiva rakShA bhrAturyavIyasaH
shlokas.81:
vichitravIryasya tathA rAjye sampratipAdanam |
dharmasya nRRiShu sambhUtiraNImANDavyashApajA
shlokas.82:
kRRiShNadvaipAyanAchchaiva prasUtirvaradAnajA |
dhRRitarAShTrasya pANDoshcha pANDavAnAM cha sambhavaH
shlokas.83:
vAraNAvatayAtrA cha mantro duryodhanasya cha |
vidurasya cha vAkyena suru~NgopakramakriyA
shlokas.84:
pANDavAnAM vane ghore hiDimbAyAshcha darshanam |
ghaTotkachasya chotpattiratraiva parikIrtitA
shlokas.85:
aj~nAtacharyA pANDUnAM vAso brAhmaNaveshmani |
bakasya nidhanaM chaiva nAgarANAM cha vismayaH
shlokas.86:
a~NgAraparNaM nirjitya ga~NgAkUle.arjunastadA |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaH sarvaiH pA~nchAlAnabhito yayau
shlokas.88:
pa~nchAnAmekapatnItve vimarsho drupadasya cha |
draupadyA devavihito vivAhashchApyamAnuShaH
shlokas.89:
vidurasya cha samprAptirdarshanaM keshavasya cha |
khANDavaprasthavAsashcha tathA rAjyArdhashAsanam
shlokas.90:
nAradasyAj~nayA chaiva draupadyAH samayakriyA |
sundopasundayostatra upAkhyAnaM prakIrtitam
shlokas.91:
pArthasya vanavAsashcha ulUpyA pathi sa~NgamaH |
puNyatIrthAnusa.nyAnaM babhruvAhanajanma cha
shlokas.92:
dvArakAyAM subhadrA cha kAmayAnena kAminI |
vAsudevasyAnumate prAptA chaiva kirITinA
shlokas.93:
haraNaM gRRihya samprApte kRRiShNe devakinandane |
samprAptishchakradhanuShoH khANDavasya cha dAhanam
shlokas.94:
abhimanyoH subhadrAyAM janma chottamatejasaH |
mayasya mokSho jvalanAdbhuja~Ngasya cha mokShaNam
maharShermandapAlasya shAr~NgyaM tanayasambhavaH
shlokas.95:
ityetadAdhiparvoktaM prathamaM bahuvistaram |
adhyAyAnAM shate dve tu sa~NkhyAte paramarShiNA
aShTAdashaiva chAdhyAyA vyAsenottamatejasA
shlokas.96:
sapta shlokasahasrANi tathA nava shatAni cha |
shlokAshcha chaturAshItirdRRiShTo grantho mahAtmanA
shlokas.97:
dvitIyaM tu sabhAparva bahuvRRittAntamuchyate |
sabhAkriyA pANDavAnAM ki~NkarANAM cha darshanam
shlokas.99:
girivraje niruddhAnAM rAj~nAM kRRiShNena mokShaNam |
rAjasUye.arghasa.nvAde shishupAlavadhastathA
shlokas.100:
yaj~ne vibhUtiM tAM dRRiShTvA duHkhAmarShAnvitasya cha |
duryodhanasyAvahAso bhImena cha sabhAtale
shlokas.101:
yatrAsya manyurudbhUto yena dyUtamakArayat |
yatra dharmasutaM dyUte shakuniH kitavo.ajayat
shlokas.102:
yatra dyUtArNave magnAndraupadI naurivArNavAt |
tArayAmAsa tA.nstIrNA~nj~nAtvA duryodhano nRRipaH
punareva tato dyUte samAhvayata pANDavAn
shlokas.103:
etatsarvaM sabhAparva samAkhyAtaM mahAtmanA |
adhyAyAH saptatirj~neyAstathA dvau chAtra sa~NkhyayA
shlokas.104:
shlokAnAM dve sahasre tu pa~ncha shlokashatAni cha |
shlokAshchaikAdasha j~neyAH parvaNyasminprakIrtitAH
shlokas.105:
ataH paraM tRRitIyaM tu j~neyamAraNyakaM mahat |
paurAnugamanaM chaiva dharmaputrasya dhImataH
shlokas.106:
vRRiShNInAmAgamo yatra pA~nchAlAnAM cha sarvashaH |
yatra saubhavadhAkhyAnaM kirmIravadha eva cha
astrahetorvivAsashcha pArthasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.107:
mahAdevena yuddhaM cha kirAtavapuShA saha |
darshanaM lokapAlAnAM svargArohaNameva cha
shlokas.108:
darshanaM bRRihadashvasya maharSherbhAvitAtmanaH |
yudhiShThirasya chArtasya vyasane paridevanam
shlokas.109:
nalopAkhyAnamatraiva dharmiShThaM karuNodayam |
damayantyAH sthitiryatra nalasya vyasanAgame
shlokas.110:
vanavAsagatAnAM cha pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
svarge pravRRittirAkhyAtA lomashenArjunasya vai
shlokas.111:
tIrthayAtrA tathaivAtra pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
jaTAsurasya tatraiva vadhaH samupavarNyate
shlokas.112:
niyukto bhImasenashcha draupadyA gandhamAdane |
yatra mandArapuShpArthaM nalinIM tAmadharShayat
shlokas.115:
tataH shyenakapotIyamupAkhyAnamanantaram |
indro.agniryatra dharmashcha ajij~nAsa~nshibiM nRRipam
shlokas.116:
RRishyashRRi~Ngasya charitaM kaumArabrahmachAriNaH |
jAmadagnyasya rAmasya charitaM bhUritejasaH
shlokas.117:
kArtavIryavadho yatra haihayAnAM cha varNyate |
saukanyamapi chAkhyAnaM chyavano yatra bhArgavaH
shlokas.118:
sharyAtiyaj~ne nAsatyau kRRitavAnsomapIthinau |
tAbhyAM cha yatra sa muniryauvanaM pratipAditaH
shlokas.119:
jantUpAkhyAnamatraiva yatra putreNa somakaH |
putrArthamayajadrAjA lebhe putrashataM cha saH
shlokas.120:
aShTAvakrIyamatraiva vivAde yatra bandinam |
vijitya sAgaraM prAptaM pitaraM labdhavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.121:
avApya divyAnyastrANi gurvarthe savyasAchinA |
nivAtakavachairyuddhaM hiraNyapuravAsibhiH
shlokas.122:
samAgamashcha pArthasya bhrAtRRibhirgandhamAdane |
ghoShayAtrA cha gandharvairyatra yuddhaM kirITinaH
shlokas.123:
punarAgamanaM chaiva teShAM dvaitavanaM saraH |
jayadrathenApahAro draupadyAshchAshramAntarAt
shlokas.125:
sa.ndarshanaM cha kRRiShNasya sa.nvAdashchaiva satyayA |
vrIhidrauNikamAkhyAnamaindradyumnaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.126:
sAvitryauddAlakIyaM cha vainyopAkhyAnameva cha |
rAmAyaNamupAkhyAnamatraiva bahuvistaram
shlokas.127:
karNasya parimoSho.atra kuNDalAbhyAM pura.ndarAt |
AraNeyamupAkhyAnaM yatra dharmo.anvashAtsutam
jagmurlabdhavarA yatra pANDavAH pashchimAM disham
shlokas.128:
etadAraNyakaM parva tRRitIyaM parikIrtitam |
atrAdhyAyashate dve tu sa~NkhyAte paramarShiNA
ekonasaptatishchaiva tathAdhyAyAH prakIrtitAH
shlokas.129:
ekAdasha sahasrANi shlokAnAM ShaTshatAni cha |
chatuHShaShTistathA shlokAH parvaitatparikIrtitam
shlokas.130:
ataH paraM nibodhedaM vairATaM parvavistaram |
virATanagaraM gatvA shmashAne vipulAM shamIm
dRRiShTvA saMnidadhustatra pANDavA AyudhAnyuta
shlokas.131:
yatra pravishya nagaraM Chadmabhirnyavasanta te |
durAtmano vadho yatra kIchakasya vRRikodarAt
shlokas.132:
gograhe yatra pArthena nirjitAH kuravo yudhi |
godhanaM cha virATasya mokShitaM yatra pANDavaiH
shlokas.133:
virATenottarA dattA snuShA yatra kirITinaH |
abhimanyuM samuddishya saubhadramarighAtinam
shlokas.134:
chaturthametadvipulaM vairATaM parva varNitam |
atrApi parisa~NkhyAtamadhyAyAnAM mahAtmanA
shlokas.135:
saptaShaShTiratho pUrNA shlokAgramapi me shRRiNu |
shlokAnAM dve sahasre tu shlokAH pa~nchAshadeva tu
parvaNyasminsamAkhyAtAH sa~NkhyayA paramarShiNA
shlokas.136:
udyogaparva vij~neyaM pa~nchamaM shRRiNvataH param |
upaplavye niviShTeShu pANDaveShu jigIShayA
duryodhano.arjunashchaiva vAsudevamupasthitau
shlokas.137:
sAhAyyamasminsamare bhavAnnau kartumarhati |
ityukte vachane kRRiShNo yatrovAcha mahAmatiH
shlokas.138:
ayudhyamAnamAtmAnaM mantriNaM puruSharShabhau |
akShauhiNIM vA sainyasya kasya vA kiM dadAmyaham
shlokas.139:
vavre duryodhanaH sainyaM mandAtmA yatra durmatiH |
ayudhyamAnaM sachivaM vavre kRRiShNaM dhana~njayaH
shlokas.140:
sa~njayaM preShayAmAsa shamArthaM pANDavAnprati |
yatra dUtaM mahArAjo dhRRitarAShTraH pratApavAn
shlokas.141:
shrutvA cha pANDavAnyatra vAsudevapurogamAn |
prajAgaraH samprajaj~ne dhRRitarAShTrasya chintayA
shlokas.142:
viduro yatra vAkyAni vichitrANi hitAni cha |
shrAvayAmAsa rAjAnaM dhRRitarAShTraM manIShiNam
shlokas.143:
tathA sanatsujAtena yatrAdhyAtmamanuttamam |
manastApAnvito rAjA shrAvitaH shokalAlasaH
shlokas.144:
prabhAte rAjasamitau sa~njayo yatra chAbhibhoH |
aikAtmyaM vAsudevasya proktavAnarjunasya cha
shlokas.145:
yatra kRRiShNo dayApannaH sandhimichChanmahAyashAH |
svayamAgAchChamaM kartuM nagaraM nAgasAhvayam
shlokas.146:
pratyAkhyAnaM cha kRRiShNasya rAj~nA duryodhanena vai |
shamArthaM yAchamAnasya pakShayorubhayorhitam
shlokas.147:
karNaduryodhanAdInAM duShTaM vij~nAya mantritam |
yogeshvaratvaM kRRiShNena yatra rAjasu darshitam
shlokas.148:
rathamAropya kRRiShNena yatra karNo.anumantritaH |
upAyapUrvaM shauNDIryAtpratyAkhyAtashcha tena saH
shlokas.150:
yatra rAj~nA ulUkasya preShaNaM pANDavAnprati |
shvobhAvini mahAyuddhe dUtyena krUravAdinA
rathAtirathasa~NkhyAnamambopAkhyAnameva cha
shlokas.151:
etatsubahuvRRittAntaM pa~nchamaM parva bhArate |
udyogaparva nirdiShTaM sandhivigrahasa.nshritam
shlokas.152:
adhyAyAH sa~NkhyayA tvatra ShaDashItishataM smRRitam |
shlokAnAM ShaTsahasrANi tAvantyeva shatAni cha
shlokas.153:
shlokAshcha navatiH proktAstathaivAShTau mahAtmanA |
vyAsenodAramatinA parvaNyasmi.nstapodhanAH
shlokas.154:
ata UrdhvaM vichitrArthaM bhIShmaparva prachakShate |
jambUkhaNDavinirmANaM yatroktaM sa~njayena ha
shlokas.155:
yatra yuddhamabhUdghoraM dashAhAnyatidAruNam |
yatra yaudhiShThiraM sainyaM viShAdamagamatparam
shlokas.156:
kashmalaM yatra pArthasya vAsudevo mahAmatiH |
mohajaM nAshayAmAsa hetubhirmokShadarshanaiH
shlokas.157:
shikhaNDinaM puraskRRitya yatra pArtho mahAdhanuH |
vinighnannishitairbANai rathAdbhIShmamapAtayat
shlokas.158:
ShaShThametanmahAparva bhArate parikIrtitam |
adhyAyAnAM shataM proktaM saptadasha tathApare
shlokas.159:
pa~ncha shlokasahasrANi sa~NkhyayAShTau shatAni cha |
shlokAshcha chaturAshItiH parvaNyasminprakIrtitAH
vyAsena vedaviduShA sa~NkhyAtA bhIShmaparvaNi
shlokas.160:
droNaparva tatashchitraM bahuvRRittAntamuchyate |
yatra sa.nshaptakAH pArthamapaninyU raNAjirAt
shlokas.161:
bhagadatto mahArAjo yatra shakrasamo yudhi |
supratIkena nAgena saha shastaH kirITinA
shlokas.162:
yatrAbhimanyuM bahavo jaghnurlokamahArathAH |
jayadrathamukhA bAlaM shUramaprAptayauvanam
shlokas.163:
hate.abhimanyau kruddhena yatra pArthena sa.nyuge |
akShauhiNIH sapta hatvA hato rAjA jayadrathaH
sa.nshaptakAvasheShaM cha kRRitaM niHsheShamAhave
shlokas.164:
alambusaH shrutAyushcha jalasandhashcha vIryavAn |
saumadattirvirATashcha drupadashcha mahArathaH
ghaTotkachAdayashchAnye nihatA droNaparvaNi
shlokas.165:
ashvatthAmApi chAtraiva droNe yudhi nipAtite |
astraM prAdushchakArograM nArAyaNamamarShitaH
shlokas.166:
saptamaM bhArate parva mahadetadudAhRRitam |
atra te pRRithivIpAlAH prAyasho nidhanaM gatAH
droNaparvaNi ye shUrA nirdiShTAH puruSharShabhAH
shlokas.167:
adhyAyAnAM shataM proktamadhyAyAH saptatistathA |
aShTau shlokasahasrANi tathA nava shatAni cha
shlokas.168:
shlokA nava tathaivAtra sa~NkhyAtAstattvadarshinA |
pArAsharyeNa muninA sa~nchintya droNaparvaNi
shlokas.169:
ataH paraM karNaparva prochyate paramAdbhutam |
sArathye viniyogashcha madrarAjasya dhImataH
AkhyAtaM yatra paurANaM tripurasya nipAtanam
shlokas.171:
anyonyaM prati cha krodho yudhiShThirakirITinoH |
dvairathe yatra pArthena hataH karNo mahArathaH
shlokas.172:
aShTamaM parva nirdiShTametadbhAratachintakaiH |
ekonasaptatiH proktA adhyAyAH karNaparvaNi
chatvAryeva sahasrANi nava shlokashatAni cha
shlokas.173:
ataH paraM vichitrArthaM shalyaparva prakIrtitam |
hatapravIre sainye tu netA madreshvaro.abhavat
shlokas.174:
vRRittAni rathayuddhAni kIrtyante yatra bhAgashaH |
vinAshaH kurumukhyAnAM shalyaparvaNi kIrtyate
shlokas.175:
shalyasya nidhanaM chAtra dharmarAjAnmahArathAt |
gadAyuddhaM tu tumulamatraiva parikIrtitam
sarasvatyAshcha tIrthAnAM puNyatA parikIrtitA
shlokas.177:
sa~NkhyAtA bahuvRRittAntAH shlokAgraM chAtra shasyate |
trINi shlokasahasrANi dve shate vi.nshatistathA
muninA sampraNItAni kauravANAM yashobhRRitAm
shlokas.178:
ataH paraM pravakShyAmi sauptikaM parva dAruNam |
bhagnoruM yatra rAjAnaM duryodhanamamarShaNam
shlokas.179:
vyapayAteShu pArtheShu trayaste.abhyAyayU rathAH |
kRRitavarmA kRRipo drauNiH sAyAhne rudhirokShitAH
shlokas.180:
pratijaj~ne dRRiDhakrodho drauNiryatra mahArathaH |
ahatvA sarvapA~nchAlAndhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAn
pANDavA.nshcha sahAmAtyAnna vimokShyAmi da.nshanam
shlokas.182:
yatrAmuchyanta pArthAste pa~ncha kRRiShNabalAshrayAt |
sAtyakishcha maheShvAsaH sheShAshcha nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.183:
draupadI putrashokArtA pitRRibhrAtRRivadhArditA |
kRRitAnashanasa~NkalpA yatra bhartRRinupAvishat
shlokas.184:
draupadIvachanAdyatra bhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
anvadhAvata sa~Nkruddho bhAradvAjaM guroH sutam
shlokas.186:
maivamityabravItkRRiShNaH shamaya.nstasya tadvachaH |
yatrAstramastreNa cha tachChamayAmAsa phAlgunaH
shlokas.188:
gUDhotpannasya chAkhyAnaM karNasya pRRithayAtmanaH |
sutasyaitadiha proktaM dashamaM parva sauptikam
shlokas.189:
aShTAdashAsminnadhyAyAH parvaNyuktA mahAtmanA |
shlokAgramatra kathitaM shatAnyaShTau tathaiva cha
shlokas.190:
shlokAshcha saptatiH proktA yathAvadabhisa~NkhyayA |
sauptikaiShIkasambandhe parvaNyamitabuddhinA
shlokas.191:
ata UrdhvamidaM prAhuH strIparva karuNodayam |
vilApo vIrapatnInAM yatrAtikaruNaH smRRitaH
krodhAveshaH prasAdashcha gAndhArIdhRRitarAShTrayoH
shlokas.193:
yatra rAjA mahAprAj~naH sarvadharmabhRRitAM varaH |
rAj~nAM tAni sharIrANi dAhayAmAsa shAstrataH
shlokas.194:
etadekAdashaM proktaM parvAtikaruNaM mahat |
saptavi.nshatiradhyAyAH parvaNyasminnudAhRRitAH
shlokas.195:
shlokAH saptashataM chAtra pa~nchasaptatiruchyate |
sa~NkhyayA bhAratAkhyAnaM kartrA hyatra mahAtmanA
praNItaM sajjanamanovaiklavyAshrupravartakam
shlokas.196:
ataH paraM shAntiparva dvAdashaM buddhivardhanam |
yatra nirvedamApanno dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
ghAtayitvA pitRRinbhrAtRRinputrAnsambandhibAndhavAn
shlokas.197:
shAntiparvaNi dharmAshcha vyAkhyAtAH sharatalpikAH |
rAjabhirveditavyA ye samya~NnayabubhutsubhiH
shlokas.198:
ApaddharmAshcha tatraiva kAlahetupradarshakAH |
yAnbuddhvA puruShaH samyaksarvaj~natvamavApnuyAt
mokShadharmAshcha kathitA vichitrA bahuvistarAH
shlokas.199:
dvAdashaM parva nirdiShTametatprAj~najanapriyam |
parvaNyatra parij~neyamadhyAyAnAM shatatrayam
tri.nshachchaiva tathAdhyAyA nava chaiva tapodhanAH
shlokas.200:
shlokAnAM tu sahasrANi kIrtitAni chaturdasha |
pa~ncha chaiva shatAnyAhuH pa~nchavi.nshatisa~NkhyayA
shlokas.201:
ata UrdhvaM tu vij~neyamAnushAsanamuttamam |
yatra prakRRitimApannaH shrutvA dharmavinishchayam
bhIShmAdbhAgIrathIputrAtkururAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.202:
vyavahAro.atra kArtsnyena dharmArthIyo nidarshitaH |
vividhAnAM cha dAnAnAM phalayogAH pRRithagvidhAH
shlokas.203:
tathA pAtravisheShAshcha dAnAnAM cha paro vidhiH |
AchAravidhiyogashcha satyasya cha parA gatiH
shlokas.204:
etatsubahuvRRittAntamuttamaM chAnushAsanam |
bhIShmasyAtraiva samprAptiH svargasya parikIrtitA
shlokas.205:
etattrayodashaM parva dharmanishchayakArakam |
adhyAyAnAM shataM chAtra ShaTchatvAri.nshadeva cha
shlokAnAM tu sahasrANi ShaTsaptaiva shatAni cha
shlokas.206:
tato.ashvamedhikaM nAma parva proktaM chaturdasham |
tatsa.nvartamaruttIyaM yatrAkhyAnamanuttamam
shlokas.207:
suvarNakoshasamprAptirjanma choktaM parikShitaH |
dagdhasyAstrAgninA pUrvaM kRRiShNAtsa~njIvanaM punaH
shlokas.208:
charyAyAM hayamutsRRiShTaM pANDavasyAnugachChataH |
tatra tatra cha yuddhAni rAjaputrairamarShaNaiH
shlokas.209:
chitrA~NgadAyAH putreNa putrikAyA dhana~njayaH |
sa~NgrAme babhruvAhena sa.nshayaM chAtra darshitaH
ashvamedhe mahAyaj~ne nakulAkhyAnameva cha
shlokas.210:
ityAshvamedhikaM parva proktametanmahAdbhutam |
atrAdhyAyashataM tri.nshattrayo.adhyAyAshcha shabditAH
shlokas.211:
trINi shlokasahasrANi tAvantyeva shatAni cha |
vi.nshatishcha tathA shlokAH sa~NkhyAtAstattvadarshinA
shlokas.212:
tata AshramavAsAkyaM parva pa~nchadashaM smRRitam |
yatra rAjyaM parityajya gAndhArIsahito nRRipaH
dhRRitarAShTrAshramapadaM vidurashcha jagAma ha
shlokas.213:
yaM dRRiShTvA prasthitaM sAdhvI pRRithApyanuyayau tadA |
putrarAjyaM parityajya gurushushrUShaNe ratA
shlokas.215:
RRiSheH prasAdAtkRRiShNasya dRRiShTvAshcharyamanuttamam |
tyaktvA shokaM sadArashcha siddhiM paramikAM gataH
shlokas.216:
yatra dharmaM samAshritya viduraH sugatiM gataH |
sa~njayashcha mahAmAtro vidvAngAvalgaNirvashI
shlokas.217:
dadarsha nAradaM yatra dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
nAradAchchaiva shushrAva vRRiShNInAM kadanaM mahat
shlokas.219:
sahasramekaM shlokAnAM pa~ncha shlokashatAni cha |
ShaDeva cha tathA shlokAH sa~NkhyAtAstattvadarshinA
shlokas.220:
ataH paraM nibodhedaM mausalaM parva dAruNam |
yatra te puruShavyAghrAH shastrasparshasahA yudhi
brahmadaNDaviniShpiShTAH samIpe lavaNAmbhasaH
shlokas.222:
yatra sarvakShayaM kRRitvA tAvubhau rAmakeshavau |
nAtichakramatuH kAlaM prAptaM sarvaharaM samam
shlokas.223:
yatrArjuno dvAravatImetya vRRiShNivinAkRRitAm |
dRRiShTvA viShAdamagamatparAM chArtiM nararShabhaH
shlokas.224:
sa satkRRitya yadushreShThaM mAtulaM shaurimAtmanaH |
dadarsha yaduvIrANAmApAne vaishasaM mahat
shlokas.225:
sharIraM vAsudevasya rAmasya cha mahAtmanaH |
sa.nskAraM lambhayAmAsa vRRiShNInAM cha pradhAnataH
shlokas.226:
sa vRRiddhabAlamAdAya dvAravatyAstato janam |
dadarshApadi kaShTAyAM gANDIvasya parAbhavam
shlokas.227:
sarveShAM chaiva divyAnAmastrANAmaprasannatAm |
nAshaM vRRiShNikalatrANAM prabhAvAnAmanityatAm
shlokas.228:
dRRiShTvA nirvedamApanno vyAsavAkyaprachoditaH |
dharmarAjaM samAsAdya saMnyAsaM samarochayet
shlokas.229:
ityetanmausalaM parva ShoDashaM parikIrtitam |
adhyAyAShTau samAkhyAtAH shlokAnAM cha shatatrayam
shlokas.230:
mahAprasthAnikaM tasmAdUrdhvaM saptadashaM smRRitam |
yatra rAjyaM parityajya pANDavAH puruSharShabhAH
draupadyA sahitA devyA siddhiM paramikAM gatAH
shlokas.231:
atrAdhyAyAstrayaH proktAH shlokAnAM cha shataM tathA |
vi.nshatishcha tathA shlokAH sa~NkhyAtAstattvadarshinA
shlokas.232:
svargaparva tato j~neyaM divyaM yattadamAnuSham |
adhyAyAH pa~ncha sa~NkhyAtAH parvaitadabhisa~NkhyayA
shlokAnAM dve shate chaiva prasa~NkhyAte tapodhanAH
shlokas.233:
aShTAdashaivametAni parvANyuktAnyasheShataH |
khileShu hariva.nshashcha bhaviShyachcha prakIrtitam
shlokas.234:
etadakhilamAkhyAtaM bhArataM parvasa~NgrahAt |
aShTAdasha samAjagmurakShauhiNyo yuyutsayA
tanmahaddAruNaM yuddhamahAnyaShTAdashAbhavat
shlokas.235:
yo vidyAchchaturo vedAnsA~NgopaniShadAndvijaH |
na chAkhyAnamidaM vidyAnnaiva sa syAdvichakShaNaH
shlokas.236:
shrutvA tvidamupAkhyAnaM shrAvyamanyanna rochate |
pu.nskokilarutaM shrutvA rUkShA dhvA~NkShasya vAgiva
shlokas.237:
itihAsottamAdasmAjjAyante kavibuddhayaH |
pa~nchabhya iva bhUtebhyo lokasa.nvidhayastrayaH
shlokas.238:
asyAkhyAnasya viShaye purANaM vartate dvijAH |
antarikShasya viShaye prajA iva chaturvidhAH
shlokas.239:
kriyAguNAnAM sarveShAmidamAkhyAnamAshrayaH |
indriyANAM samastAnAM chitrA iva manaHkriyAH
shlokas.240:
anAshrityaitadAkhyAnaM kathA bhuvi na vidyate |
AhAramanapAshritya sharIrasyeva dhAraNam
shlokas.242:
dvaipAyanauShThapuTaniHsRRitamaprameyaM; puNyaM pavitramatha pApaharaM shivaM cha |
yo bhArataM samadhigachChati vAchyamAnaM; kiM tasya puShkarajalairabhiShechanena
shlokas.243:
AkhyAnaM tadidamanuttamaM mahArthaM; vinyastaM mahadiha parvasa~NgraheNa |
shrutvAdau bhavati nRRiNAM sukhAvagAhaM; vistIrNaM lavaNajalaM yathA plavena

shlokas.001:
sUta uvAcha||
janamejayaH pArikShitaH saha bhrAtRRibhiH kurukShetre dIrghasatramupAste |
tasya bhrAtarastrayaH shrutasena ugraseno bhImasena iti
shlokas.002:
teShu tatsatramupAsIneShu tatra shvAbhyAgachChatsArameyaH |
sa janamejayasya bhrAtRRibhirabhihato rorUyamANo mAtuH samIpamupAgachChat
shlokas.003:
taM mAtA rorUyamANamuvAcha |
kiM rodiShi |
kenAsyabhihata iti
shlokas.004:
sa evamukto mAtaraM pratyuvAcha |
janamejayasya bhrAtRRibhirabhihato.asmIti
shlokas.005:
taM mAtA pratyuvAcha |
vyaktaM tvayA tatrAparAddhaM yenAsyabhihata iti
shlokas.006:
sa tAM punaruvAcha |
nAparAdhyAmi ki~nchit |
nAvekShe havIMShi nAvaliha iti
shlokas.007: tachChrutvA tasya mAtA saramA putrashokArtA tatsatramupAgachChadyatra sa janamejayaH saha bhrAtRRibhirdIrghasatramupAste
shlokas.008:
sa tayA kruddhayA tatroktaH |
ayaM me putro na ki~nchidaparAdhyati |
kimarthamabhihata iti |
yasmAchchAyamabhihato.anapakArI tasmAdadRRiShTaM tvAM bhayamAgamiShyatIti
shlokas.009: sa janamejaya evamukto devashunyA saramayA dRRiDhaM sambhrAnto viShaNNashchAsIt
shlokas.010: sa tasminsatre samApte hAstinapuraM pratyetya purohitamanurUpamanvichChamAnaH paraM yatnamakarodyo me pApakRRityAM shamayediti
shlokas.011: sa kadAchinmRRigayAM yAtaH pArikShito janamejayaH kasmi.nshchitsvaviShayoddeshe Ashramamapashyat
shlokas.012:
tatra kashchidRRiShirAsAM chakre shrutashravA nAma |
tasyAbhimataH putra Aste somashravA nAma
shlokas.013: tasya taM putramabhigamya janamejayaH pArikShitaH paurohityAya vavre
shlokas.014:
sa namaskRRitya tamRRiShimuvAcha |
bhagavannayaM tava putro mama purohito.astviti
shlokas.015:
sa evamuktaH pratyuvAcha |
bho janamejaya putro.ayaM mama sarpyAM jAtaH |
mahAtapasvI svAdhyAyasampanno mattapovIryasambhRRito machChukraM pItavatyAstasyAH kukShau sa.nvRRiddhaH |
samartho.ayaM bhavataH sarvAH pApakRRityAH shamayitumantareNa mahAdevakRRityAm |
asya tvekamupA.nshuvratam |
yadenaM kashchidbrAhmaNaH ka~nchidarthamabhiyAchettaM tasmai dadyAdayam |
yadyetadutsahase tato nayasvainamiti
shlokas.017:
sa taM purohitamupAdAyopAvRRitto bhrAtRRinuvAcha |
mayAyaM vRRita upAdhyAyaH |
yadayaM brUyAttatkAryamavichArayadbhiriti
shlokas.018:
tenaivamuktA bhrAtarastasya tathA chakruH |
sa tathA bhrAtRRinsa.ndishya takShashilAM pratyabhipratasthe |
taM cha deshaM vashe sthApayAmAsa
shlokas.019:
etasminnantare kashchidRRiShirdhaumyo nAmAyodaH |
tasya shiShyAstrayo babhUvurupamanyurAruNirvedashcheti
shlokas.020:
sa ekaM shiShyamAruNiM pA~nchAlyaM preShayAmAsa |
gachCha kedArakhaNDaM badhAneti
shlokas.021: sa upAdhyAyena sa.ndiShTa AruNiH pA~nchAlyastatra gatvA tatkedArakhaNDaM baddhuM nAshaknot
shlokas.023:
sa tatra sa.nvivesha kedArakhaNDe |
shayAne tasmi.nstadudakaM tasthau
shlokas.024:
tataH kadAchidupAdhyAya Ayodo dhaumyaH shiShyAnapRRichChat |
kva AruNiH pA~nchAlyo gata iti
shlokas.025:
te pratyUchuH |
bhagavataiva preShito gachCha kedArakhaNDaM badhAneti
shlokas.026:
sa evamuktastA~nshiShyAnpratyuvAcha |
tasmAtsarve tatra gachChAmo yatra sa iti
shlokas.027:
sa tatra gatvA tasyAhvAnAya shabdaM chakAra |
bho AruNe pA~nchAlya kvAsi |
vatsaihIti
shlokas.028:
sa tachChrutvA AruNirupAdhyAyavAkyaM tasmAtkedArakhaNDAtsahasotthAya tamupAdhyAyamupatasthe |
provAcha chainam |
ayamasmyatra kedArakhaNDe niHsaramANamudakamavAraNIyaM sa.nroddhuM sa.nviShTo bhagavachChabdaM shrutvaiva sahasA vidArya kedArakhaNDaM bhavantamupasthitaH |
tadabhivAdaye bhagavantam |
Aj~nApayatu bhavAn |
kiM karavANIti
shlokas.030:
sa upAdhyAyenAnugRRihItaH |
yasmAttvayA madvacho.anuShThitaM tasmAchChreyo.avApsyasIti |
sarve cha te vedAH pratibhAsyanti sarvANi cha dharmashAstrANIti
shlokas.034:
sa upAdhyAyavachanAdarakShadgAH |
sa chAhani gA rakShitvA divasakShaye.abhyAgamyopAdhyAyasyAgrataH sthitvA namashchakre
shlokas.035:
tamupAdhyAyaH pIvAnamapashyat |
uvAcha chainam |
vatsopamanyo kena vRRittiM kalpayasi |
pIvAnasi dRRiDhamiti
shlokas.036:
sa upAdhyAyaM pratyuvAcha |
bhaikSheNa vRRittiM kalpayAmIti
shlokas.038:
sa tathetyuktvA punararakShadgAH |
rakShitvA chAgamya tathaivopAdhyAyasyAgrataH sthitvA namashchakre
shlokas.039:
tamupAdhyAyastathApi pIvAnameva dRRiShTvovAcha |
vatsopamanyo sarvamasheShataste bhaikShaM gRRihNAmi |
kenedAnIM vRRittiM kalpayasIti
shlokas.040:
sa evamukta upAdhyAyena pratyuvAcha |
bhagavate nivedya pUrvamaparaM charAmi |
tena vRRittiM kalpayAmIti
shlokas.041:
tamupAdhyAyaH pratyuvAcha |
naiShA nyAyyA guruvRRittiH |
anyeShAmapi vRRittyuparodhaM karoShyevaM vartamAnaH |
lubdho.asIti
shlokas.042:
sa tathetyuktvA gA arakShat |
rakShitvA cha punarupAdhyAyagRRihamAgamyopAdhyAyasyAgrataH sthitvA namashchakre
shlokas.043:
tamupAdhyAyastathApi pIvAnameva dRRiShTvA punaruvAcha |
ahaM te sarvaM bhaikShaM gRRihNAmi na chAnyachcharasi |
pIvAnasi |
kena vRRittiM kalpayasIti
shlokas.044:
sa upAdhyAyaM pratyuvAcha |
bho etAsAM gavAM payasA vRRittiM kalpayAmIti
shlokas.045:
tamupAdhyAyaH pratyuvAcha |
naitannyAyyaM paya upayoktuM bhavato mayAnanuj~nAtamiti
shlokas.046: sa tatheti pratij~nAya gA rakShitvA punarupAdhyAyagRRihAnetya guroragrataH sthitvA namashchakre
shlokas.047:
tamupAdhyAyaH pIvAnamevApashyat |
uvAcha chainam |
bhaikShaM nAshnAsi na chAnyachcharasi |
payo na pibasi |
pIvAnasi |
kena vRRittiM kalpayasIti
shlokas.048:
sa evamukta upAdhyAyaM pratyuvAcha |
bhoH phenaM pibAmi yamime vatsA mAtRRiNAM stanaM pibanta udgirantIti
shlokas.049:
tamupAdhyAyaH pratyuvAcha |
ete tvadanukampayA guNavanto vatsAH prabhUtataraM phenamudgiranti |
tadevamapi vatsAnAM vRRittyuparodhaM karoShyevaM vartamAnaH |
phenamapi bhavAnna pAtumarhatIti
shlokas.050:
sa tatheti pratij~nAya nirAhArastA gA arakShat |
tathA pratiShiddho bhaikShaM nAshnAti na chAnyachcharati |
payo na pibati |
phenaM nopayu~Nkte
shlokas.053:
atha tasminnanAgachChatyupAdhyAyaH shiShyAnavochat |
mayopamanyuH sarvataH pratiShiddhaH |
sa niyataM kupitaH |
tato nAgachChati chiragatashcheti
shlokas.054:
sa evamuktvA gatvAraNyamupamanyorAhvAnaM chakre |
bho upamanyo kvAsi |
vatsaihIti
shlokas.055:
sa tadAhvAnamupAdhyAyAchChrutvA pratyuvAchochchaiH |
ayamasmi bho upAdhyAya kUpe patita iti
shlokas.056:
tamupAdhyAyaH pratyuvAcha |
kathamasi kUpe patita iti
shlokas.057:
sa taM pratyuvAcha |
arkapatrANi bhakShayitvAndhIbhUto.asmi |
ataH kUpe patita iti
shlokas.058:
tamupAdhyAyaH pratyuvAcha |
ashvinau stuhi |
tau tvAM chakShuShmantaM kariShyato devabhiShajAviti
shlokas.059: sa evamukta upAdhyAyena stotuM prachakrame devAvashvinau vAgbhirRRigbhiH
shlokas.60:
pra pUrvagau pUrvajau chitrabhAnU; girA vA sha.nsAmi tapanAvanantau |
divyau suparNau virajau vimAnA;vadhikShiyantau bhuvanAni vishvA
shlokas.61:
hiraNmayau shakunI sAmparAyau; nAsatyadasrau sunasau vaijayantau |
shukraM vayantau tarasA suvemA;vabhi vyayantAvasitaM vivasvat
shlokas.62:
grastAM suparNasya balena vartikA;mamu~nchatAmashvinau saubhagAya |
tAvatsuvRRittAvanamanta mAyayA; sattamA gA aruNA udAvahan
shlokas.63:
ShaShTishcha gAvastrishatAshcha dhenava; ekaM vatsaM suvate taM duhanti |
nAnAgoShThA vihitA ekadohanA;stAvashvinau duhato gharmamukthyam
shlokas.64:
ekAM nAbhiM saptashatA arAH shritAH; pradhiShvanyA vi.nshatirarpitA arAH |
anemi chakraM parivartate.ajaraM; mAyAshvinau samanakti charShaNI
shlokas.65:
ekaM chakraM vartate dvAdashAraM pradhi;ShaNNAbhimekAkShamamRRitasya dhAraNam |
yasmindevA adhi vishve viShaktA;stAvashvinau mu~nchato mA viShIdatam
shlokas.66:
ashvinAvindramamRRitaM vRRittabhUyau; tirodhattAmashvinau dAsapatnI |
bhittvA girimashvinau gAmudAcharantau; tadvRRiShTamahnA prathitA valasya
shlokas.67:
yuvAM disho janayatho dashAgre; samAnaM mUrdhni rathayA viyanti |
tAsAM yAtamRRiShayo.anuprayAnti; devA manuShyAH kShitimAcharanti
shlokas.68:
yuvAM varNAnvikurutho vishvarUpAM;ste.adhikShiyanti bhuvanAni vishvA |
te bhAnavo.apyanusRRitAshcharanti; devA manuShyAH kShitimAcharanti
shlokas.69:
tau nAsatyAvashvinAvAmahe vAM; srajaM cha yAM bibhRRithaH puShkarasya |
tau nAsatyAvamRRitAvRRitAvRRidhA;vRRite devAstatprapadena sUte
shlokas.70:
mukhena garbhaM labhatAM yuvAnau; gatAsuretatprapadena sUte |
sadyo jAto mAtaramatti garbha;stAvashvinau mu~nchatho jIvase gAH
shlokas.071:
evaM tenAbhiShTutAvashvinAvAjagmatuH |
Ahatushchainam |
prItau svaH |
eSha te.apUpaH |
ashAnainamiti
shlokas.072:
sa evamuktaH pratyuvAcha |
nAnRRitamUchaturbhavantau |
na tvahametamapUpamupayoktumutsahe anivedya gurava iti
shlokas.073:
tatastamashvinAvUchatuH |
AvAbhyAM purastAdbhavata upAdhyAyenaivamevAbhiShTutAbhyAmapUpaH prItAbhyAM dattaH |
upayuktashcha sa tenAnivedya gurave |
tvamapi tathaiva kuruShva yathA kRRitamupAdhyAyeneti
shlokas.074:
sa evamuktaH punareva pratyuvAchaitau |
pratyanunaye bhavantAvashvinau |
notsahe.ahamanivedyopAdhyAyAyopayoktumiti
shlokas.075:
tamashvinAvAhatuH |
prItau svastavAnayA guruvRRittyA |
upAdhyAyasya te kArShNAyasA dantAH |
bhavato hiraNmayA bhaviShyanti |
chakShuShmA.nshcha bhaviShyasi |
shreyashchAvApsyasIti
shlokas.077:
Aha chainam |
yathAshvinAvAhatustathA tvaM shreyo.avApsyasIti |
sarve cha te vedAH pratibhAsyantIti
shlokas.080:
tamupAdhyAyaH sa.ndidesha |
vatsa veda ihAsyatAm |
bhavatA madgRRihe ka~nchitkAlaM shushrUShamANena bhavitavyam |
shreyaste bhaviShyatIti
shlokas.081:
sa tathetyuktvA gurukule dIrghakAlaM gurushushrUShaNaparo.avasat |
gauriva nityaM guruShu dhUrShu niyujyamAnaH shItoShNakShuttRRiShNAduHkhasahaH sarvatrApratikUlaH
shlokas.082:
tasya mahatA kAlena guruH paritoShaM jagAma |
tatparitoShAchcha shreyaH sarvaj~natAM chAvApa |
eShA tasyApi parIkShA vedasya
shlokas.083:
sa upAdhyAyenAnuj~nAtaH samAvRRittastasmAdgurukulavAsAdgRRihAshramaM pratyapadyata |
tasyApi svagRRihe vasatastrayaH shiShyA babhUvuH
shlokas.084:
sa shiShyAnna ki~nchiduvAcha |
karma vA kriyatAM gurushushrUShA veti |
duHkhAbhij~no hi gurukulavAsasya shiShyAnparikleshena yojayituM neyeSha
shlokas.085: atha kasyachitkAlasya vedaM brAhmaNaM janamejayaH pauShyashcha kShatriyAvupetyopAdhyAyaM varayAM chakratuH
shlokas.086:
sa kadAchidyAjyakAryeNAbhiprasthita utta~NkaM nAma shiShyaM niyojayAmAsa |
bho utta~Nka yatki~nchidasmadgRRihe parihIyate tadichChAmyahamaparihINaM bhavatA kriyamANamiti
shlokas.087: sa evaM pratisamAdishyotta~NkaM vedaH pravAsaM jagAma
shlokas.089:
sa vasa.nstatropAdhyAyastrIbhiH sahitAbhirAhUyoktaH |
upAdhyAyinI te RRitumatI |
upAdhyAyashcha proShitaH |
asyA yathAyamRRiturvandhyo na bhavati tathA kriyatAm |
etadviShIdatIti
shlokas.090:
sa evamuktastAH striyaH pratyuvAcha |
na mayA strINAM vachanAdidamakAryaM kAryam |
na hyahamupAdhyAyena sa.ndiShTaH |
akAryamapi tvayA kAryamiti
shlokas.091:
tasya punarupAdhyAyaH kAlAntareNa gRRihAnupajagAma tasmAtpravAsAt |
sa tadvRRittaM tasyAsheShamupalabhya prItimAnabhUt
shlokas.092:
uvAcha chainam |
vatsotta~Nka kiM te priyaM karavANIti |
dharmato hi shushrUShito.asmi bhavatA |
tena prItiH paraspareNa nau sa.nvRRiddhA |
tadanujAne bhavantam |
sarvAmeva siddhiM prApsyasi |
gamyatAmiti
shlokas.093:
sa evamuktaH pratyuvAcha |
kiM te priyaM karavANIti |
evaM hyAhuH
shlokas.095:
tayoranyataraH praiti vidveShaM chAdhigachChati |
so.ahamanuj~nAto bhavatA ichChAmIShTaM te gurvarthamupahartumiti
shlokas.096:
tenaivamukta upAdhyAyaH pratyuvAcha |
vatsotta~Nka uShyatAM tAvaditi
shlokas.097:
sa kadAchittamupAdhyAyamAhotta~NkaH |
Aj~nApayatu bhavAn |
kiM te priyamupaharAmi gurvarthamiti
shlokas.098:
tamupAdhyAyaH pratyuvAcha |
vatsotta~Nka bahusho mAM chodayasi gurvarthamupahareyamiti |
tadgachCha |
enAM pravishyopAdhyAyinIM pRRichCha kimupaharAmIti |
eShA yadbravIti tadupaharasveti
shlokas.099:
sa evamukta upAdhyAyenopAdhyAyinImapRRichChat |
bhavatyupAdhyAyenAsmyanuj~nAto gRRihaM gantum |
tadichChAmIShTaM te gurvarthamupahRRityAnRRiNo gantum |
tadAj~nApayatu bhavatI |
kimupaharAmi gurvarthamiti
shlokas.100:
saivamuktopAdhyAyinyutta~NkaM pratyuvAcha |
gachCha pauShyaM rAjAnam |
bhikShasva tasya kShatriyayA pinaddhe kuNDale |
te Anayasva |
itashchaturthe.ahani puNyakaM bhavitA |
tAbhyAmAbaddhAbhyAM brAhmaNAnpariveShTumichChAmi |
shobhamAnA yathA tAbhyAM kuNDalAbhyAM tasminnahani sampAdayasva |
shreyo hi te syAtkShaNaM kurvata iti
shlokas.101:
sa evamukta upAdhyAyinyA prAtiShThatotta~NkaH |
sa pathi gachChannapashyadRRiShabhamatipramANaM tamadhirUDhaM cha puruShamatipramANameva
shlokas.102:
sa puruSha utta~NkamabhyabhAShata |
utta~NkaitatpurIShamasya RRiShabhasya bhakShayasveti
shlokas.104:
tamAha puruSho bhUyaH |
bhakShayasvotta~Nka |
mA vichAraya |
upAdhyAyenApi te bhakShitaM pUrvamiti
shlokas.105: sa evamukto bADhamityuktvA tadA tadRRiShabhasya purIShaM mUtraM cha bhakShayitvotta~NkaH pratasthe yatra sa kShatriyaH pauShyaH
shlokas.106:
tamupetyApashyadutta~Nka AsInam |
sa tamupetyAshIrbhirabhinandyovAcha |
arthI bhavantamupagato.asmIti
shlokas.107:
sa enamabhivAdyovAcha |
bhagavanpauShyaH khalvaham |
kiM karavANIti
shlokas.108:
tamuvAchotta~NkaH |
gurvarthe kuNDalAbhyAmarthyAgato.asmIti ye te kShatriyayA pinaddhe kuNDale te bhavAndAtumarhatIti
shlokas.109:
taM pauShyaH pratyuvAcha |
pravishyAntaHpuraM kShatriyA yAchyatAmiti
shlokas.111:
sa pauShyaM punaruvAcha |
na yuktaM bhavatA vayamanRRitenopacharitum |
na hi te kShatriyAntaHpure saMnihitA |
nainAM pashyAmIti
shlokas.112:
sa evamuktaH pauShyastaM pratyuvAcha |
samprati bhavAnuchChiShTaH |
smara tAvat |
na hi sA kShatriyA uchChiShTenAshuchinA vA shakyA draShTum |
pativratAtvAdeShA nAshucherdarshanamupaitIti
shlokas.113:
athaivamukta utta~NkaH smRRitvovAcha |
asti khalu mayochChiShTenopaspRRiShTaM shIghraM gachChatA cheti
shlokas.114:
taM pauShyaH pratyuvAcha |
etattadevaM hi |
na gachChatopaspRRiShTaM bhavati na sthiteneti
shlokas.115: athotta~NkastathetyuktvA prA~Nmukha upavishya suprakShAlitapANipAdavadano.ashabdAbhir hRRidaya~NgamAbhiradbhirupaspRRishya triH pItvA dviH parimRRijya khAnyadbhirupaspRRishyAntaHpuraM pravishya tAM kShatriyAmapashyat
shlokas.116:
sA cha dRRiShTvaivotta~NkamabhyutthAyAbhivAdyovAcha |
svAgataM te bhagavan |
Aj~nApaya kiM karavANIti
shlokas.117:
sa tAmuvAcha |
ete kuNDale gurvarthaM me bhikShite dAtumarhasIti
shlokas.118: sA prItA tena tasya sadbhAvena pAtramayamanatikramaNIyashcheti matvA te kuNDale avamuchyAsmai prAyachChat
shlokas.119:
Aha chainam |
ete kuNDale takShako nAgarAjaH prArthayati |
apramatto netumarhasIti
shlokas.120:
sa evamuktastAM kShatriyAM pratyuvAcha |
bhavati sunirvRRitA bhava |
na mAM shaktastakShako nAgarAjo dharShayitumiti
shlokas.122:
sa taM dRRiShTvovAcha |
bhoH pauShya prIto.asmIti
shlokas.123:
taM pauShyaH pratyuvAcha |
bhagava.nshchirasya pAtramAsAdyate |
bhavA.nshcha guNavAnatithiH |
tatkariShye shrAddham |
kShaNaH kriyatAmiti
shlokas.124:
tamutta~NkaH pratyuvAcha |
kRRitakShaNa evAsmi |
shIghramichChAmi yathopapannamannamupahRRitaM bhavateti
shlokas.126:
athotta~NkaH shItamannaM sakeshaM dRRiShTvA ashuchyetaditi matvA pauShyamuvAcha |
yasmAnme ashuchyannaM dadAsi tasmadandho bhaviShyasIti
shlokas.127:
taM pauShyaH pratyuvAcha |
yasmAttvamapyaduShTamannaM dUShayasi tasmAdanapatyo bhaviShyasIti
shlokas.129:
atha tadannaM muktakeshyA striyopahRRitaM sakeshamashuchi matvotta~NkaM prasAdayAmAsa |
bhagavannaj~nAnAdetadannaM sakeshamupahRRitaM shItaM cha |
tatkShAmaye bhavantam |
na bhaveyamandha iti
shlokas.130:
tamutta~NkaH pratyuvAcha |
na mRRiShA bravImi |
bhUtvA tvamandho nachirAdanandho bhaviShyasIti |
mamApi shApo na bhavedbhavatA datta iti
shlokas.131:
taM pauShyaH pratyuvAcha |
nAhaM shaktaH shApaM pratyAdAtum |
na hi me manyuradyApyupashamaM gachChati |
kiM chaitadbhavatA na j~nAyate yathA
shlokas.132:
nAvanItaM hRRidayaM brAhmaNasya; vAchi kShuro nihitastIkShNadhAraH |
viparItametadubhayaM kShatriyasya; vA~NnAvanItI hRRidayaM tIkShNadhAram
shlokas.133:
iti |
tadevaM gate na shakto.ahaM tIkShNahRRidayatvAttaM shApamanyathA kartum |
gamyatAmiti
shlokas.134:
tamutta~NkaH pratyuvAcha |
bhavatAhamannasyAshuchibhAvamAgamayya pratyanunItaH |
prAkcha te.abhihitam |
yasmAdaduShTamannaM dUShayasi tasmAdanapatyo bhaviShyasIti |
duShTe chAnne naiSha mama shApo bhaviShyatIti
shlokas.136:
so.apashyatpathi nagnaM shramaNamAgachChantaM muhurmuhurdRRishyamAnamadRRishyamAnaM cha |
athotta~Nkaste kuNDale bhUmau nikShipyodakArthaM prachakrame
shlokas.137:
etasminnantare sa shramaNastvaramANa upasRRitya te kuNDale gRRihItvA prAdravat |
tamutta~Nko.abhisRRitya jagrAha |
sa tadrUpaM vihAya takShakarUpaM kRRitvA sahasA dharaNyAM vivRRitaM mahAbilaM vivesha
shlokas.138:
pravishya cha nAgalokaM svabhavanamagachChat |
tamutta~Nko.anvAvivesha tenaiva bilena |
pravishya cha nAgAnastuvadebhiH shlokaiH
shlokas.139:
ya airAvatarAjAnaH sarpAH samitishobhanAH |
varShanta iva jImUtAH savidyutpavaneritAH
shlokas.140:
surUpAshcha virUpAshcha tathA kalmAShakuNDalAH |
AdityavannAkapRRiShThe rejurairAvatodbhavAH
shlokas.141:
bahUni nAgavartmAni ga~NgAyAstIra uttare |
ichChetko.arkA.nshusenAyAM chartumairAvataM vinA
shlokas.142:
shatAnyashItiraShTau cha sahasrANi cha vi.nshatiH |
sarpANAM pragrahA yAnti dhRRitarAShTro yadejati
shlokas.143:
ye chainamupasarpanti ye cha dUraM paraM gatAH |
ahamairAvatajyeShThabhrAtRRibhyo.akaravaM namaH
shlokas.144:
yasya vAsaH kurukShetre khANDave chAbhavatsadA |
taM kAdraveyamastauShaM kuNDalArthAya takShakam
shlokas.145:
takShakashchAshvasenashcha nityaM sahacharAvubhau |
kurukShetre nivasatAM nadImikShumatImanu
shlokas.146:
jaghanyajastakShakasya shrutaseneti yaH shrutaH |
avasadyo mahaddyumni prArthayannAgamukhyatAm
karavANi sadA chAhaM namastasmai mahAtmane
shlokas.147: evaM stuvannapi nAgAnyadA te kuNDale nAlabhadathApashyatstriyau tantre adhiropya paTaM vayantyau
shlokas.148:
tasmi.nshcha tantre kRRiShNAH sitAshcha tantavaH |
chakraM chApashyatShaDbhiH kumAraiH parivartyamAnam |
puruShaM chApashyaddarshanIyam
shlokas.150:
trINyarpitAnyatra shatAni madhye; ShaShTishcha nityaM charati dhruve.asmin |
chakre chaturvi.nshatiparvayoge; ShaDyatkumArAH parivartayanti
shlokas.151:
tantraM chedaM vishvarUpaM yuvatyau; vayatastantUnsatataM vartayantyau |
kRRiShNAnsitA.nshchaiva vivartayantyau; bhUtAnyajasraM bhuvanAni chaiva
shlokas.152:
vajrasya bhartA bhuvanasya goptA; vRRitrasya hantA namuchernihantA |
kRRiShNe vasAno vasane mahAtmA; satyAnRRite yo vivinakti loke
shlokas.153:
yo vAjinaM garbhamapAM purANaM; vaishvAnaraM vAhanamabhyupetaH |
namaH sadAsmai jagadIshvarAya; lokatrayeshAya pura.ndarAya
shlokas.154:
tataH sa enaM puruShaH prAha |
prIto.asmi te.ahamanena stotreNa |
kiM te priyaM karavANIti
shlokas.156:
sa enaM puruShaH punaruvAcha |
etamashvamapAne dhamasveti
shlokas.159:
atha sasambhramastakShako.agnitejobhayaviShaNNaste kuNDale gRRihItvA sahasA svabhavanAnniShkramyotta~NkamuvAcha |
ete kuNDale pratigRRihNAtu bhavAniti
shlokas.160:
sa te pratijagrAhotta~NkaH |
kuNDale pratigRRihyAchintayat |
adya tatpuNyakamupAdhyAyinyAH |
dUraM chAhamabhyAgataH |
kathaM nu khalu sambhAvayeyamiti
shlokas.161:
tata enaM chintayAnameva sa puruSha uvAcha |
utta~Nka enamashvamadhiroha |
eSha tvAM kShaNAdevopAdhyAyakulaM prApayiShyatIti
shlokas.162:
sa tathetyuktvA tamashvamadhiruhya pratyAjagAmopAdhyAyakulam |
upAdhyAyinI cha snAtA keshAnAvapayantyupaviShTotta~Nko nAgachChatIti shApAyAsya mano dadhe
shlokas.163:
athotta~NkaH pravishya upAdhyAyinImabhyavAdayat |
te chAsyai kuNDale prAyachChat
shlokas.164:
sA chainaM pratyuvAcha |
utta~Nka deshe kAle.abhyAgataH |
svAgataM te vatsa |
manAgasi mayA na shaptaH |
shreyastavopasthitam |
siddhimApnuhIti
shlokas.165:
athotta~Nka upAdhyAyamabhyavAdayat |
tamupAdhyAyaH pratyuvAcha |
vatsotta~Nka svAgataM te |
kiM chiraM kRRitamiti
shlokas.166:
tamutta~Nka upAdhyAyaM pratyuvAcha |
bhostakShakeNa nAgarAjena vighnaH kRRito.asminkarmaNi |
tenAsmi nAgalokaM nItaH
shlokas.167:
tatra cha mayA dRRiShTe striyau tantre.adhiropya paTaM vayantyau |
tasmi.nshcha tantre kRRiShNAH sitAshcha tantavaH |
kiM tat
shlokas.168:
tatra cha mayA chakraM dRRiShTaM dvAdashAram |
ShaTchainaM kumArAH parivartayanti |
tadapi kim
shlokas.169:
puruShashchApi mayA dRRiShTaH |
sa punaH kaH
shlokas.171:
pathi gachChatA mayA RRiShabho dRRiShTaH |
taM cha puruSho.adhirUDhaH |
tenAsmi sopachAramuktaH |
utta~NkAsya RRiShabhasya purIShaM bhakShaya |
upAdhyAyenApi te bhakShitamiti |
tatastadvachanAnmayA tadRRiShabhasya purIShamupayuktam |
tadichChAmi bhavatopadiShTaM kiM taditi
shlokas.172:
tenaivamukta upAdhyAyaH pratyuvAcha |
ye te striyau dhAtA vidhAtA cha |
ye cha te kRRiShNAH sitAshcha tantavaste rAtryahanI
shlokas.173:
yadapi tachchakraM dvAdashAraM ShaTkumArAH parivartayanti te RRitavaH ShaTsa.nvatsarashchakram |
yaH puruShaH sa parjanyaH |
yo.ashvaH so.agniH
shlokas.174:
ya RRiShabhastvayA pathi gachChatA dRRiShTaH sa airAvato nAgarAjaH |
yashchainamadhirUDhaH sa indraH |
yadapi te purIShaM bhakShitaM tasya RRiShabhasya tadamRRitam
shlokas.175:
tena khalvasi na vyApannastasminnAgabhavane |
sa chApi mama sakhA indraH
shlokas.176:
tadanugrahAtkuNDale gRRihItvA punarabhyAgato.asi |
tatsaumya gamyatAm |
anujAne bhavantam |
shreyo.avApsyasIti
shlokas.177: sa upAdhyAyenAnuj~nAta utta~NkaH kruddhastakShakasya pratichikIrShamANo hAstinapuraM pratasthe
shlokas.178:
sa hAstinapuraM prApya nachirAddvijasattamaH |
samAgachChata rAjAnamutta~Nko janamejayam
shlokas.179:
purA takShashilAtastaM nivRRittamaparAjitam |
samyagvijayinaM dRRiShTvA samantAnmantribhirvRRitam
shlokas.180:
tasmai jayAshiShaH pUrvaM yathAnyAyaM prayujya saH |
uvAchainaM vachaH kAle shabdasampannayA girA
shlokas.181:
anyasminkaraNIye tvaM kArye pArthivasattama |
bAlyAdivAnyadeva tvaM kuruShe nRRipasattama
shlokas.182:
evamuktastu vipreNa sa rAjA pratyuvAcha ha |
janamejayaH prasannAtmA samyaksampUjya taM munim
shlokas.183:
AsAM prajAnAM paripAlanena; svaM kShatradharmaM paripAlayAmi |
prabrUhi vA kiM kriyatAM dvijendra; shushrUShurasmyadya vachastvadIyam
shlokas.184:
sa evamuktastu nRRipottamena; dvijottamaH puNyakRRitAM variShThaH |
uvAcha rAjAnamadInasattvaM; svameva kAryaM nRRipateshcha yattat
shlokas.185:
takShakeNa narendrendra yena te hi.nsitaH pitA |
tasmai pratikuruShva tvaM pannagAya durAtmane
shlokas.186:
kAryakAlaM cha manye.ahaM vidhidRRiShTasya karmaNaH |
tadgachChApachitiM rAjanpitustasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.187:
tena hyanaparAdhI sa daShTo duShTAntarAtmanA |
pa~nchatvamagamadrAjA vajrAhata iva drumaH
shlokas.188:
baladarpasamutsiktastakShakaH pannagAdhamaH |
akAryaM kRRitavAnpApo yo.adashatpitaraM tava
shlokas.189:
rAjarShiva.nshagoptAramamarapratimaM nRRipam |
jaghAna kAshyapaM chaiva nyavartayata pApakRRit
shlokas.190:
dagdhumarhasi taM pApaM jvalite havyavAhane |
sarpasatre mahArAja tvayi taddhi vidhIyate
shlokas.191:
evaM pitushchApachitiM gatavA.nstvaM bhaviShyasi |
mama priyaM cha sumahatkRRitaM rAjanbhaviShyati
shlokas.192:
karmaNaH pRRithivIpAla mama yena durAtmanA |
vighnaH kRRito mahArAja gurvarthaM charato.anagha
shlokas.193:
etachChrutvA tu nRRipatistakShakasya chukopa ha |
utta~NkavAkyahaviShA dIpto.agnirhaviShA yathA
shlokas.194:
apRRichChachcha tadA rAjA mantriNaH svAnsuduHkhitaH |
utta~Nkasyaiva sAMnidhye pituH svargagatiM prati
shlokas.195:
tadaiva hi sa rAjendro duHkhashokApluto.abhavat |
yadaiva pitaraM vRRittamutta~NkAdashRRiNottadA

shlokas.001: lomaharShaNaputra ugrashravAH sUtaH paurANiko naimiShAraNye shaunakasya kulapaterdvAdashavArShike satre RRiShInabhyAgatAnupatasthe
shlokas.002:
paurANikaH purANe kRRitashramaH sa tAnkRRitA~njaliruvAcha |
kiM bhavantaH shrotumichChanti |
kimahaM bruvANIti
shlokas.003:
tamRRiShaya UchuH |
paramaM lomaharShaNe prakShyAmastvAM vakShyasi cha naH shushrUShatAM kathAyogam |
tadbhagavA.nstu tAvachChaunako.agnisharaNamadhyAste
shlokas.4:
yo.asau divyAH kathA veda devatAsurasa~NkathAH |
manuShyoragagandharvakathA veda cha sarvashaH
shlokas.5:
sa chApyasminmakhe saute vidvAnkulapatirdvijaH |
dakSho dhRRitavrato dhImA~nshAstre chAraNyake guruH
shlokas.6:
satyavAdI shamaparastapasvI niyatavrataH |
sarveShAmeva no mAnyaH sa tAvatpratipAlyatAm
shlokas.7:
tasminnadhyAsati gurAvAsanaM paramArchitam |
tato vakShyasi yattvAM sa prakShyati dvijasattamaH
shlokas.8:
sUta uvAcha||
evamastu gurau tasminnupaviShTe mahAtmani |
tena pRRiShTaH kathAH puNyA vakShyAmi vividhAshrayAH
shlokas.9:
so.atha viprarShabhaH kAryaM kRRitvA sarvaM yathAkramam |
devAnvAgbhiH pitRRinadbhistarpayitvAjagAma ha
shlokas.10:
yatra brahmarShayaH siddhAsta AsInA yatavratAH |
yaj~nAyatanamAshritya sUtaputrapuraHsarAH
shlokas.11:
RRitvikShvatha sadasyeShu sa vai gRRihapatistataH |
upaviShTeShUpaviShTaH shaunako.athAbravIdidam

shlokas.1:
shaunaka uvAcha||
purANamakhilaM tAta pitA te.adhItavAnpurA |
kachchittvamapi tatsarvamadhIShe lomaharShaNe
shlokas.2:
purANe hi kathA divyA Adiva.nshAshcha dhImatAm |
kathyante tAH purAsmAbhiH shrutAH pUrvaM pitustava
shlokas.3:
tatra va.nshamahaM pUrvaM shrotumichChAmi bhArgavam |
kathayasva kathAmetAM kalyAH sma shravaNe tava
shlokas.4:
sUta uvAcha||
yadadhItaM purA samyagdvijashreShTha mahAtmabhiH |
vaishampAyanaviprAdyaistaishchApi kathitaM purA
shlokas.5:
yadadhItaM cha pitrA me samyakchaiva tato mayA |
tattAvachChRRiNu yo devaiH sendraiH sAgnimarudgaNaiH
pUjitaH pravaro va.nsho bhRRigUNAM bhRRigunandana
shlokas.6:
imaM va.nshamahaM brahmanbhArgavaM te mahAmune |
nigadAmi kathAyuktaM purANAshrayasa.nyutam
shlokas.7:
bhRRigoH sudayitaH putrashchyavano nAma bhArgavaH |
chyavanasyApi dAyAdaH pramatirnAma dhArmikaH
pramaterapyabhUtputro ghRRitAchyAM rururityuta
shlokas.8:
rurorapi suto jaj~ne shunako vedapAragaH |
pramadvarAyAM dharmAtmA tava pUrvapitAmahAt
shlokas.9:
tapasvI cha yashasvI cha shrutavAnbrahmavittamaH |
dharmiShThaH satyavAdI cha niyato niyatendriyaH
shlokas.10:
shaunaka uvAcha||
sUtaputra yathA tasya bhArgavasya mahAtmanaH |
chyavanatvaM parikhyAtaM tanmamAchakShva pRRichChataH
shlokas.11:
sUta uvAcha||
bhRRigoH sudayitA bhAryA pulometyabhivishrutA |
tasyAM garbhaH samabhavadbhRRigorvIryasamudbhavaH
shlokas.12:
tasmingarbhe sambhRRite.atha pulomAyAM bhRRigUdvaha |
samaye samashIlinyAM dharmapatnyAM yashasvinaH
shlokas.13:
abhiShekAya niShkrAnte bhRRigau dharmabhRRitAM vare |
AshramaM tasya rakSho.atha pulomAbhyAjagAma ha
shlokas.14:
taM pravishyAshramaM dRRiShTvA bhRRigorbhAryAmaninditAm |
hRRichChayena samAviShTo vichetAH samapadyata
shlokas.15:
abhyAgataM tu tadrakShaH pulomA chArudarshanA |
nyamantrayata vanyena phalamUlAdinA tadA
shlokas.16:
tAM tu rakShastato brahmanhRRichChayenAbhipIDitam |
dRRiShTvA hRRiShTamabhUttatra jihIrShustAmaninditAm
shlokas.17:
athAgnisharaNe.apashyajjvalitaM jAtavedasam |
tamapRRichChattato rakShaH pAvakaM jvalitaM tadA
shlokas.18:
sha.nsa me kasya bhAryeyamagne pRRiShTa RRitena vai |
satyastvamasi satyaM me vada pAvaka pRRichChate
shlokas.19:
mayA hIyaM pUrvavRRitA bhAryArthe varavarNinI |
pashchAttvimAM pitA prAdAdbhRRigave.anRRitakAriNe
shlokas.20:
seyaM yadi varArohA bhRRigorbhAryA rahogatA |
tathA satyaM samAkhyAhi jihIrShAmyAshramAdimAm
shlokas.21:
manyurhi hRRidayaM me.adya pradahanniva tiShThati |
matpurvabhAryAM yadimAM bhRRiguH prApa sumadhyamAm
shlokas.22:
tadrakSha evamAmantrya jvalitaM jAtavedasam |
sha~NkamAno bhRRigorbhAryAM punaH punarapRRichChata
shlokas.23:
tvamagne sarvabhUtAnAmantashcharasi nityadA |
sAkShivatpuNyapApeShu satyaM brUhi kave vachaH
shlokas.24:
matpUrvabhAryApahRRitA bhRRiguNAnRRitakAriNA |
seyaM yadi tathA me tvaM satyamAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.25:
shrutvA tvatto bhRRigorbhAryAM hariShyAmyahamAshramAt |
jAtavedaH pashyataste vada satyAM giraM mama
shlokas.26:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA saptArchirduHkhito bhRRisham |
bhIto.anRRitAchcha shApAchcha bhRRigorityabravIchChanaiH

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
agneratha vachaH shrutvA tadrakShaH prajahAra tAm |
brahmanvarAharUpeNa manomArutaraMhasA
shlokas.2:
tataH sa garbho nivasankukShau bhRRigukulodvaha |
roShAnmAtushchyutaH kukSheshchyavanastena so.abhavat
shlokas.3:
taM dRRiShTvA mAturudarAchchyutamAdityavarchasam |
tadrakSho bhasmasAdbhUtaM papAta parimuchya tAm
shlokas.4:
sA tamAdAya sushroNI sasAra bhRRigunandanam |
chyavanaM bhArgavaM brahmanpulomA duHkhamUrchChitA
shlokas.5:
tAM dadarsha svayaM brahmA sarvalokapitAmahaH |
rudatIM bAShpapUrNAkShIM bhRRigorbhAryAmaninditAm
sAntvayAmAsa bhagavAnvadhUM brahmA pitAmahaH
shlokas.6:
ashrubindUdbhavA tasyAH prAvartata mahAnadI |
anuvartatI sRRitiM tasyA bhRRigoH patnyA yashasvinaH
shlokas.7:
tasyA mArgaM sRRitavatIM dRRiShTvA tu saritaM tadA |
nAma tasyAstadA nadyAshchakre lokapitAmahaH
vadhUsareti bhagavA.nshchyavanasyAshramaM prati
shlokas.8:
sa evaM chyavano jaj~ne bhRRigoH putraH pratApavAn |
taM dadarsha pitA tatra chyavanaM tAM cha bhAminIm
shlokas.9:
sa pulomAM tato bhAryAM paprachCha kupito bhRRiguH |
