kenAsi rakShase tasmai kathiteha jihIrShave
na hi tvAM veda tadrakSho madbhAryAM chAruhAsinIm
shlokas.10:
tattvamAkhyAhi taM hyadya shaptumichChAmyahaM ruShA |
bibheti ko na shApAnme kasya chAyaM vyatikramaH
shlokas.11:
pulomovAcha||
agninA bhagava.nstasmai rakShase.ahaM niveditA |
tato mAmanayadrakShaH kroshantIM kurarImiva
shlokas.12:
sAhaM tava sutasyAsya tejasA parimokShitA |
bhasmIbhUtaM cha tadrakSho mAmutsRRijya papAta vai
shlokas.13:
sUta uvAcha||
iti shrutvA pulomAyA bhRRiguH paramamanyumAn |
shashApAgnimabhikruddhaH sarvabhakSho bhaviShyasi

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
shaptastu bhRRiguNA vahniH kruddho vAkyamathAbravIt |
kimidaM sAhasaM brahmankRRitavAnasi sAmpratam
shlokas.2:
dharme prayatamAnasya satyaM cha vadataH samam |
pRRiShTo yadabruvaM satyaM vyabhichAro.atra ko mama
shlokas.3:
pRRiShTo hi sAkShI yaH sAkShyaM jAnamAno.anyathA vadet |
sa pUrvAnAtmanaH sapta kule hanyAttathA parAn
shlokas.4:
yashcha kAryArthatattvaj~no jAnamAno na bhAShate |
so.api tenaiva pApena lipyate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.5:
shakto.ahamapi shaptuM tvAM mAnyAstu brAhmaNA mama |
jAnato.api cha te vyaktaM kathayiShye nibodha tat
shlokas.6:
yogena bahudhAtmAnaM kRRitvA tiShThAmi mUrtiShu |
agnihotreShu satreShu kriyAsvatha makheShu cha
shlokas.7:
vedoktena vidhAnena mayi yaddhUyate haviH |
devatAH pitarashchaiva tena tRRiptA bhavanti vai
shlokas.8:
Apo devagaNAH sarve ApaH pitRRigaNAstathA |
darshashcha paurNamAsashcha devAnAM pitRRibhiH saha
shlokas.9:
devatAH pitarastasmAtpitarashchApi devatAH |
ekIbhUtAshcha pUjyante pRRithaktvena cha parvasu
shlokas.10:
devatAH pitarashchaiva juhvate mayi yatsadA |
tridashAnAM pitRRiNAM cha mukhamevamahaM smRRitaH
shlokas.11:
amAvAsyAM cha pitaraH paurNamAsyAM cha devatAH |
manmukhenaiva hUyante bhu~njate cha hutaM haviH
sarvabhakShaH kathaM teShAM bhaviShyAmi mukhaM tvaham
shlokas.12:
chintayitvA tato vahnishchakre saMhAramAtmanaH |
dvijAnAmagnihotreShu yaj~nasatrakriyAsu cha
shlokas.13:
niro~NkAravaShaTkArAH svadhAsvAhAvivarjitAH |
vinAgninA prajAH sarvAstata AsansuduHkhitAH
shlokas.14:
atharShayaH samudvignA devAngatvAbruvanvachaH |
agninAshAtkriyAbhra.nshAdbhrAntA lokAstrayo.anaghAH
vidhadhvamatra yatkAryaM na syAtkAlAtyayo yathA
shlokas.15:
atharShayashcha devAshcha brahmANamupagamya tu |
agnerAvedaya~nshApaM kriyAsaMhArameva cha
shlokas.16:
bhRRiguNA vai mahAbhAga shapto.agniH kAraNAntare |
kathaM devamukho bhUtvA yaj~nabhAgAgrabhuktathA
hutabhuksarvalokeShu sarvabhakShatvameShyati
shlokas.17:
shrutvA tu tadvachasteShAmagnimAhUya lokakRRit |
uvAcha vachanaM shlakShNaM bhUtabhAvanamavyayam
shlokas.18:
lokAnAmiha sarveShAM tvaM kartA chAnta eva cha |
tvaM dhArayasi lokA.nstrInkriyANAM cha pravartakaH
sa tathA kuru lokesha nochChidyerankriyA yathA
shlokas.19:
kasmAdevaM vimUDhastvamIshvaraH sanhutAshanaH |
tvaM pavitraM yadA loke sarvabhUtagatashcha ha
shlokas.20:
na tvaM sarvasharIreNa sarvabhakShatvameShyasi |
upAdAne.archiSho yAste sarvaM dhakShyanti tAH shikhin
shlokas.21:
yathA sUryA.nshubhiH spRRiShTaM sarvaM shuchi vibhAvyate |
tathA tvadarchirnirdagdhaM sarvaM shuchi bhaviShyati
shlokas.22:
tadagne tvaM mahattejaH svaprabhAvAdvinirgatam |
svatejasaiva taM shApaM kuru satyamRRiShervibho
devAnAM chAtmano bhAgaM gRRihANa tvaM mukhe hutam
shlokas.23:
evamastviti taM vahniH pratyuvAcha pitAmaham |
jagAma shAsanaM kartuM devasya parameShThinaH
shlokas.24:
devarShayashcha muditAstato jagmuryathAgatam |
RRiShayashcha yathApUrvaM kriyAH sarvAH prachakrire
shlokas.25:
divi devA mumudire bhUtasa~NghAshcha laukikAH |
agnishcha paramAM prItimavApa hatakalmaShaH
shlokas.26:
evameSha purAvRRitta itihAso.agnishApajaH |
pulomasya vinAshashcha chyavanasya cha sambhavaH

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
sa chApi chyavano brahmanbhArgavo.ajanayatsutam |
sukanyAyAM mahAtmAnaM pramatiM dIptatejasam
shlokas.2:
pramatistu ruruM nAma ghRRitAchyAM samajIjanat |
ruruH pramadvarAyAM tu shunakaM samajIjanat
shlokas.3:
tasya brahmanruroH sarvaM charitaM bhUritejasaH |
vistareNa pravakShyAmi tachChRRiNu tvamasheShataH
shlokas.4:
RRiShirAsInmahAnpUrvaM tapovidyAsamanvitaH |
sthUlakesha iti khyAtaH sarvabhUtahite rataH
shlokas.5:
etasminneva kAle tu menakAyAM prajaj~nivAn |
gandharvarAjo viprarShe vishvAvasuriti shrutaH
shlokas.6:
athApsarA menakA sA taM garbhaM bhRRigunandana |
utsasarja yathAkAlaM sthUlakeshAshramaM prati
shlokas.7:
utsRRijya chaiva taM garbhaM nadyAstIre jagAma ha |
kanyAmamaragarbhAbhAM jvalantImiva cha shriyA
shlokas.8:
tAM dadarsha samutsRRiShTAM nadItIre mahAnRRiShiH |
sthUlakeshaH sa tejasvI vijane bandhuvarjitAm
shlokas.9:
sa tAM dRRiShTvA tadA kanyAM sthUlakesho dvijottamaH |
jagrAhAtha munishreShThaH kRRipAviShTaH pupoSha cha
vavRRidhe sA varArohA tasyAshramapade shubhA
shlokas.10:
pramadAbhyo varA sA tu sarvarUpaguNAnvitA |
tataH pramadvaretyasyA nAma chakre mahAnRRiShiH
shlokas.11:
tAmAshramapade tasya rururdRRiShTvA pramadvarAm |
babhUva kila dharmAtmA madanAnugatAtmavAn
shlokas.12:
pitaraM sakhibhiH so.atha vAchayAmAsa bhArgavaH |
pramatishchAbhyayAchChrutvA sthUlakeshaM yashasvinam
shlokas.13:
tataH prAdAtpitA kanyAM rurave tAM pramadvarAm |
vivAhaM sthApayitvAgre nakShatre bhagadaivate
shlokas.14:
tataH katipayAhasya vivAhe samupasthite |
sakhIbhiH krIDatI sArdhaM sA kanyA varavarNinI
shlokas.15:
nApashyata prasuptaM vai bhujagaM tiryagAyatam |
padA chainaM samAkrAmanmumUrShuH kAlachoditA
shlokas.16:
sa tasyAH sampramattAyAshchoditaH kAladharmaNA |
viShopaliptAndashanAnbhRRishama~Nge nyapAtayat
shlokas.17:
sA daShTA sahasA bhUmau patitA gatachetanA |
vyasuraprekShaNIyApi prekShaNIyatamAkRRitiH
shlokas.18:
prasuptevAbhavachchApi bhuvi sarpaviShArditA |
bhUyo manoharatarA babhUva tanumadhyamA
shlokas.19:
dadarsha tAM pitA chaiva te chaivAnye tapasvinaH |
vicheShTamAnAM patitAM bhUtale padmavarchasam
shlokas.20:
tataH sarve dvijavarAH samAjagmuH kRRipAnvitAH |
svastyAtreyo mahAjAnuH kushikaH sha~NkhamekhalaH
shlokas.21:
bhAradvAjaH kauNakutsa ArShTiSheNo.atha gautamaH |
pramatiH saha putreNa tathAnye vanavAsinaH
shlokas.22:
tAM te kanyAM vyasuM dRRiShTvA bhujagasya viShArditAm |
ruruduH kRRipayAviShTA rurustvArto bahiryayau

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
teShu tatropaviShTeShu brAhmaNeShu samantataH |
rurushchukrosha gahanaM vanaM gatvA suduHkhitaH
shlokas.2:
shokenAbhihataH so.atha vilapankaruNaM bahu |
abravIdvachanaM shochanpriyAM chintya pramadvarAm
shlokas.3:
shete sA bhuvi tanva~NgI mama shokavivardhinI |
bAndhavAnAM cha sarveShAM kiM nu duHkhamataH param
shlokas.4:
yadi dattaM tapastaptaM guravo vA mayA yadi |
samyagArAdhitAstena sa~njIvatu mama priyA
shlokas.5:
yathA janmaprabhRRiti vai yatAtmAhaM dhRRitavrataH |
pramadvarA tathAdyaiva samuttiShThatu bhAminI
shlokas.6:
devadUta uvAcha||
abhidhatse ha yadvAchA ruro duHkhena tanmRRiShA |
na tu martyasya dharmAtmannAyurasti gatAyuShaH
shlokas.7:
gatAyureShA kRRipaNA gandharvApsarasoH sutA |
tasmAchChoke manastAta mA kRRithAstvaM katha~nchana
shlokas.8:
upAyashchAtra vihitaH pUrvaM devairmahAtmabhiH |
taM yadIchChasi kartuM tvaM prApsyasImAM pramadvarAm
shlokas.9:
rururuvAcha||
ka upAyaH kRRito devairbrUhi tattvena khechara |
kariShye taM tathA shrutvA trAtumarhati mAM bhavAn
shlokas.10:
devadUta uvAcha||
AyuSho.ardhaM prayachChasva kanyAyai bhRRigunandana |
evamutthAsyati ruro tava bhAryA pramadvarA
shlokas.11:
rururuvAcha||
AyuSho.ardhaM prayachChAmi kanyAyai khecharottama |
shRRi~NgArarUpAbharaNA uttiShThatu mama priyA
shlokas.12:
sUta uvAcha||
tato gandharvarAjashcha devadUtashcha sattamau |
dharmarAjamupetyedaM vachanaM pratyabhAShatAm
shlokas.13:
dharmarAjAyuSho.ardhena rurorbhAryA pramadvarA |
samuttiShThatu kalyANI mRRitaiva yadi manyase
shlokas.14:
dharmarAja uvAcha||
pramadvarA rurorbhAryA devadUta yadIchChasi |
uttiShThatvAyuSho.ardhena ruroreva samanvitA
shlokas.15:
sUta uvAcha||
evamukte tataH kanyA sodatiShThatpramadvarA |
rurostasyAyuSho.ardhena supteva varavarNinI
shlokas.16:
etaddRRiShTaM bhaviShye hi ruroruttamatejasaH |
AyuSho.atipravRRiddhasya bhAryArthe.ardhaM hrasatviti
shlokas.17:
tata iShTe.ahani tayoH pitarau chakraturmudA |
vivAhaM tau cha remAte parasparahitaiShiNau
shlokas.18:
sa labdhvA durlabhAM bhAryAM padmaki~njalkasaprabhAm |
vrataM chakre vinAshAya jihmagAnAM dhRRitavrataH
shlokas.19:
sa dRRiShTvA jihmagAnsarvA.nstIvrakopasamanvitaH |
abhihanti yathAsannaM gRRihya praharaNaM sadA
shlokas.20:
sa kadAchidvanaM vipro rururabhyAgamanmahat |
shayAnaM tatra chApashyaDDuNDubhaM vayasAnvitam
shlokas.21:
tata udyamya daNDaM sa kAladaNDopamaM tadA |
abhyaghnadruShito viprastamuvAchAtha DuNDubhaH
shlokas.22:
nAparAdhyAmi te ki~nchidahamadya tapodhana |
sa.nrambhAttatkimarthaM mAmabhiha.nsi ruShAnvitaH

shlokas.1:
rururuvAcha||
mama prANasamA bhAryA daShTAsIdbhujagena ha |
tatra me samayo ghora Atmanoraga vai kRRitaH
shlokas.2:
hanyAM sadaiva bhujagaM yaM yaM pashyeyamityuta |
tato.ahaM tvAM jighA.nsAmi jIvitena vimokShyase
shlokas.3:
DuNDubha uvAcha||
anye te bhujagA vipra ye dashantIha mAnavAn |
DuNDubhAnahigandhena na tvaM hi.nsitumarhasi
shlokas.4:
ekAnarthAnpRRithagarthAnekaduHkhAnpRRithaksukhAn |
DuNDubhAndharmavidbhUtvA na tvaM hi.nsitumarhasi
shlokas.5:
sUta uvAcha||
iti shrutvA vachastasya bhujagasya rurustadA |
nAvadhIdbhayasa.nvigna RRiShiM matvAtha DuNDubham
shlokas.6:
uvAcha chainaM bhagavAnruruH sa.nshamayanniva |
kAmayA bhujaga brUhi ko.asImAM vikriyAM gataH
shlokas.7:
DuNDubha uvAcha||
ahaM purA ruro nAmnA RRiShirAsaM sahasrapAt |
so.ahaM shApena viprasya bhujagatvamupAgataH
shlokas.8:
rururuvAcha||
kimarthaM shaptavAnkruddho dvijastvAM bhujagottama |
kiyantaM chaiva kAlaM te vapuretadbhaviShyati

shlokas.1:
DuNDubha uvAcha||
sakhA babhUva me pUrvaM khagamo nAma vai dvijaH |
bhRRishaM sa.nshitavAktAta tapobalasamanvitaH
shlokas.2:
sa mayA krIDatA bAlye kRRitvA tArNamathoragam |
agnihotre prasaktaH sanbhIShitaH pramumoha vai
shlokas.3:
labdhvA cha sa punaH sa~nj~nAM mAmuvAcha tapodhanaH |
nirdahanniva kopena satyavAksa.nshitavrataH
shlokas.4:
yathAvIryastvayA sarpaH kRRito.ayaM madbibhIShayA |
tathAvIryo bhuja~NgastvaM mama kopAdbhaviShyasi
shlokas.5:
tasyAhaM tapaso vIryaM jAnamAnastapodhana |
bhRRishamudvignahRRidayastamavochaM vanaukasam
shlokas.6:
prayataH sambhramAchchaiva prA~njaliH praNataH sthitaH |
sakheti hasatedaM te narmArthaM vai kRRitaM mayA
shlokas.7:
kShantumarhasi me brahma~nshApo.ayaM vinivartyatAm |
so.atha mAmabravIddRRiShTvA bhRRishamudvignachetasam
shlokas.8:
muhuruShNaM viniHshvasya susambhrAntastapodhanaH |
nAnRRitaM vai mayA proktaM bhavitedaM katha~nchana
shlokas.9:
yattu vakShyAmi te vAkyaM shRRiNu tanme dhRRitavrata |
shrutvA cha hRRidi te vAkyamidamastu tapodhana
shlokas.10:
utpatsyati rururnAma pramaterAtmajaH shuchiH |
taM dRRiShTvA shApamokShaste bhavitA nachirAdiva
shlokas.11:
sa tvaM rururiti khyAtaH pramaterAtmajaH shuchiH |
svarUpaM pratilabhyAhamadya vakShyAmi te hitam
shlokas.12:
ahi.nsA paramo dharmaH sarvaprANabhRRitAM smRRitaH |
tasmAtprANabhRRitaH sarvAnna hi.nsyAdbrAhmaNaH kvachit
shlokas.13:
brAhmaNaH saumya eveha jAyateti parA shrutiH |
vedavedA~NgavittAta sarvabhUtAbhayapradaH
shlokas.14:
ahi.nsA satyavachanaM kShamA cheti vinishchitam |
brAhmaNasya paro dharmo vedAnAM dharaNAdapi
shlokas.15:
kShatriyasya tu yo dharmaH sa neheShyati vai tava |
daNDadhAraNamugratvaM prajAnAM paripAlanam
shlokas.16:
tadidaM kShatriyasyAsItkarma vai shRRiNu me ruro |
janamejayasya dharmAtmansarpANAM hi.nsanaM purA
shlokas.17:
paritrANaM cha bhItAnAM sarpANAM brAhmaNAdapi |
tapovIryabalopetAdvedavedA~NgapAragAt
AstIkAddvijamukhyAdvai sarpasatre dvijottama

shlokas.1:
rururuvAcha||
kathaM hi.nsitavAnsarpAnkShatriyo janamejayaH |
sarpA vA hi.nsitAstAta kimarthaM dvijasattama
shlokas.2:
kimarthaM mokShitAshchaiva pannagAstena sha.nsa me |
AstIkena tadAchakShva shrotumichChAmyasheShataH
shlokas.3:
RRiShiruvAcha||
shroShyasi tvaM ruro sarvamAstIkacharitaM mahat |
brAhmaNAnAM kathayatAmityuktvAntaradhIyata
shlokas.4:
sUta uvAcha||
rurushchApi vanaM sarvaM paryadhAvatsamantataH |
tamRRiShiM draShTumanvichChansa.nshrAnto nyapatadbhuvi
shlokas.5:
labdhasa~nj~no rurushchAyAttachchAchakhyau pitustadA |
pitA chAsya tadAkhyAnaM pRRiShTaH sarvaM nyavedayat

shlokas.1:
shaunaka uvAcha||
kimarthaM rAjashArdUlaH sa rAjA janamejayaH |
sarpasatreNa sarpANAM gato.antaM tadvadasva me
shlokas.2:
AstIkashcha dvijashreShThaH kimarthaM japatAM varaH |
mokShayAmAsa bhujagAndIptAttasmAddhutAshanAt
shlokas.3:
kasya putraH sa rAjAsItsarpasatraM ya Aharat |
sa cha dvijAtipravaraH kasya putro vadasva me
shlokas.4:
sUta uvAcha||
mahadAkhyAnamAstIkaM yatraitatprochyate dvija |
sarvametadasheSheNa shRRiNu me vadatAM vara
shlokas.5:
shaunaka uvAcha||
shrotumichChAmyasheSheNa kathAmetAM manoramAm |
AstIkasya purANasya brAhmaNasya yashasvinaH
shlokas.6:
sUta uvAcha||
itihAsamimaM vRRiddhAH purANaM parichakShate |
kRRiShNadvaipAyanaproktaM naimiShAraNyavAsinaH
shlokas.7:
pUrvaM prachoditaH sUtaH pitA me lomaharShaNaH |
shiShyo vyAsasya medhAvI brAhmaNairidamuktavAn
shlokas.8:
tasmAdahamupashrutya pravakShyAmi yathAtatham |
idamAstIkamAkhyAnaM tubhyaM shaunaka pRRichChate
shlokas.9:
AstIkasya pitA hyAsItprajApatisamaH prabhuH |
brahmachArI yatAhArastapasyugre rataH sadA
shlokas.10:
jaratkAruriti khyAta UrdhvaretA mahAnRRiShiH |
yAyAvarANAM dharmaj~naH pravaraH sa.nshitavrataH
shlokas.11:
aTamAnaH kadAchitsa svAndadarsha pitAmahAn |
lambamAnAnmahAgarte pAdairUrdhvairadhomukhAn
shlokas.12:
tAnabravItsa dRRiShTvaiva jaratkAruH pitAmahAn |
ke bhavanto.avalambante garte.asminvA adhomukhAH
shlokas.13:
vIraNastambake lagnAH sarvataH paribhakShite |
mUShakena nigUDhena garte.asminnityavAsinA
shlokas.14:
pitara UchuH||
yAyAvarA nAma vayamRRiShayaH sa.nshitavratAH |
santAnaprakShayAdbrahmannadho gachChAma medinIm
shlokas.15:
asmAkaM santatistveko jaratkAruriti shrutaH |
mandabhAgyo.alpabhAgyAnAM tapa eva samAsthitaH
shlokas.16:
na sa putrA~njanayituM dArAnmUDhashchikIrShati |
tena lambAmahe garte santAnaprakShayAdiha
shlokas.17:
anAthAstena nAthena yathA duShkRRitinastathA |
kastvaM bandhurivAsmAkamanushochasi sattama
shlokas.18:
j~nAtumichChAmahe brahmanko bhavAniha dhiShThitaH |
kimarthaM chaiva naH shochyAnanukampitumarhasi
shlokas.19:
jaratkAruruvAcha||
mama pUrve bhavanto vai pitaraH sapitAmahAH |
brUta kiM karavANyadya jaratkArurahaM svayam
shlokas.20:
pitara UchuH||
yatasva yatnavA.nstAta santAnAya kulasya naH |
Atmano.arthe.asmadarthe cha dharma ityeva chAbhibho
shlokas.21:
na hi dharmaphalaistAta na tapobhiH susa~nchitaiH |
tAM gatiM prApnuvantIha putriNo yAM vrajanti ha
shlokas.22:
taddAragrahaNe yatnaM santatyAM cha manaH kuru |
putrakAsmanniyogAttvametannaH paramaM hitam
shlokas.23:
jaratkAruruvAcha||
na dArAnvai kariShyAmi sadA me bhAvitaM manaH |
bhavatAM tu hitArthAya kariShye dArasa~Ngraham
shlokas.24:
samayena cha kartAhamanena vidhipUrvakam |
tathA yadyupalapsyAmi kariShye nAnyathA tvaham
shlokas.25:
sanAmnI yA bhavitrI me ditsitA chaiva bandhubhiH |
bhaikShavattAmahaM kanyAmupaya.nsye vidhAnataH
shlokas.26:
daridrAya hi me bhAryAM ko dAsyati visheShataH |
pratigrahIShye bhikShAM tu yadi kashchitpradAsyati
shlokas.27:
evaM dArakriyAhetoH prayatiShye pitAmahAH |
anena vidhinA shashvanna kariShye.ahamanyathA
shlokas.28:
tatra chotpatsyate janturbhavatAM tAraNAya vai |
shAshvataM sthAnamAsAdya modantAM pitaro mama
shlokas.29:
sUta uvAcha||
tato niveshAya tadA sa vipraH sa.nshitavrataH |
mahIM chachAra dArArthI na cha dArAnavindata
shlokas.30:
sa kadAchidvanaM gatvA vipraH pitRRivachaH smaran |
chukrosha kanyAbhikShArthI tisro vAchaH shanairiva
shlokas.31:
taM vAsukiH pratyagRRihNAdudyamya bhaginIM tadA |
na sa tAM pratijagrAha na sanAmnIti chintayan
shlokas.32:
sanAmnImudyatAM bhAryAM gRRihNIyAmiti tasya hi |
mano niviShTamabhavajjaratkArormahAtmanaH
shlokas.33:
tamuvAcha mahAprAj~no jaratkArurmahAtapAH |
kiMnAmnI bhaginIyaM te brUhi satyaM bhuja~Ngama
shlokas.34:
vAsukiruvAcha||
jaratkAro jaratkAruH svaseyamanujA mama |
tvadarthaM rakShitA pUrvaM pratIchChemAM dvijottama
shlokas.35:
sUta uvAcha||
mAtrA hi bhujagAH shaptAH pUrvaM brahmavidAM vara |
janamejayasya vo yaj~ne dhakShyatyanilasArathiH
shlokas.36:
tasya shApasya shAntyarthaM pradadau pannagottamaH |
svasAramRRiShaye tasmai suvratAya tapasvine
shlokas.37:
sa cha tAM pratijagrAha vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA |
AstIko nAma putrashcha tasyAM jaj~ne mahAtmanaH
shlokas.38:
tapasvI cha mahAtmA cha vedavedA~NgapAragaH |
samaH sarvasya lokasya pitRRimAtRRibhayApahaH
shlokas.39:
atha kAlasya mahataH pANDaveyo narAdhipaH |
AjahAra mahAyaj~naM sarpasatramiti shrutiH
shlokas.40:
tasminpravRRitte satre tu sarpANAmantakAya vai |
mochayAmAsa taM shApamAstIkaH sumahAyashAH
shlokas.41:
nAgA.nshcha mAtulA.nshchaiva tathA chAnyAnsa bAndhavAn |
pitRRi.nshcha tArayAmAsa santatyA tapasA tathA
vrataishcha vividhairbrahmansvAdhyAyaishchAnRRiNo.abhavat
shlokas.42:
devA.nshcha tarpayAmAsa yaj~nairvividhadakShiNaiH |
RRiShI.nshcha brahmacharyeNa santatyA cha pitAmahAn
shlokas.43:
apahRRitya guruM bhAraM pitRRiNAM sa.nshitavrataH |
jaratkArurgataH svargaM sahitaH svaiH pitAmahaiH
shlokas.44:
AstIkaM cha sutaM prApya dharmaM chAnuttamaM muniH |
jaratkAruH sumahatA kAlena svargamIyivAn
shlokas.45:
etadAkhyAnamAstIkaM yathAvatkIrtitaM mayA |
prabrUhi bhRRigushArdUla kiM bhUyaH kathyatAmiti

shlokas.1:
shaunaka uvAcha||
saute kathaya tAmetAM vistareNa kathAM punaH |
AstIkasya kaveH sAdhoH shushrUShA paramA hi naH
shlokas.2:
madhuraM kathyate saumya shlakShNAkSharapadaM tvayA |
prIyAmahe bhRRishaM tAta pitevedaM prabhAShase
shlokas.3:
asmachChushrUShaNe nityaM pitA hi niratastava |
AchaShTaitadyathAkhyAnaM pitA te tvaM tathA vada
shlokas.4:
sUta uvAcha||
AyuShyamidamAkhyAnamAstIkaM kathayAmi te |
yathA shrutaM kathayataH sakAshAdvai piturmayA
shlokas.5:
purA devayuge brahmanprajApatisute shubhe |
AstAM bhaginyau rUpeNa samupete.adbhute.anaghe
shlokas.6:
te bhArye kashyapasyAstAM kadrUshcha vinatA cha ha |
prAdAttAbhyAM varaM prItaH prajApatisamaH patiH
kashyapo dharmapatnIbhyAM mudA paramayA yutaH
shlokas.7:
varAtisargaM shrutvaiva kashyapAduttamaM cha te |
harShAdapratimAM prItiM prApatuH sma varastriyau
shlokas.8:
vavre kadrUH sutAnnAgAnsahasraM tulyatejasaH |
dvau putrau vinatA vavre kadrUputrAdhikau bale
ojasA tejasA chaiva vikrameNAdhikau sutau
shlokas.9:
tasyai bhartA varaM prAdAdadhyardhaM putramIpsitam |
evamastviti taM chAha kashyapaM vinatA tadA
shlokas.10:
kRRitakRRityA tu vinatA labdhvA vIryAdhikau sutau |
kadrUshcha labdhvA putrANAM sahasraM tulyatejasAm
shlokas.11:
dhAryau prayatnato garbhAvityuktvA sa mahAtapAH |
te bhArye varasaMhRRiShTe kashyapo vanamAvishat
shlokas.12:
kAlena mahatA kadrUraNDAnAM dashatIrdasha |
janayAmAsa viprendra dve aNDe vinatA tadA
shlokas.13:
tayoraNDAni nidadhuH prahRRiShTAH parichArikAH |
sopasvedeShu bhANDeShu pa~ncha varShashatAni cha
shlokas.14:
tataH pa~nchashate kAle kadrUputrA viniHsRRitAH |
aNDAbhyAM vinatAyAstu mithunaM na vyadRRishyata
shlokas.15:
tataH putrArthiNI devI vrIDitA sA tapasvinI |
aNDaM bibheda vinatA tatra putramadRRikShata
shlokas.16:
pUrvArdhakAyasampannamitareNAprakAshatA |
sa putro roShasampannaH shashApainAmiti shrutiH
shlokas.17:
yo.ahamevaM kRRito mAtastvayA lobhaparItayA |
sharIreNAsamagro.adya tasmAddAsI bhaviShyasi
shlokas.18:
pa~ncha varShashatAnyasyA yayA vispardhase saha |
eSha cha tvAM suto mAtardAsyatvAnmokShayiShyati
shlokas.19:
yadyenamapi mAtastvaM mAmivANDavibhedanAt |
na kariShyasyadehaM vA vya~NgaM vApi tapasvinam
shlokas.20:
pratipAlayitavyaste janmakAlo.asya dhIrayA |
vishiShTabalamIpsantyA pa~nchavarShashatAtparaH
shlokas.21:
evaM shaptvA tataH putro vinatAmantarikShagaH |
aruNo dRRishyate brahmanprabhAtasamaye sadA
shlokas.22:
garuDo.api yathAkAlaM jaj~ne pannagasUdanaH |
sa jAtamAtro vinatAM parityajya khamAvishat
shlokas.23:
AdAsyannAtmano bhojyamannaM vihitamasya yat |
vidhAtrA bhRRigushArdUla kShudhitasya bubhukShataH

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
etasminneva kAle tu bhaginyau te tapodhana |
apashyatAM samAyAntamuchchaiHshravasamantikAt
shlokas.2:
yaM taM devagaNAH sarve hRRiShTarUpA apUjayan |
mathyamAne.amRRite jAtamashvaratnamanuttamam
shlokas.3:
mahaughabalamashvAnAmuttamaM javatAM varam |
shrImantamajaraM divyaM sarvalakShaNalakShitam
shlokas.4:
shaunaka uvAcha||
kathaM tadamRRitaM devairmathitaM kva cha sha.nsa me |
yatra jaj~ne mahAvIryaH so.ashvarAjo mahAdyutiH
shlokas.5:
sUta uvAcha||
jvalantamachalaM meruM tejorAshimanuttamam |
AkShipantaM prabhAM bhAnoH svashRRi~NgaiH kA~nchanojjvalaiH
shlokas.6:
kA~nchanAbharaNaM chitraM devagandharvasevitam |
aprameyamanAdhRRiShyamadharmabahulairjanaiH
shlokas.7:
vyAlairAcharitaM ghorairdivyauShadhividIpitam |
nAkamAvRRitya tiShThantamuchChrayeNa mahAgirim
shlokas.8:
agamyaM manasApyanyairnadIvRRikShasamanvitam |
nAnApatagasa~Nghaishcha nAditaM sumanoharaiH
shlokas.9:
tasya pRRiShThamupAruhya bahuratnAchitaM shubham |
anantakalpamudviddhaM surAH sarve mahaujasaH
shlokas.10:
te mantrayitumArabdhAstatrAsInA divaukasaH |
amRRitArthe samAgamya taponiyamasa.nsthitAH
shlokas.11:
tatra nArAyaNo devo brahmANamidamabravIt |
chintayatsu sureShvevaM mantrayatsu cha sarvashaH
shlokas.12:
devairasurasa~Nghaishcha mathyatAM kalashodadhiH |
bhaviShyatyamRRitaM tatra mathyamAne mahodadhau
shlokas.13:
sarvauShadhIH samAvApya sarvaratnAni chaiva hi |
manthadhvamudadhiM devA vetsyadhvamamRRitaM tataH

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
tato.abhrashikharAkArairgirishRRi~Ngairala~NkRRitam |
mandaraM parvatavaraM latAjAlasamAvRRitam
shlokas.2:
nAnAvihagasa~NghuShTaM nAnAdaMShTrisamAkulam |
kiMnarairapsarobhishcha devairapi cha sevitam
shlokas.3:
ekAdasha sahasrANi yojanAnAM samuchChritam |
adho bhUmeH sahasreShu tAvatsveva pratiShThitam
shlokas.4:
tamuddhartuM na shaktA vai sarve devagaNAstadA |
viShNumAsInamabhyetya brahmANaM chedamabruvan
shlokas.5:
bhavantAvatra kurutAM buddhiM naiHshreyasIM parAm |
mandaroddharaNe yatnaH kriyatAM cha hitAya naH
shlokas.6:
tatheti chAbravIdviShNurbrahmaNA saha bhArgava |
tato.anantaH samutthAya brahmaNA parichoditaH
nArAyaNena chApyuktastasminkarmaNi vIryavAn
shlokas.7:
atha parvatarAjAnaM tamananto mahAbalaH |
ujjahAra balAdbrahmansavanaM savanaukasam
shlokas.8:
tatastena surAH sArdhaM samudramupatasthire |
tamUchuramRRitArthAya nirmathiShyAmahe jalam
shlokas.9:
apAmpatirathovAcha mamApya.nsho bhavettataH |
soDhAsmi vipulaM mardaM mandarabhramaNAditi
shlokas.10:
Uchushcha kUrmarAjAnamakUpAraM surAsurAH |
gireradhiShThAnamasya bhavAnbhavitumarhati
shlokas.11:
kUrmeNa tu tathetyuktvA pRRiShThamasya samarpitam |
tasya shailasya chAgraM vai yantreNendro.abhyapIDayat
shlokas.12:
manthAnaM mandaraM kRRitvA tathA netraM cha vAsukim |
devA mathitumArabdhAH samudraM nidhimambhasAm
amRRitArthinastato brahmansahitA daityadAnavAH
shlokas.13:
ekamantamupAshliShTA nAgarAj~no mahAsurAH |
vibudhAH sahitAH sarve yataH puchChaM tataH sthitAH
shlokas.14:
ananto bhagavAndevo yato nArAyaNastataH |
shira udyamya nAgasya punaH punaravAkShipat
shlokas.15:
vAsukeratha nAgasya sahasAkShipyataH suraiH |
sadhUmAH sArchiSho vAtA niShpeturasakRRinmukhAt
shlokas.16:
te dhUmasa~NghAH sambhUtA meghasa~NghAH savidyutaH |
abhyavarShansuragaNA~nshramasantApakarshitAn
shlokas.17:
tasmAchcha girikUTAgrAtprachyutAH puShpavRRiShTayaH |
surAsuragaNAnmAlyaiH sarvataH samavAkiran
shlokas.18:
babhUvAtra mahAghoSho mahAmegharavopamaH |
udadhermathyamAnasya mandareNa surAsuraiH
shlokas.19:
tatra nAnAjalacharA viniShpiShTA mahAdriNA |
vilayaM samupAjagmuH shatasho lavaNAmbhasi
shlokas.20:
vAruNAni cha bhUtAni vividhAni mahIdharaH |
pAtAlatalavAsIni vilayaM samupAnayat
shlokas.21:
tasmi.nshcha bhrAmyamANe.adrau sa~NghRRiShyantaH parasparam |
nyapatanpatagopetAH parvatAgrAnmahAdrumAH
shlokas.22:
teShAM sa~NgharShajashchAgnirarchirbhiH prajvalanmuhuH |
vidyudbhiriva nIlAbhramAvRRiNonmandaraM girim
shlokas.23:
dadAha ku~njarA.nshchaiva siMhA.nshchaiva viniHsRRitAn |
vigatAsUni sarvANi sattvAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.24:
tamagnimamarashreShThaH pradahantaM tatastataH |
vAriNA meghajenendraH shamayAmAsa sarvataH
shlokas.25:
tato nAnAvidhAstatra susruvuH sAgarAmbhasi |
mahAdrumANAM niryAsA bahavashchauShadhIrasAH
shlokas.26:
teShAmamRRitavIryANAM rasAnAM payasaiva cha |
amaratvaM surA jagmuH kA~nchanasya cha niHsravAt
shlokas.27:
atha tasya samudrasya tajjAtamudakaM payaH |
rasottamairvimishraM cha tataH kShIrAdabhUdghRRitam
shlokas.28:
tato brahmANamAsInaM devA varadamabruvan |
shrAntAH sma subhRRishaM brahmannodbhavatyamRRitaM cha tat
shlokas.29:
RRite nArAyaNaM devaM daityA nAgottamAstathA |
chirArabdhamidaM chApi sAgarasyApi manthanam
shlokas.30:
tato nArAyaNaM devaM brahmA vachanamabravIt |
vidhatsvaiShAM balaM viShNo bhavAnatra parAyaNam
shlokas.31:
viShNuruvAcha||
balaM dadAmi sarveShAM karmaitadye samAsthitAH |
kShobhyatAM kalashaH sarvairmandaraH parivartyatAm
shlokas.32:
sUta uvAcha||
nArAyaNavachaH shrutvA balinaste mahodadheH |
tatpayaH sahitA bhUyashchakrire bhRRishamAkulam
shlokas.33:
tataH shatasahasrA.nshuH samAna iva sAgarAt |
prasannabhAH samutpannaH somaH shItA.nshurujjvalaH
shlokas.34:
shrIranantaramutpannA ghRRitAtpANDuravAsinI |
surA devI samutpannA turagaH pANDurastathA
shlokas.35:
kaustubhashcha maNirdivya utpanno.amRRitasambhavaH |
marIchivikachaH shrImAnnArAyaNa urogataH
shlokas.36:
shrIH surA chaiva somashcha turagashcha manojavaH |
yato devAstato jagmurAdityapathamAshritAH
shlokas.37:
dhanvantaristato devo vapuShmAnudatiShThata |
shvetaM kamaNDaluM bibhradamRRitaM yatra tiShThati
shlokas.38:
etadatyadbhutaM dRRiShTvA dAnavAnAM samutthitaH |
amRRitArthe mahAnnAdo mamedamiti jalpatAm
shlokas.39:
tato nArAyaNo mAyAmAsthito mohinIM prabhuH |
strIrUpamadbhutaM kRRitvA dAnavAnabhisa.nshritaH
shlokas.40:
tatastadamRRitaM tasyai daduste mUDhachetasaH |
striyai dAnavadaiteyAH sarve tadgatamAnasAH

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
athAvaraNamukhyAni nAnApraharaNAni cha |
pragRRihyAbhyadravandevAnsahitA daityadAnavAH
shlokas.2:
tatastadamRRitaM devo viShNurAdAya vIryavAn |
jahAra dAnavendrebhyo nareNa sahitaH prabhuH
shlokas.3:
tato devagaNAH sarve papustadamRRitaM tadA |
viShNoH sakAshAtsamprApya sambhrame tumule sati
shlokas.4:
tataH pibatsu tatkAlaM deveShvamRRitamIpsitam |
rAhurvibudharUpeNa dAnavaH prApibattadA
shlokas.5:
tasya kaNThamanuprApte dAnavasyAmRRite tadA |
AkhyAtaM chandrasUryAbhyAM surANAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.6:
tato bhagavatA tasya shirashChinnamala~NkRRitam |
chakrAyudhena chakreNa pibato.amRRitamojasA
shlokas.7:
tachChailashRRi~NgapratimaM dAnavasya shiro mahat |
chakreNotkRRittamapatachchAlayadvasudhAtalam
shlokas.8:
tato vairavinirbandhaH kRRito rAhumukhena vai |
shAshvatashchandrasUryAbhyAM grasatyadyApi chaiva tau
shlokas.9:
vihAya bhagavA.nshchApi strIrUpamatulaM hariH |
nAnApraharaNairbhImairdAnavAnsamakampayat
shlokas.10:
tataH pravRRittaH sa~NgrAmaH samIpe lavaNAmbhasaH |
surANAmasurANAM cha sarvaghorataro mahAn
shlokas.11:
prAsAH suvipulAstIkShNA nyapatanta sahasrashaH |
tomarAshcha sutIkShNAgrAH shastrANi vividhAni cha
shlokas.12:
tato.asurAshchakrabhinnA vamanto rudhiraM bahu |
asishaktigadArugNA nipeturdharaNItale
shlokas.13:
ChinnAni paTTishaishchApi shirA.nsi yudhi dAruNe |
taptakA~nchanajAlAni nipeturanishaM tadA
shlokas.14:
rudhireNAvaliptA~NgA nihatAshcha mahAsurAH |
adrINAmiva kUTAni dhAturaktAni sherate
shlokas.15:
hAhAkAraH samabhavattatra tatra sahasrashaH |
anyonyaM ChindatAM shastrairAditye lohitAyati
shlokas.16:
parighaishchAyasaiH pItaiH saMnikarShe cha muShTibhiH |
nighnatAM samare.anyonyaM shabdo divamivAspRRishat
shlokas.17:
Chindhi bhindhi pradhAvadhvaM pAtayAbhisareti cha |
vyashrUyanta mahAghorAH shabdAstatra samantataH
shlokas.18:
evaM sutumule yuddhe vartamAne bhayAvahe |
naranArAyaNau devau samAjagmaturAhavam
shlokas.19:
tatra divyaM dhanurdRRiShTvA narasya bhagavAnapi |
chintayAmAsa vai chakraM viShNurdAnavasUdanam
shlokas.20:
tato.ambarAchchintitamAtramAgataM; mahAprabhaM chakramamitratApanam |
vibhAvasostulyamakuNThamaNDalaM; sudarshanaM bhImamajayyamuttamam
shlokas.21:
tadAgataM jvalitahutAshanaprabhaM; bhaya~NkaraM karikarabAhurachyutaH |
mumocha vai chapalamudagravegava;nmahAprabhaM paranagarAvadAraNam
shlokas.22:
tadantakajvalanasamAnavarchasaM; punaH punarnyapatata vegavattadA |
vidArayadditidanujAnsahasrashaH; kareritaM puruShavareNa sa.nyuge
shlokas.23:
dahatkvachijjvalana ivAvaleliha;tprasahya tAnasuragaNAnnyakRRintata |
praveritaM viyati muhuH kShitau tadA; papau raNe rudhiramatho pishAchavat
shlokas.24:
athAsurA giribhiradInachetaso; muhurmuhuH suragaNamardaya.nstadA |
mahAbalA vigalitameghavarchasaH; sahasrasho gaganamabhiprapadya ha
shlokas.25:
athAmbarAdbhayajananAH prapedire; sapAdapA bahuvidhamegharUpiNaH |
mahAdrayaH pravigalitAgrasAnavaH; parasparaM drutamabhihatya sasvanAH
shlokas.26:
tato mahI pravichalitA sakAnanA; mahAdripAtAbhihatA samantataH |
parasparaM bhRRishamabhigarjatAM muhU; raNAjire bhRRishamabhisampravartite
shlokas.27:
narastato varakanakAgrabhUShaNai;rmaheShubhirgaganapathaM samAvRRiNot |
vidArayangirishikharANi patribhi;rmahAbhaye.asuragaNavigrahe tadA
shlokas.28:
tato mahIM lavaNajalaM cha sAgaraM; mahAsurAH pravivishurarditAH suraiH |
viyadgataM jvalitahutAshanaprabhaM; sudarshanaM parikupitaM nishAmya cha
shlokas.29:
tataH surairvijayamavApya mandaraH; svameva deshaM gamitaH supUjitaH |
vinAdya khaM divamapi chaiva sarvasha;stato gatAH saliladharA yathAgatam
shlokas.30:
tato.amRRitaM sunihitameva chakrire; surAH parAM mudamabhigamya puShkalAm |
dadau cha taM nidhimamRRitasya rakShituM; kirITine balabhidathAmaraiH saha

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
etatte sarvamAkhyAtamamRRitaM mathitaM yathA |
yatra so.ashvaH samutpannaH shrImAnatulavikramaH
shlokas.2:
yaM nishAmya tadA kadrUrvinatAmidamabravIt |
uchchaiHshravA nu ki.nvarNo bhadre jAnIhi mAchiram
shlokas.3:
vinatovAcha||
shveta evAshvarAjo.ayaM kiM vA tvaM manyase shubhe |
brUhi varNaM tvamapyasya tato.atra vipaNAvahe
shlokas.4:
kadrUruvAcha||
kRRiShNavAlamahaM manye hayamenaM shuchismite |
ehi sArdhaM mayA dIvya dAsIbhAvAya bhAmini
shlokas.5:
sUta uvAcha||
evaM te samayaM kRRitvA dAsIbhAvAya vai mithaH |
jagmatuH svagRRihAneva shvo drakShyAva iti sma ha
shlokas.6:
tataH putrasahasraM tu kadrUrjihmaM chikIrShatI |
Aj~nApayAmAsa tadA vAlA bhUtvA~njanaprabhAH
shlokas.7:
AvishadhvaM hayaM kShipraM dAsI na syAmahaM yathA |
tadvAkyaM nAnvapadyanta tA~nshashApa bhuja~NgamAn
shlokas.8:
sarpasatre vartamAne pAvako vaH pradhakShyati |
janamejayasya rAjarSheH pANDaveyasya dhImataH
shlokas.9:
shApamenaM tu shushrAva svayameva pitAmahaH |
atikrUraM samuddiShTaM kadrvA daivAdatIva hi
shlokas.10:
sArdhaM devagaNaiH sarvairvAchaM tAmanvamodata |
bahutvaM prekShya sarpANAM prajAnAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.11:
tigmavIryaviShA hyete dandashUkA mahAbalAH |
teShAM tIkShNaviShatvAddhi prajAnAM cha hitAya vai
prAdAdviShahaNIM vidyAM kAshyapAya mahAtmane

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
tato rajanyAM vyuShTAyAM prabhAta udite ravau |
kadrUshcha vinatA chaiva bhaginyau te tapodhana
shlokas.2:
amarShite susa.nrabdhe dAsye kRRitapaNe tadA |
jagmatusturagaM draShTumuchChaiHshravasamantikAt
shlokas.3:
dadRRishAte tadA tatra samudraM nidhimambhasAm |
timi~NgilajhaShAkIrNaM makarairAvRRitaM tathA
shlokas.4:
sattvaishcha bahusAhasrairnAnArUpaiH samAvRRitam |
ugrairnityamanAdhRRiShyaM kUrmagrAhasamAkulam
shlokas.5:
AkaraM sarvaratnAnAmAlayaM varuNasya cha |
nAgAnAmAlayaM ramyamuttamaM saritAM patim
shlokas.6:
pAtAlajvalanAvAsamasurANAM cha bandhanam |
bhaya~NkaraM cha sattvAnAM payasAM nidhimarNavam
shlokas.7:
shubhaM divyamamartyAnAmamRRitasyAkaraM param |
aprameyamachintyaM cha supuNyajalamadbhutam
shlokas.8:
ghoraM jalacharArAvaraudraM bhairavanisvanam |
gambhIrAvartakalilaM sarvabhUtabhaya~Nkaram
shlokas.9:
velAdolAnilachalaM kShobhodvegasamutthitam |
vIchIhastaiH prachalitairnRRityantamiva sarvashaH
shlokas.10:
chandravRRiddhikShayavashAdudvRRittormidurAsadam |
pA~nchajanyasya jananaM ratnAkaramanuttamam
shlokas.11:
gAM vindatA bhagavatA govindenAmitaujasA |
varAharUpiNA chAntarvikShobhitajalAvilam
shlokas.12:
brahmarShiNA cha tapatA varShANAM shatamatriNA |
anAsAditagAdhaM cha pAtAlatalamavyayam
shlokas.13:
adhyAtmayoganidrAM cha padmanAbhasya sevataH |
yugAdikAlashayanaM viShNoramitatejasaH
shlokas.14:
vaDavAmukhadIptAgnestoyahavyapradaM shubham |
agAdhapAraM vistIrNamaprameyaM saritpatim
shlokas.15:
mahAnadIbhirbahvIbhiH spardhayeva sahasrashaH |
abhisAryamANamanishaM dadRRishAte mahArNavam
shlokas.16:
gambhIraM timimakarograsa~NkulaM taM; garjantaM jalachararAvaraudranAdaiH |
vistIrNaM dadRRishaturambaraprakAshaM; te.agAdhaM nidhimurumambhasAmanantam
shlokas.17:
ityevaM jhaShamakarormisa~NkulaM taM; gambhIraM vikasitamambaraprakAsham |
pAtAlajvalanashikhAvidIpitaM taM; pashyantyau drutamabhipetatustadAnIm

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
taM samudramatikramya kadrUrvinatayA saha |
nyapatatturagAbhyAshe nachirAdiva shIghragA
shlokas.2:
nishAmya cha bahUnvAlAnkRRiShNAnpuchChaM samAshritAn |
vinatAM viShaNNavadanAM kadrUrdAsye nyayojayat
shlokas.3:
tataH sA vinatA tasminpaNitena parAjitA |
abhavadduHkhasantaptA dAsIbhAvaM samAsthitA
shlokas.4:
etasminnantare chaiva garuDaH kAla Agate |
vinA mAtrA mahAtejA vidAryANDamajAyata
shlokas.5:
agnirAshirivodbhAsansamiddho.atibhaya~NkaraH |
pravRRiddhaH sahasA pakShI mahAkAyo nabhogataH
shlokas.6:
taM dRRiShTvA sharaNaM jagmuH prajAH sarvA vibhAvasum |
praNipatyAbruva.nshchainamAsInaM vishvarUpiNam
shlokas.7:
agne mA tvaM pravardhiShThAH kachchinno na didhakShasi |
asau hi rAshiH sumahAnsamiddhastava sarpati
shlokas.8:
agniruvAcha||
naitadevaM yathA yUyaM manyadhvamasurArdanAH |
garuDo balavAneSha mama tulyaH svatejasA
shlokas.9:
sUta uvAcha||
evamuktAstato gatvA garuDaM vAgbhirastuvan |
adUrAdabhyupetyainaM devAH sarShigaNAstadA
shlokas.10:
tvamRRiShistvaM mahAbhAgastvaM devaH patageshvaraH |
tvaM prabhustapanaprakhyastvaM nastrANamanuttamam
shlokas.11:
balormimAnsAdhuradInasattvaH; samRRiddhimAnduShprasahastvameva |
tapaH shrutaM sarvamahInakIrte; anAgataM chopagataM cha sarvam
shlokas.12:
tvamuttamaH sarvamidaM charAcharaM; gabhastibhirbhAnurivAvabhAsase |
samAkShipanbhAnumataH prabhAM muhu;stvamantakaH sarvamidaM dhruvAdhruvam
shlokas.13:
divAkaraH parikupito yathA dahe;tprajAstathA dahasi hutAshanaprabha |
bhaya~NkaraH pralaya ivAgnirutthito; vinAshayanyugaparivartanAntakRRit
shlokas.14:
khageshvaraM sharaNamupasthitA vayaM; mahaujasaM vitimiramabhragocharam |
mahAbalaM garuDamupetya khecharaM; parAvaraM varadamajayyavikramam
shlokas.15:
evaM stutaH suparNastu devaiH sarShigaNaistadA |
tejasaH pratisaMhAramAtmanaH sa chakAra ha

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
tataH kAmagamaH pakShI mahAvIryo mahAbalaH |
mAturantikamAgachChatparaM tIraM mahodadheH
shlokas.2:
yatra sA vinatA tasminpaNitena parAjitA |
atIva duHkhasantaptA dAsIbhAvamupAgatA
shlokas.3:
tataH kadAchidvinatAM pravaNAM putrasaMnidhau |
kAla AhUya vachanaM kadrUridamabhAShata
shlokas.4:
nAgAnAmAlayaM bhadre suramyaM ramaNIyakam |
samudrakukShAvekAnte tatra mAM vinate vaha
shlokas.5:
tataH suparNamAtA tAmavahatsarpamAtaram |
pannagAngaruDashchApi mAturvachanachoditaH
shlokas.6:
sa sUryasyAbhito yAti vainateyo viha~NgamaH |
sUryarashmiparItAshcha mUrchChitAH pannagAbhavan
tadavasthAnsutAndRRiShTvA kadrUH shakramathAstuvat
shlokas.7:
namaste devadevesha namaste balasUdana |
namuchighna namaste.astu sahasrAkSha shachIpate
shlokas.8:
sarpANAM sUryataptAnAM vAriNA tvaM plavo bhava |
tvameva paramaM trANamasmAkamamarottama
shlokas.9:
Isho hyasi payaH sraShTuM tvamanalpaM pura.ndara |
tvameva meghastvaM vAyustvamagnirvaidyuto.ambare
shlokas.10:
tvamabhraghanavikSheptA tvAmevAhuH punarghanam |
tvaM vajramatulaM ghoraM ghoShavA.nstvaM balAhakaH
shlokas.11:
sraShTA tvameva lokAnAM saMhartA chAparAjitaH |
tvaM jyotiH sarvabhUtAnAM tvamAdityo vibhAvasuH
shlokas.12:
tvaM mahadbhUtamAshcharyaM tvaM rAjA tvaM surottamaH |
tvaM viShNustvaM sahasrAkShastvaM devastvaM parAyaNam
shlokas.13:
tvaM sarvamamRRitaM deva tvaM somaH paramArchitaH |
tvaM muhUrtastithishcha tvaM lavastvaM vai punaH kShaNaH
shlokas.14:
shuklastvaM bahulashchaiva kalA kAShThA truTistathA |
sa.nvatsarartavo mAsA rajanyashcha dinAni cha
shlokas.15:
tvamuttamA sagirivanA vasundharA; sabhAskaraM vitimiramambaraM tathA |
mahodadhiH satimitimi~NgilastathA; mahormimAnbahumakaro jhaShAlayaH
shlokas.16:
mahadyashastvamiti sadAbhipUjyase; manIShibhirmuditamanA maharShibhiH |
abhiShTutaH pibasi cha somamadhvare; vaShaTkRRitAnyapi cha havIMShi bhUtaye
shlokas.17:
tvaM vipraiH satatamihejyase phalArthaM; vedA~NgeShvatulabalaugha gIyase cha |
tvaddhetoryajanaparAyaNA dvijendrA; vedA~NgAnyabhigamayanti sarvavedaiH

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
evaM stutastadA kadrvA bhagavAnharivAhanaH |
nIlajImUtasa~NghAtairvyoma sarvaM samAvRRiNot
shlokas.2:
te meghA mumuchustoyaM prabhUtaM vidyudujjvalAH |
parasparamivAtyarthaM garjantaH satataM divi
shlokas.3:
sa~NghAtitamivAkAshaM jaladaiH sumahAdbhutaiH |
sRRijadbhiratulaM toyamajasraM sumahAravaiH
shlokas.4:
sampranRRittamivAkAshaM dhArormibhiranekashaH |
meghastanitanirghoShamambaraM samapadyata
shlokas.5:
nAgAnAmuttamo harshastadA varShati vAsave |
ApUryata mahI chApi salilena samantataH

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
suparNenohyamAnAste jagmustaM deshamAshu vai |
sAgarAmbuparikShiptaM pakShisa~NghaninAditam
shlokas.2:
vichitraphalapuShpAbhirvanarAjibhirAvRRitam |
bhavanairAvRRitaM ramyaistathA padmAkarairapi
shlokas.3:
prasannasalilaishchApi hradaishchitrairvibhUShitam |
divyagandhavahaiH puNyairmArutairupavIjitam
shlokas.4:
upajighradbhirAkAshaM vRRikShairmalayajairapi |
shobhitaM puShpavarShANi mu~nchadbhirmArutoddhutaiH
shlokas.5:
kiradbhiriva tatrasthAnnAgAnpuShpAmbuvRRiShTibhiH |
manaHsaMharShaNaM puNyaM gandharvApsarasAM priyam
nAnApakShirutaM ramyaM kadrUputrapraharShaNam
shlokas.6:
tatte vanaM samAsAdya vijahruH pannagA mudA |
abruva.nshcha mahAvIryaM suparNaM patagottamam
shlokas.7:
vahAsmAnaparaM dvIpaM suramyaM vipulodakam |
tvaM hi deshAnbahUnramyAnpatanpashyasi khechara
shlokas.8:
sa vichintyAbravItpakShI mAtaraM vinatAM tadA |
kiM kAraNaM mayA mAtaH kartavyaM sarpabhAShitam
shlokas.9:
vinatovAcha||
dAsIbhUtAsmyanAryAyA bhaginyAH patagottama |
paNaM vitathamAsthAya sarpairupadhinA kRRitam
shlokas.10:
sUta uvAcha||
tasmi.nstu kathite mAtrA kAraNe gaganecharaH |
uvAcha vachanaM sarpA.nstena duHkhena duHkhitaH
shlokas.11:
kimAhRRitya viditvA vA kiM vA kRRitveha pauruSham |
dAsyAdvo vipramuchyeyaM satyaM sha.nsata lelihAH
shlokas.12:
shrutvA tamabruvansarpA AharAmRRitamojasA |
tato dAsyAdvipramokSho bhavitA tava khechara

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
ityukto garuDaH sarpaistato mAtaramabravIt |
gachChAmyamRRitamAhartuM bhakShyamichChAmi veditum
shlokas.2:
vinatovAcha||
samudrakukShAvekAnte niShAdAlayamuttamam |
sahasrANAmanekAnAM tAnbhuktvAmRRitamAnaya
shlokas.3:
na tu te brAhmaNaM hantuM kAryA buddhiH katha~nchana |
avadhyaH sarvabhUtAnAM brAhmaNo hyanalopamaH
shlokas.4:
agnirarko viShaM shastraM vipro bhavati kopitaH |
bhUtAnAmagrabhugvipro varNashreShThaH pitA guruH
shlokas.5:
garuDa uvAcha||
yathAhamabhijAnIyAM brAhmaNaM lakShaNaiH shubhaiH |
tanme kAraNato mAtaH pRRichChato vaktumarhasi
shlokas.6:
vinatovAcha||
yaste kaNThamanuprApto nigIrNaM baDishaM yathA |
daheda~NgAravatputra taM vidyAdbAhmaNarShabham
shlokas.7:
sUta uvAcha||
provAcha chainaM vinatA putrahArdAdidaM vachaH |
jAnantyapyatulaM vIryamAshIrvAdasamanvitam
shlokas.8:
pakShau te mArutaH pAtu chandraH pRRiShThaM tu putraka |
shirastu pAtu te vahnirbhAskaraH sarvameva tu
shlokas.9:
ahaM cha te sadA putra shAntisvastiparAyaNA |
ariShTaM vraja panthAnaM vatsa kAryArthasiddhaye
shlokas.10:
tataH sa mAturvachanaM nishamya; vitatya pakShau nabha utpapAta |
tato niShAdAnbalavAnupAgama;dbubhukShitaH kAla ivAntako mahAn
shlokas.11:
sa tAnniShAdAnupasaMhara.nstadA; rajaH samuddhUya nabhaHspRRishaM mahat |
samudrakukShau cha vishoShayanpayaH; samIpagAnbhUmidharAnvichAlayan
shlokas.12:
tataH sa chakre mahadAnanaM tadA; niShAdamArgaM pratirudhya pakShirAT |
tato niShAdAstvaritAH pravavraju;ryato mukhaM tasya bhuja~NgabhojinaH
shlokas.13:
tadAnanaM vivRRitamatipramANava;tsamabhyayurgaganamivArditAH khagAH |
sahasrashaH pavanarajobhramohitA; mahAnilaprachalitapAdape vane
shlokas.14:
tataH khago vadanamamitratApanaH; samAharatparichapalo mahAbalaH |
niShUdayanbahuvidhamatsyabhakShiNo; bubhukShito gaganachareshvarastadA

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
tasya kaNThamanuprApto brAhmaNaH saha bhAryayA |
dahandIpta ivA~NgArastamuvAchAntarikShagaH
shlokas.2:
dvijottama vinirgachCha tUrNamAsyAdapAvRRitAt |
na hi me brAhmaNo vadhyaH pApeShvapi rataH sadA
shlokas.3:
bruvANamevaM garuDaM brAhmaNaH samabhAShata |
niShAdI mama bhAryeyaM nirgachChatu mayA saha
shlokas.4:
garuDa uvAcha||
etAmapi niShAdIM tvaM parigRRihyAshu niShpata |
tUrNaM sambhAvayAtmAnamajIrNaM mama tejasA
shlokas.5:
sUta uvAcha||
tataH sa vipro niShkrAnto niShAdIsahitastadA |
vardhayitvA cha garuDamiShTaM deshaM jagAma ha
shlokas.6:
sahabhArye viniShkrAnte tasminvipre sa pakShirAT |
vitatya pakShAvAkAshamutpapAta manojavaH
shlokas.7:
tato.apashyatsa pitaraM pRRiShTashchAkhyAtavAnpituH |
ahaM hi sarpaiH prahitaH somamAhartumudyataH
mAturdAsyavimokShArthamAhariShye tamadya vai
shlokas.8:
mAtrA chAsmi samAdiShTo niShAdAnbhakShayeti vai |
na cha me tRRiptirabhavadbhakShayitvA sahasrashaH
shlokas.9:
tasmAdbhoktavyamaparaM bhagavanpradishasva me |
yadbhuktvAmRRitamAhartuM samarthaH syAmahaM prabho
shlokas.10:
kashyapa uvAcha||
AsIdvibhAvasurnAma maharShiH kopano bhRRisham |
bhrAtA tasyAnujashchAsItsupratIko mahAtapAH
shlokas.11:
sa nechChati dhanaM bhrAtrA sahaikasthaM mahAmuniH |
vibhAgaM kIrtayatyeva supratIko.atha nityashaH
shlokas.12:
athAbravIchcha taM bhrAtA supratIkaM vibhAvasuH |
vibhAgaM bahavo mohAtkartumichChanti nityadA
tato vibhaktA anyonyaM nAdriyante.arthamohitAH
shlokas.13:
tataH svArthaparAnmUDhAnpRRithagbhUtAnsvakairdhanaiH |
viditvA bhedayantyetAnamitrA mitrarUpiNaH
shlokas.14:
viditvA chApare bhinnAnantareShu patantyatha |
bhinnAnAmatulo nAshaH kShiprameva pravartate
shlokas.15:
tasmAchchaiva vibhAgArthaM na prasha.nsanti paNDitAH |
gurushAstre nibaddhAnAmanyonyamabhisha~NkinAm
shlokas.16:
niyantuM na hi shakyastvaM bhedato dhanamichChasi |
yasmAttasmAtsupratIka hastitvaM samavApsyasi
shlokas.17:
shaptastvevaM supratIko vibhAvasumathAbravIt |
tvamapyantarjalacharaH kachChapaH sambhaviShyasi
shlokas.18:
evamanyonyashApAttau supratIkavibhAvasU |
gajakachChapatAM prAptAvarthArthaM mUDhachetasau
shlokas.19:
roShadoShAnuSha~NgeNa tiryagyonigatAvapi |
parasparadveSharatau pramANabaladarpitau
shlokas.20:
sarasyasminmahAkAyau pUrvavairAnusAriNau |
tayorekataraH shrImAnsamupaiti mahAgajaH
shlokas.21:
tasya bRRiMhitashabdena kUrmo.apyantarjaleshayaH |
utthito.asau mahAkAyaH kRRitsnaM sa~NkShobhayansaraH
shlokas.22:
taM dRRiShTvAveShTitakaraH patatyeSha gajo jalam |
dantahastAgralA~NgUlapAdavegena vIryavAn
shlokas.23:
taM vikShobhayamANaM tu saro bahujhaShAkulam |
kUrmo.apyabhyudyatashirA yuddhAyAbhyeti vIryavAn
shlokas.24:
ShaDuchChrito yojanAni gajastaddviguNAyataH |
kUrmastriyojanotsedho dashayojanamaNDalaH
shlokas.25:
tAvetau yuddhasaMmattau parasparajayaiShiNau |
upayujyAshu karmedaM sAdhayepsitamAtmanaH
shlokas.26:
sUta uvAcha||
sa tachChrutvA piturvAkyaM bhImavego.antarikShagaH |
nakhena gajamekena kUrmamekena chAkShipat
shlokas.27:
samutpapAta chAkAshaM tata uchchairviha~NgamaH |
so.alambatIrthamAsAdya devavRRikShAnupAgamat
shlokas.28:
te bhItAH samakampanta tasya pakShAnilAhatAH |
na no bha~njyAditi tadA divyAH kanakashAkhinaH
shlokas.29:
prachalA~NgAnsa tAndRRiShTvA manorathaphalA~NkurAn |
anyAnatularUpA~NgAnupachakrAma khecharaH
shlokas.30:
kA~nchanai rAjataishchaiva phalairvaiDUryashAkhinaH |
sAgarAmbuparikShiptAnbhrAjamAnAnmahAdrumAn
shlokas.31:
tamuvAcha khagashreShThaM tatra rohiNapAdapaH |
atipravRRiddhaH sumahAnApatantaM manojavam
shlokas.32:
yaiShA mama mahAshAkhA shatayojanamAyatA |
etAmAsthAya shAkhAM tvaM khAdemau gajakachChapau
shlokas.33:
tato drumaM patagasahasrasevitaM; mahIdharapratimavapuH prakampayan |
khagottamo drutamabhipatya vegavA;nbabha~nja tAmaviralapatrasa.nvRRitAm

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
spRRiShTamAtrA tu padbhyAM sA garuDena balIyasA |
abhajyata taroH shAkhA bhagnAM chainAmadhArayat
shlokas.2:
tAM bhagnAM sa mahAshAkhAM smayansamavalokayan |
athAtra lambato.apashyadvAlakhilyAnadhomukhAn
shlokas.3:
sa tadvinAshasantrAsAdanupatya khagAdhipaH |
shAkhAmAsyena jagrAha teShAmevAnvavekShayA
shanaiH paryapatatpakShI parvatAnpravishAtayan
shlokas.4:
evaM so.abhyapataddeshAnbahUnsagajakachChapaH |
dayArthaM vAlakhilyAnAM na cha sthAnamavindata
shlokas.5:
sa gatvA parvatashreShThaM gandhamAdanamavyayam |
dadarsha kashyapaM tatra pitaraM tapasi sthitam
shlokas.6:
dadarsha taM pitA chApi divyarUpaM viha~Ngamam |
tejovIryabalopetaM manomArutaraMhasam
shlokas.7:
shailashRRi~NgapratIkAshaM brahmadaNDamivodyatam |
achintyamanabhij~neyaM sarvabhUtabhaya~Nkaram
shlokas.8:
mAyAvIryadharaM sAkShAdagnimiddhamivodyatam |
apradhRRiShyamajeyaM cha devadAnavarAkShasaiH
shlokas.9:
bhettAraM girishRRi~NgANAM nadIjalavishoShaNam |
lokasa.nloDanaM ghoraM kRRitAntasamadarshanam
shlokas.10:
tamAgatamabhiprekShya bhagavAnkashyapastadA |
viditvA chAsya sa~NkalpamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.11:
putra mA sAhasaM kArShIrmA sadyo lapsyase vyathAm |
mA tvA daheyuH sa~NkruddhA vAlakhilyA marIchipAH
shlokas.12:
prasAdayAmAsa sa tAnkashyapaH putrakAraNAt |
vAlakhilyA.nstapaHsiddhAnidamuddishya kAraNam
shlokas.13:
prajAhitArthamArambho garuDasya tapodhanAH |
chikIrShati mahatkarma tadanuj~nAtumarhatha
shlokas.14:
evamuktA bhagavatA munayaste samabhyayuH |
muktvA shAkhAM giriM puNyaM himavantaM taporthinaH
shlokas.15:
tatasteShvapayAteShu pitaraM vinatAtmajaH |
shAkhAvyAkShiptavadanaH paryapRRichChata kashyapam
shlokas.16:
bhagavankva vimu~nchAmi tarushAkhAmimAmaham |
varjitaM brAhmaNairdeshamAkhyAtu bhagavAnmama
shlokas.17:
tato niShpuruShaM shailaM himasa.nruddhakandaram |
agamyaM manasApyanyaistasyAchakhyau sa kashyapaH
shlokas.18:
taM parvatamahAkukShimAvishya manasA khagaH |
javenAbhyapatattArkShyaH sashAkhAgajakachChapaH
shlokas.19:
na tAM vadhraH pariNahechChatacharmA mahAnaNuH |
shAkhino mahatIM shAkhAM yAM pragRRihya yayau khagaH
shlokas.20:
tataH sa shatasAhasraM yojanAntaramAgataH |
kAlena nAtimahatA garuDaH patatAM varaH
shlokas.21:
sa taM gatvA kShaNenaiva parvataM vachanAtpituH |
amu~nchanmahatIM shAkhAM sasvanAM tatra khecharaH
shlokas.22:
pakShAnilahatashchAsya prAkampata sa shailarAT |
mumocha puShpavarShaM cha samAgalitapAdapaH
shlokas.23:
shRRi~NgANi cha vyashIryanta girestasya samantataH |
maNikA~nchanachitrANi shobhayanti mahAgirim
shlokas.24:
shAkhino bahavashchApi shAkhayAbhihatAstayA |
kA~nchanaiH kusumairbhAnti vidyutvanta ivAmbudAH
shlokas.25:
te hemavikachA bhUyo yuktAH parvatadhAtubhiH |
vyarAja~nshAkhinastatra sUryA.nshupratira~njitAH
shlokas.26:
tatastasya gireH shRRi~NgamAsthAya sa khagottamaH |
bhakShayAmAsa garuDastAvubhau gajakachChapau
shlokas.27:
tataH parvatakUTAgrAdutpapAta manojavaH |
prAvartantAtha devAnAmutpAtA bhayavedinaH
shlokas.28:
indrasya vajraM dayitaM prajajvAla vyathAnvitam |
sadhUmA chApatatsArchirdivolkA nabhasashchyutA
shlokas.29:
tathA vasUnAM rudrANAmAdityAnAM cha sarvashaH |
sAdhyAnAM marutAM chaiva ye chAnye devatAgaNAH
svaM svaM praharaNaM teShAM parasparamupAdravat
shlokas.30:
abhUtapUrvaM sa~NgrAme tadA devAsure.api cha |
vavurvAtAH sanirghAtAH peturulkAH samantataH
shlokas.31:
nirabhramapi chAkAshaM prajagarja mahAsvanam |
devAnAmapi yo devaH so.apyavarShadasRRiktadA
shlokas.32:
mamlurmAlyAni devAnAM shemustejA.nsi chaiva hi |
utpAtameghA raudrAshcha vavarShuH shoNitaM bahu
rajA.nsi mukuTAnyeShAmutthitAni vyadharShayan
shlokas.33:
tatastrAsasamudvignaH saha devaiH shatakratuH |
utpAtAndAruNAnpashyannityuvAcha bRRihaspatim
shlokas.34:
kimarthaM bhagavanghorA mahotpAtAH samutthitAH |
na cha shatruM prapashyAmi yudhi yo naH pradharShayet
shlokas.35:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
tavAparAdhAddevendra pramAdAchcha shatakrato |
tapasA vAlakhilyAnAM bhUtamutpannamadbhutam
shlokas.36:
kashyapasya muneH putro vinatAyAshcha khecharaH |
hartuM somamanuprApto balavAnkAmarUpavAn
shlokas.37:
samartho balinAM shreShTho hartuM somaM viha~NgamaH |
sarvaM sambhAvayAmyasminnasAdhyamapi sAdhayet
shlokas.38:
sUta uvAcha||
shrutvaitadvachanaM shakraH provAchAmRRitarakShiNaH |
mahAvIryabalaH pakShI hartuM somamihodyataH
shlokas.39:
yuShmAnsambodhayAmyeSha yathA sa na haredbalAt |
atulaM hi balaM tasya bRRihaspatiruvAcha me
shlokas.40:
tachChrutvA vibudhA vAkyaM vismitA yatnamAsthitAH |
parivAryAmRRitaM tasthurvajrI chendraH shatakratuH
shlokas.41:
dhArayanto mahArhANi kavachAni manasvinaH |
kA~nchanAni vichitrANi vaiDUryavikRRitAni cha
shlokas.42:
vividhAni cha shastrANi ghorarUpANyanekashaH |
shitatIkShNAgradhArANi samudyamya sahasrashaH
shlokas.43:
savisphuli~NgajvAlAni sadhUmAni cha sarvashaH |
chakrANi parighA.nshchaiva trishUlAni parashvadhAn
shlokas.44:
shaktIshcha vividhAstIkShNAH karavAlA.nshcha nirmalAn |
svadeharUpANyAdAya gadAshchograpradarshanAH
shlokas.45:
taiH shastrairbhAnumadbhiste divyAbharaNabhUShitAH |
bhAnumantaH suragaNAstasthurvigatakalmaShAH
shlokas.46:
anupamabalavIryatejaso; dhRRitamanasaH parirakShaNe.amRRitasya |
asurapuravidAraNAH surA; jvalanasamiddhavapuHprakAshinaH
shlokas.47:
iti samaravaraM surAsthitaM; parighasahasrashataiH samAkulam |
vigalitamiva chAmbarAntare; tapanamarIchivibhAsitaM babhau

shlokas.1:
shaunaka uvAcha||
ko.aparAdho mahendrasya kaH pramAdashcha sUtaja |
tapasA vAlakhilyAnAM sambhUto garuDaH katham
shlokas.2:
kashyapasya dvijAteshcha kathaM vai pakShirATsutaH |
adhRRiShyaH sarvabhUtAnAmavadhyashchAbhavatkatham
shlokas.3:
kathaM cha kAmachArI sa kAmavIryashcha khecharaH |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM purANe yadi paThyate
shlokas.4:
sUta uvAcha||
viShayo.ayaM purANasya yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
shRRiNu me vadataH sarvametatsa~NkShepato dvija
shlokas.5:
yajataH putrakAmasya kashyapasya prajApateH |
sAhAyyamRRiShayo devA gandharvAshcha daduH kila
shlokas.6:
tatredhmAnayane shakro niyuktaH kashyapena ha |
munayo vAlakhilyAshcha ye chAnye devatAgaNAH
shlokas.7:
shakrastu vIryasadRRishamidhmabhAraM giriprabham |
samudyamyAnayAmAsa nAtikRRichChrAdiva prabhuH
shlokas.8:
athApashyadRRiShInhrasvAna~NguShThodaraparvaNaH |
palAshavRRintikAmekAM sahitAnvahataH pathi
shlokas.9:
pralInAnsveShvivA~NgeShu nirAhArA.nstapodhanAn |
klishyamAnAnmandabalAngoShpade samplutodake
shlokas.10:
tA.nshcha sarvAnsmayAviShTo vIryonmattaH pura.ndaraH |
avahasyAtyagAchChIghraM la~NghayitvAvamanya cha
shlokas.11:
te.atha roShasamAviShTAH subhRRishaM jAtamanyavaH |
Arebhire mahatkarma tadA shakrabhaya~Nkaram
shlokas.12:
juhuvuste sutapaso vidhivajjAtavedasam |
mantrairuchchAvachairviprA yena kAmena tachChRRiNu
shlokas.13:
kAmavIryaH kAmagamo devarAjabhayapradaH |
indro.anyaH sarvadevAnAM bhavediti yatavratAH
shlokas.14:
indrAchChataguNaH shaurye vIrye chaiva manojavaH |
tapaso naH phalenAdya dAruNaH sambhavatviti
shlokas.15:
tadbuddhvA bhRRishasantapto devarAjaH shatakratuH |
jagAma sharaNaM tatra kashyapaM sa.nshitavratam
shlokas.16:
tachChrutvA devarAjasya kashyapo.atha prajApatiH |
vAlakhilyAnupAgamya karmasiddhimapRRichChata
shlokas.17:
evamastviti taM chApi pratyUchuH satyavAdinaH |
tAnkashyapa uvAchedaM sAntvapUrvaM prajApatiH
shlokas.18:
ayamindrastribhuvane niyogAdbrahmaNaH kRRitaH |
indrArthaM cha bhavanto.api yatnavantastapodhanAH
shlokas.19:
na mithyA brahmaNo vAkyaM kartumarhatha sattamAH |
bhavatAM cha na mithyAyaM sa~Nkalpo me chikIrShitaH
shlokas.20:
bhavatveSha patatrINAmindro.atibalasattvavAn |
prasAdaH kriyatAM chaiva devarAjasya yAchataH
shlokas.21:
evamuktAH kashyapena vAlakhilyAstapodhanAH |
pratyUchurabhisampUjya munishreShThaM prajApatim
shlokas.22:
indrArtho.ayaM samArambhaH sarveShAM naH prajApate |
apatyArthaM samArambho bhavatashchAyamIpsitaH
shlokas.23:
tadidaM saphalaM karma tvayA vai pratigRRihyatAm |
tathA chaiva vidhatsvAtra yathA shreyo.anupashyasi
shlokas.24:
etasminneva kAle tu devI dAkShAyaNI shubhA |
vinatA nAma kalyANI putrakAmA yashasvinI
shlokas.25:
tapastaptvA vrataparA snAtA pu.nsavane shuchiH |
upachakrAma bhartAraM tAmuvAchAtha kashyapaH
shlokas.26:
ArambhaH saphalo devi bhavitAyaM tavepsitaH |
janayiShyasi putrau dvau vIrau tribhuvaneshvarau
shlokas.27:
tapasA vAlakhilyAnAM mama sa~Nkalpajau tathA |
bhaviShyato mahAbhAgau putrau te lokapUjitau
shlokas.28:
uvAcha chainAM bhagavAnmArIchaH punareva ha |
dhAryatAmapramAdena garbho.ayaM sumahodayaH
shlokas.29:
ekaH sarvapatatrINAmindratvaM kArayiShyati |
lokasambhAvito vIraH kAmavIryo viha~NgamaH
shlokas.30:
shatakratumathovAcha prIyamANaH prajApatiH |
tvatsahAyau khagAvetau bhrAtarau te bhaviShyataH
shlokas.31:
naitAbhyAM bhavitA doShaH sakAshAtte pura.ndara |
vyetu te shakra santApastvamevendro bhaviShyasi
shlokas.32:
na chApyevaM tvayA bhUyaH kSheptavyA brahmavAdinaH |
na chAvamAnyA darpAtte vAgviShA bhRRishakopanAH
shlokas.33:
evamukto jagAmendro nirvisha~NkastriviShTapam |
vinatA chApi siddhArthA babhUva muditA tadA
shlokas.34:
janayAmAsa putrau dvAvaruNaM garuDaM tathA |
aruNastayostu vikala Adityasya puraHsaraH
shlokas.35:
patatrINAM tu garuDa indratvenAbhyaShichyata |
tasyaitatkarma sumahachChrUyatAM bhRRigunandana

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
tatastasmindvijashreShTha samudIrNe tathAvidhe |
garutmAnpakShirATtUrNaM samprApto vibudhAnprati
shlokas.2:
taM dRRiShTvAtibalaM chaiva prAkampanta samantataH |
parasparaM cha pratyaghnansarvapraharaNAnyapi
shlokas.3:
tatra chAsIdameyAtmA vidyudagnisamaprabhaH |
bhauvanaH sumahAvIryaH somasya parirakShitA
shlokas.4:
sa tena patagendreNa pakShatuNDanakhaiH kShataH |
muhUrtamatulaM yuddhaM kRRitvA vinihato yudhi
shlokas.5:
rajashchoddhUya sumahatpakShavAtena khecharaH |
kRRitvA lokAnnirAlokA.nstena devAnavAkirat
shlokas.6:
tenAvakIrNA rajasA devA mohamupAgaman |
na chainaM dadRRishushChannA rajasAmRRitarakShiNaH
shlokas.7:
evaM sa.nloDayAmAsa garuDastridivAlayam |
pakShatuNDaprahAraishcha devAnsa vidadAra ha
shlokas.8:
tato devaH sahasrAkShastUrNaM vAyumachodayat |
vikShipemAM rajovRRiShTiM tavaitatkarma mAruta
shlokas.9:
atha vAyurapovAha tadrajastarasA balI |
tato vitimire jAte devAH shakunimArdayan
shlokas.10:
nanAda chochchairbalavAnmahAmegharavaH khagaH |
vadhyamAnaH suragaNaiH sarvabhUtAni bhIShayan
utpapAta mahAvIryaH pakShirATparavIrahA
shlokas.11:
tamutpatyAntarikShasthaM devAnAmupari sthitam |
varmiNo vibudhAH sarve nAnAshastrairavAkiran
shlokas.12:
paTTishaiH parighaiH shUlairgadAbhishcha savAsavAH |
kShurAntairjvalitaishchApi chakrairAdityarUpibhiH
shlokas.13:
nAnAshastravisargaishcha vadhyamAnaH samantataH |
kurvansutumulaM yuddhaM pakShirANna vyakampata
shlokas.14:
vinardanniva chAkAshe vainateyaH pratApavAn |
pakShAbhyAmurasA chaiva samantAdvyAkShipatsurAn
shlokas.15:
te vikShiptAstato devAH prajagmurgaruDArditAH |
nakhatuNDakShatAshchaiva susruvuH shoNitaM bahu
shlokas.16:
sAdhyAH prAchIM sagandharvA vasavo dakShiNAM disham |
prajagmuH sahitA rudraiH patagendrapradharShitAH
shlokas.17:
dishaM pratIchImAdityA nAsatyA uttarAM disham |
muhurmuhuH prekShamANA yudhyamAnA mahaujasam
shlokas.18:
ashvakrandena vIreNa reNukena cha pakShiNA |
krathanena cha shUreNa tapanena cha khecharaH
shlokas.19:
ulUkashvasanAbhyAM cha nimeSheNa cha pakShiNA |
prarujena cha sa.nyuddhaM chakAra pralihena cha
shlokas.20:
tAnpakShanakhatuNDAgrairabhinadvinatAsutaH |
yugAntakAle sa~NkruddhaH pinAkIva mahAbalaH
shlokas.21:
mahAvIryA mahotsAhAstena te bahudhA kShatAH |
rejurabhraghanaprakhyA rudhiraughapravarShiNaH
shlokas.22:
tAnkRRitvA patagashreShThaH sarvAnutkrAntajIvitAn |
atikrAnto.amRRitasyArthe sarvato.agnimapashyata
shlokas.23:
AvRRiNvAnaM mahAjvAlamarchirbhiH sarvato.ambaram |
dahantamiva tIkShNA.nshuM ghoraM vAyusamIritam
shlokas.24:
tato navatyA navatIrmukhAnAM; kRRitvA tarasvI garuDo mahAtmA |
nadIH samApIya mukhaistatastaiH; sushIghramAgamya punarjavena
shlokas.25:
jvalantamagniM tamamitratApanaH; samAstaratpatraratho nadIbhiH |
tataH prachakre vapuranyadalpaM; praveShTukAmo.agnimabhiprashAmya

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
jAmbUnadamayo bhUtvA marIchivikachojjvalaH |
pravivesha balAtpakShI vArivega ivArNavam
shlokas.2:
sa chakraM kShuraparyantamapashyadamRRitAntike |
paribhramantamanishaM tIkShNadhAramayasmayam
shlokas.3:
jvalanArkaprabhaM ghoraM ChedanaM somahAriNAm |
ghorarUpaM tadatyarthaM yantraM devaiH sunirmitam
shlokas.4:
tasyAntaraM sa dRRiShTvaiva paryavartata khecharaH |
arAntareNAbhyapatatsa~NkShipyA~NgaM kShaNena ha
shlokas.5:
adhashchakrasya chaivAtra dIptAnalasamadyutI |
vidyujjihvau mahAghorau dIptAsyau dIptalochanau
shlokas.6:
chakShurviShau mahAvIryau nityakruddhau tarasvinau |
rakShArthamevAmRRitasya dadarsha bhujagottamau
shlokas.7:
sadA sa.nrabdhanayanau sadA chAnimiShekShaNau |
tayoreko.api yaM pashyetsa tUrNaM bhasmasAdbhavet
shlokas.8:
tayoshchakShUMShi rajasA suparNastUrNamAvRRiNot |
adRRiShTarUpastau chApi sarvataH paryakAlayat
shlokas.9:
tayora~Nge samAkramya vainateyo.antarikShagaH |
AchChinattarasA madhye somamabhyadravattataH
shlokas.10:
samutpATyAmRRitaM tattu vainateyastato balI |
utpapAta javenaiva yantramunmathya vIryavAn
shlokas.11:
apItvaivAmRRitaM pakShI parigRRihyAshu vIryavAn |
agachChadaparishrAnta AvAryArkaprabhAM khagaH
shlokas.12:
viShNunA tu tadAkAshe vainateyaH sameyivAn |
tasya nArAyaNastuShTastenAlaulyena karmaNA
shlokas.13:
tamuvAchAvyayo devo varado.asmIti khecharam |
sa vavre tava tiShTheyamuparItyantarikShagaH
shlokas.14:
uvAcha chainaM bhUyo.api nArAyaNamidaM vachaH |
ajarashchAmarashcha syAmamRRitena vinApyaham
shlokas.15:
pratigRRihya varau tau cha garuDo viShNumabravIt |
bhavate.api varaM dadmi vRRiNItAM bhagavAnapi
shlokas.16:
taM vavre vAhanaM kRRiShNo garutmantaM mahAbalam |
dhvajaM cha chakre bhagavAnupari sthAsyasIti tam
shlokas.17:
anupatya khagaM tvindro vajreNA~Nge.abhyatADayat |
viha~NgamaM surAmitraM harantamamRRitaM balAt
shlokas.18:
tamuvAchendramAkrande garuDaH patatAM varaH |
prahasa~nshlakShNayA vAchA tathA vajrasamAhataH
shlokas.19:
RRiShermAnaM kariShyAmi vajraM yasyAsthisambhavam |
vajrasya cha kariShyAmi tava chaiva shatakrato
shlokas.20:
eSha patraM tyajAmyekaM yasyAntaM nopalapsyase |
na hi vajranipAtena rujA me.asti kadAchana
shlokas.21:
tatra taM sarvabhUtAni vismitAnyabruva.nstadA |
surUpaM patramAlakShya suparNo.ayaM bhavatviti
shlokas.22:
dRRiShTvA tadadbhutaM chApi sahasrAkShaH pura.ndaraH |
khago mahadidaM bhUtamiti matvAbhyabhAShata
shlokas.23:
balaM vij~nAtumichChAmi yatte paramanuttamam |
sakhyaM chAnantamichChAmi tvayA saha khagottama

shlokas.1:
garuDa uvAcha||
sakhyaM me.astu tvayA deva yathechChasi pura.ndara |
balaM tu mama jAnIhi mahachchAsahyameva cha
shlokas.2:
kAmaM naitatprasha.nsanti santaH svabalasa.nstavam |
guNasa~NkIrtanaM chApi svayameva shatakrato
shlokas.3:
sakheti kRRitvA tu sakhe pRRiShTo vakShyAmyahaM tvayA |
na hyAtmastavasa.nyuktaM vaktavyamanimittataH
shlokas.4:
saparvatavanAmurvIM sasAgaravanAmimAm |
pakShanADyaikayA shakra tvAM chaivAtrAvalambinam
shlokas.5:
sarvAnsampiNDitAnvApi lokAnsasthANuja~NgamAn |
vaheyamaparishrAnto viddhIdaM me mahadbalam
shlokas.6:
sUta uvAcha||
ityuktavachanaM vIraM kirITI shrImatAM varaH |
Aha shaunaka devendraH sarvabhUtahitaH prabhuH
shlokas.7:
pratigRRihyatAmidAnIM me sakhyamAnantyamuttamam |
na kAryaM tava somena mama somaH pradIyatAm
asmA.nste hi prabAdheyuryebhyo dadyAdbhavAnimam
shlokas.8:
garuDa uvAcha||
ki~nchitkAraNamuddishya somo.ayaM nIyate mayA |
na dAsyAmi samAdAtuM somaM kasmaichidapyaham
shlokas.9:
yatremaM tu sahasrAkSha nikShipeyamahaM svayam |
tvamAdAya tatastUrNaM harethAstridasheshvara
shlokas.10:
shakra uvAcha||
vAkyenAnena tuShTo.ahaM yattvayoktamihANDaja |
yadichChasi varaM mattastadgRRihANa khagottama
shlokas.11:
sUta uvAcha||
ityuktaH pratyuvAchedaM kadrUputrAnanusmaran |
smRRitvA chaivopadhikRRitaM mAturdAsyanimittataH
shlokas.12:
Isho.ahamapi sarvasya kariShyAmi tu te.arthitAm |
bhaveyurbhujagAH shakra mama bhakShyA mahAbalAH
shlokas.13:
tathetyuktvAnvagachChattaM tato dAnavasUdanaH |
hariShyAmi vinikShiptaM somamityanubhAShya tam
shlokas.14:
AjagAma tatastUrNaM suparNo mAturantikam |
atha sarpAnuvAchedaM sarvAnparamahRRiShTavat
shlokas.15:
idamAnItamamRRitaM nikShepsyAmi kusheShu vaH |
snAtA ma~Ngalasa.nyuktAstataH prAshnIta pannagAH
shlokas.16:
adAsI chaiva mAteyamadyaprabhRRiti chAstu me |
yathoktaM bhavatAmetadvacho me pratipAditam
shlokas.17:
tataH snAtuM gatAH sarpAH pratyuktvA taM tathetyuta |
shakro.apyamRRitamAkShipya jagAma tridivaM punaH
shlokas.18:
athAgatAstamuddeshaM sarpAH somArthinastadA |
snAtAshcha kRRitajapyAshcha prahRRiShTAH kRRitama~NgalAH
shlokas.19:
tadvij~nAya hRRitaM sarpAH pratimAyAkRRitaM cha tat |
somasthAnamidaM cheti darbhA.nste lilihustadA
shlokas.20:
tato dvaidhIkRRitA jihvA sarpANAM tena karmaNA |
abhava.nshchAmRRitasparshAddarbhAste.atha pavitriNaH
shlokas.21:
tataH suparNaH paramaprahRRiShTavA;nvihRRitya mAtrA saha tatra kAnane |
bhuja~NgabhakShaH paramArchitaH khagai;rahInakIrtirvinatAmanandayat
shlokas.22:
imAM kathAM yaH shRRiNuyAnnaraH sadA; paTheta vA dvijajanamukhyasa.nsadi |
asa.nshayaM tridivamiyAtsa puNyabhA;~NmahAtmanaH patagapateH prakIrtanAt

shlokas.1:
shaunaka uvAcha||
bhuja~NgamAnAM shApasya mAtrA chaiva sutena cha |
vinatAyAstvayA proktaM kAraNaM sUtanandana
shlokas.2:
varapradAnaM bhartrA cha kadrUvinatayostathA |
nAmanI chaiva te prokte pakShiNorvainateyayoH
shlokas.3:
pannagAnAM tu nAmAni na kIrtayasi sUtaja |
prAdhAnyenApi nAmAni shrotumichChAmahe vayam
shlokas.4:
sUta uvAcha||
bahutvAnnAmadheyAni bhujagAnAM tapodhana |
na kIrtayiShye sarveShAM prAdhAnyena tu me shRRiNu
shlokas.5:
sheShaH prathamato jAto vAsukistadanantaram |
airAvatastakShakashcha karkoTakadhana~njayau
shlokas.6:
kAliyo maNinAgashcha nAgashchApUraNastathA |
nAgastathA pi~njaraka elApatro.atha vAmanaH
shlokas.7:
nIlAnIlau tathA nAgau kalmAShashabalau tathA |
AryakashchAdikashchaiva nAgashcha shalapotakaH
shlokas.8:
sumanomukho dadhimukhastathA vimalapiNDakaH |
AptaH koTanakashchaiva sha~Nkho vAlashikhastathA
shlokas.9:
niShThyUnako hemaguho nahuShaH pi~NgalastathA |
bAhyakarNo hastipadastathA mudgarapiNDakaH
shlokas.10:
kambalAshvatarau chApi nAgaH kAlIyakastathA |
vRRittasa.nvartakau nAgau dvau cha padmAviti shrutau
shlokas.11:
nAgaH sha~Nkhanakashchaiva tathA cha sphaNDako.aparaH |
kShemakashcha mahAnAgo nAgaH piNDArakastathA
shlokas.12:
karavIraH puShpadaMShTra eLako bilvapANDukaH |
mUShakAdaH sha~NkhashirAH pUrNadaMShTro haridrakaH
shlokas.13:
aparAjito jyotikashcha pannagaH shrIvahastathA |
kauravyo dhRRitarAShTrashcha puShkaraH shalyakastathA
shlokas.14:
virajAshcha subAhushcha shAlipiNDashcha vIryavAn |
hastibhadraH piTharako mukharaH koNavAsanaH
shlokas.15:
ku~njaraH kurarashchaiva tathA nAgaH prabhAkaraH |
kumudaH kumudAkShashcha tittirirhalikastathA
karkarAkarkarau chobhau kuNDodaramahodarau
shlokas.16:
ete prAdhAnyato nAgAH kIrtitA dvijasattama |
bahutvAnnAmadheyAnAmitare na prakIrtitAH
shlokas.17:
eteShAM prasavo yashcha prasavasya cha santatiH |
asa~Nkhyeyeti matvA tAnna bravImi dvijottama
shlokas.18:
bahUnIha sahasrANi prayutAnyarbudAni cha |
ashakyAnyeva sa~NkhyAtuM bhujagAnAM tapodhana

shlokas.1:
shaunaka uvAcha||
jAtA vai bhujagAstAta vIryavanto durAsadAH |
shApaM taM tvatha vij~nAya kRRitavanto nu kiM param
shlokas.2:
sUta uvAcha||
teShAM tu bhagavA~nsheShastyaktvA kadrUM mahAyashAH |
tapo vipulamAtasthe vAyubhakSho yatavrataH
shlokas.3:
gandhamAdanamAsAdya badaryAM cha taporataH |
gokarNe puShkarAraNye tathA himavatastaTe
shlokas.4:
teShu teShu cha puNyeShu tIrtheShvAyataneShu cha |
ekAntashIlI niyataH satataM vijitendriyaH
shlokas.5:
tapyamAnaM tapo ghoraM taM dadarsha pitAmahaH |
parishuShkamA.nsatvaksnAyuM jaTAchIradharaM prabhum
shlokas.6:
tamabravItsatyadhRRitiM tapyamAnaM pitAmahaH |
kimidaM kuruShe sheSha prajAnAM svasti vai kuru
shlokas.7:
tvaM hi tIvreNa tapasA prajAstApayase.anagha |
brUhi kAmaM cha me sheSha yatte hRRidi chiraM sthitam
shlokas.8:
sheSha uvAcha||
sodaryA mama sarve hi bhrAtaro mandachetasaH |
saha tairnotsahe vastuM tadbhavAnanumanyatAm
shlokas.9:
abhyasUyanti satataM parasparamamitravat |
tato.ahaM tapa AtiShThe naitAnpashyeyamityuta
shlokas.10:
na marShayanti satataM vinatAM sasutAM cha te |
asmAkaM chAparo bhrAtA vainateyaH pitAmaha
shlokas.11:
taM cha dviShanti te.atyarthaM sa chApi sumahAbalaH |
varapradAnAtsa pituH kashyapasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.12:
so.ahaM tapaH samAsthAya mokShyAmIdaM kalevaram |
kathaM me pretyabhAve.api na taiH syAtsaha sa~NgamaH
shlokas.13:
brahmovAcha||
jAnAmi sheSha sarveShAM bhrAtRRiNAM te vicheShTitam |
mAtushchApyaparAdhAdvai bhrAtRRiNAM te mahadbhayam
shlokas.14:
kRRito.atra parihArashcha pUrvameva bhuja~Ngama |
bhrAtRRiNAM tava sarveShAM na shokaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.15:
vRRiNIShva cha varaM mattaH sheSha yatte.abhikA~NkShitam |
ditsAmi hi varaM te.adya prItirme paramA tvayi
shlokas.16:
diShTyA cha buddhirdharme te niviShTA pannagottama |
ato bhUyashcha te buddhirdharme bhavatu susthirA
shlokas.17:
sheSha uvAcha||
eSha eva varo me.adya kA~NkShitaH prapitAmaha |
dharme me ramatAM buddhiH shame tapasi cheshvara
shlokas.18:
brahmovAcha||
prIto.asmyanena te sheSha damena prashamena cha |
tvayA tvidaM vachaH kAryaM manniyogAtprajAhitam
shlokas.19:
imAM mahIM shailavanopapannAM; sasAgarAM sAkarapattanAM cha |
tvaM sheSha samyakchalitAM yathAva;tsa~NgRRihya tiShThasva yathAchalA syAt
shlokas.20:
sheSha uvAcha||
yathAha devo varadaH prajApati;rmahIpatirbhUtapatirjagatpatiH |
tathA mahIM dhArayitAsmi nishchalAM; prayachCha tAM me shirasi prajApate
shlokas.21:
brahmovAcha||
adho mahIM gachCha bhuja~Ngamottama; svayaM tavaiShA vivaraM pradAsyati |
imAM dharAM dhArayatA tvayA hi me; mahatpriyaM sheSha kRRitaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.22:
sUta uvAcha||
tatheti kRRitvA vivaraM pravishya sa; prabhurbhuvo bhujagavarAgrajaH sthitaH |
bibharti devIM shirasA mahImimAM; samudranemiM parigRRihya sarvataH
shlokas.23:
brahmovAcha||
sheSho.asi nAgottama dharmadevo; mahImimAM dhArayase yadekaH |
anantabhogaH parigRRihya sarvAM; yathAhamevaM balabhidyathA vA
shlokas.24:
sUta uvAcha||
adho bhUmervasatyevaM nAgo.anantaH pratApavAn |
dhArayanvasudhAmekaH shAsanAdbrahmaNo vibhuH
shlokas.25:
suparNaM cha sakhAyaM vai bhagavAnamarottamaH |
prAdAdanantAya tadA vainateyaM pitAmahaH

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
mAtuH sakAshAttaM shApaM shrutvA pannagasattamaH |
vAsukishchintayAmAsa shApo.ayaM na bhavetkatham
shlokas.2:
tataH sa mantrayAmAsa bhrAtRRibhiH saha sarvashaH |
airAvataprabhRRitibhirye sma dharmaparAyaNAH
shlokas.3:
vAsukiruvAcha||
ayaM shApo yathoddiShTo viditaM vastathAnaghAH |
tasya shApasya mokShArthaM mantrayitvA yatAmahe
shlokas.4:
sarveShAmeva shApAnAM pratighAto hi vidyate |
na tu mAtrAbhishaptAnAM mokSho vidyeta pannagAH
shlokas.5:
avyayasyAprameyasya satyasya cha tathAgrataH |
shaptA ityeva me shrutvA jAyate hRRidi vepathuH
shlokas.6:
nUnaM sarvavinAsho.ayamasmAkaM samudAhRRitaH |
na hyenAM so.avyayo devaH shapantIM pratyaShedhayat
shlokas.7:
tasmAtsaMmantrayAmo.atra bhujagAnAmanAmayam |
yathA bhaveta sarveShAM mA naH kAlo.atyagAdayam
shlokas.8:
api mantrayamANA hi hetuM pashyAma mokShaNe |
yathA naShTaM purA devA gUDhamagniM guhAgatam
shlokas.9:
yathA sa yaj~no na bhavedyathA vApi parAbhavet |
janamejayasya sarpANAM vinAshakaraNAya hi
shlokas.10:
sUta uvAcha||
tathetyuktvA tu te sarve kAdraveyAH samAgatAH |
samayaM chakrire tatra mantrabuddhivishAradAH
shlokas.11:
eke tatrAbruvannAgA vayaM bhUtvA dvijarShabhAH |
janamejayaM taM bhikShAmo yaj~naste na bhavediti
shlokas.12:
apare tvabruvannAgAstatra paNDitamAninaH |
mantriNo.asya vayaM sarve bhaviShyAmaH susaMmatAH
shlokas.13:
sa naH prakShyati sarveShu kAryeShvarthavinishchayam |
tatra buddhiM pravakShyAmo yathA yaj~no nivartate
shlokas.14:
sa no bahumatAnrAjA buddhvA buddhimatAM varaH |
yaj~nArthaM prakShyati vyaktaM neti vakShyAmahe vayam
shlokas.15:
darshayanto bahUndoShAnpretya cheha cha dAruNAn |
hetubhiH kAraNaishchaiva yathA yaj~no bhavenna saH
shlokas.16:
athavA ya upAdhyAyaH kratau tasminbhaviShyati |
sarpasatravidhAnaj~no rAjakAryahite rataH
shlokas.17:
taM gatvA dashatAM kashchidbhujagaH sa mariShyati |
tasminhate yaj~nakare kratuH sa na bhaviShyati
shlokas.18:
ye chAnye sarpasatraj~nA bhaviShyantyasya RRitvijaH |
tA.nshcha sarvAndashiShyAmaH kRRitamevaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.19:
tatrApare.amantrayanta dharmAtmAno bhuja~NgamAH |
abuddhireShA yuShmAkaM brahmahatyA na shobhanA
shlokas.20:
samyaksaddharmamUlA hi vyasane shAntiruttamA |
adharmottaratA nAma kRRitsnaM vyApAdayejjagat
shlokas.21:
apare tvabruvannAgAH samiddhaM jAtavedasam |
varShairnirvApayiShyAmo meghA bhUtvA savidyutaH
shlokas.22:
srugbhANDaM nishi gatvA vA apare bhujagottamAH |
pramattAnAM harantvAshu vighna evaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.23:
yaj~ne vA bhujagAstasmi~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
janaM dashantu vai sarvamevaM trAso bhaviShyati
shlokas.24:
athavA sa.nskRRitaM bhojyaM dUShayantu bhuja~NgamAH |
svena mUtrapurISheNa sarvabhojyavinAshinA
shlokas.25:
apare tvabruva.nstatra RRitvijo.asya bhavAmahe |
yaj~navighnaM kariShyAmo dIyatAM dakShiNA iti
vashyatAM cha gato.asau naH kariShyati yathepShitam
shlokas.26:
apare tvabruva.nstatra jale prakrIDitaM nRRipam |
gRRihamAnIya badhnImaH kraturevaM bhavenna saH
shlokas.27:
apare tvabruva.nstatra nAgAH sukRRitakAriNaH |
dashAmainaM pragRRihyAshu kRRitamevaM bhaviShyati
ChinnaM mUlamanarthAnAM mRRite tasminbhaviShyati
shlokas.28:
eShA vai naiShThikI buddhiH sarveShAmeva saMmatA |
yathA vA manyase rAja.nstatkShipraM sa.nvidhIyatAm
shlokas.29:
ityuktvA samudaikShanta vAsukiM pannageshvaram |
vAsukishchApi sa~nchintya tAnuvAcha bhuja~NgamAn
shlokas.30:
naiShA vo naiShThikI buddhirmatA kartuM bhuja~NgamAH |
sarveShAmeva me buddhiH pannagAnAM na rochate
shlokas.31:
kiM tvatra sa.nvidhAtavyaM bhavatAM yadbhaveddhitam |
anenAhaM bhRRishaM tapye guNadoShau madAshrayau

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
shrutvA tu vachanaM teShAM sarveShAmiti cheti cha |
vAsukeshcha vachaH shrutvA elApatro.abravIdidam
shlokas.2:
na sa yaj~no na bhavitA na sa rAjA tathAvidhaH |
janamejayaH pANDaveyo yato.asmAkaM mahAbhayam
shlokas.3:
daivenopahato rAjanyo bhavediha pUruShaH |
sa daivamevAshrayate nAnyattatra parAyaNam
shlokas.4:
tadidaM daivamasmAkaM bhayaM pannagasattamAH |
daivamevAshrayAmo.atra shRRiNudhvaM cha vacho mama
shlokas.5:
ahaM shApe samutsRRiShTe samashrauShaM vachastadA |
mAturutsa~NgamArUDho bhayAtpannagasattamAH
shlokas.6:
devAnAM pannagashreShThAstIkShNAstIkShNA iti prabho |
pitAmahamupAgamya duHkhArtAnAM mahAdyute
shlokas.7:
devA UchuH||
kA hi labdhvA priyAnputrA~nshapedevaM pitAmaha |
RRite kadrUM tIkShNarUpAM devadeva tavAgrataH
shlokas.8:
tatheti cha vachastasyAstvayApyuktaM pitAmaha |
etadichChAma vij~nAtuM kAraNaM yanna vAritA
shlokas.9:
brahmovAcha||
bahavaH pannagAstIkShNA bhImavIryA viSholbaNAH |
prajAnAM hitakAmo.ahaM na nivAritavA.nstadA
shlokas.10:
ye dandashUkAH kShudrAshcha pApachArA viSholbaNAH |
teShAM vinAsho bhavitA na tu ye dharmachAriNaH
shlokas.11:
yannimittaM cha bhavitA mokShasteShAM mahAbhayAt |
pannagAnAM nibodhadhvaM tasminkAle tathAgate
shlokas.12:
yAyAvarakule dhImAnbhaviShyati mahAnRRiShiH |
jaratkAruriti khyAtastejasvI niyatendriyaH
shlokas.13:
tasya putro jaratkArorutpatsyati mahAtapAH |
AstIko nAma yaj~naM sa pratiShetsyati taM tadA
tatra mokShyanti bhujagA ye bhaviShyanti dhArmikAH
shlokas.14:
devA UchuH||
sa munipravaro deva jaratkArurmahAtapAH |
kasyAM putraM mahAtmAnaM janayiShyati vIryavAn
shlokas.15:
brahmovAcha||
sanAmAyAM sanAmA sa kanyAyAM dvijasattamaH |
apatyaM vIryavAndevA vIryavajjanayiShyati
shlokas.16:
elApatra uvAcha||
evamastviti taM devAH pitAmahamathAbruvan |
uktvA chaivaM gatA devAH sa cha devaH pitAmahaH
shlokas.17:
so.ahamevaM prapashyAmi vAsuke bhaginIM tava |
jaratkAruriti khyAtAM tAM tasmai pratipAdaya
shlokas.18:
bhaikShavadbhikShamANAya nAgAnAM bhayashAntaye |
RRiShaye suvratAya tvameSha mokShaH shruto mayA

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
elApatrasya tu vachaH shrutvA nAgA dvijottama |
sarve prahRRiShTamanasaH sAdhu sAdhvityapUjayan
shlokas.2:
tataH prabhRRiti tAM kanyAM vAsukiH paryarakShata |
jaratkAruM svasAraM vai paraM harShamavApa cha
shlokas.3:
tato nAtimahAnkAlaH samatIta ivAbhavat |
atha devAsurAH sarve mamanthurvaruNAlayam
shlokas.4:
tatra netramabhUnnAgo vAsukirbalinAM varaH |
samApyaiva cha tatkarma pitAmahamupAgaman
shlokas.5:
devA vAsukinA sArdhaM pitAmahamathAbruvan |
bhagava~nshApabhIto.ayaM vAsukistapyate bhRRisham
shlokas.6:
tasyedaM mAnasaM shalyaM samuddhartuM tvamarhasi |
jananyAH shApajaM deva j~nAtInAM hitakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.7:
hito hyayaM sadAsmAkaM priyakArI cha nAgarAT |
kuru prasAdaM devesha shamayAsya manojvaram
shlokas.8:
brahmovAcha||
mayaivaitadvitIrNaM vai vachanaM manasAmarAH |
elApatreNa nAgena yadasyAbhihitaM purA
shlokas.9:
tatkarotveSha nAgendraH prAptakAlaM vachastathA |
vinashiShyanti ye pApA na tu ye dharmachAriNaH
shlokas.10:
utpannaH sa jaratkArustapasyugre rato dvijaH |
tasyaiSha bhaginIM kAle jaratkAruM prayachChatu
shlokas.11:
yadelApatreNa vachastadoktaM bhujagena ha |
pannagAnAM hitaM devAstattathA na tadanyathA
shlokas.12:
sUta uvAcha||
etachChrutvA sa nAgendraH pitAmahavachastadA |
sarpAnbahU~njaratkArau nityayuktAnsamAdadhat
shlokas.13:
jaratkAruryadA bhAryAmichChedvarayituM prabhuH |
shIghrametya mamAkhyeyaM tannaH shreyo bhaviShyati

shlokas.1:
shaunaka uvAcha||
jaratkAruriti proktaM yattvayA sUtanandana |
ichChAmyetadahaM tasya RRiSheH shrotuM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.2:
kiM kAraNaM jaratkArornAmaitatprathitaM bhuvi |
jaratkAruniruktaM tvaM yathAvadvaktumarhasi
shlokas.3:
sUta uvAcha||
jareti kShayamAhurvai dAruNaM kArusa~nj~nitam |
sharIraM kAru tasyAsIttatsa dhImA~nshanaiH shanaiH
shlokas.4:
kShapayAmAsa tIvreNa tapasetyata uchyate |
jaratkAruriti brahmanvAsukerbhaginI tathA
shlokas.5:
evamuktastu dharmAtmA shaunakaH prAhasattadA |
ugrashravasamAmantrya upapannamiti bruvan
shlokas.6:
sUta uvAcha||
atha kAlasya mahataH sa muniH sa.nshitavrataH |
tapasyabhirato dhImAnna dArAnabhyakA~NkShata
shlokas.7:
sa UrdhvaretAstapasi prasaktaH; svAdhyAyavAnvItabhayaklamaH san |
chachAra sarvAM pRRithivIM mahAtmA; na chApi dArAnmanasApyakA~NkShat
shlokas.8:
tato.aparasminsamprApte kAle kasmi.nshchideva tu |
parikShiditi vikhyAto rAjA kauravava.nshabhRRit
shlokas.9:
yathA pANDurmahAbAhurdhanurdharavaro bhuvi |
babhUva mRRigayAshIlaH purAsya prapitAmahaH
shlokas.10:
mRRigAnvidhyanvarAhA.nshcha tarakShUnmahiShA.nstathA |
anyA.nshcha vividhAnvanyA.nshchachAra pRRithivIpatiH
shlokas.11:
sa kadAchinmRRigaM viddhvA bANena nataparvaNA |
pRRiShThato dhanurAdAya sasAra gahane vane
shlokas.12:
yathA hi bhagavAnrudro viddhvA yaj~namRRigaM divi |
anvagachChaddhanuShpANiH paryanveSha.nstatastataH
shlokas.13:
na hi tena mRRigo viddho jIvangachChati vai vanam |
pUrvarUpaM tu tannUnamAsItsvargagatiM prati
parikShitastasya rAj~no viddho yannaShTavAnmRRigaH
shlokas.14:
dUraM chApahRRitastena mRRigeNa sa mahIpatiH |
parishrAntaH pipAsArta AsasAda muniM vane
shlokas.15:
gavAM prachAreShvAsInaM vatsAnAM mukhaniHsRRitam |
bhUyiShThamupayu~njAnaM phenamApibatAM payaH
shlokas.16:
tamabhidrutya vegena sa rAjA sa.nshitavratam |
apRRichChaddhanurudyamya taM muniM kShuchChramAnvitaH
shlokas.17:
bho bho brahmannahaM rAjA parikShidabhimanyujaH |
mayA viddho mRRigo naShTaH kachchittvaM dRRiShTavAnasi
shlokas.18:
sa munistasya novAcha ki~nchinmaunavrate sthitaH |
tasya skandhe mRRitaM sarpaM kruddho rAjA samAsajat
shlokas.19:
dhanuShkoTyA samutkShipya sa chainaM samudaikShata |
na cha ki~nchiduvAchainaM shubhaM vA yadi vAshubham
shlokas.20:
sa rAjA krodhamutsRRijya vyathitastaM tathAgatam |
dRRiShTvA jagAma nagaramRRiShistvAste tathaiva saH
shlokas.21:
taruNastasya putro.abhUttigmatejA mahAtapAH |
shRRi~NgI nAma mahAkrodho duShprasAdo mahAvrataH
shlokas.22:
sa devaM paramIshAnaM sarvabhUtahite ratam |
brahmANamupatasthe vai kAle kAle susa.nyataH
sa tena samanuj~nAto brahmaNA gRRihameyivAn
shlokas.23:
sakhyoktaH krIDamAnena sa tatra hasatA kila |
sa.nrambhI kopano.atIva viShakalpa RRiSheH sutaH
RRiShiputreNa narmArthaM kRRishena dvijasattama
shlokas.24:
tejasvinastava pitA tathaiva cha tapasvinaH |
shavaM skandhena vahati mA shRRi~Ngingarvito bhava
shlokas.25:
vyAharatsvRRiShiputreShu mA sma ki~nchidvacho vadIH |
asmadvidheShu siddheShu brahmavitsu tapasviShu
shlokas.26:
kva te puruShamAnitvaM kva te vAchastathAvidhAH |
darpajAH pitaraM yastvaM draShTA shavadharaM tathA

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa tejasvI shRRi~NgI kopasamanvitaH |
mRRitadhAraM guruM shrutvA paryatapyata manyunA
shlokas.2:
sa taM kRRishamabhipreShkya sUnRRitAM vAchamutsRRijan |
apRRichChata kathaM tAtaH sa me.adya mRRitadhArakaH
shlokas.3:
kRRisha uvAcha||
rAj~nA parikShitA tAta mRRigayAM paridhAvatA |
avasaktaH pituste.adya mRRitaH skandhe bhuja~NgamaH
shlokas.4:
shRRi~NgyuvAcha||
kiM me pitrA kRRitaM tasya rAj~no.aniShTaM durAtmanaH |
brUhi tvaM kRRisha tattvena pashya me tapaso balam
shlokas.5:
kRRisha uvAcha||
sa rAjA mRRigayAM yAtaH parikShidabhimanyujaH |
sasAra mRRigamekAkI viddhvA bANena patriNA
shlokas.6:
na chApashyanmRRigaM rAjA chara.nstasminmahAvane |
pitaraM te sa dRRiShTvaiva paprachChAnabhibhAShiNam
shlokas.7:
taM sthANubhUtaM tiShThantaM kShutpipAsAshramAturaH |
punaH punarmRRigaM naShTaM paprachCha pitaraM tava
shlokas.8:
sa cha maunavratopeto naiva taM pratyabhAShata |
tasya rAjA dhanuShkoTyA sarpaM skandhe samAsRRijat
shlokas.9:
shRRi~Ngi.nstava pitAdyAsau tathaivAste yatavrataH |
so.api rAjA svanagaraM pratiyAto gajAhvayam
shlokas.10:
sUta uvAcha||
shrutvaivamRRiShiputrastu divaM stabdhveva viShThitaH |
kopasa.nraktanayanaH prajvalanniva manyunA
shlokas.11:
AviShTaH sa tu kopena shashApa nRRipatiM tadA |
vAryupaspRRishya tejasvI krodhavegabalAtkRRitaH
shlokas.12:
shRRi~NgyuvAcha||
yo.asau vRRiddhasya tAtasya tathA kRRichChragatasya cha |
skandhe mRRitamavAsrAkShItpannagaM rAjakilbiShI
shlokas.13:
taM pApamatisa~NkruddhastakShakaH pannagottamaH |
AshIviShastigmatejA madvAkyabalachoditaH
shlokas.14:
saptarAtrAdito netA yamasya sadanaM prati |
dvijAnAmavamantAraM kurUNAmayashaskaram
shlokas.15:
sUta uvAcha||
iti shaptvA nRRipaM kruddhaH shRRi~NgI pitaramabhyayAt |
AsInaM gochare tasminvahantaM shavapannagam
shlokas.16:
sa tamAlakShya pitaraM shRRi~NgI skandhagatena vai |
shavena bhujagenAsIdbhUyaH krodhasamanvitaH
shlokas.17:
duHkhAchchAshrUNi mumuche pitaraM chedamabravIt |
shrutvemAM dharShaNAM tAta tava tena durAtmanA
shlokas.18:
rAj~nA parikShitA kopAdashapaM tamahaM nRRipam |
yathArhati sa evograM shApaM kurukulAdhamaH
shlokas.19:
saptame.ahani taM pApaM takShakaH pannagottamaH |
vaivasvatasya bhavanaM netA paramadAruNam
shlokas.20:
tamabravItpitA brahma.nstathA kopasamanvitam |
na me priyaM kRRitaM tAta naiSha dharmastapasvinAm
shlokas.21:
vayaM tasya narendrasya viShaye nivasAmahe |
nyAyato rakShitAstena tasya pApaM na rochaye
shlokas.22:
sarvathA vartamAnasya rAj~no hyasmadvidhaiH sadA |
kShantavyaM putra dharmo hi hato hanti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.23:
yadi rAjA na rakSheta pIDA vai naH parA bhavet |
na shaknuyAma charituM dharmaM putra yathAsukham
shlokas.24:
rakShyamANA vayaM tAta rAjabhiH shAstradRRiShTibhiH |
charAmo vipulaM dharmaM teShAM chA.nsho.asti dharmataH
shlokas.25:
parikShittu visheSheNa yathAsya prapitAmahaH |
rakShatyasmAnyathA rAj~nA rakShitavyAH prajAstathA
shlokas.26:
teneha kShudhitenAdya shrAntena cha tapasvinA |
ajAnatA vratamidaM kRRitametadasa.nshayam
shlokas.27:
tasmAdidaM tvayA bAlyAtsahasA duShkRRitaM kRRitam |
na hyarhati nRRipaH shApamasmattaH putra sarvathA

shlokas.1:
shRRi~NgyuvAcha||
yadyetatsAhasaM tAta yadi vA duShkRRitaM kRRitam |
priyaM vApyapriyaM vA te vAguktA na mRRiShA mayA
shlokas.2:
naivAnyathedaM bhavitA pitareSha bravImi te |
nAhaM mRRiShA prabravImi svaireShvapi kutaH shapan
shlokas.3:
shamIka uvAcha||
jAnAmyugraprabhAvaM tvAM putra satyagiraM tathA |
nAnRRitaM hyuktapUrvaM te naitanmithyA bhaviShyati
shlokas.4:
pitrA putro vayaHstho.api satataM vAchya eva tu |
yathA syAdguNasa.nyuktaH prApnuyAchcha mahadyashaH
shlokas.5:
kiM punarbAla eva tvaM tapasA bhAvitaH prabho |
vardhate cha prabhavatAM kopo.atIva mahAtmanAm
shlokas.6:
so.ahaM pashyAmi vaktavyaM tvayi dharmabhRRitAM vara |
putratvaM bAlatAM chaiva tavAvekShya cha sAhasam
shlokas.7:
sa tvaM shamayuto bhUtvA vanyamAhAramAharan |
chara krodhamimaM tyaktvA naivaM dharmaM prahAsyasi
shlokas.8:
krodho hi dharmaM harati yatInAM duHkhasa~nchitam |
tato dharmavihInAnAM gatiriShTA na vidyate
shlokas.9:
shama eva yatInAM hi kShamiNAM siddhikArakaH |
kShamAvatAmayaM lokaH parashchaiva kShamAvatAm
shlokas.10:
tasmAchcharethAH satataM kShamAshIlo jitendriyaH |
kShamayA prApsyase lokAnbrahmaNaH samanantarAn
shlokas.11:
mayA tu shamamAsthAya yachChakyaM kartumadya vai |
tatkariShye.adya tAtAhaM preShayiShye nRRipAya vai
shlokas.12:
mama putreNa shapto.asi bAlenAkRRitabuddhinA |
mamemAM dharShaNAM tvattaH prekShya rAjannamarShiNA
shlokas.13:
sUta uvAcha||
evamAdishya shiShyaM sa preShayAmAsa suvrataH |
parikShite nRRipataye dayApanno mahAtapAH
shlokas.14:
sa.ndishya kushalaprashnaM kAryavRRittAntameva cha |
