shiShyaM gauramukhaM nAma shIlavantaM samAhitam
shlokas.15:
so.abhigamya tataH shIghraM narendraM kuruvardhanam |
vivesha bhavanaM rAj~naH pUrvaM dvAHsthairniveditaH
shlokas.16:
pUjitashcha narendreNa dvijo gauramukhastataH |
Achakhyau parivishrAnto rAj~ne sarvamasheShataH
shamIkavachanaM ghoraM yathoktaM mantrisaMnidhau
shlokas.17:
shamIko nAma rAjendra viShaye vartate tava |
RRiShiH paramadharmAtmA dAntaH shAnto mahAtapAH
shlokas.18:
tasya tvayA naravyAghra sarpaH prANairviyojitaH |
avasakto dhanuShkoTyA skandhe bharatasattama
kShAntavA.nstava tatkarma putrastasya na chakShame
shlokas.19:
tena shapto.asi rAjendra pituraj~nAtamadya vai |
takShakaH saptarAtreNa mRRityuste vai bhaviShyati
shlokas.20:
tatra rakShAM kuruShveti punaH punarathAbravIt |
tadanyathA na shakyaM cha kartuM kenachidapyuta
shlokas.21:
na hi shaknoti sa.nyantuM putraM kopasamanvitam |
tato.ahaM preShitastena tava rAjanhitArthinA
shlokas.22:
iti shrutvA vacho ghoraM sa rAjA kurunandanaH |
paryatapyata tatpApaM kRRitvA rAjA mahAtapAH
shlokas.23:
taM cha maunavratadharaM shrutvA munivaraM tadA |
bhUya evAbhavadrAjA shokasantaptamAnasaH
shlokas.24:
anukroshAtmatAM tasya shamIkasyAvadhArya tu |
paryatapyata bhUyo.api kRRitvA tatkilbiShaM muneH
shlokas.25:
na hi mRRityuM tathA rAjA shrutvA vai so.anvatapyata |
ashochadamaraprakhyo yathA kRRitveha karma tat
shlokas.26:
tatastaM preShayAmAsa rAjA gauramukhaM tadA |
bhUyaH prasAdaM bhagavAnkarotviti mameti vai
shlokas.27:
tasmi.nshcha gatamAtre vai rAjA gauramukhe tadA |
mantribhirmantrayAmAsa saha sa.nvignamAnasaH
shlokas.28:
nishchitya mantribhishchaiva sahito mantratattvavit |
prAsAdaM kArayAmAsa ekastambhaM surakShitam
shlokas.29:
rakShAM cha vidadhe tatra bhiShajashchauShadhAni cha |
brAhmaNAnsiddhamantrA.nshcha sarvato vai nyaveshayat
shlokas.30:
rAjakAryANi tatrasthaH sarvANyevAkarochcha saH |
mantribhiH saha dharmaj~naH samantAtparirakShitaH
shlokas.31:
prApte tu divase tasminsaptame dvijasattama |
kAshyapo.abhyAgamadvidvA.nstaM rAjAnaM chikitsitum
shlokas.32:
shrutaM hi tena tadabhUdadya taM rAjasattamam |
takShakaH pannagashreShTho neShyate yamasAdanam
shlokas.33:
taM daShTaM pannagendreNa kariShye.ahamapajvaram |
tatra me.arthashcha dharmashcha bhaviteti vichintayan
shlokas.34:
taM dadarsha sa nAgendrastakShakaH kAshyapaM pathi |
gachChantamekamanasaM dvijo bhUtvA vayotigaH
shlokas.35:
tamabravItpannagendraH kAshyapaM munipu~Ngavam |
kva bhavA.nstvarito yAti kiM cha kAryaM chikIrShati
shlokas.36:
kAshyapa uvAcha||
nRRipaM kurukulotpannaM parikShitamari.ndamam |
takShakaH pannagashreShThastejasAdya pradhakShyati
shlokas.37:
taM daShTaM pannagendreNa tenAgnisamatejasA |
pANDavAnAM kulakaraM rAjAnamamitaujasam
gachChAmi saumya tvaritaM sadyaH kartumapajvaram
shlokas.38:
takShaka uvAcha||
ahaM sa takShako brahma.nstaM dhakShyAmi mahIpatim |
nivartasva na shaktastvaM mayA daShTaM chikitsitum
shlokas.39:
kAshyapa uvAcha||
ahaM taM nRRipatiM nAga tvayA daShTamapajvaram |
kariShya iti me buddhirvidyAbalamupAshritaH

shlokas.1:
takShaka uvAcha||
daShTaM yadi mayeha tvaM shaktaH ki~nchichchikitsitum |
tato vRRikShaM mayA daShTamimaM jIvaya kAshyapa
shlokas.2:
paraM mantrabalaM yatte taddarshaya yatasva cha |
nyagrodhamenaM dhakShyAmi pashyataste dvijottama
shlokas.3:
kAshyapa uvAcha||
dasha nAgendra vRRikShaM tvaM yamenamabhimanyase |
ahamenaM tvayA daShTaM jIvayiShye bhuja~Ngama
shlokas.4:
sUta uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa nAgendraH kAshyapena mahAtmanA |
adashadvRRikShamabhyetya nyagrodhaM pannagottamaH
shlokas.5:
sa vRRikShastena daShTaH sansadya eva mahAdyute |
AshIviShaviShopetaH prajajvAla samantataH
shlokas.6:
taM dagdhvA sa nagaM nAgaH kAshyapaM punarabravIt |
kuru yatnaM dvijashreShTha jIvayainaM vanaspatim
shlokas.7:
bhasmIbhUtaM tato vRRikShaM pannagendrasya tejasA |
bhasma sarvaM samAhRRitya kAshyapo vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.8:
vidyAbalaM pannagendra pashya me.asminvanaspatau |
ahaM sa~njIvayAmyenaM pashyataste bhuja~Ngama
shlokas.9:
tataH sa bhagavAnvidvAnkAshyapo dvijasattamaH |
bhasmarAshIkRRitaM vRRikShaM vidyayA samajIvayat
shlokas.10:
a~NkuraM taM sa kRRitavA.nstataH parNadvayAnvitam |
palAshinaM shAkhinaM cha tathA viTapinaM punaH
shlokas.11:
taM dRRiShTvA jIvitaM vRRikShaM kAshyapena mahAtmanA |
uvAcha takShako brahmannetadatyadbhutaM tvayi
shlokas.12:
viprendra yadviShaM hanyA mama vA madvidhasya vA |
kaM tvamarthamabhiprepsuryAsi tatra tapodhana
shlokas.13:
yatte.abhilaShitaM prAptuM phalaM tasmAnnRRipottamAt |
ahameva pradAsyAmi tatte yadyapi durlabham
shlokas.14:
viprashApAbhibhUte cha kShINAyuShi narAdhipe |
ghaTamAnasya te vipra siddhiH sa.nshayitA bhavet
shlokas.15:
tato yashaH pradIptaM te triShu lokeShu vishrutam |
virashmiriva gharmA.nshurantardhAnamito vrajet
shlokas.16:
kAshyapa uvAcha||
dhanArthI yAmyahaM tatra tanme ditsa bhuja~Ngama |
tato.ahaM vinivartiShye gRRihAyoragasattama
shlokas.17:
takShaka uvAcha||
yAvaddhanaM prArthayase tasmAdrAj~nastato.adhikam |
ahaM te.adya pradAsyAmi nivartasva dvijottama
shlokas.18:
sUta uvAcha||
takShakasya vachaH shrutvA kAshyapo dvijasattamaH |
pradadhyau sumahAtejA rAjAnaM prati buddhimAn
shlokas.19:
divyaj~nAnaH sa tejasvI j~nAtvA taM nRRipatiM tadA |
kShINAyuShaM pANDaveyamapAvartata kAshyapaH
labdhvA vittaM munivarastakShakAdyAvadIpsitam
shlokas.20:
nivRRitte kAshyape tasminsamayena mahAtmani |
jagAma takShakastUrNaM nagaraM nAgasAhvayam
shlokas.21:
atha shushrAva gachChansa takShako jagatIpatim |
mantrAgadairviShaharai rakShyamANaM prayatnataH
shlokas.22:
sa chintayAmAsa tadA mAyAyogena pArthivaH |
mayA va~nchayitavyo.asau ka upAyo bhavediti
shlokas.23:
tatastApasarUpeNa prAhiNotsa bhuja~NgamAn |
phalapatrodakaM gRRihya rAj~ne nAgo.atha takShakaH
shlokas.24:
takShaka uvAcha||
gachChadhvaM yUyamavyagrA rAjAnaM kAryavattayA |
phalapatrodakaM nAma pratigrAhayituM nRRipam
shlokas.25:
sUta uvAcha||
te takShakasamAdiShTAstathA chakrurbhuja~NgamAH |
upaninyustathA rAj~ne darbhAnApaH phalAni cha
shlokas.26:
tachcha sarvaM sa rAjendraH pratijagrAha vIryavAn |
kRRitvA cha teShAM kAryANi gamyatAmityuvAcha tAn
shlokas.27:
gateShu teShu nAgeShu tApasachChadmarUpiShu |
amAtyAnsuhRRidashchaiva provAcha sa narAdhipaH
shlokas.28:
bhakShayantu bhavanto vai svAdUnImAni sarvashaH |
tApasairupanItAni phalAni sahitA mayA
shlokas.29:
tato rAjA sasachivaH phalAnyAdAtumaichChata |
yadgRRihItaM phalaM rAj~nA tatra kRRimirabhUdaNuH
hrasvakaH kRRiShNanayanastAmro varNena shaunaka
shlokas.30:
sa taM gRRihya nRRipashreShThaH sachivAnidamabravIt |
astamabhyeti savitA viShAdadya na me bhayam
shlokas.31:
satyavAgastu sa muniH kRRimiko mAM dashatvayam |
takShako nAma bhUtvA vai tathA parihRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.32:
te chainamanvavartanta mantriNaH kAlachoditAH |
evamuktvA sa rAjendro grIvAyAM saMniveshya ha
kRRimikaM prAhasattUrNaM mumUrShurnaShTachetanaH
shlokas.33:
hasanneva cha bhogena takShakeNAbhiveShTitaH |
tasmAtphalAdviniShkramya yattadrAj~ne niveditam

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
taM tathA mantriNo dRRiShTvA bhogena pariveShTitam |
vivarNavadanAH sarve rurudurbhRRishaduHkhitAH
shlokas.2:
taM tu nAdaM tataH shrutvA mantriNaste pradudruvuH |
apashya.nshchaiva te yAntamAkAshe nAgamadbhutam
shlokas.3:
sImantamiva kurvANaM nabhasaH padmavarchasam |
takShakaM pannagashreShThaM bhRRishaM shokaparAyaNAH
shlokas.4:
tatastu te tadgRRihamagninA vRRitaM; pradIpyamAnaM viShajena bhoginaH |
bhayAtparityajya dishaH prapedire; papAta tachchAshanitADitaM yathA
shlokas.5:
tato nRRipe takShakatejasA hate; prayujya sarvAH paralokasatkriyAH |
shuchirdvijo rAjapurohitastadA; tathaiva te tasya nRRipasya mantriNaH
shlokas.6:
nRRipaM shishuM tasya sutaM prachakrire; sametya sarve puravAsino janAH |
nRRipaM yamAhustamamitraghAtinaM; kurupravIraM janamejayaM janAH
shlokas.7:
sa bAla evAryamatirnRRipottamaH; sahaiva tairmantripurohitaistadA |
shashAsa rAjyaM kurupu~NgavAgrajo; yathAsya vIraH prapitAmahastathA
shlokas.8:
tatastu rAjAnamamitratApanaM; samIkShya te tasya nRRipasya mantriNaH |
suvarNavarmANamupetya kAshipaM; vapuShTamArthaM varayAM prachakramuH
shlokas.9:
tataH sa rAjA pradadau vapuShTamAM; kurupravIrAya parIkShya dharmataH |
sa chApi tAM prApya mudA yuto.abhava;nna chAnyanArIShu mano dadhe kvachit
shlokas.10:
saraHsu phulleShu vaneShu chaiva ha; prasannachetA vijahAra vIryavAn |
tathA sa rAjanyavaro vijahrivA;nyathorvashIM prApya purA purUravAH
shlokas.11:
vapuShTamA chApi varaM patiM tadA; pratItarUpaM samavApya bhUmipam |
bhAvena rAmA ramayAM babhUva vai; vihArakAleShvavarodhasundarI

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
etasminneva kAle tu jaratkArurmahAtapAH |
chachAra pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM yatrasAya~NgRRiho muniH
shlokas.2:
charandIkShAM mahAtejA dushcharAmakRRitAtmabhiH |
tIrtheShvAplavanaM kurvanpuNyeShu vichachAra ha
shlokas.3:
vAyubhakSho nirAhAraH shuShyannaharaharmuniH |
sa dadarsha pitRRingarte lambamAnAnadhomukhAn
shlokas.4:
ekatantvavashiShTaM vai vIraNastambamAshritAn |
taM cha tantuM shanairAkhumAdadAnaM bilAshrayam
shlokas.5:
nirAhArAnkRRishAndInAngarte.a.artA.nstrANamichChataH |
upasRRitya sa tAndInAndInarUpo.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.6:
ke bhavanto.avalambante vIraNastambamAshritAH |
durbalaM khAditairmUlairAkhunA bilavAsinA
shlokas.7:
vIraNastambake mUlaM yadapyekamiha sthitam |
tadapyayaM shanairAkhurAdatte dashanaiH shitaiH
shlokas.8:
Chetsyate.alpAvashiShTatvAdetadapyachirAdiva |
tataH stha patitAro.atra garte asminnadhomukhAH
shlokas.9:
tato me duHkhamutpannaM dRRiShTvA yuShmAnadhomukhAn |
kRRichChrAmApadamApannAnpriyaM kiM karavANi vaH
shlokas.10:
tapaso.asya chaturthena tRRitIyenApi vA punaH |
ardhena vApi nistartumApadaM brUta mAchiram
shlokas.11:
athavApi samagreNa tarantu tapasA mama |
bhavantaH sarva evAsmAtkAmamevaM vidhIyatAm
shlokas.12:
pitara UchuH||
RRiddho bhavAnbrahmachArI yo nastrAtumihechChati |
na tu viprAgrya tapasA shakyametadvyapohitum
shlokas.13:
asti nastAta tapasaH phalaM pravadatAM vara |
santAnaprakShayAdbrahmanpatAmo niraye.ashuchau
shlokas.14:
lambatAmiha nastAta na j~nAnaM pratibhAti vai |
yena tvAM nAbhijAnImo loke vikhyAtapauruSham
shlokas.15:
RRiddho bhavAnmahAbhAgo yo naH shochyAnsuduHkhitAn |
shochasyupetya kAruNyAchChRRiNu ye vai vayaM dvija
shlokas.16:
yAyAvarA nAma vayamRRiShayaH sa.nshitavratAH |
lokAtpuNyAdiha bhraShTAH santAnaprakShayAdvibho
shlokas.17:
pranaShTaM nastapaH puNyaM na hi nastanturasti vai |
asti tveko.adya nastantuH so.api nAsti yathA tathA
shlokas.18:
mandabhAgyo.alpabhAgyAnAM bandhuH sa kila naH kule |
jaratkAruriti khyAto vedavedA~NgapAragaH
niyatAtmA mahAtmA cha suvrataH sumahAtapAH
shlokas.19:
tena sma tapaso lobhAtkRRichChramApAditA vayam |
na tasya bhAryA putro vA bAndhavo vAsti kashchana
shlokas.20:
tasmAllambAmahe garte naShTasa~nj~nA hyanAthavat |
sa vaktavyastvayA dRRiShTvA asmAkaM nAthavattayA
shlokas.21:
pitaraste.avalambante garte dInA adhomukhAH |
sAdhu dArAnkuruShveti prajAyasveti chAbhibho
kulatanturhi naH shiShTastvamevaikastapodhana
shlokas.22:
yaM tu pashyasi no brahmanvIraNastambamAshritAn |
eSho.asmAkaM kulastamba AsItsvakulavardhanaH
shlokas.23:
yAni pashyasi vai brahmanmUlAnIhAsya vIrudhaH |
ete nastantavastAta kAlena paribhakShitAH
shlokas.24:
yattvetatpashyasi brahmanmUlamasyArdhabhakShitam |
tatra lambAmahe sarve so.apyekastapa AsthitaH
shlokas.25:
yamAkhuM pashyasi brahmankAla eSha mahAbalaH |
sa taM taporataM mandaM shanaiH kShapayate tudan
jaratkAruM tapolubdhaM mandAtmAnamachetasam
shlokas.26:
na hi nastattapastasya tArayiShyati sattama |
ChinnamUlAnparibhraShTAnkAlopahatachetasaH
narakapratiShThAnpashyAsmAnyathA duShkRRitinastathA
shlokas.27:
asmAsu patiteShvatra saha pUrvaiH pitAmahaiH |
ChinnaH kAlena so.apyatra gantA vai narakaM tataH
shlokas.28:
tapo vApyathavA yaj~no yachchAnyatpAvanaM mahat |
tatsarvaM na samaM tAta santatyeti satAM matam
shlokas.29:
sa tAta dRRiShTvA brUyAstvaM jaratkAruM tapasvinam |
yathAdRRiShTamidaM chAsmai tvayAkhyeyamasheShataH
shlokas.30:
yathA dArAnprakuryAtsa putrA.nshchotpAdayedyathA |
tathA brahma.nstvayA vAchyaH so.asmAkaM nAthavattayA

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
etachChrutvA jaratkArurduHkhashokaparAyaNaH |
uvAcha svAnpitRRinduHkhAdbAShpasa.ndigdhayA girA
shlokas.2:
ahameva jaratkAruH kilbiShI bhavatAM sutaH |
taddaNDaM dhArayata me duShkRRiterakRRitAtmanaH
shlokas.3:
pitara UchuH||
putra diShTyAsi samprApta imaM deshaM yadRRichChayA |
kimarthaM cha tvayA brahmanna kRRito dArasa~NgrahaH
shlokas.4:
jaratkAruruvAcha||
mamAyaM pitaro nityaM hRRidyarthaH parivartate |
UrdhvaretAH sharIraM vai prApayeyamamutra vai
shlokas.5:
evaM dRRiShTvA tu bhavataH shakuntAniva lambataH |
mayA nivartitA buddhirbrahmacharyAtpitAmahAH
shlokas.6:
kariShye vaH priyaM kAmaM nivekShye nAtra sa.nshayaH |
sanAmnIM yadyahaM kanyAmupalapsye kadAchana
shlokas.7:
bhaviShyati cha yA kAchidbhaikShavatsvayamudyatA |
pratigrahItA tAmasmi na bhareyaM cha yAmaham
shlokas.8:
eva.nvidhamahaM kuryAM niveshaM prApnuyAM yadi |
anyathA na kariShye tu satyametatpitAmahAH
shlokas.9:
sUta uvAcha||
evamuktvA tu sa pitRRi.nshchachAra pRRithivIM muniH |
na cha sma labhate bhAryAM vRRiddho.ayamiti shaunaka
shlokas.10:
yadA nirvedamApannaH pitRRibhishchoditastathA |
tadAraNyaM sa gatvochchaishchukrosha bhRRishaduHkhitaH
shlokas.11:
yAni bhUtAni santIha sthAvarANi charANi cha |
antarhitAni vA yAni tAni shRRiNvantu me vachaH
shlokas.12:
ugre tapasi vartantaM pitarashchodayanti mAm |
nivishasveti duHkhArtAsteShAM priyachikIrShayA
shlokas.13:
niveshArthyakhilAM bhUmiM kanyAbhaikShaM charAmi bhoH |
daridro duHkhashIlashcha pitRRibhiH saMniyojitaH
shlokas.14:
yasya kanyAsti bhUtasya ye mayeha prakIrtitAH |
te me kanyAM prayachChantu charataH sarvatodisham
shlokas.15:
mama kanyA sanAmnI yA bhaikShavachchodyatA bhavet |
bhareyaM chaiva yAM nAhaM tAM me kanyAM prayachChata
shlokas.16:
tataste pannagA ye vai jaratkArau samAhitAH |
tAmAdAya pravRRittiM te vAsukeH pratyavedayan
shlokas.17:
teShAM shrutvA sa nAgendraH kanyAM tAM samala~NkRRitAm |
pragRRihyAraNyamagamatsamIpaM tasya pannagaH
shlokas.18:
tatra tAM bhaikShavatkanyAM prAdAttasmai mahAtmane |
nAgendro vAsukirbrahmanna sa tAM pratyagRRihNata
shlokas.19:
asanAmeti vai matvA bharaNe chAvichArite |
mokShabhAve sthitashchApi dvandvIbhUtaH parigrahe
shlokas.20:
tato nAma sa kanyAyAH paprachCha bhRRigunandana |
vAsuke bharaNaM chAsyA na kuryAmityuvAcha ha

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
vAsukistvabravIdvAkyaM jaratkArumRRiShiM tadA |
sanAmA tava kanyeyaM svasA me tapasAnvitA
shlokas.2:
bhariShyAmi cha te bhAryAM pratIchChemAM dvijottama |
rakShaNaM cha kariShye.asyAH sarvashaktyA tapodhana
shlokas.3:
pratishrute tu nAgena bhariShye bhaginImiti |
jaratkArustadA veshma bhujagasya jagAma ha
shlokas.4:
tatra mantravidAM shreShThastapovRRiddho mahAvrataH |
jagrAha pANiM dharmAtmA vidhimantrapuraskRRitam
shlokas.5:
tato vAsagRRihaM shubhraM pannagendrasya saMmatam |
jagAma bhAryAmAdAya stUyamAno maharShibhiH
shlokas.6:
shayanaM tatra vai kL^iptaM spardhyAstaraNasa.nvRRitam |
tatra bhAryAsahAyaH sa jaratkAruruvAsa ha
shlokas.7:
sa tatra samayaM chakre bhAryayA saha sattamaH |
vipriyaM me na kartavyaM na cha vAchyaM kadAchana
shlokas.8:
tyajeyamapriye hi tvAM kRRite vAsaM cha te gRRihe |
etadgRRihANa vachanaM mayA yatsamudIritam
shlokas.9:
tataH paramasa.nvignA svasA nAgapatestu sA |
atiduHkhAnvitA vAchaM tamuvAchaivamastviti
shlokas.10:
tathaiva sA cha bhartAraM duHkhashIlamupAcharat |
upAyaiH shvetakAkIyaiH priyakAmA yashasvinI
shlokas.11:
RRitukAle tataH snAtA kadAchidvAsukeH svasA |
bhartAraM taM yathAnyAyamupatasthe mahAmunim
shlokas.12:
tatra tasyAH samabhavadgarbho jvalanasaMnibhaH |
atIva tapasA yukto vaishvAnarasamadyutiH
shuklapakShe yathA somo vyavardhata tathaiva saH
shlokas.13:
tataH katipayAhasya jaratkArurmahAtapAH |
utsa~Nge.asyAH shiraH kRRitvA suShvApa parikhinnavat
shlokas.14:
tasmi.nshcha supte viprendre savitAstamiyAdgirim |
ahnaH parikShaye brahma.nstataH sAchintayattadA
vAsukerbhaginI bhItA dharmalopAnmanasvinI
shlokas.15:
kiM nu me sukRRitaM bhUyAdbharturutthApanaM na vA |
duHkhashIlo hi dharmAtmA kathaM nAsyAparAdhnuyAm
shlokas.16:
kopo vA dharmashIlasya dharmalopo.atha vA punaH |
dharmalopo garIyAnvai syAdatretyakaronmanaH
shlokas.17:
utthApayiShye yadyenaM dhruvaM kopaM kariShyati |
dharmalopo bhavedasya sandhyAtikramaNe dhruvam
shlokas.18:
iti nishchitya manasA jaratkArurbhuja~NgamA |
tamRRiShiM dIptatapasaM shayAnamanalopamam
uvAchedaM vachaH shlakShNaM tato madhurabhAShiNI
shlokas.19:
uttiShTha tvaM mahAbhAga sUryo.astamupagachChati |
sandhyAmupAssva bhagavannapaH spRRiShTvA yatavrataH
shlokas.20:
prAduShkRRitAgnihotro.ayaM muhUrto ramyadAruNaH |
sandhyA pravartate cheyaM pashchimAyAM dishi prabho
shlokas.21:
evamuktaH sa bhagavA~njaratkArurmahAtapAH |
bhAryAM prasphuramANoShTha idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.22:
avamAnaH prayukto.ayaM tvayA mama bhuja~Ngame |
samIpe te na vatsyAmi gamiShyAmi yathAgatam
shlokas.23:
na hi tejo.asti vAmoru mayi supte vibhAvasoH |
astaM gantuM yathAkAlamiti me hRRidi vartate
shlokas.24:
na chApyavamatasyeha vastuM rocheta kasyachit |
kiM punardharmashIlasya mama vA madvidhasya vA
shlokas.25:
evamuktA jaratkArurbhartrA hRRidayakampanam |
abravIdbhaginI tatra vAsukeH saMniveshane
shlokas.26:
nAvamAnAtkRRitavatI tavAhaM pratibodhanam |
dharmalopo na te vipra syAdityetatkRRitaM mayA
shlokas.27:
uvAcha bhAryAmityukto jaratkArurmahAtapAH |
RRiShiH kopasamAviShTastyaktukAmo bhuja~NgamAm
shlokas.28:
na me vAganRRitaM prAha gamiShye.ahaM bhuja~Ngame |
samayo hyeSha me pUrvaM tvayA saha mithaH kRRitaH
shlokas.29:
sukhamasmyuShito bhadre brUyAstvaM bhrAtaraM shubhe |
ito mayi gate bhIru gataH sa bhagavAniti
tvaM chApi mayi niShkrAnte na shokaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.30:
ityuktA sAnavadyA~NgI pratyuvAcha patiM tadA |
jaratkAruM jaratkArushchintAshokaparAyaNA
shlokas.31:
bAShpagadgadayA vAchA mukhena parishuShyatA |
kRRitA~njalirvarArohA paryashrunayanA tataH
dhairyamAlambya vAmorUrhRRidayena pravepatA
shlokas.32:
na mAmarhasi dharmaj~na parityaktumanAgasam |
dharme sthitAM sthito dharme sadA priyahite ratAm
shlokas.33:
pradAne kAraNaM yachcha mama tubhyaM dvijottama |
tadalabdhavatIM mandAM kiM mAM vakShyati vAsukhiH
shlokas.34:
mAtRRishApAbhibhUtAnAM j~nAtInAM mama sattama |
apatyamIpShitaM tvattastachcha tAvanna dRRishyate
shlokas.35:
tvatto hyapatyalAbhena j~nAtInAM me shivaM bhavet |
samprayogo bhavennAyaM mama moghastvayA dvija
shlokas.36:
j~nAtInAM hitamichChantI bhagava.nstvAM prasAdaye |
imamavyaktarUpaM me garbhamAdhAya sattama
kathaM tyaktvA mahAtmA sangantumichChasyanAgasam
shlokas.37:
evamuktastu sa munirbhAryAM vachanamabravIt |
yadyuktamanurUpaM cha jaratkArustapodhanaH
shlokas.38:
astyeSha garbhaH subhage tava vaishvAnaropamaH |
RRiShiH paramadharmAtmA vedavedA~NgapAragaH
shlokas.39:
evamuktvA sa dharmAtmA jaratkArurmahAnRRiShiH |
ugrAya tapase bhUyo jagAma kRRitanishchayaH

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
gatamAtraM tu bhartAraM jaratkAruravedayat |
bhrAtustvaritamAgamya yathAtathyaM tapodhana
shlokas.2:
tataH sa bhujagashreShThaH shrutvA sumahadapriyam |
uvAcha bhaginIM dInAM tadA dInataraH svayam
shlokas.3:
jAnAsi bhadre yatkAryaM pradAne kAraNaM cha yat |
pannagAnAM hitArthAya putraste syAttato yadi
shlokas.4:
sa sarpasatrAtkila no mokShayiShyati vIryavAn |
evaM pitAmahaH pUrvamuktavAnmAM suraiH saha
shlokas.5:
apyasti garbhaH subhage tasmAtte munisattamAt |
na chechChAmyaphalaM tasya dArakarma manIShiNaH
shlokas.6:
kAmaM cha mama na nyAyyaM praShTuM tvAM kAryamIdRRisham |
kiM tu kAryagarIyastvAttatastvAhamachUchudam
shlokas.7:
durvAsatAM viditvA cha bhartuste.atitapasvinaH |
nainamanvAgamiShyAmi kadAchiddhi shapetsa mAm
shlokas.8:
AchakShva bhadre bhartustvaM sarvameva vicheShTitam |
shalyamuddhara me ghoraM bhadre hRRidi chirasthitam
shlokas.9:
jaratkArustato vAkyamityuktA pratyabhAShata |
AshvAsayantI santaptaM vAsukiM pannageshvaram
shlokas.10:
pRRiShTo mayApatyahetoH sa mahAtmA mahAtapAH |
astItyudaramuddishya mamedaM gatavA.nshcha saH
shlokas.11:
svaireShvapi na tenAhaM smarAmi vitathaM kvachit |
uktapUrvaM kuto rAjansAmparAye sa vakShyati
shlokas.12:
na santApastvayA kAryaH kAryaM prati bhuja~Ngame |
utpatsyati hi te putro jvalanArkasamadyutiH
shlokas.13:
ityuktvA hi sa mAM bhrAtargato bhartA tapovanam |
tasmAdvyetu paraM duHkhaM tavedaM manasi sthitam
shlokas.14:
etachChrutvA sa nAgendro vAsukiH parayA mudA |
evamastviti tadvAkyaM bhaginyAH pratyagRRihNata
shlokas.15:
sAntvamAnArthadAnaishcha pUjayA chAnurUpayA |
sodaryAM pUjayAmAsa svasAraM pannagottamaH
shlokas.16:
tataH sa vavRRidhe garbho mahAtejA raviprabhaH |
yathA somo dvijashreShTha shuklapakShodito divi
shlokas.17:
yathAkAlaM tu sA brahmanprajaj~ne bhujagasvasA |
kumAraM devagarbhAbhaM pitRRimAtRRibhayApaham
shlokas.18:
vavRRidhe sa cha tatraiva nAgarAjaniveshane |
vedA.nshchAdhijage sA~NgAnbhArgavAchchyavanAtmajAt
shlokas.19:
charitavrato bAla eva buddhisattvaguNAnvitaH |
nAma chAsyAbhavatkhyAtaM lokeShvAstIka ityuta
shlokas.20:
astItyuktvA gato yasmAtpitA garbhasthameva tam |
vanaM tasmAdidaM tasya nAmAstIketi vishrutam
shlokas.21:
sa bAla eva tatrasthashcharannamitabuddhimAn |
gRRihe pannagarAjasya prayatnAtparyarakShyata
shlokas.22:
bhagavAniva deveshaH shUlapANirhiraNyadaH |
vivardhamAnaH sarvA.nstAnpannagAnabhyaharShayat

shlokas.1:
shaunaka uvAcha||
yadapRRichChattadA rAjA mantriNo janamejayaH |
pituH svargagatiM tanme vistareNa punarvada
shlokas.2:
sUta uvAcha||
shRRiNu brahmanyathA pRRiShTA mantriNo nRRipatestadA |
AkhyAtavantaste sarve nidhanaM tatparikShitaH
shlokas.3:
janamejaya uvAcha||
jAnanti tu bhavantastadyathAvRRittaH pitA mama |
AsIdyathA cha nidhanaM gataH kAle mahAyashAH
shlokas.4:
shrutvA bhavatsakAshAddhi piturvRRittamasheShataH |
kalyANaM pratipatsyAmi viparItaM na jAtu chit
shlokas.5:
sUta uvAcha||
mantriNo.athAbruvanvAkyaM pRRiShTAstena mahAtmanA |
sarvadharmavidaH prAj~nA rAjAnaM janamejayam
shlokas.6:
dharmAtmA cha mahAtmA cha prajApAlaH pitA tava |
AsIdiha yathAvRRittaH sa mahAtmA shRRiNuShva tat
shlokas.7:
chAturvarNyaM svadharmasthaM sa kRRitvA paryarakShata |
dharmato dharmavidrAjA dharmo vigrahavAniva
shlokas.8:
rarakSha pRRithivIM devIM shrImAnatulavikramaH |
dveShTArastasya naivAsansa cha na dveShTi ka~nchana
samaH sarveShu bhUteShu prajApatirivAbhavat
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNAH kShatriyA vaishyAH shUdrAshchaiva svakarmasu |
sthitAH sumanaso rAja.nstena rAj~nA svanuShThitAH
shlokas.10:
vidhavAnAthakRRipaNAnvikalA.nshcha babhAra saH |
sudarshaH sarvabhUtAnAmAsItsoma ivAparaH
shlokas.11:
tuShTapuShTajanaH shrImAnsatyavAgdRRiDhavikramaH |
dhanurvede cha shiShyo.abhUnnRRipaH shAradvatasya saH
shlokas.12:
govindasya priyashchAsItpitA te janamejaya |
lokasya chaiva sarvasya priya AsInmahAyashAH
shlokas.13:
parikShINeShu kuruShu uttarAyAmajAyata |
parikShidabhavattena saubhadrasyAtmajo balI
shlokas.14:
rAjadharmArthakushalo yuktaH sarvaguNairnRRipaH |
jitendriyashchAtmavA.nshcha medhAvI vRRiddhasevitaH
shlokas.15:
ShaDvargavinmahAbuddhirnItidharmaviduttamaH |
prajA imAstava pitA ShaShTiM varShANyapAlayat
tato diShTAntamApannaH sarpeNAnativartitam
shlokas.16:
tatastvaM puruShashreShTha dharmeNa pratipedivAn |
idaM varShasahasrAya rAjyaM kurukulAgatam
bAla evAbhijAto.asi sarvabhUtAnupAlakaH
shlokas.17:
janamejaya uvAcha||
nAsminkule jAtu babhUva rAjA; yo na prajAnAM hitakRRitpriyashcha |
visheShataH prekShya pitAmahAnAM; vRRittaM mahadvRRittaparAyaNAnAm
shlokas.18:
kathaM nidhanamApannaH pitA mama tathAvidhaH |
AchakShadhvaM yathAvanme shrotumichChAmi tattvataH
shlokas.19:
sUta uvAcha||
evaM sa~nchoditA rAj~nA mantriNaste narAdhipam |
UchuH sarve yathAvRRittaM rAj~naH priyahite ratAH
shlokas.20:
babhUva mRRigayAshIlastava rAjanpitA sadA |
yathA pANDurmahAbhAgo dhanurdharavaro yudhi
asmAsvAsajya sarvANi rAjakAryANyasheShataH
shlokas.21:
sa kadAchidvanacharo mRRigaM vivyAdha patriNA |
viddhvA chAnvasarattUrNaM taM mRRigaM gahane vane
shlokas.22:
padAtirbaddhanistri.nshastatAyudhakalApavAn |
na chAsasAda gahane mRRigaM naShTaM pitA tava
shlokas.23:
parishrAnto vayaHsthashcha ShaShTivarSho jarAnvitaH |
kShudhitaH sa mahAraNye dadarsha munimantike
shlokas.24:
sa taM paprachCha rAjendro muniM maunavratAnvitam |
na cha ki~nchiduvAchainaM sa muniH pRRichChato.api san
shlokas.25:
tato rAjA kShuchChramArtastaM muniM sthANuvatsthitam |
maunavratadharaM shAntaM sadyo manyuvashaM yayau
shlokas.26:
na bubodha hi taM rAjA maunavratadharaM munim |
sa taM manyusamAviShTo dharShayAmAsa te pitA
shlokas.27:
mRRitaM sarpaM dhanuShkoTyA samutkShipya dharAtalAt |
tasya shuddhAtmanaH prAdAtskandhe bharatasattama
shlokas.28:
na chovAcha sa medhAvI tamatho sAdhvasAdhu vA |
tasthau tathaiva chAkrudhyansarpaM skandhena dhArayan

shlokas.1:
mantriNa UchuH||
tataH sa rAjA rAjendra skandhe tasya bhuja~Ngamam |
muneH kShutkShAma Asajya svapuraM punarAyayau
shlokas.2:
RRiShestasya tu putro.abhUdgavi jAto mahAyashAH |
shRRi~NgI nAma mahAtejAstigmavIryo.atikopanaH
shlokas.3:
brahmANaM so.abhyupAgamya muniH pUjAM chakAra ha |
anuj~nAto gatastatra shRRi~NgI shushrAva taM tadA
sakhyuH sakAshAtpitaraM pitrA te dharShitaM tathA
shlokas.4:
mRRitaM sarpaM samAsaktaM pitrA te janamejaya |
vahantaM kurushArdUla skandhenAnapakAriNam
shlokas.5:
tapasvinamatIvAtha taM munipravaraM nRRipa |
jitendriyaM vishuddhaM cha sthitaM karmaNyathAdbhute
shlokas.6:
tapasA dyotitAtmAnaM sveShva~NgeShu yataM tathA |
shubhAchAraM shubhakathaM susthiraM tamalolupam
shlokas.7:
akShudramanasUyaM cha vRRiddhaM maunavrate sthitam |
sharaNyaM sarvabhUtAnAM pitrA viprakRRitaM tava
shlokas.8:
shashApAtha sa tachChrutvA pitaraM te ruShAnvitaH |
RRiSheH putro mahAtejA bAlo.api sthavirairvaraH
shlokas.9:
sa kShipramudakaM spRRiShTvA roShAdidamuvAcha ha |
pitaraM te.abhisandhAya tejasA prajvalanniva
shlokas.10:
anAgasi gurau yo me mRRitaM sarpamavAsRRijat |
taM nAgastakShakaH kruddhastejasA sAdayiShyati
saptarAtrAditaH pApaM pashya me tapaso balam
shlokas.11:
ityuktvA prayayau tatra pitA yatrAsya so.abhavat |
dRRiShTvA cha pitaraM tasmai shApaM taM pratyavedayat
shlokas.12:
sa chApi munishArdUlaH preShayAmAsa te pituH |
shapto.asi mama putreNa yatto bhava mahIpate
takShakastvAM mahArAja tejasA sAdayiShyati
shlokas.13:
shrutvA tu tadvacho ghoraM pitA te janamejaya |
yatto.abhavatparitrastastakShakAtpannagottamAt
shlokas.14:
tatastasmi.nstu divase saptame samupasthite |
rAj~naH samIpaM brahmarShiH kAshyapo gantumaichChata
shlokas.15:
taM dadarshAtha nAgendraH kAshyapaM takShakastadA |
tamabravItpannagendraH kAshyapaM tvaritaM vrajan
kva bhavA.nstvarito yAti kiM cha kAryaM chikIrShati
shlokas.16:
kAshyapa uvAcha||
yatra rAjA kurushreShThaH parikShinnAma vai dvija |
takShakeNa bhuja~Ngena dhakShyate kila tatra vai
shlokas.17:
gachChAmyahaM taM tvaritaH sadyaH kartumapajvaram |
mayAbhipannaM taM chApi na sarpo dharShayiShyati
shlokas.18:
takShaka uvAcha||
kimarthaM taM mayA daShTaM sa~njIvayitumichChasi |
brUhi kAmamahaM te.adya dadmi svaM veshma gamyatAm
shlokas.19:
mantriNa UchuH||
dhanalipsurahaM tatra yAmItyuktashcha tena saH |
tamuvAcha mahAtmAnaM mAnaya~nshlakShNayA girA
shlokas.20:
yAvaddhanaM prArthayase tasmAdrAj~nastato.adhikam |
gRRihANa matta eva tvaM saMnivartasva chAnagha
shlokas.21:
sa evamukto nAgena kAshyapo dvipadAM varaH |
labdhvA vittaM nivavRRite takShakAdyAvadIpsitam
shlokas.22:
tasminpratigate vipre Chadmanopetya takShakaH |
taM nRRipaM nRRipatishreShTha pitaraM dhArmikaM tava
shlokas.23:
prAsAdasthaM yattamapi dagdhavAnviShavahninA |
tatastvaM puruShavyAghra vijayAyAbhiShechitaH
shlokas.24:
etaddRRiShTaM shrutaM chApi yathAvannRRipasattama |
asmAbhirnikhilaM sarvaM kathitaM te sudAruNam
shlokas.25:
shrutvA chaitaM nRRipashreShTha pArthivasya parAbhavam |
asya charSherutta~Nkasya vidhatsva yadanantaram
shlokas.26:
janamejaya uvAcha||
etattu shrotumichChAmi aTavyAM nirjane vane |
sa.nvAdaM pannagendrasya kAshyapasya cha yattadA
shlokas.27:
kena dRRiShTaM shrutaM chApi bhavatAM shrotramAgatam |
shrutvA chAtha vidhAsyAmi pannagAntakarIM matim
shlokas.28:
mantriNa UchuH||
shRRiNu rAjanyathAsmAkaM yenaitatkathitaM purA |
samAgamaM dvijendrasya pannagendrasya chAdhvani
shlokas.29:
tasminvRRikShe naraH kashchidindhanArthAya pArthiva |
vichinvanpUrvamArUDhaH shuShkashAkhaM vanaspatim
abudhyamAnau taM tatra vRRikShasthaM pannagadvijau
shlokas.30:
sa tu tenaiva vRRikSheNa bhasmIbhUto.abhavattadA |
dvijaprabhAvAdrAjendra jIvitaH savanaspatiH
shlokas.31:
tena gatvA nRRipashreShTha nagare.asminniveditam |
yathAvRRittaM tu tatsarvaM takShakasya dvijasya cha
shlokas.32:
etatte kathitaM rAjanyathAvRRittaM yathAshrutam |
shrutvA tu nRRipashArdUla prakuruShva yathepsitam
shlokas.33:
sUta uvAcha||
mantriNAM tu vachaH shrutvA sa rAjA janamejayaH |
paryatapyata duHkhArtaH pratyapiMShatkare karam
shlokas.34:
niHshvAsamuShNamasakRRiddIrghaM rAjIvalochanaH |
mumochAshrUNi cha tadA netrAbhyAM pratataM nRRipaH
uvAcha cha mahIpAlo duHkhashokasamanvitaH
shlokas.35:
shrutvaitadbhavatAM vAkyaM piturme svargatiM prati |
nishchiteyaM mama matiryA vai tAM me nibodhata
shlokas.36:
anantaramahaM manye takShakAya durAtmane |
pratikartavyamityeva yena me hi.nsitaH pitA
shlokas.37:
RRiSherhi shRRi~NgervachanaM kRRitvA dagdhvA cha pArthivam |
yadi gachChedasau pApo nanu jIvetpitA mama
shlokas.38:
parihIyeta kiM tasya yadi jIvetsa pArthivaH |
kAshyapasya prasAdena mantriNAM sunayena cha
shlokas.39:
sa tu vAritavAnmohAtkAshyapaM dvijasattamam |
sa~njijIvayiShuM prAptaM rAjAnamaparAjitam
shlokas.40:
mahAnatikramo hyeSha takShakasya durAtmanaH |
dvijasya yo.adadaddravyaM mA nRRipaM jIvayediti
shlokas.41:
utta~Nkasya priyaM kurvannAtmanashcha mahatpriyam |
bhavatAM chaiva sarveShAM yAsyAmyapachitiM pituH

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
evamuktvA tataH shrImAnmantribhishchAnumoditaH |
Aruroha pratij~nAM sa sarpasatrAya pArthivaH
brahmanbharatashArdUlo rAjA pArikShitastadA
shlokas.2:
purohitamathAhUya RRitvijaM vasudhAdhipaH |
abravIdvAkyasampannaH sampadarthakaraM vachaH
shlokas.3:
yo me hi.nsitavA.nstAtaM takShakaH sa durAtmavAn |
pratikuryAM yathA tasya tadbhavanto bruvantu me
shlokas.4:
api tatkarma viditaM bhavatAM yena pannagam |
takShakaM sampradIpte.agnau prApsye.ahaM sahabAndhavam
shlokas.5:
yathA tena pitA mahyaM pUrvaM dagdho viShAgninA |
tathAhamapi taM pApaM dagdhumichChAmi pannagam
shlokas.6:
RRitvija UchuH||
asti rAjanmahatsatraM tvadarthaM devanirmitam |
sarpasatramiti khyAtaM purANe kathyate nRRipa
shlokas.7:
AhartA tasya satrasya tvannAnyo.asti narAdhipa |
iti paurANikAH prAhurasmAkaM chAsti sa kratuH
shlokas.8:
sUta uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa rAjarShirmene sarpaM hi takShakam |
hutAshanamukhaM dIptaM praviShTamiti sattama
shlokas.9:
tato.abravInmantravidastAnrAjA brAhmaNA.nstadA |
AhariShyAmi tatsatraM sambhArAH sambhriyantu me
shlokas.10:
tataste RRitvijastasya shAstrato dvijasattama |
deshaM taM mApayAmAsuryaj~nAyatanakAraNAt
yathAvajj~nAnaviduShaH sarve buddhyA paraM gatAH
shlokas.11:
RRiddhyA paramayA yuktamiShTaM dvijagaNAyutam |
prabhUtadhanadhAnyADhyamRRitvigbhiH suniveshitam
shlokas.12:
nirmAya chApi vidhivadyaj~nAyatanamIpsitam |
rAjAnaM dIkShayAmAsuH sarpasatrAptaye tadA
shlokas.13:
idaM chAsIttatra pUrvaM sarpasatre bhaviShyati |
nimittaM mahadutpannaM yaj~navighnakaraM tadA
shlokas.14:
yaj~nasyAyatane tasminkriyamANe vacho.abravIt |
sthapatirbuddhisampanno vAstuvidyAvishAradaH
shlokas.15:
ityabravItsUtradhAraH sUtaH paurANikastadA |
yasmindeshe cha kAle cha mApaneyaM pravartitA
brAhmaNaM kAraNaM kRRitvA nAyaM sa.nsthAsyate kratuH
shlokas.16:
etachChrutvA tu rAjA sa prAgdIkShAkAlamabravIt |
kShattAraM neha me kashchidaj~nAtaH pravishediti
shlokas.17:
tataH karma pravavRRite sarpasatre vidhAnataH |
paryakrAma.nshcha vidhivatsve sve karmaNi yAjakAH
shlokas.18:
paridhAya kRRiShNavAsA.nsi dhUmasa.nraktalochanAH |
juhuvurmantravachchaiva samiddhaM jAtavedasam
shlokas.19:
kampayantashcha sarveShAmuragANAM manA.nsi te |
sarpAnAjuhuvustatra sarvAnagnimukhe tadA
shlokas.20:
tataH sarpAH samApetuH pradIpte havyavAhane |
viveShTamAnAH kRRipaNA AhvayantaH parasparam
shlokas.21:
visphurantaH shvasantashcha veShTayantastathA pare |
puchChaiH shirobhishcha bhRRishaM chitrabhAnuM prapedire
shlokas.22:
shvetAH kRRiShNAshcha nIlAshcha sthavirAH shishavastathA |
ruvanto bhairavAnnAdAnpeturdIpte vibhAvasau
shlokas.23:
evaM shatasahasrANi prayutAnyarbudAni cha |
avashAni vinaShTAni pannagAnAM dvijottama
shlokas.24:
indurA iva tatrAnye hastihastA ivApare |
mattA iva cha mAta~NgA mahAkAyA mahAbalAH
shlokas.25:
uchchAvachAshcha bahavo nAnAvarNA viSholbaNAH |
ghorAshcha parighaprakhyA dandashUkA mahAbalAH
prapeturagnAvuragA mAtRRivAgdaNDapIDitAH

shlokas.1:
shaunaka uvAcha||
sarpasatre tadA rAj~naH pANDaveyasya dhImataH |
janamejayasya ke tvAsannRRitvijaH paramarShayaH
shlokas.2:
ke sadasyA babhUvushcha sarpasatre sudAruNe |
viShAdajanane.atyarthaM pannagAnAM mahAbhaye
shlokas.3:
sarvaM vistaratastAta bhavA~nsha.nsitumarhati |
sarpasatravidhAnaj~nA vij~neyAste hi sUtaja
shlokas.4:
sUta uvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi nAmAnIha manIShiNAm |
ye RRitvijaH sadasyAshcha tasyAsannRRipatestadA
shlokas.5:
tatra hotA babhUvAtha brAhmaNashchaNDabhArgavaH |
chyavanasyAnvaye jAtaH khyAto vedavidAM varaH
shlokas.6:
udgAtA brAhmaNo vRRiddho vidvAnkautsAryajaiminiH |
brahmAbhavachChAr~Ngaravo adhvaryurbodhapi~NgalaH
shlokas.7:
sadasyashchAbhavadvyAsaH putrashiShyasahAyavAn |
uddAlakaH shamaThakaH shvetaketushcha pa~nchamaH
shlokas.8:
asito devalashchaiva nAradaH parvatastathA |
AtreyaH kuNDajaTharo dvijaH kuTighaTastathA
shlokas.9:
vAtsyaH shrutashravA vRRiddhastapaHsvAdhyAyashIlavAn |
kahoDo devasharmA cha maudgalyaH shamasaubharaH
shlokas.10:
ete chAnye cha bahavo brAhmaNAH sa.nshitavratAH |
sadasyA abhava.nstatra satre pArikShitasya ha
shlokas.11:
juhvatsvRRitvikShvatha tadA sarpasatre mahAkratau |
ahayaH prApata.nstatra ghorAH prANibhayAvahAH
shlokas.12:
vasAmedovahAH kulyA nAgAnAM sampravartitAH |
vavau gandhashcha tumulo dahyatAmanishaM tadA
shlokas.13:
patatAM chaiva nAgAnAM dhiShThitAnAM tathAmbare |
ashrUyatAnishaM shabdaH pachyatAM chAgninA bhRRisham
shlokas.14:
takShakastu sa nAgendraH pura.ndaraniveshanam |
gataH shrutvaiva rAjAnaM dIkShitaM janamejayam
shlokas.15:
tataH sarvaM yathAvRRittamAkhyAya bhujagottamaH |
agachChachCharaNaM bhIta AgaskRRitvA pura.ndaram
shlokas.16:
tamindraH prAha suprIto na tavAstIha takShaka |
bhayaM nAgendra tasmAdvai sarpasatrAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.17:
prasAdito mayA pUrvaM tavArthAya pitAmahaH |
tasmAttava bhayaM nAsti vyetu te mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.18:
evamAshvAsitastena tataH sa bhujagottamaH |
uvAsa bhavane tatra shakrasya muditaH sukhI
shlokas.19:
ajasraM nipatatsvagnau nAgeShu bhRRishaduHkhitaH |
alpasheShaparIvAro vAsukiH paryatapyata
shlokas.20:
kashmalaM chAvishadghoraM vAsukiM pannageshvaram |
sa ghUrNamAnahRRidayo bhaginImidamabravIt
shlokas.21:
dahyante.a~NgAni me bhadre disho na pratibhAnti cha |
sIdAmIva cha saMmohAdghUrNatIva cha me manaH
shlokas.22:
dRRiShTirbhramati me.atIva hRRidayaM dIryatIva cha |
patiShyAmyavasho.adyAhaM tasmindIpte vibhAvasau
shlokas.23:
pArikShitasya yaj~no.asau vartate.asmajjighA.nsayA |
vyaktaM mayApi gantavyaM pitRRirAjaniveshanam
shlokas.24:
ayaM sa kAlaH samprApto yadarthamasi me svasaH |
jaratkAroH purA dattA sA trAhyasmAnsabAndhavAn
shlokas.25:
AstIkaH kila yaj~naM taM vartantaM bhujagottame |
pratiShetsyati mAM pUrvaM svayamAha pitAmahaH
shlokas.26:
tadvatse brUhi vatsaM svaM kumAraM vRRiddhasaMmatam |
mamAdya tvaM sabhRRityasya mokShArthaM vedavittamam

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
tata AhUya putraM svaM jaratkArurbhuja~NgamA |
vAsukernAgarAjasya vachanAdidamabravIt
shlokas.2:
ahaM tava pituH putra bhrAtrA dattA nimittataH |
kAlaH sa chAyaM samprAptastatkuruShva yathAtatham
shlokas.3:
AstIka uvAcha||
kiMnimittaM mama piturdattA tvaM mAtulena me |
tanmamAchakShva tattvena shrutvA kartAsmi tattathA
shlokas.4:
sUta uvAcha||
tata AchaShTa sA tasmai bAndhavAnAM hitaiShiNI |
bhaginI nAgarAjasya jaratkAruraviklavA
shlokas.5:
bhujagAnAmasheShANAM mAtA kadrUriti shrutiH |
tayA shaptA ruShitayA sutA yasmAnnibodha tat
shlokas.6:
uchChaiHshravAH so.ashvarAjo yanmithyA na kRRito mama |
vinatAnimittaM paNite dAsabhAvAya putrakAH
shlokas.7:
janamejayasya vo yaj~ne dhakShyatyanilasArathiH |
tatra pa~nchatvamApannAH pretalokaM gamiShyatha
shlokas.8:
tAM cha shaptavatImevaM sAkShAllokapitAmahaH |
evamastviti tadvAkyaM provAchAnumumoda cha
shlokas.9:
vAsukishchApi tachChrutvA pitAmahavachastadA |
amRRite mathite tAta devA~nsharaNamIyivAn
shlokas.10:
siddhArthAshcha surAH sarve prApyAmRRitamanuttamam |
bhrAtaraM me puraskRRitya prajApatimupAgaman
shlokas.11:
te taM prasAdayAmAsurdevAH sarve pitAmaham |
rAj~nA vAsukinA sArdhaM sa shApo na bhavediti
shlokas.12:
vAsukirnAgarAjo.ayaM duHkhito j~nAtikAraNAt |
abhishApaH sa mAtrAsya bhagavanna bhavediti
shlokas.13:
brahmovAcha||
jaratkArurjaratkAruM yAM bhAryAM samavApsyati |
tatra jAto dvijaH shApAdbhujagAnmokShayiShyati
shlokas.14:
jaratkAruruvAcha||
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM vAsukiH pannageshvaraH |
prAdAnmAmamaraprakhya tava pitre mahAtmane
prAgevAnAgate kAle tatra tvaM mayyajAyathAH
shlokas.15:
ayaM sa kAlaH samprApto bhayAnnastrAtumarhasi |
bhrAtaraM chaiva me tasmAttrAtumarhasi pAvakAt
shlokas.16:
amoghaM naH kRRitaM tatsyAdyadahaM tava dhImate |
pitre dattA vimokShArthaM kathaM vA putra manyase
shlokas.17:
sUta uvAcha||
evamuktastathetyuktvA so.astIko mAtaraM tadA |
abravIdduHkhasantaptaM vAsukiM jIvayanniva
shlokas.18:
ahaM tvAM mokShayiShyAmi vAsuke pannagottama |
tasmAchChApAnmahAsattva satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.19:
bhava svasthamanA nAga na hi te vidyate bhayam |
prayatiShye tathA saumya yathA shreyo bhaviShyati
na me vAganRRitaM prAha svaireShvapi kuto.anyathA
shlokas.20:
taM vai nRRipavaraM gatvA dIkShitaM janamejayam |
vAgbhirma~NgalayuktAbhistoShayiShye.adya mAtula
yathA sa yaj~no nRRipaternirvartiShyati sattama
shlokas.21:
sa sambhAvaya nAgendra mayi sarvaM mahAmate |
na te mayi mano jAtu mithyA bhavitumarhati
shlokas.22:
vAsukiruvAcha||
AstIka parighUrNAmi hRRidayaM me vidIryate |
dishashcha na prajAnAmi brahmadaNDanipIDitaH
shlokas.23:
AstIka uvAcha||
na santApastvayA kAryaH katha~nchitpannagottama |
dIptAdagneH samutpannaM nAshayiShyAmi te bhayam
shlokas.24:
brahmadaNDaM mahAghoraM kAlAgnisamatejasam |
nAshayiShyAmi mAtra tvaM bhayaM kArShIH katha~nchana
shlokas.25:
sUta uvAcha||
tataH sa vAsukerghoramapanIya manojvaram |
AdhAya chAtmano.a~NgeShu jagAma tvarito bhRRisham
shlokas.26:
janamejayasya taM yaj~naM sarvaiH samuditaM guNaiH |
mokShAya bhujagendrANAmAstIko dvijasattamaH
shlokas.27:
sa gatvApashyadAstIko yaj~nAyatanamuttamam |
vRRitaM sadasyairbahubhiH sUryavahnisamaprabhaiH
shlokas.28:
sa tatra vArito dvAHsthaiH pravishandvijasattamaH |
abhituShTAva taM yaj~naM praveshArthI dvijottamaH

shlokas.1:
AstIka uvAcha||
somasya yaj~no varuNasya yaj~naH; prajApateryaj~na AsItprayAge |
tathA yaj~no.ayaM tava bhAratAgrya; pArikShita svasti no.astu priyebhyaH
shlokas.2:
shakrasya yaj~naH shatasa~Nkhya ukta;stathAparastulyasa~NkhyaH shataM vai |
tathA yaj~no.ayaM tava bhAratAgrya; pArikShita svasti no.astu priyebhyaH
shlokas.3:
yamasya yaj~no harimedhasashcha; yathA yaj~no rantidevasya rAj~naH |
tathA yaj~no.ayaM tava bhAratAgrya; pArikShita svasti no.astu priyebhyaH
shlokas.4:
gayasya yaj~naH shashabindoshcha rAj~no; yaj~nastathA vaishravaNasya rAj~naH |
tathA yaj~no.ayaM tava bhAratAgrya; pArikShita svasti no.astu priyebhyaH
shlokas.5:
nRRigasya yaj~nastvajamIDhasya chAsI;dyathA yaj~no dAsharatheshcha rAj~naH |
tathA yaj~no.ayaM tava bhAratAgrya; pArikShita svasti no.astu priyebhyaH
shlokas.6:
yaj~naH shruto no divi devasUno;ryudhiShThirasyAjamIDhasya rAj~naH |
tathA yaj~no.ayaM tava bhAratAgrya; pArikShita svasti no.astu priyebhyaH
shlokas.7:
kRRiShNasya yaj~naH satyavatyAH sutasya; svayaM cha karma prachakAra yatra |
tathA yaj~no.ayaM tava bhAratAgrya; pArikShita svasti no.astu priyebhyaH
shlokas.8:
ime hi te sUryahutAshavarchasaH; samAsate vRRitrahaNaH kratuM yathA |
naiShAM j~nAnaM vidyate j~nAtumadya; dattaM yebhyo na praNashyetkatha~nchit
shlokas.9:
RRitviksamo nAsti lokeShu chaiva; dvaipAyaneneti vinishchitaM me |
etasya shiShyA hi kShitiM charanti; sarvartvijaH karmasu sveShu dakShAH
shlokas.10:
vibhAvasushchitrabhAnurmahAtmA; hiraNyaretA vishvabhukkRRiShNavartmA |
pradakShiNAvartashikhaH pradIpto; havyaM tavedaM hutabhugvaShTi devaH
shlokas.11:
neha tvadanyo vidyate jIvaloke; samo nRRipaH pAlayitA prajAnAm |
dhRRityA cha te prItamanAH sadAhaM; tvaM vA rAjA dharmarAjo yamo vA
shlokas.12:
shakraH sAkShAdvajrapANiryatheha; trAtA loke.asmi.nstvaM tatheha prajAnAm |
matastvaM naH puruShendreha loke; na cha tvadanyo gRRihapatirasti yaj~ne
shlokas.13:
khaTvA~NganAbhAgadilIpakalpo; yayAtimAndhAtRRisamaprabhAvaH |
AdityatejaHpratimAnatejA; bhIShmo yathA bhrAjasi suvratastvam
shlokas.14:
vAlmIkivatte nibhRRitaM sudhairyaM; vasiShThavatte niyatashcha kopaH |
prabhutvamindreNa samaM mataM me; dyutishcha nArAyaNavadvibhAti
shlokas.15:
yamo yathA dharmavinishchayaj~naH; kRRiShNo yathA sarvaguNopapannaH |
shriyAM nivAso.asi yathA vasUnAM; nidhAnabhUto.asi tathA kratUnAm
shlokas.16:
dambhodbhavenAsi samo balena; rAmo yathA shastravidastravichcha |
aurvatritAbhyAmasi tulyatejA; duShprekShaNIyo.asi bhagIratho vA
shlokas.17:
sUta uvAcha||
evaM stutAH sarva eva prasannA; rAjA sadasyA RRitvijo havyavAhaH |
teShAM dRRiShTvA bhAvitAnI~NgitAni; provAcha rAjA janamejayo.atha

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
bAlo vAkyaM sthavira iva prabhAShate; nAyaM bAlaH sthaviro.ayaM mato me |
ichChAmyahaM varamasmai pradAtuM; tanme viprA vitaradhvaM sametAH
shlokas.2:
sadasyA UchuH||
bAlo.api vipro mAnya eveha rAj~nAM; yashchAvidvAnyashcha vidvAnyathAvat |
sarvAnkAmA.nstvatta eSho.arhate.adya; yathA cha nastakShaka eti shIghram
shlokas.3:
sUta uvAcha||
vyAhartukAme varade nRRipe dvijaM; varaM vRRiNIShveti tato.abhyuvAcha |
hotA vAkyaM nAtihRRiShTAntarAtmA; karmaNyasmi.nstakShako naiti tAvat
shlokas.4:
janamejaya uvAcha||
yathA chedaM karma samApyate me; yathA cha nastakShaka eti shIghram |
tathA bhavantaH prayatantu sarve; paraM shaktyA sa hi me vidviShANaH
shlokas.5:
RRitvija UchuH||
yathA shAstrANi naH prAhuryathA sha.nsati pAvakaH |
indrasya bhavane rAja.nstakShako bhayapIDitaH
shlokas.6:
sUta uvAcha||
yathA sUto lohitAkSho mahAtmA; paurANiko veditavAnpurastAt |
sa rAjAnaM prAha pRRiShTastadAnIM; yathAhurviprAstadvadetannRRideva
shlokas.7:
purANamAgamya tato bravImyahaM; dattaM tasmai varamindreNa rAjan |
vaseha tvaM matsakAshe sugupto; na pAvakastvAM pradahiShyatIti
shlokas.8:
etachChrutvA dIkShitastapyamAna; Aste hotAraM chodayankarmakAle |
hotA cha yattaH sa juhAva mantrai;ratho indraH svayamevAjagAma
shlokas.9:
vimAnamAruhya mahAnubhAvaH; sarvairdevaiH parisa.nstUyamAnaH |
balAhakaishchApyanugamyamAno; vidyAdharairapsarasAM gaNaishcha
shlokas.10:
tasyottarIye nihitaH sa nAgo; bhayodvignaH sharma naivAbhyagachChat |
tato rAjA mantravido.abravItpunaH; kruddho vAkyaM takShakasyAntamichChan
shlokas.11:
indrasya bhavane viprA yadi nAgaH sa takShakaH |
tamindreNaiva sahitaM pAtayadhvaM vibhAvasau
shlokas.12:
RRitvija UchuH||
ayamAyAti vai tUrNaM takShakaste vashaM nRRipa |
shrUyate.asya mahAnnAdo ruvato bhairavaM bhayAt
shlokas.13:
nUnaM mukto vajrabhRRitA sa nAgo; bhraShTashchA~NkAnmantravisrastakAyaH |
ghUrNannAkAshe naShTasa~nj~no.abhyupaiti; tIvrAnniHshvAsAnniHshvasanpannagendraH
shlokas.14:
vartate tava rAjendra karmaitadvidhivatprabho |
asmai tu dvijamukhyAya varaM tvaM dAtumarhasi
shlokas.15:
janamejaya uvAcha||
bAlAbhirUpasya tavAprameya; varaM prayachChAmi yathAnurUpam |
vRRiNIShva yatte.abhimataM hRRidi sthitaM; tatte pradAsyAmyapi chedadeyam
shlokas.16:
sUta uvAcha||
patiShyamANe nAgendre takShake jAtavedasi |
idamantaramityevaM tadAstIko.abhyachodayat
shlokas.17:
varaM dadAsi chenmahyaM vRRiNomi janamejaya |
satraM te viramatvetanna pateyurihoragAH
shlokas.18:
evamuktastato rAjA brahmanpArikShitastadA |
nAtihRRiShTamanA vAkyamAstIkamidamabravIt
shlokas.19:
suvarNaM rajataM gAshcha yachchAnyanmanyase vibho |
tatte dadyAM varaM vipra na nivartetkraturmama
shlokas.20:
AstIka uvAcha||
suvarNaM rajataM gAshcha na tvAM rAjanvRRiNomyaham |
satraM te viramatvetatsvasti mAtRRikulasya naH
shlokas.21:
sUta uvAcha||
AstIkenaivamuktastu rAjA pArikShitastadA |
punaH punaruvAchedamAstIkaM vadatAM varam
shlokas.22:
anyaM varaya bhadraM te varaM dvijavarottama |
ayAchata na chApyanyaM varaM sa bhRRigunandana
shlokas.23:
tato vedavidastatra sadasyAH sarva eva tam |
rAjAnamUchuH sahitA labhatAM brAhmaNo varam

shlokas.1:
shaunaka uvAcha||
ye sarpAH sarpasatre.asminpatitA havyavAhane |
teShAM nAmAni sarveShAM shrotumichChAmi sUtaja
shlokas.2:
sUta uvAcha||
sahasrANi bahUnyasminprayutAnyarbudAni cha |
na shakyaM parisa~NkhyAtuM bahutvAdvedavittama
shlokas.3:
yathAsmRRiti tu nAmAni pannagAnAM nibodha me |
uchyamAnAni mukhyAnAM hutAnAM jAtavedasi
shlokas.4:
vAsukeH kulajA.nstAvatprAdhAnyena nibodha me |
nIlaraktAnsitAnghorAnmahAkAyAnviSholbaNAn
shlokas.5:
koTiko mAnasaH pUrNaH sahaH pailo halIsakaH |
pichChilaH koNapashchakraH koNavegaH prakAlanaH
shlokas.6:
hiraNyavAhaH sharaNaH kakShakaH kAladantakaH |
ete vAsukijA nAgAH praviShTA havyavAhanam
shlokas.7:
takShakasya kule jAtAnpravakShyAmi nibodha tAn |
puchChaNDako maNDalakaH piNDabhettA rabheNakaH
shlokas.8:
uchChikhaH suraso dra~Ngo balaheDo virohaNaH |
shilIshalakaro mUkaH sukumAraH pravepanaH
shlokas.9:
mudgaraH shasharomA cha sumanA vegavAhanaH |
ete takShakajA nAgAH praviShTA havyavAhanam
shlokas.10:
pArAvataH pAriyAtraH pANDaro hariNaH kRRishaH |
viha~NgaH sharabho modaH pramodaH saMhatA~NgadaH
shlokas.11:
airAvatakulAdete praiviShTA havyavAhanam |
kauravyakulajAnnAgA~nshRRiNu me dvijasattama
shlokas.12:
aiNDilaH kuNDalo muNDo veNiskandhaH kumArakaH |
bAhukaH shRRi~Ngavegashcha dhUrtakaH pAtapAtarau
shlokas.13:
dhRRitarAShTrakule jAtA~nshRRiNu nAgAnyathAtatham |
kIrtyamAnAnmayA brahmanvAtavegAnviSholbaNAn
shlokas.14:
sha~NkukarNaH pi~NgalakaH kuThAramukhamechakau |
pUrNA~NgadaH pUrNamukhaH prahasaH shakunirhariH
shlokas.15:
AmAhaThaH komaThakaH shvasano mAnavo vaTaH |
bhairavo muNDavedA~NgaH pisha~NgashchodrapAragaH
shlokas.16:
RRiShabho vegavAnnAma piNDArakamahAhanU |
raktA~NgaH sarvasAra~NgaH samRRiddhaH pATarAkShasau
shlokas.17:
varAhako vAraNakaH sumitrashchitravedikaH |
parAsharastaruNako maNiskandhastathAruNiH
shlokas.18:
iti nAgA mayA brahmankIrtitAH kIrtivardhanAH |
prAdhAnyena bahutvAttu na sarve parikIrtitAH
shlokas.19:
eteShAM putrapautrAstu prasavasya cha santatiH |
na shakyAH parisa~NkhyAtuM ye dIptaM pAvakaM gatAH
shlokas.20:
saptashIrShA dvishIrShAshcha pa~nchashIrShAstathApare |
kAlAnalaviShA ghorA hutAH shatasahasrashaH
shlokas.21:
mahAkAyA mahAvIryAH shailashRRi~NgasamuchChrayAH |
yojanAyAmavistArA dviyojanasamAyatAH
shlokas.22:
kAmarUpAH kAmagamA dIptAnalaviSholbaNAH |
dagdhAstatra mahAsatre brahmadaNDanipIDitAH

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
idamatyadbhutaM chAnyadAstIkasyAnushushrumaH |
tathA varaishChandyamAne rAj~nA pArikShitena ha
shlokas.2:
indrahastAchchyuto nAgaH kha eva yadatiShThata |
tatashchintAparo rAjA babhUva janamejayaH
shlokas.3:
hUyamAne bhRRishaM dIpte vidhivatpAvake tadA |
na sma sa prApatadvahnau takShako bhayapIDitaH
shlokas.4:
shaunaka uvAcha||
kiM sUta teShAM viprANAM mantragrAmo manIShiNAm |
na pratyabhAttadAgnau yanna papAta sa takShakaH
shlokas.5:
sUta uvAcha||
tamindrahastAdvisrastaM visa~nj~naM pannagottamam |
AstIkastiShTha tiShTheti vAchastisro.abhyudairayat
shlokas.6:
vitasthe so.antarikShe.atha hRRidayena vidUyatA |
yathA tiShTheta vai kashchidgochakrasyAntarA naraH
shlokas.7:
tato rAjAbravIdvAkyaM sadasyaishchodito bhRRisham |
kAmametadbhavatvevaM yathAstIkasya bhAShitam
shlokas.8:
samApyatAmidaM karma pannagAH santvanAmayAH |
prIyatAmayamAstIkaH satyaM sUtavacho.astu tat
shlokas.9:
tato halahalAshabdaH prItijaH samavartata |
AstIkasya vare datte tathaivopararAma cha
shlokas.10:
sa yaj~naH pANDaveyasya rAj~naH pArikShitasya ha |
prItimA.nshchAbhavadrAjA bhArato janamejayaH
shlokas.11:
RRitvigbhyaH sasadasyebhyo ye tatrAsansamAgatAH |
tebhyashcha pradadau vittaM shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.12:
lohitAkShAya sUtAya tathA sthapataye vibhuH |
yenoktaM tatra satrAgre yaj~nasya vinivartanam
shlokas.13:
nimittaM brAhmaNa iti tasmai vittaM dadau bahu |
tatashchakArAvabhRRithaM vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.14:
AstIkaM preShayAmAsa gRRihAneva susatkRRitam |
rAjA prItamanAH prItaM kRRitakRRityaM manIShiNam
shlokas.15:
punarAgamanaM kAryamiti chainaM vacho.abravIt |
bhaviShyasi sadasyo me vAjimedhe mahAkratau
shlokas.16:
tathetyuktvA pradudrAva sa chAstIko mudA yutaH |
kRRitvA svakAryamatulaM toShayitvA cha pArthivam
shlokas.17:
sa gatvA paramaprIto mAtaraM mAtulaM cha tam |
abhigamyopasa~NgRRihya yathAvRRittaM nyavedayat
shlokas.18:
etachChrutvA prIyamANAH sametA; ye tatrAsanpannagA vItamohAH |
te.a.astIke vai prItimanto babhUvu;rUchushchainaM varamiShTaM vRRiNIShva
shlokas.19:
bhUyo bhUyaH sarvashaste.abruva.nstaM; kiM te priyaM karavAmo.adya vidvan |
prItA vayaM mokShitAshchaiva sarve; kAmaM kiM te karavAmo.adya vatsa
shlokas.20:
AstIka uvAcha||
sAyaM prAtaH suprasannAtmarUpA; loke viprA mAnavAshchetare.api |
dharmAkhyAnaM ye vadeyurmamedaM; teShAM yuShmadbhyo naiva ki~nchidbhayaM syAt
shlokas.21:
sUta uvAcha||
taishchApyukto bhAgineyaH prasannai;retatsatyaM kAmamevaM charantaH |
prItyA yuktA IpsitaM sarvashaste; kartAraH sma pravaNA bhAgineya
shlokas.22:
jaratkArorjaratkArvAM samutpanno mahAyashAH |
AstIkaH satyasandho mAM pannagebhyo.abhirakShatu
shlokas.23:
asitaM chArtimantaM cha sunIthaM chApi yaH smaret |
divA vA yadi vA rAtrau nAsya sarpabhayaM bhavet
shlokas.24:
sUta uvAcha||
mokShayitvA sa bhujagAnsarpasatrAddvijottamaH |
jagAma kAle dharmAtmA diShTAntaM putrapautravAn
shlokas.25:
ityAkhyAnaM mayAstIkaM yathAvatkIrtitaM tava |
yatkIrtayitvA sarpebhyo na bhayaM vidyate kvachit
shlokas.26:
shrutvA dharmiShThamAkhyAnamAstIkaM puNyavardhanam |
AstIkasya kavervipra shrImachcharitamAditaH
shlokas.27:
shaunaka uvAcha||
bhRRiguva.nshAtprabhRRityeva tvayA me kathitaM mahat |
AkhyAnamakhilaM tAta saute prIto.asmi tena te
shlokas.28:
prakShyAmi chaiva bhUyastvAM yathAvatsUtanandana |
yAM kathAM vyAsasampannAM tAM cha bhUyaH prachakShva me
shlokas.29:
tasminparamaduShprApe sarpasatre mahAtmanAm |
karmAntareShu vidhivatsadasyAnAM mahAkave
shlokas.30:
yA babhUvuH kathAshchitrA yeShvartheShu yathAtatham |
tvatta ichChAmahe shrotuM saute tvaM vai vichakShaNaH
shlokas.31:
sUta uvAcha||
karmAntareShvakathayandvijA vedAshrayAH kathAH |
vyAsastvakathayannityamAkhyAnaM bhArataM mahat
shlokas.32:
shaunaka uvAcha||
mahAbhAratamAkhyAnaM pANDavAnAM yashaskaram |
janamejayena yatpRRiShTaH kRRiShNadvaipAyanastadA
shlokas.33:
shrAvayAmAsa vidhivattadA karmAntareShu saH |
tAmahaM vidhivatpuNyAM shrotumichChAmi vai kathAm
shlokas.34:
manaHsAgarasambhUtAM maharSheH puNyakarmaNaH |
kathayasva satAM shreShTha na hi tRRipyAmi sUtaja
shlokas.35:
sUta uvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi mahadAkhyAnamuttamam |
kRRiShNadvaipAyanamataM mahAbhAratamAditaH
shlokas.36:
tajjuShasvottamamate kathyamAnaM mayA dvija |
sha.nsituM tanmanoharSho mamApIha pravartate

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
shrutvA tu sarpasatrAya dIkShitaM janamejayam |
abhyAgachChadRRiShirvidvAnkRRiShNadvaipAyanastadA
shlokas.2:
janayAmAsa yaM kAlI shakteH putrAtparAsharAt |
kanyaiva yamunAdvIpe pANDavAnAM pitAmaham
shlokas.3:
jAtamAtrashcha yaH sadya iShTyA dehamavIvRRidhat |
vedA.nshchAdhijage sA~NgAnsetihAsAnmahAyashAH
shlokas.4:
yaM nAtitapasA kashchinna vedAdhyayanena cha |
na vratairnopavAsaishcha na prasUtyA na manyunA
shlokas.5:
vivyAsaikaM chaturdhA yo vedaM vedavidAM varaH |
parAvaraj~no brahmarShiH kaviH satyavrataH shuchiH
shlokas.6:
yaH pANDuM dhRRitarAShTraM cha viduraM chApyajIjanat |
shantanoH santatiM tanvanpuNyakIrtirmahAyashAH
shlokas.7:
janamejayasya rAjarSheH sa tadyaj~nasadastadA |
vivesha shiShyaiH sahito vedavedA~NgapAragaiH
shlokas.8:
tatra rAjAnamAsInaM dadarsha janamejayam |
vRRitaM sadasyairbahubhirdevairiva pura.ndaram
shlokas.9:
tathA mUrdhAvasiktaishcha nAnAjanapadeshvaraiH |
RRitvigbhirdevakalpaishcha kushalairyaj~nasa.nstare
shlokas.10:
janamejayastu rAjarShirdRRiShTvA tamRRiShimAgatam |
sagaNo.abyudyayau tUrNaM prItyA bharatasattamaH
shlokas.11:
kA~nchanaM viShTaraM tasmai sadasyAnumate prabhuH |
AsanaM kalpayAmAsa yathA shakro bRRihaspateH
shlokas.12:
tatropaviShTaM varadaM devarShigaNapUjitam |
pUjayAmAsa rAjendraH shAstradRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.13:
pAdyamAchamanIyaM cha arghyaM gAM cha vidhAnataH |
pitAmahAya kRRiShNAya tadarhAya nyavedayat
shlokas.14:
pratigRRihya cha tAM pUjAM pANDavAjjanamejayAt |
gAM chaiva samanuj~nAya vyAsaH prIto.abhavattadA
shlokas.15:
tathA sampUjayitvA taM yatnena prapitAmaham |
upopavishya prItAtmA paryapRRichChadanAmayam
shlokas.16:
bhagavAnapi taM dRRiShTvA kushalaM prativedya cha |
sadasyaiH pUjitaH sarvaiH sadasyAnabhyapUjayat
shlokas.17:
tatastaM satkRRitaM sarvaiH sadasyairjanamejayaH |
idaM pashchAddvijashreShThaM paryapRRichChatkRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.18:
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha bhavAnpratyakShadarshivAn |
teShAM charitamichChAmi kathyamAnaM tvayA dvija
shlokas.19:
kathaM samabhavadbhedasteShAmakliShTakarmaNAm |
tachcha yuddhaM kathaM vRRittaM bhUtAntakaraNaM mahat
shlokas.20:
pitAmahAnAM sarveShAM daivenAviShTachetasAm |
kArtsnyenaitatsamAchakShva bhagavankushalo hyasi
shlokas.21:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA kRRiShNadvaipAyanastadA |
shashAsa shiShyamAsInaM vaishampAyanamantike
shlokas.22:
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha yathA bhedo.abhavatpurA |
tadasmai sarvamAchakShva yanmattaH shrutavAnasi
shlokas.23:
gurorvachanamAj~nAya sa tu viprarShabhastadA |
AchachakShe tataH sarvamitihAsaM purAtanam
shlokas.24:
tasmai rAj~ne sadasyebhyaH kShatriyebhyashcha sarvashaH |
bhedaM rAjyavinAshaM cha kurupANDavayostadA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
gurave prA~NnamaskRRitya manobuddhisamAdhibhiH |
sampUjya cha dvijAnsarvA.nstathAnyAnviduSho janAn
shlokas.2:
maharSheH sarvalokeShu vishrutasyAsya dhImataH |
pravakShyAmi mataM kRRitsnaM vyAsasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.3:
shrotuM pAtraM cha rAja.nstvaM prApyemAM bhAratIM kathAm |
gurorvaktuM parispando mudA protsAhatIva mAm
shlokas.4:
shRRiNu rAjanyathA bhedaH kurupANDavayorabhUt |
rAjyArthe dyUtasambhUto vanavAsastathaiva cha
shlokas.5:
yathA cha yuddhamabhavatpRRithivIkShayakArakam |
tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi pRRichChate bharatarShabha
shlokas.6:
mRRite pitari te vIrA vanAdetya svamandiram |
nachirAdiva vidvA.nso vede dhanuShi chAbhavan
shlokas.7:
tA.nstathA rUpavIryaujaHsampannAnpaurasaMmatAn |
nAmRRiShyankuravo dRRiShTvA pANDavA~nshrIyashobhRRitaH
shlokas.8:
tato duryodhanaH krUraH karNashcha sahasaubalaH |
teShAM nigrahanirvAsAnvividhA.nste samAcharan
shlokas.9:
dadAvatha viShaM pApo bhImAya dhRRitarAShTrajaH |
jarayAmAsa tadvIraH sahAnnena vRRikodaraH
shlokas.10:
pramANakoTyAM sa.nsuptaM punarbaddhvA vRRikodaram |
toyeShu bhImaM ga~NgAyAH prakShipya puramAvrajat
shlokas.11:
yadA prabuddhaH kaunteyastadA sa~nChidya bandhanam |
udatiShThanmahArAja bhImaseno gatavyathaH
shlokas.12:
AshIviShaiH kRRiShNasarpaiH suptaM chainamada.nshayat |
sarveShvevA~NgadesheShu na mamAra cha shatruhA
shlokas.13:
teShAM tu viprakAreShu teShu teShu mahAmatiH |
mokShaNe pratighAte cha viduro.avahito.abhavat
shlokas.14:
svargastho jIvalokasya yathA shakraH sukhAvahaH |
pANDavAnAM tathA nityaM viduro.api sukhAvahaH
shlokas.15:
yadA tu vividhopAyaiH sa.nvRRitairvivRRitairapi |
nAshaknodvinihantuM tAndaivabhAvyartharakShitAn
shlokas.16:
tataH saMmantrya sachivairvRRiShaduHshAsanAdibhiH |
dhRRitarAShTramanuj~nApya jAtuShaM gRRihamAdishat
shlokas.17:
tatra tAnvAsayAmAsa pANDavAnamitaujasaH |
adAhayachcha visrabdhAnpAvakena punastadA
shlokas.18:
vidurasyaiva vachanAtkhanitrI vihitA tataH |
mokShayAmAsa yogena te muktAH prAdravanbhayAt
shlokas.19:
tato mahAvane ghore hiDimbaM nAma rAkShasam |
bhImaseno.avadhItkruddho bhuvi bhImaparAkramaH
shlokas.20:
atha sandhAya te vIrA ekachakrAM vraja.nstadA |
brahmarUpadharA bhUtvA mAtrA saha parantapAH
shlokas.21:
tatra te brAhmaNArthAya bakaM hatvA mahAbalam |
brAhmaNaiH sahitA jagmuH pA~nchAlAnAM puraM tataH
shlokas.22:
te tatra draupadIM labdhvA parisa.nvatsaroShitAH |
viditA hAstinapuraM pratyAjagmurari.ndamAH
shlokas.23:
ta uktA dhRRitarAShTreNa rAj~nA shAntanavena cha |
bhrAtRRibhirvigrahastAta kathaM vo na bhavediti
asmAbhiH khANDavaprasthe yuShmadvAso.anuchintitaH
shlokas.24:
tasmAjjanapadopetaM suvibhaktamahApatham |
vAsAya khANDavaprasthaM vrajadhvaM gatamanyavaH
shlokas.25:
tayoste vachanAjjagmuH saha sarvaiH suhRRijjanaiH |
nagaraM khANDavaprasthaM ratnAnyAdAya sarvashaH
shlokas.26:
tatra te nyavasanrAjansa.nvatsaragaNAnbahUn |
vashe shastrapratApena kurvanto.anyAnmahIkShitaH
shlokas.27:
evaM dharmapradhAnAste satyavrataparAyaNAH |
apramattotthitAH kShAntAH pratapanto.ahitA.nstadA
shlokas.28:
ajayadbhImasenastu dishaM prAchIM mahAbalaH |
udIchImarjuno vIraH pratIchIM nakulastathA
shlokas.29:
dakShiNAM sahadevastu vijigye paravIrahA |
evaM chakrurimAM sarve vashe kRRitsnAM vasundharAm
shlokas.30:
pa~nchabhiH sUryasa~NkAshaiH sUryeNa cha virAjatA |
ShaTsUryevAbabhau pRRithvI pANDavaiH satyavikramaiH
shlokas.31:
tato nimitte kasmi.nshchiddharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
vanaM prasthApayAmAsa bhrAtaraM vai dhana~njayam
shlokas.32:
sa vai sa.nvatsaraM pUrNaM mAsaM chaikaM vane.avasat |
tato.agachChaddhRRiShIkeshaM dvAravatyAM kadAchana
shlokas.33:
labdhavA.nstatra bIbhatsurbhAryAM rAjIvalochanAm |
anujAM vAsudevasya subhadrAM bhadrabhAShiNIm
shlokas.34:
sA shachIva mahendreNa shrIH kRRiShNeneva sa~NgatA |
subhadrA yuyuje prItA pANDavenArjunena ha
shlokas.35:
atarpayachcha kaunteyaH khANDave havyavAhanam |
bIbhatsurvAsudevena sahito nRRipasattama
shlokas.36:
nAtibhAro hi pArthasya keshavenAbhavatsaha |
vyavasAyasahAyasya viShNoH shatruvadheShviva
shlokas.37:
pArthAyAgnirdadau chApi gANDIvaM dhanuruttamam |
iShudhI chAkShayairbANai rathaM cha kapilakShaNam
shlokas.38:
mokShayAmAsa bIbhatsurmayaM tatra mahAsuram |
sa chakAra sabhAM divyAM sarvaratnasamAchitAm
shlokas.39:
tasyAM duryodhano mando lobhaM chakre sudurmatiH |
tato.akShairva~nchayitvA cha saubalena yudhiShThiram
shlokas.40:
vanaM prasthApayAmAsa sapta varShANi pa~ncha cha |
aj~nAtamekaM rAShTre cha tathA varShaM trayodasham
shlokas.41:
tatashchaturdashe varShe yAchamAnAH svakaM vasu |
nAlabhanta mahArAja tato yuddhamavartata
shlokas.42:
tataste sarvamutsAdya hatvA duryodhanaM nRRipam |
rAjyaM vidrutabhUyiShThaM pratyapadyanta pANDavAH
shlokas.43:
evametatpurAvRRittaM teShAmakliShTakarmaNAm |
bhedo rAjyavinAshashcha jayashcha jayatAM vara

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathitaM vai samAsena tvayA sarvaM dvijottama |
mahAbhAratamAkhyAnaM kurUNAM charitaM mahat
shlokas.2:
kathAM tvanagha chitrArthAmimAM kathayati tvayi |
vistarashravaNe jAtaM kautUhalamatIva me
shlokas.3:
sa bhavAnvistareNemAM punarAkhyAtumarhati |
na hi tRRipyAmi pUrveShAM shRRiNvAnashcharitaM mahat
shlokas.4:
na tatkAraNamalpaM hi dharmaj~nA yatra pANDavAH |
avadhyAnsarvasho jaghnuH prashasyante cha mAnavaiH
shlokas.5:
kimarthaM te naravyAghrAH shaktAH santo hyanAgasaH |
prayujyamAnAnsa~NkleshAnkShAntavanto durAtmanAm
shlokas.6:
kathaM nAgAyutaprANo bAhushAlI vRRikodaraH |
pariklishyannapi krodhaM dhRRitavAnvai dvijottama
shlokas.7:
kathaM sA draupadI kRRiShNA klishyamAnA durAtmabhiH |
shaktA satI dhArtarAShTrAnnAdahadghorachakShuShA
shlokas.8:
kathaM vyatikramandyUte pArthau mAdrIsutau tathA |
anuvrajannaravyAghraM va~nchyamAnaM durAtmabhiH
shlokas.9:
kathaM dharmabhRRitAM shreShThaH suto dharmasya dharmavit |
anarhaH paramaM kleshaM soDhavAnsa yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.10:
kathaM cha bahulAH senAH pANDavaH kRRiShNasArathiH |
asyanneko.anayatsarvAH pitRRilokaM dhana~njayaH
shlokas.11:
etadAchakShva me sarvaM yathAvRRittaM tapodhana |
yadyachcha kRRitavantaste tatra tatra mahArathAH
shlokas.12:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
maharSheH sarvalokeShu pUjitasya mahAtmanaH |
pravakShyAmi mataM kRRitsnaM vyAsasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.13:
idaM shatasahasraM hi shlokAnAM puNyakarmaNAm |
satyavatyAtmajeneha vyAkhyAtamamitaujasA
shlokas.14:
ya idaM shrAvayedvidvAnyashchedaM shRRiNuyAnnaraH |
te brahmaNaH sthAnametya prApnuyurdevatulyatAm
shlokas.15:
idaM hi vedaiH samitaM pavitramapi chottamam |
shrAvyANAmuttamaM chedaM purANamRRiShisa.nstutam
shlokas.16:
asminnarthashcha dharmashcha nikhilenopadishyate |
itihAse mahApuNye buddhishcha parinaiShThikI
shlokas.17:
akShudrAndAnashIlA.nshcha satyashIlAnanAstikAn |
kArShNaM vedamimaM vidvA~nshrAvayitvArthamashnute
shlokas.18:
bhrUNahatyAkRRitaM chApi pApaM jahyAdasa.nshayam |
itihAsamimaM shrutvA puruSho.api sudAruNaH
shlokas.19:
jayo nAmetihAso.ayaM shrotavyo vijigIShuNA |
mahIM vijayate sarvAM shatrU.nshchApi parAjayet
shlokas.20:
idaM pu.nsavanaM shreShThamidaM svastyayanaM mahat |
mahiShIyuvarAjAbhyAM shrotavyaM bahushastathA
shlokas.21:
arthashAstramidaM puNyaM dharmashAstramidaM param |
mokShashAstramidaM proktaM vyAsenAmitabuddhinA
shlokas.22:
sampratyAchakShate chaiva AkhyAsyanti tathApare |
putrAH shushrUShavaH santi preShyAshcha priyakAriNaH
shlokas.23:
sharIreNa kRRitaM pApaM vAchA cha manasaiva cha |
sarvaM tattyajati kShipramidaM shRRiNvannaraH sadA
shlokas.24:
bhAratAnAM mahajjanma shRRiNvatAmanasUyatAm |
nAsti vyAdhibhayaM teShAM paralokabhayaM kutaH
shlokas.25:
dhanyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM svargyaM puNyaM tathaiva cha |
kRRiShNadvaipAyanenedaM kRRitaM puNyachikIrShuNA
shlokas.26:
kIrtiM prathayatA loke pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
anyeShAM kShatriyANAM cha bhUridraviNatejasAm
shlokas.27:
yathA samudro bhagavAnyathA cha himavAngiriH |
khyAtAvubhau ratnanidhI tathA bhAratamuchyate
shlokas.28:
ya idaM shrAvayedvidvAnbrAhmaNAniha parvasu |
dhUtapApmA jitasvargo brahmabhUyaM sa gachChati
shlokas.29:
yashchedaM shrAvayechChrAddhe brAhmaNAnpAdamantataH |
akShayyaM tasya tachChrAddhamupatiShThetpitRRinapi
shlokas.30:
ahnA yadenashchAj~nAnAtprakaroti narashcharan |
tanmahAbhAratAkhyAnaM shrutvaiva pravilIyate
shlokas.31:
bhAratAnAM mahajjanma mahAbhAratamuchyate |
niruktamasya yo veda sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.32:
tribhirvarShaiH sadotthAyI kRRiShNadvaipAyano muniH |
mahAbhAratamAkhyAnaM kRRitavAnidamuttamam
shlokas.33:
dharme chArthe cha kAme cha mokShe cha bharatarShabha |
yadihAsti tadanyatra yannehAsti na tatkvachit

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
rAjoparicharo nAma dharmanityo mahIpatiH |
babhUva mRRigayAM gantuM sa kadAchiddhRRitavrataH
shlokas.2:
sa chediviShayaM ramyaM vasuH pauravanandanaH |
indropadeshAjjagrAha grahaNIyaM mahIpatiH
shlokas.3:
tamAshrame nyastashastraM nivasantaM taporatim |
devaH sAkShAtsvayaM vajrI samupAyAnmahIpatim
shlokas.4:
indratvamarho rAjAyaM tapasetyanuchintya vai |
taM sAntvena nRRipaM sAkShAttapasaH saMnyavartayat
shlokas.5:
indra uvAcha||
na sa~NkIryeta dharmo.ayaM pRRithivyAM pRRithivIpate |
taM pAhi dharmo hi dhRRitaH kRRitsnaM dhArayate jagat
shlokas.6:
lokyaM dharmaM pAlaya tvaM nityayuktaH samAhitaH |
dharmayuktastato lokAnpuNyAnApsyasi shAshvatAn
shlokas.7:
diviShThasya bhuviShThastvaM sakhA bhUtvA mama priyaH |
UdhaH pRRithivyA yo deshastamAvasa narAdhipa
shlokas.8:
pashavyashchaiva puNyashcha susthiro dhanadhAnyavAn |
svArakShyashchaiva saumyashcha bhogyairbhUmiguNairyutaH
shlokas.9:
atyanyAneSha desho hi dhanaratnAdibhiryutaH |
vasupUrNA cha vasudhA vasa chediShu chedipa
shlokas.10:
dharmashIlA janapadAH susantoShAshcha sAdhavaH |
na cha mithyApralApo.atra svaireShvapi kuto.anyathA
shlokas.11:
na cha pitrA vibhajyante narA guruhite ratAH |
yu~njate dhuri no gAshcha kRRishAH sandhukShayanti cha
shlokas.12:
sarve varNAH svadharmasthAH sadA chediShu mAnada |
na te.astyaviditaM ki~nchittriShu lokeShu yadbhavet
shlokas.13:
devopabhogyaM divyaM cha AkAshe sphATikaM mahat |
AkAshagaM tvAM maddattaM vimAnamupapatsyate
shlokas.14:
tvamekaH sarvamartyeShu vimAnavaramAsthitaH |
chariShyasyuparistho vai devo vigrahavAniva
shlokas.15:
dadAmi te vaijayantIM mAlAmamlAnapa~NkajAm |
dhArayiShyati sa~NgrAme yA tvAM shastrairavikShatam
shlokas.16:
lakShaNaM chaitadeveha bhavitA te narAdhipa |
indramAleti vikhyAtaM dhanyamapratimaM mahat
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yaShTiM cha vaiNavIM tasmai dadau vRRitraniShUdanaH |
iShTapradAnamuddishya shiShTAnAM paripAlinIm
shlokas.18:
tasyAH shakrasya pUjArthaM bhUmau bhUmipatistadA |
praveshaM kArayAmAsa gate sa.nvatsare tadA
shlokas.19:
tataH prabhRRiti chAdyApi yaShTyAH kShitipasattamaiH |
praveshaH kriyate rAjanyathA tena pravartitaH
shlokas.20:
aparedyustathA chAsyAH kriyate uchChrayo nRRipaiH |
ala~NkRRitAyAH piTakairgandhairmAlyaishcha bhUShaNaiH
mAlyadAmaparikShiptA vidhivatkriyate.api cha
shlokas.21:
bhagavAnpUjyate chAtra hAsyarUpeNa sha~NkaraH |
svayameva gRRihItena vasoH prItyA mahAtmanaH
shlokas.22:
etAM pUjAM mahendrastu dRRiShTvA deva kRRitAM shubhAm |
vasunA rAjamukhyena prItimAnabravIdvibhuH
shlokas.23:
ye pUjayiShyanti narA rAjAnashcha mahaM mama |
kArayiShyanti cha mudA yathA chedipatirnRRipaH
shlokas.24:
teShAM shrIrvijayashchaiva sarAShTrANAM bhaviShyati |
tathA sphIto janapado muditashcha bhaviShyati
shlokas.25:
evaM mahAtmanA tena mahendreNa narAdhipa |
vasuH prItyA maghavatA mahArAjo.abhisatkRRitaH
shlokas.26:
utsavaM kArayiShyanti sadA shakrasya ye narAH |
bhUmidAnAdibhirdAnairyathA pUtA bhavanti vai
varadAnamahAyaj~naistathA shakrotsavena te
shlokas.27:
sampUjito maghavatA vasushchedipatistadA |
pAlayAmAsa dharmeNa chedisthaH pRRithivImimAm
indraprItyA bhUmipatishchakArendramahaM vasuH
shlokas.28:
putrAshchAsya mahAvIryAH pa~nchAsannamitaujasaH |
nAnArAjyeShu cha sutAnsa samrADabhyaShechayat
shlokas.29:
mahAratho magadharADvishruto yo bRRihadrathaH |
pratyagrahaH kushAmbashcha yamAhurmaNivAhanam
machChillashcha yadushchaiva rAjanyashchAparAjitaH
shlokas.30:
ete tasya sutA rAjanrAjarSherbhUritejasaH |
nyaveshayannAmabhiH svaiste deshA.nshcha purANi cha
vAsavAH pa~ncha rAjAnaH pRRithagva.nshAshcha shAshvatAH
shlokas.31:
vasantamindraprAsAde AkAshe sphATike cha tam |
upatasthurmahAtmAnaM gandharvApsaraso nRRipam
rAjoparicharetyevaM nAma tasyAtha vishrutam
shlokas.32:
puropavAhinIM tasya nadIM shuktimatIM giriH |
arautsIchchetanAyuktaH kAmAtkolAhalaH kila
shlokas.33:
giriM kolAhalaM taM tu padA vasuratADayat |
nishchakrAma nadI tena prahAravivareNa sA
shlokas.34:
tasyAM nadyAmajanayanmithunaM parvataH svayam |
tasmAdvimokShaNAtprItA nadI rAj~ne nyavedayat
shlokas.35:
yaH pumAnabhavattatra taM sa rAjarShisattamaH |
vasurvasupradashchakre senApatimari.ndamam
chakAra patnIM kanyAM tu dayitAM girikAM nRRipaH
shlokas.36:
vasoH patnI tu girikA kAmAtkAle nyavedayat |
RRitukAlamanuprAptaM snAtA pu.nsavane shuchiH
shlokas.37:
tadahaH pitarashchainamUchurjahi mRRigAniti |
taM rAjasattamaM prItAstadA matimatAM varam
shlokas.38:
sa pitRRiNAM niyogaM tamavyatikramya pArthivaH |
chachAra mRRigayAM kAmI girikAmeva sa.nsmaran
atIva rUpasampannAM sAkShAchChriyamivAparAm
shlokas.39:
tasya retaH prachaskanda charato ruchire vane |
skannamAtraM cha tadreto vRRikShapatreNa bhUmipaH
shlokas.40:
pratijagrAha mithyA me na skandedreta ityuta |
RRitushcha tasyAH patnyA me na moghaH syAditi prabhuH
shlokas.41:
sa~nchintyaivaM tadA rAjA vichArya cha punaH punaH |
amoghatvaM cha vij~nAya retaso rAjasattamaH
shlokas.42:
shukraprasthApane kAlaM mahiShyAH prasamIkShya saH |
abhimantryAtha tachChukramArAttiShThantamAshugam
sUkShmadharmArthatattvaj~no j~nAtvA shyenaM tato.abravIt
shlokas.43:
matpriyArthamidaM saumya shukraM mama gRRihaM naya |
girikAyAH prayachChAshu tasyA hyArtavamadya vai
shlokas.44:
gRRihItvA tattadA shyenastUrNamutpatya vegavAn |
javaM paramamAsthAya pradudrAva viha~NgamaH
shlokas.45:
tamapashyadathAyAntaM shyenaM shyenastathAparaH |
abhyadravachcha taM sadyo dRRiShTvaivAmiShasha~NkayA
shlokas.46:
tuNDayuddhamathAkAshe tAvubhau samprachakratuH |
yudhyatorapatadretastachchApi yamunAmbhasi
shlokas.47:
tatrAdriketi vikhyAtA brahmashApAdvarApsarAH |
mInabhAvamanuprAptA babhUva yamunAcharI
shlokas.48:
shyenapAdaparibhraShTaM tadvIryamatha vAsavam |
jagrAha tarasopetya sAdrikA matsyarUpiNI
shlokas.49:
kadAchidatha matsIM tAM babandhurmatsyajIvinaH |
mAse cha dashame prApte tadA bharatasattama
ujjahrurudarAttasyAH strIpumA.nsaM cha mAnuSham
shlokas.50:
AshcharyabhUtaM matvA tadrAj~naste pratyavedayan |
kAye matsyA imau rAjansambhUtau mAnuShAviti
shlokas.51:
tayoH pumA.nsaM jagrAha rAjoparicharastadA |
sa matsyo nAma rAjAsIddhArmikaH satyasa~NgaraH
shlokas.52:
sApsarA muktashApA cha kShaNena samapadyata |
puroktA yA bhagavatA tiryagyonigatA shubhe
mAnuShau janayitvA tvaM shApamokShamavApsyasi
shlokas.53:
tataH sA janayitvA tau vishastA matsyaghAtinA |
santyajya matsyarUpaM sA divyaM rUpamavApya cha
siddharShichAraNapathaM jagAmAtha varApsarAH
shlokas.54:
yA kanyA duhitA tasyA matsyA matsyasagandhinI |
rAj~nA dattAtha dAshAya iyaM tava bhavatviti
rUpasattvasamAyuktA sarvaiH samuditA guNaiH
shlokas.55:
sA tu satyavatI nAma matsyaghAtyabhisa.nshrayAt |
AsInmatsyasagandhaiva ka~nchitkAlaM shuchismitA
shlokas.56:
shushrUShArthaM piturnAvaM tAM tu vAhayatIM jale |
tIrthayAtrAM parikrAmannapashyadvai parAsharaH
shlokas.57:
atIva rUpasampannAM siddhAnAmapi kA~NkShitAm |
dRRiShTvaiva cha sa tAM dhImA.nshchakame chArudarshanAm
vidvA.nstAM vAsavIM kanyAM kAryavAnmunipu~NgavaH
shlokas.58:
sAbravItpashya bhagavanpArAvAre RRiShInsthitAn |
AvayordRRishyatorebhiH kathaM nu syAtsamAgamaH
shlokas.59:
evaM tayokto bhagavAnnIhAramasRRijatprabhuH |
yena deshaH sa sarvastu tamobhUta ivAbhavat
shlokas.60:
dRRiShTvA sRRiShTaM tu nIhAraM tatastaM paramarShiNA |
vismitA chAbravItkanyA vrIDitA cha manasvinI
shlokas.61:
viddhi mAM bhagavankanyAM sadA pitRRivashAnugAm |
tvatsa.nyogAchcha duShyeta kanyAbhAvo mamAnagha
shlokas.62:
kanyAtve dUShite chApi kathaM shakShye dvijottama |
gantuM gRRihaM gRRihe chAhaM dhImanna sthAtumutsahe
etatsa~nchintya bhagavanvidhatsva yadanantaram
shlokas.63:
evamuktavatIM tAM tu prItimAnRRiShisattamaH |
uvAcha matpriyaM kRRitvA kanyaiva tvaM bhaviShyasi
shlokas.64:
vRRiNIShva cha varaM bhIru yaM tvamichChasi bhAmini |
vRRithA hi na prasAdo me bhUtapUrvaH shuchismite
shlokas.65:
evamuktA varaM vavre gAtrasaugandhyamuttamam |
sa chAsyai bhagavAnprAdAnmanasaH kA~NkShitaM prabhuH
shlokas.66:
tato labdhavarA prItA strIbhAvaguNabhUShitA |
jagAma saha sa.nsargamRRiShiNAdbhutakarmaNA
shlokas.67:
tena gandhavatItyeva nAmAsyAH prathitaM bhuvi |
tasyAstu yojanAdgandhamAjighranti narA bhuvi
shlokas.68:
tato yojanagandheti tasyA nAma parishrutam |
parAsharo.api bhagavA~njagAma svaM niveshanam
shlokas.69:
iti satyavatI hRRiShTA labdhvA varamanuttamam |
parAshareNa sa.nyuktA sadyo garbhaM suShAva sA
jaj~ne cha yamunAdvIpe pArAsharyaH sa vIryavAn
shlokas.70:
sa mAtaramupasthAya tapasyeva mano dadhe |
smRRito.ahaM darshayiShyAmi kRRityeShviti cha so.abravIt
shlokas.71:
evaM dvaipAyano jaj~ne satyavatyAM parAsharAt |
dvIpe nyastaH sa yadbAlastasmAddvaipAyano.abhavat
shlokas.72:
pAdApasAriNaM dharmaM vidvAnsa tu yuge yuge |
AyuH shaktiM cha martyAnAM yugAnugamavekShya cha
shlokas.73:
brahmaNo brAhmaNAnAM cha tathAnugrahakAmyayA |
vivyAsa vedAnyasmAchcha tasmAdvyAsa iti smRRitaH
shlokas.74:
vedAnadhyApayAmAsa mahAbhAratapa~nchamAn |
sumantuM jaiminiM pailaM shukaM chaiva svamAtmajam
shlokas.75:
prabhurvariShTho varado vaishampAyanameva cha |
saMhitAstaiH pRRithaktvena bhAratasya prakAshitAH
shlokas.76:
tathA bhIShmaH shAntanavo ga~NgAyAmamitadyutiH |
vasuvIryAtsamabhavanmahAvIryo mahAyashAH
shlokas.77:
shUle protaH purANarShirachorashchorasha~NkayA |
aNImANDavya iti vai vikhyAtaH sumahAyashAH
shlokas.78:
sa dharmamAhUya purA maharShiridamuktavAn |
iShIkayA mayA bAlyAdekA viddhA shakuntikA
shlokas.79:
tatkilbiShaM smare dharma nAnyatpApamahaM smare |
tanme sahasrasamitaM kasmAnnehAjayattapaH
shlokas.81:
tena shApena dharmo.api shUdrayonAvajAyata |
vidvAnvidurarUpeNa dhArmI tanurakilbiShI
shlokas.82:
sa~njayo munikalpastu jaj~ne sUto gavalgaNAt |
sUryAchcha kuntikanyAyAM jaj~ne karNo mahArathaH
sahajaM kavachaM bibhratkuNDaloddyotitAnanaH
shlokas.83:
anugrahArthaM lokAnAM viShNurlokanamaskRRitaH |
vasudevAttu devakyAM prAdurbhUto mahAyashAH
shlokas.84:
anAdinidhano devaH sa kartA jagataH prabhuH |
avyaktamakSharaM brahma pradhAnaM nirguNAtmakam
shlokas.85:
AtmAnamavyayaM chaiva prakRRitiM prabhavaM param |
puruShaM vishvakarmANaM sattvayogaM dhruvAkSharam
shlokas.86:
anantamachalaM devaM ha.nsaM nArAyaNaM prabhum |
dhAtAramajaraM nityaM tamAhuH paramavyayam
shlokas.87:
puruShaH sa vibhuH kartA sarvabhUtapitAmahaH |
dharmasa.nvardhanArthAya prajaj~ne.andhakavRRiShNiShu
shlokas.88:
astraj~nau tu mahAvIryau sarvashastravishAradau |
sAtyakiH kRRitavarmA cha nArAyaNamanuvratau
satyakAddhRRidikAchchaiva jaj~nAte.astravishAradau
shlokas.89:
bharadvAjasya cha skannaM droNyAM shukramavardhata |
maharSherugratapasastasmAddroNo vyajAyata
shlokas.90:
gautamAnmithunaM jaj~ne sharastambAchCharadvataH |
ashvatthAmnashcha jananI kRRipashchaiva mahAbalaH
ashvatthAmA tato jaj~ne droNAdastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.91:
tathaiva dhRRiShTadyumno.api sAkShAdagnisamadyutiH |
vaitAne karmaNi tate pAvakAtsamajAyata
vIro droNavinAshAya dhanuShA saha vIryavAn
shlokas.92:
tathaiva vedyAM kRRiShNApi jaj~ne tejasvinI shubhA |
vibhrAjamAnA vapuShA bibhratI rUpamuttamam
shlokas.93:
prahrAdashiShyo nagnajitsubalashchAbhavattataH |
tasya prajA dharmahantrI jaj~ne devaprakopanAt
shlokas.94:
gAndhArarAjaputro.abhUchChakuniH saubalastathA |
duryodhanasya mAtA cha jaj~nAte.arthavidAvubhau
shlokas.95:
kRRiShNadvaipAyanAjjaj~ne dhRRitarAShTro janeshvaraH |
kShetre vichitravIryasya pANDushchaiva mahAbalaH
shlokas.96:
pANDostu jaj~nire pa~ncha putrA devasamAH pRRithak |
dvayoH striyorguNajyeShThasteShAmAsIdyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.97:
dharmAdyudhiShThiro jaj~ne mArutAttu vRRikodaraH |
indrAddhana~njayaH shrImAnsarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.98:
jaj~nAte rUpasampannAvashvibhyAM tu yamAvubhau |
nakulaH sahadevashcha gurushushrUShaNe ratau
shlokas.99:
tathA putrashataM jaj~ne dhRRitarAShTrasya dhImataH |
duryodhanaprabhRRitayo yuyutsuH karaNastathA
shlokas.100:
abhimanyuH subhadrAyAmarjunAdabhyajAyata |
svasrIyo vAsudevasya pautraH pANDormahAtmanaH
shlokas.101:
pANDavebhyo.api pa~nchabhyaH kRRiShNAyAM pa~ncha jaj~nire |
kumArA rUpasampannAH sarvashastravishAradAH
shlokas.102:
prativindhyo yudhiShThirAtsutasomo vRRikodarAt |
arjunAchChrutakIrtistu shatAnIkastu nAkuliH
shlokas.103:
tathaiva sahadevAchcha shrutasenaH pratApavAn |
hiDimbAyAM cha bhImena vane jaj~ne ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.104:
shikhaNDI drupadAjjaj~ne kanyA putratvamAgatA |
yAM yakShaH puruShaM chakre sthUNaH priyachikIrShayA
shlokas.105:
kurUNAM vigrahe tasminsamAgachChanbahUnyatha |
rAj~nAM shatasahasrANi yotsyamAnAni sa.nyuge
shlokas.106:
teShAmaparimeyAni nAmadheyAni sarvashaH |
na shakyaM parisa~NkhyAtuM varShANAmayutairapi
ete tu kIrtitA mukhyA yairAkhyAnamidaM tatam

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
ya ete kIrtitA brahmanye chAnye nAnukIrtitAH |
samyaktA~nshrotumichChAmi rAj~nashchAnyAnsuvarchasaH
shlokas.2:
yadarthamiha sambhUtA devakalpA mahArathAH |
bhuvi tanme mahAbhAga samyagAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
rahasyaM khalvidaM rAjandevAnAmiti naH shrutam |
tattu te kathayiShyAmi namaskRRitvA svayambhuve
shlokas.4:
triHsaptakRRitvaH pRRithivIM kRRitvA niHkShatriyAM purA |
jAmadagnyastapastepe mahendre parvatottame
shlokas.5:
tadA niHkShatriye loke bhArgaveNa kRRite sati |
brAhmaNAnkShatriyA rAjangarbhArthinyo.abhichakramuH
shlokas.6:
tAbhiH saha samApeturbrAhmaNAH sa.nshitavratAH |
RRitAvRRitau naravyAghra na kAmAnnAnRRitau tathA
shlokas.7:
tebhyastu lebhire garbhAnkShatriyAstAH sahasrashaH |
tataH suShuvire rAjankShatriyAnvIryasaMmatAn
kumArA.nshcha kumArIshcha punaH kShatrAbhivRRiddhaye
shlokas.8:
evaM tadbrAhmaNaiH kShatraM kShatriyAsu tapasvibhiH |
jAtamRRidhyata dharmeNa sudIrgheNAyuShAnvitam
chatvAro.api tadA varNA babhUvurbrAhmaNottarAH
shlokas.9:
abhyagachChannRRitau nArIM na kAmAnnAnRRitau tathA |
tathaivAnyAni bhUtAni tiryagyonigatAnyapi
RRitau dArA.nshcha gachChanti tadA sma bharatarShabha
shlokas.10:
tato.avardhanta dharmeNa sahasrashatajIvinaH |
tAH prajAH pRRithivIpAla dharmavrataparAyaNAH
AdhibhirvyAdhibhishchaiva vimuktAH sarvasho narAH
shlokas.11:
athemAM sAgarApA~NgAM gAM gajendragatAkhilAm |
adhyatiShThatpunaH kShatraM sashailavanakAnanAm
shlokas.12:
prashAsati punaH kShatre dharmeNemAM vasundharAm |
brAhmaNAdyAstadA varNA lebhire mudamuttamAm
shlokas.13:
kAmakrodhodbhavAndoShAnnirasya cha narAdhipAH |
daNDaM daNDyeShu dharmeNa praNayanto.anvapAlayan
shlokas.14:
tathA dharmapare kShatre sahasrAkShaH shatakratuH |
svAdu deshe cha kAle cha vavarShApyAyayanprajAH
shlokas.15:
na bAla eva mriyate tadA kashchinnarAdhipa |
na cha striyaM prajAnAti kashchidaprAptayauvanaH
shlokas.16:
evamAyuShmatIbhistu prajAbhirbharatarShabha |
iyaM sAgaraparyantA samApUryata medinI
shlokas.17:
Ijire cha mahAyaj~naiH kShatriyA bahudakShiNaiH |
sA~NgopaniShadAnvedAnviprAshchAdhIyate tadA
shlokas.18:
na cha vikrINate brahma brAhmaNAH sma tadA nRRipa |
na cha shUdrasamAbhyAshe vedAnuchchArayantyuta
shlokas.19:
kArayantaH kRRiShiM gobhistathA vaishyAH kShitAviha |
na gAmayu~njanta dhuri kRRishA~NgAshchApyajIvayan
shlokas.20:
phenapA.nshcha tathA vatsAnna duhanti sma mAnavAH |
na kUTamAnairvaNijaH paNyaM vikrINate tadA
shlokas.21:
karmANi cha naravyAghra dharmopetAni mAnavAH |
dharmamevAnupashyantashchakrurdharmaparAyaNAH
shlokas.22:
svakarmaniratAshchAsansarve varNA narAdhipa |
evaM tadA naravyAghra dharmo na hrasate kvachit
shlokas.23:
kAle gAvaH prasUyante nAryashcha bharatarShabha |
phalantyRRituShu vRRikShAshcha puShpANi cha phalAni cha
shlokas.24:
evaM kRRitayuge samyagvartamAne tadA nRRipa |
ApUryata mahI kRRitsnA prANibhirbahubhirbhRRisham
shlokas.25:
tataH samudite loke mAnuShe bharatarShabha |
asurA jaj~nire kShetre rAj~nAM manujapu~Ngava
shlokas.26:
Adityairhi tadA daityA bahusho nirjitA yudhi |
aishvaryAdbhra.nshitAshchApi sambabhUvuH kShitAviha
shlokas.27:
iha devatvamichChanto mAnuSheShu manasvinaH |
jaj~nire bhuvi bhUteShu teShu teShvasurA vibho
shlokas.28:
goShvashveShu cha rAjendra kharoShTramahiSheShu cha |
kravyAdeShu cha bhUteShu gajeShu cha mRRigeShu cha
shlokas.29:
jAtairiha mahIpAla jAyamAnaishcha tairmahI |
na shashAkAtmanAtmAnamiyaM dhArayituM dharA
shlokas.30:
atha jAtA mahIpAlAH kechidbalasamanvitAH |
diteH putrA danoshchaiva tasmAllokAdiha chyutAH
shlokas.31:
vIryavanto.avaliptAste nAnArUpadharA mahIm |
imAM sAgaraparyantAM parIyurarimardanAH
shlokas.32:
brAhmaNAnkShatriyAnvaishyA~nshUdrA.nshchaivApyapIDayan |
anyAni chaiva bhUtAni pIDayAmAsurojasA
shlokas.33:
trAsayanto vinighnantastA.nstAnbhUtagaNA.nshcha te |
vicheruH sarvato rAjanmahIM shatasahasrashaH
shlokas.34:
AshramasthAnmaharShI.nshcha dharShayantastatastataH |
abrahmaNyA vIryamadA mattA madabalena cha
shlokas.35:
evaM vIryabalotsiktairbhUriyaM tairmahAsuraiH |
pIDyamAnA mahIpAla brahmANamupachakrame
shlokas.36:
na hImAM pavano rAjanna nAgA na nagA mahIm |
tadA dhArayituM shekurAkrAntAM dAnavairbalAt
shlokas.37:
tato mahI mahIpAla bhArArtA bhayapIDitA |
jagAma sharaNaM devaM sarvabhUtapitAmaham
shlokas.38:
sA sa.nvRRitaM mahAbhAgairdevadvijamaharShibhiH |
dadarsha devaM brahmANaM lokakartAramavyayam
shlokas.39:
gandharvairapsarobhishcha bandikarmasu niShThitaiH |
vandyamAnaM mudopetairvavande chainametya sA
shlokas.40:
atha vij~nApayAmAsa bhUmistaM sharaNArthinI |
saMnidhau lokapAlAnAM sarveShAmeva bhArata
shlokas.41:
tatpradhAnAtmanastasya bhUmeH kRRityaM svayambhuvaH |
pUrvamevAbhavadrAjanviditaM parameShThinaH
shlokas.42:
sraShTA hi jagataH kasmAnna sambudhyeta bhArata |
surAsurANAM lokAnAmasheSheNa manogatam
shlokas.43:
tamuvAcha mahArAja bhUmiM bhUmipatirvibhuH |
prabhavaH sarvabhUtAnAmIshaH shambhuH prajApatiH
shlokas.44:
yadarthamasi samprAptA matsakAshaM vasundhare |
tadarthaM saMniyokShyAmi sarvAneva divaukasaH
shlokas.45:
ityuktvA sa mahIM devo brahmA rAjanvisRRijya cha |
Adidesha tadA sarvAnvibudhAnbhUtakRRitsvayam
shlokas.46:
asyA bhUmernirasituM bhAraM bhAgaiH pRRithakpRRithak |
asyAmeva prasUyadhvaM virodhAyeti chAbravIt
shlokas.47:
tathaiva cha samAnIya gandharvApsarasAM gaNAn |
uvAcha bhagavAnsarvAnidaM vachanamuttamam
svaira.nshaiH samprasUyadhvaM yatheShTaM mAnuSheShviti
shlokas.48:
atha shakrAdayaH sarve shrutvA suragurorvachaH |
tathyamarthyaM cha pathyaM cha tasya te jagRRihustadA
shlokas.49:
atha te sarvashoM.ashaiH svairgantuM bhUmiM kRRitakShaNAH |
nArAyaNamamitraghnaM vaikuNThamupachakramuH
shlokas.50:
yaH sa chakragadApANiH pItavAsAsitaprabhaH |
padmanAbhaH surArighnaH pRRithuchArva~nchitekShaNaH
shlokas.51:
taM bhuvaH shodhanAyendra uvAcha puruShottamam |
a.nshenAvatarasveti tathetyAha cha taM hariH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
atha nArAyaNenendrashchakAra saha sa.nvidam |
avatartuM mahIM svargAda.nshataH sahitaH suraiH
shlokas.2:
Adishya cha svayaM shakraH sarvAneva divaukasaH |
nirjagAma punastasmAtkShayAnnArAyaNasya ha
shlokas.3:
te.amarArivinAshAya sarvalokahitAya cha |
avateruH krameNemAM mahIM svargAddivaukasaH
shlokas.4:
tato brahmarShiva.nsheShu pArthivarShikuleShu cha |
jaj~nire rAjashArdUla yathAkAmaM divaukasaH
shlokas.5:
dAnavAnrAkShasA.nshchaiva gandharvAnpannagA.nstathA |
