puruShAdAni chAnyAni jaghnuH sattvAnyanekashaH
shlokas.6:
dAnavA rAkShasAshchaiva gandharvAH pannagAstathA |
na tAnbalasthAnbAlye.api jaghnurbharatasattama
shlokas.7:
janamejaya uvAcha||
devadAnavasa~NghAnAM gandharvApsarasAM tathA |
mAnavAnAM cha sarveShAM tathA vai yakSharakShasAm
shlokas.8:
shrotumichChAmi tattvena sambhavaM kRRitsnamAditaH |
prANinAM chaiva sarveShAM sarvashaH sarvaviddhyasi
shlokas.9:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi namaskRRitvA svayambhuve |
surAdInAmahaM samyaglokAnAM prabhavApyayam
shlokas.10:
brahmaNo mAnasAH putrA viditAH ShaNmaharShayaH |
marIchiratrya~Ngirasau pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH
shlokas.11:
marIcheH kashyapaH putraH kashyapAttu imAH prajAH |
prajaj~nire mahAbhAgA dakShakanyAstrayodasha
shlokas.12:
aditirditirdanuH kAlA anAyuH siMhikA muniH |
krodhA prAvA ariShTA cha vinatA kapilA tathA
shlokas.13:
kadrUshcha manujavyAghra dakShakanyaiva bhArata |
etAsAM vIryasampannaM putrapautramanantakam
shlokas.14:
adityAM dvAdashAdityAH sambhUtA bhuvaneshvarAH |
ye rAjannAmatastA.nste kIrtayiShyAmi bhArata
shlokas.15:
dhAtA mitro.aryamA shakro varuNashchA.nsha eva cha |
bhago vivasvAnpUShA cha savitA dashamastathA
shlokas.16:
ekAdashastathA tvaShTA viShNurdvAdasha uchyate |
jaghanyajaH sa sarveShAmAdityAnAM guNAdhikaH
shlokas.17:
eka eva diteH putro hiraNyakashipuH smRRitaH |
nAmnA khyAtAstu tasyeme putrAH pa~ncha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.18:
prahrAdaH pUrvajasteShAM saMhrAdastadanantaram |
anuhrAdastRRitIyo.abhUttasmAchcha shibibAShkalau
shlokas.19:
prahrAdasya trayaH putrAH khyAtAH sarvatra bhArata |
virochanashcha kumbhashcha nikumbhashcheti vishrutAH
shlokas.20:
virochanasya putro.abhUdbalirekaH pratApavAn |
baleshcha prathitaH putro bANo nAma mahAsuraH
shlokas.21:
chatvAri.nshaddanoH putrAH khyAtAH sarvatra bhArata |
teShAM prathamajo rAjA viprachittirmahAyashAH
shlokas.22:
shambaro namuchishchaiva pulomA cheti vishrutaH |
asilomA cha keshI cha durjayashchaiva dAnavaH
shlokas.23:
ayaHshirA ashvashirA ayaHsha~Nkushcha vIryavAn |
tathA gaganamUrdhA cha vegavAnketumA.nshcha yaH
shlokas.24:
svarbhAnurashvo.ashvapatirvRRiShaparvAjakastathA |
ashvagrIvashcha sUkShmashcha tuhuNDashcha mahAsuraH
shlokas.25:
isRRipA ekachakrashcha virUpAkSho harAharau |
nichandrashcha nikumbhashcha kupathaH kApathastathA
shlokas.26:
sharabhaH shalabhashchaiva sUryAchandramasau tathA |
iti khyAtA danorva.nshe dAnavAH parikIrtitAH
anyau tu khalu devAnAM sUryAchandramasau smRRitau
shlokas.27:
ime cha va.nshe prathitAH sattvavanto mahAbalAH |
danuputrA mahArAja dasha dAnavapu~NgavAH
shlokas.28:
ekAkSho mRRitapA vIraH pralambanarakAvapi |
vAtApiH shatrutapanaH shaThashchaiva mahAsuraH
shlokas.29:
gaviShThashcha danAyushcha dIrghajihvashcha dAnavaH |
asa~NkhyeyAH smRRitAsteShAM putrAH pautrAshcha bhArata
shlokas.30:
siMhikA suShuve putraM rAhuM chandrArkamardanam |
suchandraM chandrahantAraM tathA chandravimardanam
shlokas.31:
krUrasvabhAvaM krUrAyAH putrapautramanantakam |
gaNaH krodhavasho nAma krUrakarmArimardanaH
shlokas.32:
anAyuShaH punaH putrAshchatvAro.asurapu~NgavAH |
vikSharo balavIrau cha vRRitrashchaiva mahAsuraH
shlokas.33:
kAlAyAH prathitAH putrAH kAlakalpAH prahAriNaH |
bhuvi khyAtA mahAvIryA dAnaveShu parantapAH
shlokas.34:
vinAshanashcha krodhashcha hantA krodhasya chAparaH |
krodhashatrustathaivAnyaH kAleyA iti vishrutAH
shlokas.35:
asurANAmupAdhyAyaH shukrastvRRiShisuto.abhavat |
khyAtAshchoshanasaH putrAshchatvAro.asurayAjakAH
shlokas.36:
tvaShTAvarastathAtrishcha dvAvanyau mantrakarmiNau |
tejasA sUryasa~NkAshA brahmalokaprabhAvanAH
shlokas.37:
ityeSha va.nshaprabhavaH kathitaste tarasvinAm |
asurANAM surANAM cha purANe sa.nshruto mayA
shlokas.38:
eteShAM yadapatyaM tu na shakyaM tadasheShataH |
prasa~NkhyAtuM mahIpAla guNabhUtamanantakam
shlokas.39:
tArkShyashchAriShTanemishcha tathaiva garuDAruNau |
AruNirvAruNishchaiva vainateyA iti smRRitAH
shlokas.40:
sheSho.ananto vAsukishcha takShakashcha bhuja~NgamaH |
kUrmashcha kulikashchaiva kAdraveyA mahAbalAH
shlokas.41:
bhImasenograsenau cha suparNo varuNastathA |
gopatirdhRRitarAShTrashcha sUryavarchAshcha saptamaH
shlokas.42:
patravAnarkaparNashcha prayutashchaiva vishrutaH |
bhImashchitrarathashchaiva vikhyAtaH sarvavidvashI
shlokas.43:
tathA shAlishirA rAjanpradyumnashcha chaturdashaH |
kaliH pa~nchadashashchaiva nAradashchaiva ShoDashaH
ityete devagandharvA mauneyAH parikIrtitAH
shlokas.44:
atastu bhUtAnyanyAni kIrtayiShyAmi bhArata |
anavadyAmanuvashAmanUnAmaruNAM priyAm
anUpAM subhagAM bhAsImiti prAvA vyajAyata
shlokas.45:
siddhaH pUrNashcha barhI cha pUrNAshashcha mahAyashAH |
brahmachArI ratiguNaH suparNashchaiva saptamaH
shlokas.46:
vishvAvasushcha bhAnushcha suchandro dashamastathA |
ityete devagandharvAH prAveyAH parikIrtitAH
shlokas.47:
imaM tvapsarasAM va.nshaM viditaM puNyalakShaNam |
prAvAsUta mahAbhAgA devI devarShitaH purA
shlokas.48:
alambusA mishrakeShI vidyutparNA tulAnaghA |
aruNA rakShitA chaiva rambhA tadvanmanoramA
shlokas.49:
asitA cha subAhushcha suvratA subhujA tathA |
supriyA chAtibAhushcha vikhyAtau cha hahAhuhU
tumburushcheti chatvAraH smRRitA gandharvasattamAH
shlokas.50:
amRRitaM brAhmaNA gAvo gandharvApsarasastathA |
apatyaM kapilAyAstu purANe parikIrtitam
shlokas.51:
iti te sarvabhUtAnAM sambhavaH kathito mayA |
yathAvatparisa~NkhyAto gandharvApsarasAM tathA
shlokas.52:
bhujagAnAM suparNAnAM rudrANAM marutAM tathA |
gavAM cha brAhmaNAnAM cha shrImatAM puNyakarmaNAm
shlokas.53:
AyuShyashchaiva puNyashcha dhanyaH shrutisukhAvahaH |
shrotavyashchaiva satataM shrAvyashchaivAnasUyatA
shlokas.54:
imaM tu va.nshaM niyamena yaH paThe;nmahAtmanAM brAhmaNadevasaMnidhau |
apatyalAbhaM labhate sa puShkalaM; shriyaM yashaH pretya cha shobhanAM gatim

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
brahmaNo mAnasAH putrA viditAH ShaNmaharShayaH |
ekAdasha sutAH sthANoH khyAtAH paramamAnasAH
shlokas.2:
mRRigavyAdhashcha sharvashcha nirRRitishcha mahAyashAH |
ajaikapAdahirbudhnyaH pinAkI cha parantapaH
shlokas.3:
dahano.atheshvarashchaiva kapAlI cha mahAdyutiH |
sthANurbhavashcha bhagavAnrudrA ekAdasha smRRitAH
shlokas.4:
marIchira~NgirA atriH pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH |
ShaDete brahmaNaH putrA vIryavanto maharShayaH
shlokas.5:
trayastva~NgirasaH putrA loke sarvatra vishrutAH |
bRRihaspatirutathyashcha sa.nvartashcha dhRRitavratAH
shlokas.6:
atrestu bahavaH putrAH shrUyante manujAdhipa |
sarve vedavidaH siddhAH shAntAtmAno maharShayaH
shlokas.7:
rAkShasAstu pulastyasya vAnarAH kiMnarAstathA |
pulahasya mRRigAH siMhA vyAghrAH kimpuruShAstathA
shlokas.8:
kratoH kratusamAH putrAH pata~NgasahachAriNaH |
vishrutAstriShu lokeShu satyavrataparAyaNAH
shlokas.9:
dakShastvajAyatA~NguShThAddakShiNAdbhagavAnRRiShiH |
brahmaNaH pRRithivIpAla putraH putravatAM varaH
shlokas.10:
vAmAdajAyatA~NguShThAdbhAryA tasya mahAtmanaH |
tasyAM pa~nchAshataM kanyAH sa evAjanayanmuniH
shlokas.11:
tAH sarvAstvanavadyA~NgyaH kanyAH kamalalochanAH |
putrikAH sthApayAmAsa naShTaputraH prajApatiH
shlokas.12:
dadau sa dasha dharmAya saptavi.nshatimindave |
divyena vidhinA rAjankashyapAya trayodasha
shlokas.13:
nAmato dharmapatnyastAH kIrtyamAnA nibodha me |
kIrtirlakShmIrdhRRitirmedhA puShTiH shraddhA kriyA tathA
shlokas.14:
buddhirlajjA matishchaiva patnyo dharmasya tA dasha |
dvArANyetAni dharmasya vihitAni svayambhuvA
shlokas.15:
saptavi.nshati somasya patnyo loke parishrutAH |
kAlasya nayane yuktAH somapatnyaH shubhavratAH
sarvA nakShatrayoginyo lokayAtrAvidhau sthitAH
shlokas.16:
pitAmaho munirdevastasya putraH prajApatiH |
tasyAShTau vasavaH putrAsteShAM vakShyAmi vistaram
shlokas.17:
dharo dhruvashcha somashcha ahashchaivAnilo.analaH |
pratyUShashcha prabhAsashcha vasavo.aShTAviti smRRitAH
shlokas.18:
dhUmrAyAshcha dharaH putro brahmavidyo dhruvastathA |
chandramAstu manasvinyAH shvasAyAH shvasanastathA
shlokas.19:
ratAyAshchApyahaH putraH shANDilyAshcha hutAshanaH |
pratyUShashcha prabhAsashcha prabhAtAyAH sutau smRRitau
shlokas.20:
dharasya putro draviNo hutahavyavahastathA |
dhruvasya putro bhagavAnkAlo lokaprakAlanaH
shlokas.21:
somasya tu suto varchA varchasvI yena jAyate |
manoharAyAH shishiraH prANo.atha ramaNastathA
shlokas.22:
ahnaH sutaH smRRito jyotiH shramaH shAntastathA muniH |
agneH putraH kumArastu shrImA~nsharavaNAlayaH
shlokas.23:
tasya shAkho vishAkhashcha naigameshashcha pRRiShThajaH |
kRRittikAbhyupapatteshcha kArttikeya iti smRRitaH
shlokas.24:
anilasya shivA bhAryA tasyAH putraH purojavaH |
avij~nAtagatishchaiva dvau putrAvanilasya tu
shlokas.25:
pratyUShasya viduH putramRRiShiM nAmnAtha devalam |
dvau putrau devalasyApi kShamAvantau manIShiNau
shlokas.26:
bRRihaspatestu bhaginI varastrI brahmachAriNI |
yogasiddhA jagatsarvamasaktaM vicharatyuta
prabhAsasya tu bhAryA sA vasUnAmaShTamasya ha
shlokas.27:
vishvakarmA mahAbhAgo jaj~ne shilpaprajApatiH |
kartA shilpasahasrANAM tridashAnAM cha vardhakiH
shlokas.28:
bhUShaNAnAM cha sarveShAM kartA shilpavatAM varaH |
yo divyAni vimAnAni devatAnAM chakAra ha
shlokas.29:
manuShyAshchopajIvanti yasya shilpaM mahAtmanaH |
pUjayanti cha yaM nityaM vishvakarmANamavyayam
shlokas.30:
stanaM tu dakShiNaM bhittvA brahmaNo naravigrahaH |
niHsRRito bhagavAndharmaH sarvalokasukhAvahaH
shlokas.31:
trayastasya varAH putrAH sarvabhUtamanoharAH |
shamaH kAmashcha harShashcha tejasA lokadhAriNaH
shlokas.32:
kAmasya tu ratirbhAryA shamasya prAptira~NganA |
nandI tu bhAryA harShasya yatra lokAH pratiShThitAH
shlokas.33:
marIcheH kashyapaH putraH kashyapasya surAsurAH |
jaj~nire nRRipashArdUla lokAnAM prabhavastu saH
shlokas.34:
tvAShTrI tu saviturbhAryA vaDavArUpadhAriNI |
asUyata mahAbhAgA sAntarikShe.ashvinAvubhau
shlokas.35:
dvAdashaivAditeH putrAH shakramukhyA narAdhipa |
teShAmavarajo viShNuryatra lokAH pratiShThitAH
shlokas.36:
trayastri.nshata ityete devAsteShAmahaM tava |
anvayaM sampravakShyAmi pakShaishcha kulato gaNAn
shlokas.37:
rudrANAmaparaH pakShaH sAdhyAnAM marutAM tathA |
vasUnAM bhArgavaM vidyAdvishvedevA.nstathaiva cha
shlokas.38:
vainateyastu garuDo balavAnaruNastathA |
bRRihaspatishcha bhagavAnAdityeShveva gaNyate
shlokas.39:
ashvibhyAM guhyakAnviddhi sarvauShadhyastathA pashUn |
eSha devagaNo rAjankIrtitaste.anupUrvashaH
yaM kIrtayitvA manujaH sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.40:
brahmaNo hRRidayaM bhittvA niHsRRito bhagavAnbhRRiguH |
bhRRigoH putraH kavirvidvA~nshukraH kavisuto grahaH
shlokas.41:
trailokyaprANayAtrArthe varShAvarShe bhayAbhaye |
svayambhuvA niyuktaH sanbhuvanaM paridhAvati
shlokas.42:
yogAchAryo mahAbuddhirdaityAnAmabhavadguruH |
surANAM chApi medhAvI brahmachArI yatavrataH
shlokas.43:
tasminniyukte vibhunA yogakShemAya bhArgave |
anyamutpAdayAmAsa putraM bhRRiguraninditam
shlokas.44:
chyavanaM dIptatapasaM dharmAtmAnaM manIShiNam |
yaH sa roShAchchyuto garbhAnmAturmokShAya bhArata
shlokas.45:
AruShI tu manoH kanyA tasya patnI manIShiNaH |
aurvastasyAM samabhavadUruM bhittvA mahAyashAH
mahAtapA mahAtejA bAla eva guNairyutaH
shlokas.46:
RRichIkastasya putrastu jamadagnistato.abhavat |
jamadagnestu chatvAra AsanputrA mahAtmanaH
shlokas.47:
rAmasteShAM jaghanyo.abhUdajaghanyairguNairyutaH |
sarvashastrAstrakushalaH kShatriyAntakaro vashI
shlokas.48:
aurvasyAsItputrashataM jamadagnipurogamam |
teShAM putrasahasrANi babhUvurbhRRiguvistaraH
shlokas.49:
dvau putrau brahmaNastvanyau yayostiShThati lakShaNam |
loke dhAtA vidhAtA cha yau sthitau manunA saha
shlokas.50:
tayoreva svasA devI lakShmIH padmagRRihA shubhA |
tasyAstu mAnasAH putrAsturagA vyomachAriNaH
shlokas.51:
varuNasya bhAryA jyeShThA tu shukrAddevI vyajAyata |
tasyAH putraM balaM viddhi surAM cha suranandinIm
shlokas.53:
tasyApi nirRRitirbhAryA nairRRitA yena rAkShasAH |
ghorAstasyAstrayaH putrAH pApakarmaratAH sadA
bhayo mahAbhayashchaiva mRRityurbhUtAntakastathA
shlokas.54:
kAkIM shyenIM cha bhAsIM cha dhRRitarAShTrIM tathA shukIm |
tAmrA tu suShuve devI pa~nchaitA lokavishrutAH
shlokas.55:
ulUkAnsuShuve kAkI shyenI shyenAnvyajAyata |
bhAsI bhAsAnajanayadgRRidhrA.nshchaiva janAdhipa
shlokas.56:
dhRRitarAShTrI tu ha.nsA.nshcha kalaha.nsA.nshcha sarvashaH |
chakravAkA.nshcha bhadraM te prajaj~ne sA tu bhAminI
shlokas.57:
shukI vijaj~ne dharmaj~na shukAneva manasvinI |
kalyANaguNasampannA sarvalakShaNapUjitA
shlokas.58:
nava krodhavashA nArIH prajaj~ne.apyAtmasambhavAH |
mRRigIM cha mRRigamandAM cha hariM bhadramanAmapi
shlokas.59:
mAta~NgImatha shArdUlIM shvetAM surabhimeva cha |
sarvalakShaNasampannAM surasAM cha yashasvinIm
shlokas.60:
apatyaM tu mRRigAH sarve mRRigyA naravarAtmaja |
RRikShAshcha mRRigamandAyAH sRRimarAshchamarA api
shlokas.61:
tatastvairAvataM nAgaM jaj~ne bhadramanA sutam |
airAvataH sutastasyA devanAgo mahAgajaH
shlokas.62:
haryAshcha harayo.apatyaM vAnarAshcha tarasvinaH |
golA~NgUlA.nshcha bhadraM te haryAH putrAnprachakShate
shlokas.63:
prajaj~ne tvatha shArdUlI siMhAnvyAghrA.nshcha bhArata |
dvIpinashcha mahAbhAga sarvAneva na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.64:
mAta~NgyAstvatha mAta~NgA apatyAni narAdhipa |
dishAgajaM tu shvetAkhyaM shvetAjanayadAshugam
shlokas.65:
tathA duhitarau rAjansurabhirvai vyajAyata |
rohiNIM chaiva bhadraM te gandharvIM cha yashasvinIm
rohiNyAM jaj~nire gAvo gandharvyAM vAjinaH sutAH
shlokas.66:
surasAjanayannAgAnrAjankadrUshcha pannagAn |
sapta piNDaphalAnvRRikShAnanalApi vyajAyata
analAyAH shukI putrI kadrvAstu surasA sutA
shlokas.67:
aruNasya bhAryA shyenI tu vIryavantau mahAbalau |
sampAtiM janayAmAsa tathaiva cha jaTAyuSham
dvau putrau vinatAyAstu vikhyAtau garuDAruNau
shlokas.68:
ityeSha sarvabhUtAnAM mahatAM manujAdhipa |
prabhavaH kIrtitaH samya~NmayA matimatAM vara
shlokas.69:
yaM shrutvA puruShaH samyakpUto bhavati pApmanaH |
sarvaj~natAM cha labhate gatimagryAM cha vindati

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
devAnAM dAnavAnAM cha yakShANAmatha rakShasAm |
anyeShAM chaiva bhUtAnAM sarveShAM bhagavannaham
shlokas.2:
shrotumichChAmi tattvena mAnuSheShu mahAtmanAm |
janma karma cha bhUtAnAmeteShAmanupUrvashaH
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
mAnuSheShu manuShyendra sambhUtA ye divaukasaH |
prathamaM dAnavA.nshchaiva tA.nste vakShyAmi sarvashaH
shlokas.4:
viprachittiriti khyAto ya AsIddAnavarShabhaH |
jarAsandha iti khyAtaH sa AsInmanujarShabhaH
shlokas.5:
diteH putrastu yo rAjanhiraNyakashipuH smRRitaH |
sa jaj~ne mAnuShe loke shishupAlo nararShabhaH
shlokas.6:
saMhrAda iti vikhyAtaH prahrAdasyAnujastu yaH |
sa shalya iti vikhyAto jaj~ne bAhlIkapu~NgavaH
shlokas.7:
anuhrAdastu tejasvI yo.abhUtkhyAto jaghanyajaH |
dhRRiShTaketuriti khyAtaH sa AsInmanujeshvaraH
shlokas.8:
yastu rAja~nshibirnAma daiteyaH parikIrtitaH |
druma ityabhivikhyAtaH sa AsIdbhuvi pArthivaH
shlokas.9:
bAShkalo nAma yasteShAmAsIdasurasattamaH |
bhagadatta iti khyAtaH sa AsInmanujeshvaraH
shlokas.10:
ayaHshirA ashvashirA ayaHsha~Nkushcha vIryavAn |
tathA gaganamUrdhA cha vegavA.nshchAtra pa~nchamaH
shlokas.11:
pa~nchaite jaj~nire rAjanvIryavanto mahAsurAH |
kekayeShu mahAtmAnaH pArthivarShabhasattamAH
shlokas.12:
ketumAniti vikhyAto yastato.anyaH pratApavAn |
amitaujA iti khyAtaH pRRithivyAM so.abhavannnRRipaH
shlokas.13:
svarbhAnuriti vikhyAtaH shrImAnyastu mahAsuraH |
ugrasena iti khyAta ugrakarmA narAdhipaH
shlokas.14:
yastvashva iti vikhyAtaH shrImAnAsInmahAsuraH |
ashoko nAma rAjAsInmahAvIryaparAkramaH
shlokas.15:
tasmAdavarajo yastu rAjannashvapatiH smRRitaH |
daiteyaH so.abhavadrAjA hArdikyo manujarShabhaH
shlokas.16:
vRRiShaparveti vikhyAtaH shrImAnyastu mahAsuraH |
dIrghapraj~na iti khyAtaH pRRithivyAM so.abhavannRRipaH
shlokas.17:
ajakastvanujo rAjanya AsIdvRRiShaparvaNaH |
sa malla iti vikhyAtaH pRRithivyAmabhavannRRipaH
shlokas.18:
ashvagrIva iti khyAtaH sattvavAnyo mahAsuraH |
rochamAna iti khyAtaH pRRithivyAM so.abhavannRRipaH
shlokas.19:
sUkShmastu matimAnrAjankIrtimAnyaH prakIrtitaH |
bRRihanta iti vikhyAtaH kShitAvAsItsa pArthivaH
shlokas.20:
tuhuNDa iti vikhyAto ya AsIdasurottamaH |
senAbinduriti khyAtaH sa babhUva narAdhipaH
shlokas.21:
isRRipA nAma yasteShAmasurANAM balAdhikaH |
pApajinnAma rAjAsIdbhuvi vikhyAtavikramaH
shlokas.22:
ekachakra iti khyAta AsIdyastu mahAsuraH |
prativindhya iti khyAto babhUva prathitaH kShitau
shlokas.23:
virUpAkShastu daiteyashchitrayodhI mahAsuraH |
chitravarmeti vikhyAtaH kShitAvAsItsa pArthivaH
shlokas.24:
harastvariharo vIra AsIdyo dAnavottamaH |
suvAsturiti vikhyAtaH sa jaj~ne manujarShabhaH
shlokas.25:
aharastu mahAtejAH shatrupakShakShaya~NkaraH |
bAhlIko nAma rAjA sa babhUva prathitaH kShitau
shlokas.26:
nichandrashchandravaktrashcha ya AsIdasurottamaH |
mu~njakesha iti khyAtaH shrImAnAsItsa pArthivaH
shlokas.27:
nikumbhastvajitaH sa~Nkhye mahAmatirajAyata |
bhUmau bhUmipatiH shreShTho devAdhipa iti smRRitaH
shlokas.28:
sharabho nAma yasteShAM daiteyAnAM mahAsuraH |
pauravo nAma rAjarShiH sa babhUva nareShviha
shlokas.29:
dvitIyaH shalabhasteShAmasurANAM babhUva yaH |
prahrAdo nAma bAhlIkaH sa babhUva narAdhipaH
shlokas.30:
chandrastu ditijashreShTho loke tArAdhipopamaH |
RRiShiko nAma rAjarShirbabhUva nRRipasattamaH
shlokas.31:
mRRitapA iti vikhyAto ya AsIdasurottamaH |
pashchimAnUpakaM viddhi taM nRRipaM nRRipasattama
shlokas.32:
gaviShThastu mahAtejA yaH prakhyAto mahAsuraH |
drumasena iti khyAtaH pRRithivyAM so.abhavannRRipaH
shlokas.33:
mayUra iti vikhyAtaH shrImAnyastu mahAsuraH |
sa vishva iti vikhyAto babhUva pRRithivIpatiH
shlokas.34:
suparNa iti vikhyAtastasmAdavarajastu yaH |
kAlakIrtiriti khyAtaH pRRithivyAM so.abhavannRRipaH
shlokas.35:
chandrahanteti yasteShAM kIrtitaH pravaro.asuraH |
shunako nAma rAjarShiH sa babhUva narAdhipaH
shlokas.36:
vinAshanastu chandrasya ya AkhyAto mahAsuraH |
jAnakirnAma rAjarShiH sa babhUva narAdhipaH
shlokas.37:
dIrghajihvastu kauravya ya ukto dAnavarShabhaH |
kAshirAja iti khyAtaH pRRithivyAM pRRithivIpatiH
shlokas.38:
grahaM tu suShuve yaM taM siMhI chandrArkamardanam |
krAtha ityabhivikhyAtaH so.abhavanmanujAdhipaH
shlokas.39:
anAyuShastu putrANAM chaturNAM pravaro.asuraH |
vikSharo nAma tejasvI vasumitro.abhavannRRipaH
shlokas.40:
dvitIyo vikSharAdyastu narAdhipa mahAsuraH |
pA.nsurAShTrAdhipa iti vishrutaH so.abhavannRRipaH
shlokas.41:
balavIra iti khyAto yastvAsIdasurottamaH |
pauNDramatsyaka ityeva sa babhUva narAdhipaH
shlokas.42:
vRRitra ityabhivikhyAto yastu rAjanmahAsuraH |
maNimAnnAma rAjarShiH sa babhUva narAdhipaH
shlokas.43:
krodhahanteti yastasya babhUvAvarajo.asuraH |
daNDa ityabhivikhyAtaH sa AsInnRRipatiH kShitau
shlokas.44:
krodhavardhana ityeva yastvanyaH parikIrtitaH |
daNDadhAra iti khyAtaH so.abhavanmanujeshvaraH
shlokas.45:
kAlakAyAstu ye putrAsteShAmaShTau narAdhipAH |
jaj~nire rAjashArdUla shArdUlasamavikramAH
shlokas.46:
magadheShu jayatsenaH shrImAnAsItsa pArthivaH |
aShTAnAM pravarasteShAM kAleyAnAM mahAsuraH
shlokas.47:
dvitIyastu tatasteShAM shrImAnharihayopamaH |
aparAjita ityeva sa babhUva narAdhipaH
shlokas.48:
tRRitIyastu mahArAja mahAbAhurmahAsuraH |
niShAdAdhipatirjaj~ne bhuvi bhImaparAkramaH
shlokas.49:
teShAmanyatamo yastu chaturthaH parikIrtitaH |
shreNimAniti vikhyAtaH kShitau rAjarShisattamaH
shlokas.50:
pa~nchamastu babhUvaiShAM pravaro yo mahAsuraH |
mahaujA iti vikhyAto babhUveha parantapaH
shlokas.51:
ShaShThastu matimAnyo vai teShAmAsInmahAsuraH |
abhIruriti vikhyAtaH kShitau rAjarShisattamaH
shlokas.52:
samudrasenashcha nRRipasteShAmevAbhavadgaNAt |
vishrutaH sAgarAntAyAM kShitau dharmArthatattvavit
shlokas.53:
bRRihannAmAShTamasteShAM kAleyAnAM parantapaH |
babhUva rAjandharmAtmA sarvabhUtahite rataH
shlokas.54:
gaNaH krodhavasho nAma yaste rAjanprakIrtitaH |
tataH sa~njaj~nire vIrAH kShitAviha narAdhipAH
shlokas.55:
nandikaH karNaveShTashcha siddhArthaH kITakastathA |
suvIrashcha subAhushcha mahAvIro.atha bAhlikaH
shlokas.56:
krodho vichityaH surasaH shrImAnnIlashcha bhUmipaH |
vIradhAmA cha kauravya bhUmipAlashcha nAmataH
shlokas.57:
dantavaktrashcha nAmAsIddurjayashchaiva nAmataH |
rukmI cha nRRipashArdUlo rAjA cha janamejayaH
shlokas.58:
AShADho vAyuvegashcha bhUritejAstathaiva cha |
ekalavyaH sumitrashcha vATadhAno.atha gomukhaH
shlokas.59:
kArUShakAshcha rAjAnaH kShemadhUrtistathaiva cha |
shrutAyuruddhavashchaiva bRRihatsenastathaiva cha
shlokas.60:
kShemogratIrthaH kuharaH kali~NgeShu narAdhipaH |
matimA.nshcha manuShyendra Ishvarashcheti vishrutaH
shlokas.61:
gaNAtkrodhavashAdevaM rAjapUgo.abhavatkShitau |
jAtaH purA mahArAja mahAkIrtirmahAbalaH
shlokas.62:
yastvAsIddevako nAma devarAjasamadyutiH |
sa gandharvapatirmukhyaH kShitau jaj~ne narAdhipaH
shlokas.64:
dhanvinAM nRRipashArdUla yaH sa sarvAstravittamaH |
bRRihatkIrtirmahAtejAH sa~njaj~ne manujeShviha
shlokas.65:
dhanurvede cha vede cha yaM taM vedavido viduH |
variShThamindrakarmANaM droNaM svakulavardhanam
shlokas.66:
mahAdevAntakAbhyAM cha kAmAtkrodhAchcha bhArata |
ekatvamupapannAnAM jaj~ne shUraH parantapaH
shlokas.67:
ashvatthAmA mahAvIryaH shatrupakShakShaya~NkaraH |
vIraH kamalapatrAkShaH kShitAvAsInnarAdhipa
shlokas.68:
jaj~nire vasavastvaShTau ga~NgAyAM shantanoH sutAH |
vasiShThasya cha shApena niyogAdvAsavasya cha
shlokas.70:
jAmadagnyena rAmeNa yaH sa sarvavidAM varaH |
ayudhyata mahAtejA bhArgaveNa mahAtmanA
shlokas.71:
yastu rAjankRRipo nAma brahmarShirabhavatkShitau |
rudrANAM taM gaNAdviddhi sambhUtamatipauruSham
shlokas.72:
shakunirnAma yastvAsIdrAjA loke mahArathaH |
dvAparaM viddhi taM rAjansambhUtamarimardanam
shlokas.73:
sAtyakiH satyasandhastu yo.asau vRRiShNikulodvahaH |
pakShAtsa jaj~ne marutAM devAnAmarimardanaH
shlokas.74:
drupadashchApi rAjarShistata evAbhavadgaNAt |
mAnuShe nRRipa loke.asminsarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.75:
tatashcha kRRitavarmANaM viddhi rAja~njanAdhipam |
jAtamapratikarmANaM kShatriyarShabhasattamam
shlokas.76:
marutAM tu gaNAdviddhi sa~njAtamarimardanam |
virATaM nAma rAjarShiM pararAShTrapratApanam
shlokas.77:
ariShTAyAstu yaH putro ha.nsa ityabhivishrutaH |
sa gandharvapatirjaj~ne kuruva.nshavivardhanaH
shlokas.78:
dhRRitarAShTra iti khyAtaH kRRiShNadvaipAyanAdapi |
dIrghabAhurmahAtejAH praj~nAchakShurnarAdhipaH
mAturdoShAdRRiSheH kopAdandha eva vyajAyata
shlokas.79:
atrestu sumahAbhAgaM putraM putravatAM varam |
viduraM viddhi loke.asmi~njAtaM buddhimatAM varam
shlokas.80:
kalera.nshAttu sa~njaj~ne bhuvi duryodhano nRRipaH |
durbuddhirdurmatishchaiva kurUNAmayashaskaraH
shlokas.81:
jagato yaH sa sarvasya vidviShTaH kalipUruShaH |
yaH sarvAM ghAtayAmAsa pRRithivIM puruShAdhamaH
yena vairaM samuddIptaM bhUtAntakaraNaM mahat
shlokas.82:
paulastyA bhrAtaraH sarve jaj~nire manujeShviha |
shataM duHshAsanAdInAM sarveShAM krUrakarmaNAm
shlokas.83:
durmukho duHsahashchaiva ye chAnye nAnushabditAH |
duryodhanasahAyAste paulastyA bharatarShabha
shlokas.84:
dharmasyA.nshaM tu rAjAnaM viddhi rAjanyudhiShThiram |
bhImasenaM tu vAtasya devarAjasya chArjunam
shlokas.85:
ashvinostu tathaivA.nshau rUpeNApratimau bhuvi |
nakulaH sahadevashcha sarvalokamanoharau
shlokas.86:
yaH suvarchA iti khyAtaH somaputraH pratApavAn |
abhimanyurbRRihatkIrtirarjunasya suto.abhavat
shlokas.87:
agnera.nshaM tu viddhi tvaM dhRRiShTadyumnaM mahAratham |
shikhaNDinamatho rAjanstrIpu.nsaM viddhi rAkShasam
shlokas.88:
draupadeyAshcha ye pa~ncha babhUvurbharatarShabha |
vishvedevagaNAnrAja.nstAnviddhi bharatarShabha
shlokas.89:
AmuktakavachaH karNo yastu jaj~ne mahArathaH |
divAkarasya taM viddhi devasyA.nshamanuttamam
shlokas.90:
yastu nArAyaNo nAma devadevaH sanAtanaH |
tasyA.nsho mAnuSheShvAsIdvAsudevaH pratApavAn
shlokas.91:
sheShasyA.nshastu nAgasya baladevo mahAbalaH |
sanatkumAraM pradyumnaM viddhi rAjanmahaujasam
shlokas.92:
evamanye manuShyendra bahavoM.ashA divaukasAm |
jaj~nire vasudevasya kule kulavivardhanAH
shlokas.93:
gaNastvapsarasAM yo vai mayA rAjanprakIrtitaH |
tasya bhAgaH kShitau jaj~ne niyogAdvAsavasya cha
shlokas.94:
tAni ShoDasha devInAM sahasrANi narAdhipa |
babhUvurmAnuShe loke nArAyaNaparigrahaH
shlokas.95:
shriyastu bhAgaH sa~njaj~ne ratyarthaM pRRithivItale |
drupadasya kule kanyA vedimadhyAdaninditA
shlokas.96:
nAtihrasvA na mahatI nIlotpalasugandhinI |
padmAyatAkShI sushroNI asitAyatamUrdhajA
shlokas.97:
sarvalakShaNasampannA vaiDUryamaNisaMnibhA |
pa~nchAnAM puruShendrANAM chittapramathinI rahaH
shlokas.98:
siddhirdhRRitishcha ye devyau pa~nchAnAM mAtarau tu te |
kuntI mAdrI cha jaj~nAte matistu subalAtmajA
shlokas.99:
iti devAsurANAM te gandharvApsarasAM tathA |
a.nshAvataraNaM rAjanrAkShasAnAM cha kIrtitam
shlokas.100:
ye pRRithivyAM samudbhUtA rAjAno yuddhadurmadAH |
mahAtmAno yadUnAM cha ye jAtA vipule kule
shlokas.101:
dhanyaM yashasyaM putrIyamAyuShyaM vijayAvaham |
idama.nshAvataraNaM shrotavyamanasUyatA
shlokas.102:
a.nshAvataraNaM shrutvA devagandharvarakShasAm |
prabhavApyayavitprAj~no na kRRichChreShvavasIdati

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
tvattaH shrutamidaM brahmandevadAnavarakShasAm |
a.nshAvataraNaM samyaggandharvApsarasAM tathA
shlokas.2:
imaM tu bhUya ichChAmi kurUNAM va.nshamAditaH |
kathyamAnaM tvayA vipra viprarShigaNasaMnidhau
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pauravANAM va.nshakaro duHShanto nAma vIryavAn |
pRRithivyAshchaturantAyA goptA bharatasattama
shlokas.4:
chaturbhAgaM bhuvaH kRRitsnaM sa bhu~Nkte manujeshvaraH |
samudrAvaraNA.nshchApi deshAnsa samiti~njayaH
shlokas.5:
AmlechChATavikAnsarvAnsa bhu~Nkte ripumardanaH |
ratnAkarasamudrAntA.nshchAturvarNyajanAvRRitAn
shlokas.6:
na varNasa~Nkarakaro nAkRRiShyakarakRRijjanaH |
na pApakRRitkashchidAsIttasminrAjani shAsati
shlokas.7:
dharmyAM ratiM sevamAnA dharmArthAvabhipedire |
tadA narA naravyAghra tasmi~njanapadeshvare
shlokas.8:
nAsIchchorabhayaM tAta na kShudhAbhayamaNvapi |
nAsIdvyAdhibhayaM chApi tasmi~njanapadeshvare
shlokas.9:
svairdharmai remire varNA daive karmaNi niHspRRihAH |
tamAshritya mahIpAlamAsa.nshchaivAkutobhayAH
shlokas.10:
kAlavarShI cha parjanyaH sasyAni phalavanti cha |
sarvaratnasamRRiddhA cha mahI vasumatI tadA
shlokas.11:
sa chAdbhutamahAvIryo vajrasaMhanano yuvA |
udyamya mandaraM dorbhyAM haretsavanakAnanam
shlokas.12:
dhanuShyatha gadAyuddhe tsarupraharaNeShu cha |
nAgapRRiShThe.ashvapRRiShThe cha babhUva pariniShThitaH
shlokas.13:
bale viShNusamashchAsIttejasA bhAskaropamaH |
akShubdhatve.arNavasamaH sahiShNutve dharAsamaH
shlokas.14:
saMmataH sa mahIpAlaH prasannapurarAShTravAn |
bhUyo dharmaparairbhAvairviditaM janamAvasat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa kadAchinmahAbAhuH prabhUtabalavAhanaH |
vanaM jagAma gahanaM hayanAgashatairvRRitaH
shlokas.2:
khaDgashaktidharairvIrairgadAmusalapANibhiH |
prAsatomarahastaishcha yayau yodhashatairvRRitaH
shlokas.3:
siMhanAdaishcha yodhAnAM sha~NkhadundubhinisvanaiH |
rathanemisvanaishchApi sanAgavarabRRiMhitaiH
shlokas.4:
heShitasvanamishraishcha kShveDitAsphoTitasvanaiH |
AsItkilakilAshabdastasmingachChati pArthive
shlokas.5:
prAsAdavarashRRi~NgasthAH parayA nRRipashobhayA |
dadRRishustaM striyastatra shUramAtmayashaskaram
shlokas.6:
shakropamamamitraghnaM paravAraNavAraNam |
pashyantaH strIgaNAstatra shastrapANiM sma menire
shlokas.7:
ayaM sa puruShavyAghro raNe.adbhutaparAkramaH |
yasya bAhubalaM prApya na bhavantyasuhRRidgaNAH
shlokas.8:
iti vAcho bruvantyastAH striyaH premNA narAdhipam |
tuShTuvuH puShpavRRiShTIshcha sasRRijustasya mUrdhani
shlokas.9:
tatra tatra cha viprendraiH stUyamAnaH samantataH |
niryayau parayA prItyA vanaM mRRigajighA.nsayA
shlokas.10:
sudUramanujagmustaM paurajAnapadAstadA |
nyavartanta tataH pashchAdanuj~nAtA nRRipeNa ha
shlokas.11:
suparNapratimenAtha rathena vasudhAdhipaH |
mahImApUrayAmAsa ghoSheNa tridivaM tathA
shlokas.12:
sa gachChandadRRishe dhImAnnandanapratimaM vanam |
bilvArkakhadirAkIrNaM kapitthadhavasa~Nkulam
shlokas.13:
viShamaM parvataprasthairashmabhishcha samAvRRitam |
nirjalaM nirmanuShyaM cha bahuyojanamAyatam
mRRigasa~NghairvRRitaM ghorairanyaishchApi vanecharaiH
shlokas.14:
tadvanaM manujavyAghraH sabhRRityabalavAhanaH |
loDayAmAsa duHShantaH sUdayanvividhAnmRRigAn
shlokas.15:
bANagocharasamprAptA.nstatra vyAghragaNAnbahUn |
pAtayAmAsa duHShanto nirbibheda cha sAyakaiH
shlokas.16:
dUrasthAnsAyakaiH kA.nshchidabhinatsa nararShabhaH |
abhyAshamAgatA.nshchAnyAnkhaDgena nirakRRintata
shlokas.17:
kA.nshchideNAnsa nirjaghne shaktyA shaktimatAM varaH |
gadAmaNDalatattvaj~nashchachArAmitavikramaH
shlokas.18:
tomarairasibhishchApi gadAmusalakarpaNaiH |
chachAra sa vinighnanvai vanyA.nstatra mRRigadvijAn
shlokas.19:
rAj~nA chAdbhutavIryeNa yodhaishcha samarapriyaiH |
loDyamAnaM mahAraNyaM tatyajushcha mahAmRRigAH
shlokas.20:
tatra vidrutasa~NghAni hatayUthapatIni cha |
mRRigayUthAnyathautsukyAchChabdaM chakrustatastataH
shlokas.21:
shuShkAM chApi nadIM gatvA jalanairAshyakarshitAH |
vyAyAmaklAntahRRidayAH patanti sma vichetasaH
shlokas.22:
kShutpipAsAparItAshcha shrAntAshcha patitA bhuvi |
kechittatra naravyAghrairabhakShyanta bubhukShitaiH
shlokas.23:
kechidagnimathotpAdya samidhya cha vanecharAH |
bhakShayanti sma mA.nsAni prakuTya vidhivattadA
shlokas.24:
tatra kechidgajA mattA balinaH shastravikShatAH |
sa~NkochyAgrakarAnbhItAH pradravanti sma vegitAH
shlokas.25:
shakRRinmUtraM sRRijantashcha kSharantaH shoNitaM bahu |
vanyA gajavarAstatra mamRRidurmanujAnbahUn
shlokas.26:
tadvanaM balameghena sharadhAreNa sa.nvRRitam |
vyarochanmahiShAkIrNaM rAj~nA hatamahAmRRigam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato mRRigasahasrANi hatvA vipulavAhanaH |
rAjA mRRigaprasa~Ngena vanamanyadvivesha ha
shlokas.2:
eka evottamabalaH kShutpipAsAsamanvitaH |
sa vanasyAntamAsAdya mahadIriNamAsadat
shlokas.3:
tachchApyatItya nRRipatiruttamAshramasa.nyutam |
manaHprahlAdajananaM dRRiShTikAntamatIva cha
shItamArutasa.nyuktaM jagAmAnyanmahadvanam
shlokas.4:
puShpitaiH pAdapaiH kIrNamatIva sukhashAdvalam |
vipulaM madhurArAvairnAditaM vihagaistathA
shlokas.5:
pravRRiddhaviTapairvRRikShaiH sukhachChAyaiH samAvRRitam |
ShaTpadAghUrNitalataM lakShmyA paramayA yutam
shlokas.6:
nApuShpaH pAdapaH kashchinnAphalo nApi kaNTakI |
ShaTpadairvApyanAkIrNastasminvai kAnane.abhavat
shlokas.7:
vihagairnAditaM puShpairala~NkRRitamatIva cha |
sarvartukusumairvRRikShairatIva sukhashAdvalam
manoramaM maheShvAso vivesha vanamuttamam
shlokas.8:
mArutAgalitAstatra drumAH kusumashAlinaH |
puShpavRRiShTiM vichitrAM sma vyasRRija.nste punaH punaH
shlokas.9:
divaspRRisho.atha sa~NghuShTAH pakShibhirmadhurasvaraiH |
virejuH pAdapAstatra vichitrakusumAmbarAH
shlokas.10:
teShAM tatra pravAleShu puShpabhArAvanAmiShu |
ruvanti rAvaM vihagAH ShaTpadaiH sahitA mRRidu
shlokas.11:
tatra pradeshA.nshcha bahUnkusumotkaramaNDitAn |
latAgRRihaparikShiptAnmanasaH prItivardhanAn
sampashyansa mahAtejA babhUva muditastadA
shlokas.12:
parasparAshliShTashAkhaiH pAdapaiH kusumAchitaiH |
ashobhata vanaM tattairmahendradhvajasaMnibhaiH
shlokas.13:
sukhashItaH sugandhI cha puShpareNuvaho.anilaH |
parikrAmanvane vRRikShAnupaitIva rira.nsayA
shlokas.14:
eva~NguNasamAyuktaM dadarsha sa vanaM nRRipaH |
nadIkachChodbhavaM kAntamuchChritadhvajasaMnibham
shlokas.15:
prekShamANo vanaM tattu suprahRRiShTaviha~Ngamam |
AshramapravaraM ramyaM dadarsha cha manoramam
shlokas.16:
nAnAvRRikShasamAkIrNaM samprajvalitapAvakam |
yatibhirvAlakhilyaishcha vRRitaM munigaNAnvitam
shlokas.17:
agnyAgAraishcha bahubhiH puShpasa.nstarasa.nstRRitam |
mahAkachChairbRRihadbhishcha vibhrAjitamatIva cha
shlokas.18:
mAlinImabhito rAjannadIM puNyAM sukhodakAm |
naikapakShigaNAkIrNAM tapovanamanoramAm
tatra vyAlamRRigAnsaumyAnpashyanprItimavApa saH
shlokas.19:
taM chApyatirathaH shrImAnAshramaM pratyapadyata |
devalokapratIkAshaM sarvataH sumanoharam
shlokas.20:
nadImAshramasa.nshliShTAM puNyatoyAM dadarsha saH |
sarvaprANabhRRitAM tatra jananImiva viShThitAm
shlokas.21:
sachakravAkapulinAM puShpaphenapravAhinIm |
sakiMnaragaNAvAsAM vAnararkShaniShevitAm
shlokas.22:
puNyasvAdhyAyasa~NghuShTAM pulinairupashobhitAm |
mattavAraNashArdUlabhujagendraniShevitAm
shlokas.23:
nadImAshramasambaddhAM dRRiShTvAshramapadaM tathA |
chakArAbhipraveshAya matiM sa nRRipatistadA
shlokas.24:
ala~NkRRitaM dvIpavatyA mAlinyA ramyatIrayA |
naranArAyaNasthAnaM ga~Ngayevopashobhitam
mattabarhiNasa~NghuShTaM pravivesha mahadvanam
shlokas.25:
tatsa chaitrarathaprakhyaM samupetya nareshvaraH |
atIva guNasampannamanirdeshyaM cha varchasA
maharShiM kAshyapaM draShTumatha kaNvaM tapodhanam
shlokas.26:
rathinImashvasambAdhAM padAtigaNasa~NkulAm |
avasthApya vanadvAri senAmidamuvAcha saH
shlokas.27:
muniM virajasaM draShTuM gamiShyAmi tapodhanam |
kAshyapaM sthIyatAmatra yAvadAgamanaM mama
shlokas.28:
tadvanaM nandanaprakhyamAsAdya manujeshvaraH |
kShutpipAse jahau rAjA harShaM chAvApa puShkalam
shlokas.29:
sAmAtyo rAjali~NgAni so.apanIya narAdhipaH |
purohitasahAyashcha jagAmAshramamuttamam
didRRikShustatra tamRRiShiM taporAshimathAvyayam
shlokas.30:
brahmalokapratIkAshamAshramaM so.abhivIkShya cha |
ShaTpadodgItasa~NghuShTaM nAnAdvija gaNAyutam
shlokas.31:
RRicho bahvRRichamukhyaishcha preryamANAH padakramaiH |
shushrAva manujavyAghro vitateShviha karmasu
shlokas.32:
yaj~navidyA~Ngavidbhishcha kramadbhishcha kramAnapi |
amitAtmabhiH suniyataiH shushubhe sa tadAshramaH
shlokas.33:
atharvavedapravarAH pUgayAj~nika saMmatAH |
saMhitAmIrayanti sma padakramayutAM tu te
shlokas.34:
shabdasa.nskArasa.nyuktaM bruvadbhishchAparairdvijaiH |
nAditaH sa babhau shrImAnbrahmaloka ivAshramaH
shlokas.35:
yaj~nasa.nskAravidbhishcha kramashikShA vishAradaiH |
nyAyatattvArthavij~nAnasampannairvedapAragaiH
shlokas.36:
nAnAvAkyasamAhArasamavAyavishAradaiH |
visheShakAryavidbhishcha mokShadharmaparAyaNaiH
shlokas.37:
sthApanAkShepasiddhAntaparamArthaj~natAM gataiH |
lokAyatikamukhyaishcha samantAdanunAditam
shlokas.38:
tatra tatra cha viprendrAnniyatAnsa.nshitavratAn |
japahomaparAnsiddhAndadarsha paravIrahA
shlokas.39:
AsanAni vichitrANi puShpavanti mahIpatiH |
prayatnopahitAni sma dRRiShTvA vismayamAgamat
shlokas.40:
devatAyatanAnAM cha pUjAM prekShya kRRitAM dvijaiH |
brahmalokasthamAtmAnaM mene sa nRRipasattamaH
shlokas.41:
sa kAshyapatapoguptamAshramapravaraM shubham |
nAtRRipyatprekShamANo vai tapodhanagaNairyutam
shlokas.42:
sa kAshyapasyAyatanaM mahAvratai;rvRRitaM samantAdRRiShibhistapodhanaiH |
vivesha sAmAtyapurohito.arihA; viviktamatyarthamanoharaM shivam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato gachChanmahAbAhureko.amAtyAnvisRRijya tAn |
nApashyadAshrame tasmi.nstamRRiShiM sa.nshitavratam
shlokas.2:
so.apashyamAnastamRRiShiM shUnyaM dRRiShTvA tamAshramam |
uvAcha ka ihetyuchchairvanaM saMnAdayanniva
shlokas.3:
shrutvAtha tasya taM shabdaM kanyA shrIriva rUpiNI |
nishchakrAmAshramAttasmAttApasIveShadhAriNI
shlokas.4:
sA taM dRRiShTvaiva rAjAnaM duHShantamasitekShaNA |
svAgataM ta iti kShipramuvAcha pratipUjya cha
shlokas.5:
AsanenArchayitvA cha pAdyenArghyeNa chaiva hi |
paprachChAnAmayaM rAjankushalaM cha narAdhipam
shlokas.6:
yathAvadarchayitvA sA pRRiShTvA chAnAmayaM tadA |
uvAcha smayamAneva kiM kAryaM kriyatAmiti
shlokas.7:
tAmabravIttato rAjA kanyAM madhurabhAShiNIm |
dRRiShTvA sarvAnavadyA~NgIM yathAvatpratipUjitaH
shlokas.8:
Agato.ahaM mahAbhAgamRRiShiM kaNvamupAsitum |
kva gato bhagavAnbhadre tanmamAchakShva shobhane
shlokas.9:
shakuntalovAcha||
gataH pitA me bhagavAnphalAnyAhartumAshramAt |
muhUrtaM sampratIkShasva drakShyasyenamihAgatam
shlokas.10:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
apashyamAnastamRRiShiM tayA choktastathA nRRipaH |
tAM cha dRRiShTvA varArohAM shrImatIM chAruhAsinIm
shlokas.11:
vibhrAjamAnAM vapuShA tapasA cha damena cha |
rUpayauvanasampannAmityuvAcha mahIpatiH
shlokas.12:
kAsi kasyAsi sushroNi kimarthaM chAgatA vanam |
eva.nrUpaguNopetA kutastvamasi shobhane
shlokas.13:
darshanAdeva hi shubhe tvayA me.apahRRitaM manaH |
ichChAmi tvAmahaM j~nAtuM tanmamAchakShva shobhane
shlokas.14:
evamuktA tadA kanyA tena rAj~nA tadAshrame |
uvAcha hasatI vAkyamidaM sumadhurAkSharam
shlokas.15:
kaNvaShyAhaM bhagavato duHShanta duhitA matA |
tapasvino dhRRitimato dharmaj~nasya yashasvinaH
shlokas.16:
duHShanta uvAcha||
UrdhvaretA mahAbhAgo bhagavA.NllokapUjitaH |
chaleddhi vRRittAddharmo.api na chaletsa.nshitavrataH
shlokas.17:
kathaM tvaM tasya duhitA sambhUtA varavarNinI |
sa.nshayo me mahAnatra taM me ChettumihArhasi
shlokas.18:
shakuntalovAcha||
yathAyamAgamo mahyaM yathA chedamabhUtpurA |
shRRiNu rAjanyathAtattvaM yathAsmi duhitA muneH
shlokas.19:
RRiShiH kashchidihAgamya mama janmAbhyachodayat |
tasmai provAcha bhagavAnyathA tachChRRiNu pArthiva
shlokas.20:
tapyamAnaH kila purA vishvAmitro mahattapaH |
subhRRishaM tApayAmAsa shakraM suragaNeshvaram
shlokas.21:
tapasA dIptavIryo.ayaM sthAnAnmAM chyAvayediti |
bhItaH pura.ndarastasmAnmenakAmidamabravIt
shlokas.22:
guNairdivyairapsarasAM menake tvaM vishiShyase |
shreyo me kuru kalyANi yattvAM vakShyAmi tachChRRiNu
shlokas.23:
asAvAdityasa~NkAsho vishvAmitro mahAtapAH |
tapyamAnastapo ghoraM mama kampayate manaH
shlokas.24:
menake tava bhAro.ayaM vishvAmitraH sumadhyame |
sa.nshitAtmA sudurdharSha ugre tapasi vartate
shlokas.25:
sa mAM na chyAvayetsthAnAttaM vai gatvA pralobhaya |
chara tasya tapovighnaM kuru me priyamuttamam
shlokas.26:
rUpayauvanamAdhuryacheShTitasmitabhAShitaiH |
lobhayitvA varArohe tapasaH saMnivartaya
shlokas.27:
menakovAcha||
mahAtejAH sa bhagavAnsadaiva cha mahAtapAH |
kopanashcha tathA hyenaM jAnAti bhagavAnapi
shlokas.28:
tejasastapasashchaiva kopasya cha mahAtmanaH |
tvamapyudvijase yasya nodvijeyamahaM katham
shlokas.29:
mahAbhAgaM vasiShThaM yaH putrairiShTairvyayojayat |
kShatre jAtashcha yaH pUrvamabhavadbrAhmaNo balAt
shlokas.30:
shauchArthaM yo nadIM chakre durgamAM bahubhirjalaiH |
yAM tAM puNyatamAM loke kaushikIti vidurjanAH
shlokas.31:
babhAra yatrAsya purA kAle durge mahAtmanaH |
dArAnmata~Ngo dharmAtmA rAjarShirvyAdhatAM gataH
shlokas.32:
atItakAle durbhikShe yatraitya punarAshramam |
muniH pAreti nadyA vai nAma chakre tadA prabhuH
shlokas.33:
mata~NgaM yAjayAM chakre yatra prItamanAH svayam |
tvaM cha somaM bhayAdyasya gataH pAtuM shureshvara
shlokas.34:
ati nakShatrava.nshA.nshcha kruddho nakShatrasampadA |
prati shravaNapUrvANi nakShatrANi sasarja yaH
shlokas.35:
etAni yasya karmANi tasyAhaM bhRRishamudvije |
yathA mAM na dahetkruddhastathAj~nApaya mAM vibho
shlokas.36:
tejasA nirdahellokAnkampayeddharaNIM padA |
sa~NkShipechcha mahAmeruM tUrNamAvartayettathA
shlokas.37:
tAdRRishaM tapasA yuktaM pradIptamiva pAvakam |
kathamasmadvidhA bAlA jitendriyamabhispRRishet
shlokas.38:
hutAshanamukhaM dIptaM sUryachandrAkShitArakam |
kAlajihvaM surashreShTha kathamasmadvidhA spRRishet
shlokas.39:
yamashcha somashcha maharShayashcha; sAdhyA vishve vAlakhilyAshcha sarve |
ete.api yasyodvijante prabhAvA;tkasmAttasmAnmAdRRishI nodvijeta
shlokas.40:
tvayaivamuktA cha kathaM samIpa;mRRiSherna gachCheyamahaM surendra |
rakShAM tu me chintaya devarAja; yathA tvadarthaM rakShitAhaM chareyam
shlokas.41:
kAmaM tu me mArutastatra vAsaH; prakrIDitAyA vivRRiNotu deva |
bhavechcha me manmathastatra kArye; sahAyabhUtastava devaprasAdAt
shlokas.42:
vanAchcha vAyuH surabhiH pravAye;ttasminkAle tamRRiShiM lobhayantyAH |
tathetyuktvA vihite chaiva tasmiM;stato yayau sAshramaM kaushikasya

shlokas.1:
shakuntalovAcha||
evamuktastayA shakraH sa.ndidesha sadAgatim |
prAtiShThata tadA kAle menakA vAyunA saha
shlokas.2:
athApashyadvarArohA tapasA dagdhakilbiSham |
vishvAmitraM tapasyantaM menakA bhIrurAshrame
shlokas.3:
abhivAdya tataH sA taM prAkrIDadRRiShisaMnidhau |
apovAha cha vAso.asyA mArutaH shashisaMnibham
shlokas.4:
sAgachChattvaritA bhUmiM vAsastadabhili~NgatI |
utsmayantIva savrIDaM mArutaM varavarNinI
shlokas.5:
gRRiddhAM vAsasi sambhrAntAM menakAM munisattamaH |
anirdeshyavayorUpAmapashyadvivRRitAM tadA
shlokas.6:
tasyA rUpaguNaM dRRiShTvA sa tu viprarShabhastadA |
chakAra bhAvaM sa.nsarge tayA kAmavashaM gataH
shlokas.7:
nyamantrayata chApyenAM sA chApyaichChadaninditA |
tau tatra suchiraM kAlaM vane vyaharatAmubhau
ramamANau yathAkAmaM yathaikadivasaM tathA
shlokas.8:
janayAmAsa sa munirmenakAyAM shakuntalAm |
prasthe himavato ramye mAlinImabhito nadIm
shlokas.9:
jAtamutsRRijya taM garbhaM menakA mAlinImanu |
kRRitakAryA tatastUrNamagachChachChakrasa.nsadam
shlokas.10:
taM vane vijane garbhaM siMhavyAghrasamAkule |
dRRiShTvA shayAnaM shakunAH samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.11:
nemAM hi.nsyurvane bAlAM kravyAdA mA.nsagRRiddhinaH |
paryarakShanta tAM tatra shakuntA menakAtmajAm
shlokas.12:
upaspraShTuM gatashchAhamapashyaM shayitAmimAm |
nirjane vipine.araNye shakuntaiH parivAritAm
AnayitvA tatashchainAM duhitRRitve nyayojayam
shlokas.13:
sharIrakRRitprANadAtA yasya chAnnAni bhu~njate |
krameNa te trayo.apyuktAH pitaro dharmanishchaye
shlokas.14:
nirjane cha vane yasmAchChakuntaiH parirakShitA |
shakuntaleti nAmAsyAH kRRitaM chApi tato mayA
shlokas.15:
evaM duhitaraM viddhi mama saumya shakuntalAm |
shakuntalA cha pitaraM manyate mAmaninditA
shlokas.16:
etadAchaShTa pRRiShTaH sanmama janma maharShaye |
sutAM kaNvasya mAmevaM viddhi tvaM manujAdhipa
shlokas.17:
kaNvaM hi pitaraM manye pitaraM svamajAnatI |
iti te kathitaM rAjanyathAvRRittaM shrutaM mayA

shlokas.1:
duHShanta uvAcha||
suvyaktaM rAjaputrI tvaM yathA kalyANi bhAShase |
bhAryA me bhava sushroNi brUhi kiM karavANi te
shlokas.2:
suvarNamAlA vAsA.nsi kuNDale parihATake |
nAnApattanaje shubhre maNiratne cha shobhane
shlokas.3:
AharAmi tavAdyAhaM niShkAdInyajinAni cha |
sarvaM rAjyaM tavAdyAstu bhAryA me bhava shobhane
shlokas.4:
gAndharveNa cha mAM bhIru vivAhenaihi sundari |
vivAhAnAM hi rambhoru gAndharvaH shreShTha uchyate
shlokas.5:
shakuntalovAcha||
phalAhAro gato rAjanpitA me ita AshramAt |
taM muhUrtaM pratIkShasva sa mAM tubhyaM pradAsyati
shlokas.6:
duHShanta uvAcha||
ichChAmi tvAM varArohe bhajamAnAmanindite |
tvadarthaM mAM sthitaM viddhi tvadgataM hi mano mama
shlokas.7:
Atmano bandhurAtmaiva gatirAtmaiva chAtmanaH |
AtmanaivAtmano dAnaM kartumarhasi dharmataH
shlokas.8:
aShTAveva samAsena vivAhA dharmataH smRRitAH |
brAhmo daivastathaivArShaH prAjApatyastathAsuraH
shlokas.9:
gAndharvo rAkShasashchaiva paishAchashchAShTamaH smRRitaH |
teShAM dharmAnyathApUrvaM manuH svAyambhuvo.abravIt
shlokas.10:
prashastA.nshchaturaH pUrvAnbrAhmaNasyopadhAraya |
ShaDAnupUrvyA kShatrasya viddhi dharmyAnanindite
shlokas.11:
rAj~nAM tu rAkShaso.apyukto viTshUdreShvAsuraH smRRitaH |
pa~nchAnAM tu trayo dharmyA dvAvadharmyau smRRitAviha
shlokas.12:
paishAchashchAsurashchaiva na kartavyau katha~nchana |
anena vidhinA kAryo dharmasyaiShA gatiH smRRitA
shlokas.13:
gAndharvarAkShasau kShatre dharmyau tau mA visha~NkithAH |
pRRithagvA yadi vA mishrau kartavyau nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.14:
sA tvaM mama sakAmasya sakAmA varavarNini |
gAndharveNa vivAhena bhAryA bhavitumarhasi
shlokas.15:
shakuntalovAcha||
yadi dharmapathastveSha yadi chAtmA prabhurmama |
pradAne pauravashreShTha shRRiNu me samayaM prabho
shlokas.16:
satyaM me pratijAnIhi yattvAM vakShyAmyahaM rahaH |
mama jAyeta yaH putraH sa bhavettvadanantaram
shlokas.17:
yuvarAjo mahArAja satyametadbravIhi me |
yadyetadevaM duHShanta astu me sa~NgamastvayA
shlokas.18:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamastviti tAM rAjA pratyuvAchAvichArayan |
api cha tvAM nayiShyAmi nagaraM svaM shuchismite
yathA tvamarhA sushroNi satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.19:
evamuktvA sa rAjarShistAmaninditagAminIm |
jagrAha vidhivatpANAvuvAsa cha tayA saha
shlokas.20:
vishvAsya chainAM sa prAyAdabravIchcha punaH punaH |
preShayiShye tavArthAya vAhinIM chatura~NgiNIm
tayA tvAmAnayiShyAmi nivAsaM svaM shuchismite
shlokas.21:
iti tasyAH pratishrutya sa nRRipo janamejaya |
manasA chintayanprAyAtkAshyapaM prati pArthivaH
shlokas.22:
bhagavA.nstapasA yuktaH shrutvA kiM nu kariShyati |
evaM sa~nchintayanneva pravivesha svakaM puram
shlokas.23:
muhUrtayAte tasmi.nstu kaNvo.apyAshramamAgamat |
shakuntalA cha pitaraM hriyA nopajagAma tam
shlokas.24:
vij~nAyAtha cha tAM kaNvo divyaj~nAno mahAtapAH |
uvAcha bhagavAnprItaH pashyandivyena chakShuShA
shlokas.25:
tvayAdya rAjAnvayayA mAmanAdRRitya yatkRRitaH |
pu.nsA saha samAyogo na sa dharmopaghAtakaH
shlokas.26:
kShatriyasya hi gAndharvo vivAhaH shreShTha uchyate |
sakAmAyAH sakAmena nirmantro rahasi smRRitaH
shlokas.27:
dharmAtmA cha mahAtmA cha duHShantaH puruShottamaH |
abhyagachChaH patiM yaM tvaM bhajamAnaM shakuntale
shlokas.28:
mahAtmA janitA loke putrastava mahAbalaH |
ya imAM sAgarApA~NgAM kRRitsnAM bhokShyati medinIm
shlokas.29:
paraM chAbhiprayAtasya chakraM tasya mahAtmanaH |
bhaviShyatyapratihataM satataM chakravartinaH
shlokas.30:
tataH prakShAlya pAdau sA vishrAntaM munimabravIt |
vinidhAya tato bhAraM saMnidhAya phalAni cha
shlokas.31:
mayA patirvRRito yo.asau duHShantaH puruShottamaH |
tasmai sasachivAya tvaM prasAdaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.32:
kaNva uvAcha||
prasanna eva tasyAhaM tvatkRRite varavarNini |
gRRihANa cha varaM mattastatkRRite yadabhIpsitam
shlokas.33:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato dharmiShThatAM vavre rAjyAchchAskhalanaM tathA |
shakuntalA pauravANAM duHShantahitakAmyayA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pratij~nAya tu duHShante pratiyAte shakuntalA |
garbhaM suShAva vAmoruH kumAramamitaujasam
shlokas.2:
triShu varSheShu pUrNeShu diptAnalasamadyutim |
rUpaudAryaguNopetaM dauHShantiM janamejaya
shlokas.3:
jAtakarmAdisa.nskAraM kaNvaH puNyakRRitAM varaH |
tasyAtha kArayAmAsa vardhamAnasya dhImataH
shlokas.4:
dantaiH shuklaiH shikharibhiH siMhasaMhanano yuvA |
chakrA~NkitakaraH shrImAnmahAmUrdhA mahAbalaH
kumAro devagarbhAbhaH sa tatrAshu vyavardhata
shlokas.5:
ShaDvarSha eva bAlaH sa kaNvAshramapadaM prati |
vyAghrAnsiMhAnvarAhA.nshcha gajA.nshcha mahiShA.nstathA
shlokas.6:
baddhvA vRRikSheShu balavAnAshramasya samantataH |
Arohandamaya.nshchaiva krIDa.nshcha paridhAvati
shlokas.7:
tato.asya nAma chakruste kaNvAshramanivAsinaH |
astvayaM sarvadamanaH sarvaM hi damayatyayam
shlokas.8:
sa sarvadamano nAma kumAraH samapadyata |
vikrameNaujasA chaiva balena cha samanvitaH
shlokas.9:
taM kumAramRRiShirdRRiShTvA karma chAsyAtimAnuSham |
samayo yauvarAjyAyetyabravIchcha shakuntalAm
shlokas.10:
tasya tadbalamAj~nAya kaNvaH shiShyAnuvAcha ha |
shakuntalAmimAM shIghraM sahaputrAmito.a.ashramAt
bhartre prApayatAdyaiva sarvalakShaNapUjitAm
shlokas.11:
nArINAM chiravAso hi bAndhaveShu na rochate |
kIrtichAritradharmaghnastasmAnnayata mAchiram
shlokas.12:
tathetyuktvA tu te sarve prAtiShThantAmitaujasaH |
shakuntalAM puraskRRitya saputrAM gajasAhvayam
shlokas.13:
gRRihItvAmaragarbhAbhaM putraM kamalalochanam |
AjagAma tataH shubhrA duHShantaviditAdvanAt
shlokas.14:
abhisRRitya cha rAjAnaM viditA sA praveshitA |
saha tenaiva putreNa taruNAdityavarchasA
shlokas.15:
pUjayitvA yathAnyAyamabravIttaM shakuntalA |
ayaM putrastvayA rAjanyauvarAjye.abhiShichyatAm
shlokas.16:
tvayA hyayaM suto rAjanmayyutpannaH suropamaH |
yathAsamayametasminvartasva puruShottama
shlokas.17:
yathA samAgame pUrvaM kRRitaH sa samayastvayA |
taM smarasva mahAbhAga kaNvAshramapadaM prati
shlokas.18:
so.atha shrutvaiva tadvAkyaM tasyA rAjA smarannapi |
abravInna smarAmIti kasya tvaM duShTatApasi
shlokas.19:
dharmakAmArthasambandhaM na smarAmi tvayA saha |
gachCha vA tiShTha vA kAmaM yadvApIchChasi tatkuru
shlokas.20:
saivamuktA varArohA vrIDiteva manasvinI |
visa~nj~neva cha duHkhena tasthau sthANurivAchalA
shlokas.21:
sa.nrambhAmarShatAmrAkShI sphuramANoShThasampuTA |
kaTAkShairnirdahantIva tiryagrAjAnamaikShata
shlokas.22:
AkAraM gUhamAnA cha manyunAbhisamIritA |
tapasA sambhRRitaM tejo dhArayAmAsa vai tadA
shlokas.23:
sA muhUrtamiva dhyAtvA duHkhAmarShasamanvitA |
bhartAramabhisamprekShya kruddhA vachanamabravIt
shlokas.24:
jAnannapi mahArAja kasmAdevaM prabhAShase |
na jAnAmIti niHsa~NgaM yathAnyaH prAkRRitastathA
shlokas.25:
atra te hRRidayaM veda satyasyaivAnRRitasya cha |
kalyANa bata sAkShI tvaM mAtmAnamavamanyathAH
shlokas.26:
yo.anyathA santamAtmAnamanyathA pratipadyate |
kiM tena na kRRitaM pApaM choreNAtmApahAriNA
shlokas.27:
eko.ahamasmIti cha manyase tvaM; na hRRichChayaM vetsi muniM purANam |
yo veditA karmaNaH pApakasya; tasyAntike tvaM vRRijinaM karoShi
shlokas.28:
manyate pApakaM kRRitvA na kashchidvetti mAmiti |
vidanti chainaM devAshcha svashchaivAntarapUruShaH
shlokas.29:
AdityachandrAvanilAnalau cha; dyaurbhUmirApo hRRidayaM yamashcha |
ahashcha rAtrishcha ubhe cha sandhye; dharmashcha jAnAti narasya vRRittam
shlokas.30:
yamo vaivasvatastasya niryAtayati duShkRRitam |
hRRidi sthitaH karmasAkShI kShetraj~no yasya tuShyati
shlokas.31:
na tu tuShyati yasyaiSha puruShasya durAtmanaH |
taM yamaH pApakarmANaM niryAtayati duShkRRitam
shlokas.32:
avamanyAtmanAtmAnamanyathA pratipadyate |
devA na tasya shreyA.nso yasyAtmApi na kAraNam
shlokas.33:
svayaM prApteti mAmevaM mAvama.nsthAH pativratAm |
arghyArhAM nArchayasi mAM svayaM bhAryAmupasthitAm
shlokas.34:
kimarthaM mAM prAkRRitavadupaprekShasi sa.nsadi |
na khalvahamidaM shUnye raumi kiM na shRRiNoShi me
shlokas.35:
yadi me yAchamAnAyA vachanaM na kariShyasi |
duHShanta shatadhA mUrdhA tataste.adya phaliShyati
shlokas.36:
bhAryAM patiH sampravishya sa yasmAjjAyate punaH |
jAyAyA iti jAyAtvaM purANAH kavayo viduH
shlokas.37:
yadAgamavataH pu.nsastadapatyaM prajAyate |
tattArayati santatyA pUrvapretAnpitAmahAn
shlokas.38:
punnAmno narakAdyasmAtpitaraM trAyate sutaH |
tasmAtputra iti proktaH svayameva svayambhuvA
shlokas.39:
sA bhAryA yA gRRihe dakShA sA bhAryA yA prajAvatI |
sA bhAryA yA patiprANA sA bhAryA yA pativratA
shlokas.40:
ardhaM bhAryA manuShyasya bhAryA shreShThatamaH sakhA |
bhAryA mUlaM trivargasya bhAryA mitraM mariShyataH
shlokas.41:
bhAryAvantaH kriyAvantaH sabhAryA gRRihamedhinaH |
bhAryAvantaH pramodante bhAryAvantaH shriyAnvitAH
shlokas.42:
sakhAyaH pravivikteShu bhavantyetAH priya.nvadAH |
pitaro dharmakAryeShu bhavantyArtasya mAtaraH
shlokas.43:
kAntAreShvapi vishrAmo narasyAdhvanikasya vai |
yaH sadAraH sa vishvAsyastasmAddArAH parA gatiH
shlokas.44:
sa.nsarantamapi pretaM viShameShvekapAtinam |
bhAryaivAnveti bhartAraM satataM yA pativratA
shlokas.45:
prathamaM sa.nsthitA bhAryA patiM pretya pratIkShate |
pUrvaM mRRitaM cha bhartAraM pashchAtsAdhvyanugachChati
shlokas.46:
etasmAtkAraNAdrAjanpANigrahaNamiShyate |
yadApnoti patirbhAryAmiha loke paratra cha
shlokas.47:
AtmAtmanaiva janitaH putra ityuchyate budhaiH |
tasmAdbhAryAM naraH pashyenmAtRRivatputramAtaram
shlokas.48:
bhAryAyAM janitaM putramAdarshe svamivAnanam |
hlAdate janitA preShkya svargaM prApyeva puNyakRRit
shlokas.49:
dahyamAnA manoduHkhairvyAdhibhishchAturA narAH |
hlAdante sveShu dAreShu gharmArtAH salileShviva
shlokas.50:
susa.nrabdho.api rAmANAM na brUyAdapriyaM budhaH |
ratiM prItiM cha dharmaM cha tAsvAyattamavekShya cha
shlokas.51:
Atmano janmanaH kShetraM puNyaM rAmAH sanAtanam |
RRiShINAmapi kA shaktiH sraShTuM rAmAmRRite prajAH
shlokas.52:
paripatya yadA sUnurdharaNIreNuguNThitaH |
piturAshliShyate.a~NgAni kimivAstyadhikaM tataH
shlokas.53:
sa tvaM svayamanuprAptaM sAbhilAShamimaM sutam |
prekShamANaM cha kAkSheNa kimarthamavamanyase
shlokas.54:
aNDAni bibhrati svAni na bhindanti pipIlikAH |
na bharethAH kathaM nu tvaM dharmaj~naH sansvamAtmajam
shlokas.55:
na vAsasAM na rAmANAM nApAM sparshastathA sukhaH |
shishorAli~NgyamAnasya sparshaH sUnoryathA sukhaH
shlokas.56:
brAhmaNo dvipadAM shreShTho gaurvariShThA chatuShpadAm |
gururgarIyasAM shreShThaH putraH sparshavatAM varaH
shlokas.57:
spRRishatu tvAM samAshliShya putro.ayaM priyadarshanaH |
putrasparshAtsukhataraH sparsho loke na vidyate
shlokas.58:
triShu varSheShu pUrNeShu prajAtAhamari.ndama |
imaM kumAraM rAjendra tava shokapraNAshanam
shlokas.59:
AhartA vAjimedhasya shatasa~Nkhyasya paurava |
iti vAgantarikShe mAM sUtake.abhyavadatpurA
shlokas.60:
nanu nAmA~NkamAropya snehAdgrAmAntaraM gatAH |
mUrdhni putrAnupAghrAya pratinandanti mAnavAH
shlokas.61:
vedeShvapi vadantImaM mantravAdaM dvijAtayaH |
jAtakarmaNi putrANAM tavApi viditaM tathA
shlokas.62:
a~NgAda~NgAtsambhavasi hRRidayAdabhijAyase |
AtmA vai putranAmAsi sa jIva sharadaH shatam
shlokas.63:
poSho hi tvadadhIno me santAnamapi chAkShayam |
tasmAttvaM jIva me vatsa susukhI sharadAM shatam
shlokas.64:
tvada~NgebhyaH prasUto.ayaM puruShAtpuruSho.aparaH |
sarasIvAmale.a.atmAnaM dvitIyaM pashya me sutam
shlokas.65:
yathA hyAhavanIyo.agnirgArhapatyAtpraNIyate |
tathA tvattaH prasUto.ayaM tvamekaH sandvidhA kRRitaH
shlokas.66:
mRRigApakRRiShTena hi te mRRigayAM paridhAvatA |
ahamAsAditA rAjankumArI piturAshrame
shlokas.67:
urvashI pUrvachittishcha sahajanyA cha menakA |
vishvAchI cha ghRRitAchI cha ShaDevApsarasAM varAH
shlokas.68:
tAsAM mAM menakA nAma brahmayonirvarApsarAH |
divaH samprApya jagatIM vishvAmitrAdajIjanat
shlokas.69:
sA mAM himavataH pRRiShThe suShuve menakApsarAH |
avakIrya cha mAM yAtA parAtmajamivAsatI
shlokas.70:
kiM nu karmAshubhaM pUrvaM kRRitavatyasmi janmani |
yadahaM bAndhavaistyaktA bAlye samprati cha tvayA
shlokas.71:
kAmaM tvayA parityaktA gamiShyAmyahamAshramam |
imaM tu bAlaM santyaktuM nArhasyAtmajamAtmanA
shlokas.72:
duHShanta uvAcha||
na putramabhijAnAmi tvayi jAtaM shakuntale |
asatyavachanA nAryaH kaste shraddhAsyate vachaH
shlokas.73:
menakA niranukroshA bandhakI jananI tava |
yayA himavataH pRRiShThe nirmAlyeva praveritA
shlokas.74:
sa chApi niranukroshaH kShatrayoniH pitA tava |
vishvAmitro brAhmaNatve lubdhaH kAmaparAyaNaH
shlokas.75:
menakApsarasAM shreShThA maharShINAM cha te pitA |
tayorapatyaM kasmAttvaM pu.nshchalIvAbhidhAsyasi
shlokas.76:
ashraddheyamidaM vAkyaM kathayantI na lajjase |
visheShato matsakAshe duShTatApasi gamyatAm
shlokas.77:
kva maharShiH sadaivograH sApsarA kva cha menakA |
kva cha tvamevaM kRRipaNA tApasIveShadhAriNI
shlokas.78:
atikAyashcha putraste bAlo.api balavAnayam |
kathamalpena kAlena shAlaskandha ivodgataH
shlokas.79:
sunikRRiShTA cha yoniste pu.nshchalI pratibhAsi me |
yadRRichChayA kAmarAgAjjAtA menakayA hyasi
shlokas.80:
sarvametatparokShaM me yattvaM vadasi tApasi |
nAhaM tvAmabhijAnAmi yatheShTaM gamyatAM tvayA

shlokas.1:
shakuntalovAcha||
rAjansarShapamAtrANi parachChidrANi pashyasi |
Atmano bilvamAtrANi pashyannapi na pashyasi
shlokas.2:
menakA tridasheShveva tridashAshchAnu menakAm |
mamaivodrichyate janma duHShanta tava janmataH
shlokas.3:
kShitAvaTasi rAja.nstvamantarikShe charAmyaham |
AvayorantaraM pashya merusarShapayoriva
shlokas.4:
mahendrasya kuberasya yamasya varuNasya cha |
bhavanAnyanusa.nyAmi prabhAvaM pashya me nRRipa
shlokas.5:
satyashchApi pravAdo.ayaM yaM pravakShyAmi te.anagha |
nidarshanArthaM na dveShAttachChrutvA kShantumarhasi
shlokas.6:
virUpo yAvadAdarshe nAtmanaH pashyate mukham |
manyate tAvadAtmAnamanyebhyo rUpavattaram
shlokas.7:
yadA tu mukhamAdarshe vikRRitaM so.abhivIkShate |
tadetaraM vijAnAti AtmAnaM netaraM janam
shlokas.8:
atIva rUpasampanno na ki~nchidavamanyate |
atIva jalpandurvAcho bhavatIha viheThakaH
shlokas.9:
mUrkho hi jalpatAM pu.nsAM shrutvA vAchaH shubhAshubhAH |
ashubhaM vAkyamAdatte purIShamiva sUkaraH
shlokas.10:
prAj~nastu jalpatAM pu.nsAM shrutvA vAchaH shubhAshubhAH |
guNavadvAkyamAdatte ha.nsaH kShIramivAmbhasaH
shlokas.11:
anyAnparivadansAdhuryathA hi paritapyate |
tathA parivadannanyA.nstuShTo bhavati durjanaH
shlokas.12:
abhivAdya yathA vRRiddhAnsanto gachChanti nirvRRitim |
evaM sajjanamAkrushya mUrkho bhavati nirvRRitaH
shlokas.13:
sukhaM jIvantyadoShaj~nA mUrkhA doShAnudarshinaH |
yatra vAchyAH paraiH santaH parAnAhustathAvidhAn
shlokas.14:
ato hAsyataraM loke ki~nchidanyanna vidyate |
yatra durjana ityAha durjanaH sajjanaM svayam
shlokas.15:
satyadharmachyutAtpu.nsaH kruddhAdAshIviShAdiva |
anAstiko.apyudvijate janaH kiM punarAstikaH
shlokas.16:
svayamutpAdya vai putraM sadRRishaM yo.avamanyate |
tasya devAH shriyaM ghnanti na cha lokAnupAshnute
shlokas.17:
kulava.nshapratiShThAM hi pitaraH putramabruvan |
uttamaM sarvadharmANAM tasmAtputraM na santyajet
shlokas.18:
svapatnIprabhavAnpa~ncha labdhAnkrItAnvivardhitAn |
kRRitAnanyAsu chotpannAnputrAnvai manurabravIt
shlokas.19:
dharmakIrtyAvahA nRRiNAM manasaH prItivardhanAH |
trAyante narakAjjAtAH putrA dharmaplavAH pitRRin
shlokas.20:
sa tvaM nRRipatishArdUla na putraM tyaktumarhasi |
AtmAnaM satyadharmau cha pAlayAno mahIpate
narendrasiMha kapaTaM na voDhuM tvamihArhasi
shlokas.21:
varaM kUpashatAdvApI varaM vApIshatAtkratuH |
varaM kratushatAtputraH satyaM putrashatAdvaram
shlokas.22:
ashvamedhasahasraM cha satyaM cha tulayA dhRRitam |
ashvamedhasahasrAddhi satyameva vishiShyate
shlokas.23:
sarvavedAdhigamanaM sarvatIrthAvagAhanam |
satyaM cha vadato rAjansamaM vA syAnna vA samam
shlokas.24:
nAsti satyAtparo dharmo na satyAdvidyate param |
na hi tIvrataraM ki~nchidanRRitAdiha vidyate
shlokas.25:
rAjansatyaM paraM brahma satyaM cha samayaH paraH |
mA tyAkShIH samayaM rAjansatyaM sa~Ngatamastu te
shlokas.26:
anRRite chetprasa~Ngaste shraddadhAsi na chetsvayam |
Atmano hanta gachChAmi tvAdRRishe nAsti sa~Ngatam
shlokas.27:
RRite.api tvayi duHShanta shailarAjAvata.nsakAm |
chaturantAmimAmurvIM putro me pAlayiShyati
shlokas.28:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etAvaduktvA vachanaM prAtiShThata shakuntalA |
athAntarikShe duHShantaM vAguvAchAsharIriNI
RRitvikpurohitAchAryairmantribhishchAvRRitaM tadA
shlokas.29:
bhastrA mAtA pituH putro yena jAtaH sa eva saH |
bharasva putraM duHShanta mAvama.nsthAH shakuntalAm
shlokas.30:
retodhAH putra unnayati naradeva yamakShayAt |
tvaM chAsya dhAtA garbhasya satyamAha shakuntalA
shlokas.31:
jAyA janayate putramAtmano.a~NgaM dvidhA kRRitam |
tasmAdbharasva duHShanta putraM shAkuntalaM nRRipa
shlokas.32:
abhUtireShA kastyajyAjjIva~njIvantamAtmajam |
shAkuntalaM mahAtmAnaM dauHShantiM bhara paurava
shlokas.33:
bhartavyo.ayaM tvayA yasmAdasmAkaM vachanAdapi |
tasmAdbhavatvayaM nAmnA bharato nAma te sutaH
shlokas.34:
tachChrutvA pauravo rAjA vyAhRRitaM vai divaukasAm |
purohitamamAtyA.nshcha samprahRRiShTo.abravIdidam
shlokas.35:
shRRiNvantvetadbhavanto.asya devadUtasya bhAShitam |
ahamapyevamevainaM jAnAmi svayamAtmajam
shlokas.36:
yadyahaM vachanAdeva gRRihNIyAmimamAtmajam |
bhaveddhi sha~NkA lokasya naivaM shuddho bhavedayam
shlokas.37:
taM vishodhya tadA rAjA devadUtena bhArata |
hRRiShTaH pramuditashchApi pratijagrAha taM sutam
shlokas.38:
mUrdhni chainamupAghrAya sasnehaM pariShasvaje |
sabhAjyamAno vipraishcha stUyamAnashcha bandibhiH
sa mudaM paramAM lebhe putrasa.nsparshajAM nRRipaH
shlokas.39:
tAM chaiva bhAryAM dharmaj~naH pUjayAmAsa dharmataH |
abravIchchaiva tAM rAjA sAntvapUrvamidaM vachaH
shlokas.40:
kRRito lokaparokSho.ayaM sambandho vai tvayA saha |
tasmAdetanmayA devi tvachChuddhyarthaM vichAritam
shlokas.41:
manyate chaiva lokaste strIbhAvAnmayi sa~Ngatam |
putrashchAyaM vRRito rAjye mayA tasmAdvichAritam
shlokas.42:
yachcha kopitayAtyarthaM tvayokto.asmyapriyaM priye |
praNayinyA vishAlAkShi tatkShAntaM te mayA shubhe
shlokas.43:
tAmevamuktvA rAjarShirduHShanto mahiShIM priyAm |
vAsobhirannapAnaishcha pUjayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.44:
duHShantashcha tato rAjA putraM shAkuntalaM tadA |
bharataM nAmataH kRRitvA yauvarAjye.abhyaShechayat
shlokas.45:
tasya tatprathitaM chakraM prAvartata mahAtmanaH |
bhAsvaraM divyamajitaM lokasaMnAdanaM mahat
shlokas.46:
sa vijitya mahIpAlA.nshchakAra vashavartinaH |
chachAra cha satAM dharmaM prApa chAnuttamaM yashaH
shlokas.47:
sa rAjA chakravartyAsItsArvabhaumaH pratApavAn |
Ije cha bahubhiryaj~nairyathA shakro marutpatiH
shlokas.48:
yAjayAmAsa taM kaNvo dakShavadbhUridakShiNam |
shrImAngovitataM nAma vAjimedhamavApa saH
yasminsahasraM padmAnAM kaNvAya bharato dadau
shlokas.49:
bharatAdbhAratI kIrtiryenedaM bhArataM kulam |
apare ye cha pUrve cha bhAratA iti vishrutAH
shlokas.50:
bharatasyAnvavAye hi devakalpA mahaujasaH |
babhUvurbrahmakalpAshcha bahavo rAjasattamAH
shlokas.51:
yeShAmaparimeyAni nAmadheyAni sarvashaH |
teShAM tu te yathAmukhyaM kIrtayiShyAmi bhArata
mahAbhAgAndevakalpAnsatyArjavaparAyaNAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
prajApatestu dakShasya manorvaivasvatasya cha |
bharatasya kuroH pUrorajamIDhasya chAnvaye
shlokas.2:
yAdavAnAmimaM va.nshaM pauravANAM cha sarvashaH |
tathaiva bhAratAnAM cha puNyaM svastyayanaM mahat
dhanyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM kIrtayiShyAmi te.anagha
shlokas.3:
tejobhiruditAH sarve maharShisamatejasaH |
dasha prachetasaH putrAH santaH pUrvajanAH smRRitAH
meghajenAgninA ye te pUrvaM dagdhA mahaujasaH
shlokas.4:
tebhyaH prAchetaso jaj~ne dakSho dakShAdimAH prajAH |
sambhUtAH puruShavyAghra sa hi lokapitAmahaH
shlokas.5:
vIriNyA saha sa~Ngamya dakShaH prAchetaso muniH |
AtmatulyAnajanayatsahasraM sa.nshitavratAn
shlokas.6:
sahasrasa~NkhyAnsamitAnsutAndakShasya nAradaH |
mokShamadhyApayAmAsa sA~Nkhyaj~nAnamanuttamam
shlokas.7:
tataH pa~nchAshataM kanyAH putrikA abhisa.ndadhe |
prajApatiH prajA dakShaH sisRRikShurjanamejaya
shlokas.8:
dadau sa dasha dharmAya kashyapAya trayodasha |
kAlasya nayane yuktAH saptavi.nshatimindave
shlokas.9:
trayodashAnAM patnInAM yA tu dAkShAyaNI varA |
mArIchaH kashyapastasyAmAdityAnsamajIjanat
indrAdInvIryasampannAnvivasvantamathApi cha
shlokas.10:
vivasvataH suto jaj~ne yamo vaivasvataH prabhuH |
mArtaNDashcha yamasyApi putro rAjannajAyata
shlokas.11:
mArtaNDasya manurdhImAnajAyata sutaH prabhuH |
manorva.nsho mAnavAnAM tato.ayaM prathito.abhavat
brahmakShatrAdayastasmAnmanorjAtAstu mAnavAH
shlokas.12:
tatrAbhavattadA rAjanbrahma kShatreNa sa~Ngatam |
brAhmaNA mAnavAsteShAM sA~NgaM vedamadIdharan
shlokas.13:
venaM dhRRiShNuM nariShyantaM nAbhAgekShvAkumeva cha |
karUShamatha sharyAtiM tathaivAtrAShTamImilAm
shlokas.14:
pRRiShadhranavamAnAhuH kShatradharmaparAyaNAn |
nAbhAgAriShTadashamAnmanoH putrAnmahAbalAn
shlokas.15:
pa~nchAshataM manoH putrAstathaivAnye.abhavankShitau |
anyonyabhedAtte sarve vineshuriti naH shrutam
shlokas.16:
purUravAstato vidvAnilAyAM samapadyata |
sA vai tasyAbhavanmAtA pitA cheti hi naH shrutam
shlokas.17:
trayodasha samudrasya dvIpAnashnanpurUravAH |
amAnuShairvRRitaH sattvairmAnuShaH sanmahAyashAH
shlokas.18:
vipraiH sa vigrahaM chakre vIryonmattaH purUravAH |
jahAra cha sa viprANAM ratnAnyutkroshatAmapi
shlokas.19:
sanatkumArastaM rAjanbrahmalokAdupetya ha |
anudarshayAM tatashchakre pratyagRRihNAnna chApyasau
shlokas.20:
tato maharShibhiH kruddhaiH shaptaH sadyo vyanashyata |
lobhAnvito madabalAnnaShTasa~nj~no narAdhipaH
shlokas.21:
sa hi gandharvalokastha urvashyA sahito virAT |
AninAya kriyArthe.agnInyathAvadvihitA.nstridhA
shlokas.22:
ShaTputrA jaj~nire.athailAdAyurdhImAnamAvasuH |
dRRiDhAyushcha vanAyushcha shrutAyushchorvashIsutAH
shlokas.23:
nahuShaM vRRiddhasharmANaM rajiM rambhamanenasam |
svarbhAnavIsutAnetAnAyoH putrAnprachakShate
shlokas.24:
AyuSho nahuShaH putro dhImAnsatyaparAkramaH |
rAjyaM shashAsa sumahaddharmeNa pRRithivIpatiH
shlokas.25:
pitRRindevAnRRiShInviprAngandharvoragarAkShasAn |
nahuShaH pAlayAmAsa brahmakShatramatho vishaH
shlokas.26:
sa hatvA dasyusa~NghAtAnRRiShInkaramadApayat |
pashuvachchaiva tAnpRRiShThe vAhayAmAsa vIryavAn
shlokas.27:
kArayAmAsa chendratvamabhibhUya divaukasaH |
tejasA tapasA chaiva vikrameNaujasA tathA
shlokas.28:
yatiM yayAtiM sa.nyAtimAyAtiM pA~nchamuddhavam |
nahuSho janayAmAsa ShaTputrAnpriyavAsasi
shlokas.29:
yayAtirnAhuShaH samrADAsItsatyaparAkramaH |
sa pAlayAmAsa mahImIje cha vividhaiH savaiH
shlokas.30:
atishaktyA pitRRinarchandevA.nshcha prayataH sadA |
anvagRRihNAtprajAH sarvA yayAtiraparAjitaH
shlokas.31:
tasya putrA maheShvAsAH sarvaiH samuditA guNaiH |
devayAnyAM mahArAja sharmiShThAyAM cha jaj~nire
shlokas.32:
devayAnyAmajAyetAM yadusturvasureva cha |
druhyushchAnushcha pUrushcha sharmiShThAyAM prajaj~nire
shlokas.33:
sa shAshvatIH samA rAjanprajA dharmeNa pAlayan |
jarAmArChanmahAghorAM nAhuSho rUpanAshinIm
shlokas.34:
jarAbhibhUtaH putrAnsa rAjA vachanamabravIt |
yaduM pUruM turvasuM cha druhyuM chAnuM cha bhArata
shlokas.35:
yauvanena charankAmAnyuvA yuvatibhiH saha |
vihartumahamichChAmi sAhyaM kuruta putrakAH
shlokas.36:
taM putro devayAneyaH pUrvajo yadurabravIt |
kiM kAryaM bhavataH kAryamasmAbhiryauvanena cha
shlokas.37:
yayAtirabravIttaM vai jarA me pratigRRihyatAm |
yauvanena tvadIyena chareyaM viShayAnaham
shlokas.38:
yajato dIrghasatrairme shApAchchoshanaso muneH |
kAmArthaH parihINo me tapye.ahaM tena putrakAH
shlokas.39:
mAmakena sharIreNa rAjyamekaH prashAstu vaH |
ahaM tanvAbhinavayA yuvA kAmAnavApnuyAm
shlokas.40:
na te tasya pratyagRRihNanyaduprabhRRitayo jarAm |
tamabravIttataH pUruH kanIyAnsatyavikramaH
shlokas.41:
rAja.nshcharAbhinavayA tanvA yauvanagocharaH |
ahaM jarAM samAsthAya rAjye sthAsyAmi te.a.aj~nayA
shlokas.42:
evamuktaH sa rAjarShistapovIryasamAshrayAt |
sa~nchArayAmAsa jarAM tadA putre mahAtmani
shlokas.43:
pauraveNAtha vayasA rAjA yauvanamAsthitaH |
yAyAtenApi vayasA rAjyaM pUrurakArayat
shlokas.44:
tato varShasahasrAnte yayAtiraparAjitaH |
atRRipta eva kAmAnAM pUruM putramuvAcha ha
shlokas.45:
tvayA dAyAdavAnasmi tvaM me va.nshakaraH sutaH |
pauravo va.nsha iti te khyAtiM loke gamiShyati
shlokas.46:
tataH sa nRRipashArdUlaH pUruM rAjye.abhiShichya cha |
kAlena mahatA pashchAtkAladharmamupeyivAn

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
yayAtiH pUrvako.asmAkaM dashamo yaH prajApateH |
kathaM sa shukratanayAM lebhe paramadurlabhAm
shlokas.2:
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM vistareNa dvijottama |
AnupUrvyA cha me sha.nsa pUrorva.nshakarAnpRRithak
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yayAtirAsIdrAjarShirdevarAjasamadyutiH |
taM shukravRRiShaparvANau vavrAte vai yathA purA
shlokas.4:
tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi pRRichChato janamejaya |
devayAnyAshcha sa.nyogaM yayAternAhuShasya cha
shlokas.5:
surANAmasurANAM cha samajAyata vai mithaH |
aishvaryaM prati sa~NgharShastrailokye sacharAchare
shlokas.6:
jigIShayA tato devA vavrire.a.a~NgirasaM munim |
paurohityena yAjyArthe kAvyaM tUshanasaM pare
brAhmaNau tAvubhau nityamanyonyaspardhinau bhRRisham
shlokas.7:
tatra devA nijaghnuryAndAnavAnyudhi sa~NgatAn |
tAnpunarjIvayAmAsa kAvyo vidyAbalAshrayAt
tataste punarutthAya yodhayAM chakrire surAn
shlokas.8:
asurAstu nijaghnuryAnsurAnsamaramUrdhani |
na tAnsa~njIvayAmAsa bRRihaspatirudAradhIH
shlokas.9:
na hi veda sa tAM vidyAM yAM kAvyo veda vIryavAn |
sa~njIvanIM tato devA viShAdamagamanparam
shlokas.10:
te tu devA bhayodvignAH kAvyAdushanasastadA |
UchuH kachamupAgamya jyeShThaM putraM bRRihaspateH
shlokas.11:
bhajamAnAnbhajasvAsmAnkuru naH sAhyamuttamam |
yAsau vidyA nivasati brAhmaNe.amitatejasi
shukre tAmAhara kShipraM bhAgabhA~Nno bhaviShyasi
shlokas.12:
vRRiShaparvasamIpe sa shakyo draShTuM tvayA dvijaH |
rakShate dAnavA.nstatra na sa rakShatyadAnavAn
shlokas.13:
tamArAdhayituM shakto bhavAnpUrvavayAH kavim |
devayAnIM cha dayitAM sutAM tasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.14:
tvamArAdhayituM shakto nAnyaH kashchana vidyate |
shIladAkShiNyamAdhuryairAchAreNa damena cha
devayAnyAM hi tuShTAyAM vidyAM tAM prApsyasi dhruvam
shlokas.15:
tathetyuktvA tataH prAyAdbRRihaspatisutaH kachaH |
tadAbhipUjito devaiH samIpaM vRRiShaparvaNaH
shlokas.16:
sa gatvA tvarito rAjandevaiH sampreShitaH kachaH |
asurendrapure shukraM dRRiShTvA vAkyamuvAcha ha
shlokas.17:
RRiShera~NgirasaH pautraM putraM sAkShAdbRRihaspateH |
nAmnA kacha iti khyAtaM shiShyaM gRRihNAtu mAM bhavAn
shlokas.18:
brahmacharyaM chariShyAmi tvayyahaM paramaM gurau |
anumanyasva mAM brahmansahasraM parivatsarAn
shlokas.19:
shukra uvAcha||
kacha susvAgataM te.astu pratigRRihNAmi te vachaH |
archayiShye.ahamarchyaM tvAmarchito.astu bRRihaspatiH
shlokas.20:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kachastu taM tathetyuktvA pratijagrAha tadvratam |
AdiShTaM kaviputreNa shukreNoshanasA svayam
shlokas.21:
vratasya vratakAlaM sa yathoktaM pratyagRRihNata |
ArAdhayannupAdhyAyaM devayAnIM cha bhArata
shlokas.22:
nityamArAdhayiShya.nstAM yuvA yauvanago.a.amukhe |
gAyannRRityanvAdaya.nshcha devayAnImatoShayat
shlokas.23:
sa.nshIlayandevayAnIM kanyAM samprAptayauvanAm |
puShpaiH phalaiH preShaNaishcha toShayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.24:
devayAnyapi taM vipraM niyamavratachAriNam |
anugAyamAnA lalanA rahaH paryacharattadA
shlokas.25:
pa~ncha varShashatAnyevaM kachasya charato vratam |
tatrAtIyuratho buddhvA dAnavAstaM tataH kacham
shlokas.26:
gA rakShantaM vane dRRiShTvA rahasyekamamarShitAH |
jaghnurbRRihaspaterdveShAdvidyArakShArthameva cha
hatvA shAlAvRRikebhyashcha prAyachCha.nstilashaH kRRitam
shlokas.27:
tato gAvo nivRRittAstA agopAH svaM niveshanam |
tA dRRiShTvA rahitA gAstu kachenAbhyAgatA vanAt
uvAcha vachanaM kAle devayAnyatha bhArata
shlokas.28:
ahutaM chAgnihotraM te sUryashchAstaM gataH prabho |
agopAshchAgatA gAvaH kachastAta na dRRishyate
shlokas.29:
vyaktaM hato mRRito vApi kachastAta bhaviShyati |
taM vinA na cha jIveyaM kachaM satyaM bravImi te
shlokas.31:
shukra uvAcha||
ayamehIti shabdena mRRitaM sa~njIvayAmyaham |
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sa~njIvanIM vidyAM prayujya kachamAhvayat |
AhUtaH prAdurabhavatkacho.ariShTo.atha vidyayA
hato.ahamiti chAchakhyau pRRiShTo brAhmaNakanyayA
shlokas.32:
sa punardevayAnyoktaH puShpAhAro yadRRichChayA |
vanaM yayau tato vipro dadRRishurdAnavAshcha tam
shlokas.33:
tato dvitIyaM hatvA taM dagdhvA kRRitvA cha chUrNashaH |
prAyachChanbrAhmaNAyaiva surAyAmasurAstadA
shlokas.34:
devayAnyatha bhUyo.api vAkyaM pitaramabravIt |
puShpAhAraH preShaNakRRitkachastAta na dRRishyate
shlokas.35:
shukra uvAcha||
bRRihaspateH sutaH putri kachaH pretagatiM gataH |
vidyayA jIvito.apyevaM hanyate karavANi kim
shlokas.36:
maivaM shucho mA ruda devayAni; na tvAdRRishI martyamanuprashochet |
surAshcha vishve cha jagachcha sarva;mupasthitAM vaikRRitimAnamanti
shlokas.37:
devayAnyuvAcha||
yasyA~NgirA vRRiddhatamaH pitAmaho; bRRihaspatishchApi pitA tapodhanaH |
RRiSheH putraM tamatho vApi pautraM; kathaM na shocheyamahaM na rudyAm
shlokas.38:
sa brahmachArI cha tapodhanashcha; sadotthitaH karmasu chaiva dakShaH |
kachasya mArgaM pratipatsye na bhokShye; priyo hi me tAta kacho.abhirUpaH
shlokas.39:
shukra uvAcha||
asa.nshayaM mAmasurA dviShanti; ye me shiShyaM nAgasaM sUdayanti |
abrAhmaNaM kartumichChanti raudrA;ste mAM yathA prastutaM dAnavairhi
apyasya pApasya bhavedihAntaH; kaM brahmahatyA na dahedapIndram
shlokas.40:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa~nchodito devayAnyA maharShiH punarAhvayat |
sa.nrambheNaiva kAvyo hi bRRihaspatisutaM kacham
shlokas.41:
gurorbhIto vidyayA chopahUtaH; shanairvAchaM jaThare vyAjahAra |
tamabravItkena pathopanIto; mamodare tiShThasi brUhi vipra
shlokas.42:
kacha uvAcha||
bhavatprasAdAnna jahAti mAM smRRitiH; smare cha sarvaM yachcha yathA cha vRRittam |
na tvevaM syAttapaso vyayo me; tataH kleshaM ghoramimaM sahAmi
shlokas.43:
asuraiH surAyAM bhavato.asmi datto; hatvA dagdhvA chUrNayitvA cha kAvya |
brAhmIM mAyAmAsurI chaiva mAyA; tvayi sthite kathamevAtivartet
shlokas.44:
shukra uvAcha||
kiM te priyaM karavANyadya vatse; vadhena me jIvitaM syAtkachasya |
nAnyatra kukShermama bhedanena; dRRishyetkacho madgato devayAni
shlokas.45:
devayAnyuvAcha||
dvau mAM shokAvagnikalpau dahetAM; kachasya nAshastava chaivopaghAtaH |
kachasya nAshe mama nAsti sharma; tavopaghAte jIvituM nAsmi shaktA
shlokas.46:
shukra uvAcha||
sa.nsiddharUpo.asi bRRihaspateH suta; yattvAM bhaktaM bhajate devayAnI |
vidyAmimAM prApnuhi jIvanIM tvaM; na chedindraH kacharUpI tvamadya
shlokas.47:
na nivartetpunarjIvankashchidanyo mamodarAt |
brAhmaNaM varjayitvaikaM tasmAdvidyAmavApnuhi
shlokas.48:
putro bhUtvA bhAvaya bhAvito mA;masmAddehAdupaniShkramya tAta |
samIkShethA dharmavatImavekShAM; guroH sakAshAtprApya vidyAM savidyaH
shlokas.49:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
guroH sakAshAtsamavApya vidyAM; bhittvA kukShiM nirvichakrAma vipraH |
kacho.abhirUpo dakShiNaM brAhmaNasya; shuklAtyaye paurNamAsyAmivenduH
shlokas.50:
dRRiShTvA cha taM patitaM brahmarAshi;mutthApayAmAsa mRRitaM kacho.api |
vidyAM siddhAM tAmavApyAbhivAdya; tataH kachastaM gurumityuvAcha
shlokas.51:
RRitasya dAtAramanuttamasya; nidhiM nidhInAM chaturanvayAnAm |
ye nAdriyante gurumarchanIyaM; pApA.NllokA.nste vrajantyapratiShThAn
shlokas.52:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
surApAnAdva~nchanAM prApayitvA; sa~nj~nAnAshaM chaiva tathAtighoram |
dRRiShTvA kachaM chApi tathAbhirUpaM; pItaM tadA surayA mohitena
shlokas.53:
samanyurutthAya mahAnubhAva;stadoshanA viprahitaM chikIrShuH |
kAvyaH svayaM vAkyamidaM jagAda; surApAnaM prati vai jAtasha~NkaH
shlokas.54:
yo brAhmaNo.adya prabhRRitIha kashchi;nmohAtsurAM pAsyati mandabuddhiH |
apetadharmo brahmahA chaiva sa syA;dasmi.Nlloke garhitaH syAtpare cha
shlokas.55:
mayA chemAM vipradharmoktisImAM; maryAdAM vai sthApitAM sarvaloke |
santo viprAH shushruvA.nso gurUNAM; devA lokAshchopashRRiNvantu sarve
shlokas.56:
itIdamuktvA sa mahAnubhAva;staponidhInAM nidhiraprameyaH |
tAndAnavAndaivavimUDhabuddhI;nidaM samAhUya vacho.abhyuvAcha
shlokas.57:
AchakShe vo dAnavA bAlishAH stha; siddhaH kacho vatsyati matsakAshe |
sa~njIvanIM prApya vidyAM mahArthAM; tulyaprabhAvo brahmaNA brahmabhUtaH
shlokas.58:
guroruShya sakAshe tu dasha varShashatAni saH |
anuj~nAtaH kacho gantumiyeSha tridashAlayam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
samAvRRittavrataM taM tu visRRiShTaM guruNA tadA |
prasthitaM tridashAvAsaM devayAnyabravIdidam
shlokas.2:
RRiShera~NgirasaH pautra vRRittenAbhijanena cha |
bhrAjase vidyayA chaiva tapasA cha damena cha
shlokas.3:
RRiShiryathA~NgirA mAnyaH piturmama mahAyashAH |
tathA mAnyashcha pUjyashcha bhUyo mama bRRihaspatiH
shlokas.4:
evaM j~nAtvA vijAnIhi yadbravImi tapodhana |
vratasthe niyamopete yathA vartAmyahaM tvayi
shlokas.5:
sa samAvRRittavidyo mAM bhaktAM bhajitumarhasi |
gRRihANa pANiM vidhivanmama mantrapuraskRRitam
shlokas.6:
kacha uvAcha||
pUjyo mAnyashcha bhagavAnyathA tava pitA mama |
tathA tvamanavadyA~Ngi pUjanIyatarA mama
shlokas.7:
AtmaprANaiH priyatamA bhArgavasya mahAtmanaH |
tvaM bhadre dharmataH pUjyA guruputrI sadA mama
shlokas.8:
yathA mama gururnityaM mAnyaH shukraH pitA tava |
devayAni tathaiva tvaM naivaM mAM vaktumarhasi
shlokas.9:
devayAnyuvAcha||
guruputrasya putro vai na tu tvamasi me pituH |
tasmAnmAnyashcha pUjyashcha mamApi tvaM dvijottama
shlokas.10:
asurairhanyamAne cha kacha tvayi punaH punaH |
tadA prabhRRiti yA prItistAM tvameva smarasva me
shlokas.11:
sauhArde chAnurAge cha vettha me bhaktimuttamAm |
na mAmarhasi dharmaj~na tyaktuM bhaktAmanAgasam
shlokas.12:
kacha uvAcha||
aniyojye niyoge mAM niyunakShi shubhavrate |
prasIda subhru tvaM mahyaM gurorgurutarI shubhe
shlokas.13:
yatroShitaM vishAlAkShi tvayA chandranibhAnane |
tatrAhamuShito bhadre kukShau kAvyasya bhAmini
shlokas.14:
bhaginI dharmato me tvaM maivaM vochaH shubhAnane |
sukhamasmyuShito bhadre na manyurvidyate mama
shlokas.15:
ApRRichChe tvAM gamiShyAmi shivamAsha.nsa me pathi |
avirodhena dharmasya smartavyo.asmi kathAntare
apramattotthitA nityamArAdhaya guruM mama
shlokas.16:
devayAnyuvAcha||
yadi mAM dharmakAmArthe pratyAkhyAsyasi choditaH |
tataH kacha na te vidyA siddhimeShA gamiShyati
shlokas.17:
kacha uvAcha||
guruputrIti kRRitvAhaM pratyAchakShe na doShataH |
guruNA chAbhyanuj~nAtaH kAmamevaM shapasva mAm
shlokas.18:
ArShaM dharmaM bruvANo.ahaM devayAni yathA tvayA |
shapto nArho.asmi shApasya kAmato.adya na dharmataH
shlokas.19:
tasmAdbhavatyA yaH kAmo na tathA sa bhaviShyati |
RRiShiputro na te kashchijjAtu pANiM grahIShyati
shlokas.20:
phaliShyati na te vidyA yattvaM mAmAttha tattathA |
adhyApayiShyAmi tu yaM tasya vidyA phaliShyati
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA dvijashreShTho devayAnIM kachastadA |
tridasheshAlayaM shIghraM jagAma dvijasattamaH
shlokas.22:
tamAgatamabhiprekShya devA indrapurogamAH |
bRRihaspatiM sabhAjyedaM kachamAhurmudAnvitAH
shlokas.23:
yattvamasmaddhitaM karma chakartha paramAdbhutam |
na te yashaH praNashitA bhAgabhA~Nno bhaviShyasi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kRRitavidye kache prApte hRRiShTarUpA divaukasaH |
kachAdadhItya tAM vidyAM kRRitArthA bharatarShabha
shlokas.2:
sarva eva samAgamya shatakratumathAbruvan |
kAlaste vikramasyAdya jahi shatrUnpura.ndara
shlokas.3:
evamuktastu sahitaistridashairmaghavA.nstadA |
tathetyuktvopachakrAma so.apashyata vane striyaH
shlokas.4:
krIDantInAM tu kanyAnAM vane chaitrarathopame |
vAyubhUtaH sa vastrANi sarvANyeva vyamishrayat
shlokas.5:
tato jalAtsamuttIrya kanyAstAH sahitAstadA |
vastrANi jagRRihustAni yathAsannAnyanekashaH
shlokas.6:
tatra vAso devayAnyAH sharmiShThA jagRRihe tadA |
vyatimishramajAnantI duhitA vRRiShaparvaNaH
shlokas.7:
tatastayormithastatra virodhaH samajAyata |
devayAnyAshcha rAjendra sharmiShThAyAshcha tatkRRite
shlokas.8:
devayAnyuvAcha||
kasmAdgRRihNAsi me vastraM shiShyA bhUtvA mamAsuri |
samudAchArahInAyA na te shreyo bhaviShyati
shlokas.9:
sharmiShThovAcha||
AsInaM cha shayAnaM cha pitA te pitaraM mama |
stauti vandati chAbhIkShNaM nIchaiH sthitvA vinItavat
shlokas.10:
yAchatastvaM hi duhitA stuvataH pratigRRihNataH |
sutAhaM stUyamAnasya dadato.apratigRRihNataH
shlokas.11:
anAyudhA sAyudhAyA riktA kShubhyasi bhikShuki |
lapsyase pratiyoddhAraM na hi tvAM gaNayAmyaham
shlokas.12:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
samuchChrayaM devayAnIM gatAM saktAM cha vAsasi |
sharmiShThA prAkShipatkUpe tataH svapuramAvrajat
shlokas.13:
hateyamiti vij~nAya sharmiShThA pApanishchayA |
anavekShya yayau veshma krodhavegaparAyaNA
shlokas.14:
atha taM deshamabhyAgAdyayAtirnahuShAtmajaH |
shrAntayugyaH shrAntahayo mRRigalipsuH pipAsitaH
shlokas.15:
sa nAhuShaH prekShamANa udapAnaM gatodakam |
dadarsha kanyAM tAM tatra dIptAmagnishikhAmiva
shlokas.16:
tAmapRRichChatsa dRRiShTvaiva kanyAmamaravarNinIm |
sAntvayitvA nRRipashreShThaH sAmnA paramavalgunA
shlokas.17:
kA tvaM tAmranakhI shyAmA sumRRiShTamaNikuNDalA |
dIrghaM dhyAyasi chAtyarthaM kasmAchChvasiShi chAturA
shlokas.18:
kathaM cha patitAsyasminkUpe vIruttRRiNAvRRite |
duhitA chaiva kasya tvaM vada sarvaM sumadhyame
shlokas.19:
devayAnyuvAcha||
yo.asau devairhatAndaityAnutthApayati vidyayA |
tasya shukrasya kanyAhaM sa mAM nUnaM na budhyate
shlokas.20:
eSha me dakShiNo rAjanpANistAmranakhA~NguliH |
samuddhara gRRihItvA mAM kulInastvaM hi me mataH
shlokas.21:
jAnAmi hi tvAM sa.nshAntaM vIryavantaM yashasvinam |
tasmAnmAM patitAmasmAtkUpAduddhartumarhasi
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tAmatha brAhmaNIM strIM cha vij~nAya nahuShAtmajaH |
gRRihItvA dakShiNe pANAvujjahAra tato.avaTAt
shlokas.23:
uddhRRitya chainAM tarasA tasmAtkUpAnnarAdhipaH |
AmantrayitvA sushroNIM yayAtiH svapuraM yayau
shlokas.24:
devayAnyuvAcha||
tvaritaM ghUrNike gachCha sarvamAchakShva me pituH |
nedAnIM hi pravekyAmi nagaraM vRRiShaparvaNaH
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sA tu vai tvaritaM gatvA ghUrNikAsuramandiram |
dRRiShTvA kAvyamuvAchedaM sambhramAviShTachetanA
shlokas.26:
AchakShe te mahAprAj~na devayAnI vane hatA |
sharmiShThayA mahAbhAga duhitrA vRRiShaparvaNaH
shlokas.27:
shrutvA duhitaraM kAvyastatra sharmiShThayA hatAm |
tvarayA niryayau duHkhAnmArgamANaH sutAM vane
shlokas.28:
dRRiShTvA duhitaraM kAvyo devayAnIM tato vane |
bAhubhyAM sampariShvajya duHkhito vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.29:
AtmadoShairniyachChanti sarve duHkhasukhe janAH |
manye dushcharitaM te.asti yasyeyaM niShkRRitiH kRRitA
shlokas.30:
devayAnyuvAcha||
niShkRRitirme.astu vA mAstu shRRiNuShvAvahito mama |
sharmiShThayA yaduktAsmi duhitrA vRRiShaparvaNaH
satyaM kilaitatsA prAha daityAnAmasi gAyanaH
shlokas.31:
evaM hi me kathayati sharmiShThA vArShaparvaNI |
vachanaM tIkShNaparuShaM krodharaktekShaNA bhRRisham
shlokas.32:
stuvato duhitA hi tvaM yAchataH pratigRRihNataH |
sutAhaM stUyamAnasya dadato.apratigRRihNataH
shlokas.33:
iti mAmAha sharmiShThA duhitA vRRiShaparvaNaH |
krodhasa.nraktanayanA darpapUrNA punaH punaH
shlokas.34:
yadyahaM stuvatastAta duhitA pratigRRihNataH |
prasAdayiShye sharmiShThAmityuktA hi sakhI mayA
shlokas.35:
shukra uvAcha||
stuvato duhitA na tvaM bhadre na pratigRRihNataH |
astotuH stUyamAnasya duhitA devayAnyasi
shlokas.36:
vRRiShaparvaiva tadveda shakro rAjA cha nAhuShaH |
achintyaM brahma nirdvandvamaishvaraM hi balaM mama

shlokas.1:
shukra uvAcha||
yaH pareShAM naro nityamativAdA.nstitikShati |
devayAni vijAnIhi tena sarvamidaM jitam
shlokas.2:
yaH samutpatitaM krodhaM nigRRihNAti hayaM yathA |
sa yantetyuchyate sadbhirna yo rashmiShu lambate
shlokas.3:
yaH samutpatitaM krodhamakrodhena nirasyati |
devayAni vijAnIhi tena sarvamidaM jitam
shlokas.4:
yaH samutpatitaM krodhaM kShamayeha nirasyati |
yathoragastvachaM jIrNAM sa vai puruSha uchyate
shlokas.5:
yaH sandhArayate manyuM yo.ativAdA.nstitikShati |
yashcha tapto na tapati dRRiDhaM so.arthasya bhAjanam
shlokas.6:
yo yajedaparishrAnto mAsi mAsi shataM samAH |
na krudhyedyashcha sarvasya tayorakrodhano.adhikaH
shlokas.7:
yatkumArAH kumAryashcha vairaM kuryurachetasaH |
na tatprAj~no.anukurvIta viduste na balAbalam
shlokas.8:
devayAnyuvAcha||
vedAhaM tAta bAlApi dharmANAM yadihAntaram |
akrodhe chAtivAde cha veda chApi balAbalam
shlokas.9:
shiShyasyAshiShyavRRitterhi na kShantavyaM bubhUShatA |
tasmAtsa~NkIrNavRRitteShu vAso mama na rochate
shlokas.10:
pumA.nso ye hi nindanti vRRittenAbhijanena cha |
na teShu nivasetprAj~naH shreyorthI pApabuddhiShu
shlokas.11:
ye tvenamabhijAnanti vRRittenAbhijanena cha |
teShu sAdhuShu vastavyaM sa vAsaH shreShTha uchyate
shlokas.12:
vAgduruktaM mahAghoraM duhiturvRRiShaparvaNaH |
na hyato duShkarataraM manye lokeShvapi triShu
yaH sapatnashriyaM dIptAM hInashrIH paryupAsate

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH kAvyo bhRRigushreShThaH samanyurupagamya ha |
vRRiShaparvANamAsInamityuvAchAvichArayan
shlokas.2:
nAdharmashcharito rAjansadyaH phalati gauriva |
putreShu vA naptRRiShu vA na chedAtmani pashyati
phalatyeva dhruvaM pApaM gurubhuktamivodare
shlokas.3:
yadaghAtayathA vipraM kachamA~NgirasaM tadA |
apApashIlaM dharmaj~naM shushrUShuM madgRRihe ratam
