shlokas.4:
vadhAdanarhatastasya vadhAchcha duhiturmama |
vRRiShaparvannibodhedaM tyakShyAmi tvAM sabAndhavam
sthAtuM tvadviShaye rAjanna shakShyAmi tvayA saha
shlokas.5:
aho mAmabhijAnAsi daitya mithyApralApinam |
yathemamAtmano doShaM na niyachChasyupekShase
shlokas.6:
vRRiShaparvovAcha||
nAdharmaM na mRRiShAvAdaM tvayi jAnAmi bhArgava |
tvayi dharmashcha satyaM cha tatprasIdatu no bhavAn
shlokas.7:
yadyasmAnapahAya tvamito gachChasi bhArgava |
samudraM sampravekShyAmo nAnyadasti parAyaNam
shlokas.8:
shukra uvAcha||
samudraM pravishadhvaM vA disho vA dravatAsurAH |
duhiturnApriyaM soDhuM shakto.ahaM dayitA hi me
shlokas.9:
prasAdyatAM devayAnI jIvitaM hyatra me sthitam |
yogakShemakaraste.ahamindrasyeva bRRihaspatiH
shlokas.10:
vRRiShaparvovAcha||
yatki~nchidasurendrANAM vidyate vasu bhArgava |
bhuvi hastigavAshvaM vA tasya tvaM mama cheshvaraH
shlokas.11:
shukra uvAcha||
yatki~nchidasti draviNaM daityendrANAM mahAsura |
tasyeshvaro.asmi yadi te devayAnI prasAdyatAm
shlokas.12:
devayAnyuvAcha||
yadi tvamIshvarastAta rAj~no vittasya bhArgava |
nAbhijAnAmi tatte.ahaM rAjA tu vadatu svayam
shlokas.13:
vRRiShaparvovAcha||
yaM kAmamabhikAmAsi devayAni shuchismite |
tatte.ahaM sampradAsyAmi yadi chedapi durlabham
shlokas.14:
devayAnyuvAcha||
dAsIM kanyAsahasreNa sharmiShThAmabhikAmaye |
anu mAM tatra gachChetsA yatra dAsyati me pitA
shlokas.15:
vRRiShaparvovAcha||
uttiShTha he sa~NgrahItri sharmiShThAM shIghramAnaya |
yaM cha kAmayate kAmaM devayAnI karotu tam
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato dhAtrI tatra gatvA sharmiShThAM vAkyamabravIt |
uttiShTha bhadre sharmiShThe j~nAtInAM sukhamAvaha
shlokas.17:
tyajati brAhmaNaH shiShyAndevayAnyA prachoditaH |
sA yaM kAmayate kAmaM sa kAryo.adya tvayAnaghe
shlokas.18:
sharmiShThovAcha||
sA yaM kAmayate kAmaM karavANyahamadya tam |
mA tvevApagamachChukro devayAnI cha matkRRite
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH kanyAsahasreNa vRRitA shibikayA tadA |
piturniyogAttvaritA nishchakrAma purottamAt
shlokas.20:
sharmiShThovAcha||
ahaM kanyAsahasreNa dAsI te parichArikA |
anu tvAM tatra yAsyAmi yatra dAsyati te pitA
shlokas.21:
devayAnyuvAcha||
stuvato duhitA te.ahaM bandinaH pratigRRihNataH |
stUyamAnasya duhitA kathaM dAsI bhaviShyasi
shlokas.22:
sharmiShThovAcha||
yena kenachidArtAnAM j~nAtInAM sukhamAvahet |
atastvAmanuyAsyAmi yatra dAsyati te pitA
shlokas.23:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pratishrute dAsabhAve duhitrA vRRiShaparvaNaH |
devayAnI nRRipashreShTha pitaraM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.24:
pravishAmi puraM tAta tuShTAsmi dvijasattama |
amoghaM tava vij~nAnamasti vidyAbalaM cha te
shlokas.25:
evamukto duhitrA sa dvijashreShTho mahAyashAH |
pravivesha puraM hRRiShTaH pUjitaH sarvadAnavaiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
atha dIrghasya kAlasya devayAnI nRRipottama |
vanaM tadeva niryAtA krIDArthaM varavarNinI
shlokas.2:
tena dAsIsahasreNa sArdhaM sharmiShThayA tadA |
tameva deshaM samprAptA yathAkAmaM chachAra sA
tAbhiH sakhIbhiH sahitA sarvAbhirmuditA bhRRisham
shlokas.3:
krIDantyo.abhiratAH sarvAH pibantyo madhumAdhavIm |
khAdantyo vividhAnbhakShyAnvidashantyaH phalAni cha
shlokas.4:
punashcha nAhuSho rAjA mRRigalipsuryadRRichChayA |
tameva deshaM samprApto jalArthI shramakarshitaH
shlokas.5:
dadRRishe devayAnIM cha sharmiShThAM tAshcha yoShitaH |
pibantIrlalamAnAshcha divyAbharaNabhUShitAH
shlokas.6:
upaviShTAM cha dadRRishe devayAnIM shuchismitAm |
rUpeNApratimAM tAsAM strINAM madhye varA~NganAm
sharmiShThayA sevyamAnAM pAdasa.nvAhanAdibhiH
shlokas.7:
yayAtiruvAcha||
dvAbhyAM kanyAsahasrAbhyAM dve kanye parivArite |
gotre cha nAmanI chaiva dvayoH pRRichChAmi vAmaham
shlokas.8:
devayAnyuvAcha||
AkhyAsyAmyahamAdatsva vachanaM me narAdhipa |
shukro nAmAsuraguruH sutAM jAnIhi tasya mAm
shlokas.9:
iyaM cha me sakhI dAsI yatrAhaM tatra gAminI |
duhitA dAnavendrasya sharmiShThA vRRiShaparvaNaH
shlokas.10:
yayAtiruvAcha||
kathaM nu te sakhI dAsI kanyeyaM varavarNinI |
asurendrasutA subhru paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.11:
devayAnyuvAcha||
sarva eva naravyAghra vidhAnamanuvartate |
vidhAnavihitaM matvA mA vichitrAH kathAH kRRithAH
shlokas.12:
rAjavadrUpaveShau te brAhmIM vAchaM bibharShi cha |
kiMnAmA tvaM kutashchAsi kasya putrashcha sha.nsa me
shlokas.13:
yayAtiruvAcha||
brahmacharyeNa kRRitsno me vedaH shrutipathaM gataH |
rAjAhaM rAjaputrashcha yayAtiriti vishrutaH
shlokas.14:
devayAnyuvAcha||
kenAsyarthena nRRipate imaM deshamupAgataH |
jighRRikShurvArijaM ki~nchidatha vA mRRigalipsayA
shlokas.15:
yayAtiruvAcha||
mRRigalipsurahaM bhadre pAnIyArthamupAgataH |
bahu chApyanuyukto.asmi tanmAnuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.16:
devayAnyuvAcha||
dvAbhyAM kanyAsahasrAbhyAM dAsyA sharmiShThayA saha |
tvadadhInAsmi bhadraM te sakhA bhartA cha me bhava
shlokas.17:
yayAtiruvAcha||
viddhyaushanasi bhadraM te na tvAmarho.asmi bhAmini |
avivAhyA hi rAjAno devayAni pitustava
shlokas.18:
devayAnyuvAcha||
sa.nsRRiShTaM brahmaNA kShatraM kShatraM cha brahmasaMhitam |
RRiShishcha RRiShiputrashcha nAhuShA~Nga vahasva mAm
shlokas.19:
yayAtiruvAcha||
ekadehodbhavA varNAshchatvAro.api varA~Ngane |
pRRithagdharmAH pRRithakShauchAsteShAM tu brAhmaNo varaH
shlokas.20:
devayAnyuvAcha||
pANidharmo nAhuShAyaM na pumbhiH sevitaH purA |
taM me tvamagrahIragre vRRiNomi tvAmahaM tataH
shlokas.21:
kathaM nu me manasvinyAH pANimanyaH pumAnspRRishet |
gRRihItamRRiShiputreNa svayaM vApyRRiShiNA tvayA
shlokas.22:
yayAtiruvAcha||
kruddhAdAshIviShAtsarpAjjvalanAtsarvatomukhAt |
durAdharShataro vipraH puruSheNa vijAnatA
shlokas.23:
devayAnyuvAcha||
kathamAshIviShAtsarpAjjvalanAtsarvatomukhAt |
durAdharShataro vipra ityAttha puruSharShabha
shlokas.24:
yayAtiruvAcha||
ekamAshIviSho hanti shastreNaikashcha vadhyate |
hanti vipraH sarAShTrANi purANyapi hi kopitaH
shlokas.25:
durAdharShataro viprastasmAdbhIru mato mama |
ato.adattAM cha pitrA tvAM bhadre na vivahAmyaham
shlokas.26:
devayAnyuvAcha||
dattAM vahasva pitrA mAM tvaM hi rAjanvRRito mayA |
ayAchato bhayaM nAsti dattAM cha pratigRRihNataH
shlokas.27:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tvaritaM devayAnyAtha preShitaM piturAtmanaH |
shrutvaiva cha sa rAjAnaM darshayAmAsa bhArgavaH
shlokas.28:
dRRiShTvaiva chAgataM shukraM yayAtiH pRRithivIpatiH |
vavande brAhmaNaM kAvyaM prA~njaliH praNataH sthitaH
shlokas.29:
devayAnyuvAcha||
rAjAyaM nAhuShastAta durge me pANimagrahIt |
namaste dehi mAmasmai nAnyaM loke patiM vRRiNe
shlokas.30:
shukra uvAcha||
vRRito.anayA patirvIra sutayA tvaM mameShTayA |
gRRihANemAM mayA dattAM mahiShIM nahuShAtmaja
shlokas.31:
yayAtiruvAcha||
adharmo na spRRishedevaM mahAnmAmiha bhArgava |
varNasa~Nkarajo brahmanniti tvAM pravRRiNomyaham
shlokas.32:
shukra uvAcha||
adharmAttvAM vimu~nchAmi varayasva yathepShitam |
asminvivAhe mA glAsIrahaM pApaM nudAmi te
shlokas.33:
vahasva bhAryAM dharmeNa devayAnIM sumadhyamAm |
anayA saha samprItimatulAM samavApsyasi
shlokas.34:
iyaM chApi kumArI te sharmiShThA vArShaparvaNI |
sampUjyA satataM rAjanmA chainAM shayane hvayeH
shlokas.35:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamukto yayAtistu shukraM kRRitvA pradakShiNam |
jagAma svapuraM hRRiShTo anuj~nAto mahAtmanA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yayAtiH svapuraM prApya mahendrapurasaMnibham |
pravishyAntaHpuraM tatra devayAnIM nyaveshayat
shlokas.2:
devayAnyAshchAnumate tAM sutAM vRRiShaparvaNaH |
ashokavanikAbhyAshe gRRihaM kRRitvA nyaveshayat
shlokas.3:
vRRitAM dAsIsahasreNa sharmiShThAmAsurAyaNIm |
vAsobhirannapAnaishcha sa.nvibhajya susatkRRitAm
shlokas.4:
devayAnyA tu sahitaH sa nRRipo nahuShAtmajaH |
vijahAra bahUnabdAndevavanmudito bhRRisham
shlokas.5:
RRitukAle tu samprApte devayAnI varA~NganA |
lebhe garbhaM prathamataH kumAraM cha vyajAyata
shlokas.6:
gate varShasahasre tu sharmiShThA vArShaparvaNI |
dadarsha yauvanaM prAptA RRituM sA chAnvachintayat
shlokas.7:
RRitukAlashcha samprApto na cha me.asti patirvRRitaH |
kiM prAptaM kiM nu kartavyaM kiM vA kRRitvA kRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.8:
devayAnI prajAtAsau vRRithAhaM prAptayauvanA |
yathA tayA vRRito bhartA tathaivAhaM vRRiNomi tam
shlokas.9:
rAj~nA putraphalaM deyamiti me nishchitA matiH |
apIdAnIM sa dharmAtmA iyAnme darshanaM rahaH
shlokas.10:
atha niShkramya rAjAsau tasminkAle yadRRichChayA |
ashokavanikAbhyAshe sharmiShThAM prApya viShThitaH
shlokas.11:
tamekaM rahite dRRiShTvA sharmiShThA chAruhAsinI |
pratyudgamyA~njaliM kRRitvA rAjAnaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.12:
somasyendrasya viShNorvA yamasya varuNasya vA |
tava vA nAhuSha kule kaH striyaM spraShTumarhati
shlokas.13:
rUpAbhijanashIlairhi tvaM rAjanvettha mAM sadA |
sA tvAM yAche prasAdyAhamRRituM dehi narAdhipa
shlokas.14:
yayAtiruvAcha||
vedmi tvAM shIlasampannAM daityakanyAmaninditAm |
rUpe cha te na pashyAmi sUchyagramapi ninditam
shlokas.15:
abravIdushanA kAvyo devayAnIM yadAvaham |
neyamAhvayitavyA te shayane vArShaparvaNI
shlokas.16:
sharmiShThovAcha||
na narmayuktaM vachanaM hinasti; na strIShu rAjanna vivAhakAle |
prANAtyaye sarvadhanApahAre; pa~nchAnRRitAnyAhurapAtakAni
shlokas.17:
pRRiShTaM tu sAkShye pravadantamanyathA; vadanti mithyopahitaM narendra |
ekArthatAyAM tu samAhitAyAM; mithyA vadantamanRRitaM hinasti
shlokas.18:
yayAtiruvAcha||
rAjA pramANaM bhUtAnAM sa nashyeta mRRiShA vadan |
arthakRRichChramapi prApya na mithyA kartumutsahe
shlokas.19:
sharmiShThovAcha||
samAvetau matau rAjanpatiH sakhyAshcha yaH patiH |
samaM vivAhamityAhuH sakhyA me.asi patirvRRitaH
shlokas.20:
yayAtiruvAcha||
dAtavyaM yAchamAnebhya iti me vratamAhitam |
tvaM cha yAchasi mAM kAmaM brUhi kiM karavANi te
shlokas.21:
sharmiShThovAcha||
adharmAttrAhi mAM rAjandharmaM cha pratipAdaya |
tvatto.apatyavatI loke chareyaM dharmamuttamam
shlokas.22:
traya evAdhanA rAjanbhAryA dAsastathA sutaH |
yatte samadhigachChanti yasya te tasya taddhanam
shlokas.23:
devayAnyA bhujiShyAsmi vashyA cha tava bhArgavI |
sA chAhaM cha tvayA rAjanbharaNIye bhajasva mAm
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu rAjA sa tathyamityeva jaj~nivAn |
pUjayAmAsa sharmiShThAM dharmaM cha pratyapAdayat
shlokas.25:
samAgamya cha sharmiShThAM yathAkAmamavApya cha |
anyonyamabhisampUjya jagmatustau yathAgatam
shlokas.26:
tasminsamAgame subhrUH sharmiShThA chAruhAsinI |
lebhe garbhaM prathamatastasmAnnRRipatisattamAt
shlokas.27:
prajaj~ne cha tataH kAle rAjanrAjIvalochanA |
kumAraM devagarbhAbhaM rAjIvanibhalochanam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA kumAraM jAtaM tu devayAnI shuchismitA |
chintayAmAsa duHkhArtA sharmiShThAM prati bhArata
shlokas.2:
abhigamya cha sharmiShThAM devayAnyabravIdidam |
kimidaM vRRijinaM subhru kRRitaM te kAmalubdhayA
shlokas.3:
sharmiShThovAcha||
RRiShirabhyAgataH kashchiddharmAtmA vedapAragaH |
sa mayA varadaH kAmaM yAchito dharmasaMhitam
shlokas.4:
nAhamanyAyataH kAmamAcharAmi shuchismite |
tasmAdRRiShermamApatyamiti satyaM bravImi te
shlokas.5:
devayAnyuvAcha||
shobhanaM bhIru satyaM chedatha sa j~nAyate dvijaH |
gotranAmAbhijanato vettumichChAmi taM dvijam
shlokas.6:
sharmiShThovAcha||
ojasA tejasA chaiva dIpyamAnaM raviM yathA |
taM dRRiShTvA mama sampraShTuM shaktirnAsIchChuchismite
shlokas.7:
devayAnyuvAcha||
yadyetadevaM sharmiShThe na manyurvidyate mama |
apatyaM yadi te labdhaM jyeShThAchChreShThAchcha vai dvijAt
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
anyonyamevamuktvA cha samprahasya cha te mithaH |
jagAma bhArgavI veshma tathyamityeva jaj~nuShI
shlokas.9:
yayAtirdevayAnyAM tu putrAvajanayannRRipaH |
yaduM cha turvasuM chaiva shakraviShNU ivAparau
shlokas.10:
tasmAdeva tu rAjarSheH sharmiShThA vArShaparvaNI |
druhyuM chAnuM cha pUruM cha trInkumArAnajIjanat
shlokas.11:
tataH kAle tu kasmi.nshchiddevayAnI shuchismitA |
yayAtisahitA rAjannirjagAma mahAvanam
shlokas.12:
dadarsha cha tadA tatra kumArAndevarUpiNaH |
krIDamAnAnsuvishrabdhAnvismitA chedamabravIt
shlokas.13:
kasyaite dArakA rAjandevaputropamAH shubhAH |
varchasA rUpatashchaiva sadRRishA me matAstava
shlokas.14:
evaM pRRiShTvA tu rAjAnaM kumArAnparyapRRichChata |
kiMnAmadheyagotro vaH putrakA brAhmaNaH pitA
vibrUta me yathAtathyaM shrotumichChAmi taM hyaham
shlokas.15:
te.adarshayanpradeshinyA tameva nRRipasattamam |
sharmiShThAM mAtaraM chaiva tasyAchakhyushcha dArakAH
shlokas.16:
ityuktvA sahitAste tu rAjAnamupachakramuH |
nAbhyanandata tAnrAjA devayAnyAstadAntike
rudantaste.atha sharmiShThAmabhyayurbAlakAstataH
shlokas.17:
dRRiShTvA tu teShAM bAlAnAM praNayaM pArthivaM prati |
buddhvA cha tattvato devI sharmiShThAmidamabravIt
shlokas.18:
madadhInA satI kasmAdakArShIrvipriyaM mama |
tamevAsuradharmaM tvamAsthitA na bibheShi kim
shlokas.19:
sharmiShThovAcha||
yaduktamRRiShirityeva tatsatyaM chAruhAsini |
nyAyato dharmatashchaiva charantI na bibhemi te
shlokas.20:
yadA tvayA vRRito rAjA vRRita eva tadA mayA |
sakhIbhartA hi dharmeNa bhartA bhavati shobhane
shlokas.21:
pUjyAsi mama mAnyA cha jyeShThA shreShThA cha brAhmaNI |
tvatto.api me pUjyatamo rAjarShiH kiM na vettha tat
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA tasyAstato vAkyaM devayAnyabravIdidam |
rAjannAdyeha vatsyAmi vipriyaM me kRRitaM tvayA
shlokas.23:
sahasotpatitAM shyAmAM dRRiShTvA tAM sAshrulochanAm |
tvaritaM sakAshaM kAvyasya prasthitAM vyathitastadA
shlokas.24:
anuvavrAja sambhrAntaH pRRiShThataH sAntvayannRRipaH |
nyavartata na chaiva sma krodhasa.nraktalochanA
shlokas.25:
avibruvantI ki~nchittu rAjAnaM chArulochanA |
achirAdiva samprAptA kAvyasyoshanaso.antikam
shlokas.26:
sA tu dRRiShTvaiva pitaramabhivAdyAgrataH sthitA |
anantaraM yayAtistu pUjayAmAsa bhArgavam
shlokas.27:
devayAnyuvAcha||
adharmeNa jito dharmaH pravRRittamadharottaram |
sharmiShThayAtivRRittAsmi duhitrA vRRiShaparvaNaH
shlokas.28:
trayo.asyAM janitAH putrA rAj~nAnena yayAtinA |
durbhagAyA mama dvau tu putrau tAta bravImi te
shlokas.29:
dharmaj~na iti vikhyAta eSha rAjA bhRRigUdvaha |
atikrAntashcha maryAdAM kAvyaitatkathayAmi te
shlokas.30:
shukra uvAcha||
dharmaj~naH sanmahArAja yo.adharmamakRRithAH priyam |
tasmAjjarA tvAmachirAddharShayiShyati durjayA
shlokas.31:
yayAtiruvAcha||
RRituM vai yAchamAnAyA bhagavannAnyachetasA |
duhiturdAnavendrasya dharmyametatkRRitaM mayA
shlokas.32:
RRituM vai yAchamAnAyA na dadAti pumAnvRRitaH |
bhrUNahetyuchyate brahmansa iha brahmavAdibhiH
shlokas.33:
abhikAmAM striyaM yastu gamyAM rahasi yAchitaH |
nopaiti sa cha dharmeShu bhrUNahetyuchyate budhaiH
shlokas.34:
ityetAni samIkShyAhaM kAraNAni bhRRigUdvaha |
adharmabhayasa.nvignaH sharmiShThAmupajagmivAn
shlokas.35:
shukra uvAcha||
nanvahaM pratyavekShyaste madadhIno.asi pArthiva |
mithyAchArasya dharmeShu chauryaM bhavati nAhuSha
shlokas.36:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kruddhenoshanasA shapto yayAtirnAhuShastadA |
pUrvaM vayaH parityajya jarAM sadyo.anvapadyata
shlokas.37:
yayAtiruvAcha||
atRRipto yauvanasyAhaM devayAnyAM bhRRigUdvaha |
prasAdaM kuru me brahma~njareyaM mA visheta mAm
shlokas.38:
shukra uvAcha||
nAhaM mRRiShA bravImyetajjarAM prApto.asi bhUmipa |
jarAM tvetAM tvamanyasmai sa~NkrAmaya yadIchChasi
shlokas.39:
yayAtiruvAcha||
rAjyabhAksa bhavedbrahmanpuNyabhAkkIrtibhAktathA |
yo me dadyAdvayaH putrastadbhavAnanumanyatAm
shlokas.40:
shukra uvAcha||
sa~NkrAmayiShyasi jarAM yatheShTaM nahuShAtmaja |
mAmanudhyAya bhAvena na cha pApamavApsyasi
shlokas.41:
vayo dAsyati te putro yaH sa rAjA bhaviShyati |
AyuShmAnkIrtimA.nshchaiva bahvapatyastathaiva cha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
jarAM prApya yayAtistu svapuraM prApya chaiva ha |
putraM jyeShThaM variShThaM cha yadumityabravIdvachaH
shlokas.2:
jarA valI cha mAM tAta palitAni cha paryaguH |
kAvyasyoshanasaH shApAnna cha tRRipto.asmi yauvane
shlokas.3:
tvaM yado pratipadyasva pApmAnaM jarayA saha |
yauvanena tvadIyena chareyaM viShayAnaham
shlokas.4:
pUrNe varShasahasre tu punaste yauvanaM tvaham |
dattvA svaM pratipatsyAmi pApmAnaM jarayA saha
shlokas.5:
yaduruvAcha||
sitashmashrushirA dIno jarayA shithilIkRRitaH |
valIsantatagAtrashcha durdarsho durbalaH kRRishaH
shlokas.6:
ashaktaH kAryakaraNe paribhUtaH sa yauvanaiH |
sahopajIvibhishchaiva tAM jarAM nAbhikAmaye
shlokas.7:
yayAtiruvAcha||
yattvaM me hRRidayAjjAto vayaH svaM na prayachChasi |
tasmAdarAjyabhAktAta prajA te vai bhaviShyati
shlokas.8:
turvaso pratipadyasva pApmAnaM jarayA saha |
yauvanena chareyaM vai viShayA.nstava putraka
shlokas.9:
pUrNe varShasahasre tu punardAsyAmi yauvanam |
svaM chaiva pratipatsyAmi pApmAnaM jarayA saha
shlokas.10:
turvasuruvAcha||
na kAmaye jarAM tAta kAmabhogapraNAshinIm |
balarUpAntakaraNIM buddhiprANavinAshinIm
shlokas.11:
yayAtiruvAcha||
yattvaM me hRRidayAjjAto vayaH svaM na prayachChasi |
tasmAtprajA samuchChedaM turvaso tava yAsyati
shlokas.12:
sa~NkIrNAchAradharmeShu pratilomachareShu cha |
pishitAshiShu chAntyeShu mUDha rAjA bhaviShyasi
shlokas.13:
gurudAraprasakteShu tiryagyonigateShu cha |
pashudharmiShu pApeShu mlechCheShu prabhaviShyasi
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM sa turvasuM shaptvA yayAtiH sutamAtmanaH |
sharmiShThAyAH sutaM druhyumidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.15:
druhyo tvaM pratipadyasva varNarUpavinAshinIm |
jarAM varShasahasraM me yauvanaM svaM dadasva cha
shlokas.16:
pUrNe varShasahasre tu pratidAsyAmi yauvanam |
svaM chAdAsyAmi bhUyo.ahaM pApmAnaM jarayA saha
shlokas.17:
druhyuruvAcha||
na gajaM na rathaM nAshvaM jIrNo bhu~Nkte na cha striyam |
vAgbha~NgashchAsya bhavati tajjarAM nAbhikAmaye
shlokas.18:
yayAtiruvAcha||
yattvaM me hRRidayAjjAto vayaH svaM na prayachChasi |
tasmAddruhyo priyaH kAmo na te sampatsyate kvachit
shlokas.19:
uDupaplavasantAro yatra nityaM bhaviShyati |
arAjA bhojashabdaM tvaM tatrAvApsyasi sAnvayaH
shlokas.20:
ano tvaM pratipadyasva pApmAnaM jarayA saha |
ekaM varShasahasraM tu chareyaM yauvanena te
shlokas.21:
anuruvAcha||
jIrNaH shishuvadAdatte.akAle.annamashuchiryathA |
na juhoti cha kAle.agniM tAM jarAM nAbhikAmaye
shlokas.22:
yayAtiruvAcha||
yattvaM me hRRidayAjjAto vayaH svaM na prayachChasi |
jarAdoShastvayokto.ayaM tasmAttvaM pratipatsyase
shlokas.23:
prajAshcha yauvanaprAptA vinashiShyantyano tava |
agnipraskandanaparastvaM chApyevaM bhaviShyasi
shlokas.24:
pUro tvaM me priyaH putrastvaM varIyAnbhaviShyasi |
jarA valI cha me tAta palitAni cha paryaguH
kAvyasyoshanasaH shApAnna cha tRRipto.asmi yauvane
shlokas.25:
pUro tvaM pratipadyasva pApmAnaM jarayA saha |
ka~nchitkAlaM chareyaM vai viShayAnvayasA tava
shlokas.26:
pUrNe varShasahasre tu pratidAsyAmi yauvanam |
svaM chaiva pratipatsyAmi pApmAnaM jarayA saha
shlokas.27:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha pUruH pitarama~njasA |
yathAttha mAM mahArAja tatkariShyAmi te vachaH
shlokas.28:
pratipatsyAmi te rAjanpApmAnaM jarayA saha |
gRRihANa yauvanaM mattashchara kAmAnyathepsitAn
shlokas.29:
jarayAhaM pratichChanno vayorUpadharastava |
yauvanaM bhavate dattvA chariShyAmi yathAttha mAm
shlokas.30:
yayAtiruvAcha||
pUro prIto.asmi te vatsa prItashchedaM dadAmi te |
sarvakAmasamRRiddhA te prajA rAjye bhaviShyati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pauraveNAtha vayasA yayAtirnahuShAtmajaH |
prItiyukto nRRipashreShThashchachAra viShayAnpriyAn
shlokas.2:
yathAkAmaM yathotsAhaM yathAkAlaM yathAsukham |
dharmAviruddhAnrAjendro yathArhati sa eva hi
shlokas.3:
devAnatarpayadyaj~naiH shrAddhaistadvatpitRRinapi |
dInAnanugrahairiShTaiH kAmaishcha dvijasattamAn
shlokas.4:
atithInannapAnaishcha vishashcha paripAlanaiH |
AnRRisha.nsyena shUdrA.nshcha dasyUnsaMnigraheNa cha
shlokas.5:
dharmeNa cha prajAH sarvA yathAvadanura~njayan |
yayAtiH pAlayAmAsa sAkShAdindra ivAparaH
shlokas.6:
sa rAjA siMhavikrAnto yuvA viShayagocharaH |
avirodhena dharmasya chachAra sukhamuttamam
shlokas.7:
sa samprApya shubhAnkAmA.nstRRiptaH khinnashcha pArthivaH |
kAlaM varShasahasrAntaM sasmAra manujAdhipaH
shlokas.8:
parisa~NkhyAya kAlaj~naH kalAH kAShThAshcha vIryavAn |
pUrNaM matvA tataH kAlaM pUruM putramuvAcha ha
shlokas.9:
yathAkAmaM yathotsAhaM yathAkAlamari.ndama |
sevitA viShayAH putra yauvanena mayA tava
shlokas.10:
pUro prIto.asmi bhadraM te gRRihANedaM svayauvanam |
rAjyaM chaiva gRRihANedaM tvaM hi me priyakRRitsutaH
shlokas.11:
pratipede jarAM rAjA yayAtirnAhuShastadA |
yauvanaM pratipede cha pUruH svaM punarAtmanaH
shlokas.12:
abhiShektukAmaM nRRipatiM pUruM putraM kanIyasam |
brAhmaNapramukhA varNA idaM vachanamabruvan
shlokas.13:
kathaM shukrasya naptAraM devayAnyAH sutaM prabho |
jyeShThaM yadumatikramya rAjyaM pUroH pradAsyasi
shlokas.14:
yadurjyeShThastava suto jAtastamanu turvasuH |
sharmiShThAyAH suto druhyustato.anuH pUrureva cha
shlokas.15:
kathaM jyeShThAnatikramya kanIyAnrAjyamarhati |
etatsambodhayAmastvAM dharmaM tvamanupAlaya
shlokas.16:
yayAtiruvAcha||
brAhmaNapramukhA varNAH sarve shRRiNvantu me vachaH |
jyeShThaM prati yathA rAjyaM na deyaM me katha~nchana
shlokas.17:
mama jyeShThena yadunA niyogo nAnupAlitaH |
pratikUlaH pituryashcha na sa putraH satAM mataH
shlokas.18:
mAtApitrorvachanakRRiddhitaH pathyashcha yaH sutaH |
sa putraH putravadyashcha vartate pitRRimAtRRiShu
shlokas.19:
yadunAhamavaj~nAtastathA turvasunApi cha |
druhyunA chAnunA chaiva mayyavaj~nA kRRitA bhRRisham
shlokas.20:
pUruNA me kRRitaM vAkyaM mAnitashcha visheShataH |
kanIyAnmama dAyAdo jarA yena dhRRitA mama
mama kAmaH sa cha kRRitaH pUruNA putrarUpiNA
shlokas.21:
shukreNa cha varo dattaH kAvyenoshanasA svayam |
putro yastvAnuvarteta sa rAjA pRRithivIpatiH
bhavato.anunayAmyevaM pUrU rAjye.abhiShichyatAm
shlokas.22:
prakRRitaya UchuH||
yaH putro guNasampanno mAtApitrorhitaH sadA |
sarvamarhati kalyANaM kanIyAnapi sa prabho
shlokas.23:
arhaH pUruridaM rAjyaM yaH sutaH priyakRRittava |
varadAnena shukrasya na shakyaM vaktumuttaram
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
paurajAnapadaistuShTairityukto nAhuShastadA |
abhyaShi~nchattataH pUruM rAjye sve sutamAtmajam
shlokas.25:
dattvA cha pUrave rAjyaM vanavAsAya dIkShitaH |
purAtsa niryayau rAjA brAhmaNaistApasaiH saha
shlokas.26:
yadostu yAdavA jAtAsturvasoryavanAH sutAH |
druhyorapi sutA bhojA anostu mlechChajAtayaH
shlokas.27:
pUrostu pauravo va.nsho yatra jAto.asi pArthiva |
idaM varShasahasrAya rAjyaM kArayituM vashI

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM sa nAhuSho rAjA yayAtiH putramIpsitam |
rAjye.abhiShichya mudito vAnaprastho.abhavanmuniH
shlokas.2:
uShitvA cha vane vAsaM brAhmaNaiH saha sa.nshritaH |
phalamUlAshano dAnto yathA svargamito gataH
shlokas.3:
sa gataH suravAsaM taM nivasanmuditaH sukham |
kAlasya nAtimahataH punaH shakreNa pAtitaH
shlokas.4:
nipatanprachyutaH svargAdaprApto medinItalam |
sthita AsIdantarikShe sa tadeti shrutaM mayA
shlokas.5:
tata eva punashchApi gataH svargamiti shrutiH |
rAj~nA vasumatA sArdhamaShTakena cha vIryavAn
pratardanena shibinA sametya kila sa.nsadi
shlokas.6:
janamejaya uvAcha||
karmaNA kena sa divaM punaH prApto mahIpatiH |
sarvametadasheSheNa shrotumichChAmi tattvataH
kathyamAnaM tvayA vipra viprarShigaNasaMnidhau
shlokas.7:
devarAjasamo hyAsIdyayAtiH pRRithivIpatiH |
vardhanaH kuruva.nshasya vibhAvasusamadyutiH
shlokas.8:
tasya vistIrNayashasaH satyakIrtermahAtmanaH |
charitaM shrotumichChAmi divi cheha cha sarvashaH
shlokas.9:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi yayAteruttarAM kathAm |
divi cheha cha puNyArthAM sarvapApapraNAshinIm
shlokas.10:
yayAtirnAhuSho rAjA pUruM putraM kanIyasam |
rAjye.abhiShichya muditaH pravavrAja vanaM tadA
shlokas.11:
anteShu sa vinikShipya putrAnyadupurogamAn |
phalamUlAshano rAjA vane saMnyavasachchiram
shlokas.12:
sa.nshitAtmA jitakrodhastarpayanpitRRidevatAH |
agnI.nshcha vidhivajjuhvanvAnaprasthavidhAnataH
shlokas.13:
atithInpUjayAmAsa vanyena haviShA vibhuH |
shilo~nChavRRittimAsthAya sheShAnnakRRitabhojanaH
shlokas.14:
pUrNaM varShasahasraM sa eva.nvRRittirabhUnnRRipaH |
abbhakShaH sharadastri.nshadAsInniyatavA~NmanAH
shlokas.15:
tatashcha vAyubhakSho.abhUtsa.nvatsaramatandritaH |
pa~nchAgnimadhye cha tapastepe sa.nvatsaraM nRRipaH
shlokas.16:
ekapAdasthitashchAsItShaNmAsAnanilAshanaH |
puNyakIrtistataH svargaM jagAmAvRRitya rodasI

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
svargataH sa tu rAjendro nivasandevasadmani |
pUjitastridashaiH sAdhyairmarudbhirvasubhistathA
shlokas.2:
devalokAdbrahmalokaM sa~ncharanpuNyakRRidvashI |
avasatpRRithivIpAlo dIrghakAlamiti shrutiH
shlokas.3:
sa kadAchinnRRipashreShTho yayAtiH shakramAgamat |
kathAnte tatra shakreNa pRRiShTaH sa pRRithivIpatiH
shlokas.4:
shakra uvAcha||
yadA sa pUrustava rUpeNa rAja;~njarAM gRRihItvA prachachAra bhUmau |
tadA rAjyaM sampradAyaiva tasmai; tvayA kimuktaH kathayeha satyam
shlokas.5:
yayAtiruvAcha||
ga~NgAyamunayormadhye kRRitsno.ayaM viShayastava |
madhye pRRithivyAstvaM rAjA bhrAtaro.antyAdhipAstava
shlokas.6:
akrodhanaH krodhanebhyo vishiShTa;stathA titikShuratitikShorvishiShTaH |
amAnuShebhyo mAnuShAshcha pradhAnA; vidvA.nstathaivAviduShaH pradhAnaH
shlokas.7:
AkrushyamAno nAkroshenmanyureva titikShataH |
AkroShTAraM nirdahati sukRRitaM chAsya vindati
shlokas.8:
nAruntudaH syAnna nRRisha.nsavAdI; na hInataH paramabhyAdadIta |
yayAsya vAchA para udvijeta; na tAM vadedrushatIM pApalokyAm
shlokas.9:
aruntudaM puruShaM rUkShavAchaM; vAkkaNTakairvitudantaM manuShyAn |
vidyAdalakShmIkatamaM janAnAM; mukhe nibaddhAM nirRRitiM vahantam
shlokas.10:
sadbhiH purastAdabhipUjitaH syA;tsadbhistathA pRRiShThato rakShitaH syAt |
sadAsatAmativAdA.nstitikShe;tsatAM vRRittaM chAdadItAryavRRittaH
shlokas.11:
vAksAyakA vadanAnniShpatanti; yairAhataH shochati rAtryahAni |
parasya vA marmasu ye patanti; tAnpaNDito nAvasRRijetpareShu
shlokas.12:
na hIdRRishaM sa.nvananaM triShu lokeShu vidyate |
yathA maitrI cha bhUteShu dAnaM cha madhurA cha vAk
shlokas.13:
tasmAtsAntvaM sadA vAchyaM na vAchyaM paruShaM kvachit |
pUjyAnsampUjayeddadyAnna cha yAchetkadAchana

shlokas.1:
indra uvAcha||
sarvANi karmANi samApya rAja;ngRRihAnparityajya vanaM gato.asi |
tattvAM pRRichChAmi nahuShasya putra; kenAsi tulyastapasA yayAte
shlokas.2:
yayAtiruvAcha||
nAhaM devamanuShyeShu na gandharvamaharShiShu |
AtmanastapasA tulyaM ka~nchitpashyAmi vAsava
shlokas.3:
indra uvAcha||
yadAvama.nsthAH sadRRishaH shreyasashcha; pApIyasashchAviditaprabhAvaH |
tasmAllokA antavantastaveme; kShINe puNye patitAsyadya rAjan
shlokas.4:
yayAtiruvAcha||
surarShigandharvanarAvamAnA;tkShayaM gatA me yadi shakra lokAH |
ichCheyaM vai suralokAdvihInaH; satAM madhye patituM devarAja
shlokas.5:
indra uvAcha||
satAM sakAshe patitAsi rAjaM;shchyutaH pratiShThAM yatra labdhAsi bhUyaH |
evaM viditvA tu punaryayAte; na te.avamAnyAH sadRRishaH shreyasashcha
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH prahAyAmararAjajuShTA;npuNyA.NllokAnpatamAnaM yayAtim |
samprekShya rAjarShivaro.aShTakasta;muvAcha saddharmavidhAnagoptA
shlokas.7:
kastvaM yuvA vAsavatulyarUpaH; svatejasA dIpyamAno yathAgniH |
patasyudIrNAmbudharAndhakArA;tkhAtkhecharANAM pravaro yathArkaH
shlokas.8:
dRRiShTvA cha tvAM sUryapathAtpatantaM; vaishvAnarArkadyutimaprameyam |
kiM nu svidetatpatatIti sarve; vitarkayantaH parimohitAH smaH
shlokas.9:
dRRiShTvA cha tvAM viShThitaM devamArge; shakrArkaviShNupratimaprabhAvam |
abhyudgatAstvAM vayamadya sarve; tattvaM pAte tava jij~nAsamAnAH
shlokas.10:
na chApi tvAM dhRRiShNumaH praShTumagre; na cha tvamasmAnpRRichChasi ye vayaM smaH |
tattvAM pRRichChAmaH spRRihaNIyarUpaM; kasya tvaM vA kiMnimittaM tvamAgAH
shlokas.11:
bhayaM tu te vyetu viShAdamohau; tyajAshu devendrasamAnarUpa |
tvAM vartamAnaM hi satAM sakAshe; nAlaM prasoDhuM balahApi shakraH
shlokas.12:
santaH pratiShThA hi sukhachyutAnAM; satAM sadaivAmararAjakalpa |
te sa~NgatAH sthAvaraja~NgameshAH; pratiShThitastvaM sadRRisheShu satsu
shlokas.13:
prabhuragniH pratapane bhUmirAvapane prabhuH |
prabhuH sUryaH prakAshitve satAM chAbhyAgataH prabhuH

shlokas.1:
yayAtiruvAcha||
ahaM yayAtirnahuShasya putraH; pUroH pitA sarvabhUtAvamAnAt |
prabhra.nshitaH surasiddharShilokA;tparichyutaH prapatAmyalpapuNyaH
shlokas.2:
ahaM hi pUrvo vayasA bhavadbhya;stenAbhivAdaM bhavatAM na prayu~nje |
yo vidyayA tapasA janmanA vA; vRRiddhaH sa pUjyo bhavati dvijAnAm
shlokas.3:
aShTaka uvAcha||
avAdIshchedvayasA yaH sa vRRiddha; iti rAjannAbhyavadaH katha~nchit |
yo vai vidvAnvayasA sansma vRRiddhaH; sa eva pUjyo bhavati dvijAnAm
shlokas.4:
yayAtiruvAcha||
pratikUlaM karmaNAM pApamAhu;stadvartate.apravaNe pApalokyam |
santo.asatAM nAnuvartanti chaita;dyathA AtmaiShAmanukUlavAdI
shlokas.5:
abhUddhanaM me vipulaM mahadvai; vicheShTamAno nAdhigantA tadasmi |
evaM pradhAryAtmahite niviShTo; yo vartate sa vijAnAti jIvan
shlokas.6:
nAnAbhAvA bahavo jIvaloke; daivAdhInA naShTacheShTAdhikArAH |
tattatprApya na vihanyeta dhIro; diShTaM balIya iti matvAtmabuddhyA
shlokas.7:
sukhaM hi janturyadi vApi duHkhaM; daivAdhInaM vindati nAtmashaktyA |
tasmAddiShTaM balavanmanyamAno; na sa~njvarennApi hRRiShyetkadAchit
shlokas.8:
duHkhe na tapyenna sukhena hRRiShye;tsamena varteta sadaiva dhIraH |
diShTaM balIya iti manyamAno; na sa~njvarennApi hRRiShyetkadAchit
shlokas.9:
bhaye na muhyAmyaShTakAhaM kadA chi;tsantApo me mAnaso nAsti kashchit |
dhAtA yathA mAM vidadhAti loke; dhruvaM tathAhaM bhaviteti matvA
shlokas.10:
sa.nsvedajA aNDajA udbhidAshcha; sarIsRRipAH kRRimayo.athApsu matsyAH |
tathAshmAnastRRiNakAShThaM cha sarvaM; diShTakShaye svAM prakRRitiM bhajante
shlokas.11:
anityatAM sukhaduHkhasya buddhvA; kasmAtsantApamaShTakAhaM bhajeyam |
kiM kuryAM vai kiM cha kRRitvA na tapye; tasmAtsantApaM varjayAmyapramattaH
shlokas.12:
aShTaka uvAcha||
ye ye lokAH pArthivendra pradhAnA;stvayA bhuktA yaM cha kAlaM yathA cha |
tanme rAjanbrUhi sarvaM yathAva;tkShetraj~navadbhAShase tvaM hi dharmAn
shlokas.13:
yayAtiruvAcha||
rAjAhamAsamiha sArvabhauma;stato lokAnmahato ajayaM vai |
tatrAvasaM varShasahasramAtraM; tato lokaM paramasmyabhyupetaH
shlokas.14:
tataH purIM puruhUtasya ramyAM; sahasradvArAM shatayojanAyatAm |
adhyAvasaM varShasahasramAtraM; tato lokaM paramasmyabhyupetaH
shlokas.15:
tato divyamajaraM prApya lokaM; prajApaterlokapaterdurApam |
tatrAvasaM varShasahasramAtraM; tato lokaM paramasmyabhyupetaH
shlokas.16:
devasya devasya niveshane cha; vijitya lokAnavasaM yatheShTam |
sampUjyamAnastridashaiH samastai;stulyaprabhAvadyutirIshvarANAm
shlokas.17:
tathAvasaM nandane kAmarUpI; sa.nvatsarANAmayutaM shatAnAm |
sahApsarobhirviharanpuNyagandhA;npashyannagAnpuShpitA.nshchArurUpAn
shlokas.18:
tatrasthaM mAM devasukheShu saktaM; kAle.atIte mahati tato.atimAtram |
dUto devAnAmabravIdugrarUpo; dhva.nsetyuchchaistriH plutena svareNa
shlokas.19:
etAvanme viditaM rAjasiMha; tato bhraShTo.ahaM nandanAtkShINapuNyaH |
vAcho.ashrauShaM chAntarikShe surANA;manukroshAchChochatAM mAnavendra
shlokas.20:
aho kaShTaM kShINapuNyo yayAtiH; patatyasau puNyakRRitpuNyakIrtiH |
tAnabruvaM patamAnastato.ahaM; satAM madhye nipateyaM kathaM nu
shlokas.21:
tairAkhyAtA bhavatAM yaj~nabhUmiH; samIkShya chainAM tvaritamupAgato.asmi |
havirgandhaM deshikaM yaj~nabhUme;rdhUmApA~NgaM pratigRRihya pratItaH

shlokas.1:
aShTaka uvAcha||
yadAvaso nandane kAmarUpI; sa.nvatsarANAmayutaM shatAnAm |
kiM kAraNaM kArtayugapradhAna; hitvA tattvaM vasudhAmanvapadyaH
shlokas.2:
yayAtiruvAcha||
j~nAtiH suhRRitsvajano yo yatheha; kShINe vitte tyajyate mAnavairhi |
tathA tatra kShINapuNyaM manuShyaM; tyajanti sadyaH seshvarA devasa~NghAH
shlokas.3:
aShTaka uvAcha||
kathaM tasminkShINapuNyA bhavanti; saMmuhyate me.atra mano.atimAtram |
ki.nvishiShTAH kasya dhAmopayAnti; tadvai brUhi kShetravittvaM mato me
shlokas.4:
yayAtiruvAcha||
imaM bhaumaM narakaM te patanti; lAlapyamAnA naradeva sarve |
te ka~NkagomAyubalAshanArthaM; kShINA vivRRiddhiM bahudhA vrajanti
shlokas.5:
tasmAdetadvarjanIyaM nareNa; duShTaM loke garhaNIyaM cha karma |
AkhyAtaM te pArthiva sarvameta;dbhUyashchedAnIM vada kiM te vadAmi
shlokas.6:
aShTaka uvAcha||
yadA tu tAnvitudante vayA.nsi; tathA gRRidhrAH shitikaNThAH pata~NgAH |
kathaM bhavanti kathamAbhavanti; na bhaumamanyaM narakaM shRRiNomi
shlokas.7:
yayAtiruvAcha||
UrdhvaM dehAtkarmaNo jRRimbhamANA;dvyaktaM pRRithivyAmanusa~ncharanti |
imaM bhaumaM narakaM te patanti; nAvekShante varShapUgAnanekAn
shlokas.8:
ShaShTiM sahasrANi patanti vyomni; tathA ashItiM parivatsarANi |
tAnvai tudanti prapatataH prapAtaM; bhImA bhaumA rAkShasAstIkShNadaMShTrAH
shlokas.9:
aShTaka uvAcha||
yadenasaste patatastudanti; bhImA bhaumA rAkShasAstIkShNadaMShTrAH |
kathaM bhavanti kathamAbhavanti; kathambhUtA garbhabhUtA bhavanti
shlokas.10:
yayAtiruvAcha||
asraM retaH puShpaphalAnupRRikta;manveti tadvai puruSheNa sRRiShTam |
sa vai tasyA raja Apadyate vai; sa garbhabhUtaH samupaiti tatra
shlokas.11:
vanaspatI.nshchauShadhIshchAvishanti; apo vAyuM pRRithivIM chAntarikSham |
chatuShpadaM dvipadaM chApi sarva;mevambhUtA garbhabhUtA bhavanti
shlokas.12:
aShTaka uvAcha||
anyadvapurvidadhAtIha garbha; utAho svitsvena kAmena yAti |
ApadyamAno narayonimetA;mAchakShva me sa.nshayAtprabravImi
shlokas.13:
sharIradehAdisamuchChrayaM cha; chakShuHshrotre labhate kena sa~nj~nAm |
etattattvaM sarvamAchakShva pRRiShTaH; kShetraj~naM tvAM tAta manyAma sarve
shlokas.14:
yayAtiruvAcha||
vAyuH samutkarShati garbhayoni;mRRitau retaH puShparasAnupRRiktam |
sa tatra tanmAtrakRRitAdhikAraH; krameNa sa.nvardhayatIha garbham
shlokas.15:
sa jAyamAno vigRRihItagAtraH; ShaDj~nAnaniShThAyatano manuShyaH |
sa shrotrAbhyAM vedayatIha shabdaM; sarvaM rUpaM pashyati chakShuShA cha
shlokas.16:
ghrANena gandhaM jihvayAtho rasaM cha; tvachA sparshaM manasA veda bhAvam |
ityaShTakehopachitiM cha viddhi; mahAtmanaH prANabhRRitaH sharIre
shlokas.17:
aShTaka uvAcha||
yaH sa.nsthitaH puruSho dahyate vA; nikhanyate vApi nighRRiShyate vA |
abhAvabhUtaH sa vinAshametya; kenAtmAnaM chetayate purastAt
shlokas.18:
yayAtiruvAcha||
hitvA so.asUnsuptavanniShTanitvA; purodhAya sukRRitaM duShkRRitaM cha |
anyAM yoniM pavanAgrAnusArI; hitvA dehaM bhajate rAjasiMha
shlokas.19:
puNyAM yoniM puNyakRRito vrajanti; pApAM yoniM pApakRRito vrajanti |
kITAH pata~NgAshcha bhavanti pApA; na me vivakShAsti mahAnubhAva
shlokas.20:
chatuShpadA dvipadAH ShaTpadAshcha; tathAbhUtA garbhabhUtA bhavanti |
AkhyAtametannikhilena sarvaM; bhUyastu kiM pRRichChasi rAjasiMha
shlokas.21:
aShTaka uvAcha||
kiM svitkRRitvA labhate tAta lokA;nmartyaH shreShThA.nstapasA vidyayA vA |
tanme pRRiShTaH sha.nsa sarvaM yathAva;chChubhA.NllokAnyena gachChetkrameNa
shlokas.22:
yayAtiruvAcha||
tapashcha dAnaM cha shamo damashcha; hrIrArjavaM sarvabhUtAnukampA |
nashyanti mAnena tamo.abhibhUtAH; pu.nsaH sadaiveti vadanti santaH
shlokas.23:
adhIyAnaH paNDitaM manyamAno; yo vidyayA hanti yashaH pareShAm |
tasyAntavantashcha bhavanti lokA; na chAsya tadbrahma phalaM dadAti
shlokas.24:
chatvAri karmANyabhaya~NkarANi; bhayaM prayachChantyayathAkRRitAni |
mAnAgnihotramuta mAnamaunaM; mAnenAdhItamuta mAnayaj~naH
shlokas.25:
na mAnyamAno mudamAdadIta; na santApaM prApnuyAchchAvamAnAt |
santaH sataH pUjayantIha loke; nAsAdhavaH sAdhubuddhiM labhante
shlokas.26:
iti dadyAditi yajedityadhIyIta me vratam |
ityasminnabhayAnyAhustAni varjyAni nityashaH
shlokas.27:
yenAshrayaM vedayante purANaM; manIShiNo mAnasamAnabhaktam |
tanniHshreyastaijasaM rUpametya; parAM shAntiM prApnuyuH pretya cheha

shlokas.1:
aShTaka uvAcha||
charangRRihasthaH kathameti devA;nkathaM bhikShuH kathamAchAryakarmA |
vAnaprasthaH satpathe saMniviShTo; bahUnyasminsamprati vedayanti
shlokas.2:
yayAtiruvAcha||
AhUtAdhyAyI gurukarmasvachodyaH; pUrvotthAyI charamaM chopashAyI |
mRRidurdAnto dhRRitimAnapramattaH; svAdhyAyashIlaH sidhyati brahmachArI
shlokas.3:
dharmAgataM prApya dhanaM yajeta; dadyAtsadaivAtithInbhojayechcha |
anAdadAnashcha parairadattaM; saiShA gRRihasthopaniShatpurANI
shlokas.4:
svavIryajIvI vRRijinAnnivRRitto; dAtA parebhyo na paropatApI |
tAdRRi~NmuniH siddhimupaiti mukhyAM; vasannaraNye niyatAhAracheShTaH
shlokas.5:
ashilpajIvI nagRRihashcha nityaM; jitendriyaH sarvato vipramuktaH |
anokasArI laghuralpachAra;shcharandeshAnekacharaH sa bhikShuH
shlokas.6:
rAtryA yayA chAbhijitAshcha lokA; bhavanti kAmA vijitAH sukhAshcha |
tAmeva rAtriM prayateta vidvA;naraNyasa.nstho bhavituM yatAtmA
shlokas.7:
dashaiva pUrvAndasha chAparA.nstu; j~nAtInsahAtmAnamathaikavi.nsham |
araNyavAsI sukRRite dadhAti; vimuchyAraNye svasharIradhAtUn
shlokas.8:
aShTaka uvAcha||
kati svideva munayo maunAni kati chApyuta |
bhavantIti tadAchakShva shrotumichChAmahe vayam
shlokas.9:
yayAtiruvAcha||
araNye vasato yasya grAmo bhavati pRRiShThataH |
grAme vA vasato.araNyaM sa muniH syAjjanAdhipa
shlokas.10:
aShTaka uvAcha||
kathaM svidvasato.araNye grAmo bhavati pRRiShThataH |
grAme vA vasato.araNyaM kathaM bhavati pRRiShThataH
shlokas.11:
yayAtiruvAcha||
na grAmyamupayu~njIta ya AraNyo munirbhavet |
tathAsya vasato.araNye grAmo bhavati pRRiShThataH
shlokas.12:
anagniraniketashcha agotracharaNo muniH |
kaupInAchChAdanaM yAvattAvadichChechcha chIvaram
shlokas.13:
yAvatprANAbhisandhAnaM tAvadichChechcha bhojanam |
tathAsya vasato grAme.araNyaM bhavati pRRiShThataH
shlokas.14:
yastu kAmAnparityajya tyaktakarmA jitendriyaH |
AtiShTheta munirmaunaM sa loke siddhimApnuyAt
shlokas.15:
dhautadantaM kRRittanakhaM sadA snAtamala~NkRRitam |
asitaM sitakarmasthaM kastaM nArchitumarhati
shlokas.16:
tapasA karshitaH kShAmaH kShINamA.nsAsthishoNitaH |
yadA bhavati nirdvandvo munirmaunaM samAsthitaH
atha lokamimaM jitvA lokaM vijayate param
shlokas.17:
Asyena tu yadAhAraM govanmRRigayate muniH |
athAsya lokaH pUrvo yaH so.amRRitatvAya kalpate

shlokas.1:
aShTaka uvAcha||
katarastvetayoH pUrvaM devAnAmeti sAtmyatAm |
ubhayordhAvato rAjansUryAchandramasoriva
shlokas.2:
yayAtiruvAcha||
aniketo gRRihastheShu kAmavRRitteShu sa.nyataH |
grAma eva vasanbhikShustayoH pUrvataraM gataH
shlokas.3:
aprApya dIrghamAyustu yaH prApto vikRRitiM charet |
tapyeta yadi tatkRRitvA charetso.anyattatastapaH
shlokas.4:
yadvai nRRisha.nsaM tadapathyamAhu;ryaH sevate dharmamanarthabuddhiH |
asvo.apyanIshashcha tathaiva rAjaM;stadArjavaM sa samAdhistadAryam
shlokas.5:
aShTaka uvAcha||
kenAsi dUtaH prahito.adya rAja;nyuvA sragvI darshanIyaH suvarchAH |
kuta AgataH katarasyAM dishi tva;mutAho svitpArthivaM sthAnamasti
shlokas.6:
yayAtiruvAcha||
imaM bhaumaM narakaM kShINapuNyaH; praveShTumurvIM gaganAdviprakIrNaH |
uktvAhaM vaH prapatiShyAmyanantaraM; tvaranti mAM brAhmaNA lokapAlAH
shlokas.7:
satAM sakAshe tu vRRitaH prapAta;ste sa~NgatA guNavantashcha sarve |
shakrAchcha labdho hi varo mayaiSha; patiShyatA bhUmitale narendra
shlokas.8:
aShTaka uvAcha||
pRRichChAmi tvAM mA prapata prapAtaM; yadi lokAH pArthiva santi me.atra |
yadyantarikShe yadi vA divi shritAH; kShetraj~naM tvAM tasya dharmasya manye
shlokas.9:
yayAtiruvAcha||
yAvatpRRithivyAM vihitaM gavAshvaM; sahAraNyaiH pashubhiH parvataishcha |
tAvallokA divi te sa.nsthitA vai; tathA vijAnIhi narendrasiMha
shlokas.10:
aShTaka uvAcha||
tA.nste dadAmi mA prapata prapAtaM; ye me lokA divi rAjendra santi |
yadyantarikShe yadi vA divi shritA;stAnAkrama kShipramamitrasAha
shlokas.11:
yayAtiruvAcha||
nAsmadvidho.abrAhmaNo brahmavichcha; pratigrahe vartate rAjamukhya |
yathA pradeyaM satataM dvijebhya;stathAdadaM pUrvamahaM narendra
shlokas.12:
nAbrAhmaNaH kRRipaNo jAtu jIve;dyA chApi syAdbrAhmaNI vIrapatnI |
so.ahaM yadaivAkRRitapUrvaM chareyaM; vivitsamAnaH kimu tatra sAdhu
shlokas.13:
pratardana uvAcha||
pRRichChAmi tvAM spRRihaNIyarUpa; pratardano.ahaM yadi me santi lokAH |
yadyantarikShe yadi vA divi shritAH; kShetraj~naM tvAM tasya dharmasya manye
shlokas.14:
yayAtiruvAcha||
santi lokA bahavaste narendra; apyekaikaH sapta saptApyahAni |
madhuchyuto ghRRitapRRiktA vishokA;ste nAntavantaH pratipAlayanti
shlokas.15:
pratardana uvAcha||
tA.nste dadAmi mA prapata prapAtaM; ye me lokAstava te vai bhavantu |
yadyantarikShe yadi vA divi shritA;stAnAkrama kShipramapetamohaH
shlokas.16:
yayAtiruvAcha||
na tulyatejAH sukRRitaM kAmayeta; yogakShemaM pArthiva pArthivaH san |
daivAdeshAdApadaM prApya vidvAM;shcharennRRisha.nsaM na hi jAtu rAjA
shlokas.17:
dharmyaM mArgaM chetayAno yashasyaM; kuryAnnRRipo dharmamavekShamANaH |
na madvidho dharmabuddhiH prajAna;nkuryAdevaM kRRipaNaM mAM yathAttha
shlokas.18:
kuryAmapUrvaM na kRRitaM yadanyai;rvivitsamAnaH kimu tatra sAdhu |
bruvANamevaM nRRipatiM yayAtiM; nRRipottamo vasumanAbravIttam

shlokas.1:
vasumanA uvAcha||
pRRichChAmi tvAM vasumanA raushadashvi;ryadyasti loko divi mahyaM narendra |
yadyantarikShe prathito mahAtma;nkShetraj~naM tvAM tasya dharmasya manye
shlokas.2:
yayAtiruvAcha||
yadantarikShaM pRRithivI dishashcha; yattejasA tapate bhAnumA.nshcha |
lokAstAvanto divi sa.nsthitA vai; te nAntavantaH pratipAlayanti
shlokas.3:
vasumanA uvAcha||
tA.nste dadAmi pata mA prapAtaM; ye me lokAstava te vai bhavantu |
krINIShvainA.nstRRiNakenApi rAja;npratigrahaste yadi samyakpraduShTaH
shlokas.4:
yayAtiruvAcha||
na mithyAhaM vikrayaM vai smarAmi; vRRithA gRRihItaM shishukAchCha~NkamAnaH |
kuryAM na chaivAkRRitapUrvamanyai;rvivitsamAnaH kimu tatra sAdhu
shlokas.5:
vasumanA uvAcha||
tA.nstvaM lokAnpratipadyasva rAja;nmayA dattAnyadi neShTaH krayaste |
ahaM na tAnvai pratigantA narendra; sarve lokAstava te vai bhavantu
shlokas.6:
shibiruvAcha||
pRRichChAmi tvAM shibiraushInaro.ahaM; mamApi lokA yadi santIha tAta |
yadyantarikShe yadi vA divi shritAH; kShetraj~naM tvAM tasya dharmasya manye
shlokas.7:
yayAtiruvAcha||
na tvaM vAchA hRRidayenApi vidva;nparIpsamAnAnnAvama.nsthA narendra |
tenAnantA divi lokAH shritAste; vidyudrUpAH svanavanto mahAntaH
shlokas.8:
shibiruvAcha||
tA.nstvaM lokAnpratipadyasva rAja;nmayA dattAnyadi neShTaH krayaste |
na chAhaM tAnpratipatsyeha dattvA; yatra gatvA tvamupAsse ha lokAn
shlokas.9:
yayAtiruvAcha||
yathA tvamindrapratimaprabhAva;ste chApyanantA naradeva lokAH |
tathAdya loke na rame.anyadatte; tasmAchChibe nAbhinandAmi dAyam
shlokas.10:
aShTaka uvAcha||
na chedekaikasho rAja.NllokAnnaH pratinandasi |
sarve pradAya bhavate gantAro narakaM vayam
shlokas.11:
yayAtiruvAcha||
yadarhAya dadadhvaM tatsantaH satyAnRRisha.nsyataH |
ahaM tu nAbhidhRRiShNomi yatkRRitaM na mayA purA
shlokas.12:
aShTaka uvAcha||
kasyaite pratidRRishyante rathAH pa~ncha hiraNmayAH |
uchchaiH santaH prakAshante jvalanto.agnishikhA iva
shlokas.13:
yayAtiruvAcha||
yuShmAnete hi vakShyanti rathAH pa~ncha hiraNmayAH |
uchchaiH santaH prakAshante jvalanto.agnishikhA iva
shlokas.14:
aShTaka uvAcha||
AtiShThasva rathaM rAjanvikramasva vihAyasA |
vayamapyanuyAsyAmo yadA kAlo bhaviShyati
shlokas.15:
yayAtiruvAcha||
sarvairidAnIM gantavyaM sahasvargajito vayam |
eSha no virajAH panthA dRRishyate devasadmanaH
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te.adhiruhya rathAnsarve prayAtA nRRipasattamAH |
Akramanto divaM bhAbhirdharmeNAvRRitya rodasI
shlokas.17:
aShTaka uvAcha||
ahaM manye pUrvameko.asmi gantA; sakhA chendraH sarvathA me mahAtmA |
kasmAdevaM shibiraushInaro.aya;meko.atyagAtsarvavegena vAhAn
shlokas.18:
yayAtiruvAcha||
adadAddevayAnAya yAvadvittamavindata |
ushInarasya putro.ayaM tasmAchChreShTho hi naH shibiH
shlokas.19:
dAnaM tapaH satyamathApi dharmo; hrIH shrIH kShamA saumya tathA titikShA |
rAjannetAnyapratimasya rAj~naH; shibeH sthitAnyanRRisha.nsasya buddhyA
eva.nvRRitto hrIniShedhashcha yasmA;ttasmAchChibiratyagAdvai rathena
shlokas.20:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
athAShTakaH punarevAnvapRRichCha;nmAtAmahaM kautukAdindrakalpam |
pRRichChAmi tvAM nRRipate brUhi satyaM; kutashcha kasyAsi sutashcha kasya
kRRitaM tvayA yaddhi na tasya kartA; loke tvadanyaH kShatriyo brAhmaNo vA
shlokas.21:
yayAtiruvAcha||
yayAtirasmi nahuShasya putraH; pUroH pitA sArvabhaumastvihAsam |
guhyamarthaM mAmakebhyo bravImi; mAtAmaho.ahaM bhavatAM prakAshaH
shlokas.22:
sarvAmimAM pRRithivIM nirjigAya; prasthe baddhvA hyadadaM brAhmaNebhyaH |
medhyAnashvAnekashaphAnsurUpAM;stadA devAH puNyabhAjo bhavanti
shlokas.23:
adAmahaM pRRithivIM brAhmaNebhyaH; pUrNAmimAmakhilAM vAhanasya |
gobhiH suvarNena dhanaishcha mukhyai;statrAsangAH shatamarbudAni
shlokas.24:
satyena me dyaushcha vasundharA cha; tathaivAgnirjvalate mAnuSheShu |
na me vRRithA vyAhRRitameva vAkyaM; satyaM hi santaH pratipUjayanti
sarve cha devA munayashcha lokAH; satyena pUjyA iti me manogatam
shlokas.25:
yo naH svargajitaH sarvAnyathAvRRittaM nivedayet |
anasUyurdvijAgrebhyaH sa labhennaH salokatAm
shlokas.26:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM rAjA sa mahAtmA hyatIva; svairdauhitraistArito.amitrasAhaH |
tyaktvA mahIM paramodArakarmA; svargaM gataH karmabhirvyApya pRRithvIm

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
bhagava~nshrotumichChAmi pUrorva.nshakarAnnRRipAn |
yadvIryA yAdRRishAshchaiva yAvanto yatparAkramAH
shlokas.2:
na hyasmi~nshIlahIno vA nirvIryo vA narAdhipaH |
prajAvirahito vApi bhUtapUrvaH kadAchana
shlokas.3:
teShAM prathitavRRittAnAM rAj~nAM vij~nAnashAlinAm |
charitaM shrotumichChAmi vistareNa tapodhana
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
pUrorva.nshadharAnvIrA~nshakrapratimatejasaH
shlokas.5:
pravIreshvararaudrAshvAstrayaH putrA mahArathAH |
pUroH pauShTyAmajAyanta pravIrastatra va.nshakRRit
shlokas.6:
manasyurabhavattasmAchChUraH shyenIsutaH prabhuH |
pRRithivyAshchaturantAyA goptA rAjIvalochanaH
shlokas.7:
subhrUH saMhanano vAgmI sauvIrItanayAstrayaH |
manasyorabhavanputrAH shUrAH sarve mahArathAH
shlokas.8:
raudrAshvasya maheShvAsA dashApsarasi sUnavaH |
yajvAno jaj~nire shUrAH prajAvanto bahushrutAH
sarve sarvAstravidvA.nsaH sarve dharmaparAyaNAH
shlokas.9:
RRichepuratha kakShepuH kRRikaNepushcha vIryavAn |
sthaNDilepurvanepushcha sthalepushcha mahArathaH
shlokas.10:
tejepurbalavAndhImAnsatyepushchendravikramaH |
dharmepuH saMnatepushcha dashamo devavikramaH
anAdhRRiShTisutAstAta rAjasUyAshvamedhinaH
shlokas.11:
matinArastato rAjA vidvA.nshcharcheputo.abhavat |
matinArasutA rAja.nshchatvAro.amitavikramAH
ta.nsurmahAnatiratho druhyushchApratimadyutiH
shlokas.12:
teShAM ta.nsurmahAvIryaH pauravaM va.nshamudvahan |
AjahAra yasho dIptaM jigAya cha vasundharAm
shlokas.13:
ilinaM tu sutaM ta.nsurjanayAmAsa vIryavAn |
so.api kRRitsnAmimAM bhUmiM vijigye jayatAM varaH
shlokas.14:
rathantaryAM sutAnpa~ncha pa~nchabhUtopamA.nstataH |
ilino janayAmAsa duHShantaprabhRRitInnRRipa
shlokas.15:
duHShantaM shUrabhImau cha prapUrvaM vasumeva cha |
teShAM jyeShTho.abhavadrAjA duHShanto janamejaya
shlokas.16:
duHShantAdbharato jaj~ne vidvA~nshAkuntalo nRRipaH |
tasmAdbharatava.nshasya vipratasthe mahadyashaH
shlokas.17:
bharatastisRRiShu strIShu nava putrAnajIjanat |
nAbhyanandanta tAnrAjA nAnurUpA mametyuta
shlokas.18:
tato mahadbhiH kratubhirIjAno bharatastadA |
lebhe putraM bharadvAjAdbhumanyuM nAma bhArata
shlokas.19:
tataH putriNamAtmAnaM j~nAtvA pauravanandanaH |
bhumanyuM bharatashreShTha yauvarAjye.abhyaShechayat
shlokas.20:
tatastasya mahIndrasya vitathaH putrako.abhavat |
tataH sa vitatho nAma bhumanyorabhavatsutaH
shlokas.21:
suhotrashcha suhotA cha suhaviH suyajustathA |
puShkariNyAmRRichIkasya bhumanyorabhavansutAH
shlokas.22:
teShAM jyeShThaH suhotrastu rAjyamApa mahIkShitAm |
rAjasUyAshvamedhAdyaiH so.ayajadbahubhiH savaiH
shlokas.23:
suhotraH pRRithivIM sarvAM bubhuje sAgarAmbarAm |
pUrNAM hastigavAshvasya bahuratnasamAkulAm
shlokas.24:
mamajjeva mahI tasya bhUribhArAvapIDitA |
hastyashvarathasampUrNA manuShyakalilA bhRRisham
shlokas.25:
suhotre rAjani tadA dharmataH shAsati prajAH |
chaityayUpA~NkitA chAsIdbhUmiH shatasahasrashaH
pravRRiddhajanasasyA cha sahadevA vyarochata
shlokas.26:
aikShvAkI janayAmAsa suhotrAtpRRithivIpateH |
ajamIDhaM sumIDhaM cha purumIDhaM cha bhArata
shlokas.27:
ajamIDho varasteShAM tasminva.nshaH pratiShThitaH |
ShaTputrAnso.apyajanayattisRRiShu strIShu bhArata
shlokas.28:
RRikShaM dhUminyatho nIlI duHShantaparameShThinau |
keshinyajanayajjahnumubhau cha janarUpiNau
shlokas.29:
tatheme sarvapA~nchAlA duHShantaparameShThinoH |
anvayAH kushikA rAja~njahnoramitatejasaH
shlokas.30:
janarUpiNayorjyeShThamRRikShamAhurjanAdhipam |
RRikShAtsa.nvaraNo jaj~ne rAjanva.nshakarastava
shlokas.31:
ArkShe sa.nvaraNe rAjanprashAsati vasundharAm |
sa~NkShayaH sumahAnAsItprajAnAmiti shushrumaH
shlokas.32:
vyashIryata tato rAShTraM kShayairnAnAvidhaistathA |
kShunmRRityubhyAmanAvRRiShTyA vyAdhibhishcha samAhatam
abhyaghnanbhAratA.nshchaiva sapatnAnAM balAni cha
shlokas.33:
chAlayanvasudhAM chaiva balena chatura~NgiNA |
abhyayAttaM cha pA~nchAlyo vijitya tarasA mahIm
akShauhiNIbhirdashabhiH sa enaM samare.ajayat
shlokas.34:
tataH sadAraH sAmAtyaH saputraH sasuhRRijjanaH |
rAjA sa.nvaraNastasmAtpalAyata mahAbhayAt
shlokas.35:
sindhornadasya mahato niku~nje nyavasattadA |
nadIviShayaparyante parvatasya samIpataH
tatrAvasanbahUnkAlAnbhAratA durgamAshritAH
shlokas.36:
teShAM nivasatAM tatra sahasraM parivatsarAn |
athAbhyagachChadbharatAnvasiShTho bhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.37:
tamAgataM prayatnena pratyudgamyAbhivAdya cha |
arghyamabhyAhara.nstasmai te sarve bhAratAstadA
nivedya sarvamRRiShaye satkAreNa suvarchase
shlokas.38:
taM samAmaShTamImuShTaM rAjA vavre svayaM tadA |
purohito bhavAnno.astu rAjyAya prayatAmahe
omityevaM vasiShTho.api bhAratAnpratyapadyata
shlokas.39:
athAbhyaShi~nchatsAmrAjye sarvakShatrasya pauravam |
viShANabhUtaM sarvasyAM pRRithivyAmiti naH shrutam
shlokas.40:
bharatAdhyuShitaM pUrvaM so.adhyatiShThatpurottamam |
punarbalibhRRitashchaiva chakre sarvamahIkShitaH
shlokas.41:
tataH sa pRRithivIM prApya punarIje mahAbalaH |
AjamIDho mahAyaj~nairbahubhirbhUridakShiNaiH
shlokas.42:
tataH sa.nvaraNAtsaurI suShuve tapatI kurum |
rAjatve taM prajAH sarvA dharmaj~na iti vavrire
shlokas.43:
tasya nAmnAbhivikhyAtaM pRRithivyAM kurujA~Ngalam |
kurukShetraM sa tapasA puNyaM chakre mahAtapAH
shlokas.44:
ashvavantamabhiShvantaM tathA chitrarathaM munim |
janamejayaM cha vikhyAtaM putrA.nshchAsyAnushushrumaH
pa~nchaitAnvAhinI putrAnvyajAyata manasvinI
shlokas.45:
abhiShvataH parikShittu shabalAshvashcha vIryavAn |
abhirAjo virAjashcha shalmalashcha mahAbalaH
shlokas.46:
uchchaiHshravA bhadrakAro jitArishchAShTamaH smRRitaH |
eteShAmanvavAye tu khyAtAste karmajairguNaiH
shlokas.47:
janamejayAdayaH sapta tathaivAnye mahAbalAH |
parikShito.abhavanputrAH sarve dharmArthakovidAH
shlokas.48:
kakShasenograsenau cha chitrasenashcha vIryavAn |
indrasenaH suSheNashcha bhImasenashcha nAmataH
shlokas.49:
janamejayasya tanayA bhuvi khyAtA mahAbalAH |
dhRRitarAShTraH prathamajaH pANDurbAhlIka eva cha
shlokas.50:
niShadhashcha mahAtejAstathA jAmbUnado balI |
kuNDodaraH padAtishcha vasAtishchAShTamaH smRRitaH
sarve dharmArthakushalAH sarve bhUtahite ratAH
shlokas.51:
dhRRitarAShTro.atha rAjAsIttasya putro.atha kuNDikaH |
hastI vitarkaH krAthashcha kuNDalashchApi pa~nchamaH
haviHshravAstathendrAbhaH sumanyushchAparAjitaH
shlokas.52:
pratIpasya trayaH putrA jaj~nire bharatarShabha |
devApiH shantanushchaiva bAhlIkashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.53:
devApistu pravavrAja teShAM dharmaparIpsayA |
shantanushcha mahIM lebhe bAhlIkashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.54:
bharatasyAnvaye jAtAH sattvavanto mahArathAH |
devarShikalpA nRRipate bahavo rAjasattamAH
shlokas.55:
eva.nvidhAshchApyapare devakalpA mahArathAH |
jAtA manoranvavAye ailava.nshavivardhanAH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
shrutastvatto mayA vipra pUrveShAM sambhavo mahAn |
udArAshchApi va.nshe.asminrAjAno me parishrutAH
shlokas.2:
kiM tu laghvarthasa.nyuktaM priyAkhyAnaM na mAmati |
prINAtyato bhavAnbhUyo vistareNa bravItu me
shlokas.3:
etAmeva kathAM divyAmA prajApatito manoH |
teShAmAjananaM puNyaM kasya na prItimAvahet
shlokas.4:
saddharmaguNamAhAtmyairabhivardhitamuttamam |
viShTabhya lokA.nstrIneShAM yashaH sphItamavasthitam
shlokas.5:
guNaprabhAvavIryaujaHsattvotsAhavatAmaham |
na tRRipyAmi kathAM shRRiNvannamRRitAsvAdasaMmitAm
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjanpurA samya~NmayA dvaipAyanAchChrutam |
prochyamAnamidaM kRRitsnaM svava.nshajananaM shubham
shlokas.007:
dakShasyAditiH |
aditervivasvAn |
vivasvato manuH |
manorilA |
ilAyAH purUravAH |
purUravasa AyuH |
AyuSho nahuShaH |
nahuShasya yayAtiH
shlokas.008:
yayAterdve bhArye babhUvatuH |
ushanaso duhitA devayAnI vRRiShaparvaNashcha duhitA sharmiShThA nAma |
atrAnuva.nsho bhavati
shlokas.9:
yaduM cha turvasuM chaiva devayAnI vyajAyata |
druhyuM chAnuM cha pUruM cha sharmiShThA vArShaparvaNI
shlokas.011:
pUrorbhAryA kausalyA nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne janamejayo nAma |
yastrInashvamedhAnAjahAra |
vishvajitA cheShTvA vanaM pravivesha
shlokas.012:
janamejayaH khalvanantAM nAmopayeme mAdhavIm |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne prAchinvAn |
yaH prAchIM dishaM jigAya yAvatsUryodayAt |
tatastasya prAchinvatvam
shlokas.014:
sa.nyAtiH khalu dRRiShadvato duhitaraM varA~NgIM nAmopayeme |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne ahampAtiH
shlokas.015:
ahampAtistu khalu kRRitavIryaduhitaramupayeme bhAnumatIM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne sArvabhaumaH
shlokas.016:
sArvabhaumaH khalu jitvAjahAra kaikeyIM sunandAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne jayatsenaH
shlokas.017:
jayatsenaH khalu vaidarbhImupayeme suShuvAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne arAchInaH
shlokas.018:
arAchIno.api vaidarbhImevAparAmupayeme maryAdAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne mahAbhaumaH
shlokas.019:
mahAbhaumaH khalu prAsenajitImupayeme suyaj~nAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne ayutanAyI |
yaH puruShamedhAnAmayutamAnayat |
tadasyAyutanAyitvam
shlokas.020:
ayutanAyI khalu pRRithushravaso duhitaramupayeme bhAsAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne akrodhanaH
shlokas.021:
akrodhanaH khalu kAli~NgIM karaNDuM nAmopayeme |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne devAtithiH
shlokas.022:
devAtithiH khalu vaidehImupayeme maryAdAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne RRichaH
shlokas.023:
RRichaH khalvA~NgeyImupayeme sudevAM nAma |
tasyAM putramajanayadRRikSham
shlokas.024:
RRikShaH khalu takShakaduhitaramupayeme jvAlAM nAma |
tasyAM putraM matinAraM nAmotpAdayAmAsa
shlokas.026:
nivRRitte cha satre sarasvatyabhigamya taM bhartAraM varayAmAsa |
tasyAM putramajanayatta.nsuM nAma
shlokas.28:
ta.nsuM sarasvatI putraM matinArAdajIjanat |
ilinaM janayAmAsa kAlindyAM ta.nsurAtmajam
shlokas.030:
duHShantaH khalu vishvAmitraduhitaraM shakuntalAM nAmopayeme |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne bharataH |
tatra shlokau bhavataH
shlokas.31:
mAtA bhastrA pituH putro yena jAtaH sa eva saH |
bharasva putraM duHShanta mAvama.nsthAH shakuntalAm
shlokas.32:
retodhAH putra unnayati naradeva yamakShayAt |
tvaM chAsya dhAtA garbhasya satyamAha shakuntalA
shlokas.034:
bharataH khalu kAsheyImupayeme sArvasenIM sunandAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne bhumanyuH
shlokas.035:
bhumanyuH khalu dAshArhImupayeme jayAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne suhotraH
shlokas.036:
suhotraH khalvikShvAkukanyAmupayeme suvarNAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne hastI |
ya idaM hAstinapuraM mApayAmAsa |
etadasya hAstinapuratvam
shlokas.037:
hastI khalu traigartImupayeme yashodharAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne vikuNThanaH
shlokas.038:
vikuNThanaH khalu dAshArhImupayeme sudevAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne.ajamIDhaH
shlokas.039:
ajamIDhasya chaturvi.nshaM putrashataM babhUva kaikeyyAM nAgAyAM gAndhAryAM vimalAyAmRRikShAyAM cheti |
pRRithakpRRithagva.nshakarA nRRipatayaH |
tatra va.nshakaraH sa.nvaraNaH
shlokas.040:
sa.nvaraNaH khalu vaivasvatIM tapatIM nAmopayeme |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne kuruH
shlokas.041:
kuruH khalu dAshArhImupayeme shubhA~NgIM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne viDUrathaH
shlokas.042:
viDUrathastu mAgadhImupayeme sampriyAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne.arugvAnnAma
shlokas.043:
arugvAnkhalu mAgadhImupayeme.amRRitAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne parikShit
shlokas.044:
parikShitkhalu bAhudAmupayeme suyashAM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne bhImasenaH
shlokas.045:
bhImasenaH khalu kaikeyImupayeme sukumArIM nAma |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne paryashravAH |
yamAhuH pratIpaM nAma
shlokas.046:
pratIpaH khalu shaibyAmupayeme sunandAM nAma |
tasyAM putrAnutpAdayAmAsa devApiM shantanuM bAhlIkaM cheti
shlokas.047:
devApiH khalu bAla evAraNyaM pravivesha |
shantanustu mahIpAlo.abhavat |
atrAnuva.nsho bhavati
shlokas.48:
yaM yaM karAbhyAM spRRishati jIrNaM sa sukhamashnute |
punaryuvA cha bhavati tasmAttaM shantanuM viduH
shlokas.050:
shantanuH khalu ga~NgAM bhAgIrathImupayeme |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne devavrataH |
yamAhurbhIShma iti
shlokas.051:
bhIShmaH khalu pituH priyachikIrShayA satyavatImudavahanmAtaram |
yAmAhurgandhakAlIti
shlokas.052:
tasyAM kAnIno garbhaH parAsharAddvaipAyanaH |
tasyAmeva shantanordvau putrau babhUvatuH |
chitrA~Ngado vichitravIryashcha
shlokas.053:
tayoraprAptayauvana eva chitrA~Ngado gandharveNa hataH |
vichitravIryastu rAjA samabhavat
shlokas.056:
tataH satyavatI chintayAmAsa |
dauHShanto va.nsha uchChidyate iti
shlokas.058: sa tasyAH purataH sthitaH kiM karavANIti
shlokas.059:
sA tamuvAcha |
bhrAtA tavAnapatya eva svaryAto vichitravIryaH |
sAdhvapatyaM tasyotpAdayeti
shlokas.060: sa paramityuktvA trInputrAnutpAdayAmAsa dhRRitarAShTraM pANDuM viduraM cheti
shlokas.061: tatra dhRRitarAShTrasya rAj~naH putrashataM babhUva gAndhAryAM varadAnAddvaipAyanasya
shlokas.062: teShAM dhRRitarAShTrasya putrANAM chatvAraH pradhAnA babhUvurduryodhano duHshAsano vikarNashchitrasena iti
shlokas.063: pANDostu dve bhArye babhUvatuH kuntI mAdrI chetyubhe strIratne
shlokas.065:
sa bANaviddha uvAcha pANDum |
charatA dharmamimaM yena tvayAbhij~nena kAmarasasyAhamanavAptakAmaraso.abhihatastasmAttvamapyetAmavasthAmAsAdyAnavAptakAmarasaH pa~nchatvamApsyasi kShiprameveti
shlokas.066: sa vivarNarUpaH pANDuH shApaM pariharamANo nopAsarpata bhArye
shlokas.067:
vAkyaM chovAcha |
svachApalyAdidaM prAptavAnaham |
shRRiNomi cha nAnapatyasya lokA santIti
shlokas.069: sA tatra putrAnutpAdayAmAsa dharmAdyudhiShThiraM mArutAdbhImasenaM shakrAdarjunamiti
shlokas.070:
sa tAM hRRiShTarUpaH pANDuruvAcha |
iyaM te sapatnyanapatyA |
sAdhvasyAmapatyamutpAdyatAmiti
shlokas.077: tataste pa~ncha pANDavAH kuntyA sahitA hAstinapuramAnIya tApasairbhIShmasya vidurasya cha niveditAH
shlokas.078: tatrApi jatugRRihe dagdhuM samArabdhA na shakitA viduramantritena
shlokas.080: tasyAmapyekachakrAyAM bakaM nAma rAkShasaM hatvA pA~nchAlanagaramabhigatAH
shlokas.082:
putrA.nshchotpAdayAmAsuH |
prativindhyaM yudhiShThiraH |
sutasomaM vRRikodaraH |
shrutakIrtimarjunaH |
shatAnIkaM nakulaH |
shrutakarmANaM sahadeva iti
shlokas.083:
yudhiShThirastu govAsanasya shaibyasya devikAM nAma kanyAM svaya.nvare lebhe |
tasyAM putraM janayAmAsa yaudheyaM nAma
shlokas.084:
bhImaseno.api kAshyAM baladharAM nAmopayeme vIryashulkAm |
tasyAM putraM sarvagaM nAmotpAdayAmAsa
shlokas.085:
arjunaH khalu dvAravatIM gatvA bhaginIM vAsudevasya subhadrAM nAma bhAryAmudavahat |
tasyAM putramabhimanyuM nAma janayAmAsa
shlokas.086:
nakulastu chaidyAM kareNuvatIM nAma bhAryAmudavahat |
tasyAM putraM niramitraM nAmAjanayat
shlokas.087:
sahadevo.api mAdrImeva svaya.nvare vijayAM nAmopayeme |
tasyAM putramajanayatsuhotraM nAma
shlokas.088: bhImasenastu pUrvameva hiDimbAyAM rAkShasyAM ghaTotkachaM nAma putraM janayAmAsa
shlokas.091:
tamutsa~Ngena pratijagrAha pRRithA niyogAtpuruShottamasya vAsudevasya |
ShANmAsikaM garbhamahamenaM jIvayiShyAmIti
shlokas.092:
sa~njIvayitvA chainamuvAcha |
parikShINe kule jAto bhavatvayaM parikShinnAmeti
shlokas.093:
parikShittu khalu mAdravatIM nAmopayeme |
tasyAmasya janamejayaH
shlokas.094: janamejayAttu vapuShTamAyAM dvau putrau shatAnIkaH sha~Nkushcha
shlokas.095:
shatAnIkastu khalu vaidehImupayeme |
tasyAmasya jaj~ne putro.ashvamedhadattaH
shlokas.96:
ityeSha pUrorva.nshastu pANDavAnAM cha kIrtitaH |
pUrorva.nshamimaM shrutvA sarvapApaiH pramuchyate

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ikShvAkuva.nshaprabhavo rAjAsItpRRithivIpatiH |
mahAbhiSha iti khyAtaH satyavAksatyavikramaH
shlokas.2:
so.ashvamedhasahasreNa vAjapeyashatena cha |
toShayAmAsa devendraM svargaM lebhe tataH prabhuH
shlokas.3:
tataH kadAchidbrahmANamupAsAM chakrire surAH |
tatra rAjarShayo Asansa cha rAjA mahAbhiShaH
shlokas.4:
atha ga~NgA sarichChreShThA samupAyAtpitAmaham |
tasyA vAsaH samuddhUtaM mArutena shashiprabham
shlokas.5:
tato.abhavansuragaNAH sahasAvA~NmukhAstadA |
mahAbhiShastu rAjarShirasha~Nko dRRiShTavAnnadIm
shlokas.6:
apadhyAto bhagavatA brahmaNA sa mahAbhiShaH |
uktashcha jAto martyeShu punarlokAnavApsyasi
shlokas.7:
sa chintayitvA nRRipatirnRRipAnsarvA.nstapodhanAn |
pratIpaM rochayAmAsa pitaraM bhUrivarchasam
shlokas.8:
mahAbhiShaM tu taM dRRiShTvA nadI dhairyAchchyutaM nRRipam |
tameva manasAdhyAyamupAvartatsaridvarA
shlokas.9:
sA tu vidhvastavapuShaH kashmalAbhihataujasaH |
dadarsha pathi gachChantI vasUndevAndivaukasaH
shlokas.10:
tathArUpA.nshcha tAndRRiShTvA paprachCha saritAM varA |
kimidaM naShTarUpAH stha kachchitkShemaM divaukasAm
shlokas.11:
tAmUchurvasavo devAH shaptAH smo vai mahAnadi |
alpe.aparAdhe sa.nrambhAdvasiShThena mahAtmanA
shlokas.12:
vimUDhA hi vayaM sarve prachChannamRRiShisattamam |
sandhyAM vasiShThamAsInaM tamatyabhisRRitAH purA
shlokas.13:
tena kopAdvayaM shaptA yonau sambhavateti ha |
na shakyamanyathA kartuM yaduktaM brahmavAdinA
shlokas.14:
tvaM tasmAnmAnuShI bhUtvA sUShva putrAnvasUnbhuvi |
na mAnuShINAM jaTharaM pravishemAshubhaM vayam
shlokas.15:
ityuktA tAnvasUnga~NgA tathetyuktvAbravIdidam |
martyeShu puruShashreShThaH ko vaH kartA bhaviShyati
shlokas.16:
vasava UchuH||
pratIpasya suto rAjA shantanurnAma dhArmikaH |
bhavitA mAnuShe loke sa naH kartA bhaviShyati
shlokas.17:
ga~NgovAcha||
mamApyevaM mataM devA yathAvadata mAnaghAH |
priyaM tasya kariShyAmi yuShmAkaM chaitadIpshitam
shlokas.18:
vasava UchuH||
jAtAnkumArAnsvAnapsu prakSheptuM vai tvamarhasi |
yathA nachirakAlaM no niShkRRitiH syAttrilokage
shlokas.19:
ga~NgovAcha||
evametatkariShyAmi putrastasya vidhIyatAm |
nAsya moghaH sa~NgamaH syAtputrahetormayA saha
shlokas.20:
vasava UchuH||
turIyArdhaM pradAsyAmo vIryasyaikaikasho vayam |
tena vIryeNa putraste bhavitA tasya chepsitaH
shlokas.21:
na sampatsyati martyeShu punastasya tu santatiH |
tasmAdaputraH putraste bhaviShyati sa vIryavAn
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM te samayaM kRRitvA ga~NgayA vasavaH saha |
jagmuH prahRRiShTamanaso yathAsa~Nkalpama~njasA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH pratIpo rAjA sa sarvabhUtahite rataH |
niShasAda samA bahvIrga~NgAtIragato japan
shlokas.2:
tasya rUpaguNopetA ga~NgA shrIriva rUpiNI |
uttIrya salilAttasmAllobhanIyatamAkRRitiH
shlokas.3:
adhIyAnasya rAjarSherdivyarUpA manasvinI |
dakShiNaM shAlasa~NkAshamUruM bheje shubhAnanA
shlokas.4:
pratIpastu mahIpAlastAmuvAcha manasvinIm |
karavANi kiM te kalyANi priyaM yatte.abhikA~NkShitam
shlokas.5:
stryuvAcha||
tvAmahaM kAmaye rAjankurushreShTha bhajasva mAm |
tyAgaH kAmavatInAM hi strINAM sadbhirvigarhitaH
shlokas.6:
pratIpa uvAcha||
nAhaM parastriyaM kAmAdgachCheyaM varavarNini |
na chAsavarNAM kalyANi dharmyaM tadviddhi me vratam
shlokas.7:
stryuvAcha||
nAshreyasyasmi nAgamyA na vaktavyA cha karhichit |
bhaja mAM bhajamAnAM tvaM rAjankanyAM varastriyam
shlokas.8:
pratIpa uvAcha||
mayAtivRRittametatte yanmAM chodayasi priyam |
anyathA pratipannaM mAM nAshayeddharmaviplavaH
shlokas.9:
prApya dakShiNamUruM me tvamAshliShTA varA~Ngane |
apatyAnAM snuShANAM cha bhIru viddhyetadAsanam
shlokas.10:
savyataH kAminIbhAgastvayA sa cha vivarjitaH |
tasmAdahaM nAchariShye tvayi kAmaM varA~Ngane
shlokas.11:
snuShA me bhava kalyANi putrArthe tvAM vRRiNomyaham |
snuShApakShaM hi vAmoru tvamAgamya samAshritA
shlokas.12:
stryuvAcha||
evamapyastu dharmaj~na sa.nyujyeyaM sutena te |
tvadbhaktyaiva bhajiShyAmi prakhyAtaM bhArataM kulam
shlokas.13:
pRRithivyAM pArthivA ye cha teShAM yUyaM parAyaNam |
guNA na hi mayA shakyA vaktuM varShashatairapi
kulasya ye vaH prasthitAstatsAdhutvamanuttamam
shlokas.14:
sa me nAbhijanaj~naH syAdAchareyaM cha yadvibho |
tatsarvameva putraste na mImA.nseta karhichit
shlokas.15:
evaM vasantI putre te vardhayiShyAmyahaM priyam |
putraiH puNyaiH priyaishchApi svargaM prApsyati te sutaH
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathetyuktvA tu sA rAja.nstatraivAntaradhIyata |
putrajanma pratIkSha.nstu sa rAjA tadadhArayat
shlokas.17:
etasminneva kAle tu pratIpaH kShatriyarShabhaH |
tapastepe sutasyArthe sabhAryaH kurunandana
shlokas.18:
tayoH samabhavatputro vRRiddhayoH sa mahAbhiShaH |
shAntasya jaj~ne santAnastasmAdAsItsa shantanuH
shlokas.19:
sa.nsmara.nshchAkShayA.NllokAnvijitAnsvena karmaNA |
puNyakarmakRRidevAsIchChantanuH kurusattama
shlokas.20:
pratIpaH shantanuM putraM yauvanasthaM tato.anvashAt |
purA mAM strI samabhyAgAchChantano bhUtaye tava
shlokas.21:
tvAmAvrajedyadi rahaH sA putra varavarNinI |
kAmayAnAbhirUpADhyA divyA strI putrakAmyayA
sA tvayA nAnuyoktavyA kAsi kasyAsi vA~Ngane
shlokas.22:
yachcha kuryAnna tatkAryaM praShTavyA sA tvayAnagha |
manniyogAdbhajantIM tAM bhajethA ityuvAcha tam
shlokas.23:
evaM sa.ndishya tanayaM pratIpaH shantanuM tadA |
sve cha rAjye.abhiShichyainaM vanaM rAjA vivesha ha
shlokas.24:
sa rAjA shantanurdhImAnkhyAtaH pRRithvyAM dhanurdharaH |
babhUva mRRigayAshIlaH satataM vanagocharaH
shlokas.25:
sa mRRigAnmahiShA.nshchaiva vinighnanrAjasattamaH |
ga~NgAmanuchachAraikaH siddhachAraNasevitAm
shlokas.26:
sa kadAchinmahArAja dadarsha paramastriyam |
jAjvalyamAnAM vapuShA sAkShAtpadmAmiva shriyam
shlokas.27:
sarvAnavadyAM sudatIM divyAbharaNabhUShitAm |
sUkShmAmbaradharAmekAM padmodarasamaprabhAm
shlokas.28:
tAM dRRiShTvA hRRiShTaromAbhUdvismito rUpasampadA |
pibanniva cha netrAbhyAM nAtRRipyata narAdhipaH
shlokas.29:
sA cha dRRiShTvaiva rAjAnaM vicharantaM mahAdyutim |
snehAdAgatasauhArdA nAtRRipyata vilAsinI
shlokas.30:
tAmuvAcha tato rAjA sAntvaya~nshlakShNayA girA |
devI vA dAnavI vA tvaM gandharvI yadi vApsarAH
shlokas.31:
yakShI vA pannagI vApi mAnuShI vA sumadhyame |
yA vA tvaM suragarbhAbhe bhAryA me bhava shobhane
shlokas.32:
etachChrutvA vacho rAj~naH sasmitaM mRRidu valgu cha |
vasUnAM samayaM smRRitvA abhyagachChadaninditA
shlokas.33:
uvAcha chaiva rAj~naH sA hlAdayantI mano girA |
bhaviShyAmi mahIpAla mahiShI te vashAnugA
shlokas.34:
yattu kuryAmahaM rAja~nshubhaM vA yadi vAshubham |
na tadvArayitavyAsmi na vaktavyA tathApriyam
shlokas.35:
evaM hi vartamAne.ahaM tvayi vatsyAmi pArthiva |
vAritA vipriyaM choktA tyajeyaM tvAmasa.nshayam
shlokas.36:
tatheti rAj~nA sA tUktA tadA bharatasattama |
praharShamatulaM lebhe prApya taM pArthivottamam
shlokas.37:
AsAdya shantanustAM cha bubhuje kAmato vashI |
na praShTavyeti manvAno na sa tAM ki~nchidUchivAn
shlokas.38:
sa tasyAH shIlavRRittena rUpaudAryaguNena cha |
upachAreNa cha rahastutoSha jagatIpatiH
shlokas.39:
divyarUpA hi sA devI ga~NgA tripathagA nadI |
mAnuShaM vigrahaM shrImatkRRitvA sA varavarNinI
shlokas.40:
bhAgyopanatakAmasya bhAryevopasthitAbhavat |
shantano rAjasiMhasya devarAjasamadyuteH
shlokas.41:
sambhogasnehachAturyairhAvalAsyairmanoharaiH |
rAjAnaM ramayAmAsa yathA reme tathaiva saH
shlokas.42:
sa rAjA ratisaktatvAduttamastrIguNairhRRitaH |
sa.nvatsarAnRRitUnmAsAnna bubodha bahUngatAn
shlokas.43:
ramamANastayA sArdhaM yathAkAmaM janeshvaraH |
aShTAvajanayatputrA.nstasyAmamaravarNinaH
shlokas.44:
jAtaM jAtaM cha sA putraM kShipatyambhasi bhArata |
prINAmi tvAhamityuktvA ga~NgAsrotasyamajjayat
shlokas.45:
tasya tanna priyaM rAj~naH shantanorabhavattadA |
na cha tAM ki~nchanovAcha tyAgAdbhIto mahIpatiH
shlokas.46:
atha tAmaShTame putre jAte prahasitAmiva |
uvAcha rAjA duHkhArtaH parIpsanputramAtmanaH
shlokas.47:
mA vadhIH kAsi kasyAsi kiM hi.nsasi sutAniti |
putraghni sumahatpApaM mA prApastiShTha garhite
shlokas.48:
stryuvAcha||
putrakAma na te hanmi putraM putravatAM vara |
jIrNastu mama vAso.ayaM yathA sa samayaH kRRitaH
shlokas.49:
ahaM ga~NgA jahnusutA maharShigaNasevitA |
devakAryArthasiddhyarthamuShiTAhaM tvayA saha
shlokas.50:
aShTeme vasavo devA mahAbhAgA mahaujasaH |
vasiShThashApadoSheNa mAnuShatvamupAgatAH
shlokas.51:
teShAM janayitA nAnyastvadRRite bhuvi vidyate |
madvidhA mAnuShI dhAtrI na chaivAstIha kAchana
shlokas.53:
devAnAM samayastveSha vasUnAM sa.nshruto mayA |
jAtaM jAtaM mokShayiShye janmato mAnuShAditi
shlokas.54:
tatte shApAdvinirmuktA Apavasya mahAtmanaH |
svasti te.astu gamiShyAmi putraM pAhi mahAvratam
shlokas.55:
eSha paryAyavAso me vasUnAM saMnidhau kRRitaH |
matprasUtaM vijAnIhi ga~NgAdattamimaM sutam

shlokas.1:
shantanuruvAcha||
Apavo nAma ko nveSha vasUnAM kiM cha duShkRRitam |
yasyAbhishApAtte sarve mAnuShIM tanumAgatAH
shlokas.2:
anena cha kumAreNa ga~NgAdattena kiM kRRitam |
yasya chaiva kRRitenAyaM mAnuSheShu nivatsyati
shlokas.3:
IshAnAH sarvalokasya vasavaste cha vai katham |
mAnuSheShUdapadyanta tanmamAchakShva jAhnavi
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
saivamuktA tato ga~NgA rAjAnamidamabravIt |
bhartAraM jAhnavI devI shantanuM puruSharShabham
shlokas.5:
yaM lebhe varuNaH putraM purA bharatasattama |
vasiShTho nAma sa muniH khyAta Apava ityuta
shlokas.6:
tasyAshramapadaM puNyaM mRRigapakShigaNAnvitam |
meroH pArshve nagendrasya sarvartukusumAvRRitam
shlokas.7:
sa vAruNistapastepe tasminbharatasattama |
vane puNyakRRitAM shreShThaH svAdumUlaphalodake
shlokas.8:
dakShasya duhitA yA tu surabhItyatigarvitA |
gAM prajAtA tu sA devI kashyapAdbharatarShabha
shlokas.9:
anugrahArthaM jagataH sarvakAmadughAM varAm |
tAM lebhe gAM tu dharmAtmA homadhenuM sa vAruNiH
shlokas.10:
sA tasmi.nstApasAraNye vasantI munisevite |
chachAra ramye dharmye cha gaurapetabhayA tadA
shlokas.11:
atha tadvanamAjagmuH kadAchidbharatarShabha |
pRRithvAdyA vasavaH sarve devadevarShisevitam
shlokas.12:
te sadArA vanaM tachcha vyacharanta samantataH |
remire ramaNIyeShu parvateShu vaneShu cha
shlokas.13:
tatraikasya tu bhAryA vai vasorvAsavavikrama |
sA charantI vane tasmingAM dadarsha sumadhyamA
yA sA vasiShThasya muneH sarvakAmadhuguttamA
shlokas.14:
sA vismayasamAviShTA shIladraviNasampadA |
dive vai darshayAmAsa tAM gAM govRRiShabhekShaNa
shlokas.15:
svApInAM cha sudogdhrIM cha suvAladhimukhAM shubhAm |
upapannAM guNaiH sarvaiH shIlenAnuttamena cha
shlokas.16:
eva~NguNasamAyuktAM vasave vasunandinI |
darshayAmAsa rAjendra purA pauravanandana
shlokas.17:
dyaustadA tAM tu dRRiShTvaiva gAM gajendrendravikrama |
uvAcha rAja.nstAM devIM tasyA rUpaguNAnvadan
shlokas.18:
eShA gauruttamA devi vAruNerasitekShaNe |
RRiShestasya varArohe yasyedaM vanamuttamam
shlokas.19:
asyAH kShIraM pibenmartyaH svAdu yo vai sumadhyame |
dasha varShasahasrANi sa jIvetsthirayauvanaH
shlokas.20:
etachChrutvA tu sA devI nRRipottama sumadhyamA |
tamuvAchAnavadyA~NgI bhartAraM dIptatejasam
shlokas.21:
asti me mAnuShe loke naradevAtmajA sakhI |
nAmnA jinavatI nAma rUpayauvanashAlinI
shlokas.22:
ushInarasya rAjarSheH satyasandhasya dhImataH |
duhitA prathitA loke mAnuShe rUpasampadA
shlokas.23:
tasyA hetormahAbhAga savatsAM gAM mamepsitAm |
AnayasvAmarashreShTha tvaritaM puNyavardhana
shlokas.24:
yAvadasyAH payaH pItvA sA sakhI mama mAnada |
mAnuSheShu bhavatvekA jarArogavivarjitA
shlokas.25:
etanmama mahAbhAga kartumarhasyanindita |
priyaM priyataraM hyasmAnnAsti me.anyatkatha~nchana
shlokas.26:
etachChrutvA vachastasyA devyAH priyachikIrShayA |
pRRithvAdyairbhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM dyaustadA tAM jahAra gAm
shlokas.27:
tayA kamalapatrAkShyA niyukto dyaustadA nRRipa |
RRiShestasya tapastIvraM na shashAka nirIkShitum
hRRitA gauH sA tadA tena prapAtastu na tarkitaH
shlokas.28:
athAshramapadaM prAptaH phalAnyAdAya vAruNiH |
na chApashyata gAM tatra savatsAM kAnanottame
shlokas.29:
tataH sa mRRigayAmAsa vane tasmi.nstapodhanaH |
nAdhyagachChachcha mRRigaya.nstAM gAM munirudAradhIH
shlokas.30:
j~nAtvA tathApanItAM tAM vasubhirdivyadarshanaH |
yayau krodhavashaM sadyaH shashApa cha vasU.nstadA
shlokas.31:
yasmAnme vasavo jahrurgAM vai dogdhrIM suvAladhim |
tasmAtsarve janiShyanti mAnuSheShu na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.32:
evaM shashApa bhagavAnvasU.nstAnmunisattamaH |
vashaM kopasya samprApta Apavo bharatarShabha
shlokas.33:
shaptvA cha tAnmahAbhAgastapasyeva mano dadhe |
evaM sa shaptavAnrAjanvasUnaShTau tapodhanaH
mahAprabhAvo brahmarShirdevAnroShasamanvitaH
shlokas.34:
athAshramapadaM prApya taM sma bhUyo mahAtmanaH |
shaptAH sma iti jAnanta RRiShiM tamupachakramuH
shlokas.35:
prasAdayantastamRRiShiM vasavaH pArthivarShabha |
na lebhire cha tasmAtte prasAdamRRiShisattamAt
ApavAtpuruShavyAghra sarvadharmavishAradAt
shlokas.36:
uvAcha cha sa dharmAtmA sapta yUyaM dharAdayaH |
anu sa.nvatsarAchChApamokShaM vai samavApsyatha
shlokas.37:
ayaM tu yatkRRite yUyaM mayA shaptAH sa vatsyati |
dyaustadA mAnuShe loke dIrghakAlaM svakarmaNA
shlokas.38:
nAnRRitaM tachchikIrShAmi yuShmAnkruddho yadabruvam |
na prajAsyati chApyeSha mAnuSheShu mahAmanAH
shlokas.39:
bhaviShyati cha dharmAtmA sarvashAstravishAradaH |
pituH priyahite yuktaH strIbhogAnvarjayiShyati
evamuktvA vasUnsarvA~njagAma bhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.40:
tato mAmupajagmuste samastA vasavastadA |
ayAchanta cha mAM rAjanvaraM sa cha mayA kRRitaH
jAtA~njAtAnprakShipAsmAnsvayaM ga~Nge tvamambhasi
shlokas.41:
evaM teShAmahaM samyakShaptAnAM rAjasattama |
mokShArthaM mAnuShAllokAdyathAvatkRRitavatyaham
shlokas.42:
ayaM shApAdRRiShestasya eka eva nRRipottama |
dyau rAjanmAnuShe loke chiraM vatsyati bhArata
shlokas.43:
etadAkhyAya sA devI tatraivAntaradhIyata |
AdAya cha kumAraM taM jagAmAtha yathepsitam
shlokas.44:
sa tu devavrato nAma gA~Ngeya iti chAbhavat |
dvinAmA shantanoH putraH shantanoradhiko guNaiH
shlokas.45:
shantanushchApi shokArto jagAma svapuraM tataH |
tasyAhaM kIrtayiShyAmi shantanoramitAnguNAn
shlokas.46:
mahAbhAgyaM cha nRRipaterbhAratasya yashasvinaH |
yasyetihAso dyutimAnmahAbhAratamuchyate

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa evaM shantanurdhImAndevarAjarShisatkRRitaH |
dharmAtmA sarvalokeShu satyavAgiti vishrutaH
shlokas.2:
damo dAnaM kShamA buddhirhrIrdhRRitisteja uttamam |
nityAnyAsanmahAsattve shantanau puruSharShabhe
shlokas.3:
evaM sa guNasampanno dharmArthakushalo nRRipaH |
AsIdbharatava.nshasya goptA sAdhujanasya cha
shlokas.4:
kambugrIvaH pRRithuvya.nso mattavAraNavikramaH |
dharma eva paraH kAmAdarthAchcheti vyavasthitaH
shlokas.5:
etAnyAsanmahAsattve shantanau bharatarShabha |
na chAsya sadRRishaH kashchitkShatriyo dharmato.abhavat
shlokas.6:
vartamAnaM hi dharme sve sarvadharmavidAM varam |
taM mahIpA mahIpAlaM rAjarAjye.abhyaShechayan
shlokas.7:
vItashokabhayAbAdhAH sukhasvapnavibodhanAH |
prati bhAratagoptAraM samapadyanta bhUmipAH
shlokas.8:
shantanupramukhairgupte loke nRRipatibhistadA |
niyamAtsarvavarNAnAM brahmottaramavartata
shlokas.9:
brahma paryacharatkShatraM vishaH kShatramanuvratAH |
brahmakShatrAnuraktAshcha shUdrAH paryacharanvishaH
shlokas.10:
sa hAstinapure ramye kurUNAM puTabhedane |
vasansAgaraparyantAmanvashAdvai vasundharAm
shlokas.11:
sa devarAjasadRRisho dharmaj~naH satyavAgRRijuH |
dAnadharmatapoyogAchChriyA paramayA yutaH
shlokas.12:
arAgadveShasa.nyuktaH somavatpriyadarshanaH |
tejasA sUryasa~NkAsho vAyuvegasamo jave
antakapratimaH kope kShamayA pRRithivIsamaH
shlokas.13:
vadhaH pashuvarAhANAM tathaiva mRRigapakShiNAm |
shantanau pRRithivIpAle nAvartata vRRithA nRRipa
shlokas.14:
dharmabrahmottare rAjye shantanurvinayAtmavAn |
samaM shashAsa bhUtAni kAmarAgavivarjitaH
shlokas.15:
devarShipitRRiyaj~nArthamArabhyanta tadA kriyAH |
na chAdharmeNa keShA~nchitprANinAmabhavadvadhaH
shlokas.16:
asukhAnAmanAthAnAM tiryagyoniShu vartatAm |
sa eva rAjA bhUtAnAM sarveShAmabhavatpitA
shlokas.17:
tasminkurupatishreShThe rAjarAjeshvare sati |
shritA vAgabhavatsatyaM dAnadharmAshritaM manaH
shlokas.18:
sa samAH ShoDashAShTau cha chatasro.aShTau tathAparAH |
ratimaprApnuvanstrIShu babhUva vanagocharaH
shlokas.19:
tathArUpastathAchArastathAvRRittastathAshrutaH |
gA~Ngeyastasya putro.abhUnnAmnA devavrato vasuH
shlokas.20:
sarvAstreShu sa niShNAtaH pArthiveShvitareShu cha |
mahAbalo mahAsattvo mahAvIryo mahArathaH
shlokas.21:
sa kadAchinmRRigaM viddhvA ga~NgAmanusarannadIm |
bhAgIrathImalpajalAM shantanurdRRiShTavAnnRRipaH
shlokas.22:
tAM dRRiShTvA chintayAmAsa shantanuH puruSharShabhaH |
syandate kiM nviyaM nAdya sarichChreShThA yathA purA
shlokas.23:
tato nimittamanvichChandadarsha sa mahAmanAH |
kumAraM rUpasampannaM bRRihantaM chArudarshanam
shlokas.24:
divyamastraM vikurvANaM yathA devaM pura.ndaram |
kRRitsnAM ga~NgAM samAvRRitya sharaistIkShNairavasthitam
shlokas.25:
tAM sharairAvRRitAM dRRiShTvA nadIM ga~NgAM tadantike |
abhavadvismito rAjA karma dRRiShTvAtimAnuSham
shlokas.26:
jAtamAtraM purA dRRiShTaM taM putraM shantanustadA |
nopalebhe smRRitiM dhImAnabhij~nAtuM tamAtmajam
shlokas.27:
sa tu taM pitaraM dRRiShTvA mohayAmAsa mAyayA |
saMmohya tu tataH kShipraM tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.28:
tadadbhutaM tadA dRRiShTvA tatra rAjA sa shantanuH |
sha~NkamAnaH sutaM ga~NgAmabravIddarshayeti ha
shlokas.29:
darshayAmAsa taM ga~NgA bibhratI rUpamuttamam |
gRRihItvA dakShiNe pANau taM kumAramala~NkRRitam
shlokas.30:
ala~NkRRitAmAbharaNairarajombaradhAriNIm |
dRRiShTapUrvAmapi satIM nAbhyajAnAtsa shantanuH
shlokas.31:
ga~NgovAcha||
yaM putramaShTamaM rAja.nstvaM purA mayyajAyithAH |
sa te.ayaM puruShavyAghra nayasvainaM gRRihAntikam
shlokas.32:
vedAnadhijage sA~NgAnvasiShThAdeva vIryavAn |
kRRitAstraH parameShvAso devarAjasamo yudhi
shlokas.33:
surANAM saMmato nityamasurANAM cha bhArata |
ushanA veda yachChAstramayaM tadveda sarvashaH
shlokas.34:
tathaivA~NgirasaH putraH surAsuranamaskRRitaH |
yadveda shAstraM tachchApi kRRitsnamasminpratiShThitam
tava putre mahAbAhau sA~NgopA~NgaM mahAtmani
shlokas.35:
RRiShiH parairanAdhRRiShyo jAmadagnyaH pratApavAn |
yadastraM veda rAmashcha tadapyasminpratiShThitam
shlokas.36:
maheShvAsamimaM rAjanrAjadharmArthakovidam |
mayA dattaM nijaM putraM vIraM vIra gRRihAnnaya
shlokas.37:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tayaivaM samanuj~nAtaH putramAdAya shantanuH |
bhrAjamAnaM yathAdityamAyayau svapuraM prati
shlokas.38:
pauravaH svapuraM gatvA pura.ndarapuropamam |
sarvakAmasamRRiddhArthaM mene AtmAnamAtmanA
pauraveShu tataH putraM yauvarAjye.abhyaShechayat
shlokas.39:
pauravA~nshantanoH putraH pitaraM cha mahAyashAH |
rAShTraM cha ra~njayAmAsa vRRittena bharatarShabha
shlokas.40:
sa tathA saha putreNa ramamANo mahIpatiH |
vartayAmAsa varShANi chatvAryamitavikramaH
shlokas.41:
sa kadAchidvanaM yAto yamunAmabhito nadIm |
mahIpatiranirdeshyamAjighradgandhamuttamam
shlokas.42:
tasya prabhavamanvichChanvichachAra samantataH |
sa dadarsha tadA kanyAM dAshAnAM devarUpiNIm
shlokas.43:
tAmapRRichChatsa dRRiShTvaiva kanyAmasitalochanAm |
kasya tvamasi kA chAsi kiM cha bhIru chikIrShasi
shlokas.44:
sAbravIddAshakanyAsmi dharmArthaM vAhaye tarIm |
piturniyogAdbhadraM te dAsharAj~no mahAtmanaH
shlokas.45:
rUpamAdhuryagandhaistAM sa.nyuktAM devarUpiNIm |
samIkShya rAjA dAsheyIM kAmayAmAsa shantanuH
shlokas.46:
sa gatvA pitaraM tasyA varayAmAsa tAM tadA |
paryapRRichChattatastasyAH pitaraM chAtmakAraNAt
shlokas.47:
sa cha taM pratyuvAchedaM dAsharAjo mahIpatim |
jAtamAtraiva me deyA varAya varavarNinI
hRRidi kAmastu me kashchittaM nibodha janeshvara
shlokas.48:
yadImAM dharmapatnIM tvaM mattaH prArthayase.anagha |
satyavAgasi satyena samayaM kuru me tataH
shlokas.49:
samayena pradadyAM te kanyAmahamimAM nRRipa |
na hi me tvatsamaH kashchidvaro jAtu bhaviShyati
shlokas.50:
shantanuruvAcha||
shrutvA tava varaM dAsha vyavasyeyamahaM na vA |
dAtavyaM chetpradAsyAmi na tvadeyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.51:
dAsha uvAcha||
asyAM jAyeta yaH putraH sa rAjA pRRithivIpatiH |
tvadUrdhvamabhiShektavyo nAnyaH kashchana pArthiva
shlokas.52:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
nAkAmayata taM dAtuM varaM dAshAya shantanuH |
sharIrajena tIvreNa dahyamAno.api bhArata
shlokas.53:
sa chintayanneva tadA dAshakanyAM mahIpatiH |
pratyayAddhAstinapuraM shokopahatachetanaH
shlokas.54:
tataH kadAchichChochantaM shantanuM dhyAnamAsthitam |
putro devavrato.abhyetya pitaraM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.55:
sarvato bhavataH kShemaM vidheyAH sarvapArthivAH |
tatkimarthamihAbhIkShNaM parishochasi duHkhitaH
dhyAyanniva cha kiM rAjannAbhibhAShasi ki~nchana
shlokas.56:
evamuktaH sa putreNa shantanuH pratyabhAShata |
asa.nshayaM dhyAnaparaM yathA mAttha tathAsmyuta
shlokas.57:
apatyaM nastvamevaikaH kule mahati bhArata |
anityatA cha martyAnAmataH shochAmi putraka
shlokas.58:
katha~nchittava gA~Ngeya vipattau nAsti naH kulam |
asa.nshayaM tvamevaikaH shatAdapi varaH sutaH
shlokas.59:
na chApyahaM vRRithA bhUyo dArAnkartumihotsahe |
santAnasyAvinAshAya kAmaye bhadramastu te
anapatyataikaputratvamityAhurdharmavAdinaH
shlokas.60:
agnihotraM trayo vedA yaj~nAshcha sahadakShiNAH |
sarvANyetAnyapatyasya kalAM nArhanti ShoDashIm
shlokas.61:
evameva manuShyeShu syAchcha sarvaprajAsvapi |
yadapatyaM mahAprAj~na tatra me nAsti sa.nshayaH
eShA trayI purANAnAmuttamAnAM cha shAshvatI
shlokas.62:
tvaM cha shUraH sadAmarShI shastranityashcha bhArata |
nAnyatra shastrAttasmAtte nidhanaM vidyate.anagha
shlokas.63:
so.asmi sa.nshayamApannastvayi shAnte kathaM bhavet |
iti te kAraNaM tAta duHkhasyoktamasheShataH
shlokas.64:
tatastatkAraNaM j~nAtvA kRRitsnaM chaivamasheShataH |
devavrato mahAbuddhiH prayayAvanuchintayan
shlokas.66:
tasmai sa kurumukhyAya yathAvatparipRRichChate |
varaM shasha.nsa kanyAM tAmuddishya bharatarShabha
shlokas.67:
tato devavrato vRRiddhaiH kShatriyaiH sahitastadA |
abhigamya dAsharAjAnaM kanyAM vavre pituH svayam
shlokas.68:
taM dAshaH pratijagrAha vidhivatpratipUjya cha |
abravIchchainamAsInaM rAjasa.nsadi bhArata
shlokas.69:
tvameva nAthaH paryAptaH shantanoH puruSharShabha |
putraH putravatAM shreShThaH kiM nu vakShyAmi te vachaH
shlokas.70:
ko hi sambandhakaM shlAghyamIpsitaM yaunamIdRRisham |
atikrAmanna tapyeta sAkShAdapi shatakratuH
shlokas.71:
apatyaM chaitadAryasya yo yuShmAkaM samo guNaiH |
yasya shukrAtsatyavatI prAdurbhUtA yashasvinI
shlokas.72:
tena me bahushastAta pitA te parikIrtitaH |
arhaH satyavatIM voDhuM sarvarAjasu bhArata
shlokas.73:
asito hyapi devarShiH pratyAkhyAtaH purA mayA |
satyavatyA bhRRishaM hyarthI sa AsIdRRiShisattamaH
shlokas.74:
kanyApitRRitvAtki~nchittu vakShyAmi bharatarShabha |
balavatsapatnatAmatra doShaM pashyAmi kevalam
shlokas.75:
