yasya hi tvaM sapatnaH syA gandharvasyAsurasya vA |
na sa jAtu sukhaM jIvettvayi kruddhe parantapa
shlokas.76:
etAvAnatra doSho hi nAnyaH kashchana pArthiva |
etajjAnIhi bhadraM te dAnAdAne parantapa
shlokas.77:
evamuktastu gA~NgeyastadyuktaM pratyabhAShata |
shRRiNvatAM bhUmipAlAnAM piturarthAya bhArata
shlokas.78:
idaM me matamAdatsva satyaM satyavatAM vara |
naiva jAto na vAjAta IdRRishaM vaktumutsahet
shlokas.79:
evametatkariShyAmi yathA tvamanubhAShase |
yo.asyAM janiShyate putraH sa no rAjA bhaviShyati
shlokas.80:
ityuktaH punarevAtha taM dAshaH pratyabhAShata |
chikIrShurduShkaraM karma rAjyArthe bharatarShabha
shlokas.81:
tvameva nAthaH paryAptaH shantanoramitadyuteH |
kanyAyAshchaiva dharmAtmanprabhurdAnAya cheshvaraH
shlokas.82:
idaM tu vachanaM saumya kAryaM chaiva nibodha me |
kaumArikANAM shIlena vakShyAmyahamari.ndama
shlokas.83:
yattvayA satyavatyarthe satyadharmaparAyaNa |
rAjamadhye pratij~nAtamanurUpaM tavaiva tat
shlokas.84:
nAnyathA tanmahAbAho sa.nshayo.atra na kashchana |
tavApatyaM bhavedyattu tatra naH sa.nshayo mahAn
shlokas.85:
tasya tanmatamAj~nAya satyadharmaparAyaNaH |
pratyajAnAttadA rAjanpituH priyachikIrShayA
shlokas.86:
devavrata uvAcha||
dAsharAja nibodhedaM vachanaM me nRRipottama |
shRRiNvatAM bhUmipAlAnAM yadbravImi pituH kRRite
shlokas.87:
rAjyaM tAvatpUrvameva mayA tyaktaM narAdhipa |
apatyahetorapi cha karomyeSha vinishchayam
shlokas.88:
adya prabhRRiti me dAsha brahmacharyaM bhaviShyati |
aputrasyApi me lokA bhaviShyantyakShayA divi
shlokas.89:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA samprahRRiShTatanUruhaH |
dadAnItyeva taM dAsho dharmAtmA pratyabhAShata
shlokas.90:
tato.antarikShe.apsaraso devAH sarShigaNAstathA |
abhyavarShanta kusumairbhIShmo.ayamiti chAbruvan
shlokas.91:
tataH sa piturarthAya tAmuvAcha yashasvinIm |
adhiroha rathaM mAtargachChAvaH svagRRihAniti
shlokas.92:
evamuktvA tu bhIShmastAM rathamAropya bhAminIm |
Agamya hAstinapuraM shantanoH saMnyavedayat
shlokas.93:
tasya tadduShkaraM karma prashasha.nsurnarAdhipAH |
sametAshcha pRRithakchaiva bhIShmo.ayamiti chAbruvan
shlokas.94:
taddRRiShTvA duShkaraM karma kRRitaM bhIShmeNa shantanuH |
svachChandamaraNaM tasmai dadau tuShTaH pitA svayam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato vivAhe nirvRRitte sa rAjA shantanurnRRipaH |
tAM kanyAM rUpasampannAM svagRRihe saMnyaveshayat
shlokas.2:
tataH shAntanavo dhImAnsatyavatyAmajAyata |
vIrashchitrA~Ngado nAma vIryeNa manujAnati
shlokas.3:
athAparaM maheShvAsaM satyavatyAM punaH prabhuH |
vichitravIryaM rAjAnaM janayAmAsa vIryavAn
shlokas.4:
aprAptavati tasmi.nshcha yauvanaM bharatarShabha |
sa rAjA shantanurdhImAnkAladharmamupeyivAn
shlokas.5:
svargate shantanau bhIShmashchitrA~Ngadamari.ndamam |
sthApayAmAsa vai rAjye satyavatyA mate sthitaH
shlokas.6:
sa tu chitrA~NgadaH shauryAtsarvA.nshchikShepa pArthivAn |
manuShyaM na hi mene sa ka~nchitsadRRishamAtmanaH
shlokas.7:
taM kShipantaM surA.nshchaiva manuShyAnasurA.nstathA |
gandharvarAjo balavA.nstulyanAmAbhyayAttadA
tenAsya sumahadyuddhaM kurukShetre babhUva ha
shlokas.8:
tayorbalavatostatra gandharvakurumukhyayoH |
nadyAstIre hiraNvatyAH samAstisro.abhavadraNaH
shlokas.9:
tasminvimarde tumule shastravRRiShTisamAkule |
mAyAdhiko.avadhIdvIraM gandharvaH kurusattamam
shlokas.10:
chitrA~NgadaM kurushreShThaM vichitrasharakArmukam |
antAya kRRitvA gandharvo divamAchakrame tataH
shlokas.11:
tasminnRRipatishArdUle nihate bhUrivarchasi |
bhIShmaH shAntanavo rAjanpretakAryANyakArayat
shlokas.12:
vichitravIryaM cha tadA bAlamaprAptayauvanam |
kururAjye mahAbAhurabhyaShi~nchadanantaram
shlokas.13:
vichitravIryastu tadA bhIShmasya vachane sthitaH |
anvashAsanmahArAja pitRRipaitAmahaM padam
shlokas.14:
sa dharmashAstrakushalo bhIShmaM shAntanavaM nRRipaH |
pUjayAmAsa dharmeNa sa chainaM pratyapAlayat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
hate chitrA~Ngade bhIShmo bAle bhrAtari chAnagha |
pAlayAmAsa tadrAjyaM satyavatyA mate sthitaH
shlokas.2:
samprAptayauvanaM pashyanbhrAtaraM dhImatAM varam |
bhIShmo vichitravIryasya vivAhAyAkaronmatim
shlokas.3:
atha kAshipaterbhIShmaH kanyAstisro.apsaraHsamAH |
shushrAva sahitA rAjanvRRiNvatIrvai svayaM varam
shlokas.4:
tataH sa rathinAM shreShTho rathenaikena varmabhRRit |
jagAmAnumate mAtuH purIM vArANasIM prati
shlokas.5:
tatra rAj~naH samuditAnsarvataH samupAgatAn |
dadarsha kanyAstAshchaiva bhIShmaH shantanunandanaH
shlokas.6:
kIrtyamAneShu rAj~nAM tu nAmasvatha sahasrashaH |
bhIShmaH svayaM tadA rAjanvarayAmAsa tAH prabhuH
shlokas.7:
uvAcha cha mahIpAlAnrAja~njaladaniHsvanaH |
rathamAropya tAH kanyA bhIShmaH praharatAM varaH
shlokas.8:
AhUya dAnaM kanyAnAM guNavadbhyaH smRRitaM budhaiH |
ala~NkRRitya yathAshakti pradAya cha dhanAnyapi
shlokas.9:
prayachChantyapare kanyAM mithunena gavAmapi |
vittena kathitenAnye balenAnye.anumAnya cha
shlokas.10:
pramattAmupayAntyanye svayamanye cha vindate |
aShTamaM tamatho vitta vivAhaM kavibhiH smRRitam
shlokas.11:
svaya.nvaraM tu rAjanyAH prasha.nsantyupayAnti cha |
pramathya tu hRRitAmAhurjyAyasIM dharmavAdinaH
shlokas.12:
tA imAH pRRithivIpAlA jihIrShAmi balAditaH |
te yatadhvaM paraM shaktyA vijayAyetarAya vA
sthito.ahaM pRRithivIpAlA yuddhAya kRRitanishchayaH
shlokas.13:
evamuktvA mahIpAlAnkAshirAjaM cha vIryavAn |
sarvAH kanyAH sa kauravyo rathamAropayatsvakam
Amantrya cha sa tAnprAyAchChIghraM kanyAH pragRRihya tAH
shlokas.14:
tataste pArthivAH sarve samutpeturamarShitAH |
sa.nspRRishantaH svakAnbAhUndashanto dashanachChadAn
shlokas.15:
teShAmAbharaNAnyAshu tvaritAnAM vimu~nchatAm |
Amu~nchatAM cha varmANi sambhramaH sumahAnabhUt
shlokas.16:
tArANAmiva sampAto babhUva janamejaya |
bhUShaNAnAM cha shubhrANAM kavachAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.17:
savarmabhirbhUShaNaiste drAgbhrAjadbhiritastataH |
sakrodhAmarShajihmabhrUsakaShAyadRRishastathA
shlokas.18:
sUtopakL^iptAnruchirAnsadashvodyatadhUrgatAn |
rathAnAsthAya te vIrAH sarvapraharaNAnvitAH
prayAntamekaM kauravyamanusasrurudAyudhAH
shlokas.19:
tataH samabhavadyuddhaM teShAM tasya cha bhArata |
ekasya cha bahUnAM cha tumulaM lomaharShaNam
shlokas.20:
te tviShUndashasAhasrA.nstasmai yugapadAkShipan |
aprAptA.nshchaiva tAnAshu bhIShmaH sarvA.nstadAchChinat
shlokas.21:
tataste pArthivAH sarve sarvataH parivArayan |
vavarShuH sharavarSheNa varSheNevAdrimambudAH
shlokas.22:
sa tadbANamayaM varShaM sharairAvArya sarvataH |
tataH sarvAnmahIpAlAnpratyavidhyattribhistribhiH
shlokas.23:
tasyAti puruShAnanyA.NllAghavaM rathachAriNaH |
rakShaNaM chAtmanaH sa~Nkhye shatravo.apyabhyapUjayan
shlokas.24:
tAnvinirjitya tu raNe sarvashastravishAradaH |
kanyAbhiH sahitaH prAyAdbhArato bhAratAnprati
shlokas.25:
tatastaM pRRiShThato rAja~nshAlvarAjo mahArathaH |
abhyAhanadameyAtmA bhIShmaM shAntanavaM raNe
shlokas.26:
vAraNaM jaghane nighnandantAbhyAmaparo yathA |
vAshitAmanusamprApto yUthapo balinAM varaH
shlokas.27:
strIkAma tiShTha tiShTheti bhIShmamAha sa pArthivaH |
shAlvarAjo mahAbAhuramarSheNAbhichoditaH
shlokas.28:
tataH sa puruShavyAghro bhIShmaH parabalArdanaH |
tadvAkyAkulitaH krodhAdvidhUmo.agniriva jvalan
shlokas.29:
kShatradharmaM samAsthAya vyapetabhayasambhramaH |
nivartayAmAsa rathaM shAlvaM prati mahArathaH
shlokas.30:
nivartamAnaM taM dRRiShTvA rAjAnaH sarva eva te |
prekShakAH samapadyanta bhIShmashAlvasamAgame
shlokas.31:
tau vRRiShAviva nardantau balinau vAshitAntare |
anyonyamabhivartetAM balavikramashAlinau
shlokas.32:
tato bhIShmaM shAntanavaM sharaiH shatasahasrashaH |
shAlvarAjo narashreShThaH samavAkiradAshugaiH
shlokas.33:
pUrvamabhyarditaM dRRiShTvA bhIShmaM shAlvena te nRRipAH |
vismitAH samapadyanta sAdhu sAdhviti chAbruvan
shlokas.34:
lAghavaM tasya te dRRiShTvA sa.nyuge sarvapArthivAH |
apUjayanta saMhRRiShTA vAgbhiH shAlvaM narAdhipAH
shlokas.35:
kShatriyANAM tadA vAchaH shrutvA parapura~njayaH |
kruddhaH shAntanavo bhIShmastiShTha tiShThetyabhAShata
shlokas.36:
sArathiM chAbravItkruddho yAhi yatraiSha pArthivaH |
yAvadenaM nihanmyadya bhuja~Ngamiva pakShirAT
shlokas.37:
tato.astraM vAruNaM samyagyojayAmAsa kauravaH |
tenAshvA.nshchaturo.amRRidnAchChAlvarAj~no narAdhipa
shlokas.38:
astrairastrANi sa.nvArya shAlvarAj~naH sa kauravaH |
bhIShmo nRRipatishArdUla nyavadhIttasya sArathim
astreNa chApyathaikena nyavadhItturagottamAn
shlokas.39:
kanyAhetornarashreShTha bhIShmaH shAntanavastadA |
jitvA visarjayAmAsa jIvantaM nRRipasattamam
tataH shAlvaH svanagaraM prayayau bharatarShabha
shlokas.40:
rAjAno ye cha tatrAsansvaya.nvaradidRRikShavaH |
svAnyeva te.api rAShTrANi jagmuH parapura~njaya
shlokas.41:
evaM vijitya tAH kanyA bhIShmaH praharatAM varaH |
prayayau hAstinapuraM yatra rAjA sa kauravaH
shlokas.42:
so.achireNaiva kAlena atyakrAmannarAdhipa |
vanAni saritashchaiva shailA.nshcha vividhadrumAn
shlokas.43:
akShataH kShapayitvArInsa~Nkhye.asa~NkhyeyavikramaH |
AnayAmAsa kAshyasya sutAH sAgaragAsutaH
shlokas.44:
snuShA iva sa dharmAtmA bhaginya iva chAnujAH |
yathA duhitarashchaiva pratigRRihya yayau kurUn
shlokas.45:
tAH sarvA guNasampannA bhrAtA bhrAtre yavIyase |
bhIShmo vichitravIryAya pradadau vikramAhRRitAH
shlokas.46:
satAM dharmeNa dharmaj~naH kRRitvA karmAtimAnuSham |
bhrAturvichitravIryasya vivAhAyopachakrame
satyavatyA saha mithaH kRRitvA nishchayamAtmavAn
shlokas.47:
vivAhaM kArayiShyantaM bhIShmaM kAshipateH sutA |
jyeShThA tAsAmidaM vAkyamabravIddha satI tadA
shlokas.48:
mayA saubhapatiH pUrvaM manasAbhivRRitaH patiH |
tena chAsmi vRRitA pUrvameSha kAmashcha me pituH
shlokas.49:
mayA varayitavyo.abhUchChAlvastasminsvaya.nvare |
etadvij~nAya dharmaj~na tatastvaM dharmamAchara
shlokas.50:
evamuktastayA bhIShmaH kanyayA viprasa.nsadi |
chintAmabhyagamadvIro yuktAM tasyaiva karmaNaH
shlokas.51:
sa vinishchitya dharmaj~no brAhmaNairvedapAragaiH |
anujaj~ne tadA jyeShTAmambAM kAshipateH sutAm
shlokas.52:
ambikAmbAlike bhArye prAdAdbhrAtre yavIyase |
bhIShmo vichitravIryAya vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.53:
tayoH pANiM gRRihItvA sa rUpayauvanadarpitaH |
vichitravIryo dharmAtmA kAmAtmA samapadyata
shlokas.54:
te chApi bRRihatI shyAme nIlaku~nchitamUrdhaje |
raktatu~Nganakhopete pInashroNipayodhare
shlokas.55:
AtmanaH pratirUpo.asau labdhaH patiriti sthite |
vichitravIryaM kalyANaM pUjayAmAsatustu te
shlokas.56:
sa chAshvirUpasadRRisho devasattvaparAkramaH |
sarvAsAmeva nArINAM chittapramathano.abhavat
shlokas.57:
tAbhyAM saha samAH sapta viharanpRRithivIpatiH |
vichitravIryastaruNo yakShmANaM samapadyata
shlokas.58:
suhRRidAM yatamAnAnAmAptaiH saha chikitsakaiH |
jagAmAstamivAdityaH kauravyo yamasAdanam
shlokas.59:
pretakAryANi sarvANi tasya samyagakArayat |
rAj~no vichitravIryasya satyavatyA mate sthitaH
RRitvigbhiH sahito bhIShmaH sarvaishcha kurupu~NgavaiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH satyavatI dInA kRRipaNA putragRRiddhinI |
putrasya kRRitvA kAryANi snuShAbhyAM saha bhArata
shlokas.2:
dharmaM cha pitRRiva.nshaM cha mAtRRiva.nshaM cha mAninI |
prasamIkShya mahAbhAgA gA~NgeyaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.3:
shantanordharmanityasya kauravyasya yashasvinaH |
tvayi piNDashcha kIrtishcha santAnaM cha pratiShThitam
shlokas.4:
yathA karma shubhaM kRRitvA svargopagamanaM dhruvam |
yathA chAyurdhruvaM satye tvayi dharmastathA dhruvaH
shlokas.5:
vettha dharmA.nshcha dharmaj~na samAsenetareNa cha |
vividhAstvaM shrutIrvettha vettha vedA.nshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.6:
vyavasthAnaM cha te dharme kulAchAraM cha lakShaye |
pratipattiM cha kRRichChreShu shukrA~Ngirasayoriva
shlokas.7:
tasmAtsubhRRishamAshvasya tvayi dharmabhRRitAM vara |
kArye tvAM viniyokShyAmi tachChrutvA kartumarhasi
shlokas.8:
mama putrastava bhrAtA vIryavAnsupriyashcha te |
bAla eva gataH svargamaputraH puruSharShabha
shlokas.9:
ime mahiShyau bhrAtuste kAshirAjasute shubhe |
rUpayauvanasampanne putrakAme cha bhArata
shlokas.10:
tayorutpAdayApatyaM santAnAya kulasya naH |
manniyogAnmahAbhAga dharmaM kartumihArhasi
shlokas.11:
rAjye chaivAbhiShichyasva bhAratAnanushAdhi cha |
dArA.nshcha kuru dharmeNa mA nimajjIH pitAmahAn
shlokas.12:
tathochyamAno mAtrA cha suhRRidbhishcha parantapaH |
pratyuvAcha sa dharmAtmA dharmyamevottaraM vachaH
shlokas.13:
asa.nshayaM paro dharmastvayA mAtarudAhRRitaH |
tvamapatyaM prati cha me pratij~nAM vettha vai parAm
shlokas.14:
jAnAsi cha yathAvRRittaM shulkahetostvadantare |
sa satyavati satyaM te pratijAnAmyahaM punaH
shlokas.15:
parityajeyaM trailokyaM rAjyaM deveShu vA punaH |
yadvApyadhikametAbhyAM na tu satyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.16:
tyajechcha pRRithivI gandhamApashcha rasamAtmanaH |
jyotistathA tyajedrUpaM vAyuH sparshaguNaM tyajet
shlokas.17:
prabhAM samutsRRijedarko dhUmaketustathoShNatAm |
tyajechChabdaM tathAkAshaH somaH shItA.nshutAM tyajet
shlokas.18:
vikramaM vRRitrahA jahyAddharmaM jahyAchcha dharmarAT |
na tvahaM satyamutsraShTuM vyavaseyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.19:
evamuktA tu putreNa bhUridraviNatejasA |
mAtA satyavatI bhIShmamuvAcha tadanantaram
shlokas.20:
jAnAmi te sthitiM satye parAM satyaparAkrama |
ichChansRRijethAstrI.NllokAnanyA.nstvaM svena tejasA
shlokas.21:
jAnAmi chaiva satyaM tanmadarthaM yadabhAShathAH |
ApaddharmamavekShasva vaha paitAmahIM dhuram
shlokas.22:
yathA te kulatantushcha dharmashcha na parAbhavet |
suhRRidashcha prahRRiShyera.nstathA kuru parantapa
shlokas.23:
lAlapyamAnAM tAmevaM kRRipaNAM putragRRiddhinIm |
dharmAdapetaM bruvatIM bhIShmo bhUyo.abravIdidam
shlokas.24:
rAj~ni dharmAnavekShasva mA naH sarvAnvyanInashaH |
satyAchchyutiH kShatriyasya na dharmeShu prashasyate
shlokas.25:
shantanorapi santAnaM yathA syAdakShayaM bhuvi |
tatte dharmaM pravakShyAmi kShAtraM rAj~ni sanAtanam
shlokas.26:
shrutvA taM pratipadyethAH prAj~naiH saha purohitaiH |
ApaddharmArthakushalairlokatantramavekShya cha

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
jAmadagnyena rAmeNa piturvadhamamRRiShyatA |
kruddhena cha mahAbhAge haihayAdhipatirhataH
shatAni dasha bAhUnAM nikRRittAnyarjunasya vai
shlokas.2:
punashcha dhanurAdAya mahAstrANi pramu~nchatA |
nirdagdhaM kShatramasakRRidrathena jayatA mahIm
shlokas.3:
evamuchchAvachairastrairbhArgaveNa mahAtmanA |
triHsaptakRRitvaH pRRithivI kRRitA niHkShatriyA purA
shlokas.4:
tataH sambhUya sarvAbhiH kShatriyAbhiH samantataH |
utpAditAnyapatyAni brAhmaNairniyatAtmabhiH
shlokas.5:
pANigrAhasya tanaya iti vedeShu nishchitam |
dharmaM manasi sa.nsthApya brAhmaNA.nstAH samabhyayuH
loke.apyAcharito dRRiShTaH kShatriyANAM punarbhavaH
shlokas.6:
athotathya iti khyAta AsIddhImAnRRiShiH purA |
mamatA nAma tasyAsIdbhAryA paramasaMmatA
shlokas.7:
utathyasya yavIyA.nstu purodhAstridivaukasAm |
bRRihaspatirbRRihattejA mamatAM so.anvapadyata
shlokas.8:
uvAcha mamatA taM tu devaraM vadatAM varam |
antarvatnI ahaM bhrAtrA jyeShThenAramyatAmiti
shlokas.9:
ayaM cha me mahAbhAga kukShAveva bRRihaspate |
autathyo vedamatraiva ShaDa~NgaM pratyadhIyata
shlokas.10:
amogharetAstvaM chApi nUnaM bhavitumarhasi |
tasmAdeva~Ngate.adya tvamupAramitumarhasi
shlokas.11:
evamuktastayA samyagbRRihattejA bRRihaspatiH |
kAmAtmAnaM tadAtmAnaM na shashAka niyachChitum
shlokas.12:
sambabhUva tataH kAmI tayA sArdhamakAmayA |
utsRRijantaM tu taM retaH sa garbhastho.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.13:
bhostAta kanyasa vade dvayornAstyatra sambhavaH |
amoghashukrashcha bhavAnpUrvaM chAhamihAgataH
shlokas.14:
shashApa taM tataH kruddha evamukto bRRihaspatiH |
utathyaputraM garbhasthaM nirbhartsya bhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.15:
yasmAttvamIdRRishe kAle sarvabhUtepsite sati |
evamAttha vachastasmAttamo dIrghaM pravekShyasi
shlokas.16:
sa vai dIrghatamA nAma shApAdRRiShirajAyata |
bRRihaspaterbRRihatkIrterbRRihaspatirivaujasA
shlokas.17:
sa putrA~njanayAmAsa gautamAdInmahAyashAH |
RRiSherutathyasya tadA santAnakulavRRiddhaye
shlokas.18:
lobhamohAbhibhUtAste putrAstaM gautamAdayaH |
kAShThe samudge prakShipya ga~NgAyAM samavAsRRijan
shlokas.19:
na syAdandhashcha vRRiddhashcha bhartavyo.ayamiti sma te |
chintayitvA tataH krUrAH pratijagmuratho gRRihAn
shlokas.20:
so.anusrotastadA rAjanplavamAna RRiShistataH |
jagAma subahUndeshAnandhastenoDupena ha
shlokas.21:
taM tu rAjA balirnAma sarvadharmavishAradaH |
apashyanmajjanagataH srotasAbhyAshamAgatam
shlokas.22:
jagrAha chainaM dharmAtmA baliH satyaparAkramaH |
j~nAtvA chainaM sa vavre.atha putrArthaM manujarShabha
shlokas.23:
santAnArthaM mahAbhAga bhAryAsu mama mAnada |
putrAndharmArthakushalAnutpAdayitumarhasi
shlokas.24:
evamuktaH sa tejasvI taM tathetyuktavAnRRiShiH |
tasmai sa rAjA svAM bhAryAM sudeShNAM prAhiNottadA
shlokas.25:
andhaM vRRiddhaM cha taM matvA na sA devI jagAma ha |
svAM tu dhAtreyikAM tasmai vRRiddhAya prAhiNottadA
shlokas.26:
tasyAM kAkShIvadAdInsa shUdrayonAvRRiShirvashI |
janayAmAsa dharmAtmA putrAnekAdashaiva tu
shlokas.27:
kAkShIvadAdInputrA.nstAndRRiShTvA sarvAnadhIyataH |
uvAcha tamRRiShiM rAjA mamaita iti vIryavAn
shlokas.28:
netyuvAcha maharShistaM mamaivaita iti bruvan |
shUdrayonau mayA hIme jAtAH kAkShIvadAdayaH
shlokas.29:
andhaM vRRiddhaM cha mAM matvA sudeShNA mahiShI tava |
avamanya dadau mUDhA shUdrAM dhAtreyikAM hi me
shlokas.30:
tataH prasAdayAmAsa punastamRRiShisattamam |
baliH sudeShNAM bhAryAM cha tasmai tAM prAhiNotpunaH
shlokas.31:
tAM sa dIrghatamA~NgeShu spRRiShTvA devImathAbravIt |
bhaviShyati kumAraste tejasvI satyavAgiti
shlokas.32:
tatrA~Ngo nAma rAjarShiH sudeShNAyAmajAyata |
evamanye maheShvAsA brAhmaNaiH kShatriyA bhuvi
shlokas.33:
jAtAH paramadharmaj~nA vIryavanto mahAbalAH |
etachChrutvA tvamapyatra mAtaH kuru yathepsitam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
punarbharatava.nshasya hetuM santAnavRRiddhaye |
vakShyAmi niyataM mAtastanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.2:
brAhmaNo guNavAnkashchiddhanenopanimantryatAm |
vichitravIryakShetreShu yaH samutpAdayetprajAH
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH satyavatI bhIShmaM vAchA sa.nsajjamAnayA |
vihasantIva savrIDamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.4:
satyametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi bhArata |
vishvAsAtte pravakShyAmi santAnAya kulasya cha
na te shakyamanAkhyAtumApaddhIyaM tathAvidhA
shlokas.5:
tvameva naH kule dharmastvaM satyaM tvaM parA gatiH |
tasmAnnishamya vAkyaM me kuruShva yadanantaram
shlokas.6:
dharmayuktasya dharmAtmanpiturAsIttarI mama |
sA kadAchidahaM tatra gatA prathamayauvane
shlokas.7:
atha dharmabhRRitAM shreShThaH paramarShiH parAsharaH |
AjagAma tarIM dhImA.nstariShyanyamunAM nadIm
shlokas.8:
sa tAryamANo yamunAM mAmupetyAbravIttadA |
sAntvapUrvaM munishreShThaH kAmArto madhuraM bahu
shlokas.9:
tamahaM shApabhItA cha piturbhItA cha bhArata |
varairasulabhairuktA na pratyAkhyAtumutsahe
shlokas.10:
abhibhUya sa mAM bAlAM tejasA vashamAnayat |
tamasA lokamAvRRitya naugatAmeva bhArata
shlokas.11:
matsyagandho mahAnAsItpurA mama jugupsitaH |
tamapAsya shubhaM gandhamimaM prAdAtsa me muniH
shlokas.12:
tato mAmAha sa munirgarbhamutsRRijya mAmakam |
dvIpe.asyA eva saritaH kanyaiva tvaM bhaviShyasi
shlokas.13:
pArAsharyo mahAyogI sa babhUva mahAnRRiShiH |
kanyAputro mama purA dvaipAyana iti smRRitaH
shlokas.14:
yo vyasya vedA.nshchaturastapasA bhagavAnRRiShiH |
loke vyAsatvamApede kArShNyAtkRRiShNatvameva cha
shlokas.15:
satyavAdI shamaparastapasvI dagdhakilbiShaH |
sa niyukto mayA vyaktaM tvayA cha amitadyute
bhrAtuH kShetreShu kalyANamapatyaM janayiShyati
shlokas.16:
sa hi mAmuktavA.nstatra smareH kRRityeShu mAmiti |
taM smariShye mahAbAho yadi bhIShma tvamichChasi
shlokas.17:
tava hyanumate bhIShma niyataM sa mahAtapAH |
vichitravIryakShetreShu putrAnutpAdayiShyati
shlokas.18:
maharSheH kIrtane tasya bhIShmaH prA~njalirabravIt |
dharmamarthaM cha kAmaM cha trInetAnyo.anupashyati
shlokas.19:
arthamarthAnubandhaM cha dharmaM dharmAnubandhanam |
kAmaM kAmAnubandhaM cha viparItAnpRRithakpRRithak
yo vichintya dhiyA samyagvyavasyati sa buddhimAn
shlokas.20:
tadidaM dharmayuktaM cha hitaM chaiva kulasya naH |
uktaM bhavatyA yachChreyaH paramaM rochate mama
shlokas.21:
tatastasminpratij~nAte bhIShmeNa kurunandana |
kRRiShNadvaipAyanaM kAlI chintayAmAsa vai munim
shlokas.22:
sa vedAnvibruvandhImAnmAturvij~nAya chintitam |
prAdurbabhUvAviditaH kShaNena kurunandana
shlokas.23:
tasmai pUjAM tadA dattvA sutAya vidhipUrvakam |
pariShvajya cha bAhubhyAM prasnavairabhiShichya cha
mumocha bAShpaM dAsheyI putraM dRRiShTvA chirasya tam
shlokas.24:
tAmadbhiH pariShichyArtAM maharShirabhivAdya cha |
mAtaraM pUrvajaH putro vyAso vachanamabravIt
shlokas.25:
bhavatyA yadabhipretaM tadahaM kartumAgataH |
shAdhi mAM dharmatattvaj~ne karavANi priyaM tava
shlokas.26:
tasmai pUjAM tato.akArShItpurodhAH paramarShaye |
sa cha tAM pratijagrAha vidhivanmantrapUrvakam
shlokas.27:
tamAsanagataM mAtA pRRiShTvA kushalamavyayam |
satyavatyabhivIkShyainamuvAchedamanantaram
shlokas.28:
mAtApitroH prajAyante putrAH sAdhAraNAH kave |
teShAM pitA yathA svAmI tathA mAtA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.29:
vidhAtRRivihitaH sa tvaM yathA me prathamaH sutaH |
vichitravIryo brahmarShe tathA me.avarajaH sutaH
shlokas.30:
yathaiva pitRRito bhIShmastathA tvamapi mAtRRitaH |
bhrAtA vichitravIryasya yathA vA putra manyase
shlokas.31:
ayaM shAntanavaH satyaM pAlayansatyavikramaH |
buddhiM na kurute.apatye tathA rAjyAnushAsane
shlokas.32:
sa tvaM vyapekShayA bhrAtuH santAnAya kulasya cha |
bhIShmasya chAsya vachanAnniyogAchcha mamAnagha
shlokas.33:
anukroshAchcha bhUtAnAM sarveShAM rakShaNAya cha |
AnRRisha.nsyena yadbrUyAM tachChrutvA kartumarhasi
shlokas.34:
yavIyasastava bhrAturbhArye surasutopame |
rUpayauvanasampanne putrakAme cha dharmataH
shlokas.35:
tayorutpAdayApatyaM samartho hyasi putraka |
anurUpaM kulasyAsya santatyAH prasavasya cha
shlokas.36:
vyAsa uvAcha||
vettha dharmaM satyavati paraM chAparameva cha |
yathA cha tava dharmaj~ne dharme praNihitA matiH
shlokas.37:
tasmAdahaM tvanniyogAddharmamuddishya kAraNam |
IpsitaM te kariShyAmi dRRiShTaM hyetatpurAtanam
shlokas.38:
bhrAtuH putrAnpradAsyAmi mitrAvaruNayoH samAn |
vrataM charetAM te devyau nirdiShTamiha yanmayA
shlokas.39:
sa.nvatsaraM yathAnyAyaM tataH shuddhe bhaviShyataH |
na hi mAmavratopetA upeyAtkAchida~NganA
shlokas.40:
satyavatyuvAcha||
yathA sadyaH prapadyeta devI garbhaM tathA kuru |
arAjakeShu rAShTreShu nAsti vRRiShTirna devatAH
shlokas.41:
kathamarAjakaM rAShTraM shakyaM dhArayituM prabho |
tasmAdgarbhaM samAdhatsva bhIShmastaM vardhayiShyati
shlokas.42:
vyAsa uvAcha||
yadi putraH pradAtavyo mayA kShipramakAlikam |
virUpatAM me sahatAmetadasyAH paraM vratam
shlokas.43:
yadi me sahate gandhaM rUpaM veShaM tathA vapuH |
adyaiva garbhaM kausalyA vishiShTaM pratipadyatAm
shlokas.44:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
samAgamanamAkA~NkShanniti so.antarhito muniH |
tato.abhigamya sA devI snuShAM rahasi sa~NgatAm
dharmyamarthasamAyuktamuvAcha vachanaM hitam
shlokas.45:
kausalye dharmatantraM yadbravImi tvAM nibodha me |
bharatAnAM samuchChedo vyaktaM madbhAgyasa~NkShayAt
shlokas.46:
vyathitAM mAM cha samprekShya pitRRiva.nshaM cha pIDitam |
bhIShmo buddhimadAnme.atra dharmasya cha vivRRiddhaye
shlokas.47:
sA cha buddhistavAdhInA putri j~nAtaM mayeti ha |
naShTaM cha bhArataM va.nshaM punareva samuddhara
shlokas.48:
putraM janaya sushroNi devarAjasamaprabham |
sa hi rAjyadhuraM gurvImudvakShyati kulasya naH
shlokas.49:
sA dharmato.anunIyainAM katha~nchiddharmachAriNIm |
bhojayAmAsa viprA.nshcha devarShInatithI.nstathA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH satyavatI kAle vadhUM snAtAmRRitau tadA |
sa.nveshayantI shayane shanakairvAkyamabravIt
shlokas.2:
kausalye devaraste.asti so.adya tvAnupravekShyati |
apramattA pratIkShainaM nishIthe AgamiShyati
shlokas.3:
shvashrvAstadvachanaM shrutvA shayAnA shayane shubhe |
sAchintayattadA bhIShmamanyA.nshcha kurupu~NgavAn
shlokas.4:
tato.ambikAyAM prathamaM niyuktaH satyavAgRRiShiH |
dIpyamAneShu dIpeShu shayanaM pravivesha ha
shlokas.5:
tasya kRRiShNasya kapilA jaTA dIpte cha lochane |
babhrUNi chaiva shmashrUNi dRRiShTvA devI nyamIlayat
shlokas.6:
sambabhUva tayA rAtrau mAtuH priyachikIrShayA |
bhayAtkAshisutA taM tu nAshaknodabhivIkShitum
shlokas.7:
tato niShkrAntamAsAdya mAtA putramathAbravIt |
apyasyAM guNavAnputra rAjaputro bhaviShyati
shlokas.8:
nishamya tadvacho mAturvyAsaH paramabuddhimAn |
provAchAtIndriyaj~nAno vidhinA samprachoditaH
shlokas.9:
nAgAyutasamaprANo vidvAnrAjarShisattamaH |
mahAbhAgo mahAvIryo mahAbuddhirbhaviShyati
shlokas.10:
tasya chApi shataM putrA bhaviShyanti mahAbalAH |
kiM tu mAtuH sa vaiguNyAdandha eva bhaviShyati
shlokas.11:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA mAtA putramathAbravIt |
nAndhaH kurUNAM nRRipatiranurUpastapodhana
shlokas.12:
j~nAtiva.nshasya goptAraM pitRRiNAM va.nshavardhanam |
dvitIyaM kuruva.nshasya rAjAnaM dAtumarhasi
shlokas.13:
sa tatheti pratij~nAya nishchakrAma mahAtapAH |
sApi kAlena kausalyA suShuve.andhaM tamAtmajam
shlokas.14:
punareva tu sA devI paribhAShya snuShAM tataH |
RRiShimAvAhayatsatyA yathApUrvamaninditA
shlokas.15:
tatastenaiva vidhinA maharShistAmapadyata |
ambAlikAmathAbhyAgAdRRiShiM dRRiShTvA cha sApi tam
viShaNNA pANDusa~NkAshA samapadyata bhArata
shlokas.16:
tAM bhItAM pANDusa~NkAshAM viShaNNAM prekShya pArthiva |
vyAsaH satyavatIputra idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.17:
yasmAtpANDutvamApannA virUpaM prekShya mAmapi |
tasmAdeSha sutastubhyaM pANDureva bhaviShyati
shlokas.18:
nAma chAsya tadeveha bhaviShyati shubhAnane |
ityuktvA sa nirAkrAmadbhagavAnRRiShisattamaH
shlokas.19:
tato niShkrAntamAlokya satyA putramabhAShata |
shasha.nsa sa punarmAtre tasya bAlasya pANDutAm
shlokas.20:
taM mAtA punarevAnyamekaM putramayAchata |
tatheti cha maharShistAM mAtaraM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.21:
tataH kumAraM sA devI prAptakAlamajIjanat |
pANDuM lakShaNasampannaM dIpyamAnamiva shriyA
tasya putrA maheShvAsA jaj~nire pa~ncha pANDavAH
shlokas.22:
RRitukAle tato jyeShThAM vadhUM tasmai nyayojayat |
sA tu rUpaM cha gandhaM cha maharSheH pravichintya tam
nAkarodvachanaM devyA bhayAtsurasutopamA
shlokas.23:
tataH svairbhUShaNairdAsIM bhUShayitvApsaropamAm |
preShayAmAsa kRRiShNAya tataH kAshipateH sutA
shlokas.24:
dAsI RRiShimanuprAptaM pratyudgamyAbhivAdya cha |
sa.nviveshAbhyanuj~nAtA satkRRityopachachAra ha
shlokas.25:
kAmopabhogena tu sa tasyAM tuShTimagAdRRiShiH |
tayA sahoShito rAtriM maharShiH prIyamANayA
shlokas.26:
uttiShThannabravIdenAmabhujiShyA bhaviShyasi |
ayaM cha te shubhe garbhaH shrImAnudaramAgataH
dharmAtmA bhavitA loke sarvabuddhimatAM varaH
shlokas.27:
sa jaj~ne viduro nAma kRRiShNadvaipAyanAtmajaH |
dhRRitarAShTrasya cha bhrAtA pANDoshchAmitabuddhimAn
shlokas.28:
dharmo vidurarUpeNa shApAttasya mahAtmanaH |
mANDavyasyArthatattvaj~naH kAmakrodhavivarjitaH
shlokas.29:
sa dharmasyAnRRiNo bhUtvA punarmAtrA sametya cha |
tasyai garbhaM samAvedya tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.30:
evaM vichitravIryasya kShetre dvaipAyanAdapi |
jaj~nire devagarbhAbhAH kuruva.nshavivardhanAH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kiM kRRitaM karma dharmeNa yena shApamupeyivAn |
kasya shApAchcha brahmarShe shUdrayonAvajAyata
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
babhUva brAhmaNaH kashchinmANDavya iti vishrutaH |
dhRRitimAnsarvadharmaj~naH satye tapasi cha sthitaH
shlokas.3:
sa AshramapadadvAri vRRikShamUle mahAtapAH |
UrdhvabAhurmahAyogI tasthau maunavratAnvitaH
shlokas.4:
tasya kAlena mahatA tasmi.nstapasi tiShThataH |
tamAshramapadaM prAptA dasyavo loptrahAriNaH
anusAryamANA bahubhI rakShibhirbharatarShabha
shlokas.5:
te tasyAvasathe loptraM nidadhuH kurusattama |
nidhAya cha bhayAllInAstatraivAnvAgate bale
shlokas.6:
teShu lIneShvatho shIghraM tatastadrakShiNAM balam |
AjagAma tato.apashya.nstamRRiShiM taskarAnugAH
shlokas.7:
tamapRRichCha.nstato rAja.nstathAvRRittaM tapodhanam |
katareNa pathA yAtA dasyavo dvijasattama
tena gachChAmahe brahmanpathA shIghrataraM vayam
shlokas.8:
tathA tu rakShiNAM teShAM bruvatAM sa tapodhanaH |
na ki~nchidvachanaM rAjannavadatsAdhvasAdhu vA
shlokas.9:
tataste rAjapuruShA vichinvAnAstadAshramam |
dadRRishustatra sa.nlInA.nstA.nshchorAndravyameva cha
shlokas.10:
tataH sha~NkA samabhavadrakShiNAM taM muniM prati |
sa.nyamyainaM tato rAj~ne dasyU.nshchaiva nyavedayan
shlokas.11:
taM rAjA saha taishchorairanvashAdvadhyatAmiti |
sa vadhyaghAtairaj~nAtaH shUle proto mahAtapAH
shlokas.12:
tataste shUlamAropya taM muniM rakShiNastadA |
pratijagmurmahIpAlaM dhanAnyAdAya tAnyatha
shlokas.13:
shUlasthaH sa tu dharmAtmA kAlena mahatA tataH |
nirAhAro.api viprarShirmaraNaM nAbhyupAgamat
dhArayAmAsa cha prANAnRRiShI.nshcha samupAnayat
shlokas.14:
shUlAgre tapyamAnena tapastena mahAtmanA |
santApaM paramaM jagmurmunayo.atha parantapa
shlokas.15:
te rAtrau shakunA bhUtvA saMnyavartanta sarvataH |
darshayanto yathAshakti tamapRRichChandvijottamam
shrotumichChAmahe brahmankiM pApaM kRRitavAnasi
shlokas.16:
tataH sa munishArdUlastAnuvAcha tapodhanAn |
doShataH kaM gamiShyAmi na hi me.anyo.aparAdhyati
shlokas.17:
rAjA cha tamRRiShiM shrutvA niShkramya saha mantribhiH |
prasAdayAmAsa tadA shUlasthamRRiShisattamam
shlokas.18:
yanmayApakRRitaM mohAdaj~nAnAdRRiShisattama |
prasAdaye tvAM tatrAhaM na me tvaM kroddhumarhasi
shlokas.19:
evamuktastato rAj~nA prasAdamakaronmuniH |
kRRitaprasAdo rAjA taM tataH samavatArayat
shlokas.20:
avatArya cha shUlAgrAttachChUlaM nishchakarSha ha |
ashaknuva.nshcha niShkraShTuM shUlaM mUle sa chichChide
shlokas.21:
sa tathAntargatenaiva shUlena vyacharanmuniH |
sa tena tapasA lokAnvijigye durlabhAnparaiH
aNImANDavya iti cha tato lokeShu kathyate
shlokas.22:
sa gatvA sadanaM vipro dharmasya paramArthavit |
AsanasthaM tato dharmaM dRRiShTvopAlabhata prabhuH
shlokas.23:
kiM nu tadduShkRRitaM karma mayA kRRitamajAnatA |
yasyeyaM phalanirvRRittirIdRRishyAsAditA mayA
shIghramAchakShva me tattvaM pashya me tapaso balam
shlokas.24:
dharma uvAcha||
pata~NgakAnAM puchCheShu tvayeShIkA praveshitA |
karmaNastasya te prAptaM phalametattapodhana
shlokas.25:
aNImANDavya uvAcha||
alpe.aparAdhe vipulo mama daNDastvayA kRRitaH |
shUdrayonAvato dharma mAnuShaH sambhaviShyasi
shlokas.26:
maryAdAM sthApayAmyadya loke dharmaphalodayAm |
A chaturdashamAdvarShAnna bhaviShyati pAtakam
pareNa kurvatAmevaM doSha eva bhaviShyati
shlokas.27:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etena tvaparAdhena shApAttasya mahAtmanaH |
dharmo vidurarUpeNa shUdrayonAvajAyata
shlokas.28:
dharme chArthe cha kushalo lobhakrodhavivarjitaH |
dIrghadarshI shamaparaH kurUNAM cha hite rataH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
teShu triShu kumAreShu jAteShu kurujA~Ngalam |
kuravo.atha kurukShetraM trayametadavardhata
shlokas.2:
UrdhvasasyAbhavadbhUmiH sasyAni phalavanti cha |
yathartuvarShI parjanyo bahupuShpaphalA drumAH
shlokas.3:
vAhanAni prahRRiShTAni muditA mRRigapakShiNaH |
gandhavanti cha mAlyAni rasavanti phalAni cha
shlokas.4:
vaNigbhishchAvakIryanta nagarANyatha shilpibhiH |
shUrAshcha kRRitavidyAshcha santashcha sukhino.abhavan
shlokas.5:
nAbhavandasyavaH kechinnAdharmaruchayo janAH |
pradesheShvapi rAShTrANAM kRRitaM yugamavartata
shlokas.6:
dAnakriyAdharmashIlA yaj~navrataparAyaNAH |
anyonyaprItisa.nyuktA vyavardhanta prajAstadA
shlokas.7:
mAnakrodhavihInAshcha janA lobhavivarjitAH |
anyonyamabhyavardhanta dharmottaramavartata
shlokas.8:
tanmahodadhivatpUrNaM nagaraM vai vyarochata |
dvAratoraNaniryUhairyuktamabhrachayopamaiH
prAsAdashatasambAdhaM mahendrapurasaMnibham
shlokas.9:
nadIShu vanakhaNDeShu vApIpalvalasAnuShu |
kAnaneShu cha ramyeShu vijahrurmuditA janAH
shlokas.10:
uttaraiH kurubhiH sArdhaM dakShiNAH kuravastadA |
vispardhamAnA vyachara.nstathA siddharShichAraNaiH
nAbhavatkRRipaNaH kashchinnAbhavanvidhavAH striyaH
shlokas.11:
tasmi~njanapade ramye bahavaH kurubhiH kRRitAH |
kUpArAmasabhAvApyo brAhmaNAvasathAstathA
bhIShmeNa shAstrato rAjansarvataH parirakShite
shlokas.12:
babhUva ramaNIyashcha chaityayUpashatA~NkitaH |
sa deshaH pararAShTrANi pratigRRihyAbhivardhitaH
bhIShmeNa vihitaM rAShTre dharmachakramavartata
shlokas.13:
kriyamANeShu kRRityeShu kumArANAM mahAtmanAm |
paurajAnapadAH sarve babhUvuH satatotsavAH
shlokas.14:
gRRiheShu kurumukhyAnAM paurANAM cha narAdhipa |
dIyatAM bhujyatAM cheti vAcho.ashrUyanta sarvashaH
shlokas.15:
dhRRitarAShTrashcha pANDushcha vidurashcha mahAmatiH |
janmaprabhRRiti bhIShmeNa putravatparipAlitAH
shlokas.16:
sa.nskAraiH sa.nskRRitAste tu vratAdhyayanasa.nyutAH |
shramavyAyAmakushalAH samapadyanta yauvanam
shlokas.17:
dhanurvede.ashvapRRiShThe cha gadAyuddhe.asicharmaNi |
tathaiva gajashikShAyAM nItishAstre cha pAragAH
shlokas.18:
itihAsapurANeShu nAnAshikShAsu chAbhibho |
vedavedA~Ngatattvaj~nAH sarvatra kRRitanishramAH
shlokas.19:
pANDurdhanuShi vikrAnto narebhyo.abhyadhiko.abhavat |
atyanyAnbalavAnAsIddhRRitarAShTro mahIpatiH
shlokas.20:
triShu lokeShu na tvAsItkashchidvidurasaMmitaH |
dharmanityastato rAjandharme cha paramaM gataH
shlokas.21:
pranaShTaM shantanorva.nshaM samIkShya punaruddhRRitam |
tato nirvachanaM loke sarvarAShTreShvavartata
shlokas.22:
vIrasUnAM kAshisute deshAnAM kurujA~Ngalam |
sarvadharmavidAM bhIShmaH purANAM gajasAhvayam
shlokas.23:
dhRRitarAShTrastvachakShuShTvAdrAjyaM na pratyapadyata |
karaNatvAchcha viduraH pANDurAsInmahIpatiH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
guNaiH samuditaM samyagidaM naH prathitaM kulam |
atyanyAnpRRithivIpAlAnpRRithivyAmadhirAjyabhAk
shlokas.2:
rakShitaM rAjabhiH pUrvairdharmavidbhirmahAtmabhiH |
notsAdamagamachchedaM kadAchidiha naH kulam
shlokas.3:
mayA cha satyavatyA cha kRRiShNena cha mahAtmanA |
samavasthApitaM bhUyo yuShmAsu kulatantuShu
shlokas.4:
vardhate tadidaM putra kulaM sAgaravadyathA |
tathA mayA vidhAtavyaM tvayA chaiva visheShataH
shlokas.5:
shrUyate yAdavI kanyA anurUpA kulasya naH |
subalasyAtmajA chaiva tathA madreshvarasya cha
shlokas.6:
kulInA rUpavatyashcha nAthavatyashcha sarvashaH |
uchitAshchaiva sambandhe te.asmAkaM kShatriyarShabhAH
shlokas.7:
manye varayitavyAstA ityahaM dhImatAM vara |
santAnArthaM kulasyAsya yadvA vidura manyase
shlokas.8:
vidura uvAcha||
bhavAnpitA bhavAnmAtA bhavAnnaH paramo guruH |
tasmAtsvayaM kulasyAsya vichArya kuru yaddhitam
shlokas.9:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
atha shushrAva viprebhyo gAndhArIM subalAtmajAm |
ArAdhya varadaM devaM bhaganetraharaM haram
gAndhArI kila putrANAM shataM lebhe varaM shubhA
shlokas.10:
iti shrutvA cha tattvena bhIShmaH kurupitAmahaH |
tato gAndhArarAjasya preShayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.11:
achakShuriti tatrAsItsubalasya vichAraNA |
kulaM khyAtiM cha vRRittaM cha buddhyA tu prasamIkShya saH
dadau tAM dhRRitarAShTrAya gAndhArIM dharmachAriNIm
shlokas.12:
gAndhArI tvapi shushrAva dhRRitarAShTramachakShuSham |
AtmAnaM ditsitaM chAsmai pitrA mAtrA cha bhArata
shlokas.13:
tataH sA paTTamAdAya kRRitvA bahuguNaM shubhA |
babandha netre sve rAjanpativrataparAyaNA
nAtyashnIyAM patimahamityevaM kRRitanishchayA
shlokas.14:
tato gAndhArarAjasya putraH shakunirabhyayAt |
svasAraM parayA lakShmyA yuktAmAdAya kauravAn
shlokas.15:
dattvA sa bhaginIM vIro yathArhaM cha parichChadam |
punarAyAtsvanagaraM bhIShmeNa pratipUjitaH
shlokas.16:
gAndhAryapi varArohA shIlAchAravicheShTitaiH |
tuShTiM kurUNAM sarveShAM janayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.17:
vRRittenArAdhya tAnsarvAnpativrataparAyaNA |
vAchApi puruShAnanyAnsuvratA nAnvakIrtayat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shUro nAma yadushreShTho vasudevapitAbhavat |
tasya kanyA pRRithA nAma rUpeNAsadRRishI bhuvi
shlokas.2:
paitRRiShvaseyAya sa tAmanapatyAya vIryavAn |
agryamagre pratij~nAya svasyApatyasya vIryavAn
shlokas.3:
agrajAteti tAM kanyAmagryAnugrahakA~NkShiNe |
pradadau kuntibhojAya sakhA sakhye mahAtmane
shlokas.4:
sA niyuktA piturgehe devatAtithipUjane |
ugraM paryacharadghoraM brAhmaNaM sa.nshitavratam
shlokas.5:
nigUDhanishchayaM dharme yaM taM durvAsasaM viduH |
tamugraM sa.nshitAtmAnaM sarvayatnairatoShayat
shlokas.6:
tasyai sa pradadau mantramApaddharmAnvavekShayA |
abhichArAbhisa.nyuktamabravIchchaiva tAM muniH
shlokas.7:
yaM yaM devaM tvametena mantreNAvAhayiShyasi |
tasya tasya prasAdena putrastava bhaviShyati
shlokas.8:
tathoktA sA tu vipreNa tena kautUhalAttadA |
kanyA satI devamarkamAjuhAva yashasvinI
shlokas.9:
sA dadarsha tamAyAntaM bhAskaraM lokabhAvanam |
vismitA chAnavadyA~NgI dRRiShTvA tanmahadadbhutam
shlokas.10:
prakAshakarmA tapanastasyAM garbhaM dadhau tataH |
ajIjanattato vIraM sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam
AmuktakavachaH shrImAndevagarbhaH shriyAvRRitaH
shlokas.11:
sahajaM kavachaM bibhratkuNDaloddyotitAnanaH |
ajAyata sutaH karNaH sarvalokeShu vishrutaH
shlokas.12:
prAdAchcha tasyAH kanyAtvaM punaH sa paramadyutiH |
dattvA cha dadatAM shreShTho divamAchakrame tataH
shlokas.13:
gUhamAnApachAraM taM bandhupakShabhayAttadA |
utsasarja jale kuntI taM kumAraM salakShaNam
shlokas.14:
tamutsRRiShTaM tadA garbhaM rAdhAbhartA mahAyashAH |
putratve kalpayAmAsa sabhAryaH sUtanandanaH
shlokas.15:
nAmadheyaM cha chakrAte tasya bAlasya tAvubhau |
vasunA saha jAto.ayaM vasuSheNo bhavatviti
shlokas.16:
sa vardhamAno balavAnsarvAstreShUdyato.abhavat |
A pRRiShThatApAdAdityamupatasthe sa vIryavAn
shlokas.17:
yasminkAle japannAste sa vIraH satyasa~NgaraH |
nAdeyaM brAhmaNeShvAsIttasminkAle mahAtmanaH
shlokas.18:
tamindro brAhmaNo bhUtvA bhikShArthaM bhUtabhAvanaH |
kuNDale prArthayAmAsa kavachaM cha mahAdyutiH
shlokas.19:
utkRRitya vimanAH svA~NgAtkavachaM rudhirasravam |
karNastu kuNDale ChittvA prAyachChatsa kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.20:
shaktiM tasmai dadau shakraH vismito vAkyamabravIt |
devAsuramanuShyANAM gandharvoragarakShasAm
yasmai kShepsyasi ruShTaH sanso.anayA na bhaviShyati
shlokas.21:
purA nAma tu tasyAsIdvasuSheNa iti shrutam |
tato vaikartanaH karNaH karmaNA tena so.abhavat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
rUpasattvaguNopetA dharmArAmA mahAvratA |
duhitA kuntibhojasya kRRite pitrA svaya.nvare
shlokas.2:
siMhadaMShTraM gajaskandhamRRiShabhAkShaM mahAbalam |
bhUmipAlasahasrANAM madhye pANDumavindata
shlokas.3:
sa tayA kuntibhojasya duhitrA kurunandanaH |
yuyuje.amitasaubhAgyaH paulomyA maghavAniva
shlokas.4:
yAtvA devavratenApi madrANAM puTabhedanam |
vishrutA triShu lokeShu mAdrI madrapateH sutA
shlokas.5:
sarvarAjasu vikhyAtA rUpeNAsadRRishI bhuvi |
pANDorarthe parikrItA dhanena mahatA tadA
vivAhaM kArayAmAsa bhIShmaH pANDormahAtmanaH
shlokas.6:
siMhoraskaM gajaskandhamRRiShabhAkShaM manasvinam |
pANDuM dRRiShTvA naravyAghraM vyasmayanta narA bhuvi
shlokas.7:
kRRitodvAhastataH pANDurbalotsAhasamanvitaH |
jigIShamANo vasudhAM yayau shatrUnanekashaH
shlokas.8:
pUrvamAgaskRRito gatvA dashArNAH samare jitAH |
pANDunA narasiMhena kauravANAM yashobhRRitA
shlokas.9:
tataH senAmupAdAya pANDurnAnAvidhadhvajAm |
prabhUtahastyashvarathAM padAtigaNasa~NkulAm
shlokas.10:
AgaskRRitsarvavIrANAM vairI sarvamahIbhRRitAm |
goptA magadharAShTrasya dArvo rAjagRRihe hataH
shlokas.11:
tataH koshaM samAdAya vAhanAni balAni cha |
pANDunA mithilAM gatvA videhAH samare jitAH
shlokas.12:
tathA kAshiShu suhmeShu puNDreShu bharatarShabha |
svabAhubalavIryeNa kurUNAmakarodyashaH
shlokas.13:
taM sharaughamahAjvAlamastrArchiShamari.ndamam |
pANDupAvakamAsAdya vyadahyanta narAdhipAH
shlokas.14:
te sasenAH sasenena vidhva.nsitabalA nRRipAH |
pANDunA vashagAH kRRitvA karakarmasu yojitAH
shlokas.15:
tena te nirjitAH sarve pRRithivyAM sarvapArthivAH |
tamekaM menire shUraM deveShviva pura.ndaram
shlokas.16:
taM kRRitA~njalayaH sarve praNatA vasudhAdhipAH |
upAjagmurdhanaM gRRihya ratnAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.17:
maNimuktApravAlaM cha suvarNaM rajataM tathA |
goratnAnyashvaratnAni ratharatnAni ku~njarAn
shlokas.18:
kharoShTramahiShA.nshchaiva yachcha ki~nchidajAvikam |
tatsarvaM pratijagrAha rAjA nAgapurAdhipaH
shlokas.19:
tadAdAya yayau pANDuH punarmuditavAhanaH |
harShayiShyansvarAShTrANi puraM cha gajasAhvayam
shlokas.20:
shantano rAjasiMhasya bharatasya cha dhImataH |
pranaShTaH kIrtijaH shabdaH pANDunA punaruddhRRitaH
shlokas.21:
ye purA kururAShTrANi jahruH kurudhanAni cha |
te nAgapurasiMhena pANDunA karadAH kRRitAH
shlokas.22:
ityabhAShanta rAjAno rAjAmAtyAshcha sa~NgatAH |
pratItamanaso hRRiShTAH paurajAnapadaiH saha
shlokas.23:
pratyudyayustaM samprAptaM sarve bhIShmapurogamAH |
te nadUramivAdhvAnaM gatvA nAgapurAlayAH
AvRRitaM dadRRishurlokaM hRRiShTA bahuvidhairjanaiH
shlokas.24:
nAnAyAnasamAnItai ratnairuchchAvachaistathA |
hastyashvaratharatnaishcha gobhiruShTrairathAvikaiH
nAntaM dadRRishurAsAdya bhIShmeNa saha kauravAH
shlokas.25:
so.abhivAdya pituH pAdau kausalyAnandavardhanaH |
yathArhaM mAnayAmAsa paurajAnapadAnapi
shlokas.26:
pramRRidya pararAShTrANi kRRitArthaM punarAgatam |
putramAsAdya bhIShmastu harShAdashrUNyavartayat
shlokas.27:
sa tUryashatasa~NghAnAM bherINAM cha mahAsvanaiH |
harShayansarvashaH paurAnvivesha gajasAhvayam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dhRRitarAShTrAbhyanuj~nAtaH svabAhuvijitaM dhanam |
bhIShmAya satyavatyai cha mAtre chopajahAra saH
shlokas.2:
vidurAya cha vai pANDuH preShayAmAsa taddhanam |
suhRRidashchApi dharmAtmA dhanena samatarpayat
shlokas.3:
tataH satyavatIM bhIShmaH kausalyAM cha yashasvinIm |
shubhaiH pANDujitai ratnaistoShayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.4:
nananda mAtA kausalyA tamapratimatejasam |
jayantamiva paulomI pariShvajya nararShabham
shlokas.5:
tasya vIrasya vikrAntaiH sahasrashatadakShiNaiH |
ashvamedhashatairIje dhRRitarAShTro mahAmakhaiH
shlokas.6:
samprayuktashcha kuntyA cha mAdryA cha bharatarShabha |
jitatandrIstadA pANDurbabhUva vanagocharaH
shlokas.7:
hitvA prAsAdanilayaM shubhAni shayanAni cha |
araNyanityaH satataM babhUva mRRigayAparaH
shlokas.8:
sa charandakShiNaM pArshvaM ramyaM himavato gireH |
uvAsa giripRRiShTheShu mahAshAlavaneShu cha
shlokas.9:
rarAja kuntyA mAdryA cha pANDuH saha vane vasan |
kareNvoriva madhyasthaH shrImAnpaura.ndaro gajaH
shlokas.10:
bhArataM saha bhAryAbhyAM bANakhaDgadhanurdharam |
vichitrakavachaM vIraM paramAstravidaM nRRipam
devo.ayamityamanyanta charantaM vanavAsinaH
shlokas.11:
tasya kAmA.nshcha bhogA.nshcha narA nityamatandritAH |
upajahrurvanAnteShu dhRRitarAShTreNa choditAH
shlokas.12:
atha pArashavIM kanyAM devakasya mahIpateH |
rUpayauvanasampannAM sa shushrAvApagAsutaH
shlokas.13:
tatastu varayitvA tAmAnAyya puruSharShabhaH |
vivAhaM kArayAmAsa vidurasya mahAmateH
shlokas.14:
tasyAM chotpAdayAmAsa viduraH kurunandanaH |
putrAnvinayasampannAnAtmanaH sadRRishAnguNaiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH putrashataM jaj~ne gAndhAryAM janamejaya |
dhRRitarAShTrasya vaishyAyAmekashchApi shatAtparaH
shlokas.2:
pANDoH kuntyAM cha mAdryAM cha pa~ncha putrA mahArathAH |
devebhyaH samapadyanta santAnAya kulasya vai
shlokas.3:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathaM putrashataM jaj~ne gAndhAryAM dvijasattama |
kiyatA chaiva kAlena teShAmAyushcha kiM param
shlokas.4:
kathaM chaikaH sa vaishyAyAM dhRRitarAShTrasuto.abhavat |
kathaM cha sadRRishIM bhAryAM gAndhArIM dharmachAriNIm
AnukUlye vartamAnAM dhRRitarAShTro.atyavartata
shlokas.5:
kathaM cha shaptasya sataH pANDostena mahAtmanA |
samutpannA daivatebhyaH pa~ncha putrA mahArathAH
shlokas.6:
etadvidvanyathAvRRittaM vistareNa tapodhana |
kathayasva na me tRRiptiH kathyamAneShu bandhuShu
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kShuchChramAbhipariglAnaM dvaipAyanamupasthitam |
toShayAmAsa gAndhArI vyAsastasyai varaM dadau
shlokas.8:
sA vavre sadRRishaM bhartuH putrANAM shatamAtmanaH |
tataH kAlena sA garbhaM dhRRitarAShTrAdathAgrahIt
shlokas.9:
sa.nvatsaradvayaM taM tu gAndhArI garbhamAhitam |
aprajA dhArayAmAsa tatastAM duHkhamAvishat
shlokas.10:
shrutvA kuntIsutaM jAtaM bAlArkasamatejasam |
udarasyAtmanaH sthairyamupalabhyAnvachintayat
shlokas.11:
aj~nAtaM dhRRitarAShTrasya yatnena mahatA tataH |
sodaraM pAtayAmAsa gAndhArI duHkhamUrchChitA
shlokas.12:
tato jaj~ne mA.nsapeshI lohAShThIleva saMhatA |
dvivarShasambhRRitAM kukShau tAmutsraShTuM prachakrame
shlokas.13:
atha dvaipAyano j~nAtvA tvaritaH samupAgamat |
tAM sa mA.nsamayIM peshIM dadarsha japatAM varaH
shlokas.14:
tato.abravItsaubaleyIM kimidaM te chikIrShitam |
sA chAtmano mataM satyaM shasha.nsa paramarShaye
shlokas.15:
jyeShThaM kuntIsutaM jAtaM shrutvA ravisamaprabham |
duHkhena parameNedamudaraM pAtitaM mayA
shlokas.16:
shataM cha kila putrANAM vitIrNaM me tvayA purA |
iyaM cha me mA.nsapeshI jAtA putrashatAya vai
shlokas.17:
vyAsa uvAcha||
evametatsaubaleyi naitajjAtvanyathA bhavet |
vitathaM noktapUrvaM me svaireShvapi kuto.anyathA
shlokas.18:
ghRRitapUrNaM kuNDashataM kShiprameva vidhIyatAm |
shItAbhiradbhiraShThIlAmimAM cha pariShi~nchata
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sA sichyamAnA aShThIlA abhavachChatadhA tadA |
a~NguShThaparvamAtrANAM garbhANAM pRRithageva tu
shlokas.20:
ekAdhikashataM pUrNaM yathAyogaM vishAM pate |
mA.nsapeshyAstadA rAjankramashaH kAlaparyayAt
shlokas.21:
tatastA.nsteShu kuNDeShu garbhAnavadadhe tadA |
svanugupteShu desheShu rakShAM cha vyadadhAttataH
shlokas.22:
shashAsa chaiva bhagavAnkAlenaitAvatA punaH |
vighaTTanIyAnyetAni kuNDAnIti sma saubalIm
shlokas.23:
ityuktvA bhagavAnvyAsastathA pratividhAya cha |
jagAma tapase dhImAnhimavantaM shilochchayam
shlokas.24:
jaj~ne krameNa chaitena teShAM duryodhano nRRipaH |
janmatastu pramANena jyeShTho rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.25:
jAtamAtre sute tasmindhRRitarAShTro.abravIdidam |
samAnIya bahUnviprAnbhIShmaM vidurameva cha
shlokas.26:
yudhiShThiro rAjaputro jyeShTho naH kulavardhanaH |
prAptaH svaguNato rAjyaM na tasminvAchyamasti naH
shlokas.27:
ayaM tvanantarastasmAdapi rAjA bhaviShyati |
etaddhi brUta me satyaM yadatra bhavitA dhruvam
shlokas.28:
vAkyasyaitasya nidhane dikShu sarvAsu bhArata |
kravyAdAH prANadanghorAH shivAshchAshivasha.nsinaH
shlokas.29:
lakShayitvA nimittAni tAni ghorANi sarvashaH |
te.abruvanbrAhmaNA rAjanvidurashcha mahAmatiH
shlokas.30:
vyaktaM kulAntakaraNo bhavitaiSha sutastava |
tasya shAntiH parityAge puShTyA tvapanayo mahAn
shlokas.31:
shatamekonamapyastu putrANAM te mahIpate |
ekena kuru vai kShemaM lokasya cha kulasya cha
shlokas.32:
tyajedekaM kulasyArthe grAmasyArthe kulaM tyajet |
grAmaM janapadasyArthe AtmArthe pRRithivIM tyajet
shlokas.33:
sa tathA vidureNoktastaishcha sarvairdvijottamaiH |
na chakAra tathA rAjA putrasnehasamanvitaH
shlokas.34:
tataH putrashataM sarvaM dhRRitarAShTrasya pArthiva |
mAsamAtreNa sa~njaj~ne kanyA chaikA shatAdhikA
shlokas.35:
gAndhAryAM klishyamAnAyAmudareNa vivardhatA |
dhRRitarAShTraM mahAbAhuM vaishyA paryacharatkila
shlokas.36:
tasminsa.nvatsare rAjandhRRitarAShTrAnmahAyashAH |
jaj~ne dhImA.nstatastasyAM yuyutsuH karaNo nRRipa
shlokas.37:
evaM putrashataM jaj~ne dhRRitarAShTrasya dhImataH |
mahArathAnAM vIrANAM kanyA chaikAtha duHshalA

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
jyeShThAnujyeShThatAM teShAM nAmadheyAni chAbhibho |
dhRRitarAShTrasya putrANAmAnupUrvyeNa kIrtaya
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
duryodhano yuyutsushcha rAjanduHshAsanastathA |
duHsaho duHshalashchaiva jalasandhaH samaH sahaH
shlokas.3:
vindAnuvindau durdharShaH subAhurduShpradharShaNaH |
durmarShaNo durmukhashcha duShkarNaH karNa eva cha
shlokas.4:
vivi.nshatirvikarNashcha jalasandhaH sulochanaH |
chitropachitrau chitrAkShashchAruchitraH sharAsanaH
shlokas.5:
durmado duShpragAhashcha vivitsurvikaTaH samaH |
UrNanAbhaH sunAbhashcha tathA nandopanandakau
shlokas.6:
senApatiH suSheNashcha kuNDodaramahodarau |
chitrabANashchitravarmA suvarmA durvimochanaH
shlokas.7:
ayobAhurmahAbAhushchitrA~NgashchitrakuNDalaH |
bhImavego bhImabalo balAkI balavardhanaH
shlokas.8:
ugrAyudho bhImakarmA kanakAyurdRRiDhAyudhaH |
dRRiDhavarmA dRRiDhakShatraH somakIrtiranUdaraH
shlokas.9:
dRRiDhasandho jarAsandhaH satyasandhaH sadaHsuvAk |
ugrashravA ashvasenaH senAnIrduShparAjayaH
shlokas.10:
aparAjitaH paNDitako vishAlAkSho durAvaraH |
dRRiDhahastaH suhastashcha vAtavegasuvarchasau
shlokas.11:
AdityaketurbahvAshI nAgadantograyAyinau |
kavachI niSha~NgI pAshI cha daNDadhAro dhanurgrahaH
shlokas.12:
ugro bhImaratho vIro vIrabAhuralolupaH |
abhayo raudrakarmA cha tathA dRRiDharathastrayaH
shlokas.13:
anAdhRRiShyaH kuNDabhedI virAvI dIrghalochanaH |
dIrghabAhurmahAbAhurvyUDhoruH kanakadhvajaH
shlokas.14:
kuNDAshI virajAshchaiva duHshalA cha shatAdhikA |
etadekashataM rAjankanyA chaikA prakIrtitA
shlokas.15:
nAmadheyAnupUrvyeNa viddhi janmakramaM nRRipa |
sarve tvatirathAH shUrAH sarve yuddhavishAradAH
shlokas.16:
sarve vedavidashchaiva rAjashAstreShu kovidAH |
sarve sa.nsargavidyAsu vidyAbhijanashobhinaH
shlokas.17:
sarveShAmanurUpAshcha kRRitA dArA mahIpate |
dhRRitarAShTreNa samaye samIkShya vidhivattadA
shlokas.18:
duHshalAM samaye rAjA sindhurAjAya bhArata |
jayadrathAya pradadau saubalAnumate tadA

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathito dhArtarAShTrANAmArShaH sambhava uttamaH |
amAnuSho mAnuShANAM bhavatA brahmavittama
shlokas.2:
nAmadheyAni chApyeShAM kathyamAnAni bhAgashaH |
tvattaH shrutAni me brahmanpANDavAnAM tu kIrtaya
shlokas.3:
te hi sarve mahAtmAno devarAjaparAkramAH |
tvayaivA.nshAvataraNe devabhAgAH prakIrtitAH
shlokas.4:
tasmAdichChAmyahaM shrotumatimAnuShakarmaNAm |
teShAmAjananaM sarvaM vaishampAyana kIrtaya
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
rAjA pANDurmahAraNye mRRigavyAlaniShevite |
vane maithunakAlasthaM dadarsha mRRigayUthapam
shlokas.6:
tatastAM cha mRRigIM taM cha rukmapu~NkhaiH supatribhiH |
nirbibheda sharaistIkShNaiH pANDuH pa~nchabhirAshugaiH
shlokas.7:
sa cha rAjanmahAtejA RRiShiputrastapodhanaH |
bhAryayA saha tejasvI mRRigarUpeNa sa~NgataH
shlokas.8:
sa.nsaktastu tayA mRRigyA mAnuShImIrayangiram |
kShaNena patito bhUmau vilalApAkulendriyaH
shlokas.9:
mRRiga uvAcha||
kAmamanyuparItApi buddhya~NgarahitApi cha |
varjayanti nRRisha.nsAni pApeShvabhiratA narAH
shlokas.10:
na vidhiM grasate praj~nA praj~nAM tu grasate vidhiH |
vidhiparyAgatAnarthAnpraj~nA na pratipadyate
shlokas.11:
shashvaddharmAtmanAM mukhye kule jAtasya bhArata |
kAmalobhAbhibhUtasya kathaM te chalitA matiH
shlokas.12:
pANDuruvAcha||
shatrUNAM yA vadhe vRRittiH sA mRRigANAM vadhe smRRitA |
rAj~nAM mRRiga na mAM mohAttvaM garhayitumarhasi
shlokas.13:
achChadmanAmAyayA cha mRRigANAM vadha iShyate |
sa eva dharmo rAj~nAM tu tadvidvAnkiM nu garhase
shlokas.14:
agastyaH satramAsInashchachAra mRRigayAmRRiShiH |
AraNyAnsarvadaivatyAnmRRigAnprokShya mahAvane
shlokas.15:
pramANadRRiShTadharmeNa kathamasmAnvigarhase |
agastyasyAbhichAreNa yuShmAkaM vai vapA hutA
shlokas.16:
mRRiga uvAcha||
na ripUnvai samuddishya vimu~nchanti purA sharAn |
randhra eShAM visheSheNa vadhakAlaH prashasyate
shlokas.17:
pANDuruvAcha||
pramattamapramattaM vA vivRRitaM ghnanti chaujasA |
upAyairiShubhistIkShNaiH kasmAnmRRiga vigarhase
shlokas.18:
mRRiga uvAcha||
nAhaM ghnantaM mRRigAnrAjanvigarhe AtmakAraNAt |
maithunaM tu pratIkShyaM me syAttvayehAnRRisha.nsataH
shlokas.19:
sarvabhUtahite kAle sarvabhUtepsite tathA |
ko hi vidvAnmRRigaM hanyAchcharantaM maithunaM vane
puruShArthaphalaM kAntaM yattvayA vitathaM kRRitam
shlokas.20:
pauravANAmRRiShINAM cha teShAmakliShTakarmaNAm |
va.nshe jAtasya kauravya nAnurUpamidaM tava
shlokas.21:
nRRisha.nsaM karma sumahatsarvalokavigarhitam |
asvargyamayashasyaM cha adharmiShThaM cha bhArata
shlokas.22:
strIbhogAnAM visheShaj~naH shAstradharmArthatattvavit |
nArhastvaM surasa~NkAsha kartumasvargyamIdRRisham
shlokas.23:
tvayA nRRisha.nsakartAraH pApAchArAshcha mAnavAH |
nigrAhyAH pArthivashreShTha trivargaparivarjitAH
shlokas.24:
kiM kRRitaM te narashreShTha nighnato mAmanAgasam |
muniM mUlaphalAhAraM mRRigaveShadharaM nRRipa
vasamAnamaraNyeShu nityaM shamaparAyaNam
shlokas.25:
tvayAhaM hi.nsito yasmAttasmAttvAmapyasa.nshayam |
dvayornRRisha.nsakartAramavashaM kAmamohitam
jIvitAntakaro bhAva evamevAgamiShyati
shlokas.26:
ahaM hi ki.ndamo nAma tapasApratimo muniH |
vyapatrapanmanuShyANAM mRRigyAM maithunamAcharam
shlokas.27:
mRRigo bhUtvA mRRigaiH sArdhaM charAmi gahane vane |
na tu te brahmahatyeyaM bhaviShyatyavijAnataH
mRRigarUpadharaM hatvA mAmevaM kAmamohitam
shlokas.28:
asya tu tvaM phalaM mUDha prApsyasIdRRishameva hi |
priyayA saha sa.nvAsaM prApya kAmavimohitaH
tvamapyasyAmavasthAyAM pretalokaM gamiShyasi
shlokas.29:
antakAle cha sa.nvAsaM yayA gantAsi kAntayA |
pretarAjavashaM prAptaM sarvabhUtaduratyayam
bhaktyA matimatAM shreShTha saiva tvAmanuyAsyati
shlokas.30:
vartamAnaH sukhe duHkhaM yathAhaM prApitastvayA |
tathA sukhaM tvAM samprAptaM duHkhamabhyAgamiShyati
shlokas.31:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA suduHkhArto jIvitAtsa vyayujyata |
mRRigaH pANDushcha shokArtaH kShaNena samapadyata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
taM vyatItamatikramya rAjA svamiva bAndhavam |
sabhAryaH shokaduHkhArtaH paryadevayadAturaH
shlokas.2:
pANDuruvAcha||
satAmapi kule jAtAH karmaNA bata durgatim |
prApnuvantyakRRitAtmAnaH kAmajAlavimohitAH
shlokas.3:
shashvaddharmAtmanA jAto bAla eva pitA mama |
jIvitAntamanuprAptaH kAmAtmaiveti naH shrutam
shlokas.4:
tasya kAmAtmanaH kShetre rAj~naH sa.nyatavAgRRiShiH |
kRRiShNadvaipAyanaH sAkShAdbhagavAnmAmajIjanat
shlokas.5:
tasyAdya vyasane buddhiH sa~njAteyaM mamAdhamA |
tyaktasya devairanayAnmRRigayAyAM durAtmanaH
shlokas.6:
mokShameva vyavasyAmi bandho hi vyasanaM mahat |
suvRRittimanuvartiShye tAmahaM pituravyayAm
atIva tapasAtmAnaM yojayiShyAmyasa.nshayam
shlokas.7:
tasmAdeko.ahamekAhamekaikasminvanaspatau |
charanbhaikShaM munirmuNDashchariShyAmi mahImimAm
shlokas.8:
pA.nsunA samavachChannaH shUnyAgArapratishrayaH |
vRRikShamUlaniketo vA tyaktasarvapriyApriyaH
shlokas.9:
na shochanna prahRRiShya.nshcha tulyanindAtmasa.nstutiH |
nirAshIrnirnamaskAro nirdvandvo niShparigrahaH
shlokas.10:
na chApyavahasanka~nchinna kurvanbhrukuTIM kvachit |
prasannavadano nityaM sarvabhUtahite rataH
shlokas.11:
ja~NgamAja~NgamaM sarvamavihi.nsa.nshchaturvidham |
svAsu prajAsviva sadA samaH prANabhRRitAM prati
shlokas.12:
ekakAlaM charanbhaikShaM kulAni dve cha pa~ncha cha |
asambhave vA bhaikShasya charannanashanAnyapi
shlokas.13:
alpamalpaM yathAbhojyaM pUrvalAbhena jAtu chit |
nityaM nAtichara.NllAbhe alAbhe sapta pUrayan
shlokas.14:
vAsyaikaM takShato bAhuM chandanenaikamukShataH |
nAkalyANaM na kalyANaM pradhyAyannubhayostayoH
shlokas.15:
na jijIviShuvatki~nchinna mumUrShuvadAcharan |
maraNaM jIvitaM chaiva nAbhinandanna cha dviShan
shlokas.16:
yAH kAshchijjIvatA shakyAH kartumabhyudayakriyAH |
tAH sarvAH samatikramya nimeShAdiShvavasthitaH
shlokas.17:
tAsu sarvAsvavasthAsu tyaktasarvendriyakriyaH |
samparityaktadharmAtmA sunirNiktAtmakalmaShaH
shlokas.18:
nirmuktaH sarvapApebhyo vyatItaH sarvavAgurAH |
na vashe kasyachittiShThansadharmA mAtarishvanaH
shlokas.19:
etayA satataM vRRittyA charannevamprakArayA |
dehaM sandhArayiShyAmi nirbhayaM mArgamAsthitaH
shlokas.20:
nAhaM shvAcharite mArge avIryakRRipaNochite |
svadharmAtsatatApete rameyaM vIryavarjitaH
shlokas.21:
satkRRito.asaktRRito vApi yo.anyAM kRRipaNachakShuShA |
upaiti vRRittiM kAmAtmA sa shunAM vartate pathi
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA suduHkhArto niHshvAsaparamo nRRipaH |
avekShamANaH kuntIM cha mAdrIM cha samabhAShata
shlokas.23:
kausalyA viduraH kShattA rAjA cha saha bandhubhiH |
AryA satyavatI bhIShmaste cha rAjapurohitAH
shlokas.24:
brAhmaNAshcha mahAtmAnaH somapAH sa.nshitavratAH |
pauravRRiddhAshcha ye tatra nivasantyasmadAshrayAH
prasAdya sarve vaktavyAH pANDuH pravrajito vanam
shlokas.25:
nishamya vachanaM bharturvanavAse dhRRitAtmanaH |
tatsamaM vachanaM kuntI mAdrI cha samabhAShatAm
shlokas.26:
anye.api hyAshramAH santi ye shakyA bharatarShabha |
AvAbhyAM dharmapatnIbhyAM saha taptvA tapo mahat
tvameva bhavitA sArthaH svargasyApi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.27:
praNidhAyendriyagrAmaM bhartRRilokaparAyaNe |
tyaktakAmasukhe hyAvAM tapsyAvo vipulaM tapaH
shlokas.28:
yadi AvAM mahAprAj~na tyakShyasi tvaM vishAM pate |
adyaivAvAM prahAsyAvo jItivaM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.29:
pANDuruvAcha||
yadi vyavasitaM hyetadyuvayordharmasaMhitam |
svavRRittimanuvartiShye tAmahaM pituravyayAm
shlokas.30:
tyaktagrAmyasukhAchArastapyamAno mahattapaH |
valkalI phalamUlAshI chariShyAmi mahAvane
shlokas.31:
agniM juhvannubhau kAlAvubhau kAlAvupaspRRishan |
kRRishaH parimitAhArashchIracharmajaTAdharaH
shlokas.32:
shItavAtAtapasahaH kShutpipAsAshramAnvitaH |
tapasA dushchareNedaM sharIramupashoShayan
shlokas.33:
ekAntashIlI vimRRishanpakvApakvena vartayan |
pitRRindevA.nshcha vanyena vAgbhiradbhishcha tarpayan
shlokas.34:
vAnaprasthajanasyApi darshanaM kulavAsinAm |
nApriyANyAchara~njAtu kiM punargrAmavAsinAm
shlokas.35:
evamAraNyashAstrANAmugramugrataraM vidhim |
kA~NkShamANo.ahamAsiShye dehasyAsya samApanAt
shlokas.36:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityevamuktvA bhArye te rAjA kauravava.nshajaH |
tatashchUDAmaNiM niShkama~Ngade kuNDalAni cha
vAsA.nsi cha mahArhANi strINAmAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.37:
pradAya sarvaM viprebhyaH pANDuH punarabhAShata |
gatvA nAgapuraM vAchyaM pANDuH pravrajito vanam
shlokas.38:
arthaM kAmaM sukhaM chaiva ratiM cha paramAtmikAm |
pratasthe sarvamutsRRijya sabhAryaH kurupu~NgavaH
shlokas.39:
tatastasyAnuyAtrANi te chaiva parichArakAH |
shrutvA bharatasiMhasya vividhAH karuNA giraH
bhImamArtasvaraM kRRitvA hAheti parichukrushuH
shlokas.40:
uShNamashru vimu~nchantastaM vihAya mahIpatim |
yayurnAgapuraM tUrNaM sarvamAdAya tadvachaH
shlokas.41:
shrutvA cha tebhyastatsarvaM yathAvRRittaM mahAvane |
dhRRitarAShTro narashreShThaH pANDumevAnvashochata
shlokas.42:
rAjaputrastu kauravyaH pANDurmUlaphalAshanaH |
jagAma saha bhAryAbhyAM tato nAgasabhaM girim
shlokas.43:
sa chaitrarathamAsAdya vAriSheNamatItya cha |
himavantamatikramya prayayau gandhamAdanam
shlokas.44:
rakShyamANo mahAbhUtaiH siddhaishcha paramarShibhiH |
uvAsa sa tadA rAjA sameShu viShameShu cha
shlokas.45:
indradyumnasaraH prApya ha.nsakUTamatItya cha |
shatashRRi~Nge mahArAja tApasaH samapadyata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatrApi tapasi shreShThe vartamAnaH sa vIryavAn |
siddhachAraNasa~NghAnAM babhUva priyadarshanaH
shlokas.2:
shushrUShuranaha.nvAdI sa.nyatAtmA jitendriyaH |
svargaM gantuM parAkrAntaH svena vIryeNa bhArata
shlokas.3:
keShA~nchidabhavadbhrAtA keShA~nchidabhavatsakhA |
RRiShayastvapare chainaM putravatparyapAlayan
shlokas.4:
sa tu kAlena mahatA prApya niShkalmaShaM tapaH |
brahmarShisadRRishaH pANDurbabhUva bharatarShabha
shlokas.5:
svargapAraM titIrShansa shatashRRi~NgAduda~NmukhaH |
pratasthe saha patnIbhyAmabruva.nstatra tApasAH
uparyupari gachChantaH shailarAjamuda~NmukhAH
shlokas.6:
dRRiShTavanto girerasya durgAndeshAnbahUnvayam |
AkrIDabhUtAndevAnAM gandharvApsarasAM tathA
shlokas.7:
udyAnAni kuberasya samAni viShamANi cha |
mahAnadInitambA.nshcha durgA.nshcha girigahvarAn
shlokas.8:
santi nityahimA deshA nirvRRikShamRRigapakShiNaH |
santi kechinmahAvarShA durgAH kechiddurAsadAH
shlokas.9:
atikrAmenna pakShI yAnkuta evetare mRRigAH |
vAyureko.atigAdyatra siddhAshcha paramarShayaH
shlokas.10:
gachChantyau shailarAje.asminrAjaputryau kathaM tvime |
na sIdetAmaduHkhArhe mA gamo bharatarShabha
shlokas.11:
pANDuruvAcha||
aprajasya mahAbhAgA na dvAraM parichakShate |
svarge tenAbhitapto.ahamaprajastadbravImi vaH
shlokas.12:
RRiNaishchaturbhiH sa.nyuktA jAyante manujA bhuvi |
pitRRidevarShimanujadeyaiH shatasahasrashaH
shlokas.13:
etAni tu yathAkAlaM yo na budhyati mAnavaH |
na tasya lokAH santIti dharmavidbhiH pratiShThitam
shlokas.14:
yaj~naishcha devAnprINAti svAdhyAyatapasA munIn |
putraiH shrAddhaiH pitRRi.nshchApi AnRRisha.nsyena mAnavAn
shlokas.15:
RRiShidevamanuShyANAM parimukto.asmi dharmataH |
pitryAdRRiNAdanirmuktastena tapye tapodhanAH
shlokas.16:
dehanAshe dhruvo nAshaH pitRRiNAmeSha nishchayaH |
iha tasmAtprajAhetoH prajAyante narottamAH
shlokas.17:
yathaivAhaM pituH kShetre sRRiShTastena mahAtmanA |
tathaivAsminmama kShetre kathaM vai sambhavetprajA
shlokas.18:
tApasA UchuH||
asti vai tava dharmAtmanvidma devopamaM shubham |
apatyamanaghaM rAjanvayaM divyena chakShuShA
shlokas.19:
daivadiShTaM naravyAghra karmaNehopapAdaya |
akliShTaM phalamavyagro vindate buddhimAnnaraH
shlokas.20:
tasmindRRiShTe phale tAta prayatnaM kartumarhasi |
apatyaM guNasampannaM labdhvA prItimavApsyasi
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tachChrutvA tApasavachaH pANDushchintAparo.abhavat |
Atmano mRRigashApena jAnannupahatAM kriyAm
shlokas.22:
so.abravIdvijane kuntIM dharmapatnIM yashasvinIm |
apatyotpAdane yogamApadi prasamarthayan
shlokas.23:
apatyaM nAma lokeShu pratiShThA dharmasaMhitA |
iti kunti vidurdhIrAH shAshvataM dharmamAditaH
shlokas.24:
iShTaM dattaM tapastaptaM niyamashcha svanuShThitaH |
sarvamevAnapatyasya na pAvanamihochyate
shlokas.25:
so.ahamevaM viditvaitatprapashyAmi shuchismite |
anapatyaH shubhA.NllokAnnAvApsyAmIti chintayan
shlokas.26:
mRRigAbhishApAnnaShTaM me prajanaM hyakRRitAtmanaH |
nRRisha.nsakAriNo bhIru yathaivopahataM tathA
shlokas.27:
ime vai bandhudAyAdAH ShaTputrA dharmadarshane |
ShaDevAbandhudAyAdAH putrAstA~nshRRiNu me pRRithe
shlokas.28:
svaya~njAtaH praNItashcha parikrItashcha yaH sutaH |
paunarbhavashcha kAnInaH svairiNyAM yashcha jAyate
shlokas.29:
dattaH krItaH kRRitrimashcha upagachChetsvayaM cha yaH |
sahoDho jAtaretAshcha hInayonidhRRitashcha yaH
shlokas.30:
pUrvapUrvatamAbhAve matvA lipseta vai sutam |
uttamAdavarAH pu.nsaH kA~NkShante putramApadi
shlokas.31:
apatyaM dharmaphaladaM shreShThaM vindanti sAdhavaH |
AtmashukrAdapi pRRithe manuH svAyambhuvo.abravIt
shlokas.32:
tasmAtpraheShyAmyadya tvAM hInaH prajananAtsvayam |
sadRRishAchChreyaso vA tvaM viddhyapatyaM yashasvini
shlokas.33:
shRRiNu kunti kathAM chemAM shAradaNDAyanIM prati |
yA vIrapatnI gurubhirniyuktApatyajanmani
shlokas.34:
puShpeNa prayatA snAtA nishi kunti chatuShpathe |
varayitvA dvijaM siddhaM hutvA pu.nsavane.analam
shlokas.35:
karmaNyavasite tasminsA tenaiva sahAvasat |
tatra trI~njanayAmAsa durjayAdInmahArathAn
shlokas.36:
tathA tvamapi kalyANi brAhmaNAttapasAdhikAt |
manniyogAdyata kShipramapatyotpAdanaM prati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktA mahArAja kuntI pANDumabhAShata |
kurUNAmRRiShabhaM vIraM tadA bhUmipatiM patim
shlokas.2:
na mAmarhasi dharmaj~na vaktumevaM katha~nchana |
dharmapatnImabhiratAM tvayi rAjIvalochana
shlokas.3:
tvameva tu mahAbAho mayyapatyAni bhArata |
vIra vIryopapannAni dharmato janayiShyasi
shlokas.4:
svargaM manujashArdUla gachCheyaM sahitA tvayA |
apatyAya cha mAM gachCha tvameva kurunandana
shlokas.5:
na hyahaM manasApyanyaM gachCheyaM tvadRRite naram |
tvattaH prativishiShTashcha ko.anyo.asti bhuvi mAnavaH
shlokas.6:
imAM cha tAvaddharmyAM tvaM paurANIM shRRiNu me kathAm |
parishrutAM vishAlAkSha kIrtayiShyAmi yAmaham
shlokas.7:
vyuShitAshva iti khyAto babhUva kila pArthivaH |
purA paramadharmiShThaH pUrorva.nshavivardhanaH
shlokas.8:
tasmi.nshcha yajamAne vai dharmAtmani mahAtmani |
upAgama.nstato devAH sendrAH saha maharShibhiH
shlokas.9:
amAdyadindraH somena dakShiNAbhirdvijAtayaH |
vyuShitAshvasya rAjarShestato yaj~ne mahAtmanaH
shlokas.10:
vyuShitAshvastato rAjannati martyAnvyarochata |
sarvabhUtAnyati yathA tapanaH shishirAtyaye
shlokas.11:
sa vijitya gRRihItvA cha nRRipatInrAjasattamaH |
prAchyAnudIchyAnmadhyA.nshcha dakShiNAtyAnakAlayat
shlokas.12:
ashvamedhe mahAyaj~ne vyuShitAshvaH pratApavAn |
babhUva sa hi rAjendro dashanAgabalAnvitaH
shlokas.13:
apyatra gAthAM gAyanti ye purANavido janAH |
vyuShitAshvaH samudrAntAM vijityemAM vasundharAm
apAlayatsarvavarNAnpitA putrAnivaurasAn
shlokas.14:
yajamAno mahAyaj~nairbrAhmaNebhyo dadau dhanam |
anantaratnAnyAdAya AjahAra mahAkratUn
suShAva cha bahUnsomAnsomasa.nsthAstatAna cha
shlokas.15:
AsItkAkShIvatI chAsya bhAryA paramasaMmatA |
bhadrA nAma manuShyendra rUpeNAsadRRishI bhuvi
shlokas.16:
kAmayAmAsatustau tu parasparamiti shrutiH |
sa tasyAM kAmasaMmatto yakShmANaM samapadyata
shlokas.17:
tenAchireNa kAlena jagAmAstamivA.nshumAn |
tasminprete manuShyendre bhAryAsya bhRRishaduHkhitA
shlokas.18:
aputrA puruShavyAghra vilalApeti naH shrutam |
bhadrA paramaduHkhArtA tannibodha narAdhipa
shlokas.19:
nArI paramadharmaj~na sarvA putravinAkRRitA |
patiM vinA jIvati yA na sA jIvati duHkhitA
shlokas.20:
patiM vinA mRRitaM shreyo nAryAH kShatriyapu~Ngava |
tvadgatiM gantumichChAmi prasIdasva nayasva mAm
shlokas.21:
tvayA hInA kShaNamapi nAhaM jIvitumutsahe |
prasAdaM kuru me rAjannitastUrNaM nayasva mAm
shlokas.22:
pRRiShThato.anugamiShyAmi sameShu viShameShu cha |
tvAmahaM narashArdUla gachChantamanivartinam
shlokas.23:
ChAyevAnapagA rAjansatataM vashavartinI |
bhaviShyAmi naravyAghra nityaM priyahite ratA
shlokas.24:
adya prabhRRiti mAM rAjankaShTA hRRidayashoShaNAH |
Adhayo.abhibhaviShyanti tvadRRite puShkarekShaNa
shlokas.25:
abhAgyayA mayA nUnaM viyuktAH sahachAriNaH |
sa.nyogA viprayuktA vA pUrvadeheShu pArthiva
shlokas.26:
tadidaM karmabhiH pApaiH pUrvadeheShu sa~nchitam |
duHkhaM mAmanusamprAptaM rAja.nstvadviprayogajam
shlokas.27:
adya prabhRRityahaM rAjankushaprastarashAyinI |
bhaviShyAmyasukhAviShTA tvaddarshanaparAyaNA
shlokas.28:
darshayasva naravyAghra sAdhu mAmasukhAnvitAm |
dInAmanAthAM kRRipaNAM vilapantIM nareshvara
shlokas.29:
evaM bahuvidhaM tasyAM vilapantyAM punaH punaH |
taM shavaM sampariShvajya vAkkilAntarhitAbravIt
shlokas.30:
uttiShTha bhadre gachCha tvaM dadAnIha varaM tava |
janayiShyAmyapatyAni tvayyahaM chAruhAsini
shlokas.31:
AtmIye cha varArohe shayanIye chaturdashIm |
aShTamIM vA RRitusnAtA sa.nvishethA mayA saha
shlokas.32:
evamuktA tu sA devI tathA chakre pativratA |
yathoktameva tadvAkyaM bhadrA putrArthinI tadA
shlokas.33:
sA tena suShuve devI shavena manujAdhipa |
trI~nshAlvA.nshchaturo madrAnsutAnbharatasattama
shlokas.34:
tathA tvamapi mayyeva manasA bharatarShabha |
shakto janayituM putrA.nstapoyogabalAnvayAt

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastayA rAjA tAM devIM punarabravIt |
dharmaviddharmasa.nyuktamidaM vachanamuttamam
shlokas.2:
evametatpurA kunti vyuShitAshvashchakAra ha |
yathA tvayoktaM kalyANi sa hyAsIdamaropamaH
shlokas.3:
atha tvimaM pravakShyAmi dharmaM tvetaM nibodha me |
purANamRRiShibhirdRRiShTaM dharmavidbhirmahAtmabhiH
shlokas.4:
anAvRRitAH kila purA striya AsanvarAnane |
kAmachAravihAriNyaH svatantrAshchArulochane
shlokas.5:
tAsAM vyuchcharamANAnAM kaumArAtsubhage patIn |
nAdharmo.abhUdvarArohe sa hi dharmaH purAbhavat
shlokas.6:
taM chaiva dharmaM paurANaM tiryagyonigatAH prajAH |
adyApyanuvidhIyante kAmadveShavivarjitAH
purANadRRiShTo dharmo.ayaM pUjyate cha maharShibhiH
shlokas.7:
uttareShu cha rambhoru kuruShvadyApi vartate |
strINAmanugrahakaraH sa hi dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.8:
asmi.nstu loke nachirAnmaryAdeyaM shuchismite |
sthApitA yena yasmAchcha tanme vistarataH shRRiNu
shlokas.9:
babhUvoddAlako nAma maharShiriti naH shrutam |
shvetaketuriti khyAtaH putrastasyAbhavanmuniH
shlokas.10:
maryAdeyaM kRRitA tena mAnuSheShviti naH shrutam |
kopAtkamalapatrAkShi yadarthaM tannibodha me
shlokas.11:
shvetaketoH kila purA samakShaM mAtaraM pituH |
jagrAha brAhmaNaH pANau gachChAva iti chAbravIt
shlokas.12:
RRiShiputrastataH kopaM chakArAmarShitastadA |
mAtaraM tAM tathA dRRiShTvA nIyamAnAM balAdiva
shlokas.13:
kruddhaM taM tu pitA dRRiShTvA shvetaketumuvAcha ha |
mA tAta kopaM kArShIstvameSha dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.14:
anAvRRitA hi sarveShAM varNAnAma~NganA bhuvi |
yathA gAvaH sthitAstAta sve sve varNe tathA prajAH
shlokas.15:
RRiShiputro.atha taM dharmaM shvetaketurna chakShame |
chakAra chaiva maryAdAmimAM strIpu.nsayorbhuvi
shlokas.16:
mAnuSheShu mahAbhAge na tvevAnyeShu jantuShu |
tadA prabhRRiti maryAdA sthiteyamiti naH shrutam
shlokas.17:
vyuchcharantyAH patiM nAryA adya prabhRRiti pAtakam |
bhrUNahatyAkRRitaM pApaM bhaviShyatyasukhAvaham
shlokas.18:
bhAryAM tathA vyuchcharataH kaumArIM brahmachAriNIm |
pativratAmetadeva bhavitA pAtakaM bhuvi
shlokas.19:
patyA niyuktA yA chaiva patnyapatyArthameva cha |
na kariShyati tasyAshcha bhaviShyatyetadeva hi
shlokas.20:
iti tena purA bhIru maryAdA sthApitA balAt |
uddAlakasya putreNa dharmyA vai shvetaketunA
shlokas.21:
saudAsena cha rambhoru niyuktApatyajanmani |
madayantI jagAmarShiM vasiShThamiti naH shrutam
shlokas.22:
tasmAllebhe cha sA putramashmakaM nAma bhAminI |
bhAryA kalmAShapAdasya bhartuH priyachikIrShayA
shlokas.23:
asmAkamapi te janma viditaM kamalekShaNe |
kRRiShNadvaipAyanAdbhIru kurUNAM va.nshavRRiddhaye
shlokas.24:
ata etAni sarvANi kAraNAni samIkShya vai |
mamaitadvachanaM dharmyaM kartumarhasyanindite
shlokas.25:
RRitAvRRitau rAjaputri striyA bhartA yatavrate |
nAtivartavya ityevaM dharmaM dharmavido viduH
shlokas.26:
sheSheShvanyeShu kAleShu svAtantryaM strI kilArhati |
dharmametaM janAH santaH purANaM parichakShate
shlokas.27:
bhartA bhAryAM rAjaputri dharmyaM vAdharmyameva vA |
yadbrUyAttattathA kAryamiti dharmavido viduH
shlokas.28:
visheShataH putragRRiddhI hInaH prajananAtsvayam |
yathAhamanavadyA~Ngi putradarshanalAlasaH
shlokas.29:
tathA raktA~NgulitalaH padmapatranibhaH shubhe |
prasAdArthaM mayA te.ayaM shirasyabhyudyato.a~njaliH
shlokas.30:
manniyogAtsukeshAnte dvijAtestapasAdhikAt |
putrAnguNasamAyuktAnutpAdayitumarhasi
tvatkRRite.ahaM pRRithushroNi gachCheyaM putriNAM gatim
shlokas.31:
evamuktA tataH kuntI pANDuM parapura~njayam |
pratyuvAcha varArohA bhartuH priyahite ratA
shlokas.32:
pitRRiveshmanyahaM bAlA niyuktAtithipUjane |
ugraM paryacharaM tatra brAhmaNaM sa.nshitavratam
shlokas.33:
nigUDhanishchayaM dharme yaM taM durvAsasaM viduH |
tamahaM sa.nshitAtmAnaM sarvayatnairatoShayam
shlokas.34:
sa me.abhichArasa.nyuktamAchaShTa bhagavAnvaram |
mantragrAmaM cha me prAdAdabravIchchaiva mAmidam
shlokas.35:
yaM yaM devaM tvametena mantreNAvAhayiShyasi |
akAmo vA sakAmo vA sa te vashamupaiShyati
shlokas.36:
ityuktAhaM tadA tena pitRRiveshmani bhArata |
brAhmaNena vachastathyaM tasya kAlo.ayamAgataH
shlokas.37:
anuj~nAtA tvayA devamAhvayeyamahaM nRRipa |
tena mantreNa rAjarShe yathA syAnnau prajA vibho
shlokas.38:
AvAhayAmi kaM devaM brUhi tattvavidAM vara |
tvatto.anuj~nApratIkShAM mAM viddhyasminkarmaNi sthitAm
shlokas.39:
pANDuruvAcha||
adyaiva tvaM varArohe prayatasva yathAvidhi |
dharmamAvAhaya shubhe sa hi deveShu puNyabhAk
shlokas.40:
adharmeNa na no dharmaH sa.nyujyeta katha~nchana |
lokashchAyaM varArohe dharmo.ayamiti ma.nsyate
shlokas.41:
dhArmikashcha kurUNAM sa bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH |
dattasyApi cha dharmeNa nAdharme ra.nsyate manaH
shlokas.42:
tasmAddharmaM puraskRRitya niyatA tvaM shuchismite |
upachArAbhichArAbhyAM dharmamArAdhayasva vai
shlokas.43:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sA tathoktA tathetyuktvA tena bhartrA varA~NganA |
abhivAdyAbhyanuj~nAtA pradakShiNamavartata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa.nvatsarAhite garbhe gAndhAryA janamejaya |
AhvayAmAsa vai kuntI garbhArthaM dharmamachyutam
shlokas.2:
sA baliM tvaritA devI dharmAyopajahAra ha |
jajApa japyaM vidhivaddattaM durvAsasA purA
shlokas.3:
sa~Ngamya sA tu dharmeNa yogamUrtidhareNa vai |
lebhe putraM varArohA sarvaprANabhRRitAM varam
shlokas.4:
aindre chandrasamAyukte muhUrte.abhijite.aShTame |
divA madhyagate sUrye tithau puNye.abhipUjite
shlokas.5:
samRRiddhayashasaM kuntI suShAva samaye sutam |
jAtamAtre sute tasminvAguvAchAsharIriNI
shlokas.6:
eSha dharmabhRRitAM shreShTho bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH |
yudhiShThira iti khyAtaH pANDoH prathamajaH sutaH
shlokas.7:
bhavitA prathito rAjA triShu lokeShu vishrutaH |
yashasA tejasA chaiva vRRittena cha samanvitaH
shlokas.8:
dhArmikaM taM sutaM labdhvA pANDustAM punarabravIt |
prAhuH kShatraM balajyeShThaM balajyeShThaM sutaM vRRiNu
shlokas.9:
tatastathoktA patyA tu vAyumevAjuhAva sA |
tasmAjjaj~ne mahAbAhurbhImo bhImaparAkramaH
shlokas.10:
tamapyatibalaM jAtaM vAgabhyavadadachyutam |
sarveShAM balinAM shreShTho jAto.ayamiti bhArata
shlokas.11:
idamatyadbhutaM chAsIjjAtamAtre vRRikodare |
yada~NkAtpatito mAtuH shilAM gAtrairachUrNayat
shlokas.12:
kuntI vyAghrabhayodvignA sahasotpatitA kila |
nAnvabudhyata sa.nsuptamutsa~Nge sve vRRikodaram
shlokas.13:
tataH sa vajrasa~NghAtaH kumAro.abhyapatadgirau |
patatA tena shatadhA shilA gAtrairvichUrNitA
tAM shilAM chUrNitAM dRRiShTvA pANDurvismayamAgamat
shlokas.14:
yasminnahani bhImastu jaj~ne bharatasattama |
duryodhano.api tatraiva prajaj~ne vasudhAdhipa
shlokas.15:
jAte vRRikodare pANDuridaM bhUyo.anvachintayat |
kathaM nu me varaH putro lokashreShTho bhavediti
shlokas.16:
daive puruShakAre cha loko.ayaM hi pratiShThitaH |
tatra daivaM tu vidhinA kAlayuktena labhyate
shlokas.17:
indro hi rAjA devAnAM pradhAna iti naH shrutam |
aprameyabalotsAho vIryavAnamitadyutiH
shlokas.18:
taM toShayitvA tapasA putraM lapsye mahAbalam |
yaM dAsyati sa me putraM sa varIyAnbhaviShyati
karmaNA manasA vAchA tasmAttapsye mahattapaH
shlokas.19:
tataH pANDurmahAtejA mantrayitvA maharShibhiH |
didesha kuntyAH kauravyo vrataM sA.nvatsaraM shubham
shlokas.20:
AtmanA cha mahAbAhurekapAdasthito.abhavat |
ugraM sa tapa Atasthe parameNa samAdhinA
shlokas.21:
ArirAdhayiShurdevaM tridashAnAM tamIshvaram |
sUryeNa saha dharmAtmA paryavartata bhArata
shlokas.22:
taM tu kAlena mahatA vAsavaH pratyabhAShata |
putraM tava pradAsyAmi triShu lokeShu vishrutam
shlokas.23:
devAnAM brAhmaNAnAM cha suhRRidAM chArthasAdhakam |
sutaM te.agryaM pradAsyAmi sarvAmitravinAshanam
shlokas.24:
ityuktaH kauravo rAjA vAsavena mahAtmanA |
uvAcha kuntIM dharmAtmA devarAjavachaH smaran
shlokas.25:
nItimantaM mahAtmAnamAdityasamatejasam |
durAdharShaM kriyAvantamatIvAdbhutadarshanam
shlokas.26:
putraM janaya sushroNi dhAma kShatriyatejasAm |
labdhaH prasAdo devendrAttamAhvaya shuchismite
shlokas.27:
evamuktA tataH shakramAjuhAva yashasvinI |
athAjagAma devendro janayAmAsa chArjunam
shlokas.28:
jAtamAtre kumAre tu vAguvAchAsharIriNI |
mahAgambhIranirghoShA nabho nAdayatI tadA
shlokas.29:
kArtavIryasamaH kunti shibitulyaparAkramaH |
eSha shakra ivAjeyo yashaste prathayiShyati
shlokas.30:
adityA viShNunA prItiryathAbhUdabhivardhitA |
tathA viShNusamaH prItiM vardhayiShyati te.arjunaH
shlokas.31:
eSha madrAnvashe kRRitvA kurU.nshcha saha kekayaiH |
chedikAshikarUShA.nshcha kurulakShma sudhAsyati
shlokas.32:
etasya bhujavIryeNa khANDave havyavAhanaH |
medasA sarvabhUtAnAM tRRiptiM yAsyati vai parAm
shlokas.33:
grAmaNIshcha mahIpAlAneSha jitvA mahAbalaH |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito vIrastrInmedhAnAhariShyati
shlokas.34:
jAmadagnyasamaH kunti viShNutulyaparAkramaH |
eSha vIryavatAM shreShTho bhaviShyatyaparAjitaH
shlokas.35:
tathA divyAni chAstrANi nikhilAnyAhariShyati |
vipranaShTAM shriyaM chAyamAhartA puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.36:
etAmatyadbhutAM vAchaM kuntIputrasya sUtake |
uktavAnvAyurAkAshe kuntI shushrAva chAsya tAm
shlokas.37:
vAchamuchchAritAmuchchaistAM nishamya tapasvinAm |
babhUva paramo harShaH shatashRRi~NganivAsinAm
shlokas.38:
tathA devaRRiShINAM cha sendrANAM cha divaukasAm |
AkAshe dundubhInAM cha babhUva tumulaH svanaH
shlokas.39:
udatiShThanmahAghoShaH puShpavRRiShTibhirAvRRitaH |
samavetya cha devAnAM gaNAH pArthamapUjayan
shlokas.40:
kAdraveyA vainateyA gandharvApsarasastathA |
prajAnAM patayaH sarve sapta chaiva maharShayaH
shlokas.41:
bharadvAjaH kashyapo gautamashcha; vishvAmitro jamadagnirvasiShThaH |
yashchodito bhAskare.abhUtpranaShTe; so.apyatrAtrirbhagavAnAjagAma
shlokas.42:
marIchira~NgirAshchaiva pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH |
dakShaH prajApatishchaiva gandharvApsarasastathA
shlokas.43:
divyamAlyAmbaradharAH sarvAla~NkArabhUShitAH |
upagAyanti bIbhatsumupanRRityanti chApsarAH
gandharvaiH sahitaH shrImAnprAgAyata cha tumburuH
shlokas.44:
bhImasenograsenau cha UrNAyuranaghastathA |
gopatirdhRRitarAShTrashcha sUryavarchAshcha saptamaH
shlokas.45:
yugapastRRiNapaH kArShNirnandishchitrarathastathA |
trayodashaH shAlishirAH parjanyashcha chaturdashaH
shlokas.46:
kaliH pa~nchadashashchAtra nAradashchaiva ShoDashaH |
sadvA bRRihadvA bRRihakaH karAlashcha mahAyashAH
shlokas.47:
brahmachArI bahuguNaH suparNashcheti vishrutaH |
vishvAvasurbhumanyushcha suchandro dashamastathA
shlokas.48:
gItamAdhuryasampannau vikhyAtau cha hahAhuhU |
ityete devagandharvA jagustatra nararShabham
shlokas.49:
tathaivApsaraso hRRiShTAH sarvAla~NkArabhUShitAH |
nanRRiturvai mahAbhAgA jagushchAyatalochanAH
shlokas.50:
anUnA chAnavadyA cha priyamukhyA guNAvarA |
adrikA cha tathA sAchI mishrakeshI alambusA
shlokas.51:
marIchiH shichukA chaiva vidyutparNA tilottamA |
agnikA lakShaNA kShemA devI rambhA manoramA
shlokas.52:
asitA cha subAhushcha supriyA suvapustathA |
puNDarIkA sugandhA cha surathA cha pramAthinI
shlokas.53:
kAmyA shAradvatI chaiva nanRRitustatra sa~NghashaH |
menakA sahajanyA cha parNikA pu~njikasthalA
shlokas.54:
kratusthalA ghRRitAchI cha vishvAchI pUrvachittyapi |
umlochetyabhivikhyAtA pramlocheti cha tA dasha
urvashyekAdashItyetA jagurAyatalochanAH
shlokas.55:
dhAtAryamA cha mitrashcha varuNoM.asho bhagastathA |
indro vivasvAnpUShA cha tvaShTA cha savitA tathA
shlokas.56:
parjanyashchaiva viShNushcha AdityAH pAvakArchiShaH |
mahimAnaM pANDavasya vardhayanto.ambare sthitAH
shlokas.57:
mRRigavyAdhashcha sharvashcha nirRRitishcha mahAyashAH |
ajaikapAdahirbudhnyaH pinAkI cha parantapaH
shlokas.58:
dahano.atheshvarashchaiva kapAlI cha vishAM pate |
sthANurbhavashcha bhagavAnrudrAstatrAvatasthire
shlokas.59:
ashvinau vasavashchAShTau marutashcha mahAbalAH |
vishvedevAstathA sAdhyAstatrAsanparisa.nsthitAH
shlokas.60:
karkoTako.atha sheShashcha vAsukishcha bhuja~NgamaH |
kachChapashchApakuNDashcha takShakashcha mahoragaH
shlokas.61:
AyayustejasA yuktA mahAkrodhA mahAbalAH |
ete chAnye cha bahavastatra nAgA vyavasthitAH
shlokas.63:
taddRRiShTvA mahadAshcharyaM vismitA munisattamAH |
adhikAM sma tato vRRittimavartanpANDavAnprati
shlokas.64:
pANDustu punarevainAM putralobhAnmahAyashAH |
prAhiNoddarshanIyA~NgIM kuntI tvenamathAbravIt
shlokas.65:
nAtashchaturthaM prasavamApatsvapi vadantyuta |
ataH paraM chAriNI syAtpa~nchame bandhakI bhavet
shlokas.66:
sa tvaM vidvandharmamimaM buddhigamyaM kathaM nu mAm |
apatyArthaM samutkramya pramAdAdiva bhAShase

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kuntIputreShu jAteShu dhRRitarAShTrAtmajeShu cha |
madrarAjasutA pANDuM raho vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
na me.asti tvayi santApo viguNe.api parantapa |
nAvaratve varArhAyAH sthitvA chAnagha nityadA
shlokas.3:
gAndhAryAshchaiva nRRipate jAtaM putrashataM tathA |
shrutvA na me tathA duHkhamabhavatkurunandana
shlokas.4:
idaM tu me mahadduHkhaM tulyatAyAmaputratA |
diShTyA tvidAnIM bharturme kuntyAmapyasti santatiH
shlokas.5:
yadi tvapatyasantAnaM kuntirAjasutA mayi |
kuryAdanugraho me syAttava chApi hitaM bhavet
shlokas.6:
stambho hi me sapatnItvAdvaktuM kuntisutAM prati |
yadi tu tvaM prasanno me svayamenAM prachodaya
shlokas.7:
pANDuruvAcha||
mamApyeSha sadA mAdri hRRidyarthaH parivartate |
na tu tvAM prasahe vaktumiShTAniShTavivakShayA
shlokas.8:
tava tvidaM mataM j~nAtvA prayatiShyAmyataH param |
manye dhruvaM mayoktA sA vacho me pratipatsyate
shlokas.9:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH kuntIM punaH pANDurvivikta idamabravIt |
kulasya mama santAnaM lokasya cha kuru priyam
shlokas.10:
mama chApiNDanAshAya pUrveShAmapi chAtmanaH |
matpriyArthaM cha kalyANi kuru kalyANamuttamam
shlokas.11:
yashaso.arthAya chaiva tvaM kuru karma suduShkaram |
prApyAdhipatyamindreNa yaj~nairiShTaM yashorthinA
shlokas.12:
tathA mantravido viprAstapastaptvA suduShkaram |
gurUnabhyupagachChanti yashaso.arthAya bhAmini
shlokas.13:
tathA rAjarShayaH sarve brAhmaNAshcha tapodhanAH |
chakruruchchAvachaM karma yashaso.arthAya duShkaram
shlokas.14:
sA tvaM mAdrIM plaveneva tArayemAmanindite |
apatyasa.nvibhAgena parAM kIrtimavApnuhi
shlokas.15:
evamuktAbravInmAdrIM sakRRichchintaya daivatam |
tasmAtte bhavitApatyamanurUpamasa.nshayam
shlokas.16:
tato mAdrI vichAryaiva jagAma manasAshvinau |
tAvAgamya sutau tasyAM janayAmAsaturyamau
shlokas.17:
nakulaM sahadevaM cha rUpeNApratimau bhuvi |
tathaiva tAvapi yamau vAguvAchAsharIriNI
shlokas.18:
rUpasattvaguNopetAvetAvanyA~njanAnati |
bhAsatastejasAtyarthaM rUpadraviNasampadA
shlokas.19:
nAmAni chakrire teShAM shatashRRi~NganivAsinaH |
bhaktyA cha karmaNA chaiva tathAshIrbhirvishAM pate
shlokas.20:
jyeShThaM yudhiShThiretyAhurbhImaseneti madhyamam |
arjuneti tRRitIyaM cha kuntIputrAnakalpayan
shlokas.21:
pUrvajaM nakuletyevaM sahadeveti chAparam |
mAdrIputrAvakathaya.nste viprAH prItamAnasAH
anusa.nvatsaraM jAtA api te kurusattamAH
shlokas.22:
kuntImatha punaH pANDurmAdryarthe samachodayat |
tamuvAcha pRRithA rAjanrahasyuktA satI sadA
shlokas.23:
uktA sakRRiddvandvameShA lebhe tenAsmi va~nchitA |
bibhemyasyAH paribhavAnnArINAM gatirIdRRishI
shlokas.24:
nAj~nAsiShamahaM mUDhA dvandvAhvAne phaladvayam |
tasmAnnAhaM niyoktavyA tvayaiSho.astu varo mama
shlokas.25:
evaM pANDoH sutAH pa~ncha devadattA mahAbalAH |
sambhUtAH kIrtimantaste kuruva.nshavivardhanAH
shlokas.26:
shubhalakShaNasampannAH somavatpriyadarshanAH |
siMhadarpA maheShvAsAH siMhavikrAntagAminaH
siMhagrIvA manuShyendrA vavRRidhurdevavikramAH
shlokas.27:
vivardhamAnAste tatra puNye haimavate girau |
vismayaM janayAmAsurmaharShINAM sameyuShAm
shlokas.28:
te cha pa~ncha shataM chaiva kuruva.nshavivardhanAH |
sarve vavRRidhuralpena kAlenApsviva nIrajAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
darshanIyA.nstataH putrAnpANDuH pa~ncha mahAvane |
tAnpashyanparvate reme svabAhubalapAlitAn
shlokas.2:
supuShpitavane kAle kadAchinmadhumAdhave |
bhUtasaMmohane rAjA sabhAryo vyacharadvanam
shlokas.3:
palAshaistilakaishchUtaishchampakaiH pAribhadrakaiH |
anyaishcha bahubhirvRRikShaiH phalapuShpasamRRiddhibhiH
shlokas.4:
jalasthAnaishcha vividhaiH padminIbhishcha shobhitam |
pANDorvanaM tu samprekShya prajaj~ne hRRidi manmathaH
shlokas.5:
prahRRiShTamanasaM tatra viharantaM yathAmaram |
taM mAdryanujagAmaikA vasanaM bibhratI shubham
shlokas.6:
samIkShamANaH sa tu tAM vayaHsthAM tanuvAsasam |
tasya kAmaH pravavRRidhe gahane.agnirivotthitaH
shlokas.7:
rahasyAtmasamAM dRRiShTvA rAjA rAjIvalochanAm |
na shashAka niyantuM taM kAmaM kAmabalAtkRRitaH
shlokas.8:
tata enAM balAdrAjA nijagrAha rahogatAm |
vAryamANastayA devyA visphurantyA yathAbalam
shlokas.9:
