sa tu kAmaparItAtmA taM shApaM nAnvabudhyata |
mAdrIM maithunadharmeNa gachChamAno balAdiva
shlokas.10:
jIvitAntAya kauravyo manmathasya vashaM gataH |
shApajaM bhayamutsRRijya jagAmaiva balAtpriyAm
shlokas.11:
tasya kAmAtmano buddhiH sAkShAtkAlena mohitA |
sampramathyendriyagrAmaM pranaShTA saha chetasA
shlokas.12:
sa tayA saha sa~Ngamya bhAryayA kurunandana |
pANDuH paramadharmAtmA yuyuje kAladharmaNA
shlokas.13:
tato mAdrI samAli~Ngya rAjAnaM gatachetasam |
mumocha duHkhajaM shabdaM punaH punaratIva ha
shlokas.14:
saha putraistataH kuntI mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau |
AjagmuH sahitAstatra yatra rAjA tathAgataH
shlokas.15:
tato mAdryabravIdrAjannArtA kuntImidaM vachaH |
ekaiva tvamihAgachCha tiShThantvatraiva dArakAH
shlokas.16:
tachChrutvA vachanaM tasyAstatraivAvArya dArakAn |
hatAhamiti vikrushya sahasopajagAma ha
shlokas.17:
dRRiShTvA pANDuM cha mAdrIM cha shayAnau dharaNItale |
kuntI shokaparItA~NgI vilalApa suduHkhitA
shlokas.18:
rakShyamANo mayA nityaM vIraH satatamAtmavAn |
kathaM tvamabhyatikrAntaH shApaM jAnanvanaukasaH
shlokas.19:
nanu nAma tvayA mAdri rakShitavyo janAdhipaH |
sA kathaM lobhitavatI vijane tvaM narAdhipam
shlokas.20:
kathaM dInasya satataM tvAmAsAdya rahogatAm |
taM vichintayataH shApaM praharShaH samajAyata
shlokas.21:
dhanyA tvamasi bAhlIki matto bhAgyatarA tathA |
dRRiShTavatyasi yadvaktraM prahRRiShTasya mahIpateH
shlokas.22:
mAdryuvAcha||
vilobhyamAnena mayA vAryamANena chAsakRRit |
AtmA na vArito.anena satyaM diShTaM chikIrShuNA
shlokas.23:
kuntyuvAcha||
ahaM jyeShThA dharmapatnI jyeShThaM dharmaphalaM mama |
avashyaM bhAvino bhAvAnmA mAM mAdri nivartaya
shlokas.24:
anveShyAmIha bhartAramahaM pretavashaM gatam |
uttiShTha tvaM visRRijyainamimAnrakShasva dArakAn
shlokas.25:
mAdryuvAcha||
ahamevAnuyAsyAmi bhartAramapalAyinam |
na hi tRRiptAsmi kAmAnAM tajjyeShThA anumanyatAm
shlokas.26:
mAM chAbhigamya kShINo.ayaM kAmAdbharatasattamaH |
tamuchChindyAmasya kAmaM kathaM nu yamasAdane
shlokas.27:
na chApyahaM vartayantI nirvisheShaM suteShu te |
vRRittimArye chariShyAmi spRRishedenastathA hi mAm
shlokas.28:
tasmAnme sutayoH kunti vartitavyaM svaputravat |
mAM hi kAmayamAno.ayaM rAjA pretavashaM gataH
shlokas.29:
rAj~naH sharIreNa saha mamApIdaM kalevaram |
dagdhavyaM supratichChannametadArye priyaM kuru
shlokas.30:
dArakeShvapramattA cha bhavethAshcha hitA mama |
ato.anyanna prapashyAmi sa.ndeShTavyaM hi ki~nchana
shlokas.31:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA taM chitAgnisthaM dharmapatnI nararShabham |
madrarAjAtmajA tUrNamanvArohadyashasvinI

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pANDoravabhRRithaM kRRitvA devakalpA maharShayaH |
tato mantramakurvanta te sametya tapasvinaH
shlokas.2:
hitvA rAjyaM cha rAShTraM cha sa mahAtmA mahAtapAH |
asminsthAne tapastaptuM tApasA~nsharaNaM gataH
shlokas.3:
sa jAtamAtrAnputrA.nshcha dArA.nshcha bhavatAmiha |
pradAyopanidhiM rAjA pANDuH svargamito gataH
shlokas.4:
te parasparamAmantrya sarvabhUtahite ratAH |
pANDoH putrAnpuraskRRitya nagaraM nAgasAhvayam
shlokas.5:
udAramanasaH siddhA gamane chakrire manaH |
bhIShmAya pANDavAndAtuM dhRRitarAShTrAya chaiva hi
shlokas.6:
tasminneva kShaNe sarve tAnAdAya pratasthire |
pANDordArA.nshcha putrA.nshcha sharIraM chaiva tApasAH
shlokas.7:
sukhinI sA purA bhUtvA satataM putravatsalA |
prapannA dIrghamadhvAnaM sa~NkShiptaM tadamanyata
shlokas.8:
sA nadIrgheNa kAlena samprAptA kurujA~Ngalam |
vardhamAnapuradvAramAsasAda yashasvinI
shlokas.9:
taM chAraNasahasrANAM munInAmAgamaM tadA |
shrutvA nAgapure nRRiNAM vismayaH samajAyata
shlokas.10:
muhUrtodita Aditye sarve dharmapuraskRRitAH |
sadArAstApasAndraShTuM niryayuH puravAsinaH
shlokas.11:
strIsa~NghAH kShatrasa~NghAshcha yAnasa~NghAnsamAsthitAH |
brAhmaNaiH saha nirjagmurbrAhmaNAnAM cha yoShitaH
shlokas.12:
tathA viTshUdrasa~NghAnAM mahAnvyatikaro.abhavat |
na kashchidakarodIrShyAmabhavandharmabuddhayaH
shlokas.13:
tathA bhIShmaH shAntanavaH somadatto.atha bAhlikaH |
praj~nAchakShushcha rAjarShiH kShattA cha viduraH svayam
shlokas.14:
sA cha satyavatI devI kausalyA cha yashasvinI |
rAjadAraiH parivRRitA gAndhArI cha viniryayau
shlokas.15:
dhRRitarAShTrasya dAyAdA duryodhanapurogamAH |
bhUShitA bhUShaNaishchitraiH shatasa~NkhyA viniryayuH
shlokas.16:
tAnmaharShigaNAnsarvA~nshirobhirabhivAdya cha |
upopavivishuH sarve kauravyAH sapurohitAH
shlokas.17:
tathaiva shirasA bhUmAvabhivAdya praNamya cha |
upopavivishuH sarve paurajAnapadA api
shlokas.18:
tamakUjamivAj~nAya janaughaM sarvashastadA |
bhIShmo rAjyaM cha rAShTraM cha maharShibhyo nyavedayat
shlokas.19:
teShAmatho vRRiddhatamaH pratyutthAya jaTAjinI |
maharShimatamAj~nAya maharShiridamabravIt
shlokas.20:
yaH sa kauravyadAyAdaH pANDurnAma narAdhipaH |
kAmabhogAnparityajya shatashRRi~Ngamito gataH
shlokas.21:
brahmacharyavratasthasya tasya divyena hetunA |
sAkShAddharmAdayaM putrastasya jAto yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.22:
tathemaM balinAM shreShThaM tasya rAj~no mahAtmanaH |
mAtarishvA dadau putraM bhImaM nAma mahAbalam
shlokas.23:
puruhUtAdayaM jaj~ne kuntyAM satyaparAkramaH |
yasya kIritrmaheShvAsAnsarvAnabhibhaviShyati
shlokas.24:
yau tu mAdrI maheShvAsAvasUta kurusattamau |
ashvibhyAM manujavyAghrAvimau tAvapi tiShThataH
shlokas.25:
charatA dharmanityena vanavAsaM yashasvinA |
eSha paitAmaho va.nshaH pANDunA punaruddhRRitaH
shlokas.26:
putrANAM janma vRRiddhiM cha vaidikAdhyayanAni cha |
pashyataH satataM pANDoH shashvatprItiravardhata
shlokas.27:
vartamAnaH satAM vRRitte putralAbhamavApya cha |
pitRRilokaM gataH pANDuritaH saptadashe.ahani
shlokas.28:
taM chitAgatamAj~nAya vaishvAnaramukhe hutam |
praviShTA pAvakaM mAdrI hitvA jIvitamAtmanaH
shlokas.29:
sA gatA saha tenaiva patilokamanuvratA |
tasyAstasya cha yatkAryaM kriyatAM tadanantaram
shlokas.30:
ime tayoH sharIre dve sutAshcheme tayorvarAH |
kriyAbhiranugRRihyantAM saha mAtrA parantapAH
shlokas.31:
pretakArye cha nirvRRitte pitRRimedhaM mahAyashAH |
labhatAM sarvadharmaj~naH pANDuH kurukulodvahaH
shlokas.32:
evamuktvA kurUnsarvAnkurUNAmeva pashyatAm |
kShaNenAntarhitAH sarve chAraNA guhyakaiH saha
shlokas.33:
gandharvanagarAkAraM tatraivAntarhitaM punaH |
RRiShisiddhagaNaM dRRiShTvA vismayaM te paraM yayuH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
pANDorvidura sarvANi pretakAryANi kAraya |
rAjavadrAjasiMhasya mAdryAshchaiva visheShataH
shlokas.2:
pashUnvAsA.nsi ratnAni dhanAni vividhAni cha |
pANDoH prayachCha mAdryAshcha yebhyo yAvachcha vA~nChitam
shlokas.3:
yathA cha kuntI satkAraM kuryAnmAdryAstathA kuru |
yathA na vAyurnAdityaH pashyetAM tAM susa.nvRRitAm
shlokas.4:
na shochyaH pANDuranaghaH prashasyaH sa narAdhipaH |
yasya pa~ncha sutA vIrA jAtAH surasutopamAH
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vidurastaM tathetyuktvA bhIShmeNa saha bhArata |
pANDuM sa.nskArayAmAsa deshe paramasa.nvRRite
shlokas.6:
tatastu nagarAttUrNamAjyahomapuraskRRitAH |
nirhRRitAH pAvakA dIptAH pANDo rAjapurohitaiH
shlokas.7:
athainamArtavairgandhairmAlyaishcha vividhairvaraiH |
shibikAM samala~nchakrurvAsasAchChAdya sarvashaH
shlokas.8:
tAM tathA shobhitAM mAlyairvAsobhishcha mahAdhanaiH |
amAtyA j~nAtayashchaiva suhRRidashchopatasthire
shlokas.9:
nRRisiMhaM narayuktena paramAla~NkRRitena tam |
avahanyAnamukhyena saha mAdryA susa.nvRRitam
shlokas.10:
pANDureNAtapatreNa chAmaravyajanena cha |
sarvavAditranAdaishcha samala~nchakrire tataH
shlokas.11:
ratnAni chApyupAdAya bahUni shatasho narAH |
pradaduH kA~NkShamANebhyaH pANDostatraurdhvadehikam
shlokas.12:
atha ChatrANi shubhrANi pANDurANi bRRihanti cha |
AjahruH kauravasyArthe vAsA.nsi ruchirANi cha
shlokas.13:
yAjakaiH shuklavAsobhirhUyamAnA hutAshanAH |
agachChannagratastasya dIpyamAnAH svala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.14:
brAhmaNAH kShatriyA vaishyAH shUdrAshchaiva sahasrashaH |
rudantaH shokasantaptA anujagmurnarAdhipam
shlokas.15:
ayamasmAnapAhAya duHkhe chAdhAya shAshvate |
kRRitvAnAthAnparo nAthaH kva yAsyati narAdhipaH
shlokas.16:
kroshantaH pANDavAH sarve bhIShmo vidura eva cha |
ramaNIye vanoddeshe ga~NgAtIre same shubhe
shlokas.17:
nyAsayAmAsuratha tAM shibikAM satyavAdinaH |
sabhAryasya nRRisiMhasya pANDorakliShTakarmaNaH
shlokas.18:
tatastasya sharIraM tatsarvagandhaniShevitam |
shuchikAlIyakAdigdhaM mukhyasnAnAdhivAsitam
paryaShi~nchajjalenAshu shAtakumbhamayairghaTaiH
shlokas.19:
chandanena cha mukhyena shuklena samalepayan |
kAlAguruvimishreNa tathA tu~Ngarasena cha
shlokas.20:
athainaM deshajaiH shuklairvAsobhiH samayojayan |
AchChannaH sa tu vAsobhirjIvanniva nararShabhaH
shushubhe puruShavyAghro mahArhashayanochitaH
shlokas.21:
yAjakairabhyanuj~nAtaM pretakarmaNi niShThitaiH |
ghRRitAvasiktaM rAjAnaM saha mAdryA svala~NkRRitam
shlokas.22:
tu~NgapadmakamishreNa chandanena sugandhinA |
anyaishcha vividhairgandhairanalpaiH samadAhayan
shlokas.23:
tatastayoH sharIre te dRRiShTvA mohavashaM gatA |
hAhA putreti kausalyA papAta sahasA bhuvi
shlokas.24:
tAM prekShya patitAmArtAM paurajAnapado janaH |
ruroda sasvanaM sarvo rAjabhaktyA kRRipAnvitaH
shlokas.25:
klAntAnIvArtanAdena sarvANi cha vichukrushuH |
mAnuShaiH saha bhUtAni tiryagyonigatAnyapi
shlokas.26:
tathA bhIShmaH shAntanavo vidurashcha mahAmatiH |
sarvashaH kauravAshchaiva prANadanbhRRishaduHkhitAH
shlokas.27:
tato bhIShmo.atha viduro rAjA cha saha bandhubhiH |
udakaM chakrire tasya sarvAshcha kuruyoShitaH
shlokas.28:
kRRitodakA.nstAnAdAya pANDavA~nshokakarshitAn |
sarvAH prakRRitayo rAja~nshochantyaH paryavArayan
shlokas.29:
yathaiva pANDavA bhUmau suShupuH saha bAndhavaiH |
tathaiva nAgarA rAja~nshishyire brAhmaNAdayaH
shlokas.30:
tadanAnandamasvasthamAkumAramahRRiShTavat |
babhUva pANDavaiH sArdhaM nagaraM dvAdasha kShapAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH kShattA cha rAjA cha bhIShmashcha saha bandhubhiH |
daduH shrAddhaM tadA pANDoH svadhAmRRitamayaM tadA
shlokas.2:
kurU.nshcha vipramukhyA.nshcha bhojayitvA sahasrashaH |
ratnaughAndvijamukhyebhyo dattvA grAmavarAnapi
shlokas.3:
kRRitashauchA.nstatastA.nstu pANDavAnbharatarShabhAn |
AdAya vivishuH paurAH puraM vAraNasAhvayam
shlokas.4:
satataM smAnvatapyanta tameva bharatarShabham |
paurajAnapadAH sarve mRRitaM svamiva bAndhavam
shlokas.5:
shrAddhAvasAne tu tadA dRRiShTvA taM duHkhitaM janam |
saMmUDhAM duHkhashokArtAM vyAso mAtaramabravIt
shlokas.6:
atikrAntasukhAH kAlAH pratyupasthitadAruNAH |
shvaH shvaH pApIyadivasAH pRRithivI gatayauvanA
shlokas.7:
bahumAyAsamAkIrNo nAnAdoShasamAkulaH |
luptadharmakriyAchAro ghoraH kAlo bhaviShyati
shlokas.8:
gachCha tvaM tyAgamAsthAya yuktA vasa tapovane |
mA drakShyasi kulasyAsya ghoraM sa~NkShayamAtmanaH
shlokas.9:
tatheti samanuj~nAya sA pravishyAbravItsnuShAm |
ambike tava putrasya durnayAtkila bhAratAH
sAnubandhA vina~NkShyanti pautrAshchaiveti naH shrutam
shlokas.10:
tatkausalyAmimAmArtAM putrashokAbhipIDitAm |
vanamAdAya bhadraM te gachChAvo yadi manyase
shlokas.11:
tathetyukte ambikayA bhIShmamAmantrya suvratA |
vanaM yayau satyavatI snuShAbhyAM saha bhArata
shlokas.12:
tAH sughoraM tapaH kRRitvA devyo bharatasattama |
dehaM tyaktvA mahArAja gatimiShTAM yayustadA
shlokas.13:
avApnuvanta vedoktAnsa.nskArAnpANDavAstadA |
avardhanta cha bhogA.nste bhu~njAnAH pitRRiveshmani
shlokas.14:
dhArtarAShTraishcha sahitAH krIDantaH pitRRiveshmani |
bAlakrIDAsu sarvAsu vishiShTAH pANDavAbhavan
shlokas.15:
jave lakShyAbhiharaNe bhojye pA.nsuvikarShaNe |
dhArtarAShTrAnbhImasenaH sarvAnsa parimardati
shlokas.16:
harShAdetAnkrIDamAnAngRRihya kAkanilIyane |
shiraHsu cha nigRRihyainAnyodhayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.17:
shatamekottaraM teShAM kumArANAM mahaujasAm |
eka eva vimRRidnAti nAtikRRichChrAdvRRikodaraH
shlokas.18:
pAdeShu cha nigRRihyainAnvinihatya balAdbalI |
chakarSha kroshato bhUmau ghRRiShTajAnushirokShikAn
shlokas.19:
dasha bAlA~njale krIDanbhujAbhyAM parigRRihya saH |
Aste sma salile magnaH pramRRitA.nshcha vimu~nchati
shlokas.20:
phalAni vRRikShamAruhya prachinvanti cha te yadA |
tadA pAdaprahAreNa bhImaH kampayate drumam
shlokas.21:
prahAravegAbhihatAddrumAdvyAghUrNitAstataH |
saphalAH prapatanti sma drutaM srastAH kumArakAH
shlokas.22:
na te niyuddhe na jave na yogyAsu kadAchana |
kumArA uttaraM chakruH spardhamAnA vRRikodaram
shlokas.23:
evaM sa dhArtarAShTrANAM spardhamAno vRRikodaraH |
apriye.atiShThadatyantaM bAlyAnna drohachetasA
shlokas.24:
tato balamatikhyAtaM dhArtarAShTraH pratApavAn |
bhImasenasya tajj~nAtvA duShTabhAvamadarshayat
shlokas.25:
tasya dharmAdapetasya pApAni paripashyataH |
mohAdaishvaryalobhAchcha pApA matirajAyata
shlokas.26:
ayaM balavatAM shreShThaH kuntIputro vRRikodaraH |
madhyamaH pANDuputrANAM nikRRityA saMnihanyatAm
shlokas.27:
atha tasmAdavarajaM jyeShThaM chaiva yudhiShThiram |
prasahya bandhane baddhvA prashAsiShye vasundharAm
shlokas.28:
evaM sa nishchayaM pApaH kRRitvA duryodhanastadA |
nityamevAntaraprekShI bhImasyAsInmahAtmanaH
shlokas.29:
tato jalavihArArthaM kArayAmAsa bhArata |
chelakambalaveshmAni vichitrANi mahAnti cha
shlokas.30:
pramANakoTyAmuddeshaM sthalaM ki~nchidupetya cha |
krIDAvasAne sarve te shuchivastrAH svala~NkRRitAH
sarvakAmasamRRiddhaM tadannaM bubhujire shanaiH
shlokas.31:
divasAnte parishrAntA vihRRitya cha kurUdvahAH |
vihArAvasatheShveva vIrA vAsamarochayan
shlokas.32:
khinnastu balavAnbhImo vyAyAmAbhyadhikastadA |
vAhayitvA kumArA.nstA~njalakrIDAgatAnvibhuH
pramANakoTyAM vAsArthI suShvApAruhya tatsthalam
shlokas.33:
shItaM vAsaM samAsAdya shrAnto madavimohitaH |
nishcheShTaH pANDavo rAjansuShvApa mRRitakalpavat
shlokas.34:
tato baddhvA latApAshairbhImaM duryodhanaH shanaiH |
gambhIraM bhImavegaM cha sthalAjjalamapAtayat
shlokas.35:
tataH prabuddhaH kaunteyaH sarvaM sa~nChidya bandhanam |
udatiShThajjalAdbhUyo bhImaH praharatAM varaH
shlokas.36:
suptaM chApi punaH sarpaistIkShNadaMShTrairmahAviShaiH |
kupitairda.nshayAmAsa sarveShvevA~Ngamarmasu
shlokas.37:
daMShTrAshcha daMShTriNAM teShAM marmasvapi nipAtitAH |
tvachaM naivAsya bibhiduH sAratvAtpRRithuvakShasaH
shlokas.38:
pratibuddhastu bhImastAnsarvAnsarpAnapothayat |
sArathiM chAsya dayitamapahastena jaghnivAn
shlokas.39:
bhojane bhImasenasya punaH prAkShepayadviSham |
kAlakUTaM navaM tIkShNaM sambhRRitaM lomaharShaNam
shlokas.40:
vaishyAputrastadAchaShTa pArthAnAM hitakAmyayA |
tachchApi bhuktvAjarayadavikAro vRRikodaraH
shlokas.41:
vikAraM na hyajanayatsutIkShNamapi tadviSham |
bhImasaMhanano bhImastadapyajarayattataH
shlokas.42:
evaM duryodhanaH karNaH shakunishchApi saubalaH |
anekairabhyupAyaistA~njighA.nsanti sma pANDavAn
shlokas.43:
pANDavAshchApi tatsarvaM pratyajAnannari.ndamAH |
udbhAvanamakurvanto vidurasya mate sthitAH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kRRipasyApi mahAbrahmansambhavaM vaktumarhasi |
sharastambhAtkathaM jaj~ne kathaM chAstrANyavAptavAn
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
maharShergautamasyAsIchCharadvAnnAma nAmataH |
putraH kila mahArAja jAtaH saha sharairvibho
shlokas.3:
na tasya vedAdhyayane tathA buddhirajAyata |
yathAsya buddhirabhavaddhanurvede parantapa
shlokas.4:
adhijagmuryathA vedA.nstapasA brahmavAdinaH |
tathA sa tapasopetaH sarvANyastrANyavApa ha
shlokas.5:
dhanurvedaparatvAchcha tapasA vipulena cha |
bhRRishaM santApayAmAsa devarAjaM sa gautamaH
shlokas.6:
tato jAlapadIM nAma devakanyAM sureshvaraH |
prAhiNottapaso vighnaM kuru tasyeti kaurava
shlokas.7:
sAbhigamyAshramapadaM ramaNIyaM sharadvataH |
dhanurbANadharaM bAlA lobhayAmAsa gautamam
shlokas.8:
tAmekavasanAM dRRiShTvA gautamo.apsarasaM vane |
loke.apratimasa.nsthAnAmutphullanayano.abhavat
shlokas.9:
dhanushcha hi sharAshchAsya karAbhyAM prApatanbhuvi |
vepathushchAsya tAM dRRiShTvA sharIre samajAyata
shlokas.10:
sa tu j~nAnagarIyastvAttapasashcha samanvayAt |
avatasthe mahAprAj~no dhairyeNa parameNa ha
shlokas.11:
yastvasya sahasA rAjanvikAraH samapadyata |
tena susrAva reto.asya sa cha tannAvabudhyata
shlokas.12:
sa vihAyAshramaM taM cha tAM chaivApsarasaM muniH |
jagAma retastattasya sharastambe papAta ha
shlokas.13:
sharastambe cha patitaM dvidhA tadabhavannRRipa |
tasyAtha mithunaM jaj~ne gautamasya sharadvataH
shlokas.14:
mRRigayAM charato rAj~naH shantanostu yadRRichChayA |
kashchitsenAcharo.araNye mithunaM tadapashyata
shlokas.15:
dhanushcha sasharaM dRRiShTvA tathA kRRiShNAjinAni cha |
vyavasya brAhmaNApatyaM dhanurvedAntagasya tat
sa rAj~ne darshayAmAsa mithunaM sasharaM tadA
shlokas.16:
sa tadAdAya mithunaM rAjAtha kRRipayAnvitaH |
AjagAma gRRihAneva mama putrAviti bruvan
shlokas.17:
tataH sa.nvardhayAmAsa sa.nskAraishchApyayojayat |
gautamo.api tadApetya dhanurvedaparo.abhavat
shlokas.18:
kRRipayA yanmayA bAlAvimau sa.nvardhitAviti |
tasmAttayornAma chakre tadeva sa mahIpatiH
shlokas.19:
nihitau gautamastatra tapasA tAvavindata |
Agamya chAsmai gotrAdi sarvamAkhyAtavA.nstadA
shlokas.20:
chaturvidhaM dhanurvedamastrANi vividhAni cha |
nikhilenAsya tatsarvaM guhyamAkhyAtavA.nstadA
so.achireNaiva kAlena paramAchAryatAM gataH
shlokas.21:
tato.adhijagmuH sarve te dhanurvedaM mahArathAH |
dhRRitarAShTrAtmajAshchaiva pANDavAshcha mahAbalAH
vRRiShNayashcha nRRipAshchAnye nAnAdeshasamAgatAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
visheShArthI tato bhIShmaH pautrANAM vinayepsayA |
iShvastraj~nAnparyapRRichChadAchAryAnvIryasaMmatAn
shlokas.2:
nAlpadhIrnAmahAbhAgastathAnAnAstrakovidaH |
nAdevasattvo vinayetkurUnastre mahAbalAn
shlokas.3:
maharShistu bharadvAjo havirdhAne charanpurA |
dadarshApsarasaM sAkShAdghRRitAchImAplutAmRRiShiH
shlokas.4:
tasyA vAyuH samuddhUto vasanaM vyapakarShata |
tato.asya retashchaskanda tadRRiShirdroNa Adadhe
shlokas.5:
tasminsamabhavaddroNaH kalashe tasya dhImataH |
adhyagIShTa sa vedA.nshcha vedA~NgAni cha sarvashaH
shlokas.6:
agniveshyaM mahAbhAgaM bharadvAjaH pratApavAn |
pratyapAdayadAgneyamastraM dharmabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.7:
agniShTujjAtaH sa munistato bharatasattama |
bhAradvAjaM tadAgneyaM mahAstraM pratyapAdayat
shlokas.8:
bharadvAjasakhA chAsItpRRiShato nAma pArthivaH |
tasyApi drupado nAma tadA samabhavatsutaH
shlokas.9:
sa nityamAshramaM gatvA droNena saha pArShataH |
chikrIDAdhyayanaM chaiva chakAra kShatriyarShabhaH
shlokas.10:
tato vyatIte pRRiShate sa rAjA drupado.abhavat |
pA~nchAleShu mahAbAhuruttareShu nareshvaraH
shlokas.11:
bharadvAjo.api bhagavAnAruroha divaM tadA |
tataH pitRRiniyuktAtmA putralobhAnmahAyashAH
shAradvatIM tato droNaH kRRipIM bhAryAmavindata
shlokas.12:
agnihotre cha dharme cha dame cha satataM ratA |
alabhadgautamI putramashvatthAmAnameva cha
shlokas.13:
sa jAtamAtro vyanadadyathaivochchaiHshravA hayaH |
tachChrutvAntarhitaM bhUtamantarikShasthamabravIt
shlokas.14:
ashvasyevAsya yatsthAma nadataH pradisho gatam |
ashvatthAmaiva bAlo.ayaM tasmAnnAmnA bhaviShyati
shlokas.15:
sutena tena suprIto bhAradvAjastato.abhavat |
tatraiva cha vasandhImAndhanurvedaparo.abhavat
shlokas.16:
sa shushrAva mahAtmAnaM jAmadagnyaM parantapam |
brAhmaNebhyastadA rAjanditsantaM vasu sarvashaH
shlokas.17:
vanaM tu prasthitaM rAmaM bhAradvAjastadAbravIt |
AgataM vittakAmaM mAM viddhi droNaM dvijarShabham
shlokas.18:
rAma uvAcha||
hiraNyaM mama yachchAnyadvasu ki~nchana vidyate |
brAhmaNebhyo mayA dattaM sarvameva tapodhana
shlokas.19:
tathaiveyaM dharA devI sAgarAntA sapattanA |
kashyapAya mayA dattA kRRitsnA nagaramAlinI
shlokas.20:
sharIramAtramevAdya mayedamavasheShitam |
astrANi cha mahArhANi shastrANi vividhAni cha
vRRiNIShva kiM prayachChAmi tubhyaM droNa vadAshu tat
shlokas.21:
droNa uvAcha||
astrANi me samagrANi sasaMhArANi bhArgava |
saprayogarahasyAni dAtumarhasyasheShataH
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathetyuktvA tatastasmai prAdAdastrANi bhArgavaH |
sarahasyavrataM chaiva dhanurvedamasheShataH
shlokas.23:
pratigRRihya tu tatsarvaM kRRitAstro dvijasattamaH |
priyaM sakhAyaM suprIto jagAma drupadaM prati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato drupadamAsAdya bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
abravItpArShataM rAjansakhAyaM viddhi mAmiti
shlokas.2:
drupada uvAcha||
akRRiteyaM tava praj~nA brahmannAtisama~njasI |
yanmAM bravIShi prasabhaM sakhA te.ahamiti dvija
shlokas.3:
na hi rAj~nAmudIrNAnAmevaM bhUtairnaraiH kvachit |
sakhyaM bhavati mandAtma~nshriyA hInairdhanachyutaiH
shlokas.4:
sauhRRidAnyapi jIryante kAlena parijIryatAm |
sauhRRidaM me tvayA hyAsItpUrvaM sAmarthyabandhanam
shlokas.5:
na sakhyamajaraM loke jAtu dRRishyeta karhichit |
kAmo vainaM viharati krodhashchainaM pravRRishchati
shlokas.6:
maivaM jIrNamupAsiShThAH sakhyaM navamupAkuru |
AsItsakhyaM dvijashreShTha tvayA me.arthanibandhanam
shlokas.7:
na daridro vasumato nAvidvAnviduShaH sakhA |
shUrasya na sakhA klIbaH sakhipUrvaM kimiShyate
shlokas.8:
yayoreva samaM vittaM yayoreva samaM kulam |
tayoH sakhyaM vivAhashcha na tu puShTavipuShTayoH
shlokas.9:
nAshrotriyaH shrotriyasya nArathI rathinaH sakhA |
nArAj~nA sa~NgataM rAj~naH sakhipUrvaM kimiShyate
shlokas.10:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
drupadenaivamuktastu bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
muhUrtaM chintayAmAsa manyunAbhipariplutaH
shlokas.11:
sa vinishchitya manasA pA~nchAlaM prati buddhimAn |
jagAma kurumukhyAnAM nagaraM nAgasAhvayam
shlokas.12:
kumArAstvatha niShkramya sametA gajasAhvayAt |
krIDanto vITayA tatra vIrAH paryacharanmudA
shlokas.13:
papAta kUpe sA vITA teShAM vai krIDatAM tadA |
na cha te pratyapadyanta karma vITopalabdhaye
shlokas.14:
atha droNaH kumArA.nstAndRRiShTvA kRRityavatastadA |
prahasya mandaM paishalyAdabhyabhAShata vIryavAn
shlokas.15:
aho nu dhigbalaM kShAtraM dhigetAM vaH kRRitAstratAm |
bharatasyAnvaye jAtA ye vITAM nAdhigachChata
shlokas.16:
eSha muShTiriShIkANAM mayAstreNAbhimantritaH |
asya vIryaM nirIkShadhvaM yadanyasya na vidyate
shlokas.17:
vetsyAmIShIkayA vITAM tAmiShIkAmathAnyayA |
tAmanyayA samAyogo vITAyA grahaNe mama
shlokas.18:
tadapashyankumArAste vismayotphullalochanAH |
aveShkya choddhRRitAM vITAM vITAveddhAramabruvan
shlokas.19:
abhivAdayAmahe brahmannaitadanyeShu vidyate |
ko.asi kaM tvAbhijAnImo vayaM kiM karavAmahe
shlokas.20:
droNa uvAcha||
AchakShadhvaM cha bhIShmAya rUpeNa cha guNaishcha mAm |
sa eva sumahAbuddhiH sAmprataM pratipatsyate
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathetyuktvA tu te sarve bhIShmamUchuH pitAmaham |
brAhmaNasya vachastathyaM tachcha karmavisheShavat
shlokas.22:
bhIShmaH shrutvA kumArANAM droNaM taM pratyajAnata |
yuktarUpaH sa hi gururityevamanuchintya cha
shlokas.23:
athainamAnIya tadA svayameva susatkRRitam |
paripaprachCha nipuNaM bhIShmaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH
hetumAgamane tasya droNaH sarvaM nyavedayat
shlokas.24:
maharSheragniveshyasya sakAshamahamachyuta |
astrArthamagamaM pUrvaM dhanurvedajighRRikShayA
shlokas.25:
brahmachArI vinItAtmA jaTilo bahulAH samAH |
avasaM tatra suchiraM dhanurvedachikIrShayA
shlokas.26:
pA~nchAlarAjaputrastu yaj~naseno mahAbalaH |
mayA sahAkarodvidyAM guroH shrAmyansamAhitaH
shlokas.27:
sa me tatra sakhA chAsIdupakArI priyashcha me |
tenAhaM saha sa~Ngamya ratavAnsuchiraM bata
bAlyAtprabhRRiti kauravya sahAdhyayanameva cha
shlokas.28:
sa samAsAdya mAM tatra priyakArI priya.nvadaH |
abravIditi mAM bhIShma vachanaM prItivardhanam
shlokas.29:
ahaM priyatamaH putraH piturdroNa mahAtmanaH |
abhiShekShyati mAM rAjye sa pA~nchAlyo yadA tadA
shlokas.30:
tvadbhojyaM bhavitA rAjyaM sakhe satyena te shape |
mama bhogAshcha vittaM cha tvadadhInaM sukhAni cha
shlokas.31:
evamuktaH pravavrAja kRRitAstro.ahaM dhanepsayA |
abhiShiktaM cha shrutvainaM kRRitArtho.asmIti chintayan
shlokas.32:
priyaM sakhAyaM suprIto rAjyasthaM punarAvrajam |
sa.nsmaransa~NgamaM chaiva vachanaM chaiva tasya tat
shlokas.33:
tato drupadamAgamya sakhipUrvamahaM prabho |
abruvaM puruShavyAghra sakhAyaM viddhi mAmiti
shlokas.34:
upasthitaM tu drupadaH sakhivachchAbhisa~Ngatam |
sa mAM nirAkAramiva prahasannidamabravIt
shlokas.35:
akRRiteyaM tava praj~nA brahmannAtisama~njasI |
yadAttha mAM tvaM prasabhaM sakhA te.ahamiti dvija
shlokas.36:
na hi rAj~nAmudIrNAnAmevambhUtairnaraiH kvachit |
sakhyaM bhavati mandAtma~nshriyA hInairdhanachyutaiH
shlokas.37:
nAshrotriyaH shrotriyasya nArathI rathinaH sakhA |
nArAjA pArthivasyApi sakhipUrvaM kimiShyate
shlokas.38:
drupadenaivamukto.ahaM manyunAbhipariplutaH |
abhyAgachChaM kurUnbhIShma shiShyairarthI guNAnvitaiH
shlokas.39:
pratijagrAha taM bhIShmo guruM pANDusutaiH saha |
pautrAnAdAya tAnsarvAnvasUni vividhAni cha
shlokas.40:
shiShyA iti dadau rAjandroNAya vidhipUrvakam |
sa cha shiShyAnmaheShvAsaH pratijagrAha kauravAn
shlokas.41:
pratigRRihya cha tAnsarvAndroNo vachanamabravIt |
rahasyekaH pratItAtmA kRRitopasadanA.nstadA
shlokas.42:
kAryaM me kA~NkShitaM ki~nchiddhRRidi samparivartate |
kRRitAstraistatpradeyaM me tadRRitaM vadatAnaghAH
shlokas.43:
tachChrutvA kauraveyAste tUShNImAsanvishAM pate |
arjunastu tataH sarvaM pratijaj~ne parantapaH
shlokas.44:
tato.arjunaM mUrdhni tadA samAghrAya punaH punaH |
prItipUrvaM pariShvajya praruroda mudA tadA
shlokas.45:
tato droNaH pANDuputrAnastrANi vividhAni cha |
grAhayAmAsa divyAni mAnuShANi cha vIryavAn
shlokas.46:
rAjaputrAstathaivAnye sametya bharatarShabha |
abhijagmustato droNamastrArthe dvijasattamam
vRRiShNayashchAndhakAshchaiva nAnAdeshyAshcha pArthivAH
shlokas.47:
sUtaputrashcha rAdheyo guruM droNamiyAttadA |
spardhamAnastu pArthena sUtaputro.atyamarShaNaH
duryodhanamupAshritya pANDavAnatyamanyata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
arjunastu paraM yatnamAtasthe gurupUjane |
astre cha paramaM yogaM priyo droNasya chAbhavat
shlokas.2:
droNena tu tadAhUya rahasyukto.annasAdhakaH |
andhakAre.arjunAyAnnaM na deyaM te katha~nchana
shlokas.3:
tataH kadAchidbhu~njAne pravavau vAyurarjune |
tena tatra pradIpaH sa dIpyamAno nivApitaH
shlokas.4:
bhu~Nkta evArjuno bhaktaM na chAsyAsyAdvyamuhyata |
hastastejasvino nityamannagrahaNakAraNAt
tadabhyAsakRRitaM matvA rAtrAvabhyasta pANDavaH
shlokas.5:
tasya jyAtalanirghoShaM droNaH shushrAva bhArata |
upetya chainamutthAya pariShvajyedamabravIt
shlokas.6:
prayatiShye tathA kartuM yathA nAnyo dhanurdharaH |
tvatsamo bhavitA loke satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.7:
tato droNo.arjunaM bhUyo ratheShu cha gajeShu cha |
ashveShu bhUmAvapi cha raNashikShAmashikShayat
shlokas.8:
gadAyuddhe.asicharyAyAM tomaraprAsashaktiShu |
droNaH sa~NkIrNayuddheShu shikShayAmAsa pANDavam
shlokas.9:
tasya tatkaushalaM dRRiShTvA dhanurvedajighRRikShavaH |
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha samAjagmuH sahasrashaH
shlokas.10:
tato niShAdarAjasya hiraNyadhanuShaH sutaH |
ekalavyo mahArAja droNamabhyAjagAma ha
shlokas.11:
na sa taM pratijagrAha naiShAdiriti chintayan |
shiShyaM dhanuShi dharmaj~nasteShAmevAnvavekShayA
shlokas.12:
sa tu droNasya shirasA pAdau gRRihya parantapaH |
araNyamanusamprAptaH kRRitvA droNaM mahImayam
shlokas.13:
tasminnAchAryavRRittiM cha paramAmAsthitastadA |
iShvastre yogamAtasthe paraM niyamamAsthitaH
shlokas.14:
parayA shraddhayA yukto yogena parameNa cha |
vimokShAdAnasandhAne laghutvaM paramApa saH
shlokas.15:
atha droNAbhyanuj~nAtAH kadAchitkurupANDavAH |
rathairviniryayuH sarve mRRigayAmarimardanAH
shlokas.16:
tatropakaraNaM gRRihya naraH kashchidyadRRichChayA |
rAjannanujagAmaikaH shvAnamAdAya pANDavAn
shlokas.17:
teShAM vicharatAM tatra tattatkarma chikIrShatAm |
shvA charansa vane mUDho naiShAdiM prati jagmivAn
shlokas.18:
sa kRRiShNaM maladigdhA~NgaM kRRiShNAjinadharaM vane |
naiShAdiM shvA samAlakShya bhaSha.nstasthau tadantike
shlokas.19:
tadA tasyAtha bhaShataH shunaH sapta sharAnmukhe |
lAghavaM darshayannastre mumocha yugapadyathA
shlokas.20:
sa tu shvA sharapUrNAsyaH pANDavAnAjagAma ha |
taM dRRiShTvA pANDavA vIrA vismayaM paramaM yayuH
shlokas.21:
lAghavaM shabdavedhitvaM dRRiShTvA tatparamaM tadA |
prekShya taM vrIDitAshchAsanprashasha.nsushcha sarvashaH
shlokas.22:
taM tato.anveShamANAste vane vananivAsinam |
dadRRishuH pANDavA rAjannasyantamanishaM sharAn
shlokas.23:
na chainamabhyajAna.nste tadA vikRRitadarshanam |
athainaM paripaprachChuH ko bhavAnkasya vetyuta
shlokas.24:
ekalavya uvAcha||
niShAdAdhipatervIrA hiraNyadhanuShaH sutam |
droNashiShyaM cha mAM vitta dhanurvedakRRitashramam
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te tamAj~nAya tattvena punarAgamya pANDavAH |
yathAvRRittaM cha te sarvaM droNAyAchakhyuradbhutam
shlokas.26:
kaunteyastvarjuno rAjannekalavyamanusmaran |
raho droNaM samAgamya praNayAdidamabravIt
shlokas.27:
nanvahaM parirabhyaikaH prItipUrvamidaM vachaH |
bhavatokto na me shiShyastvadvishiShTo bhaviShyati
shlokas.28:
atha kasmAnmadvishiShTo lokAdapi cha vIryavAn |
astyanyo bhavataH shiShyo niShAdAdhipateH sutaH
shlokas.29:
muhUrtamiva taM droNashchintayitvA vinishchayam |
savyasAchinamAdAya naiShAdiM prati jagmivAn
shlokas.30:
dadarsha maladigdhA~NgaM jaTilaM chIravAsasam |
ekalavyaM dhanuShpANimasyantamanishaM sharAn
shlokas.31:
ekalavyastu taM dRRiShTvA droNamAyAntamantikAt |
abhigamyopasa~NgRRihya jagAma shirasA mahIm
shlokas.32:
pUjayitvA tato droNaM vidhivatsa niShAdajaH |
nivedya shiShyamAtmAnaM tasthau prA~njaliragrataH
shlokas.33:
tato droNo.abravIdrAjannekalavyamidaM vachaH |
yadi shiShyo.asi me tUrNaM vetanaM sampradIyatAm
shlokas.34:
ekalavyastu tachChrutvA prIyamANo.abravIdidam |
kiM prayachChAmi bhagavannAj~nApayatu mAM guruH
shlokas.35:
na hi ki~nchidadeyaM me gurave brahmavittama |
tamabravIttvayA~NguShTho dakShiNo dIyatAM mama
shlokas.36:
ekalavyastu tachChrutvA vacho droNasya dAruNam |
pratij~nAmAtmano rakShansatye cha nirataH sadA
shlokas.37:
tathaiva hRRiShTavadanastathaivAdInamAnasaH |
ChittvAvichArya taM prAdAddroNAyA~NguShThamAtmanaH
shlokas.38:
tataH paraM tu naiShAdira~NgulIbhirvyakarShata |
na tathA sa tu shIghro.abhUdyathA pUrvaM narAdhipa
shlokas.39:
tato.arjunaH prItamanA babhUva vigatajvaraH |
droNashcha satyavAgAsInnAnyo.abhyabhavadarjunam
shlokas.40:
droNasya tu tadA shiShyau gadAyogyAM visheShataH |
duryodhanashcha bhImashcha kurUNAmabhyagachChatAm
shlokas.41:
ashvatthAmA rahasyeShu sarveShvabhyadhiko.abhavat |
tathAti puruShAnanyAntsArukau yamajAvubhau
yudhiShThiro rathashreShThaH sarvatra tu dhana~njayaH
shlokas.42:
prathitaH sAgarAntAyAM rathayUthapayUthapaH |
buddhiyogabalotsAhaiH sarvAstreShu cha pANDavaH
shlokas.43:
astre gurvanurAge cha vishiShTo.abhavadarjunaH |
tulyeShvastropadesheShu sauShThavena cha vIryavAn
ekaH sarvakumArANAM babhUvAtiratho.arjunaH
shlokas.44:
prANAdhikaM bhImasenaM kRRitavidyaM dhana~njayam |
dhArtarAShTrA durAtmAno nAmRRiShyanta narAdhipa
shlokas.45:
tA.nstu sarvAnsamAnIya sarvavidyAsu niShThitAn |
droNaH praharaNaj~nAne jij~nAsuH puruSharShabha
shlokas.46:
kRRitrimaM bhAsamAropya vRRikShAgre shilpibhiH kRRitam |
avij~nAtaM kumArANAM lakShyabhUtamupAdishat
shlokas.47:
droNa uvAcha||
shIghraM bhavantaH sarve vai dhanUMShyAdAya satvarAH |
bhAsametaM samuddishya tiShThantAM saMhiteShavaH
shlokas.48:
madvAkyasamakAlaM cha shiro.asya vinipAtyatAm |
ekaikasho niyokShyAmi tathA kuruta putrakAH
shlokas.49:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThiraM pUrvamuvAchA~NgirasAM varaH |
sandhatsva bANaM durdharSha madvAkyAnte vimu~ncha cha
shlokas.50:
tato yudhiShThiraH pUrvaM dhanurgRRihya mahAravam |
tasthau bhAsaM samuddishya guruvAkyaprachoditaH
shlokas.51:
tato vitatadhanvAnaM droNastaM kurunandanam |
sa muhUrtAduvAchedaM vachanaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.52:
pashyasyenaM drumAgrasthaM bhAsaM naravarAtmaja |
pashyAmItyevamAchAryaM pratyuvAcha yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.53:
sa muhUrtAdiva punardroNastaM pratyabhAShata |
atha vRRikShamimaM mAM vA bhrAtRRinvApi prapashyasi
shlokas.54:
tamuvAcha sa kaunteyaH pashyAmyenaM vanaspatim |
bhavantaM cha tathA bhrAtRRinbhAsaM cheti punaH punaH
shlokas.55:
tamuvAchApasarpeti droNo.aprItamanA iva |
naitachChakyaM tvayA veddhuM lakShyamityeva kutsayan
shlokas.57:
anyA.nshcha shiShyAnbhImAdInrAj~nashchaivAnyadeshajAn |
tathA cha sarve sarvaM tatpashyAma iti kutsitAH
shlokas.58:
tato dhana~njayaM droNaH smayamAno.abhyabhAShata |
tvayedAnIM prahartavyametallakShyaM nishamyatAm
shlokas.59:
madvAkyasamakAlaM te moktavyo.atra bhavechCharaH |
vitatya kArmukaM putra tiShTha tAvanmuhUrtakam
shlokas.60:
evamuktaH savyasAchI maNDalIkRRitakArmukaH |
tasthau lakShyaM samuddishya guruvAkyaprachoditaH
shlokas.61:
muhUrtAdiva taM droNastathaiva samabhAShata |
pashyasyenaM sthitaM bhAsaM drumaM mAmapi vetyuta
shlokas.62:
pashyAmyenaM bhAsamiti droNaM pArtho.abhyabhAShata |
na tu vRRikShaM bhavantaM vA pashyAmIti cha bhArata
shlokas.63:
tataH prItamanA droNo muhUrtAdiva taM punaH |
pratyabhAShata durdharShaH pANDavAnAM ratharShabham
shlokas.64:
bhAsaM pashyasi yadyenaM tathA brUhi punarvachaH |
shiraH pashyAmi bhAsasya na gAtramiti so.abravIt
shlokas.65:
arjunenaivamuktastu droNo hRRiShTatanUruhaH |
mu~nchasvetyabravItpArthaM sa mumochAvichArayan
shlokas.66:
tatastasya nagasthasya kShureNa nishitena ha |
shira utkRRitya tarasA pAtayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.67:
tasminkarmaNi sa.nsiddhe paryashvajata phalgunam |
mene cha drupadaM sa~Nkhye sAnubandhaM parAjitam
shlokas.68:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya sashiShyo.a~NgirasAM varaH |
jagAma ga~NgAmabhito majjituM bharatarShabha
shlokas.69:
avagADhamatho droNaM salile salilecharaH |
grAho jagrAha balavA~nja~NghAnte kAlachoditaH
shlokas.70:
sa samartho.api mokShAya shiShyAnsarvAnachodayat |
grAhaM hatvA mokShayadhvaM mAmiti tvarayanniva
shlokas.71:
tadvAkyasamakAlaM tu bIbhatsurnishitaiH sharaiH |
AvApaiH pa~nchabhirgrAhaM magnamambhasyatADayat
itare tu visaMmUDhAstatra tatra prapedire
shlokas.72:
taM cha dRRiShTvA kriyopetaM droNo.amanyata pANDavam |
vishiShTaM sarvashiShyebhyaH prItimA.nshchAbhavattadA
shlokas.73:
sa pArthabANairbahudhA khaNDashaH parikalpitaH |
grAhaH pa~nchatvamApede ja~NghAM tyaktvA mahAtmanaH
shlokas.74:
athAbravInmahAtmAnaM bhAradvAjo mahAratham |
gRRihANedaM mahAbAho vishiShTamatidurdharam
astraM brahmashiro nAma saprayoganivartanam
shlokas.75:
na cha te mAnuSheShvetatprayoktavyaM katha~nchana |
jagadvinirdahedetadalpatejasi pAtitam
shlokas.76:
asAmAnyamidaM tAta lokeShvastraM nigadyate |
taddhArayethAH prayataH shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama
shlokas.77:
bAdhetAmAnuShaH shatruryadA tvAM vIra kashchana |
tadvadhAya prayu~njIthAstadAstramidamAhave
shlokas.78:
tatheti tatpratishrutya bIbhatsuH sa kRRitA~njaliH |
jagrAha paramAstraM tadAha chainaM punarguruH
bhavitA tvatsamo nAnyaH pumA.Nlloke dhanurdharaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kRRitAstrAndhArtarAShTrA.nshcha pANDuputrA.nshcha bhArata |
dRRiShTvA droNo.abravIdrAjandhRRitarAShTraM janeshvaram
shlokas.2:
kRRipasya somadattasya bAhlIkasya cha dhImataH |
gA~Ngeyasya cha sAMnidhye vyAsasya vidurasya cha
shlokas.3:
rAjansamprAptavidyAste kumarAH kurusattama |
te darshayeyuH svAM shikShAM rAjannanumate tava
shlokas.4:
tato.abravInmahArAjaH prahRRiShTenAntarAtmanA |
bhAradvAja mahatkarma kRRitaM te dvijasattama
shlokas.5:
yadA tu manyase kAlaM yasmindeshe yathA yathA |
tathA tathA vidhAnAya svayamAj~nApayasva mAm
shlokas.6:
spRRihayAmyadya nirvedAtpuruShANAM sachakShuShAm |
astrahetoH parAkrAntAnye me drakShyanti putrakAn
shlokas.7:
kShattaryadgururAchAryo bravIti kuru tattathA |
na hIdRRishaM priyaM manye bhavitA dharmavatsala
shlokas.8:
tato rAjAnamAmantrya vidurAnugato bahiH |
bhAradvAjo mahAprAj~no mApayAmAsa medinIm
samAmavRRikShAM nirgulmAmudakpravaNasa.nsthitAm
shlokas.9:
tasyAM bhUmau baliM chakre tithau nakShatrapUjite |
avaghuShTaM pure chApi tadarthaM vadatAM vara
shlokas.10:
ra~NgabhUmau suvipulaM shAstradRRiShTaM yathAvidhi |
prekShAgAraM suvihitaM chakrustatra cha shilpinaH
rAj~naH sarvAyudhopetaM strINAM chaiva nararShabha
shlokas.11:
ma~nchA.nshcha kArayAmAsustatra jAnapadA janAH |
vipulAnuchChrayopetA~nshibikAshcha mahAdhanAH
shlokas.12:
tasmi.nstato.ahani prApte rAjA sasachivastadA |
bhIShmaM pramukhataH kRRitvA kRRipaM chAchAryasattamam
shlokas.13:
muktAjAlaparikShiptaM vaiDUryamaNibhUShitam |
shAtakumbhamayaM divyaM prekShAgAramupAgamat
shlokas.14:
gAndhArI cha mahAbhAgA kuntI cha jayatAM vara |
striyashcha sarvA yA rAj~naH sapreShyAH saparichChadAH
harShAdAruruhurma~nchAnmeruM devastriyo yathA
shlokas.15:
brAhmaNakShatriyAdyaM cha chAturvarNyaM purAddrutam |
darshanepsu samabhyAgAtkumArANAM kRRitAstratAm
shlokas.16:
pravAditaishcha vAditrairjanakautUhalena cha |
mahArNava iva kShubdhaH samAjaH so.abhavattadA
shlokas.17:
tataH shuklAmbaradharaH shuklayaj~nopavItavAn |
shuklakeshaH sitashmashruH shuklamAlyAnulepanaH
shlokas.18:
ra~NgamadhyaM tadAchAryaH saputraH pravivesha ha |
nabho jaladharairhInaM sA~NgAraka ivA.nshumAn
shlokas.19:
sa yathAsamayaM chakre baliM balavatAM varaH |
brAhmaNA.nshchAtra mantraj~nAnvAchayAmAsa ma~Ngalam
shlokas.20:
atha puNyAhaghoShasya puNyasya tadanantaram |
vivishurvividhaM gRRihya shastropakaraNaM narAH
shlokas.21:
tato baddhatanutrANA baddhakakShyA mahAbalAH |
baddhatUNAH sadhanuSho vivishurbharatarShabhAH
shlokas.22:
anujyeShThaM cha te tatra yudhiShThirapurogamAH |
chakrurastraM mahAvIryAH kumArAH paramAdbhutam
shlokas.23:
kechichCharAkShepabhayAchChirA.nsyavananAmire |
manujA dhRRiShTamapare vIkShAM chakruH savismayAH
shlokas.24:
te sma lakShyANi vividhurbANairnAmA~NkashobhitaiH |
vividhairlAghavotsRRiShTairuhyanto vAjibhirdrutam
shlokas.25:
tatkumArabalaM tatra gRRihItasharakArmukam |
gandharvanagarAkAraM prekShya te vismitAbhavan
shlokas.26:
sahasA chukrushustatra narAH shatasahasrashaH |
vismayotphullanayanAH sAdhu sAdhviti bhArata
shlokas.27:
kRRitvA dhanuShi te mArgAnrathacharyAsu chAsakRRit |
gajapRRiShThe.ashvapRRiShThe cha niyuddhe cha mahAbalAH
shlokas.28:
gRRihItakhaDgacharmANastato bhUyaH prahAriNaH |
tsarumArgAnyathoddiShTA.nshcheruH sarvAsu bhUmiShu
shlokas.29:
lAghavaM sauShThavaM shobhAM sthiratvaM dRRiDhamuShTitAm |
dadRRishustatra sarveShAM prayoge khaDgacharmaNAm
shlokas.30:
atha tau nityasaMhRRiShTau suyodhanavRRikodarau |
avatIrNau gadAhastAvekashRRi~NgAvivAchalau
shlokas.31:
baddhakakShyau mahAbAhU pauruShe paryavasthitau |
bRRiMhantau vAshitAhetoH samadAviva ku~njarau
shlokas.32:
tau pradakShiNasavyAni maNDalAni mahAbalau |
cheraturnirmalagadau samadAviva govRRiShau
shlokas.33:
viduro dhRRitarAShTrAya gAndhAryai pANDavAraNiH |
nyavedayetAM tatsarvaM kumArANAM vicheShTitam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kururAje cha ra~Ngasthe bhIme cha balinAM vare |
pakShapAtakRRitasnehaH sa dvidhevAbhavajjanaH
shlokas.2:
hA vIra kururAjeti hA bhImeti cha nardatAm |
puruShANAM suvipulAH praNAdAH sahasotthitAH
shlokas.3:
tataH kShubdhArNavanibhaM ra~NgamAlokya buddhimAn |
bhAradvAjaH priyaM putramashvatthAmAnamabravIt
shlokas.4:
vArayaitau mahAvIryau kRRitayogyAvubhAvapi |
mA bhUdra~Ngaprakopo.ayaM bhImaduryodhanodbhavaH
shlokas.5:
tatastAvudyatagadau guruputreNa vAritau |
yugAntAnilasa~NkShubdhau mahAvegAvivArNavau
shlokas.6:
tato ra~NgA~NgaNagato droNo vachanamabravIt |
nivArya vAditragaNaM mahAmeghanibhasvanam
shlokas.7:
yo me putrAtpriyataraH sarvAstraviduShAM varaH |
aindririndrAnujasamaH sa pArtho dRRishyatAmiti
shlokas.8:
AchAryavachanenAtha kRRitasvastyayano yuvA |
baddhagodhA~NgulitrANaH pUrNatUNaH sakArmukaH
shlokas.9:
kA~nchanaM kavachaM bibhratpratyadRRishyata phalgunaH |
sArkaH sendrAyudhataDitsasandhya iva toyadaH
shlokas.10:
tataH sarvasya ra~Ngasya samutpi~njo.abhavanmahAn |
prAvAdyanta cha vAdyAni sasha~NkhAni samantataH
shlokas.11:
eSha kuntIsutaH shrImAneSha pANDavamadhyamaH |
eSha putro mahendrasya kurUNAmeSha rakShitA
shlokas.12:
eSho.astraviduShAM shreShTha eSha dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
eSha shIlavatAM chApi shIlaj~nAnanidhiH paraH
shlokas.13:
ityevamatulA vAchaH shRRiNvantyAH prekShakeritAH |
kuntyAH prasnavasaMmishrairasraiH klinnamuro.abhavat
shlokas.14:
tena shabdena mahatA pUrNashrutirathAbravIt |
dhRRitarAShTro narashreShTho viduraM hRRiShTamAnasaH
shlokas.15:
kShattaH kShubdhArNavanibhaH kimeSha sumahAsvanaH |
sahasaivotthito ra~Nge bhindanniva nabhastalam
shlokas.16:
vidura uvAcha||
eSha pArtho mahArAja phalgunaH pANDunandanaH |
avatIrNaH sakavachastatraiSha sumahAsvanaH
shlokas.17:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
dhanyo.asmyanugRRihIto.asmi rakShito.asmi mahAmate |
pRRithAraNisamudbhUtaistribhiH pANDavavahnibhiH
shlokas.18:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasminsamudite ra~Nge katha~nchitparyavasthite |
darshayAmAsa bIbhatsurAchAryAdastralAghavam
shlokas.19:
AgneyenAsRRijadvahniM vAruNenAsRRijatpayaH |
vAyavyenAsRRijadvAyuM pArjanyenAsRRijadghanAn
shlokas.20:
bhaumena prAvishadbhUmiM pArvatenAsRRijadgirIn |
antardhAnena chAstreNa punarantarhito.abhavat
shlokas.21:
kShaNAtprA.nshuH kShaNAddhrasvaH kShaNAchcha rathadhUrgataH |
kShaNena rathamadhyasthaH kShaNenAvApatanmahIm
shlokas.22:
sukumAraM cha sUkShmaM cha guruM chApi gurupriyaH |
sauShThavenAbhisa.nyuktaH so.avidhyadvividhaiH sharaiH
shlokas.23:
bhramatashcha varAhasya lohasya pramukhe samam |
pa~ncha bANAnasa.nsaktAnsa mumochaikabANavat
shlokas.24:
gavye viShANakoshe cha chale rajjvavalambite |
nichakhAna mahAvIryaH sAyakAnekavi.nshatim
shlokas.25:
ityevamAdi sumahatkhaDge dhanuShi chAbhavat |
gadAyAM shastrakushalo darshanAni vyadarshayat
shlokas.26:
tataH samAptabhUyiShThe tasminkarmaNi bhArata |
mandIbhUte samAje cha vAditrasya cha nisvane
shlokas.27:
dvAradeshAtsamudbhUto mAhAtmya balasUchakaH |
vajraniShpeShasadRRishaH shushruve bhujanisvanaH
shlokas.28:
dIryante kiM nu girayaH kiM svidbhUmirvidIryate |
kiM svidApUryate vyoma jalabhAraghanairghanaiH
shlokas.29:
ra~NgasyaivaM matirabhUtkShaNena vasudhAdhipa |
dvAraM chAbhimukhAH sarve babhUvuH prekShakAstadA
shlokas.30:
pa~nchabhirbhrAtRRibhiH pArthairdroNaH parivRRito babhau |
pa~nchatAreNa sa.nyuktaH sAvitreNeva chandramAH
shlokas.31:
ashvatthAmnA cha sahitaM bhrAtRRiNAM shatamUrjitam |
duryodhanamamitraghnamutthitaM paryavArayat
shlokas.32:
sa taistadA bhrAtRRibhirudyatAyudhai;rvRRito gadApANiravasthitaiH sthitaH |
babhau yathA dAnavasa~NkShaye purA; pura.ndaro devagaNaiH samAvRRitaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
datte.avakAshe puruShairvismayotphullalochanaiH |
vivesha ra~NgaM vistIrNaM karNaH parapura~njayaH
shlokas.2:
sahajaM kavachaM bibhratkuNDaloddyotitAnanaH |
sadhanurbaddhanistri.nshaH pAdachArIva parvataH
shlokas.3:
kanyAgarbhaH pRRithuyashAH pRRithAyAH pRRithulochanaH |
tIkShNA.nshorbhAskarasyA.nshaH karNo.arigaNasUdanaH
shlokas.4:
siMharShabhagajendrANAM tulyavIryaparAkramaH |
dIptikAntidyutiguNaiH sUryendujvalanopamaH
shlokas.5:
prA.nshuH kanakatAlAbhaH siMhasaMhanano yuvA |
asa~NkhyeyaguNaH shrImAnbhAskarasyAtmasambhavaH
shlokas.6:
sa nirIkShya mahAbAhuH sarvato ra~NgamaNDalam |
praNAmaM droNakRRipayornAtyAdRRitamivAkarot
shlokas.7:
sa sAmAjajanaH sarvo nishchalaH sthiralochanaH |
ko.ayamityAgatakShobhaH kautUhalaparo.abhavat
shlokas.8:
so.abravInmeghadhIreNa svareNa vadatAM varaH |
bhrAtA bhrAtaramaj~nAtaM sAvitraH pAkashAsanim
shlokas.9:
pArtha yatte kRRitaM karma visheShavadahaM tataH |
kariShye pashyatAM nRRiNAM mAtmanA vismayaM gamaH
shlokas.10:
asamApte tatastasya vachane vadatAM vara |
yantrotkShipta iva kShipramuttasthau sarvato janaH
shlokas.11:
prItishcha puruShavyAghra duryodhanamathAspRRishat |
hrIshcha krodhashcha bIbhatsuM kShaNenAnvavishachcha ha
shlokas.12:
tato droNAbhyanuj~nAtaH karNaH priyaraNaH sadA |
yatkRRitaM tatra pArthena tachchakAra mahAbalaH
shlokas.13:
atha duryodhanastatra bhrAtRRibhiH saha bhArata |
karNaM pariShvajya mudA tato vachanamabravIt
shlokas.14:
svAgataM te mahAbAho diShTyA prApto.asi mAnada |
ahaM cha kururAjyaM cha yatheShTamupabhujyatAm
shlokas.15:
karNa uvAcha||
kRRitaM sarveNa me.anyena sakhitvaM cha tvayA vRRiNe |
dvandvayuddhaM cha pArthena kartumichChAmi bhArata
shlokas.16:
duryodhana uvAcha||
bhu~NkShva bhogAnmayA sArdhaM bandhUnAM priyakRRidbhava |
durhRRidAM kuru sarveShAM mUrdhni pAdamari.ndama
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH kShiptamivAtmAnaM matvA pArtho.abhyabhAShata |
karNaM bhrAtRRisamUhasya madhye.achalamiva sthitam
shlokas.18:
anAhUtopasRRiptAnAmanAhUtopajalpinAm |
ye lokAstAnhataH karNa mayA tvaM pratipatsyase
shlokas.19:
karNa uvAcha||
ra~Ngo.ayaM sarvasAmAnyaH kimatra tava phalguna |
vIryashreShThAshcha rAjanyA balaM dharmo.anuvartate
shlokas.20:
kiM kShepairdurbalAshvAsaiH sharaiH kathaya bhArata |
guroH samakShaM yAvatte harAmyadya shiraH sharaiH
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato droNAbhyanuj~nAtaH pArthaH parapura~njayaH |
bhrAtRRibhistvarayAshliShTo raNAyopajagAma tam
shlokas.22:
tato duryodhanenApi sabhrAtrA samarodyataH |
pariShvaktaH sthitaH karNaH pragRRihya sasharaM dhanuH
shlokas.23:
tataH savidyutstanitaiH sendrAyudhapurojavaiH |
AvRRitaM gaganaM meghairbalAkApa~NktihAsibhiH
shlokas.24:
tataH snehAddharihayaM dRRiShTvA ra~NgAvalokinam |
bhAskaro.apyanayannAshaM samIpopagatAnghanAn
shlokas.25:
meghachChAyopagUDhastu tato.adRRishyata pANDavaH |
sUryAtapaparikShiptaH karNo.api samadRRishyata
shlokas.26:
dhArtarAShTrA yataH karNastasmindeshe vyavasthitAH |
bhAradvAjaH kRRipo bhIShmo yataH pArthastato.abhavan
shlokas.27:
dvidhA ra~NgaH samabhavatstrINAM dvaidhamajAyata |
kuntibhojasutA mohaM vij~nAtArthA jagAma ha
shlokas.28:
tAM tathA mohasampannAM viduraH sarvadharmavit |
kuntImAshvAsayAmAsa prokShyAdbhishchandanokShitaiH
shlokas.29:
tataH pratyAgataprANA tAvubhAvapi da.nshitau |
putrau dRRiShTvA susantaptA nAnvapadyata ki~nchana
shlokas.30:
tAvudyatamahAchApau kRRipaH shAradvato.abravIt |
dvandvayuddhasamAchAre kushalaH sarvadharmavit
shlokas.31:
ayaM pRRithAyAstanayaH kanIyAnpANDunandanaH |
kauravo bhavatA sArdhaM dvandvayuddhaM kariShyati
shlokas.32:
tvamapyevaM mahAbAho mAtaraM pitaraM kulam |
kathayasva narendrANAM yeShAM tvaM kulavardhanaH
tato viditvA pArthastvAM pratiyotsyati vA na vA
shlokas.33:
evamuktasya karNasya vrIDAvanatamAnanam |
babhau varShAmbubhiH klinnaM padmamAgalitaM yathA
shlokas.34:
duryodhana uvAcha||
AchArya trividhA yonI rAj~nAM shAstravinishchaye |
tatkulInashcha shUrashcha senAM yashcha prakarShati
shlokas.35:
yadyayaM phalguno yuddhe nArAj~nA yoddhumichChati |
tasmAdeSho.a~NgaviShaye mayA rAjye.abhiShichyate
shlokas.36:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastasminkShaNe karNaH salAjakusumairghaTaiH |
kA~nchanaiH kA~nchane pIThe mantravidbhirmahArathaH
abhiShikto.a~NgarAjye sa shriyA yukto mahAbalaH
shlokas.37:
sachChatravAlavyajano jayashabdAntareNa cha |
uvAcha kauravaM rAjA rAjAnaM taM vRRiShastadA
shlokas.38:
asya rAjyapradAnasya sadRRishaM kiM dadAni te |
prabrUhi rAjashArdUla kartA hyasmi tathA nRRipa
atyantaM sakhyamichChAmItyAha taM sa suyodhanaH
shlokas.39:
evamuktastataH karNastatheti pratyabhAShata |
harShAchchobhau samAshliShya parAM mudamavApatuH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH srastottarapaTaH saprasvedaH savepathuH |
viveshAdhiratho ra~NgaM yaShTiprANo hvayanniva
shlokas.2:
tamAlokya dhanustyaktvA pitRRigauravayantritaH |
karNo.abhiShekArdrashirAH shirasA samavandata
shlokas.3:
tataH pAdAvavachChAdya paTAntena sasambhramaH |
putreti paripUrNArthamabravIdrathasArathiH
shlokas.4:
pariShvajya cha tasyAtha mUrdhAnaM snehaviklavaH |
a~NgarAjyAbhiShekArdramashrubhiH siShiche punaH
shlokas.5:
taM dRRiShTvA sUtaputro.ayamiti nishchitya pANDavaH |
bhImasenastadA vAkyamabravItprahasanniva
shlokas.6:
na tvamarhasi pArthena sUtaputra raNe vadham |
kulasya sadRRishastUrNaM pratodo gRRihyatAM tvayA
shlokas.7:
a~NgarAjyaM cha nArhastvamupabhoktuM narAdhama |
shvA hutAshasamIpasthaM puroDAshamivAdhvare
shlokas.8:
evamuktastataH karNaH ki~nchitprasphuritAdharaH |
gaganasthaM viniHshvasya divAkaramudaikShata
shlokas.9:
tato duryodhanaH kopAdutpapAta mahAbalaH |
bhrAtRRipadmavanAttasmAnmadotkaTa iva dvipaH
shlokas.10:
so.abravIdbhImakarmANaM bhImasenamavasthitam |
vRRikodara na yuktaM te vachanaM vaktumIdRRisham
shlokas.11:
kShatriyANAM balaM jyeShThaM yoddhavyaM kShatrabandhunA |
shUrANAM cha nadInAM cha prabhavA durvidAH kila
shlokas.12:
salilAdutthito vahniryena vyAptaM charAcharam |
dadhIchasyAsthito vajraM kRRitaM dAnavasUdanam
shlokas.13:
AgneyaH kRRittikAputro raudro gA~Ngeya ityapi |
shrUyate bhagavAndevaH sarvaguhyamayo guhaH
shlokas.14:
kShatriyAbhyashcha ye jAtA brAhmaNAste cha vishrutAH |
AchAryaH kalashAjjAtaH sharastambAdguruH kRRipaH
bhavatAM cha yathA janma tadapyAgamitaM nRRipaiH
shlokas.15:
sakuNDalaM sakavachaM divyalakShaNalakShitam |
kathamAdityasa~NkAshaM mRRigI vyAghraM janiShyati
shlokas.16:
pRRithivIrAjyamarho.ayaM nA~NgarAjyaM nareshvaraH |
anena bAhuvIryeNa mayA chAj~nAnuvartinA
shlokas.17:
yasya vA manujasyedaM na kShAntaM madvicheShTitam |
rathamAruhya padbhyAM vA vinAmayatu kArmukam
shlokas.18:
tataH sarvasya ra~Ngasya hAhAkAro mahAnabhUt |
sAdhuvAdAnusambaddhaH sUryashchAstamupAgamat
shlokas.19:
tato duryodhanaH karNamAlambyAtha kare nRRipa |
dIpikAgnikRRitAlokastasmAdra~NgAdviniryayau
shlokas.20:
pANDavAshcha sahadroNAH sakRRipAshcha vishAM pate |
bhIShmeNa sahitAH sarve yayuH svaM svaM niveshanam
shlokas.21:
arjuneti janaH kashchitkashchitkarNeti bhArata |
kashchidduryodhanetyevaM bruvantaH prasthitAstadA
shlokas.22:
kuntyAshcha pratyabhij~nAya divyalakShaNasUchitam |
putrama~NgeshvaraM snehAchChannA prItiravardhata
shlokas.23:
duryodhanasyApi tadA karNamAsAdya pArthiva |
bhayamarjunasA~njAtaM kShipramantaradhIyata
shlokas.24:
sa chApi vIraH kRRitashastranishramaH; pareNa sAmnAbhyavadatsuyodhanam |
yudhiShThirasyApyabhavattadA mati;rna karNatulyo.asti dhanurdharaH kShitau

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH shiShyAnsamAnIya AchAryArthamachodayat |
droNaH sarvAnasheSheNa dakShiNArthaM mahIpate
shlokas.2:
pA~nchAlarAjaM drupadaM gRRihItvA raNamUrdhani |
paryAnayata bhadraM vaH sA syAtparamadakShiNA
shlokas.3:
tathetyuktvA tu te sarve rathaistUrNaM prahAriNaH |
AchAryadhanadAnArthaM droNena sahitA yayuH
shlokas.4:
tato.abhijagmuH pA~nchAlAnnighnantaste nararShabhAH |
mamRRidustasya nagaraM drupadasya mahaujasaH
shlokas.5:
te yaj~nasenaM drupadaM gRRihItvA raNamUrdhani |
upAjahruH sahAmAtyaM droNAya bharatarShabhAH
shlokas.6:
bhagnadarpaM hRRitadhanaM tathA cha vashamAgatam |
sa vairaM manasA dhyAtvA droNo drupadamabravIt
shlokas.7:
pramRRidya tarasA rAShTraM puraM te mRRiditaM mayA |
prApya jIvanripuvashaM sakhipUrvaM kimiShyate
shlokas.8:
evamuktvA prahasyainaM nishchitya punarabravIt |
mA bhaiH prANabhayAdrAjankShamiNo brAhmaNA vayam
shlokas.9:
Ashrame krIDitaM yattu tvayA bAlye mayA saha |
tena sa.nvardhitaH snehastvayA me kShatriyarShabha
shlokas.10:
prArthayeyaM tvayA sakhyaM punareva nararShabha |
varaM dadAmi te rAjanrAjyasyArdhamavApnuhi
shlokas.11:
arAjA kila no rAj~nAM sakhA bhavitumarhati |
ataH prayatitaM rAjye yaj~nasena mayA tava
shlokas.12:
rAjAsi dakShiNe kUle bhAgIrathyAhamuttare |
sakhAyaM mAM vijAnIhi pA~nchAla yadi manyase
shlokas.13:
drupada uvAcha||
anAshcharyamidaM brahmanvikrAnteShu mahAtmasu |
prIye tvayAhaM tvattashcha prItimichChAmi shAshvatIm
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu taM droNo mokShayAmAsa bhArata |
satkRRitya chainaM prItAtmA rAjyArdhaM pratyapAdayat
shlokas.15:
mAkandImatha ga~NgAyAstIre janapadAyutAm |
so.adhyAvasaddInamanAH kAmpilyaM cha purottamam
dakShiNA.nshchaiva pA~nchAlAnyAvachcharmaNvatI nadI
shlokas.16:
droNena vairaM drupadaH sa.nsmaranna shashAma ha |
kShAtreNa cha balenAsya nApashyatsa parAjayam
shlokas.17:
hInaM viditvA chAtmAnaM brAhmaNena balena cha |
putrajanma parIpsanvai sa rAjA tadadhArayat
ahichChatraM cha viShayaM droNaH samabhipadyata
shlokas.18:
evaM rAjannahichChatrA purI janapadAyutA |
yudhi nirjitya pArthena droNAya pratipAditA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
prANAdhikaM bhImasenaM kRRitavidyaM dhana~njayam |
duryodhano lakShayitva paryatapyata durmatiH
shlokas.2:
tato vaikartanaH karNaH shakunishchApi saubalaH |
anekairabhyupAyaistA~njighA.nsanti sma pANDavAn
shlokas.3:
pANDavAshchApi tatsarvaM pratyajAnannari.ndamAH |
udbhAvanamakurvanto vidurasya mate sthitAH
shlokas.4:
guNaiH samuditAndRRiShTvA paurAH pANDusutA.nstadA |
kathayanti sma sambhUya chatvareShu sabhAsu cha
shlokas.5:
praj~nAchakShurachakShuShTvAddhRRitarAShTro janeshvaraH |
rAjyamaprAptavAnpUrvaM sa kathaM nRRipatirbhavet
shlokas.6:
tathA bhIShmaH shAntanavaH satyasandho mahAvrataH |
pratyAkhyAya purA rAjyaM nAdya jAtu grahIShyati
shlokas.7:
te vayaM pANDavaM jyeShThaM taruNaM vRRiddhashIlinam |
abhiShi~nchAma sAdhvadya satyaM karuNavedinam
shlokas.8:
sa hi bhIShmaM shAntanavaM dhRRitarAShTraM cha dharmavit |
saputraM vividhairbhogairyojayiShyati pUjayan
shlokas.9:
teShAM duryodhanaH shrutvA tAni vAkyAni bhAShatAm |
yudhiShThirAnuraktAnAM paryatapyata durmatiH
shlokas.10:
sa tapyamAno duShTAtmA teShAM vAcho na chakShame |
IrShyayA chAbhisantapto dhRRitarAShTramupAgamat
shlokas.11:
tato virahitaM dRRiShTvA pitaraM pratipUjya saH |
paurAnurAgasantaptaH pashchAdidamabhAShata
shlokas.12:
shrutA me jalpatAM tAta paurANAmashivA giraH |
tvAmanAdRRitya bhIShmaM cha patimichChanti pANDavam
shlokas.13:
matametachcha bhIShmasya na sa rAjyaM bubhUShati |
asmAkaM tu parAM pIDAM chikIrShanti pure janAH
shlokas.14:
pitRRitaH prAptavAnrAjyaM pANDurAtmaguNaiH purA |
tvamapyaguNasa.nyogAtprAptaM rAjyaM na labdhavAn
shlokas.15:
sa eSha pANDordAyAdyaM yadi prApnoti pANDavaH |
tasya putro dhruvaM prAptastasya tasyeti chAparaH
shlokas.16:
te vayaM rAjava.nshena hInAH saha sutairapi |
avaj~nAtA bhaviShyAmo lokasya jagatIpate
shlokas.17:
satataM nirayaM prAptAH parapiNDopajIvinaH |
na bhavema yathA rAja.nstathA shIghraM vidhIyatAm
shlokas.18:
abhaviShyaH sthiro rAjye yadi hi tvaM purA nRRipa |
dhruvaM prApsyAma cha vayaM rAjyamapyavashe jane

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dhRRitarAShTrastu putrasya shrutvA vachanamIdRRisham |
muhUrtamiva sa~nchintya duryodhanamathAbravIt
shlokas.2:
dharmanityaH sadA pANDurmamAsItpriyakRRiddhitaH |
sarveShu j~nAtiShu tathA mayi tvAsIdvisheShataH
shlokas.3:
nAsya ki~nchinna jAnAmi bhojanAdi chikIrShitam |
nivedayati nityaM hi mama rAjyaM dhRRitavrataH
shlokas.4:
tasya putro yathA pANDustathA dharmaparAyaNaH |
guNavA.NllokavikhyAtaH paurANAM cha susaMmataH
shlokas.5:
sa kathaM shakyamasmAbhirapakraShTuM balAditaH |
pitRRipaitAmahAdrAjyAtsasahAyo visheShataH
shlokas.6:
bhRRitA hi pANDunAmAtyA balaM cha satataM bhRRitam |
bhRRitAH putrAshcha pautrAshcha teShAmapi visheShataH
shlokas.7:
te purA satkRRitAstAta pANDunA pauravA janAH |
kathaM yudhiShThirasyArthe na no hanyuH sabAndhavAn
shlokas.8:
duryodhana uvAcha||
evametanmayA tAta bhAvitaM doShamAtmani |
dRRiShTvA prakRRitayaH sarvA arthamAnena yojitAH
shlokas.9:
dhruvamasmatsahAyAste bhaviShyanti pradhAnataH |
arthavargaH sahAmAtyo matsa.nstho.adya mahIpate
shlokas.10:
sa bhavAnpANDavAnAshu vivAsayitumarhati |
mRRidunaivAbhyupAyena nagaraM vAraNAvatam
shlokas.11:
yadA pratiShThitaM rAjyaM mayi rAjanbhaviShyati |
tadA kuntI sahApatyA punareShyati bhArata
shlokas.12:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
duryodhana mamApyetaddhRRidi samparivartate |
abhiprAyasya pApatvAnnaitattu vivRRiNomyaham
shlokas.13:
na cha bhIShmo na cha droNo na kShattA na cha gautamaH |
vivAsyamAnAnkaunteyAnanuma.nsyanti karhichit
shlokas.14:
samA hi kauraveyANAM vayamete cha putraka |
naite viShamamichCheyurdharmayuktA manasvinaH
shlokas.15:
te vayaM kauraveyANAmeteShAM cha mahAtmanAm |
kathaM na vadhyatAM tAta gachChema jagatastathA
shlokas.16:
duryodhana uvAcha||
madhyasthaH satataM bhIShmo droNaputro mayi sthitaH |
yataH putrastato droNo bhavitA nAtra sA.nshayaH
shlokas.17:
kRRipaH shAradvatashchaiva yata ete trayastataH |
droNaM cha bhAgineyaM cha na sa tyakShyati karhichit
shlokas.18:
kShattArthabaddhastvasmAkaM prachChannaM tu yataH pare |
na chaikaH sa samartho.asmAnpANDavArthe prabAdhitum
shlokas.19:
sa vishrabdhaH pANDuputrAnsaha mAtrA vivAsaya |
vAraNAvatamadyaiva nAtra doSho bhaviShyati
shlokas.20:
vinidrakaraNaM ghoraM hRRidi shalyamivArpitam |
shokapAvakamudbhUtaM karmaNaitena nAshaya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato duryodhano rAjA sarvAstAH prakRRitIH shanaiH |
arthamAnapradAnAbhyAM sa~njahAra sahAnujaH
shlokas.2:
dhRRitarAShTraprayuktAstu kechitkushalamantriNaH |
kathayAM chakrire ramyaM nagaraM vAraNAvatam
shlokas.3:
ayaM samAjaH sumahAnramaNIyatamo bhuvi |
upasthitaH pashupaternagare vAraNAvate
shlokas.4:
sarvaratnasamAkIrNe pu.nsAM deshe manorame |
ityevaM dhRRitarAShTrasya vachanAchchakrire kathAH
shlokas.5:
kathyamAne tathA ramye nagare vAraNAvate |
gamane pANDuputrANAM jaj~ne tatra matirnRRipa
shlokas.6:
yadA tvamanyata nRRipo jAtakautUhalA iti |
uvAchainAnatha tadA pANDavAnambikAsutaH
shlokas.7:
mameme puruShA nityaM kathayanti punaH punaH |
ramaNIyataraM loke nagaraM vAraNAvatam
shlokas.8:
te tAta yadi manyadhvamutsavaM vAraNAvate |
sagaNAH sAnuyAtrAshcha viharadhvaM yathAmarAH
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNebhyashcha ratnAni gAyanebhyashcha sarvashaH |
prayachChadhvaM yathAkAmaM devA iva suvarchasaH
shlokas.10:
ka~nchitkAlaM vihRRityaivamanubhUya parAM mudam |
idaM vai hAstinapuraM sukhinaH punareShyatha
shlokas.11:
dhRRitarAShTrasya taM kAmamanubuddhvA yudhiShThiraH |
AtmanashchAsahAyatvaM tatheti pratyuvAcha tam
shlokas.12:
tato bhIShmaM mahAprAj~naM viduraM cha mahAmatim |
droNaM cha bAhlikaM chaiva somadattaM cha kauravam
shlokas.13:
kRRipamAchAryaputraM cha gAndhArIM cha yashasvinIm |
yudhiShThiraH shanairdInamuvAchedaM vachastadA
shlokas.14:
ramaNIye janAkIrNe nagare vAraNAvate |
sagaNAstAta vatsyAmo dhRRitarAShTrasya shAsanAt
shlokas.15:
prasannamanasaH sarve puNyA vAcho vimu~nchata |
AshIrbhirvardhitAnasmAnna pApaM prasahiShyati
shlokas.16:
evamuktAstu te sarve pANDuputreNa kauravAH |
prasannavadanA bhUtvA te.abhyavartanta pANDavAn
shlokas.17:
svastyastu vaH pathi sadA bhUtebhyashchaiva sarvashaH |
mA cha vo.astvashubhaM ki~nchitsarvataH pANDunandanAH
shlokas.18:
tataH kRRitasvastyayanA rAjyalAbhAya pANDavAH |
kRRitvA sarvANi kAryANi prayayurvAraNAvatam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamukteShu rAj~nA tu pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
duryodhanaH paraM harShamAjagAma durAtmavAn
shlokas.2:
sa purochanamekAntamAnIya bharatarShabha |
gRRihItvA dakShiNe pANau sachivaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.3:
mameyaM vasusampUrNA purochana vasundharA |
yatheyaM mama tadvatte sa tAM rakShitumarhasi
shlokas.4:
na hi me kashchidanyo.asti vaishvAsikatarastvayA |
sahAyo yena sandhAya mantrayeyaM yathA tvayA
shlokas.5:
sa.nrakSha tAta mantraM cha sapatnA.nshcha mamoddhara |
nipuNenAbhyupAyena yadbravImi tathA kuru
shlokas.6:
pANDavA dhRRitarAShTreNa preShitA vAraNAvatam |
utsave vihariShyanti dhRRitarAShTrasya shAsanAt
shlokas.7:
sa tvaM rAsabhayuktena syandanenAshugAminA |
vAraNAvatamadyaiva yathA yAsi tathA kuru
shlokas.8:
tatra gatvA chatuHshAlaM gRRihaM paramasa.nvRRitam |
AyudhAgAramAshritya kArayethA mahAdhanam
shlokas.9:
shaNasarjarasAdIni yAni dravyANi kAnichit |
AgneyAnyuta santIha tAni sarvANi dApaya
shlokas.10:
sarpiShA cha satailena lAkShayA chApyanalpayA |
mRRittikAM mishrayitvA tvaM lepaM kuDyeShu dApayeH
shlokas.11:
shaNAnva.nshaM ghRRitaM dAru yantrANi vividhAni cha |
tasminveshmani sarvANi nikShipethAH samantataH
shlokas.12:
yathA cha tvAM na sha~NkeranparIkShanto.api pANDavAH |
Agneyamiti tatkAryamiti chAnye cha mAnavAH
shlokas.13:
veshmanyevaM kRRite tatra kRRitvA tAnparamArchitAn |
vAsayeH pANDaveyA.nshcha kuntIM cha sasuhRRijjanAm
shlokas.14:
tatrAsanAni mukhyAni yAnAni shayanAni cha |
vidhAtavyAni pANDUnAM yathA tuShyeta me pitA
shlokas.15:
yathA rameranvishrabdhA nagare vAraNAvate |
tathA sarvaM vidhAtavyaM yAvatkAlasya paryayaH
shlokas.16:
j~nAtvA tu tAnsuvishvastA~nshayAnAnakutobhayAn |
agnistatastvayA deyo dvAratastasya veshmanaH
shlokas.17:
dagdhAnevaM svake gehe dagdhA iti tato janAH |
j~nAtayo vA vadiShyanti pANDavArthAya karhichit
shlokas.18:
tattatheti pratij~nAya kauravAya purochanaH |
prAyAdrAsabhayuktena nagaraM vAraNAvatam
shlokas.19:
sa gatvA tvarito rAjanduryodhanamate sthitaH |
yathoktaM rAjaputreNa sarvaM chakre purochanaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pANDavAstu rathAnyuktvA sadashvairanilopamaiH |
ArohamANA bhIShmasya pAdau jagRRihurArtavat
shlokas.2:
rAj~nashcha dhRRitarAShTrasya droNasya cha mahAtmanaH |
anyeShAM chaiva vRRiddhAnAM vidurasya kRRipasya cha
shlokas.3:
evaM sarvAnkurUnvRRiddhAnabhivAdya yatavratAH |
samAli~Ngya samAnA.nshcha bAlaishchApyabhivAditAH
shlokas.4:
sarvA mAtRRistathApRRiShTvA kRRitvA chaiva pradakShiNam |
sarvAH prakRRitayashchaiva prayayurvAraNAvatam
shlokas.5:
vidurashcha mahAprAj~nastathAnye kurupu~NgavAH |
paurAshcha puruShavyAghrAnanvayuH shokakarshitAH
shlokas.6:
tatra kechchidbruvanti sma brAhmaNA nirbhayAstadA |
shochamAnAH pANDuputrAnatIva bharatarShabha
shlokas.7:
viShamaM pashyate rAjA sarvathA tamasAvRRitaH |
dhRRitarAShTraH sudurbuddhirna cha dharmaM prapashyati
shlokas.8:
na hi pApamapApAtmA rochayiShyati pANDavaH |
bhImo vA balinAM shreShThaH kaunteyo vA dhana~njayaH
kuta eva mahAprAj~nau mAdrIputrau kariShyataH
shlokas.9:
tadrAjyaM pitRRitaH prAptaM dhRRitarAShTro na mRRiShyate |
adharmamakhilaM kiM nu bhIShmo.ayamanumanyate
vivAsyamAnAnasthAne kaunteyAnbharatarShabhAn
shlokas.10:
piteva hi nRRipo.asmAkamabhUchChAntanavaH purA |
vichitravIryo rAjarShiH pANDushcha kurunandanaH
shlokas.11:
sa tasminpuruShavyAghre diShTabhAvaM gate sati |
rAjaputrAnimAnbAlAndhRRitarAShTro na mRRiShyate
shlokas.12:
vayametadamRRiShyantaH sarva eva purottamAt |
gRRihAnvihAya gachChAmo yatra yAti yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.13:
tA.nstathAvAdinaH paurAnduHkhitAnduHkhakarshitaH |
uvAcha paramaprIto dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.14:
pitA mAnyo guruH shreShTho yadAha pRRithivIpatiH |
asha~NkamAnaistatkAryamasmAbhiriti no vratam
shlokas.15:
bhavantaH suhRRido.asmAkamasmAnkRRitvA pradakShiNam |
AshIrbhirabhinandyAsmAnnivartadhvaM yathAgRRiham
shlokas.16:
yadA tu kAryamasmAkaM bhavadbhirupapatsyate |
tadA kariShyatha mama priyANi cha hitAni cha
shlokas.17:
te tatheti pratij~nAya kRRitvA chaitAnpradakShiNam |
AshIrbhirabhinandyainA~njagmurnagarameva hi
shlokas.18:
paureShu tu nivRRitteShu viduraH sarvadharmavit |
bodhayanpANDavashreShThamidaM vachanamabravIt
prAj~naH prAj~naM pralApaj~naH samyagdharmArthadarshivAn
shlokas.19:
vij~nAyedaM tathA kuryAdApadaM nistaredyathA |
alohaM nishitaM shastraM sharIraparikartanam
yo vetti na tamAghnanti pratighAtavidaM dviShaH
shlokas.20:
kakShaghnaH shishiraghnashcha mahAkakShe bilaukasaH |
na dahediti chAtmAnaM yo rakShati sa jIvati
shlokas.21:
nAchakShurvetti panthAnaM nAchakShurvindate dishaH |
nAdhRRitirbhUtimApnoti budhyasvaivaM prabodhitaH
shlokas.22:
anAptairdattamAdatte naraH shastramalohajam |
shvAvichCharaNamAsAdya pramuchyeta hutAshanAt
shlokas.23:
charanmArgAnvijAnAti nakShatrairvindate dishaH |
AtmanA chAtmanaH pa~ncha pIDayannAnupIDyate
shlokas.24:
anushiShTvAnugatvA cha kRRitvA chainAnpradakShiNam |
pANDavAnabhyanuj~nAya viduraH prayayau gRRihAn
shlokas.25:
nivRRitte vidure chaiva bhIShme paurajane tathA |
ajAtashatrumAmantrya kuntI vachanamabravIt
shlokas.26:
kShattA yadabravIdvAkyaM janamadhye.abruvanniva |
tvayA cha tattathetyukto jAnImo na cha tadvayam
shlokas.27:
yadi tachChakyamasmAbhiH shrotuM na cha sadoShavat |
shrotumichChAmi tatsarvaM sa.nvAdaM tava tasya cha
shlokas.28:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
viShAdagneshcha boddhavyamiti mAM viduro.abravIt |
panthAshcha vo nAviditaH kashchitsyAditi chAbravIt
shlokas.29:
jitendriyashcha vasudhAM prApsyasIti cha mAbravIt |
vij~nAtamiti tatsarvamityukto viduro mayA
shlokas.30:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
aShTame.ahani rohiNyAM prayAtAH phalgunasya te |
vAraNAvatamAsAdya dadRRishurnAgaraM janam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sarvAH prakRRitayo nagarAdvAraNAvatAt |
sarvama~Ngalasa.nyuktA yathAshAstramatandritAH
shlokas.2:
shrutvAgatAnpANDuputrAnnAnAyAnaiH sahasrashaH |
abhijagmurnarashreShThA~nshrutvaiva parayA mudA
shlokas.3:
te samAsAdya kaunteyAnvAraNAvatakA janAH |
kRRitvA jayAshiShaH sarve parivAryopatasthire
shlokas.4:
tairvRRitaH puruShavyAghro dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
vibabhau devasa~NkAsho vajrapANirivAmaraiH
shlokas.5:
satkRRitAste tu pauraishcha paurAnsatkRRitya chAnaghAH |
ala~NkRRitaM janAkIrNaM vivishurvAraNAvatam
shlokas.6:
te pravishya puraM vIrAstUrNaM jagmuratho gRRihAn |
brAhmaNAnAM mahIpAla ratAnAM sveShu karmasu
shlokas.7:
nagarAdhikRRitAnAM cha gRRihANi rathinAM tathA |
upatasthurnarashreShThA vaishyashUdragRRihAnapi
shlokas.8:
architAshcha naraiH pauraiH pANDavA bharatarShabhAH |
jagmurAvasathaM pashchAtpurochanapuraskRRitAH
shlokas.9:
tebhyo bhakShyAnnapAnAni shayanAni shubhAni cha |
AsanAni cha mukhyAni pradadau sa purochanaH
shlokas.10:
tatra te satkRRitAstena sumahArhaparichChadAH |
upAsyamAnAH puruShairUShuH puranivAsibhiH
shlokas.11:
dasharAtroShitAnAM tu tatra teShAM purochanaH |
nivedayAmAsa gRRihaM shivAkhyamashivaM tadA
shlokas.12:
tatra te puruShavyAghrA vivishuH saparichChadAH |
purochanasya vachanAtkailAsamiva guhyakAH
shlokas.13:
tattvagAramabhiprekShya sarvadharmavishAradaH |
uvAchAgneyamityevaM bhImasenaM yudhiShThiraH
jighransomya vasAgandhaM sarpirjatuvimishritam
shlokas.14:
kRRitaM hi vyaktamAgneyamidaM veshma parantapa |
shaNasarjarasaM vyaktamAnItaM gRRihakarmaNi
mu~njabalvajava.nshAdi dravyaM sarvaM ghRRitokShitam
shlokas.15:
shilpibhiH sukRRitaM hyAptairvinItairveshmakarmaNi |
vishvastaM mAmayaM pApo dagdhukAmaH purochanaH
shlokas.16:
imAM tu tAM mahAbuddhirviduro dRRiShTavA.nstadA |
ApadaM tena mAM pArtha sa sambodhitavAnpurA
shlokas.17:
te vayaM bodhitAstena buddhavanto.ashivaM gRRiham |
AchAryaiH sukRRitaM gUDhairduryodhanavashAnugaiH
shlokas.18:
bhIma uvAcha||
yadidaM gRRihamAgneyaM vihitaM manyate bhavAn |
tatraiva sAdhu gachChAmo yatra pUrvoShitA vayam
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
iha yattairnirAkArairvastavyamiti rochaye |
naShTairiva vichinvadbhirgatimiShTAM dhruvAmitaH
shlokas.20:
yadi vindeta chAkAramasmAkaM hi purochanaH |
shIghrakArI tato bhUtvA prasahyApi daheta naH
shlokas.21:
nAyaM bibhetyupakroshAdadharmAdvA purochanaH |
tathA hi vartate mandaH suyodhanamate sthitaH
shlokas.22:
api cheha pradagdheShu bhIShmo.asmAsu pitAmahaH |
kopaM kuryAtkimarthaM vA kauravAnkopayeta saH
dharma ityeva kupyeta tathAnye kurupu~NgavAH
shlokas.23:
vayaM tu yadi dAhasya bibhyataH pradravema hi |
spashairno ghAtayetsArvAnrAjyalubdhaH suyodhanaH
shlokas.24:
apadasthAnpade tiShThannapakShAnpakShasa.nsthitaH |
hInakoshAnmahAkoshaH prayogairghAtayeddhruvam
shlokas.25:
tadasmAbhirimaM pApaM taM cha pApaM suyodhanam |
va~nchayadbhirnivastavyaM ChannavAsaM kvachitkvachit
shlokas.26:
te vayaM mRRigayAshIlAshcharAma vasudhAmimAm |
tathA no viditA mArgA bhaviShyanti palAyatAm
shlokas.27:
bhaumaM cha bilamadyaiva karavAma susa.nvRRitam |
gUDhochChvasAnna nastatra hutAshaH sampradhakShyati
shlokas.28:
vasato.atra yathA chAsmAnna budhyeta purochanaH |
pauro vApi janaH kashchittathA kAryamatandritaiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vidurasya suhRRitkashchitkhanakaH kushalaH kvachit |
vivikte pANDavAnrAjannidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
prahito vidureNAsmi khanakaH kushalo bhRRisham |
pANDavAnAM priyaM kAryamiti kiM karavANi vaH
shlokas.3:
prachChannaM vidureNoktaH shreyastvamiha pANDavAn |
pratipAdaya vishvAsAditi kiM karavANi vaH
shlokas.4:
kRRiShNapakShe chaturdashyAM rAtrAvasya purochanaH |
bhavanasya tava dvAri pradAsyati hutAshanam
shlokas.5:
mAtrA saha pradagdhavyAH pANDavAH puruSharShabhAH |
iti vyavasitaM pArtha dhArtarAShTrasya me shrutam
shlokas.6:
ki~nchichcha vidureNokto mlechChavAchAsi pANDava |
tvayA cha tattathetyuktametadvishvAsakAraNam
shlokas.7:
uvAcha taM satyadhRRitiH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
abhijAnAmi saumya tvAM suhRRidaM vidurasya vai
shlokas.8:
shuchimAptaM priyaM chaiva sadA cha dRRiDhabhaktikam |
na vidyate kaveH ki~nchidabhij~nAnaprayojanam
shlokas.9:
yathA naH sa tathA nastvaM nirvisheShA vayaM tvayi |
bhavataH sma yathA tasya pAlayAsmAnyathA kaviH
shlokas.10:
idaM sharaNamAgneyaM madarthamiti me matiH |
purochanena vihitaM dhArtarAShTrasya shAsanAt
shlokas.11:
sa pApaH koshavA.nshchaiva sasahAyashcha durmatiH |
asmAnapi cha duShTAtmA nityakAlaM prabAdhate
shlokas.12:
sa bhavAnmokShayatvasmAnyatnenAsmAddhutAshanAt |
asmAsviha hi dagdheShu sakAmaH syAtsuyodhanaH
shlokas.13:
samRRiddhamAyudhAgAramidaM tasya durAtmanaH |
vaprAnte niShpratIkAramAshliShyedaM kRRitaM mahat
shlokas.14:
idaM tadashubhaM nUnaM tasya karma chikIrShitam |
prAgeva viduro veda tenAsmAnanvabodhayat
shlokas.15:
seyamApadanuprAptA kShattA yAM dRRiShTavAnpurA |
purochanasyAviditAnasmA.nstvaM vipramochaya
shlokas.16:
sa tatheti pratishrutya khanako yatnamAsthitaH |
parikhAmutkirannAma chakAra sumahadbilam
shlokas.17:
chakre cha veshmanastasya madhye nAtimahanmukham |
kapATayuktamaj~nAtaM samaM bhUmyA cha bhArata
shlokas.18:
purochanabhayAchchaiva vyadadhAtsa.nvRRitaM mukham |
sa tatra cha gRRihadvAri vasatyashubhadhIH sadA
shlokas.19:
tatra te sAyudhAH sarve vasanti sma kShapAM nRRipa |
divA charanti mRRigayAM pANDaveyA vanAdvanam
shlokas.20:
vishvastavadavishvastA va~nchayantaH purochanam |
atuShTAstuShTavadrAjannUShuH paramaduHkhitAH
shlokas.21:
na chainAnanvabudhyanta narA nagaravAsinaH |
anyatra vidurAmAtyAttasmAtkhanakasattamAt

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tA.nstu dRRiShTvA sumanasaH parisa.nvatsaroShitAn |
vishvastAniva sa.nlakShya harShaM chakre purochanaH
shlokas.2:
purochane tathA hRRiShTe kaunteyo.atha yudhiShThiraH |
bhImasenArjunau chaiva yamau chovAcha dharmavit
shlokas.3:
asmAnayaM suvishvastAnvetti pApaH purochanaH |
va~nchito.ayaM nRRisha.nsAtmA kAlaM manye palAyane
shlokas.4:
AyudhAgAramAdIpya dagdhvA chaiva purochanam |
ShaTprANino nidhAyeha dravAmo.anabhilakShitAH
shlokas.5:
atha dAnApadeshena kuntI brAhmaNabhojanam |
chakre nishi mahadrAjannAjagmustatra yoShitaH
shlokas.6:
tA vihRRitya yathAkAmaM bhuktvA pItvA cha bhArata |
jagmurnishi gRRihAneva samanuj~nApya mAdhavIm
shlokas.7:
niShAdI pa~nchaputrA tu tasminbhojye yadRRichChayA |
annArthinI samabhyAgAtsaputrA kAlachoditA
shlokas.8:
sA pItvA madirAM mattA saputrA madavihvalA |
saha sarvaiH sutai rAja.nstasminneva niveshane
suShvApa vigataj~nAnA mRRitakalpA narAdhipa
shlokas.9:
atha pravAte tumule nishi supte jane vibho |
tadupAdIpayadbhImaH shete yatra purochanaH
shlokas.10:
tataH pratApaH sumahA~nshabdashchaiva vibhAvasoH |
prAdurAsIttadA tena bubudhe sa janavrajaH
shlokas.11:
paurA UchuH||
duryodhanaprayuktena pApenAkRRitabuddhinA |
gRRihamAtmavinAshAya kAritaM dAhitaM cha yat
shlokas.12:
aho dhigdhRRitarAShTrasya buddhirnAtisama~njasI |
yaH shuchInpANDavAnbAlAndAhayAmAsa mantriNA
shlokas.13:
diShTyA tvidAnIM pApAtmA dagdho.ayamatidurmatiH |
anAgasaH suvishvastAnyo dadAha narottamAn
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM te vilapanti sma vAraNAvatakA janAH |
parivArya gRRihaM tachcha tasthU rAtrau samantataH
shlokas.15:
pANDavAshchApi te rAjanmAtrA saha suduHkhitAH |
bilena tena nirgatya jagmurgUDhamalakShitAH
shlokas.16:
tena nidroparodhena sAdhvasena cha pANDavAH |
na shekuH sahasA gantuM saha mAtrA parantapAH
shlokas.17:
bhImasenastu rAjendra bhImavegaparAkramaH |
jagAma bhrAtRRinAdAya sarvAnmAtarameva cha
shlokas.18:
skandhamAropya jananIM yamAva~Nkena vIryavAn |
pArthau gRRihItvA pANibhyAM bhrAtarau sumahAbalau
shlokas.19:
tarasA pAdapAnbha~njanmahIM padbhyAM vidArayan |
sa jagAmAshu tejasvI vAtaraMhA vRRikodaraH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
atha rAtryAM vyatItAyAmasheSho nAgaro janaH |
tatrAjagAma tvarito didRRikShuH pANDunandanAn
shlokas.2:
nirvApayanto jvalanaM te janA dadRRishustataH |
jAtuShaM tadgRRihaM dagdhamamAtyaM cha purochanam
shlokas.3:
nUnaM duryodhanenedaM vihitaM pApakarmaNA |
pANDavAnAM vinAshAya ityevaM chukruShurjanAH
shlokas.4:
vidite dhRRitarAShTrasya dhArtarAShTro na sa.nshayaH |
dagdhavAnpANDudAyAdAnna hyenaM pratiShiddhavAn
shlokas.5:
nUnaM shAntanavo bhIShmo na dharmamanuvartate |
droNashcha vidurashchaiva kRRipashchAnye cha kauravAH
shlokas.6:
te vayaM dhRRitarAShTrasya preShayAmo durAtmanaH |
sa.nvRRittaste paraH kAmaH pANDavAndagdhavAnasi
shlokas.7:
tato vyapohamAnAste pANDavArthe hutAshanam |
niShAdIM dadRRishurdagdhAM pa~nchaputrAmanAgasam
shlokas.8:
khanakena tu tenaiva veshma shodhayatA bilam |
pA.nsubhiH pratyapihitaM puruShaistairalakShitam
shlokas.9:
tataste preShayAmAsurdhRRitarAShTrasya nAgarAH |
pANDavAnagninA dagdhAnamAtyaM cha purochanam
shlokas.10:
shrutvA tu dhRRitarAShTrastadrAjA sumahadapriyam |
vinAshaM pANDuputrANAM vilalApa suduHkhitaH
shlokas.11:
adya pANDurmRRito rAjA bhrAtA mama sudurlabhaH |
teShu vIreShu dagdheShu mAtrA saha visheShataH
shlokas.12:
gachChantu puruShAH shIghraM nagaraM vAraNAvatam |
satkArayantu tAnvIrAnkuntirAjasutAM cha tAm
shlokas.13:
kArayantu cha kulyAni shubhrANi cha mahAnti cha |
ye cha tatra mRRitAsteShAM suhRRido.archantu tAnapi
shlokas.14:
eva~Ngate mayA shakyaM yadyatkArayituM hitam |
pANDavAnAM cha kuntyAshcha tatsarvaM kriyatAM dhanaiH
shlokas.15:
evamuktvA tatashchakre j~nAtibhiH parivAritaH |
udakaM pANDuputrANAM dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH
shlokas.16:
chukrushuH kauravAH sarve bhRRishaM shokaparAyaNAH |
vidurastvalpashashchakre shokaM veda paraM hi saH
shlokas.17:
pANDavAshchApi nirgatya nagarAdvAraNAvatAt |
javena prayayU rAjandakShiNAM dishamAshritAH
shlokas.18:
vij~nAya nishi panthAnaM nakShatrairdakShiNAmukhAH |
yatamAnA vanaM rAjangahanaM pratipedire
shlokas.19:
tataH shrAntAH pipAsArtA nidrAndhAH pANDunandanAH |
punarUchurmahAvIryaM bhImasenamidaM vachaH
shlokas.20:
itaH kaShTataraM kiM nu yadvayaM gahane vane |
dishashcha na prajAnImo gantuM chaiva na shaknumaH
shlokas.21:
taM cha pApaM na jAnImo yadi dagdhaH purochanaH |
kathaM nu vipramuchyema bhayAdasmAdalakShitAH
shlokas.22:
punarasmAnupAdAya tathaiva vraja bhArata |
tvaM hi no balavAneko yathA satatagastathA
shlokas.23:
ityukto dharmarAjena bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
AdAya kuntIM bhrAtRRi.nshcha jagAmAshu mahAbalaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tena vikramatA tUrNamUruvegasamIritam |
pravavAvanilo rAja~nshuchishukrAgame yathA
shlokas.2:
sa mRRidnanpuShpitA.nshchaiva phalitA.nshcha vanaspatIn |
ArujandArugulmA.nshcha pathastasya samIpajAn
shlokas.3:
tathA vRRikShAnbha~njamAno jagAmAmitavikramaH |
tasya vegena pANDUnAM mUrchCheva samajAyata
shlokas.4:
asakRRichchApi santIrya dUrapAraM bhujaplavaiH |
pathi prachChannamAsedurdhArtarAShTrabhayAttadA
shlokas.5:
kRRichChreNa mAtaraM tvekAM sukumArIM yashasvinIm |
avahattatra pRRiShThena rodhaHsu viShameShu cha
shlokas.6:
Agama.nste vanoddeshamalpamUlaphalodakam |
krUrapakShimRRigaM ghoraM sAyAhne bharatarShabhAH
shlokas.7:
ghorA samabhavatsandhyA dAruNA mRRigapakShiNaH |
aprakAshA dishaH sarvA vAtairAsannanArtavaiH
shlokas.8:
te shrameNa cha kauravyAstRRiShNayA cha prapIDitAH |
nAshaknuva.nstadA gantuM nidrayA cha pravRRiddhayA
shlokas.9:
tato bhImo vanaM ghoraM pravishya vijanaM mahat |
nyagrodhaM vipulachChAyaM ramaNIyamupAdravat
shlokas.10:
tatra nikShipya tAnsarvAnuvAcha bharatarShabhaH |
pAnIyaM mRRigayAmIha vishramadhvamiti prabho
shlokas.11:
ete ruvanti madhuraM sArasA jalachAriNaH |
dhruvamatra jalasthAyo mahAniti matirmama
shlokas.12:
anuj~nAtaH sa gachCheti bhrAtrA jyeShThena bhArata |
jagAma tatra yatra sma ruvanti jalachAriNaH
shlokas.13:
sa tatra pItvA pAnIyaM snAtvA cha bharatarShabha |
uttarIyeNa pAnIyamAjahAra tadA nRRipa
shlokas.14:
gavyUtimAtrAdAgatya tvarito mAtaraM prati |
sa suptAM mAtaraM dRRiShTvA bhrAtRRi.nshcha vasudhAtale
bhRRishaM duHkhaparItAtmA vilalApa vRRikodaraH
shlokas.15:
shayaneShu parArdhyeShu ye purA vAraNAvate |
nAdhijagmustadA nidrAM te.adya suptA mahItale
shlokas.16:
svasAraM vasudevasya shatrusa~NghAvamardinaH |
kuntibhojasutAM kuntIM sarvalakShaNapUjitAm
shlokas.17:
snuShAM vichitravIryasya bhAryAM pANDormahAtmanaH |
prAsAdashayanAM nityaM puNDarIkAntaraprabhAm
shlokas.18:
sukumAratarAM strINAM mahArhashayanochitAm |
shayAnAM pashyatAdyeha pRRithivyAmatathochitAm
shlokas.19:
dharmAdindrAchcha vAyoshcha suShuve yA sutAnimAn |
seyaM bhUmau parishrAntA shete hyadyAtathochitA
shlokas.20:
kiM nu duHkhataraM shakyaM mayA draShTumataH param |
yo.ahamadya naravyAghrAnsuptAnpashyAmi bhUtale
shlokas.21:
triShu lokeShu yadrAjyaM dharmavidyo.arhate nRRipaH |
so.ayaM bhUmau parishrAntaH shete prAkRRitavatkatham
shlokas.22:
ayaM nIlAmbudashyAmo nareShvapratimo bhuvi |
shete prAkRRitavadbhUmAvato duHkhataraM nu kim
shlokas.23:
ashvinAviva devAnAM yAvimau rUpasampadA |
tau prAkRRitavadadyemau prasuptau dharaNItale
shlokas.24:
j~nAtayo yasya naiva syurviShamAH kulapA.nsanAH |
sa jIvetsusukhaM loke grAme druma ivaikajaH
shlokas.25:
eko vRRikSho hi yo grAme bhavetparNaphalAnvitaH |
chaityo bhavati nirj~nAtirarchanIyaH supUjitaH
shlokas.26:
yeShAM cha bahavaH shUrA j~nAtayo dharmasa.nshritAH |
te jIvanti sukhaM loke bhavanti cha nirAmayAH
shlokas.27:
balavantaH samRRiddhArthA mitrabAndhavanandanAH |
jIvantyanyonyamAshritya drumAH kAnanajA iva
shlokas.28:
vayaM tu dhRRitarAShTreNa saputreNa durAtmanA |
vivAsitA na dagdhAshcha katha~nchittasya shAsanAt
shlokas.29:
tasmAnmuktA vayaM dAhAdimaM vRRikShamupAshritAH |
kAM dishaM pratipatsyAmaH prAptAH kleshamanuttamam
shlokas.30:
nAtidUre cha nagaraM vanAdasmAddhi lakShaye |
jAgartavye svapantIme hanta jAgarmyahaM svayam
shlokas.31:
pAsyantIme jalaM pashchAtpratibuddhA jitaklamAH |
iti bhImo vyavasyaiva jajAgAra svayaM tadA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatra teShu shayAneShu hiDimbo nAma rAkShasaH |
avidUre vanAttasmAchChAlavRRikShamupAshritaH
shlokas.2:
krUro mAnuShamA.nsAdo mahAvIryo mahAbalaH |
virUparUpaH pi~NgAkShaH karAlo ghoradarshanaH
pishitepsuH kShudhArtastAnapashyata yadRRichChayA
shlokas.3:
UrdhvA~NguliH sa kaNDUyandhunvanrUkShA~nshiroruhAn |
jRRimbhamANo mahAvaktraH punaH punaravekShya cha
shlokas.4:
duShTo mAnuShamA.nsAdo mahAkAyo mahAbalaH |
AghrAya mAnuShaM gandhaM bhaginImidamabravIt
shlokas.5:
upapannashchirasyAdya bhakSho mama manaHpriyaH |
snehasravAnprasravati jihvA paryeti me mukham
shlokas.6:
aShTau daMShTrAH sutIkShNAgrAshchirasyApAtaduHsahAH |
deheShu majjayiShyAmi snigdheShu pishiteShu cha
shlokas.7:
Akramya mAnuShaM kaNThamAchChidya dhamanImapi |
uShNaM navaM prapAsyAmi phenilaM rudhiraM bahu
shlokas.8:
gachCha jAnIhi ke tvete sherate vanamAshritAH |
mAnuSho balavAngandho ghrANaM tarpayatIva me
shlokas.9:
hatvaitAnmAnuShAnsarvAnAnayasva mamAntikam |
asmadviShayasuptebhyo naitebhyo bhayamasti te
shlokas.10:
eShAM mA.nsAni sa.nskRRitya mAnuShANAM yatheShTataH |
bhakShayiShyAva sahitau kuru tUrNaM vacho mama
shlokas.11:
bhrAturvachanamAj~nAya tvaramANeva rAkShasI |
jagAma tatra yatra sma pANDavA bharatarShabha
shlokas.12:
dadarsha tatra gatvA sA pANDavAnpRRithayA saha |
shayAnAnbhImasenaM cha jAgrataM tvaparAjitam
shlokas.13:
dRRiShTvaiva bhImasenaM sA shAlaskandhamivodgatam |
rAkShasI kAmayAmAsa rUpeNApratimaM bhuvi
shlokas.14:
ayaM shyAmo mahAbAhuH siMhaskandho mahAdyutiH |
kambugrIvaH puShkarAkSho bhartA yukto bhavenmama
shlokas.15:
nAhaM bhrAtRRivacho jAtu kuryAM krUropasaMhitam |
patisneho.atibalavAnna tathA bhrAtRRisauhRRidam
shlokas.16:
muhUrtamiva tRRiptishcha bhavedbhrAturmamaiva cha |
hatairetairahatvA tu modiShye shAshvatiH samAH
shlokas.17:
sA kAmarUpiNI rUpaM kRRitvA mAnuShamuttamam |
upatasthe mahAbAhuM bhImasenaM shanaiH shanaiH
shlokas.18:
vilajjamAneva latA divyAbharaNabhUShitA |
smitapUrvamidaM vAkyaM bhImasenamathAbravIt
shlokas.19:
kutastvamasi samprAptaH kashchAsi puruSharShabha |
ka ime sherate cheha puruShA devarUpiNaH
shlokas.20:
keyaM cha bRRihatI shyAmA sukumArI tavAnagha |
shete vanamidaM prApya vishvastA svagRRihe yathA
shlokas.21:
nedaM jAnAti gahanaM vanaM rAkShasasevitam |
vasati hyatra pApAtmA hiDimbo nAma rAkShasaH
shlokas.22:
tenAhaM preShitA bhrAtrA duShTabhAvena rakShasA |
bibhakShayiShatA mA.nsaM yuShmAkamamaropama
shlokas.23:
sAhaM tvAmabhisamprekShya devagarbhasamaprabham |
nAnyaM bhartAramichChAmi satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.24:
etadvij~nAya dharmaj~na yuktaM mayi samAchara |
kAmopahatachittA~NgIM bhajamAnAM bhajasva mAm
shlokas.25:
trAsye.ahaM tvAM mahAbAho rAkShasAtpuruShAdakAt |
vatsyAvo giridurgeShu bhartA bhava mamAnagha
shlokas.26:
antarikShacharA hyasmi kAmato vicharAmi cha |
atulAmApnuhi prItiM tatra tatra mayA saha
shlokas.27:
bhIma uvAcha||
mAtaraM bhrAtaraM jyeShThaM kaniShThAnaparAnimAn |
parityajeta ko nvadya prabhavanniva rAkShasi
shlokas.28:
ko hi suptAnimAnbhrAtRRindattvA rAkShasabhojanam |
mAtaraM cha naro gachChetkAmArta iva madvidhaH
shlokas.29:
rAkShasyuvAcha||
yatte priyaM tatkariShye sarvAnetAnprabodhaya |
mokShayiShyAmi vaH kAmaM rAkShasAtpuruShAdakAt
shlokas.30:
bhIma uvAcha||
sukhasuptAnvane bhrAtRRinmAtaraM chaiva rAkShasi |
na bhayAdbodhayiShyAmi bhrAtustava durAtmanaH
shlokas.31:
na hi me rAkShasA bhIru soDhuM shaktAH parAkramam |
na manuShyA na gandharvA na yakShAshchArulochane
shlokas.32:
gachCha vA tiShTha vA bhadre yadvApIchChasi tatkuru |
taM vA preShaya tanva~Ngi bhrAtaraM puruShAdakam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tAM viditvA chiragatAM hiDimbo rAkShaseshvaraH |
avatIrya drumAttasmAdAjagAmAtha pANDavAn
shlokas.2:
lohitAkSho mahAbAhurUrdhvakesho mahAbalaH |
meghasa~NghAtavarShmA cha tIkShNadaMShTrojjvalAnanaH
shlokas.3:
tamApatantaM dRRiShTvaiva tathA vikRRitadarshanam |
hiDimbovAcha vitrastA bhImasenamidaM vachaH
shlokas.4:
ApatatyeSha duShTAtmA sa~NkruddhaH puruShAdakaH |
tvAmahaM bhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM yadbravImi tathA kuru
shlokas.5:
ahaM kAmagamA vIra rakShobalasamanvitA |
AruhemAM mama shroNIM neShyAmi tvAM vihAyasA
shlokas.6:
prabodhayainAnsa.nsuptAnmAtaraM cha parantapa |
sarvAneva gamiShyAmi gRRihItvA vo vihAyasA
shlokas.7:
bhIma uvAcha||
mA bhaistvaM vipulashroNi naiSha kashchinmayi sthite |
ahamenaM haniShyAmi prekShantyAste sumadhyame
shlokas.8:
nAyaM pratibalo bhIru rAkShasApasado mama |
soDhuM yudhi parispandamathavA sarvarAkShasAH
shlokas.9:
pashya bAhU suvRRittau me hastihastanibhAvimau |
UrU parighasa~NkAshau saMhataM chApyuro mama
shlokas.10:
vikramaM me yathendrasya sAdya drakShyasi shobhane |
mAvama.nsthAH pRRithushroNi matvA mAmiha mAnuSham
shlokas.11:
hiDimbovAcha||
