nAvamanye naravyAghra tvAmahaM devarUpiNam |
dRRiShTApadAnastu mayA mAnuSheShveva rAkShasaH
shlokas.12:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA sa~njalpatastasya bhImasenasya bhArata |
vAchaH shushrAva tAH kruddho rAkShasaH puruShAdakaH
shlokas.13:
avekShamANastasyAshcha hiDimbo mAnuShaM vapuH |
sragdAmapUritashikhaM samagrendunibhAnanam
shlokas.14:
subhrUnAsAkShikeshAntaM sukumAranakhatvacham |
sarvAbharaNasa.nyuktaM susUkShmAmbaravAsasam
shlokas.15:
tAM tathA mAnuShaM rUpaM bibhratIM sumanoharam |
pu.nskAmAM sha~NkamAnashcha chukrodha puruShAdakaH
shlokas.16:
sa~Nkruddho rAkShasastasyA bhaginyAH kurusattama |
utphAlya vipule netre tatastAmidamabravIt
shlokas.17:
ko hi me bhoktukAmasya vighnaM charati durmatiH |
na bibheShi hiDimbe kiM matkopAdvipramohitA
shlokas.18:
dhiktvAmasati pu.nskAme mama vipriyakAriNi |
pUrveShAM rAkShasendrANAM sarveShAmayashaskari
shlokas.19:
yAnimAnAshritAkArShIrapriyaM sumahanmama |
eSha tAnadya vai sarvAnhaniShyAmi tvayA saha
shlokas.20:
evamuktvA hiDimbAM sa hiDimbo lohitekShaNaH |
vadhAyAbhipapAtainAM dantairdantAnupaspRRishan
shlokas.21:
tamApatantaM samprekShya bhImaH praharatAM varaH |
bhartsayAmAsa tejasvI tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bhImasenastu taM dRRiShTvA rAkShasaM prahasanniva |
bhaginIM prati sa~NkruddhamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
kiM te hiDimba etairvA sukhasuptaiH prabodhitaiH |
mAmAsAdaya durbuddhe tarasA tvaM narAshana
shlokas.3:
mayyeva praharaihi tvaM na striyaM hantumarhasi |
visheShato.anapakRRite pareNApakRRite sati
shlokas.4:
na hIyaM svavashA bAlA kAmayatyadya mAmiha |
choditaiShA hyana~Ngena sharIrAntarachAriNA
bhaginI tava durbuddhe rAkShasAnAM yashohara
shlokas.5:
tvanniyogena chaiveyaM rUpaM mama samIkShya cha |
kAmayatyadya mAM bhIrurnaiShA dUShayate kulam
shlokas.6:
ana~Ngena kRRite doShe nemAM tvamiha rAkShasa |
mayi tiShThati duShTAtmanna striyaM hantumarhasi
shlokas.7:
samAgachCha mayA sArdhamekenaiko narAshana |
ahameva nayiShyAmi tvAmadya yamasAdanam
shlokas.8:
adya te talaniShpiShTaM shiro rAkShasa dIryatAm |
ku~njarasyeva pAdena viniShpiShTaM balIyasaH
shlokas.9:
adya gAtrANi kravyAdAH shyenA gomAyavashcha te |
karShantu bhuvi saMhRRiShTA nihatasya mayA mRRidhe
shlokas.10:
kShaNenAdya kariShye.ahamidaM vanamakaNTakam |
purastAddUShitaM nityaM tvayA bhakShayatA narAn
shlokas.11:
adya tvAM bhaginI pApa kRRiShyamANaM mayA bhuvi |
drakShatyadripratIkAshaM siMheneva mahAdvipam
shlokas.12:
nirAbAdhAstvayi hate mayA rAkShasapA.nsana |
vanametachchariShyanti puruShA vanachAriNaH
shlokas.13:
hiDimba uvAcha||
garjitena vRRithA kiM te katthitena cha mAnuSha |
kRRitvaitatkarmaNA sarvaM katthethA mA chiraM kRRithAH
shlokas.14:
balinaM manyase yachcha AtmAnamaparAkramam |
j~nAsyasyadya samAgamya mayAtmAnaM balAdhikam
shlokas.15:
na tAvadetAnhi.nsiShye svapantvete yathAsukham |
eSha tvAmeva durbuddhe nihanmyadyApriya.nvadam
shlokas.16:
pItvA tavAsRRiggAtrebhyastataH pashchAdimAnapi |
haniShyAmi tataH pashchAdimAM vipriyakAriNIm
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA tato bAhuM pragRRihya puruShAdakaH |
abhyadhAvata sa~Nkruddho bhImasenamari.ndamam
shlokas.18:
tasyAbhipatatastUrNaM bhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
vegena prahRRitaM bAhuM nijagrAha hasanniva
shlokas.19:
nigRRihya taM balAdbhImo visphurantaM chakarSha ha |
tasmAddeshAddhanUMShyaShTau siMhaH kShudramRRigaM yathA
shlokas.20:
tataH sa rAkShasaH kruddhaH pANDavena balAddhRRitaH |
bhImasenaM samAli~Ngya vyanadadbhairavaM ravam
shlokas.21:
punarbhImo balAdenaM vichakarSha mahAbalaH |
mA shabdaH sukhasuptAnAM bhrAtRRiNAM me bhavediti
shlokas.22:
anyonyaM tau samAsAdya vichakarShaturojasA |
rAkShaso bhImasenashcha vikramaM chakratuH param
shlokas.23:
babha~njaturmahAvRRikShA.NllatAshchAkarShatustataH |
mattAviva susa.nrabdhau vAraNau ShaShTihAyanau
shlokas.24:
tayoH shabdena mahatA vibuddhAste nararShabhAH |
saha mAtrA tu dadRRishurhiDimbAmagrataH sthitAm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
prabuddhAste hiDimbAyA rUpaM dRRiShTvAtimAnuSham |
vismitAH puruShavyAghrA babhUvuH pRRithayA saha
shlokas.2:
tataH kuntI samIkShyainAM vismitA rUpasampadA |
uvAcha madhuraM vAkyaM sAntvapUrvamidaM shanaiH
shlokas.3:
kasya tvaM suragarbhAbhe kA chAsi varavarNini |
kena kAryeNa sushroNi kutashchAgamanaM tava
shlokas.4:
yadi vAsya vanasyAsi devatA yadi vApsarAH |
AchakShva mama tatsarvaM kimarthaM cheha tiShThasi
shlokas.5:
hiDimbovAcha||
yadetatpashyasi vanaM nIlameghanibhaM mahat |
nivAso rAkShasasyaitaddhiDimbasya mamaiva cha
shlokas.6:
tasya mAM rAkShasendrasya bhaginIM viddhi bhAmini |
bhrAtrA sampreShitAmArye tvAM saputrAM jighA.nsatA
shlokas.7:
krUrabuddherahaM tasya vachanAdAgatA iha |
adrAkShaM hemavarNAbhaM tava putraM mahaujasam
shlokas.8:
tato.ahaM sarvabhUtAnAM bhAve vicharatA shubhe |
choditA tava putrasya manmathena vashAnugA
shlokas.9:
tato vRRito mayA bhartA tava putro mahAbalaH |
apanetuM cha yatito na chaiva shakito mayA
shlokas.10:
chirAyamANAM mAM j~nAtvA tataH sa puruShAdakaH |
svayamevAgato hantumimAnsarvA.nstavAtmajAn
shlokas.11:
sa tena mama kAntena tava putreNa dhImatA |
balAdito viniShpiShya vyapakRRiShTo mahAtmanA
shlokas.12:
vikarShantau mahAvegau garjamAnau parasparam |
pashyadhvaM yudhi vikrAntAvetau tau nararAkShasau
shlokas.13:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasyAH shrutvaiva vachanamutpapAta yudhiShThiraH |
arjuno nakulashchaiva sahadevashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.14:
tau te dadRRishurAsaktau vikarShantau parasparam |
kA~NkShamANau jayaM chaiva siMhAviva raNotkaTau
shlokas.15:
tAvanyonyaM samAshliShya vikarShantau parasparam |
dAvAgnidhUmasadRRishaM chakratuH pArthivaM rajaH
shlokas.16:
vasudhAreNusa.nvItau vasudhAdharasaMnibhau |
vibhrAjetAM yathA shailau nIhAreNAbhisa.nvRRitau
shlokas.17:
rAkShasena tathA bhImaM klishyamAnaM nirIkShya tu |
uvAchedaM vachaH pArthaH prahasa~nshanakairiva
shlokas.18:
bhIma mA bhairmahAbAho na tvAM budhyAmahe vayam |
sametaM bhImarUpeNa prasuptAH shramakarshitAH
shlokas.19:
sAhAyye.asmi sthitaH pArtha yodhayiShyAmi rAkShasam |
nakulaH sahadevashcha mAtaraM gopayiShyataH
shlokas.20:
bhIma uvAcha||
udAsIno nirIkShasva na kAryaH sambhramastvayA |
na jAtvayaM punarjIvenmadbAhvantaramAgataH
shlokas.21:
arjuna uvAcha||
kimanena chiraM bhIma jIvatA pAparakShasA |
gantavyaM na chiraM sthAtumiha shakyamari.ndama
shlokas.22:
purA sa.nrajyate prAchI purA sandhyA pravartate |
raudre muhUrte rakShA.nsi prabalAni bhavanti cha
shlokas.23:
tvarasva bhIma mA krIDa jahi rakSho vibhIShaNam |
purA vikurute mAyAM bhujayoH sAramarpaya
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
arjunenaivamuktastu bhImo bhImasya rakShasaH |
utkShipyAbhrAmayaddehaM tUrNaM guNashatAdhikam
shlokas.25:
bhIma uvAcha||
vRRithAmA.nsairvRRithA puShTo vRRithA vRRiddho vRRithAmatiH |
vRRithAmaraNamarhastvaM vRRithAdya na bhaviShyasi
shlokas.26:
arjuna uvAcha||
atha vA manyase bhAraM tvamimaM rAkShasaM yudhi |
karomi tava sAhAyyaM shIghrameva nihanyatAm
shlokas.27:
atha vApyahamevainaM haniShyAmi vRRikodara |
kRRitakarmA parishrAntaH sAdhu tAvadupArama
shlokas.28:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA bhImaseno.atyamarShaNaH |
niShpiShyainaM balAdbhUmau pashumAramamArayat
shlokas.29:
sa mAryamANo bhImena nanAda vipulaM svanam |
pUraya.nstadvanaM sarvaM jalArdra iva dundubhiH
shlokas.30:
bhujAbhyAM yoktrayitvA taM balavAnpANDunandanaH |
madhye bha~NktvA sa balavAnharShayAmAsa pANDavAn
shlokas.31:
hiDimbaM nihataM dRRiShTvA saMhRRiShTAste tarasvinaH |
apUjayannaravyAghraM bhImasenamari.ndamam
shlokas.32:
abhipUjya mahAtmAnaM bhImaM bhImaparAkramam |
punarevArjuno vAkyamuvAchedaM vRRikodaram
shlokas.33:
nadUre nagaraM manye vanAdasmAdahaM prabho |
shIghraM gachChAma bhadraM te na no vidyAtsuyodhanaH
shlokas.34:
tataH sarve tathetyuktvA saha mAtrA parantapAH |
prayayuH puruShavyAghrA hiDimbA chaiva rAkShasI

shlokas.1:
bhIma uvAcha||
smaranti vairaM rakShA.nsi mAyAmAshritya mohinIm |
hiDimbe vraja panthAnaM tvaM vai bhrAtRRiniShevitam
shlokas.2:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kruddho.api puruShavyAghra bhIma mA sma striyaM vadhIH |
sharIraguptyAbhyadhikaM dharmaM gopaya pANDava
shlokas.3:
vadhAbhiprAyamAyAntamavadhIstvaM mahAbalam |
rakShasastasya bhaginI kiM naH kruddhA kariShyati
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
hiDimbA tu tataH kuntImabhivAdya kRRitA~njaliH |
yudhiShThiraM cha kaunteyamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.5:
Arye jAnAsi yadduHkhamiha strINAmana~Ngajam |
tadidaM mAmanuprAptaM bhImasenakRRitaM shubhe
shlokas.6:
soDhaM tatparamaM duHkhaM mayA kAlapratIkShayA |
so.ayamabhyAgataH kAlo bhavitA me sukhAya vai
shlokas.7:
mayA hyutsRRijya suhRRidaH svadharmaM svajanaM tathA |
vRRito.ayaM puruShavyAghrastava putraH patiH shubhe
shlokas.8:
vareNApi tathAnena tvayA chApi yashasvini |
tathA bruvantI hi tadA pratyAkhyAtA kriyAM prati
shlokas.9:
tvaM mAM mUDheti vA matvA bhaktA vAnugateti vA |
bhartrAnena mahAbhAge sa.nyojaya sutena te
shlokas.10:
tamupAdAya gachCheyaM yatheShTaM devarUpiNam |
punashchaivAgamiShyAmi vishrambhaM kuru me shubhe
shlokas.11:
ahaM hi manasA dhyAtA sarvAnneShyAmi vaH sadA |
vRRijine tArayiShyAmi durgeShu cha nararShabhAn
shlokas.12:
pRRiShThena vo vahiShyAmi shIghrAM gatimabhIpsataH |
yUyaM prasAdaM kuruta bhImaseno bhajeta mAm
shlokas.13:
ApadastaraNe prANAndhArayedyena yena hi |
sarvamAdRRitya kartavyaM taddharmamanuvartatA
shlokas.14:
Apatsu yo dhArayati dhramaM dharmaviduttamaH |
vyasanaM hyeva dharmasya dharmiNAmApaduchyate
shlokas.15:
puNyaM prANAndhArayati puNyaM prANadamuchyate |
yena yenAchareddharmaM tasmingarhA na vidyate
shlokas.16:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
evametadyathAttha tvaM hiDimbe nAtra sa.nshayaH |
sthAtavyaM tu tvayA dharme yathA brUyAM sumadhyame
shlokas.17:
snAtaM kRRitAhnikaM bhadre kRRitakautukama~Ngalam |
bhImasenaM bhajethAstvaM prAgastagamanAdraveH
shlokas.18:
ahaHsu viharAnena yathAkAmaM manojavA |
ayaM tvAnayitavyaste bhImasenaH sadA nishi
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatheti tatpratij~nAya hiDimbA rAkShasI tadA |
bhImasenamupAdAya UrdhvamAchakrame tataH
shlokas.20:
shailashRRi~NgeShu ramyeShu devatAyataneShu cha |
mRRigapakShivighuShTeShu ramaNIyeShu sarvadA
shlokas.21:
kRRitvA cha paramaM rUpaM sarvAbharaNabhUShitA |
sa~njalpantI sumadhuraM ramayAmAsa pANDavam
shlokas.22:
tathaiva vanadurgeShu puShpitadrumasAnuShu |
saraHsu ramaNIyeShu padmotpalayuteShu cha
shlokas.23:
nadIdvIpapradesheShu vaiDUryasikatAsu cha |
sutIrthavanatoyAsu tathA girinadIShu cha
shlokas.24:
sagarasya pradesheShu maNihemachiteShu cha |
pattaneShu cha ramyeShu mahAshAlavaneShu cha
shlokas.25:
devAraNyeShu puNyeShu tathA parvatasAnuShu |
guhyakAnAM nivAseShu tApasAyataneShu cha
shlokas.26:
sarvartuphalapuShpeShu mAnaseShu saraHsu cha |
bibhratI paramaM rUpaM ramayAmAsa pANDavam
shlokas.27:
ramayantI tathA bhImaM tatra tatra manojavA |
prajaj~ne rAkShasI putraM bhImasenAnmahAbalam
shlokas.28:
virUpAkShaM mahAvaktraM sha~NkukarNaM vibhIShaNam |
bhImarUpaM sutAmroShThaM tIkShNadaMShTraM mahAbalam
shlokas.29:
maheShvAsaM mahAvIryaM mahAsattvaM mahAbhujam |
mahAjavaM mahAkAyaM mahAmAyamari.ndamam
shlokas.30:
amAnuShaM mAnuShajaM bhImavegaM mahAbalam |
yaH pishAchAnatIvAnyAnbabhUvAti sa mAnuShAn
shlokas.31:
bAlo.api yauvanaM prApto mAnuSheShu vishAM pate |
sarvAstreShu paraM vIraH prakarShamagamadbalI
shlokas.32:
sadyo hi garbhaM rAkShasyo labhante prasavanti cha |
kAmarUpadharAshchaiva bhavanti bahurUpiNaH
shlokas.33:
praNamya vikachaH pAdAvagRRihNAtsa pitustadA |
mAtushcha parameShvAsastau cha nAmAsya chakratuH
shlokas.34:
ghaTabhAsotkacha iti mAtaraM so.abhyabhAShata |
abhavattena nAmAsya ghaTotkacha iti sma ha
shlokas.35:
anuraktashcha tAnAsItpANDavAnsa ghaTotkachaH |
teShAM cha dayito nityamAtmabhUto babhUva saH
shlokas.36:
sa.nvAsasamayo jIrNa ityabhAShata taM tataH |
hiDimbA samayaM kRRitvA svAM gatiM pratyapadyata
shlokas.37:
kRRityakAla upasthAsye pitRRiniti ghaTotkachaH |
Amantrya rAkShasashreShThaH pratasthe chottarAM disham
shlokas.38:
sa hi sRRiShTo maghavatA shaktihetormahAtmanA |
karNasyAprativIryasya vinAshAya mahAtmanaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te vanena vanaM vIrA ghnanto mRRigagaNAnbahUn |
apakramya yayU rAja.nstvaramANA mahArathAH
shlokas.2:
matsyA.nstrigartAnpA~nchAlAnkIchakAnantareNa cha |
ramaNIyAnvanoddeshAnprekShamANAH sarA.nsi cha
shlokas.3:
jaTAH kRRitvAtmanaH sarve valkalAjinavAsasaH |
saha kuntyA mahAtmAno bibhratastApasaM vapuH
shlokas.4:
kvachidvahanto jananIM tvaramANA mahArathAH |
kvachichChandena gachChantaste jagmuH prasabhaM punaH
shlokas.5:
brAhmaM vedamadhIyAnA vedA~NgAni cha sarvashaH |
nItishAstraM cha dharmaj~nA dadRRishuste pitAmaham
shlokas.6:
te.abhivAdya mahAtmAnaM kRRiShNadvaipAyanaM tadA |
tasthuH prA~njalayaH sarve saha mAtrA parantapAH
shlokas.7:
vyAsa uvAcha||
mayedaM manasA pUrvaM viditaM bharatarShabhAH |
yathA sthitairadharmeNa dhArtarAShTrairvivAsitAH
shlokas.8:
tadviditvAsmi samprAptashchikIrShuH paramaM hitam |
na viShAdo.atra kartavyaH sarvametatsukhAya vaH
shlokas.9:
samAste chaiva me sarve yUyaM chaiva na sa.nshayaH |
dInato bAlatashchaiva snehaM kurvanti bAndhavAH
shlokas.10:
tasmAdabhyadhikaH sneho yuShmAsu mama sAmpratam |
snehapUrvaM chikIrShAmi hitaM vastannibodhata
shlokas.11:
idaM nagaramabhyAshe ramaNIyaM nirAmayam |
vasateha pratichChannA mamAgamanakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.12:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM sa tAnsamAshvAsya vyAsaH pArthAnari.ndamAn |
ekachakrAmabhigataH kuntImAshvAsayatprabhuH
shlokas.13:
jIvaputri sutaste.ayaM dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
pRRithivyAM pArthivAnsarvAnprashAsiShyati dharmarAT
shlokas.14:
dharmeNa jitvA pRRithivImakhilAM dharmavidvashI |
bhImasenArjunabalAdbhokShyatyayamasa.nshayaH
shlokas.15:
putrAstava cha mAdryAshcha sarva eva mahArathAH |
svarAShTre vihariShyanti sukhaM sumanasastadA
shlokas.16:
yakShyanti cha naravyAghrA vijitya pRRithivImimAm |
rAjasUyAshvamedhAdyaiH kratubhirbhUridakShiNaiH
shlokas.17:
anugRRihya suhRRidvargaM dhanena cha sukhena cha |
pitRRipaitAmahaM rAjyamiha bhokShyanti te sutAH
shlokas.18:
evamuktvA niveshyainAnbrAhmaNasya niveshane |
abravItpArthivashreShThamRRiShirdvaipAyanastadA
shlokas.19:
iha mAM sampratIkShadhvamAgamiShyAmyahaM punaH |
deshakAlau viditvaiva vetsyadhvaM paramAM mudam
shlokas.20:
sa taiH prA~njalibhiH sarvaistathetyukto narAdhipa |
jagAma bhagavAnvyAso yathAkAmamRRiShiH prabhuH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
ekachakrAM gatAste tu kuntIputrA mahArathAH |
ataH paraM dvijashreShTha kimakurvata pANDavAH
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ekachakrAM gatAste tu kuntIputrA mahArathAH |
UShurnAtichiraM kAlaM brAhmaNasya niveshane
shlokas.3:
ramaNIyAni pashyanto vanAni vividhAni cha |
pArthivAnapi choddeshAnsaritashcha sarA.nsi cha
shlokas.4:
cherurbhaikShaM tadA te tu sarva eva vishAM pate |
babhUvurnAgarANAM cha svairguNaiH priyadarshanAH
shlokas.5:
nivedayanti sma cha te bhaikShaM kuntyAH sadA nishi |
tayA vibhaktAnbhAgA.nste bhu~njate sma pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.6:
ardhaM te bhu~njate vIrAH saha mAtrA parantapAH |
ardhaM bhaikShasya sarvasya bhImo bhu~Nkte mahAbalaH
shlokas.7:
tathA tu teShAM vasatAM tatra rAjanmahAtmanAm |
atichakrAma sumahAnkAlo.atha bharatarShabha
shlokas.8:
tataH kadAchidbhaikShAya gatAste bharatarShabhAH |
sa~NgatyA bhImasenastu tatrAste pRRithayA saha
shlokas.9:
athArtijaM mahAshabdaM brAhmaNasya niveshane |
bhRRishamutpatitaM ghoraM kuntI shushrAva bhArata
shlokas.10:
rorUyamANA.nstAnsarvAnparidevayatashcha sA |
kAruNyAtsAdhubhAvAchcha devI rAjanna chakShame
shlokas.11:
mathyamAneva duHkhena hRRidayena pRRithA tataH |
uvAcha bhImaM kalyANI kRRipAnvitamidaM vachaH
shlokas.12:
vasAmaH susukhaM putra brAhmaNasya niveshane |
aj~nAtA dhArtarAShTrANAM satkRRitA vItamanyavaH
shlokas.13:
sA chintaye sadA putra brAhmaNasyAsya kiM nvaham |
priyaM kuryAmiti gRRihe yatkuryuruShitAH sukham
shlokas.14:
etAvAnpuruShastAta kRRitaM yasminna nashyati |
yAvachcha kuryAdanyo.asya kuryAdabhyadhikaM tataH
shlokas.15:
tadidaM brAhmaNasyAsya duHkhamApatitaM dhruvam |
tatrAsya yadi sAhAyyaM kuryAma sukRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.16:
bhIma uvAcha||
j~nAyatAmasya yadduHkhaM yatashchaiva samutthitam |
vidite vyavasiShyAmi yadyapi syAtsuduShkaram
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA hi kathayantau tau bhUyaH shushruvatuH svanam |
ArtijaM tasya viprasya sabhAryasya vishAM pate
shlokas.18:
antaHpuraM tatastasya brAhmaNasya mahAtmanaH |
vivesha kuntI tvaritA baddhavatseva saurabhI
shlokas.19:
tatastaM brAhmaNaM tatra bhAryayA cha sutena cha |
duhitrA chaiva sahitaM dadarsha vikRRitAnanam
shlokas.20:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
dhigidaM jIvitaM loke.analasAramanarthakam |
duHkhamUlaM parAdhInaM bhRRishamapriyabhAgi cha
shlokas.21:
jIvite paramaM duHkhaM jIvite paramo jvaraH |
jIvite vartamAnasya dvandvAnAmAgamo dhruvaH
shlokas.22:
ekAtmApi hi dharmArthau kAmaM cha na niShevate |
etaishcha viprayogo.api duHkhaM paramakaM matam
shlokas.23:
AhuH kechitparaM mokShaM sa cha nAsti katha~nchana |
arthaprAptau cha narakaH kRRitsna evopapadyate
shlokas.24:
arthepsutA paraM duHkhamarthaprAptau tato.adhikam |
jAtasnehasya chArtheShu viprayoge mahattaram
shlokas.25:
na hi yogaM prapashyAmi yena muchyeyamApadaH |
putradAreNa vA sArdhaM prAdraveyAmanAmayam
shlokas.26:
yatitaM vai mayA pUrvaM yathA tvaM vettha brAhmaNi |
yataH kShemaM tato gantuM tvayA tu mama na shrutam
shlokas.27:
iha jAtA vivRRiddhAsmi pitA cheha mameti cha |
uktavatyasi durmedhe yAchyamAnA mayAsakRRit
shlokas.28:
svargato hi pitA vRRiddhastathA mAtA chiraM tava |
bAndhavA bhUtapUrvAshcha tatra vAse tu kA ratiH
shlokas.29:
so.ayaM te bandhukAmAyA ashRRiNvantyA vacho mama |
bandhupraNAshaH samprApto bhRRishaM duHkhakaro mama
shlokas.30:
athavA madvinAsho.ayaM na hi shakShyAmi ka~nchana |
parityaktumahaM bandhuM svayaM jIvannRRisha.nsavat
shlokas.31:
sahadharmacharIM dAntAM nityaM mAtRRisamAM mama |
sakhAyaM vihitAM devairnityaM paramikAM gatim
shlokas.32:
mAtrA pitrA cha vihitAM sadA gArhasthyabhAginIm |
varayitvA yathAnyAyaM mantravatpariNIya cha
shlokas.33:
kulInAM shIlasampannAmapatyajananIM mama |
tvAmahaM jIvitasyArthe sAdhvImanapakAriNIm
parityaktuM na shakShyAmi bhAryAM nityamanuvratAm
shlokas.34:
kuta eva parityaktuM sutAM shakShyAmyahaM svayam |
bAlAmaprAptavayasamajAtavya~njanAkRRitim
shlokas.35:
bharturarthAya nikShiptAM nyAsaM dhAtrA mahAtmanA |
yasyAM dauhitrajA.NllokAnAsha.nse pitRRibhiH saha
svayamutpAdya tAM bAlAM kathamutsraShTumutsahe
shlokas.36:
manyante kechidadhikaM snehaM putre piturnarAH |
kanyAyAM naiva tu punarmama tulyAvubhau matau
shlokas.37:
yasmi.NllokAH prasUtishcha sthitA nityamatho sukham |
apApAM tAmahaM bAlAM kathamutsraShTumutsahe
shlokas.38:
AtmAnamapi chotsRRijya tapsye pretavashaM gataH |
tyaktA hyete mayA vyaktaM neha shakShyanti jIvitum
shlokas.39:
eShAM chAnyatamatyAgo nRRisha.nso garhito budhaiH |
AtmatyAge kRRite cheme mariShyanti mayA vinA
shlokas.40:
sa kRRichChrAmahamApanno na shaktastartumApadam |
aho dhikkAM gatiM tvadya gamiShyAmi sabAndhavaH
sarvaiH saha mRRitaM shreyo na tu me jIvitaM kShamam

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNyuvAcha||
na santApastvayA kAryaH prAkRRiteneva karhichit |
na hi santApakAlo.ayaM vaidyasya tava vidyate
shlokas.2:
avashyaM nidhanaM sarvairgantavyamiha mAnavaiH |
avashyabhAvinyarthe vai santApo neha vidyate
shlokas.3:
bhAryA putro.atha duhitA sarvamAtmArthamiShyate |
vyathAM jahi subuddhyA tvaM svayaM yAsyAmi tatra vai
shlokas.4:
etaddhi paramaM nAryAH kAryaM loke sanAtanam |
prANAnapi parityajya yadbhartRRihitamAcharet
shlokas.5:
tachcha tatra kRRitaM karma tavApIha sukhAvaham |
bhavatyamutra chAkShayyaM loke.asmi.nshcha yashaskaram
shlokas.6:
eSha chaiva gururdharmo yaM pravakShAmyahaM tava |
arthashcha tava dharmashcha bhUyAnatra pradRRishyate
shlokas.7:
yadarthamiShyate bhAryA prAptaH so.arthastvayA mayi |
kanyA chaiva kumArashcha kRRitAhamanRRiNA tvayA
shlokas.8:
samarthaH poShaNe chAsi sutayo rakShaNe tathA |
na tvahaM sutayoH shaktA tathA rakShaNapoShaNe
shlokas.9:
mama hi tvadvihInAyAH sarvakAmA na ApadaH |
kathaM syAtAM sutau bAlau bhaveyaM cha kathaM tvaham
shlokas.10:
kathaM hi vidhavAnAthA bAlaputrA vinA tvayA |
mithunaM jIvayiShyAmi sthitA sAdhugate pathi
shlokas.11:
aha~NkRRitAvaliptaishcha prArthyamAnAmimAM sutAm |
ayuktaistava sambandhe kathaM shakShyAmi rakShitum
shlokas.12:
utsRRiShTamAmiShaM bhUmau prArthayanti yathA khagAH |
prArthayanti janAH sarve vIrahInAM tathA striyam
shlokas.13:
sAhaM vichAlyamAnA vai prArthyamAnA durAtmabhiH |
sthAtuM pathi na shakShyAmi sajjaneShTe dvijottama
shlokas.14:
kathaM tava kulasyaikAmimAM bAlAmasa.nskRRitAm |
pitRRipaitAmahe mArge niyoktumahamutsahe
shlokas.15:
kathaM shakShyAmi bAle.asminguNAnAdhAtumIpShitAn |
anAthe sarvato lupte yathA tvaM dharmadarshivAn
shlokas.16:
imAmapi cha te bAlAmanAthAM paribhUya mAm |
anarhAH prArthayiShyanti shUdrA vedashrutiM yathA
shlokas.17:
tAM chedahaM na ditseyaM tvadguNairupabRRiMhitAm |
pramathyainAM hareyuste havirdhvA~NkShA ivAdhvarAt
shlokas.18:
samprekShamANA putraM te nAnurUpamivAtmanaH |
anarhavashamApannAmimAM chApi sutAM tava
shlokas.19:
avaj~nAtA cha lokasya tathAtmAnamajAnatI |
avaliptairnarairbrahmanmariShyAmi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.20:
tau vihInau mayA bAlau tvayA chaiva mamAtmajau |
vinashyetAM na sa.ndeho matsyAviva jalakShaye
shlokas.21:
tritayaM sarvathApyevaM vinashiShyatyasa.nshayam |
tvayA vihInaM tasmAttvaM mAM parityaktumarhasi
shlokas.22:
vyuShTireShA parA strINAM pUrvaM bhartuH parA gatiH |
na tu brAhmaNa putrANAM viShaye parivartitum
shlokas.23:
parityaktaH sutashchAyaM duhiteyaM tathA mayA |
bAndhavAshcha parityaktAstvadarthaM jIvitaM cha me
shlokas.24:
yaj~naistapobhirniyamairdAnaishcha vividhaistathA |
vishiShyate striyA bharturnityaM priyahite sthitiH
shlokas.25:
tadidaM yachchikIrShAmi dharmyaM paramasaMmatam |
iShTaM chaiva hitaM chaiva tava chaiva kulasya cha
shlokas.26:
iShTAni chApyapatyAni dravyANi suhRRidaH priyAH |
ApaddharmavimokShAya bhAryA chApi satAM matam
shlokas.27:
ekato vA kulaM kRRitsnamAtmA vA kulavardhana |
na samaM sarvameveti budhAnAmeSha nishchayaH
shlokas.28:
sa kuruShva mayA kAryaM tArayAtmAnamAtmanA |
anujAnIhi mAmArya sutau me parirakSha cha
shlokas.29:
avadhyAH striya ityAhurdharmaj~nA dharmanishchaye |
dharmaj~nAnrAkShasAnAhurna hanyAtsa cha mAmapi
shlokas.30:
niHsa.nshayo vadhaH pu.nsAM strINAM sa.nshayito vadhaH |
ato mAmeva dharmaj~na prasthApayitumarhasi
shlokas.31:
bhuktaM priyANyavAptAni dharmashcha charito mayA |
tvatprasUtiH priyA prAptA na mAM tapsyatyajIvitam
shlokas.32:
jAtaputrA cha vRRiddhA cha priyakAmA cha te sadA |
samIkShyaitadahaM sarvaM vyavasAyaM karomyataH
shlokas.33:
utsRRijyApi cha mAmArya vetsyasyanyAmapi striyam |
tataH pratiShThito dharmo bhaviShyati punastava
shlokas.34:
na chApyadharmaH kalyANa bahupatnIkatA nRRiNAm |
strINAmadharmaH sumahAnbhartuH pUrvasya la~Nghane
shlokas.35:
etatsarvaM samIkShya tvamAtmatyAgaM cha garhitam |
AtmAnaM tAraya mayA kulaM chemau cha dArakau
shlokas.36:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastayA bhartA tAM samAli~Ngya bhArata |
mumocha bAShpaM shanakaiH sabhAryo bhRRishaduHkhitaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tayorduHkhitayorvAkyamatimAtraM nishamya tat |
bhRRishaM duHkhaparItA~NgI kanyA tAvabhyabhAShata
shlokas.2:
kimidaM bhRRishaduHkhArtau roravItho anAthavat |
mamApi shrUyatAM ki~nchichChrutvA cha kriyatAM kShamam
shlokas.3:
dharmato.ahaM parityAjyA yuvayornAtra sa.nshayaH |
tyaktavyAM mAM parityajya trAtaM sarvaM mayaikayA
shlokas.4:
ityarthamiShyate.apatyaM tArayiShyati mAmiti |
tasminnupasthite kAle tarataM plavavanmayA
shlokas.5:
iha vA tArayeddurgAduta vA pretya tArayet |
sarvathA tArayetputraH putra ityuchyate budhaiH
shlokas.6:
AkA~NkShante cha dauhitrAnapi nityaM pitAmahAH |
tAnsvayaM vai paritrAsye rakShantI jIvitaM pituH
shlokas.7:
bhrAtA cha mama bAlo.ayaM gate lokamamuM tvayi |
achireNaiva kAlena vinashyeta na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.8:
tAte.api hi gate svargaM vinaShTe cha mamAnuje |
piNDaH pitRRiNAM vyuchChidyettatteShAmapriyaM bhavet
shlokas.9:
pitrA tyaktA tathA mAtrA bhrAtrA chAhamasa.nshayam |
duHkhAdduHkhataraM prApya mriyeyamatathochitA
shlokas.10:
tvayi tvaroge nirmukte mAtA bhrAtA cha me shishuH |
santAnashchaiva piNDashcha pratiShThAsyatyasa.nshayam
shlokas.11:
AtmA putraH sakhA bhAryA kRRichChraM tu duhitA kila |
sa kRRichChrAnmochayAtmAnaM mAM cha dharmeNa yojaya
shlokas.12:
anAthA kRRipaNA bAlA yatrakvachanagAminI |
bhaviShyAmi tvayA tAta vihInA kRRipaNA bata
shlokas.13:
athavAhaM kariShyAmi kulasyAsya vimokShaNam |
phalasa.nsthA bhaviShyAmi kRRitvA karma suduShkaram
shlokas.14:
athavA yAsyase tatra tyaktvA mAM dvijasattama |
pIDitAhaM bhaviShyAmi tadavekShasva mAmapi
shlokas.15:
tadasmadarthaM dharmArthaM prasavArthaM cha sattama |
AtmAnaM parirakShasva tyaktavyAM mAM cha santyaja
shlokas.16:
avashyakaraNIye.arthe mA tvAM kAlo.atyagAdayam |
tvayA dattena toyena bhaviShyati hitaM cha me
shlokas.17:
kiM nvataH paramaM duHkhaM yadvayaM svargate tvayi |
yAchamAnAH parAdannaM paridhAvemahi shvavat
shlokas.18:
tvayi tvaroge nirmukte kleshAdasmAtsabAndhave |
amRRite vasatI loke bhaviShyAmi sukhAnvitA
shlokas.19:
evaM bahuvidhaM tasyA nishamya paridevitam |
pitA mAtA cha sA chaiva kanyA prarurudustrayaH
shlokas.20:
tataH praruditAnsarvAnnishamyAtha sutastayoH |
utphullanayano bAlaH kalamavyaktamabravIt
shlokas.21:
mA rodIstAta mA mAtarmA svasastvamiti bruvan |
prahasanniva sarvA.nstAnekaikaM so.apasarpati
shlokas.22:
tataH sa tRRiNamAdAya prahRRiShTaH punarabravIt |
anena taM haniShyAmi rAkShasaM puruShAdakam
shlokas.23:
tathApi teShAM duHkhena parItAnAM nishamya tat |
bAlasya vAkyamavyaktaM harShaH samabhavanmahAn
shlokas.24:
ayaM kAla iti j~nAtvA kuntI samupasRRitya tAn |
gatAsUnamRRiteneva jIvayantIdamabravIt

shlokas.1:
kuntyuvAcha||
kutomUlamidaM duHkhaM j~nAtumichChAmi tattvataH |
viditvA apakarSheyaM shakyaM chedapakarShitum
shlokas.2:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
upapannaM satAmetadyadbravIShi tapodhane |
na tu duHkhamidaM shakyaM mAnuSheNa vyapohitum
shlokas.3:
samIpe nagarasyAsya bako vasati rAkShasaH |
Isho janapadasyAsya purasya cha mahAbalaH
shlokas.4:
puShTo mAnuShamA.nsena durbuddhiH puruShAdakaH |
rakShatyasurarANnityamimaM janapadaM balI
shlokas.5:
nagaraM chaiva deshaM cha rakShobalasamanvitaH |
tatkRRite parachakrAchcha bhUtebhyashcha na no bhayam
shlokas.6:
vetanaM tasya vihitaM shAlivAhasya bhojanam |
mahiShau puruShashchaiko yastadAdAya gachChati
shlokas.7:
ekaikashchaiva puruShastatprayachChati bhojanam |
sa vAro bahubhirvarShairbhavatyasutaro naraiH
shlokas.8:
tadvimokShAya ye chApi yatante puruShAH kvachit |
saputradArA.nstAnhatvA tadrakSho bhakShayatyuta
shlokas.9:
vetrakIyagRRihe rAjA nAyaM nayamihAsthitaH |
anAmayaM janasyAsya yena syAdadya shAshvatam
shlokas.10:
etadarhA vayaM nUnaM vasAmo durbalasya ye |
viShaye nityamudvignAH kurAjAnamupAshritAH
shlokas.11:
brAhmaNAH kasya vaktavyAH kasya vA ChandachAriNaH |
guNairete hi vAsyante kAmagAH pakShiNo yathA
shlokas.12:
rAjAnaM prathamaM vindettato bhAryAM tato dhanam |
trayasya sa~nchaye chAsya j~nAtInputrA.nshcha dhArayet
shlokas.13:
viparItaM mayA chedaM trayaM sarvamupArjitam |
ta imAmApadaM prApya bhRRishaM tapsyAmahe vayam
shlokas.14:
so.ayamasmAnanuprApto vAraH kulavinAshanaH |
bhojanaM puruShashchaikaH pradeyaM vetanaM mayA
shlokas.15:
na cha me vidyate vittaM sa~NkretuM puruShaM kvachit |
suhRRijjanaM pradAtuM cha na shakShyAmi katha~nchana
gatiM chApi na pashyAmi tasmAnmokShAya rakShasaH
shlokas.16:
so.ahaM duHkhArNave magno mahatyasutare bhRRisham |
sahaivaitairgamiShyAmi bAndhavairadya rAkShasam
tato naH sahitankShudraH sarvAnevopabhokShyati

shlokas.1:
kuntyuvAcha||
na viShAdastvayA kAryo bhayAdasmAtkatha~nchana |
upAyaH paridRRiShTo.atra tasmAnmokShAya rakShasaH
shlokas.2:
ekastava suto bAlaH kanyA chaikA tapasvinI |
na te tayostathA patnyA gamanaM tatra rochaye
shlokas.3:
mama pa~ncha sutA brahma.nsteShAmeko gamiShyati |
tvadarthaM balimAdAya tasya pApasya rakShasaH
shlokas.4:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
nAhametatkariShyAmi jIvitArthI katha~nchana |
brAhmaNasyAtitheshchaiva svArthe prANairviyojanam
shlokas.5:
na tvetadakulInAsu nAdharmiShThAsu vidyate |
yadbrAhmaNArthe visRRijedAtmAnamapi chAtmajam
shlokas.6:
Atmanastu mayA shreyo boddhavyamiti rochaye |
brahmavadhyAtmavadhyA vA shreya Atmavadho mama
shlokas.7:
brahmavadhyA paraM pApaM niShkRRitirnAtra vidyate |
abuddhipUrvaM kRRitvApi shreya Atmavadho mama
shlokas.8:
na tvahaM vadhamAkA~NkShe svayamevAtmanaH shubhe |
paraiH kRRite vadhe pApaM na ki~nchinmayi vidyate
shlokas.9:
abhisandhikRRite tasminbrAhmaNasya vadhe mayA |
niShkRRitiM na prapashyAmi nRRisha.nsaM kShudrameva cha
shlokas.10:
Agatasya gRRihe tyAgastathaiva sharaNArthinaH |
yAchamAnasya cha vadho nRRisha.nsaM paramaM matam
shlokas.11:
kuryAnna ninditaM karma na nRRisha.nsaM kadAchana |
iti pUrve mahAtmAna Apaddharmavido viduH
shlokas.12:
shreyA.nstu sahadArasya vinAsho.adya mama svayam |
brAhmaNasya vadhaM nAhamanuma.nsye katha~nchana
shlokas.13:
kuntyuvAcha||
mamApyeShA matirbrahmanviprA rakShyA iti sthirA |
na chApyaniShTaH putro me yadi putrashataM bhavet
shlokas.14:
na chAsau rAkShasaH shakto mama putravinAshane |
vIryavAnmantrasiddhashcha tejasvI cha suto mama
shlokas.15:
rAkShasAya cha tatsarvaM prApayiShyati bhojanam |
mokShayiShyati chAtmAnamiti me nishchitA matiH
shlokas.16:
samAgatAshcha vIreNa dRRiShTapUrvAshcha rAkShasAH |
balavanto mahAkAyA nihatAshchApyanekashaH
shlokas.17:
na tvidaM keShuchidbrahmanvyAhartavyaM katha~nchana |
vidyArthino hi me putrAnviprakuryuH kutUhalAt
shlokas.18:
guruNA chAnanuj~nAto grAhayedyaM suto mama |
na sa kuryAttayA kAryaM vidyayeti satAM matam
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu pRRithayA sa vipro bhAryayA saha |
hRRiShTaH sampUjayAmAsa tadvAkyamamRRitopamam
shlokas.20:
tataH kuntI cha viprashcha sahitAvanilAtmajam |
tamabrUtAM kuruShveti sa tathetyabravIchcha tau

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kariShya iti bhImena pratij~nAte tu bhArata |
Ajagmuste tataH sarve bhaikShamAdAya pANDavAH
shlokas.2:
AkAreNaiva taM j~nAtvA pANDuputro yudhiShThiraH |
rahaH samupavishyaikastataH paprachCha mAtaram
shlokas.3:
kiM chikIrShatyayaM karma bhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
bhavatyanumate kachchidayaM kartumihechChati
shlokas.4:
kuntyuvAcha||
mamaiva vachanAdeSha kariShyati parantapaH |
brAhmaNArthe mahatkRRityaM moShkAya nagarasya cha
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kimidaM sAhasaM tIkShNaM bhavatyA duShkRRitaM kRRitam |
parityAgaM hi putrasya na prasha.nsanti sAdhavaH
shlokas.6:
kathaM parasutasyArthe svasutaM tyaktumichChasi |
lokavRRittiviruddhaM vai putratyAgAtkRRitaM tvayA
shlokas.7:
yasya bAhU samAshritya sukhaM sarve svapAmahe |
rAjyaM chApahRRitaM kShudrairAjihIrShAmahe punaH
shlokas.8:
yasya duryodhano vIryaM chintayannamitaujasaH |
na shete vasatIH sarvA duHkhAchChakuninA saha
shlokas.9:
yasya vIrasya vIryeNa muktA jatugRRihAdvayam |
anyebhyashchaiva pApebhyo nihatashcha purochanaH
shlokas.10:
yasya vIryaM samAshritya vasupUrNAM vasundharAm |
imAM manyAmahe prAptAM nihatya dhRRitarAShTrajAn
shlokas.11:
tasya vyavasitastyAgo buddhimAsthAya kAM tvayA |
kachchinna duHkhairbuddhiste viplutA gatachetasaH
shlokas.12:
kuntyuvAcha||
yudhiShThira na santApaH kAryaH prati vRRikodaram |
na chAyaM buddhidaurbalyAdvyavasAyaH kRRito mayA
shlokas.13:
iha viprasya bhavane vayaM putra sukhoShitAH |
tasya pratikriyA tAta mayeyaM prasamIkShitA
etAvAneva puruShaH kRRitaM yasminna nashyati
shlokas.14:
dRRiShTvA bhIShmasya vikrAntaM tadA jatugRRihe mahat |
hiDimbasya vadhAchchaiva vishvAso me vRRikodare
shlokas.15:
bAhvorbalaM hi bhImasya nAgAyutasamaM mahat |
yena yUyaM gajaprakhyA nirvyUDhA vAraNAvatAt
shlokas.16:
vRRikodarabalo nAnyo na bhUto na bhaviShyati |
yo.abhyudIyAdyudhi shreShThamapi vajradharaM svayam
shlokas.17:
jAtamAtraH purA chaiSha mamA~NkAtpatito girau |
sharIragauravAttasya shilA gAtrairvichUrNitA
shlokas.18:
tadahaM praj~nayA smRRitvA balaM bhImasya pANDava |
pratIkAraM cha viprasya tataH kRRitavatI matim
shlokas.19:
nedaM lobhAnna chAj~nAnAnna cha mohAdvinishchitam |
buddhipUrvaM tu dharmasya vyavasAyaH kRRito mayA
shlokas.20:
arthau dvAvapi niShpannau yudhiShThira bhaviShyataH |
pratIkArashcha vAsasya dharmashcha charito mahAn
shlokas.21:
yo brAhmaNasya sAhAyyaM kuryAdartheShu karhichit |
kShatriyaH sa shubhA.NllokAnprApnuyAditi me shrutam
shlokas.22:
kShatriyaH kShatriyasyaiva kurvANo vadhamokShaNam |
vipulAM kIrtimApnoti loke.asmi.nshcha paratra cha
shlokas.23:
vaishyasyaiva tu sAhAyyaM kurvANaH kShatriyo yudhi |
sa sarveShvapi lokeShu prajA ra~njayate dhruvam
shlokas.24:
shUdraM tu mokShayanrAjA sharaNArthinamAgatam |
prApnotIha kule janma sadravye rAjasatkRRite
shlokas.25:
evaM sa bhagavAnvyAsaH purA kauravanandana |
provAcha sutarAM prAj~nastasmAdetachchikIrShitam
shlokas.26:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
upapannamidaM mAtastvayA yadbuddhipUrvakam |
Artasya brAhmaNasyaivamanukroshAdidaM kRRitam
dhruvameShyati bhImo.ayaM nihatya puruShAdakam
shlokas.27:
yathA tvidaM na vindeyurnarA nagaravAsinaH |
tathAyaM brAhmaNo vAchyaH parigrAhyashcha yatnataH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato rAtryAM vyatItAyAmannamAdAya pANDavaH |
bhImaseno yayau tatra yatrAsau puruShAdakaH
shlokas.2:
AsAdya tu vanaM tasya rakShasaH pANDavo balI |
AjuhAva tato nAmnA tadannamupayojayan
shlokas.3:
tataH sa rAkShasaH shrutvA bhImasenasya tadvachaH |
AjagAma susa~Nkruddho yatra bhImo vyavasthitaH
shlokas.4:
mahAkAyo mahAvego dArayanniva medinIm |
trishikhAM bhRRikuTiM kRRitvA sa.ndashya dashanachChadam
shlokas.5:
bhu~njAnamannaM taM dRRiShTvA bhImasenaM sa rAkShasaH |
vivRRitya nayane kruddha idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.6:
ko.ayamannamidaM bhu~Nkte madarthamupakalpitam |
pashyato mama durbuddhiryiyAsuryamasAdanam
shlokas.7:
bhImasenastu tachChrutvA prahasanniva bhArata |
rAkShasaM tamanAdRRitya bhu~Nkta eva parA~NmukhaH
shlokas.8:
tataH sa bhairavaM kRRitvA samudyamya karAvubhau |
abhyadravadbhImasenaM jighA.nsuH puruShAdakaH
shlokas.9:
tathApi paribhUyainaM nekShamANo vRRikodaraH |
rAkShasaM bhu~Nkta evAnnaM pANDavaH paravIrahA
shlokas.10:
amarSheNa tu sampUrNaH kuntIputrasya rAkShasaH |
jaghAna pRRiShThaM pANibhyAmubhAbhyAM pRRiShThataH sthitaH
shlokas.11:
tathA balavatA bhImaH pANibhyAM bhRRishamAhataH |
naivAvalokayAmAsa rAkShasaM bhu~Nkta eva saH
shlokas.12:
tataH sa bhUyaH sa~Nkruddho vRRikShamAdAya rAkShasaH |
tADayiShya.nstadA bhImaM punarabhyadravadbalI
shlokas.13:
tato bhImaH shanairbhuktvA tadannaM puruSharShabhaH |
vAryupaspRRishya saMhRRiShTastasthau yudhi mahAbalaH
shlokas.14:
kShiptaM kruddhena taM vRRikShaM pratijagrAha vIryavAn |
savyena pANinA bhImaH prahasanniva bhArata
shlokas.15:
tataH sa punarudyamya vRRikShAnbahuvidhAnbalI |
prAhiNodbhImasenAya tasmai bhImashcha pANDavaH
shlokas.16:
tadvRRikShayuddhamabhavanmahIruhavinAshanam |
ghorarUpaM mahArAja bakapANDavayormahat
shlokas.17:
nAma vishrAvya tu bakaH samabhidrutya pANDavam |
bhujAbhyAM parijagrAha bhImasenaM mahAbalam
shlokas.18:
bhImaseno.api tadrakShaH parirabhya mahAbhujaH |
visphurantaM mahAvegaM vichakarSha balAdbalI
shlokas.19:
sa kRRiShyamANo bhImena karShamANashcha pANDavam |
samayujyata tIvreNa shrameNa puruShAdakaH
shlokas.20:
tayorvegena mahatA pRRithivI samakampata |
pAdapA.nshcha mahAkAyA.nshchUrNayAmAsatustadA
shlokas.21:
hIyamAnaM tu tadrakShaH samIkShya bharatarShabha |
niShpiShya bhUmau pANibhyAM samAjaghne vRRikodaraH
shlokas.22:
tato.asya jAnunA pRRiShThamavapIDya balAdiva |
bAhunA parijagrAha dakShiNena shirodharAm
shlokas.23:
savyena cha kaTIdeshe gRRihya vAsasi pANDavaH |
tadrakSho dviguNaM chakre nadantaM bhairavAnravAn
shlokas.24:
tato.asya rudhiraM vaktrAtprAdurAsIdvishAM pate |
bhajyamAnasya bhImena tasya ghorasya rakShasaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tena shabdena vitrasto janastasyAtha rakShasaH |
niShpapAta gRRihAdrAjansahaiva parichAribhiH
shlokas.2:
tAnbhItAnvigataj~nAnAnbhImaH praharatAM varaH |
sAntvayAmAsa balavAnsamaye cha nyaveshayat
shlokas.3:
na hi.nsyA mAnuShA bhUyo yuShmAbhiriha karhichit |
hi.nsatAM hi vadhaH shIghramevameva bhavediti
shlokas.4:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA tAni rakShA.nsi bhArata |
evamastviti taM prAhurjagRRihuH samayaM cha tam
shlokas.5:
tataH prabhRRiti rakShA.nsi tatra saumyAni bhArata |
nagare pratyadRRishyanta narairnagaravAsibhiH
shlokas.6:
tato bhimastamAdAya gatAsuM puruShAdakam |
dvAradeshe vinikShipya jagAmAnupalakShitaH
shlokas.7:
tataH sa bhImastaM hatvA gatvA brAhmaNaveshma tat |
AchachakShe yathAvRRittaM rAj~naH sarvamasheShataH
shlokas.8:
tato narA viniShkrAntA nagarAtkAlyameva tu |
dadRRishurnihataM bhUmau rAkShasaM rudhirokShitam
shlokas.9:
tamadrikUTasadRRishaM vinikIrNaM bhayAvaham |
ekachakrAM tato gatvA pravRRittiM pradaduH pare
shlokas.10:
tataH sahasrasho rAjannarA nagaravAsinaH |
tatrAjagmurbakaM draShTuM sastrIvRRiddhakumArakAH
shlokas.11:
tataste vismitAH sarve karma dRRiShTvAtimAnuSham |
daivatAnyarchayAM chakruH sarva eva vishAM pate
shlokas.12:
tataH pragaNayAmAsuH kasya vAro.adya bhojane |
j~nAtvA chAgamya taM vipraM paprachChuH sarva eva tat
shlokas.13:
evaM pRRiShTastu bahusho rakShamANashcha pANDavAn |
uvAcha nAgarAnsarvAnidaM viprarShabhastadA
shlokas.14:
Aj~nApitaM mAmashane rudantaM saha bandhubhiH |
dadarsha brAhmaNaH kashchinmantrasiddho mahAbalaH
shlokas.15:
paripRRichChya sa mAM pUrvaM parikleshaM purasya cha |
abravIdbrAhmaNashreShTha AshvAsya prahasanniva
shlokas.16:
prApayiShyAmyahaM tasmai idamannaM durAtmane |
mannimittaM bhayaM chApi na kAryamiti vIryavAn
shlokas.17:
sa tadannamupAdAya gato bakavanaM prati |
tena nUnaM bhavedetatkarma lokahitaM kRRitam
shlokas.18:
tataste brAhmaNAH sarve kShatriyAshcha suvismitAH |
vaishyAH shUdrAshcha muditAshchakrurbrahmamahaM tadA
shlokas.19:
tato jAnapadAH sarve AjagmurnagaraM prati |
tadadbhutatamaM draShTuM pArthAstatraiva chAvasan

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
te tathA puruShavyAghrA nihatya bakarAkShasam |
ata UrdhvaM tato brahmankimakurvata pANDavAH
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatraiva nyavasanrAjannihatya bakarAkShasam |
adhIyAnAH paraM brahma brAhmaNasya niveshane
shlokas.3:
tataH katipayAhasya brAhmaNaH sa.nshitavrataH |
pratishrayArthaM tadveshma brAhmaNasyAjagAma ha
shlokas.4:
sa samyakpUjayitvA taM vidvAnviprarShabhastadA |
dadau pratishrayaM tasmai sadA sarvAtithivratI
shlokas.5:
tataste pANDavAH sarve saha kuntyA nararShabhAH |
upAsAM chakrire vipraM kathayAnaM kathAstadA
shlokas.6:
kathayAmAsa deshAnsa tIrthAni vividhAni cha |
rAj~nAM cha vividhAshcharyAH purANi vividhAni cha
shlokas.7:
sa tatrAkathayadvipraH kathAnte janamejaya |
pA~nchAleShvadbhutAkAraM yAj~nasenyAH svaya.nvaram
shlokas.8:
dhRRiShTadyumnasya chotpattimutpattiM cha shikhaNDinaH |
ayonijatvaM kRRiShNAyA drupadasya mahAmakhe
shlokas.9:
tadadbhutatamaM shrutvA loke tasya mahAtmanaH |
vistareNaiva paprachChuH kathAM tAM puruSharShabhAH
shlokas.10:
kathaM drupadaputrasya dhRRiShTadyumnasya pAvakAt |
vedimadhyAchcha kRRiShNAyAH sambhavaH kathamadbhutaH
shlokas.11:
kathaM droNAnmaheShvAsAtsarvANyastrANyashikShata |
kathaM priyasakhAyau tau bhinnau kasya kRRitena cha
shlokas.12:
evaM taishchodito rAjansa vipraH puruSharShabhaiH |
kathayAmAsa tatsarvaM draupadIsambhavaM tadA

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
ga~NgAdvAraM prati mahAnbabhUvarShirmahAtapAH |
bharadvAjo mahAprAj~naH satataM sa.nshitavrataH
shlokas.2:
so.abhiShektuM gato ga~NgAM pUrvamevAgatAM satIm |
dadarshApsarasaM tatra ghRRitAchImAplutAmRRiShiH
shlokas.3:
tasyA vAyurnadItIre vasanaM vyaharattadA |
apakRRiShTAmbarAM dRRiShTvA tAmRRiShishchakame tataH
shlokas.4:
tasyAM sa.nsaktamanasaH kaumArabrahmachAriNaH |
hRRiShTasya retashchaskanda tadRRiShirdroNa Adadhe
shlokas.5:
tataH samabhavaddroNaH kumArastasya dhImataH |
adhyagIShTa sa vedA.nshcha vedA~NgAni cha sarvashaH
shlokas.6:
bharadvAjasya tu sakhA pRRiShato nAma pArthivaH |
tasyApi drupado nAma tadA samabhavatsutaH
shlokas.7:
sa nityamAshramaM gatvA droNena saha pArShataH |
chikrIDAdhyayanaM chaiva chakAra kShatriyarShabhaH
shlokas.8:
tatastu pRRiShate.atIte sa rAjA drupado.abhavat |
droNo.api rAmaM shushrAva ditsantaM vasu sarvashaH
shlokas.9:
vanaM tu prasthitaM rAmaM bharadvAjasuto.abravIt |
AgataM vittakAmaM mAM viddhi droNaM dvijarShabha
shlokas.10:
rAma uvAcha||
sharIramAtramevAdya mayedamavasheShitam |
astrANi vA sharIraM vA brahmannanyataraM vRRiNu
shlokas.11:
droNa uvAcha||
astrANi chaiva sarvANi teShAM saMhArameva cha |
prayogaM chaiva sarveShAM dAtumarhati me bhavAn
shlokas.12:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
tathetyuktvA tatastasmai pradadau bhRRigunandanaH |
pratigRRihya tato droNaH kRRitakRRityo.abhavattadA
shlokas.13:
samprahRRiShTamanAshchApi rAmAtparamasaMmatam |
brahmAstraM samanuprApya nareShvabhyadhiko.abhavat
shlokas.14:
tato drupadamAsAdya bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
abravItpuruShavyAghraH sakhAyaM viddhi mAmiti
shlokas.15:
drupada uvAcha||
nAshrotriyaH shrotriyasya nArathI rathinaH sakhA |
nArAjA pArthivasyApi sakhipUrvaM kimiShyate
shlokas.16:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
sa vinishchitya manasA pA~nchAlyaM prati buddhimAn |
jagAma kurumukhyAnAM nagaraM nAgasAhvayam
shlokas.17:
tasmai pautrAnsamAdAya vasUni vividhAni cha |
prAptAya pradadau bhIShmaH shiShyAndroNAya dhImate
shlokas.18:
droNaH shiShyA.nstataH sarvAnidaM vachanamabravIt |
samAnIya tadA vidvAndrupadasyAsukhAya vai
shlokas.19:
AchAryavetanaM ki~nchiddhRRidi samparivartate |
kRRitAstraistatpradeyaM syAttadRRitaM vadatAnaghAH
shlokas.20:
yadA cha pANDavAH sarve kRRitAstrAH kRRitanishramAH |
tato droNo.abravIdbhUyo vetanArthamidaM vachaH
shlokas.21:
pArShato drupado nAma ChatravatyAM nareshvaraH |
tasyApakRRiShya tadrAjyaM mama shIghraM pradIyatAm
shlokas.22:
tataH pANDusutAH pa~ncha nirjitya drupadaM yudhi |
droNAya darshayAmAsurbaddhvA sasachivaM tadA
shlokas.23:
droNa uvAcha||
prArthayAmi tvayA sakhyaM punareva narAdhipa |
arAjA kila no rAj~naH sakhA bhavitumarhati
shlokas.24:
ataH prayatitaM rAjye yaj~nasena mayA tava |
rAjAsi dakShiNe kUle bhAgIrathyAhamuttare
shlokas.25:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
asatkAraH sa sumahAnmuhUrtamapi tasya tu |
na vyeti hRRidayAdrAj~no durmanAH sa kRRisho.abhavat

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
amarShI drupado rAjA karmasiddhAndvijarShabhAn |
anvichChanparichakrAma brAhmaNAvasathAnbahUn
shlokas.2:
putrajanma parIpsanvai shokopahatachetanaH |
nAsti shreShThaM mamApatyamiti nityamachintayat
shlokas.3:
jAtAnputrAnsa nirvedAddhigbandhUniti chAbravIt |
niHshvAsaparamashchAsIddroNaM pratichikIrShayA
shlokas.4:
prabhAvaM vinayaM shikShAM droNasya charitAni cha |
kShAtreNa cha balenAsya chintayannAnvapadyata
pratikartuM nRRipashreShTho yatamAno.api bhArata
shlokas.5:
abhitaH so.atha kalmAShIM ga~NgAkUle paribhraman |
brAhmaNAvasathaM puNyamAsasAda mahIpatiH
shlokas.6:
tatra nAsnAtakaH kashchinna chAsIdavratI dvijaH |
tathaiva nAmahAbhAgaH so.apashyatsa.nshitavratau
shlokas.7:
yAjopayAjau brahmarShI shAmyantau pRRiShatAtmajaH |
saMhitAdhyayane yuktau gotratashchApi kAshyapau
shlokas.8:
tAraNe yuktarUpau tau brAhmaNAvRRiShisattamau |
sa tAvAmantrayAmAsa sarvakAmairatandritaH
shlokas.9:
buddhvA tayorbalaM buddhiM kanIyA.nsamupahvare |
prapede ChandayankAmairupayAjaM dhRRitavratam
shlokas.10:
pAdashushrUShaNe yuktaH priyavAksarvakAmadaH |
arhayitvA yathAnyAyamupayAjamuvAcha saH
shlokas.11:
yena me karmaNA brahmanputraH syAddroNamRRityave |
upayAja kRRite tasmingavAM dAtAsmi te.arbudam
shlokas.12:
yadvA te.anyaddvijashreShTha manasaH supriyaM bhavet |
sarvaM tatte pradAtAhaM na hi me.astyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.13:
ityukto nAhamityevaM tamRRiShiH pratyuvAcha ha |
ArAdhayiShyandrupadaH sa taM paryacharatpunaH
shlokas.14:
tataH sa.nvatsarasyAnte drupadaM sa dvijottamaH |
upayAjo.abravIdrAjankAle madhurayA girA
shlokas.15:
jyeShTho bhrAtA mamAgRRihNAdvicharanvananirjhare |
aparij~nAtashauchAyAM bhUmau nipatitaM phalam
shlokas.16:
tadapashyamahaM bhrAturasAmpratamanuvrajan |
vimarshaM sa~NkarAdAne nAyaM kuryAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.17:
dRRiShTvA phalasya nApashyaddoShA ye.asyAnubandhikAH |
vivinakti na shauchaM yaH so.anyatrApi kathaM bhavet
shlokas.18:
saMhitAdhyayanaM kurvanvasangurukule cha yaH |
bhaikShamuchChiShTamanyeShAM bhu~Nkte chApi sadA sadA
kIrtayanguNamannAnAmaghRRiNI cha punaH punaH
shlokas.19:
tamahaM phalArthinaM manye bhrAtaraM tarkachakShuShA |
taM vai gachChasva nRRipate sa tvAM sa.nyAjayiShyati
shlokas.20:
jugupsamAno nRRipatirmanasedaM vichintayan |
upayAjavachaH shrutvA nRRipatiH sarvadharmavit
abhisampUjya pUjArhamRRiShiM yAjamuvAcha ha
shlokas.21:
ayutAni dadAnyaShTau gavAM yAjaya mAM vibho |
droNavairAbhisantaptaM tvaM hlAdayitumarhasi
shlokas.22:
sa hi brahmavidAM shreShTho brahmAstre chApyanuttamaH |
tasmAddroNaH parAjaiShInmAM vai sa sakhivigrahe
shlokas.23:
kShatriyo nAsti tulyo.asya pRRithivyAM kashchidagraNIH |
kauravAchAryamukhyasya bhAradvAjasya dhImataH
shlokas.24:
droNasya sharajAlAni prANidehaharANi cha |
ShaDaratni dhanushchAsya dRRishyate.apratimaM mahat
shlokas.25:
sa hi brAhmaNavegena kShAtraM vegamasa.nshayam |
pratihanti maheShvAso bhAradvAjo mahAmanAH
shlokas.26:
kShatrochChedAya vihito jAmadagnya ivAsthitaH |
tasya hyastrabalaM ghoramaprasahyaM narairbhuvi
shlokas.27:
brAhmamuchchAraya.nstejo hutAhutirivAnalaH |
sametya sa dahatyAjau kShatraM brahmapuraHsaraH
brahmakShatre cha vihite brahmatejo vishiShyate
shlokas.28:
so.ahaM kShatrabalAddhIno brahmatejaH prapedivAn |
droNAdvishiShTamAsAdya bhavantaM brahmavittamam
shlokas.29:
droNAntakamahaM putraM labheyaM yudhi durjayam |
tatkarma kuru me yAja nirvapAmyarbudaM gavAm
shlokas.30:
tathetyuktvA tu taM yAjo yAjyArthamupakalpayat |
gurvartha iti chAkAmamupayAjamachodayat
yAjo droNavinAshAya pratijaj~ne tathA cha saH
shlokas.31:
tatastasya narendrasya upayAjo mahAtapAH |
Achakhyau karma vaitAnaM tadA putraphalAya vai
shlokas.32:
sa cha putro mahAvIryo mahAtejA mahAbalaH |
iShyate yadvidho rAjanbhavitA te tathAvidhaH
shlokas.33:
bhAradvAjasya hantAraM so.abhisandhAya bhUmipaH |
Ajahre tattathA sarvaM drupadaH karmasiddhaye
shlokas.34:
yAjastu havanasyAnte devImAhvApayattadA |
praihi mAM rAj~ni pRRiShati mithunaM tvAmupasthitam
shlokas.35:
devyuvAcha||
avaliptaM me mukhaM brahmanpuNyAngandhAnbibharmi cha |
sutArthenoparuddhAsmi tiShTha yAja mama priye
shlokas.36:
yAja uvAcha||
yAjena shrapitaM havyamupayAjena mantritam |
kathaM kAmaM na sa.ndadhyAtsA tvaM vipraihi tiShTha vA
shlokas.37:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
evamukte tu yAjena hute haviShi sa.nskRRite |
uttasthau pAvakAttasmAtkumAro devasaMnibhaH
shlokas.38:
jvAlAvarNo ghorarUpaH kirITI varma chottamam |
bibhratsakhaDgaH sasharo dhanuShmAnvinadanmuhuH
shlokas.39:
so.adhyArohadrathavaraM tena cha prayayau tadA |
tataH praNeduH pA~nchAlAH prahRRiShTAH sAdhu sAdhviti
shlokas.40:
bhayApaho rAjaputraH pA~nchAlAnAM yashaskaraH |
rAj~naH shokApaho jAta eSha droNavadhAya vai
ityuvAcha mahadbhUtamadRRishyaM khecharaM tadA
shlokas.41:
kumArI chApi pA~nchAlI vedimadhyAtsamutthitA |
subhagA darshanIyA~NgI vedimadhyA manoramA
shlokas.42:
shyAmA padmapalAshAkShI nIlaku~nchitamUrdhajA |
mAnuShaM vigrahaM kRRitvA sAkShAdamaravarNinI
shlokas.43:
nIlotpalasamo gandho yasyAH kroshAtpravAyati |
yA bibharti paraM rUpaM yasyA nAstyupamA bhuvi
shlokas.44:
tAM chApi jAtAM sushroNIM vAguvAchAsharIriNI |
sarvayoShidvarA kRRiShNA kShayaM kShatraM ninIShati
shlokas.45:
surakAryamiyaM kAle kariShyati sumadhyamA |
asyA hetoH kShatriyANAM mahadutpatsyate bhayam
shlokas.46:
tachChrutvA sarvapA~nchAlAH praNeduH siMhasa~Nghavat |
na chaitAnharShasampUNAniyaM sehe vasundharA
shlokas.47:
tau dRRiShTvA pRRiShatI yAjaM prapede vai sutArthinI |
na vai madanyAM jananIM jAnIyAtAmimAviti
shlokas.48:
tathetyuvAcha tAM yAjo rAj~naH priyachikIrShayA |
tayoshcha nAmanI chakrurdvijAH sampUrNamAnasAH
shlokas.49:
dhRRiShTatvAdatidhRRiShNutvAddharmAddyutsambhavAdapi |
dhRRiShTadyumnaH kumAro.ayaM drupadasya bhavatviti
shlokas.50:
kRRiShNetyevAbruvankRRiShNAM kRRiShNAbhUtsA hi varNataH |
tathA tanmithunaM jaj~ne drupadasya mahAmakhe
shlokas.51:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM tu pA~nchAlyamAnIya svaM viveshanam |
upAkarodastrahetorbhAradvAjaH pratApavAn
shlokas.52:
amokShaNIyaM daivaM hi bhAvi matvA mahAmatiH |
tathA tatkRRitavAndroNa AtmakIrtyanurakShaNAt

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA tu kaunteyAH shalyaviddhA ivAbhavan |
sarve chAsvasthamanaso babhUvuste mahArathAH
shlokas.2:
tataH kuntI sutAndRRiShTvA vibhrAntAngatachetasaH |
yudhiShThiramuvAchedaM vachanaM satyavAdinI
shlokas.3:
chirarAtroShitAH smeha brAhmaNasya niveshane |
ramamANAH pure ramye labdhabhaikShA yudhiShThira
shlokas.4:
yAnIha ramaNIyAni vanAnyupavanAni cha |
sarvANi tAni dRRiShTAni punaH punarari.ndama
shlokas.5:
punardRRiShTAni tAnyeva prINayanti na nastathA |
bhaikShaM cha na tathA vIra labhyate kurunandana
shlokas.6:
te vayaM sAdhu pA~nchAlAngachChAma yadi manyase |
apUrvadarshanaM tAta ramaNIyaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.7:
subhikShAshchaiva pA~nchAlAH shrUyante shatrukarshana |
yaj~nasenashcha rAjAsau brahmaNya iti shushrumaH
shlokas.8:
ekatra chiravAso hi kShamo na cha mato mama |
te tatra sAdhu gachChAmo yadi tvaM putra manyase
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bhavatyA yanmataM kAryaM tadasmAkaM paraM hitam |
anujA.nstu na jAnAmi gachCheyurneti vA punaH
shlokas.10:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH kuntI bhImasenamarjunaM yamajau tathA |
uvAcha gamanaM te cha tathetyevAbruva.nstadA
shlokas.11:
tata Amantrya taM vipraM kuntI rAjansutaiH saha |
pratasthe nagarIM ramyAM drupadasya mahAtmanaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vasatsu teShu prachChannaM pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
AjagAmAtha tAndraShTuM vyAsaH satyavatIsutaH
shlokas.2:
tamAgatamabhiprekShya pratyudgamya parantapAH |
praNipatyAbhivAdyainaM tasthuH prA~njalayastadA
shlokas.3:
samanuj~nApya tAnsarvAnAsInAnmunirabravIt |
prasannaH pUjitaH pArthaiH prItipUrvamidaM vachaH
shlokas.4:
api dharmeNa vartadhvaM shAstreNa cha parantapAH |
api vipreShu vaH pUjA pUjArheShu na hIyate
shlokas.5:
atha dharmArthavadvAkyamuktvA sa bhagavAnRRiShiH |
vichitrAshcha kathAstAstAH punarevedamabravIt
shlokas.6:
AsIttapovane kAchidRRiSheH kanyA mahAtmanaH |
vilagnamadhyA sushroNI subhrUH sarvaguNAnvitA
shlokas.7:
karmabhiH svakRRitaiH sA tu durbhagA samapadyata |
nAdhyagachChatpatiM sA tu kanyA rUpavatI satI
shlokas.8:
tapastaptumathArebhe patyarthamasukhA tataH |
toShayAmAsa tapasA sA kilogreNa sha~Nkaram
shlokas.9:
tasyAH sa bhagavA.nstuShTastAmuvAcha tapasvinIm |
varaM varaya bhadraM te varado.asmIti bhAmini
shlokas.10:
atheshvaramuvAchedamAtmanaH sA vacho hitam |
patiM sarvaguNopetamichChAmIti punaH punaH
shlokas.11:
tAmatha pratyuvAchedamIshAno vadatAM varaH |
pa~ncha te patayo bhadre bhaviShyantIti sha~NkaraH
shlokas.12:
pratibruvantImekaM me patiM dehIti sha~Nkaram |
punarevAbravIddeva idaM vachanamuttamam
shlokas.13:
pa~nchakRRitvastvayA uktaH patiM dehItyahaM punaH |
dehamanyaM gatAyAste yathoktaM tadbhaviShyati
shlokas.14:
drupadasya kule jAtA kanyA sA devarUpiNI |
nirdiShTA bhavatAM patnI kRRiShNA pArShatyaninditA
shlokas.15:
pA~nchAlanagaraM tasmAtpravishadhvaM mahAbalAH |
sukhinastAmanuprApya bhaviShyatha na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.16:
evamuktvA mahAbhAgaH pANDavAnAM pitAmahaH |
pArthAnAmantrya kuntIM cha prAtiShThata mahAtapAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te pratasthuH puraskRRitya mAtaraM puruSharShabhAH |
samairuda~NmukhairmArgairyathoddiShTaM parantapAH
shlokas.2:
te gachChantastvahorAtraM tIrthaM somashravAyaNam |
AseduH puruShavyAghrA ga~NgAyAM pANDunandanAH
shlokas.3:
ulmukaM tu samudyamya teShAmagre dhana~njayaH |
prakAshArthaM yayau tatra rakShArthaM cha mahAyashAH
shlokas.4:
tatra ga~NgAjale ramye vivikte krIDayanstriyaH |
IrShyurgandharvarAjaH sma jalakrIDAmupAgataH
shlokas.5:
shabdaM teShAM sa shushrAva nadIM samupasarpatAm |
tena shabdena chAviShTashchukrodha balavadbalI
shlokas.6:
sa dRRiShTvA pANDavA.nstatra saha mAtrA parantapAn |
visphArayandhanurghoramidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.7:
sandhyA sa.nrajyate ghorA pUrvarAtrAgameShu yA |
ashItibhistruTairhInaM taM muhUrtaM prachakShate
shlokas.8:
vihitaM kAmachArANAM yakShagandharvarakShasAm |
sheShamanyanmanuShyANAM kAmachAramiha smRRitam
shlokas.9:
lobhAtprachAraM charatastAsu velAsu vai narAn |
upakrAntA nigRRihNImo rAkShasaiH saha bAlishAn
shlokas.10:
tato rAtrau prApnuvato jalaM brahmavido janAH |
garhayanti narAnsarvAnbalasthAnnRRipatInapi
shlokas.11:
ArAttiShThata mA mahyaM samIpamupasarpata |
kasmAnmAM nAbhijAnIta prAptaM bhAgIrathIjalam
shlokas.12:
a~NgAraparNaM gandharvaM vitta mAM svabalAshrayam |
ahaM hi mAnI cherShyushcha kuberasya priyaH sakhA
shlokas.13:
a~NgAraparNamiti cha khyataM vanamidaM mama |
anu ga~NgAM cha vAkAM cha chitraM yatra vasAmyaham
shlokas.14:
na kuNapAH shRRi~NgiNo vA na devA na cha mAnuShAH |
idaM samupasarpanti tatkiM samupasarpatha
shlokas.15:
arjuna uvAcha||
samudre himavatpArshve nadyAmasyAM cha durmate |
rAtrAvahani sandhau cha kasya kL^iptaH parigrahaH
shlokas.16:
vayaM cha shaktisampannA akAle tvAmadhRRiShNumaH |
ashaktA hi kShaNe krUre yuShmAnarchanti mAnavAH
shlokas.17:
purA himavatashchaiShA hemashRRi~NgAdviniHsRRitA |
ga~NgA gatvA samudrAmbhaH saptadhA pratipadyate
shlokas.18:
iyaM bhUtvA chaikavaprA shuchirAkAshagA punaH |
deveShu ga~NgA gandharva prApnotyalakanandatAm
shlokas.19:
tathA pitRRinvaitaraNI dustarA pApakarmabhiH |
ga~NgA bhavati gandharva yathA dvaipAyano.abravIt
shlokas.20:
asambAdhA devanadI svargasampAdanI shubhA |
kathamichChasi tAM roddhuM naiSha dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.21:
anivAryamasambAdhaM tava vAchA kathaM vayam |
na spRRishema yathAkAmaM puNyaM bhAgIrathIjalam
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
a~NgAraparNastachChrutvA kruddha Anamya kArmukam |
mumocha sAyakAndIptAnahInAshIviShAniva
shlokas.23:
ulmukaM bhrAmaya.nstUrNaM pANDavashcharma chottamam |
vyapovAha sharA.nstasya sarvAneva dhana~njayaH
shlokas.24:
arjuna uvAcha||
bibhIShikaiShA gandharva nAstraj~neShu prayujyate |
astraj~neShu prayuktaiShA phenavatpravilIyate
shlokas.25:
mAnuShAnati gandharvAnsarvAngandharva lakShaye |
tasmAdastreNa divyena yotsye.ahaM na tu mAyayA
shlokas.26:
purAstramidamAgneyaM prAdAtkila bRRihaspatiH |
bharadvAjasya gandharva guruputraH shatakratoH
shlokas.27:
bharadvAjAdagniveshyo agniveshyAdgururmama |
sa tvidaM mahyamadadAddroNo brAhmaNasattamaH
shlokas.28:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA pANDavaH kruddho gandharvAya mumocha ha |
pradIptamastramAgneyaM dadAhAsya rathaM tu tat
shlokas.29:
virathaM viplutaM taM tu sa gandharvaM mahAbalam |
astratejaHpramUDhaM cha prapatantamavA~Nmukham
shlokas.30:
shiroruheShu jagrAha mAlyavatsu dhana~njayaH |
bhrAtRRinprati chakarShAtha so.astrapAtAdachetasam
shlokas.31:
yudhiShThiraM tasya bhAryA prapede sharaNArthinI |
nAmnA kumbhInasI nAma patitrANamabhIpsatI
shlokas.32:
gandharvyuvAcha||
trAhi tvaM mAM mahArAja patiM chemaM vimu~ncha me |
gandharvIM sharaNaM prAptAM nAmnA kumbInasIM prabho
shlokas.33:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yuddhe jitaM yashohInaM strInAthamaparAkramam |
ko nu hanyAdripuM tvAdRRi~Nmu~nchemaM ripusUdana
shlokas.34:
arjuna uvAcha||
a~NgemaM pratipadyasva gachCha gandharva mA shuchaH |
pradishatyabhayaM te.adya kururAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.35:
gandharva uvAcha||
jito.ahaM pUrvakaM nAma mu~nchAmya~NgAraparNatAm |
na cha shlAghe balenAdya na nAmnA janasa.nsadi
shlokas.36:
sAdhvimaM labdhavA.NllAbhaM yo.ahaM divyAstradhAriNam |
gAndharvyA mAyayA yoddhumichChAmi vayasA varam
shlokas.37:
astrAgninA vichitro.ayaM dagdho me ratha uttamaH |
so.ahaM chitraratho bhUtvA nAmnA dagdharatho.abhavam
shlokas.38:
sambhRRitA chaiva vidyeyaM tapaseha purA mayA |
nivedayiShye tAmadya prANadAyA mahAtmane
shlokas.39:
sa.nstambhitaM hi tarasA jitaM sharaNamAgatam |
yo.ariM sa.nyojayetprANaiH kalyANaM kiM na so.arhati
shlokas.40:
chakShuShI nAma vidyeyaM yAM somAya dadau manuH |
dadau sa vishvAvasave mahyaM vishvAvasurdadau
shlokas.41:
seyaM kApuruShaM prAptA gurudattA praNashyati |
Agamo.asyA mayA prokto vIryaM pratinibodha me
shlokas.42:
yachchakShuShA draShTumichChettriShu lokeShu ki~nchana |
tatpashyedyAdRRishaM chechChettAdRRiShaM draShTumarhati
shlokas.43:
samAnapadye ShaNmAsAnsthito vidyAM labhedimAm |
anuneShyAmyahaM vidyAM svayaM tubhyaM vrate kRRite
shlokas.44:
vidyayA hyanayA rAjanvayaM nRRibhyo visheShitAH |
avishiShTAshcha devAnAmanubhAvapravartitAH
shlokas.45:
gandharvajAnAmashvAnAmahaM puruShasattama |
bhrAtRRibhyastava pa~nchabhyaH pRRithagdAtA shataM shatam
shlokas.46:
devagandharvavAhAste divyagandhA manogamAH |
kShINAH kShINA bhavantyete na hIyante cha raMhasaH
shlokas.47:
purA kRRitaM mahendrasya vajraM vRRitranibarhaNe |
dashadhA shatadhA chaiva tachChIrNaM vRRitramUrdhani
shlokas.48:
tato bhAgIkRRito devairvajrabhAga upAsyate |
loke yatsAdhanaM ki~nchitsA vai vajratanuH smRRitA
shlokas.49:
vajrapANirbrAhmaNaH syAtkShatraM vajrarathaM smRRitam |
vaishyA vai dAnavajrAshcha karmavajrA yavIyasaH
shlokas.50:
vajraM kShatrasya vAjino avadhyA vAjinaH smRRitAH |
rathA~NgaM vaDavA sUte sUtAshchAshveShu ye matAH
shlokas.51:
kAmavarNAH kAmajavAH kAmataH samupasthitAH |
ime gandharvajAH kAmaM pUrayiShyanti te hayAH
shlokas.52:
arjuna uvAcha||
yadi prItena vA dattaM sa.nshaye jIvitasya vA |
vidyA vittaM shrutaM vApi na tadgandharva kAmaye
shlokas.53:
gandharva uvAcha||
sa.nyogo vai prItikaraH sa.nsatsu pratidRRishyate |
jIvitasya pradAnena prIto vidyAM dadAmi te
shlokas.54:
tvatto hyahaM grahIShyAmi astramAgneyamuttamam |
tathaiva sakhyaM bIbhatso chirAya bharatarShabha
shlokas.55:
arjuna uvAcha||
tvatto.astreNa vRRiNomyashvAnsa.nyogaH shAshvato.astu nau |
sakhe tadbrUhi gandharva yuShmabhyo yadbhayaM tyajet

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
kAraNaM brUhi gandharva kiM tadyena sma dharShitAH |
yAnto brahmavidaH santaH sarve rAtrAvari.ndama
shlokas.2:
gandharva uvAcha||
anagnayo.anAhutayo na cha viprapuraskRRitAH |
yUyaM tato dharShitAH stha mayA pANDavanandana
shlokas.3:
yakSharAkShasagandharvAH pishAchoragamAnavAH |
vistaraM kuruva.nshasya shrImataH kathayanti te
shlokas.4:
nAradaprabhRRitInAM cha devarShINAM mayA shrutam |
guNAnkathayatAM vIra pUrveShAM tava dhImatAm
shlokas.5:
svayaM chApi mayA dRRiShTashcharatA sAgarAmbarAm |
imAM vasumatIM kRRitsnAM prabhAvaH svakulasya te
shlokas.6:
vede dhanuShi chAchAryamabhijAnAmi te.arjuna |
vishrutaM triShu lokeShu bhAradvAjaM yashasvinam
shlokas.7:
dharmaM vAyuM cha shakraM cha vijAnAmyashvinau tathA |
pANDuM cha kurushArdUla ShaDetAnkulavardhanAn
pitRRinetAnahaM pArtha devamAnuShasattamAn
shlokas.8:
divyAtmAno mahAtmAnaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varAH |
bhavanto bhrAtaraH shUrAH sarve sucharitavratAH
shlokas.9:
uttamAM tu manobuddhiM bhavatAM bhAvitAtmanAm |
jAnannapi cha vaH pArtha kRRitavAniha dharShaNAm
shlokas.10:
strIsakAshe cha kauravya na pumAnkShantumarhati |
dharShaNAmAtmanaH pashyanbAhudraviNamAshritaH
shlokas.11:
naktaM cha balamasmAkaM bhUya evAbhivardhate |
yatastato mAM kaunteya sadAraM manyurAvishat
shlokas.12:
so.ahaM tvayeha vijitaH sa~Nkhye tApatyavardhana |
yena teneha vidhinA kIrtyamAnaM nibodha me
shlokas.13:
brahmacharyaM paro dharmaH sa chApi niyatastvayi |
yasmAttasmAdahaM pArtha raNe.asminvijitastvayA
shlokas.14:
yastu syAtkShatriyaH kashchitkAmavRRittaH parantapa |
naktaM cha yudhi yudhyeta na sa jIvetkatha~nchana
shlokas.15:
yastu syAtkAmavRRitto.api rAjA tApatya sa~Ngare |
jayennakta~ncharAnsarvAnsa purohitadhUrgataH
shlokas.16:
tasmAttApatya yatki~nchinnRRiNAM shreya ihepsitam |
tasminkarmaNi yoktavyA dAntAtmAnaH purohitAH
shlokas.17:
vede ShaDa~Nge niratAH shuchayaH satyavAdinaH |
dharmAtmAnaH kRRitAtmAnaH syurnRRipANAM purohitAH
shlokas.18:
jayashcha niyato rAj~naH svargashcha syAdanantaram |
yasya syAddharmavidvAgmI purodhAH shIlavA~nshuchiH
shlokas.19:
lAbhaM labdhumalabdhaM hi labdhaM cha parirakShitum |
purohitaM prakurvIta rAjA guNasamanvitam
shlokas.20:
purohitamate tiShThedya ichChetpRRithivIM nRRipaH |
prAptuM meruvarotta.nsAM sarvashaH sAgarAmbarAm
shlokas.21:
na hi kevalashauryeNa tApatyAbhijanena cha |
jayedabrAhmaNaH kashchidbhUmiM bhUmipatiH kvachit
shlokas.22:
tasmAdevaM vijAnIhi kurUNAM va.nshavardhana |
brAhmaNapramukhaM rAjyaM shakyaM pAlayituM chiram

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
tApatya iti yadvAkyamuktavAnasi mAmiha |
tadahaM j~nAtumichChAmi tApatyArthavinishchayam
shlokas.2:
tapatI nAma kA chaiShA tApatyA yatkRRite vayam |
kaunteyA hi vayaM sAdho tattvamichChAmi veditum
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa gandharvaH kuntIputraM dhana~njayam |
vishrutAM triShu lokeShu shrAvayAmAsa vai kathAm
shlokas.4:
gandharva uvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi kathAmetAM manoramAm |
yathAvadakhilAM pArtha dharmyAM dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.5:
uktavAnasmi yena tvAM tApatya iti yadvachaH |
tatte.ahaM kathayiShyAmi shRRiNuShvaikamanA mama
shlokas.6:
ya eSha divi dhiShNyena nAkaM vyApnoti tejasA |
etasya tapatI nAma babhUvAsadRRishI sutA
shlokas.7:
vivasvato vai kaunteya sAvitryavarajA vibho |
vishrutA triShu lokeShu tapatI tapasA yutA
shlokas.8:
na devI nAsurI chaiva na yakShI na cha rAkShasI |
nApsarA na cha gandharvI tathArUpeNa kAchana
shlokas.9:
suvibhaktAnavadyA~NgI svasitAyatalochanA |
svAchArA chaiva sAdhvI cha suveShA chaiva bhAminI
shlokas.10:
na tasyAH sadRRishaM ka~nchittriShu lokeShu bhArata |
bhartAraM savitA mene rUpashIlakulashrutaiH
shlokas.11:
samprAptayauvanAM pashyandeyAM duhitaraM tu tAm |
nopalebhe tataH shAntiM sampradAnaM vichintayan
shlokas.12:
artharkShaputraH kaunteya kurUNAmRRiShabho balI |
sUryamArAdhayAmAsa nRRipaH sa.nvaraNaH sadA
shlokas.13:
arghyamAlyopahAraishcha shashvachcha nRRipatiryataH |
niyamairupavAsaishcha tapobhirvividhairapi
shlokas.14:
shushrUShuranaha.nvAdI shuchiH pauravanandanaH |
a.nshumantaM samudyantaM pUjayAmAsa bhaktimAn
shlokas.15:
tataH kRRitaj~naM dharmaj~naM rUpeNAsadRRishaM bhuvi |
tapatyAH sadRRishaM mene sUryaH sa.nvaraNaM patim
shlokas.16:
dAtumaichChattataH kanyAM tasmai sa.nvaraNAya tAm |
nRRipottamAya kauravya vishrutAbhijanAya vai
shlokas.17:
yathA hi divi dIptA.nshuH prabhAsayati tejasA |
tathA bhuvi mahIpAlo dIptyA sa.nvaraNo.abhavat
shlokas.18:
yathArchayanti chAdityamudyantaM brahmavAdinaH |
tathA sa.nvaraNaM pArtha brAhmaNAvarajAH prajAH
shlokas.19:
sa somamati kAntatvAdAdityamati tejasA |
babhUva nRRipatiH shrImAnsuhRRidAM durhRRidAmapi
shlokas.20:
eva~NguNasya nRRipatestathAvRRittasya kaurava |
tasmai dAtuM manashchakre tapatIM tapanaH svayam
shlokas.21:
sa kadAchidatho rAjA shrImAnuruyashA bhuvi |
chachAra mRRigayAM pArtha parvatopavane kila
shlokas.22:
charato mRRigayAM tasya kShutpipAsAshramAnvitaH |
mamAra rAj~naH kaunteya girAvapratimo hayaH
shlokas.23:
sa mRRitAshvashcharanpArtha padbhyAmeva girau nRRipaH |
dadarshAsadRRishIM loke kanyAmAyatalochanAm
shlokas.24:
sa eka ekAmAsAdya kanyAM tAmarimardanaH |
tasthau nRRipatishArdUlaH pashyannavichalekShaNaH
shlokas.25:
sa hi tAM tarkayAmAsa rUpato nRRipatiH shriyam |
punaH santarkayAmAsa raverbhraShTAmiva prabhAm
shlokas.26:
giriprasthe tu sA yasminsthitA svasitalochanA |
sa savRRikShakShupalato hiraNmaya ivAbhavat
shlokas.27:
avamene cha tAM dRRiShTvA sarvaprANabhRRitAM vapuH |
avAptaM chAtmano mene sa rAjA chakShuShaH phalam
shlokas.28:
janmaprabhRRiti yatki~nchiddRRiShTavAnsa mahIpatiH |
rUpaM na sadRRishaM tasyAstarkayAmAsa ki~nchana
shlokas.29:
tayA baddhamanashchakShuH pAshairguNamayaistadA |
na chachAla tato deshAdbubudhe na cha ki~nchana
shlokas.30:
asyA nUnaM vishAlAkShyAH sadevAsuramAnuSham |
lokaM nirmathya dhAtredaM rUpamAviShkRRitaM kRRitam
shlokas.31:
evaM sa tarkayAmAsa rUpadraviNasampadA |
kanyAmasadRRishIM loke nRRipaH sa.nvaraNastadA
shlokas.32:
tAM cha dRRiShTvaiva kalyANIM kalyANAbhijano nRRipaH |
jagAma manasA chintAM kAmamArgaNapIDitaH
shlokas.33:
dahyamAnaH sa tIvreNa nRRipatirmanmathAgninA |
apragalbhAM pragalbhaH sa tAmuvAcha yashasvinIm
shlokas.34:
kAsi kasyAsi rambhoru kimarthaM cheha tiShThasi |
kathaM cha nirjane.araNye charasyekA shuchismite
shlokas.35:
tvaM hi sarvAnavadyA~NgI sarvAbharaNabhUShitA |
vibhUShaNamivaiteShAM bhUShaNAnAmabhIpsitam
shlokas.36:
na devIM nAsurIM chaiva na yakShIM na cha rAkShasIm |
na cha bhogavatIM manye na gandharvIM na mAnuShIm
shlokas.37:
yA hi dRRiShTA mayA kAshchichChrutA vApi varA~NganAH |
na tAsAM sadRRishIM manye tvAmahaM mattakAshini
shlokas.38:
evaM tAM sa mahIpAlo babhAShe na tu sA tadA |
kAmArtaM nirjane.araNye pratyabhAShata ki~nchana
shlokas.39:
tato lAlapyamAnasya pArthivasyAyatekShaNA |
saudAminIva sAbhreShu tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.40:
tAmanvichChansa nRRipatiH parichakrAma tattadA |
vanaM vanajapatrAkShIM bhramannunmattavattadA
shlokas.41:
apashyamAnaH sa tu tAM bahu tatra vilapya cha |
nishcheShTaH kauravashreShTho muhUrtaM sa vyatiShThata

shlokas.1:
gandharva uvAcha||
atha tasyAmadRRishyAyAM nRRipatiH kAmamohitaH |
pAtanaH shatrusa~NghAnAM papAta dharaNItale
shlokas.2:
tasminnipatite bhUmAvatha sA chAruhAsinI |
punaH pInAyatashroNI darshayAmAsa taM nRRipam
shlokas.3:
athAbabhAShe kalyANI vAchA madhurayA nRRipam |
taM kurUNAM kulakaraM kAmAbhihatachetasam
shlokas.4:
uttiShThottiShTha bhadraM te na tvamarhasyari.ndama |
mohaM nRRipatishArdUla gantumAviShkRRitaH kShitau
shlokas.5:
evamukto.atha nRRipatirvAchA madhurayA tadA |
dadarsha vipulashroNIM tAmevAbhimukhe sthitAm
shlokas.6:
atha tAmasitApA~NgImAbabhAShe narAdhipaH |
manmathAgniparItAtmA sa.ndigdhAkSharayA girA
shlokas.7:
sAdhu mAmasitApA~Nge kAmArtaM mattakAshini |
bhajasva bhajamAnaM mAM prANA hi prajahanti mAm
shlokas.8:
tvadarthaM hi vishAlAkShi mAmayaM nishitaiH sharaiH |
kAmaH kamalagarbhAbhe pratividhyanna shAmyati
shlokas.9:
grastamevamanAkrande bhadre kAmamahAhinA |
sA tvaM pInAyatashroNi paryApnuhi shubhAnane
shlokas.10:
tvayyadhInA hi me prANAH kiMnarodgItabhAShiNi |
chArusarvAnavadyA~Ngi padmendusadRRishAnane
shlokas.11:
na hyahaM tvadRRite bhIru shakShye jIvitumAtmanA |
tasmAtkuru vishAlAkShi mayyanukroshama~Ngane
shlokas.12:
bhaktaM mAmasitApA~Nge na parityaktumarhasi |
tvaM hi mAM prItiyogena trAtumarhasi bhAmini
shlokas.13:
gAndharveNa cha mAM bhIru vivAhenaihi sundari |
vivAhAnAM hi rambhoru gAndharvaH shreShTha uchyate
shlokas.14:
tapatyuvAcha||
nAhamIshAtmano rAjankanyA pitRRimatI hyaham |
mayi chedasti te prItiryAchasva pitaraM mama
shlokas.15:
yathA hi te mayA prANAH sa~NgRRihItA nareshvara |
darshanAdeva bhUyastvaM tathA prANAnmamAharaH
shlokas.16:
na chAhamIshA dehasya tasmAnnRRipatisattama |
samIpaM nopagachChAmi na svatantrA hi yoShitaH
shlokas.17:
kA hi sarveShu lokeShu vishrutAbhijanaM nRRipam |
kanyA nAbhilaShennAthaM bhartAraM bhaktavatsalam
shlokas.18:
tasmAdeva~Ngate kAle yAchasva pitaraM mama |
AdityaM praNipAtena tapasA niyamena cha
shlokas.19:
sa chetkAmayate dAtuM tava mAmarimardana |
bhaviShyAmyatha te rAjansatataM vashavartinI
shlokas.20:
ahaM hi tapatI nAma sAvitryavarajA sutA |
asya lokapradIpasya savituH kShatriyarShabha

shlokas.1:
gandharva uvAcha||
evamuktvA tatastUrNaM jagAmordhvamaninditA |
sa tu rAjA punarbhUmau tatraiva nipapAta ha
shlokas.2:
amAtyaH sAnuyAtrastu taM dadarsha mahAvane |
kShitau nipatitaM kAle shakradhvajamivochChritam
shlokas.3:
taM hi dRRiShTvA maheShvAsaM nirashvaM patitaM kShitau |
babhUva so.asya sachivaH sampradIpta ivAgninA
shlokas.4:
tvarayA chopasa~Ngamya snehAdAgatasambhramaH |
taM samutthApayAmAsa nRRipatiM kAmamohitam
shlokas.5:
bhUtalAdbhUmipAleshaM piteva patitaM sutam |
praj~nayA vayasA chaiva vRRiddhaH kIrtyA damena cha
shlokas.6:
amAtyastaM samutthApya babhUva vigatajvaraH |
uvAcha chainaM kalyANyA vAchA madhurayotthitam
mA bhairmanujashArdUla bhadraM chAstu tavAnagha
shlokas.7:
kShutpipAsAparishrAntaM tarkayAmAsa taM nRRipam |
patitaM pAtanaM sa~Nkhye shAtravANAM mahItale
shlokas.8:
vAriNAtha sushItena shirastasyAbhyaShechayat |
aspRRishanmukuTaM rAj~naH puNDarIkasugandhinA
shlokas.9:
tataH pratyAgataprANastadbalaM balavAnnRRipaH |
sarvaM visarjayAmAsa tamekaM sachivaM vinA
shlokas.10:
tatastasyAj~nayA rAj~no vipratasthe mahadbalam |
sa tu rAjA giriprasthe tasminpunarupAvishat
shlokas.11:
tatastasmingirivare shuchirbhUtvA kRRitA~njaliH |
ArirAdhayiShuH sUryaM tasthAvUrdhvabhujaH kShitau
shlokas.12:
jagAma manasA chaiva vasiShThamRRiShisattamam |
purohitamamitraghnastadA sa.nvaraNo nRRipaH
shlokas.13:
nakta.ndinamathaikasthe sthite tasmi~njanAdhipe |
athAjagAma viprarShistadA dvAdashame.ahani
shlokas.14:
sa viditvaiva nRRipatiM tapatyA hRRitamAnasam |
divyena vidhinA j~nAtvA bhAvitAtmA mahAnRRiShiH
shlokas.15:
tathA tu niyatAtmAnaM sa taM nRRipatisattamam |
AbabhAShe sa dharmAtmA tasyaivArthachikIrShayA
shlokas.16:
sa tasya manujendrasya pashyato bhagavAnRRiShiH |
UrdhvamAchakrame draShTuM bhAskaraM bhAskaradyutiH
shlokas.17:
sahasrA.nshuM tato vipraH kRRitA~njalirupasthitaH |
vasiShTho.ahamiti prItyA sa chAtmAnaM nyavedayat
shlokas.18:
tamuvAcha mahAtejA vivasvAnmunisattamam |
maharShe svAgataM te.astu kathayasva yathechChasi

shlokas.1:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
yaiShA te tapatI nAma sAvitryavarajA sutA |
tAM tvAM sa.nvaraNasyArthe varayAmi vibhAvaso
shlokas.2:
sa hi rAjA bRRihatkIrtirdharmArthavidudAradhIH |
yuktaH sa.nvaraNo bhartA duhituste viha~Ngama
shlokas.3:
gandharva uvAcha||
ityuktaH savitA tena dadAnItyeva nishchitaH |
pratyabhAShata taM vipraM pratinandya divAkaraH
shlokas.4:
varaH sa.nvaraNo rAj~nAM tvamRRiShINAM varo mune |
tapatI yoShitAM shreShThA kimanyatrApavarjanAt
shlokas.5:
tataH sarvAnavadyAgnIM tapatIM tapanaH svayam |
dadau sa.nvaraNasyArthe vasiShThAya mahAtmane
pratijagrAha tAM kanyAM maharShistapatIM tadA
shlokas.6:
vasiShTho.atha visRRiShTashcha punarevAjagAma ha |
yatra vikhyatakIrtiH sa kurUNAmRRiShabho.abhavat
shlokas.7:
sa rAjA manmathAviShTastadgatenAntarAtmanA |
dRRiShTvA cha devakanyAM tAM tapatIM chAruhAsinIm
vasiShThena sahAyAntIM saMhRRiShTo.abhyadhikaM babhau
shlokas.8:
kRRichChre dvAdasharAtre tu tasya rAj~naH samApite |
AjagAma vishuddhAtmA vasiShTho bhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.9:
tapasArAdhya varadaM devaM gopatimIshvaram |
lebhe sa.nvaraNo bhAryAM vasiShThasyaiva tejasA
shlokas.10:
tatastasmingirishreShThe devagandharvasevite |
jagrAha vidhivatpANiM tapatyAH sa nararShabhaH
shlokas.11:
vasiShThenAbhyanuj~nAtastasminneva dharAdhare |
so.akAmayata rAjarShirvihartuM saha bhAryayA
shlokas.12:
tataH pure cha rAShTre cha vAhaneShu baleShu cha |
Adidesha mahIpAlastameva sachivaM tadA
shlokas.13:
nRRipatiM tvabhyanuj~nAya vasiShTho.athApachakrame |
so.api rAjA girau tasminvijahArAmaropamaH
shlokas.14:
tato dvAdasha varShANi kAnaneShu jaleShu cha |
reme tasmingirau rAjA tayaiva saha bhAryayA
shlokas.15:
tasya rAj~naH pure tasminsamA dvAdasha sarvashaH |
na vavarSha sahasrAkSho rAShTre chaivAsya sarvashaH
shlokas.16:
tatkShudhArtairnirAnandaiH shavabhUtaistadA naraiH |
abhavatpretarAjasya puraM pretairivAvRRitam
shlokas.17:
tatastattAdRRishaM dRRiShTvA sa eva bhagavAnRRiShiH |
abhyapadyata dharmAtmA vasiShTho rAjasattamam
shlokas.18:
taM cha pArthivashArdUlamAnayAmAsa tatpuram |
tapatyA sahitaM rAjannuShitaM dvAdashIH samAH
shlokas.19:
tataH pravRRiShTastatrAsIdyathApUrvaM surArihA |
tasminnRRipatishArdUle praviShTe nagaraM punaH
shlokas.20:
tataH sarAShTraM mumude tatpuraM parayA mudA |
tena pArthivamukhyena bhAvitaM bhAvitAtmanA
shlokas.21:
tato dvAdasha varShANi punarIje narAdhipaH |
patnyA tapatyA sahito yathA shakro marutpatiH
shlokas.22:
evamAsInmahAbhAgA tapatI nAma paurvikI |
tava vaivasvatI pArtha tApatyastvaM yayA mataH
shlokas.23:
tasyAM sa~njanayAmAsa kuruM sa.nvaraNo nRRipaH |
tapatyAM tapatAM shreShTha tApatyastvaM tato.arjuna

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa gandharvavachaH shrutvA tattadA bharatarShabha |
arjunaH parayA prItyA pUrNachandra ivAbabhau
shlokas.2:
uvAcha cha maheShvAso gandharvaM kurusattamaH |
jAtakautUhalo.atIva vasiShThasya tapobalAt
shlokas.3:
vasiShTha iti yasyaitadRRiShernAma tvayeritam |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM yathAvattadvadasva me
shlokas.4:
ya eSha gandharvapate pUrveShAM naH purohitaH |
AsIdetanmamAchakShva ka eSha bhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.5:
gandharva uvAcha||
tapasA nirjitau shashvadajeyAvamarairapi |
kAmakrodhAvubhau yasya charaNau sa.nvavAhatuH
shlokas.6:
yastu nochChedanaM chakre kushikAnAmudAradhIH |
vishvAmitrAparAdhena dhArayanmanyumuttamam
shlokas.7:
putravyasanasantaptaH shaktimAnapi yaH prabhuH |
vishvAmitravinAshAya na mene karma dAruNam
shlokas.8:
mRRitA.nshcha punarAhartuM yaH sa putrAnyamakShayAt |
kRRitAntaM nAtichakrAma velAmiva mahodadhiH
shlokas.9:
yaM prApya vijitAtmAnaM mahAtmAnaM narAdhipAH |
ikShvAkavo mahIpAlA lebhire pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.10:
purohitavaraM prApya vasiShThamRRiShisattamam |
Ijire kratubhishchApi nRRipAste kurunandana
shlokas.11:
sa hi tAnyAjayAmAsa sarvAnnRRipatisattamAn |
brahmarShiH pANDavashreShTha bRRihaspatirivAmarAn
shlokas.12:
tasmAddharmapradhAnAtmA vedadharmavidIpsitaH |
brAhmaNo guNavAnkashchitpurodhAH pravimRRishyatAm
shlokas.13:
kShatriyeNa hi jAtena pRRithivIM jetumichChatA |
pUrvaM purohitaH kAryaH pArtha rAjyAbhivRRiddhaye
shlokas.14:
mahIM jigIShatA rAj~nA brahma kAryaM puraHsaram |
tasmAtpurohitaH kashchidguNavAnastu vo dvijaH

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
kiMnimittamabhUdvairaM vishvAmitravasiShThayoH |
vasatorAshrame puNye sha.nsa naH sarvameva tat
shlokas.2:
gandharva uvAcha||
idaM vAsiShThamAkhyAnaM purANaM parichakShate |
pArtha sarveShu lokeShu yathAvattannibodha me
shlokas.3:
kanyakubje mahAnAsItpArthivo bharatarShabha |
gAdhIti vishruto loke satyadharmaparAyaNaH
shlokas.4:
tasya dharmAtmanaH putraH samRRiddhabalavAhanaH |
vishvAmitra iti khyAto babhUva ripumardanaH
shlokas.5:
sa chachAra sahAmAtyo mRRigayAM gahane vane |
mRRigAnvidhyanvarAhA.nshcha ramyeShu marudhanvasu
shlokas.6:
vyAyAmakarshitaH so.atha mRRigalipsuH pipAsitaH |
AjagAma narashreShTha vasiShThasyAshramaM prati
shlokas.7:
tamAgatamabhiprekShya vasiShThaH shreShThabhAgRRiShiH |
vishvAmitraM narashreShThaM pratijagrAha pUjayA
shlokas.8:
pAdyArghyAchamanIyena svAgatena cha bhArata |
tathaiva pratijagrAha vanyena haviShA tathA
shlokas.9:
tasyAtha kAmadhugdhenurvasiShThasya mahAtmanaH |
uktA kAmAnprayachCheti sA kAmAnduduhe tataH
shlokas.10:
grAmyAraNyA oShadhIshcha duduhe paya eva cha |
ShaDrasaM chAmRRitarasaM rasAyanamanuttamam
shlokas.11:
bhojanIyAni peyAni bhakShyANi vividhAni cha |
lehyAnyamRRitakalpAni choShyANi cha tathArjuna
shlokas.12:
taiH kAmaiH sarvasampUrNaiH pUjitaH sa mahIpatiH |
sAmAtyaH sabalashchaiva tutoSha sa bhRRishaM nRRipaH
shlokas.13:
ShaDAyatAM supArshvoruM tripRRithuM pa~ncha sa.nvRRitAm |
maNDUkanetrAM svAkArAM pInodhasamaninditAm
shlokas.14:
suvAladhiM sha~NkukarNAM chArushRRi~NgAM manoramAm |
puShTAyatashirogrIvAM vismitaH so.abhivIkShya tAm
shlokas.15:
abhinandati tAM nandIM vasiShThasya payasvinIm |
abravIchcha bhRRishaM tuShTo vishvAmitro muniM tadA
shlokas.16:
arbudena gavAM brahmanmama rAjyena vA punaH |
nandinIM samprayachChasva bhu~NkShva rAjyaM mahAmune
shlokas.17:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
devatAtithipitrarthamAjyArthaM cha payasvinI |
adeyA nandinIyaM me rAjyenApi tavAnagha
shlokas.18:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
kShatriyo.ahaM bhavAnviprastapaHsvAdhyAyasAdhanaH |
brAhmaNeShu kuto vIryaM prashAnteShu dhRRitAtmasu
shlokas.19:
arbudena gavAM yastvaM na dadAsi mamepsitAm |
svadharmaM na prahAsyAmi nayiShye te balena gAm
shlokas.20:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
balasthashchAsi rAjA cha bAhuvIryashcha kShatriyaH |
yathechChasi tathA kShipraM kuru tvaM mA vichAraya
shlokas.21:
gandharva uvAcha||
evamuktastadA pArtha vishvAmitro balAdiva |
ha.nsachandrapratIkAshAM nandinIM tAM jahAra gAm
shlokas.22:
kashAdaNDapratihatA kAlyamAnA tatastataH |
hambhAyamAnA kalyANI vasiShThasyAtha nandinI
shlokas.23:
AgamyAbhimukhI pArtha tasthau bhagavadunmukhI |
bhRRishaM cha tADyamAnApi na jagAmAshramAttataH
shlokas.24:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
shRRiNomi te ravaM bhadre vinadantyAH punaH punaH |
balAddhriyasi me nandi kShamAvAnbrAhmaNo hyaham
shlokas.25:
gandharva uvAcha||
sA tu teShAM balAnnandI balAnAM bharatarShabha |
vishvAmitrabhayodvignA vasiShThaM samupAgamat
shlokas.26:
gauruvAcha||
pAShANadaNDAbhihatAM krandantIM mAmanAthavat |
vishvAmitrabalairghorairbhagavankimupekShase
shlokas.27:
gandharva uvAcha||
evaM tasyAM tadA partha dharShitAyAM mahAmuniH |
na chukShubhe na dhairyAchcha vichachAla dhRRitavrataH
shlokas.28:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
kShatriyANAM balaM tejo brAhmaNAnAM kShamA balam |
kShamA mAM bhajate tasmAdgamyatAM yadi rochate
shlokas.29:
gauruvAcha||
kiM nu tyaktAsmi bhagavanyadevaM mAM prabhAShase |
atyaktAhaM tvayA brahmanna shakyA nayituM balAt
shlokas.30:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
na tvAM tyajAmi kalyANi sthIyatAM yadi shakyate |
dRRiDhena dAmnA baddhvaiSha vatsaste hriyate balAt
shlokas.31:
gandharva uvAcha||
sthIyatAmiti tachChrutvA vasiShThasya payasvinI |
UrdhvA~nchitashirogrIvA prababhau ghoradarshanA
shlokas.32:
krodharaktekShaNA sA gaurhambhAravaghanasvanA |
vishvAmitrasya tatsainyaM vyadrAvayata sarvashaH
shlokas.33:
kashAgradaNDAbhihatA kAlyamAnA tatastataH |
krodhadIptekShaNA krodhaM bhUya eva samAdadhe
shlokas.34:
Aditya iva madhyAhne krodhadIptavapurbabhau |
a~NgAravarShaM mu~nchantI muhurvAladhito mahat
shlokas.35:
asRRijatpahlavAnpuchChAchChakRRitaH shabarA~nshakAn |
mUtratashchAsRRijachchApi yavanAnkrodhamUrchChitA
shlokas.36:
puNDrAnkirAtAndramiDAnsiMhalAnbarbarA.nstathA |
tathaiva daradAnmlechChAnphenataH sA sasarja ha
shlokas.37:
tairvisRRiShTairmahatsainyaM nAnAmlechChagaNaistadA |
nAnAvaraNasa~nChannairnAnAyudhadharaistathA
avAkIryata sa.nrabdhairvishvAmitrasya pashyataH
shlokas.38:
ekaikashcha tadA yodhaH pa~nchabhiH saptabhirvRRitaH |
astravarSheNa mahatA kAlyamAnaM balaM tataH
prabhagnaM sarvatastrastaM vishvAmitrasya pashyataH
shlokas.39:
na cha prANairviyujyanta kechitte sainikAstadA |
vishvAmitrasya sa~NkruddhairvAsiShThairbharatarShabha
shlokas.40:
vishvAmitrasya sainyaM tu kAlyamAnaM triyojanam |
kroshamAnaM bhayodvignaM trAtAraM nAdhyagachChata
shlokas.41:
dRRiShTvA tanmahadAshcharyaM brahmatejobhavaM tadA |
vishvAmitraH kShatrabhAvAnnirviNNo vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.42:
dhigbalaM kShatriyabalaM brahmatejobalaM balam |
balAbalaM vinishchitya tapa eva paraM balam
shlokas.43:
sa rAjyaM sphItamutsRRijya tAM cha dIptAM nRRipashriyam |
bhogA.nshcha pRRiShThataH kRRitvA tapasyeva mano dadhe
shlokas.44:
sa gatvA tapasA siddhiM lokAnviShTabhya tejasA |
tatApa sarvAndIptaujA brAhmaNatvamavApa cha
apibachcha sutaM somamindreNa saha kaushikaH

shlokas.1:
gandharva uvAcha||
kalmAShapAda ityasmi.Nlloke rAjA babhUva ha |
ikShvAkuva.nshajaH pArtha tejasAsadRRisho bhuvi
shlokas.2:
sa kadAchidvanaM rAjA mRRigayAM niryayau purAt |
mRRigAnvidhyanvarAhA.nshcha chachAra ripumardanaH
shlokas.3:
sa tu rAjA mahAtmAnaM vAsiShThamRRiShisattamam |
tRRiShArtashcha kShudhArtashcha ekAyanagataH pathi
shlokas.4:
apashyadajitaH sa~Nkhye muniM pratimukhAgatam |
shaktiM nAma mahAbhAgaM vasiShThakulanandanam
jyeShThaM putrashatAtputraM vasiShThasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.5:
apagachCha patho.asmAkamityevaM pArthivo.abravIt |
tathA RRiShiruvAchainaM sAntvaya~nshlakShNayA girA
shlokas.6:
RRiShistu nApachakrAma tasmindharmapathe sthitaH |
nApi rAjA munermAnAtkrodhAchchApi jagAma ha
shlokas.7:
amu~nchantaM tu panthAnaM tamRRiShiM nRRipasattamaH |
jaghAna kashayA mohAttadA rAkShasavanmunim
shlokas.8:
kashAprahArAbhihatastataH sa munisattamaH |
taM shashApa nRRipashreShThaM vAsiShThaH krodhamUrchChitaH
shlokas.9:
ha.nsi rAkShasavadyasmAdrAjApasada tApasam |
tasmAttvamadya prabhRRiti puruShAdo bhaviShyasi
shlokas.10:
manuShyapishite saktashchariShyasi mahImimAm |
gachCha rAjAdhametyuktaH shaktinA vIryashaktinA
shlokas.11:
tato yAjyanimittaM tu vishvAmitravasiShThayoH |
vairamAsIttadA taM tu vishvAmitro.anvapadyata
shlokas.12:
tayorvivadatorevaM samIpamupachakrame |
RRiShirugratapAH pArtha vishvAmitraH pratApavAn
shlokas.13:
tataH sa bubudhe pashchAttamRRiShiM nRRipasattamaH |
RRiSheH putraM vasiShThasya vasiShThamiva tejasA
shlokas.14:
antardhAya tadAtmAnaM vishvAmitro.api bhArata |
tAvubhAvupachakrAma chikIrShannAtmanaH priyam
shlokas.15:
sa tu shaptastadA tena shaktinA vai nRRipottamaH |
jagAma sharaNaM shaktiM prasAdayitumarhayan
shlokas.16:
tasya bhAvaM viditvA sa nRRipateH kurunandana |
vishvAmitrastato rakSha Adidesha nRRipaM prati
shlokas.17:
sa shApAttasya viprarShervishvAmitrasya chAj~nayA |
rAkShasaH ki~Nkaro nAma vivesha nRRipatiM tadA
shlokas.18:
rakShasA tu gRRihItaM taM viditvA sa munistadA |
vishvAmitro.apyapakrAmattasmAddeshAdari.ndama
shlokas.19:
tataH sa nRRipatirvidvAnrakShannAtmAnamAtmanA |
balavatpIDyamAno.api rakShasAntargatena ha
shlokas.20:
dadarsha taM dvijaH kashchidrAjAnaM prasthitaM punaH |
yayAche kShudhitashchainaM samA.nsaM bhojanaM tadA
shlokas.21:
tamuvAchAtha rAjarShirdvijaM mitrasahastadA |
Assva brahma.nstvamatraiva muhUrtamiti sAntvayan
shlokas.22:
nivRRittaH pratidAsyAmi bhojanaM te yathepsitam |
ityuktvA prayayau rAjA tasthau cha dvijasattamaH
shlokas.23:
antargataM tu tadrAj~nastadA brAhmaNabhAShitam |
so.antaHpuraM pravishyAtha sa.nvivesha narAdhipaH
shlokas.24:
tato.ardharAtra utthAya sUdamAnAyya satvaram |
uvAcha rAjA sa.nsmRRitya brAhmaNasya pratishrutam
shlokas.25:
gachChAmuShminnasau deshe brAhmaNo mAM pratIkShate |
annArthI tvaM tamannena samA.nsenopapAdaya
shlokas.26:
evamuktastadA sUdaH so.anAsAdyAmiShaM kvachit |
nivedayAmAsa tadA tasmai rAj~ne vyathAnvitaH
shlokas.27:
rAjA tu rakShasAviShTaH sUdamAha gatavyathaH |
apyenaM naramA.nsena bhojayeti punaH punaH
shlokas.28:
tathetyuktvA tataH sUdaH sa.nsthAnaM vadhyaghAtinAm |
gatvA jahAra tvarito naramA.nsamapetabhIH
shlokas.29:
sa tatsa.nskRRitya vidhivadannopahitamAshu vai |
tasmai prAdAdbrAhmaNAya kShudhitAya tapasvine
shlokas.30:
