sa siddhachakShuShA dRRiShTvA tadannaM dvijasattamaH |
abhojyamidamityAha krodhaparyAkulekShaNaH
shlokas.31:
yasmAdabhojyamannaM me dadAti sa narAdhipaH |
tasmAttasyaiva mUDhasya bhaviShyatyatra lolupA
shlokas.32:
sakto mAnuShamA.nseShu yathoktaH shaktinA purA |
udvejanIyo bhUtAnAM chariShyati mahImimAm
shlokas.33:
dviranuvyAhRRite rAj~naH sa shApo balavAnabhUt |
rakShobalasamAviShTo visa~nj~nashchAbhavattadA
shlokas.34:
tataH sa nRRipatishreShTho rAkShasopahatendriyaH |
uvAcha shaktiM taM dRRiShTvA nachirAdiva bhArata
shlokas.35:
yasmAdasadRRishaH shApaH prayukto.ayaM tvayA mayi |
tasmAttvattaH pravartiShye khAdituM mAnuShAnaham
shlokas.36:
evamuktvA tataH sadyastaM prANairviprayujya saH |
shaktinaM bhakShayAmAsa vyAghraH pashumivepsitam
shlokas.37:
shaktinaM tu hataM dRRiShTvA vishvAmitrastataH punaH |
vasiShThasyaiva putreShu tadrakShaH sa.ndidesha ha
shlokas.38:
sa tA~nshatAvarAnputrAnvasiShThasya mahAtmanaH |
bhakShayAmAsa sa~NkruddhaH siMhaH kShudramRRigAniva
shlokas.39:
vasiShTho ghAtitA~nshrutvA vishvAmitreNa tAnsutAn |
dhArayAmAsa taM shokaM mahAdririva medinIm
shlokas.40:
chakre chAtmavinAshAya buddhiM sa munisattamaH |
na tveva kushikochChedaM mene matimatAM varaH
shlokas.41:
sa merukUTAdAtmAnaM mumocha bhagavAnRRiShiH |
shirastasya shilAyAM cha tUlarAshAvivApatat
shlokas.42:
na mamAra cha pAtena sa yadA tena pANDava |
tadAgnimiddhvA bhagavAnsa.nvivesha mahAvane
shlokas.43:
taM tadA susamiddho.api na dadAha hutAshanaH |
dIpyamAno.apyamitraghna shIto.agnirabhavattataH
shlokas.44:
sa samudramabhipretya shokAviShTo mahAmuniH |
baddhvA kaNThe shilAM gurvIM nipapAta tadambhasi
shlokas.45:
sa samudrormivegena sthale nyasto mahAmuniH |
jagAma sa tataH khinnaH punarevAshramaM prati

shlokas.1:
gandharva uvAcha||
tato dRRiShTvAshramapadaM rahitaM taiH sutairmuniH |
nirjagAma suduHkhArtaH punarevAshramAttataH
shlokas.2:
so.apashyatsaritaM pUrNAM prAvRRiTkAle navAmbhasA |
vRRikShAnbahuvidhAnpArtha vahantIM tIrajAnbahUn
shlokas.3:
atha chintAM samApede punaH pauravanandana |
ambhasyasyA nimajjeyamiti duHkhasamanvitaH
shlokas.4:
tataH pAshaistadAtmAnaM gADhaM baddhvA mahAmuniH |
tasyA jale mahAnadyA nimamajja suduHkhitaH
shlokas.5:
atha ChittvA nadI pAshA.nstasyAribalamardana |
samasthaM tamRRiShiM kRRitvA vipAshaM samavAsRRijat
shlokas.6:
uttatAra tataH pAshairvimuktaH sa mahAnRRiShiH |
vipAsheti cha nAmAsyA nadyAshchakre mahAnRRiShiH
shlokas.7:
shoke buddhiM tatashchakre na chaikatra vyatiShThata |
so.agachChatparvatA.nshchaiva saritashcha sarA.nsi cha
shlokas.8:
tataH sa punarevarShirnadIM haimavatIM tadA |
chaNDagrAhavatIM dRRiShTvA tasyAH srotasyavApatat
shlokas.9:
sA tamagnisamaM vipramanuchintya saridvarA |
shatadhA vidrutA yasmAchChatadruriti vishrutA
shlokas.10:
tataH sthalagataM dRRiShTvA tatrApyAtmAnamAtmanA |
martuM na shakyamityuktvA punarevAshramaM yayau
shlokas.11:
vadhvAdRRishyantyAnugata AshramAbhimukho vrajan |
atha shushrAva sa~NgatyA vedAdhyayananiHsvanam
pRRiShThataH paripUrNArthaiH ShaDbhira~Ngairala~NkRRitam
shlokas.12:
anuvrajati ko nveSha mAmityeva cha so.abravIt |
ahaM tvadRRishyatI nAmnA taM snuShA pratyabhAShata
shakterbhAryA mahAbhAga tapoyuktA tapasvinI
shlokas.13:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
putri kasyaiSha sA~Ngasya vedasyAdhyayanasvanaH |
purA sA~Ngasya vedasya shakteriva mayA shrutaH
shlokas.14:
adRRishyantyuvAcha||
ayaM kukShau samutpannaH shaktergarbhaH sutasya te |
samA dvAdasha tasyeha vedAnabhyasato mune
shlokas.15:
gandharva uvAcha||
evamuktastato hRRiShTo vasiShThaH shreShThabhAgRRiShiH |
asti santAnamityuktvA mRRityoH pArtha nyavartata
shlokas.16:
tataH pratinivRRittaH sa tayA vadhvA sahAnagha |
kalmAShapAdamAsInaM dadarsha vijane vane
shlokas.17:
sa tu dRRiShTvaiva taM rAjA kruddha utthAya bhArata |
AviShTo rakShasogreNa iyeShAttuM tataH sma tam
shlokas.18:
adRRishyantI tu taM dRRiShTvA krUrakarmANamagrataH |
bhayasa.nvignayA vAchA vasiShThamidamabravIt
shlokas.19:
asau mRRityurivogreNa daNDena bhagavannitaH |
pragRRihItena kAShThena rAkShaso.abhyeti bhIShaNaH
shlokas.20:
taM nivArayituM shakto nAnyo.asti bhuvi kashchana |
tvadRRite.adya mahAbhAga sarvavedavidAM vara
shlokas.21:
trAhi mAM bhagavanpApAdasmAddAruNadarshanAt |
rakSho attumiha hyAvAM nUnametachchikIrShati

shlokas.1:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
mA bhaiH putri na bhetavyaM rakShasaste katha~nchana |
naitadrakSho bhayaM yasmAtpashyasi tvamupasthitam
shlokas.2:
rAjA kalmAShapAdo.ayaM vIryavAnprathito bhuvi |
sa eSho.asminvanoddeshe nivasatyatibhIShaNaH
shlokas.3:
gandharva uvAcha||
tamApatantaM samprekShya vasiShTho bhagavAnRRiShiH |
vArayAmAsa tejasvI hu~NkareNaiva bhArata
shlokas.4:
mantrapUtena cha punaH sa tamabhyukShya vAriNA |
mokShayAmAsa vai ghorAdrAkShasAdrAjasattamam
shlokas.5:
sa hi dvAdasha varShANi vasiShThasyaiva tejasA |
grasta AsIdgRRiheNeva parvakAle divAkaraH
shlokas.6:
rakShasA vipramukto.atha sa nRRipastadvanaM mahat |
tejasA ra~njayAmAsa sandhyAbhramiva bhAskaraH
shlokas.7:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAmabhivAdya kRRitA~njaliH |
uvAcha nRRipatiH kAle vasiShThamRRiShisattamam
shlokas.8:
saudAso.ahaM mahAbhAga yAjyaste dvijasattama |
asminkAle yadiShTaM te brUhi kiM karavANi te
shlokas.9:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
vRRittametadyathAkAlaM gachCha rAjyaM prashAdhi tat |
brAhmaNA.nshcha manuShyendra mAvama.nsthAH kadAchana
shlokas.10:
rAjovAcha||
nAvama.nsyAmyahaM brahmankadAchidbrAhmaNarShabhAn |
tvannideshe sthitaH shashvatpujayiShyAmyahaM dvijAn
shlokas.11:
ikShvAkUNAM tu yenAhamanRRiNaH syAM dvijottama |
tattvattaH prAptumichChAmi varaM vedavidAM vara
shlokas.12:
apatyAyepsitAM mahyaM mahiShIM gantumarhasi |
shIlarUpaguNopetAmikShvAkukulavRRiddhaye
shlokas.13:
gandharva uvAcha||
dadAnItyeva taM tatra rAjAnaM pratyuvAcha ha |
vasiShThaH parameShvAsaM satyasandho dvijottamaH
shlokas.14:
tataH pratiyayau kAle vasiShThasahito.anagha |
khyAtaM puravaraM lokeShvayodhyAM manujeshvaraH
shlokas.15:
taM prajAH pratimodantyaH sarvAH pratyudyayustadA |
vipApmAnaM mahAtmAnaM divaukasa iveshvaram
shlokas.16:
achirAtsa manuShyendro nagarIM puNyakarmaNAm |
vivesha sahitastena vasiShThena mahAtmanA
shlokas.17:
dadRRishustaM tato rAjannayodhyAvAsino janAH |
puShyeNa sahitaM kAle divAkaramivoditam
shlokas.18:
sa hi tAM pUrayAmAsa lakShmyA lakShmIvatAM varaH |
ayodhyAM vyoma shItA.nshuH sharatkAla ivoditaH
shlokas.19:
sa.nsiktamRRiShTapanthAnaM patAkochChrayabhUShitam |
manaH prahlAdayAmAsA tasya tatpuramuttamam
shlokas.20:
tuShTapuShTajanAkIrNA sA purI kurunandana |
ashobhata tadA tena shakreNevAmarAvatI
shlokas.21:
tataH praviShTe rAjendre tasminrAjani tAM purIm |
tasya rAj~no.a.aj~nayA devI vasiShThamupachakrame
shlokas.22:
RRitAvatha maharShiH sa sambabhUva tayA saha |
devyA divyena vidhinA vasiShThaH shreShThabhAgRRiShiH
shlokas.23:
atha tasyAM samutpanne garbhe sa munisattamaH |
rAj~nAbhivAditastena jagAma punarAshramam
shlokas.24:
dIrghakAladhRRitaM garbhaM suShAva na tu taM yadA |
sAtha devyashmanA kukShiM nirbibheda tadA svakam
shlokas.25:
dvAdashe.atha tato varShe sa jaj~ne manujarShabha |
ashmako nAma rAjarShiH potanaM yo nyaveshayat

shlokas.1:
gandharva uvAcha||
AshramasthA tataH putramadRRishyantI vyajAyata |
shakteH kulakaraM rAjandvitIyamiva shaktinam
shlokas.2:
jAtakarmAdikAstasya kriyAH sa munipu~NgavaH |
pautrasya bharatashreShTha chakAra bhagavAnsvayam
shlokas.3:
parAsushcha yatastena vasiShThaH sthApitastadA |
garbhasthena tato loke parAshara iti smRRitaH
shlokas.4:
amanyata sa dharmAtmA vasiShThaM pitaraM tadA |
janmaprabhRRiti tasmi.nshcha pitarIva vyavartata
shlokas.5:
sa tAta iti viprarShiM vasiShThaM pratyabhAShata |
mAtuH samakShaM kaunteya adRRishyantyAH parantapa
shlokas.6:
tAteti paripUrNArthaM tasya tanmadhuraM vachaH |
adRRishyantyashrupUrNAkShI shRRiNvantI tamuvAcha ha
shlokas.7:
mA tAta tAta tAteti na te tAto mahAmuniH |
rakShasA bhakShitastAta tava tAto vanAntare
shlokas.8:
manyase yaM tu tAteti naiSha tAtastavAnagha |
AryastveSha pitA tasya pitustava mahAtmanaH
shlokas.9:
sa evamukto duHkhArtaH satyavAgRRiShisattamaH |
sarvalokavinAshAya matiM chakre mahAmanAH
shlokas.10:
taM tathA nishchitAtmAnaM mahAtmAnaM mahAtapAH |
vasiShTho vArayAmAsa hetunA yena tachChRRiNu
shlokas.11:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
kRRitavIrya iti khyAto babhUva nRRipatiH kShitau |
yAjyo vedavidAM loke bhRRigUNAM pArthivarShabhaH
shlokas.12:
sa tAnagrabhujastAta dhAnyena cha dhanena cha |
somAnte tarpayAmAsa vipulena vishAM patiH
shlokas.13:
tasminnRRipatishArdUle svaryAte.atha kadAchana |
babhUva tatkuleyAnAM dravyakAryamupasthitam
shlokas.14:
te bhRRigUNAM dhanaM j~nAtvA rAjAnaH sarva eva ha |
yAchiShNavo.abhijagmustA.nstAta bhArgavasattamAn
shlokas.15:
bhUmau tu nidadhuH kechidbhRRigavo dhanamakShayam |
daduH kechiddvijAtibhyo j~nAtvA kShatriyato bhayam
shlokas.16:
bhRRigavastu daduH kechitteShAM vittaM yathepsitam |
kShatriyANAM tadA tAta kAraNAntaradarshanAt
shlokas.17:
tato mahItalaM tAta kShatriyeNa yadRRichChayA |
khanatAdhigataM vittaM kenachidbhRRiguveshmani
tadvittaM dadRRishuH sarve sametAH kShatriyarShabhAH
shlokas.18:
avamanya tataH kopAdbhRRigU.nstA~nsharaNAgatAn |
nijaghnuste maheShvAsAH sarvA.nstAnnishitaiH sharaiH
A garbhAdanukRRintantashcherushchaiva vasundharAm
shlokas.19:
tata uchChidyamAneShu bhRRiguShvevaM bhayAttadA |
bhRRigupatnyo giriM tAta himavantaM prapedire
shlokas.20:
tAsAmanyatamA garbhaM bhayAddAdhAra taijasam |
UruNaikena vAmorUrbhartuH kulavivRRiddhaye
dadRRishurbrAhmaNIM tAM te dIpyamAnAM svatejasA
shlokas.21:
atha garbhaH sa bhittvoruM brAhmaNyA nirjagAma ha |
muShNandRRiShTIH kShatriyANAM madhyAhna iva bhAskaraH
tatashchakShurviyuktAste giridurgeShu babhramuH
shlokas.22:
tataste moghasa~NkalpA bhayArtAH kShatriyarShabhAH |
brahmaNIM sharaNaM jagmurdRRiShTyarthaM tAmaninditAm
shlokas.23:
UchushchainAM mahAbhAgAM kShatriyAste vichetasaH |
jyotiHprahINA duHkhArtAH shAntArchiSha ivAgnayaH
shlokas.24:
bhagavatyAH prasAdena gachChetkShatraM sachakShuSham |
upAramya cha gachChema sahitAH pApakarmaNaH
shlokas.25:
saputrA tvaM prasAdaM naH sarveShAM kartumarhasi |
punardRRiShTipradAnena rAj~naH santrAtumarhasi

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNyuvAcha||
nAhaM gRRihNAmi vastAta dRRiShTIrnAsti ruShAnvitA |
ayaM tu bhArgavo nUnamUrujaH kupito.adya vaH
shlokas.2:
tena chakShUMShi vastAta nUnaM kopAnmahAtmanA |
smaratA nihatAnbandhUnAdattAni na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.3:
garbhAnapi yadA yUyaM bhRRigUNAM ghnata putrakAH |
tadAyamUruNA garbho mayA varShashataM dhRRitaH
shlokas.4:
ShaDa~NgashchAkhilo veda imaM garbhasthameva hi |
vivesha bhRRiguva.nshasya bhUyaH priyachikIrShayA
shlokas.5:
so.ayaM pitRRivadhAnnUnaM krodhAdvo hantumichChati |
tejasA yasya divyena chakShUMShi muShitAni vaH
shlokas.6:
tamimaM tAta yAchadhvamaurvaM mama sutottamam |
ayaM vaH praNipAtena tuShTo dRRiShTIrvimokShyati
shlokas.7:
gandharva uvAcha||
evamuktAstataH sarve rAjAnaste tamUrujam |
UchuH prasIdeti tadA prasAdaM cha chakAra saH
shlokas.8:
anenaiva cha vikhyAto nAmnA lokeShu sattamaH |
sa aurva iti viprarShirUruM bhittvA vyajAyata
shlokas.9:
chakShUMShi pratilabhyAtha pratijagmustato nRRipAH |
bhArgavastu munirmene sarvalokaparAbhavam
shlokas.10:
sa chakre tAta lokAnAM vinAshAya mahAmanAH |
sarveShAmeva kArtsnyena manaH pravaNamAtmanaH
shlokas.11:
ichChannapachitiM kartuM bhRRigUNAM bhRRigusattamaH |
sarvalokavinAshAya tapasA mahataidhitaH
shlokas.12:
tApayAmAsa lokAnsa sadevAsuramAnuShAn |
tapasogreNa mahatA nandayiShyanpitAmahAn
shlokas.13:
tatastaM pitarastAta vij~nAya bhRRigusattamam |
pitRRilokAdupAgamya sarva UchuridaM vachaH
shlokas.14:
aurva dRRiShTaH prabhAvaste tapasograsya putraka |
prasAdaM kuru lokAnAM niyachCha krodhamAtmanaH
shlokas.15:
nAnIshairhi tadA tAta bhRRigubhirbhAvitAtmabhiH |
vadho.abhyupekShitaH sarvaiH kShatriyANAM vihi.nsatAm
shlokas.16:
AyuShA hi prakRRiShTena yadA naH kheda Avishat |
tadAsmAbhirvadhastAta kShatriyairIpsitaH svayam
shlokas.17:
nikhAtaM taddhi vai vittaM kenachidbhRRiguveshmani |
vairAyaiva tadA nyastaM kShatriyAnkopayiShNubhiH
kiM hi vittena naH kAryaM svargepsUnAM dvijarShabha
shlokas.18:
yadA tu mRRityurAdAtuM na naH shaknoti sarvashaH |
tadAsmAbhirayaM dRRiShTa upAyastAta saMmataH
shlokas.19:
AtmahA cha pumA.nstAta na lokA.Nllabhate shubhAn |
tato.asmAbhiH samIkShyaivaM nAtmanAtmA vinAshitaH
shlokas.20:
na chaitannaH priyaM tAta yadidaM kartumichChasi |
niyachChedaM manaH pApAtsarvalokaparAbhavAt
shlokas.21:
na hi naH kShatriyAH kechinna lokAH sapta putraka |
dUShayanti tapastejaH krodhamutpatitaM jahi

shlokas.1:
aurva uvAcha||
uktavAnasmi yAM krodhAtpratij~nAM pitarastadA |
sarvalokavinAshAya na sA me vitathA bhavet
shlokas.2:
vRRithAroShapratij~no hi nAhaM jIvitumutsahe |
anistIrNo hi mAM roSho dahedagnirivAraNim
shlokas.3:
yo hi kAraNataH krodhaM sa~njAtaM kShantumarhati |
nAlaM sa manujaH samyaktrivargaM parirakShitum
shlokas.4:
ashiShTAnAM niyantA hi shiShTAnAM parirakShatA |
sthAne roShaH prayuktaH syAnnRRipaiH svargajigIShubhiH
shlokas.5:
ashrauShamahamUrustho garbhashayyAgatastadA |
ArAvaM mAtRRivargasya bhRRigUNAM kShatriyairvadhe
shlokas.6:
sAmarairhi yadA lokairbhRRigUNAM kShatriyAdhamaiH |
AgarbhotsAdanaM kShAntaM tadA mAM manyurAviShat
shlokas.7:
ApUrNakoshAH kila me mAtaraH pitarastathA |
bhayAtsarveShu lokeShu nAdhijagmuH parAyaNam
shlokas.8:
tAnbhRRigUNAM tadA dArAnkashchinnAbhyavapadyata |
yadA tadA dadhAreyamUruNaikena mAM shubhA
shlokas.9:
pratiSheddhA hi pApasya yadA lokeShu vidyate |
tadA sarveShu lokeShu pApakRRinnopapadyate
shlokas.10:
yadA tu pratiSheddhAraM pApo na labhate kvachit |
tiShThanti bahavo loke tadA pApeShu karmasu
shlokas.11:
jAnannapi cha yaH pApaM shaktimAnna niyachChati |
IshaH sanso.api tenaiva karmaNA samprayujyate
shlokas.12:
rAjabhishcheshvaraishchaiva yadi vai pitaro mama |
shaktairna shakitA trAtumiShTaM matveha jIvitam
shlokas.13:
ata eShAmahaM kruddho lokAnAmIshvaro.adya san |
bhavatAM tu vacho nAhamalaM samativartitum
shlokas.14:
mama chApi bhavedetadIshvarasya sato mahat |
upekShamANasya punarlokAnAM kilbiShAdbhayam
shlokas.15:
yashchAyaM manyujo me.agnirlokAnAdAtumichChati |
dahedeSha cha mAmeva nigRRihItaH svatejasA
shlokas.16:
bhavatAM cha vijAnAmi sarvalokahitepsutAm |
tasmAdvidadhvaM yachChreyo lokAnAM mama cheshvarAH
shlokas.17:
pitara UchuH||
ya eSha manyujaste.agnirlokAnAdAtumichChati |
apsu taM mu~ncha bhadraM te lokA hyapsu pratiShThitAH
shlokas.18:
ApomayAH sarvarasAH sarvamApomayaM jagat |
tasmAdapsu vimu~nchemaM krodhAgniM dvijasattama
shlokas.19:
ayaM tiShThatu te vipra yadIchChasi mahodadhau |
manyujo.agnirdahannApo lokA hyApomayAH smRRitAH
shlokas.20:
evaM pratij~nA satyeyaM tavAnagha bhaviShyati |
na chaiva sAmarA lokA gamiShyanti parAbhavam
shlokas.21:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
tatastaM krodhajaM tAta aurvo.agniM varuNAlaye |
utsasarja sa chaivApa upayu~Nkte mahodadhau
shlokas.22:
mahaddhayashiro bhUtvA yattadvedavido viduH |
tamagnimudgiranvaktrAtpibatyApo mahodadhau
shlokas.23:
tasmAttvamapi bhadraM te na lokAnhantumarhasi |
parAshara parAndharmA~njAna~nj~nAnavatAM vara

shlokas.1:
gandharva uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa viprarShirvasiShThena mahAtmanA |
nyayachChadAtmanaH kopaM sarvalokaparAbhavAt
shlokas.2:
Ije cha sa mahAtejAH sarvavedavidAM varaH |
RRiShI rAkShasasatreNa shAkteyo.atha parAsharaH
shlokas.3:
tato vRRiddhA.nshcha bAlA.nshcha rAkShasAnsa mahAmuniH |
dadAha vitate yaj~ne shaktervadhamanusmaran
shlokas.4:
na hi taM vArayAmAsa vasiShTho rakShasAM vadhAt |
dvitIyAmasya mA bhA~NkShaM pratij~nAmiti nishchayAt
shlokas.5:
trayANAM pAvakAnAM sa satre tasminmahAmuniH |
AsItpurastAddIptAnAM chaturtha iva pAvakaH
shlokas.6:
tena yaj~nena shubhreNa hUyamAnena yuktitaH |
tadvidIpitamAkAshaM sUryeNeva ghanAtyaye
shlokas.7:
taM vasiShThAdayaH sarve munayastatra menire |
tejasA divi dIpyantaM dvitIyamiva bhAskaram
shlokas.8:
tataH paramaduShprApamanyairRRiShirudAradhIH |
samApipayiShuH satraM tamatriH samupAgamat
shlokas.9:
tathA pulastyaH pulahaH kratushchaiva mahAkratum |
upAjagmuramitraghna rakShasAM jIvitepsayA
shlokas.10:
pulastyastu vadhAtteShAM rakShasAM bharatarShabha |
uvAchedaM vachaH pArtha parAsharamari.ndamam
shlokas.11:
kachchittAtApavighnaM te kachchinnandasi putraka |
ajAnatAmadoShANAM sarveShAM rakShasAM vadhAt
shlokas.12:
prajochChedamimaM mahyaM sarvaM somapasattama |
adharmiShThaM variShThaH sankuruShe tvaM parAshara
rAjA kalmAShapAdashcha divamAroDhumichChati
shlokas.13:
ye cha shaktyavarAH putrA vasiShThasya mahAmuneH |
te cha sarve mudA yuktA modante sahitAH suraiH
sarvametadvasiShThasya viditaM vai mahAmune
shlokas.14:
rakShasAM cha samuchCheda eSha tAta tapasvinAm |
nimittabhUtastvaM chAtra kratau vAsiShThanandana
sa satraM mu~ncha bhadraM te samAptamidamastu te
shlokas.15:
evamuktaH pulastyena vasiShThena cha dhImatA |
tadA samApayAmAsa satraM shAktiH parAsharaH
shlokas.16:
sarvarAkShasasatrAya sambhRRitaM pAvakaM muniH |
uttare himavatpArshve utsasarja mahAvane
shlokas.17:
sa tatrAdyApi rakShA.nsi vRRikShAnashmAna eva cha |
bhakShayandRRishyate vahniH sadA parvaNi parvaNi

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
rAj~nA kalmAShapAdena gurau brahmavidAM vare |
kAraNaM kiM puraskRRitya bhAryA vai saMniyojitA
shlokas.2:
jAnatA cha paraM dharmaM lokyaM tena mahAtmanA |
agamyAgamanaM kasmAdvasiShThena mahAtmanA
kRRitaM tena purA sarvaM vaktumarhasi pRRichChataH
shlokas.3:
gandharva uvAcha||
dhana~njaya nibodhedaM yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
vasiShThaM prati durdharShaM tathAmitrasahaM nRRipam
shlokas.4:
kathitaM te mayA pUrvaM yathA shaptaH sa pArthivaH |
shaktinA bharatashreShTha vAsiShThena mahAtmanA
shlokas.5:
sa tu shApavashaM prAptaH krodhaparyAkulekShaNaH |
nirjagAma purAdrAjA sahadAraH parantapaH
shlokas.6:
araNyaM nirjanaM gatvA sadAraH parichakrame |
nAnAmRRigagaNAkIrNaM nAnAsattvasamAkulam
shlokas.7:
nAnAgulmalatAchChannaM nAnAdrumasamAvRRitam |
araNyaM ghorasaMnAdaM shApagrastaH paribhraman
shlokas.8:
sa kadAchitkShudhAviShTo mRRigayanbhakShamAtmanaH |
dadarsha suparikliShTaH kasmi.nshchidvananirjhare
brAhmaNIM brAhmaNaM chaiva maithunAyopasa~Ngatau
shlokas.9:
tau samIkShya tu vitrastAvakRRitArthau pradhAvitau |
tayoshcha dravatorvipraM jagRRihe nRRipatirbalAt
shlokas.10:
dRRiShTvA gRRihItaM bhartAramatha brAhmaNyabhAShata |
shRRiNu rAjanvacho mahyaM yattvAM vakShyAmi suvrata
shlokas.11:
Adityava.nshaprabhavastvaM hi lokaparishrutaH |
apramattaH sthito dharme gurushushrUShaNe rataH
shlokas.12:
shApaM prApto.asi durdharSha na pApaM kartumarhasi |
RRitukAle tu samprApte bhartrAsmyadya samAgatA
shlokas.13:
akRRitArthA hyahaM bhartrA prasavArthashcha me mahAn |
prasIda nRRipatishreShTha bhartA me.ayaM visRRijyatAm
shlokas.14:
evaM vikroshamAnAyAstasyAH sa sunRRisha.nsakRRit |
bhartAraM bhakShayAmAsa vyAghro mRRigamivepsitam
shlokas.15:
tasyAH krodhAbhibhUtAyA yadashru nyapatadbhuvi |
so.agniH samabhavaddIptastaM cha deshaM vyadIpayat
shlokas.16:
tataH sA shokasantaptA bhartRRivyasanaduHkhitA |
kalmAShapAdaM rAjarShimashapadbrAhmaNI ruShA
shlokas.17:
yasmAnmamAkRRitArthAyAstvayA kShudra nRRisha.nsavat |
prekShantyA bhakShito me.adya prabhurbhartA mahAyashAH
shlokas.18:
tasmAttvamapi durbuddhe machChApaparivikShataH |
patnImRRitAvanuprApya sadyastyakShyasi jIvitam
shlokas.19:
yasya charShervasiShThasya tvayA putrA vinAshitAH |
tena sa~Ngamya te bhAryA tanayaM janayiShyati
sa te va.nshakaraH putro bhaviShyati nRRipAdhama
shlokas.20:
evaM shaptvA tu rAjAnaM sA tamA~NgirasI shubhA |
tasyaiva saMnidhau dIptaM pravivesha hutAshanam
shlokas.21:
vasiShThashcha mahAbhAgaH sarvametadapashyata |
j~nAnayogena mahatA tapasA cha parantapa
shlokas.22:
muktashApashcha rAjarShiH kAlena mahatA tataH |
RRitukAle.abhipatito madayantyA nivAritaH
shlokas.23:
na hi sasmAra nRRipatistaM shApaM shApamohitaH |
devyAH so.atha vachaH shrutvA sa tasyA nRRipasattamaH
taM cha shApamanusmRRitya paryatapyadbhRRishaM tadA
shlokas.24:
etasmAtkAraNAdrAjA vasiShThaM saMnyayojayat |
svadAre bharatashreShTha shApadoShasamanvitaH

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
asmAkamanurUpo vai yaH syAdgandharva vedavit |
purohitastamAchakShva sarvaM hi viditaM tava
shlokas.2:
gandharva uvAcha||
yavIyAndevalasyaiSha vane bhrAtA tapasyati |
dhaumya utkochake tIrthe taM vRRiNudhvaM yadIchChatha
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato.arjuno.astramAgneyaM pradadau tadyathAvidhi |
gandharvAya tadA prIto vachanaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.4:
tvayyeva tAvattiShThantu hayA gandharvasattama |
karmakAle grahIShyAmi svasti te.astviti chAbravIt
shlokas.5:
te.anyonyamabhisampUjya gandharvaH pANDavAshcha ha |
ramyAdbhAgIrathIkachChAdyathAkAmaM pratasthire
shlokas.6:
tata utkochakaM tIrthaM gatvA dhaumyAshramaM tu te |
taM vavruH pANDavA dhaumyaM paurohityAya bhArata
shlokas.7:
tAndhaumyaH pratijagrAha sarvavedavidAM varaH |
pAdyena phalamUlena paurohityena chaiva ha
shlokas.8:
te tadAsha.nsire labdhAM shriyaM rAjyaM cha pANDavAH |
taM brAhmaNaM puraskRRitya pA~nchAlyAshcha svaya.nvaram
shlokas.9:
mAtRRiShaShThAstu te tena guruNA sa~NgatAstadA |
nAthavantamivAtmAnaM menire bharatarShabhAH
shlokas.10:
sa hi vedArthatattvaj~nasteShAM gururudAradhIH |
tena dharmavidA pArthA yAjyAH sarvavidA kRRitAH
shlokas.11:
vIrA.nstu sa hi tAnmene prAptarAjyAnsvadharmataH |
buddhivIryabalotsAhairyuktAndevAnivAparAn
shlokas.12:
kRRitasvastyayanAstena tataste manujAdhipAH |
menire sahitA gantuM pA~nchAlyAstaM svaya.nvaram

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataste narashArdUlA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha pANDavAH |
prayayurdraupadIM draShTuM taM cha devamahotsavam
shlokas.2:
te prayAtA naravyAghrA mAtrA saha parantapAH |
brAhmaNAndadRRishurmArge gachChataH sagaNAnbahUn
shlokas.3:
tAnUchurbrAhmaNA rAjanpANDavAnbrahmachAriNaH |
kva bhavanto gamiShyanti kuto vAgachChateti ha
shlokas.4:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AgatAnekachakrAyAH sodaryAndevadarshinaH |
bhavanto hi vijAnantu sahitAnmAtRRichAriNaH
shlokas.5:
brAhmaNA UchuH||
gachChatAdyaiva pA~nchAlAndrupadasya niveshanam |
svaya.nvaro mahA.nstatra bhavitA sumahAdhanaH
shlokas.6:
ekasArthaM prayAtAH smo vayamapyatra gAminaH |
tatra hyadbhutasa~NkAsho bhavitA sumahotsavaH
shlokas.7:
yaj~nasenasya duhitA drupadasya mahAtmanaH |
vedImadhyAtsamutpannA padmapatranibhekShaNA
shlokas.8:
darshanIyAnavadyA~NgI sukumArI manasvinI |
dhRRiShTadyumnasya bhaginI droNashatroH pratApinaH
shlokas.9:
yo jAtaH kavachI khaDgI sasharaH sasharAsanaH |
susamiddhe mahAbAhuH pAvake pAvakaprabhaH
shlokas.10:
svasA tasyAnavadyA~NgI draupadI tanumadhyamA |
nIlotpalasamo gandho yasyAH kroshAtpravAyati
shlokas.11:
tAM yaj~nasenasya sutAM svaya.nvarakRRitakShaNAm |
gachChAmahe vayaM draShTuM taM cha devamahotsavam
shlokas.12:
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha yajvAno bhUridakShiNAH |
svAdhyAyavantaH shuchayo mahAtmAno yatavratAH
shlokas.13:
taruNA darshanIyAshcha nAnAdeshasamAgatAH |
mahArathAH kRRitAstrAshcha samupaiShyanti bhUmipAH
shlokas.14:
te tatra vividhAndAyAnvijayArthaM nareshvarAH |
pradAsyanti dhanaM gAshcha bhakShyaM bhojyaM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.15:
pratigRRihya cha tatsarvaM dRRiShTvA chaiva svaya.nvaram |
anubhUyotsavaM chaiva gamiShyAmo yathepsitam
shlokas.16:
naTA vaitAlikAshchaiva nartakAH sUtamAgadhAH |
niyodhakAshcha deshebhyaH sameShyanti mahAbalAH
shlokas.17:
evaM kautUhalaM kRRitvA dRRiShTvA cha pratigRRihya cha |
sahAsmAbhirmahAtmAnaH punaH pratinivartsyatha
shlokas.18:
darshanIyA.nshcha vaH sarvAndevarUpAnavasthitAn |
samIkShya kRRiShNA varayetsa~NgatyAnyatamaM varam
shlokas.19:
ayaM bhrAtA tava shrImAndarshanIyo mahAbhujaH |
niyudhyamAno vijayetsa~NgatyA draviNaM bahu
shlokas.20:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
paramaM bho gamiShyAmo draShTuM devamahotsavam |
bhavadbhiH sahitAH sarve kanyAyAstaM svaya.nvaram

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktAH prayAtAste pANDavA janamejaya |
rAj~nA dakShiNapA~nchAlAndrupadenAbhirakShitAn
shlokas.2:
tataste taM mahAtmAnaM shuddhAtmAnamakalmaSham |
dadRRishuH pANDavA rAjanpathi dvaipAyanaM tadA
shlokas.3:
tasmai yathAvatsatkAraM kRRitvA tena cha sAntvitAH |
kathAnte chAbhyanuj~nAtAH prayayurdrupadakShayam
shlokas.4:
pashyanto ramaNIyAni vanAni cha sarA.nsi cha |
tatra tatra vasantashcha shanairjagmurmahArathAH
shlokas.5:
svAdhyAyavantaH shuchayo madhurAH priyavAdinaH |
AnupUrvyeNa samprAptAH pA~nchAlAnkurunandanAH
shlokas.6:
te tu dRRiShTvA puraM tachcha skandhAvAraM cha pANDavAH |
kumbhakArasya shAlAyAM niveshaM chakrire tadA
shlokas.7:
tatra bhaikShaM samAjahrurbrAhmIM vRRittiM samAshritAH |
tA.nshcha prAptA.nstadA vIrA~njaj~nire na narAH kvachit
shlokas.8:
yaj~nasenasya kAmastu pANDavAya kirITine |
kRRiShNAM dadyAmiti sadA na chaitadvivRRiNoti saH
shlokas.9:
so.anveShamANaH kaunteyAnpA~nchAlyo janamejaya |
dRRiDhaM dhanuranAyamyaM kArayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.10:
yantraM vaihAyasaM chApi kArayAmAsa kRRitrimam |
tena yantreNa sahitaM rAjA lakShyaM cha kA~nchanam
shlokas.11:
drupada uvAcha||
idaM sajyaM dhanuH kRRitvA sajyenAnena sAyakaiH |
atItya lakShyaM yo veddhA sa labdhA matsutAmiti
shlokas.12:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
iti sa drupado rAjA sarvataH samaghoShayat |
tachChrutvA pArthivAH sarve samIyustatra bhArata
shlokas.13:
RRiShayashcha mahAtmAnaH svaya.nvaradidRRikShayA |
duryodhanapurogAshcha sakarNAH kuravo nRRipa
shlokas.14:
brAhmaNAshcha mahAbhAgA deshebhyaH samupAgaman |
te.abhyarchitA rAjagaNA drupadena mahAtmanA
shlokas.15:
tataH paurajanAH sarve sAgaroddhUtaniHsvanAH |
shishumArapuraM prApya nyavisha.nste cha pArthivAH
shlokas.16:
prAguttareNa nagarAdbhUmibhAge same shubhe |
samAjavATaH shushubhe bhavanaiH sarvato vRRitaH
shlokas.17:
prAkAraparikhopeto dvAratoraNamaNDitaH |
vitAnena vichitreNa sarvataH samavastRRitaH
shlokas.18:
tUryaughashatasa~NkIrNaH parArdhyAgurudhUpitaH |
chandanodakasiktashcha mAlyadAmaishcha shobhitaH
shlokas.19:
kailAsashikharaprakhyairnabhastalavilekhibhiH |
sarvataH sa.nvRRitairnaddhaH prAsAdaiH sukRRitochChritaiH
shlokas.20:
suvarNajAlasa.nvItairmaNikuTTimabhUShitaiH |
sukhArohaNasopAnairmahAsanaparichChadaiH
shlokas.21:
agrAmyasamavachChannairagurUttamavAsitaiH |
ha.nsAchChavarNairbahubhirAyojanasugandhibhiH
shlokas.22:
asambAdhashatadvAraiH shayanAsanashobhitaiH |
bahudhAtupinaddhA~NgairhimavachChikharairiva
shlokas.23:
tatra nAnAprakAreShu vimAneShu svala~NkRRitAH |
spardhamAnAstadAnyonyaM niSheduH sarvapArthivAH
shlokas.24:
tatropaviShTAndadRRishurmahAsattvaparAkramAn |
rAjasiMhAnmahAbhAgAnkRRiShNAguruvibhUShitAn
shlokas.25:
mahAprasAdAnbrahmaNyAnsvarAShTraparirakShiNaH |
priyAnsarvasya lokasya sukRRitaiH karmabhiH shubhaiH
shlokas.26:
ma~ncheShu cha parArdhyeShu paurajAnapadA janAH |
kRRiShNAdarshanatuShTyarthaM sarvataH samupAvishan
shlokas.27:
brAhmaNaiste cha sahitAH pANDavAH samupAvishan |
RRiddhiM pA~nchAlarAjasya pashyantastAmanuttamAm
shlokas.28:
tataH samAjo vavRRidhe sa rAjandivasAnbahUn |
ratnapradAnabahulaH shobhito naTanartakaiH
shlokas.29:
vartamAne samAje tu ramaNIye.ahni ShoDashe |
AplutA~NgI suvasanA sarvAbharaNabhUShitA
shlokas.30:
vIrakA.nsyamupAdAya kA~nchanaM samala~NkRRitam |
avatIrNA tato ra~NgaM draupadI bharatarShabha
shlokas.31:
purohitaH somakAnAM mantravidbrAhmaNaH shuchiH |
paristIrya juhAvAgnimAjyena vidhinA tadA
shlokas.32:
sa tarpayitvA jvalanaM brAhmaNAnsvasti vAchya cha |
vArayAmAsa sarvANi vAditrANi samantataH
shlokas.33:
niHshabde tu kRRite tasmindhRRiShTadyumno vishAM pate |
ra~Ngamadhyagatastatra meghagambhIrayA girA
vAkyamuchchairjagAdedaM shlakShNamarthavaduttamam
shlokas.34:
idaM dhanurlakShyamime cha bANAH; shRRiNvantu me pArthivAH sarva eva |
yantrachChidreNAbhyatikramya lakShyaM; samarpayadhvaM khagamairdashArdhaiH
shlokas.35:
etatkartA karma suduShkaraM yaH; kulena rUpeNa balena yuktaH |
tasyAdya bhAryA bhaginI mameyaM; kRRiShNA bhavitrI na mRRiShA bravImi
shlokas.36:
tAnevamuktvA drupadasya putraH; pashchAdidaM draupadImabhyuvAcha |
nAmnA cha gotreNa cha karmaNA cha; sa~NkIrtaya.nstAnnRRipatInsametAn

shlokas.1:
dhRRiShTadyumna uvAcha||
duryodhano durviShaho durmukho duShpradharShaNaH |
vivi.nshatirvikarNashcha saho duHshAsanaH samaH
shlokas.2:
yuyutsurvAtavegashcha bhImavegadharastathA |
ugrAyudho balAkI cha kanakAyurvirochanaH
shlokas.3:
sukuNDalashchitrasenaH suvarchAH kanakadhvajaH |
nandako bAhushAlI cha kuNDajo vikaTastathA
shlokas.4:
ete chAnye cha bahavo dhArtarAShTrA mahAbalAH |
karNena sahitA vIrAstvadarthaM samupAgatAH
shatasa~NkhyA mahAtmAnaH prathitAH kShatriyarShabhAH
shlokas.5:
shakunishcha balashchaiva vRRiShako.atha bRRihadbalaH |
ete gAndhArarAjasya sutAH sarve samAgatAH
shlokas.6:
ashvatthAmA cha bhojashcha sarvashastrabhRRitAM varau |
samavetau mahAtmAnau tvadarthe samala~NkRRitau
shlokas.7:
bRRihanto maNimA.nshchaiva daNDadhArashcha vIryavAn |
sahadevo jayatseno meghasandhishcha mAgadhaH
shlokas.8:
virATaH saha putrAbhyAM sha~NkhenaivottareNa cha |
vArdhakShemiH suvarchAshcha senAbindushcha pArthivaH
shlokas.9:
abhibhUH saha putreNa sudAmnA cha suvarchasA |
sumitraH sukumArashcha vRRikaH satyadhRRitistathA
shlokas.10:
sUryadhvajo rochamAno nIlashchitrAyudhastathA |
a.nshumA.nshchekitAnashcha shreNimA.nshcha mahAbalaH
shlokas.11:
samudrasenaputrashcha chandrasenaH pratApavAn |
jalasandhaH pitAputrau sudaNDo daNDa eva cha
shlokas.12:
pauNDrako vAsudevashcha bhagadattashcha vIryavAn |
kali~NgastAmraliptashcha pattanAdhipatistathA
shlokas.13:
madrarAjastathA shalyaH sahaputro mahArathaH |
rukmA~Ngadena vIreNa tathA rukmarathena cha
shlokas.14:
kauravyaH somadattashcha putrAshchAsya mahArathAH |
samavetAstrayaH shUrA bhUrirbhUrishravAH shalaH
shlokas.15:
sudakShiNashcha kAmbojo dRRiDhadhanvA cha kauravaH |
bRRihadbalaH suSheNashcha shibiraushInarastathA
shlokas.16:
sa~NkarShaNo vAsudevo raukmiNeyashcha vIryavAn |
sAmbashcha chArudeShNashcha sAraNo.atha gadastathA
shlokas.17:
akrUraH sAtyakishchaiva uddhavashcha mahAbalaH |
kRRitavarmA cha hArdikyaH pRRithurvipRRithureva cha
shlokas.18:
viDUrathashcha ka~Nkashcha samIkaH sAramejayaH |
vIro vAtapatishchaiva jhillI piNDArakastathA
ushInarashcha vikrAnto vRRiShNayaste prakIrtitAH
shlokas.19:
bhagIratho bRRihatkShatraH saindhavashcha jayadrathaH |
bRRihadratho bAhlikashcha shrutAyushcha mahArathaH
shlokas.20:
ulUkaH kaitavo rAjA chitrA~NgadashubhA~Ngadau |
vatsarAjashcha dhRRitimAnkosalAdhipatistathA
shlokas.21:
ete chAnye cha bahavo nAnAjanapadeshvarAH |
tvadarthamAgatA bhadre kShatriyAH prathitA bhuvi
shlokas.22:
ete vetsyanti vikrAntAstvadarthaM lakShyamuttamam |
vidhyeta ya imaM lakShyaM varayethAH shubhe.adya tam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te.ala~NkRRitAH kuNDalino yuvAnaH; parasparaM spardhamAnAH sametAH |
astraM balaM chAtmani manyamAnAH; sarve samutpeturaha~NkRRitena
shlokas.2:
rUpeNa vIryeNa kulena chaiva; dharmeNa chaivApi cha yauvanena |
samRRiddhadarpA madavegabhinnA; mattA yathA haimavatA gajendrAH
shlokas.3:
parasparaM spardhayA prekShamANAH; sa~NkalpajenApi pariplutA~NgAH |
kRRiShNA mamaiShetyabhibhAShamANA; nRRipAsanebhyaH sahasopatasthuH
shlokas.4:
te kShatriyA ra~NgagatAH sametA; jigIShamANA drupadAtmajAM tAm |
chakAshire parvatarAjakanyA;mumAM yathA devagaNAH sametAH
shlokas.5:
kandarpabANAbhinipIDitA~NgAH; kRRiShNAgataiste hRRidayairnarendrAH |
ra~NgAvatIrNA drupadAtmajArthaM; dveShyAnhi chakruH suhRRido.api tatra
shlokas.6:
athAyayurdevagaNA vimAnai; rudrAdityA vasavo.athAshvinau cha |
sAdhyAshcha sarve marutastathaiva; yamaM puraskRRitya dhaneshvaraM cha
shlokas.7:
daityAH suparNAshcha mahoragAshcha; devarShayo guhyakAshchAraNAshcha |
vishvAvasurnAradaparvatau cha; gandharvamukhyAshcha sahApsarobhiH
shlokas.8:
halAyudhastatra cha keshavashcha; vRRiShNyandhakAshchaiva yathA pradhAnAH |
prekShAM sma chakruryadupu~NgavAste; sthitAshcha kRRiShNasya mate babhUvuH
shlokas.9:
dRRiShTvA hi tAnmattagajendrarUpA;npa~nchAbhipadmAniva vAraNendrAn |
bhasmAvRRitA~NgAniva havyavAhA;npArthAnpradadhyau sa yadupravIraH
shlokas.10:
shasha.nsa rAmAya yudhiShThiraM cha; bhImaM cha jiShNuM cha yamau cha vIrau |
shanaiH shanaistA.nshcha nirIkShya rAmo; janArdanaM prItamanA dadarsha
shlokas.11:
anye tu nAnAnRRipaputrapautrAH; kRRiShNAgatairnetramanaHsvabhAvaiH |
vyAyachChamAnA dadRRishurbhramantIM; sa.ndaShTadantachChadatAmravaktrAH
shlokas.12:
tathaiva pArthAH pRRithubAhavaste; vIrau yamau chaiva mahAnubhAvau |
tAM draupadIM prekShya tadA sma sarve; kandarpabANAbhihatA babhUvuH
shlokas.13:
devarShigandharvasamAkulaM ta;tsuparNanAgAsurasiddhajuShTam |
divyena gandhena samAkulaM cha; divyaishcha mAlyairavakIryamANam
shlokas.14:
mahAsvanairdundubhinAditaishcha; babhUva tatsa~NkulamantarikSham |
vimAnasambAdhamabhUtsamantA;tsaveNuvINApaNavAnunAdam
shlokas.15:
tatastu te rAjagaNAH krameNa; kRRiShNAnimittaM nRRipa vikramantaH |
tatkArmukaM saMhananopapannaM; sajyaM na shekustarasApi kartum
shlokas.16:
te vikramantaH sphuratA dRRiDhena; niShkRRiShyamANA dhanuShA narendrAH |
vicheShTamAnA dharaNItalasthA; dInA adRRishyanta vibhagnachittAH
shlokas.17:
hAhAkRRitaM taddhanuShA dRRiDhena; niShpiShTabhagnA~NgadakuNDalaM cha |
kRRiShNAnimittaM vinivRRittabhAvaM; rAj~nAM tadA maNDalamArtamAsIt
shlokas.18:
tasmi.nstu sambhrAntajane samAje; nikShiptavAdeShu narAdhipeShu |
kuntIsuto jiShNuriyeSha kartuM; sajyaM dhanustatsasharaM sa vIraH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yadA nivRRittA rAjAno dhanuShaH sajyakarmaNi |
athodatiShThadviprANAM madhyAjjiShNurudAradhIH
shlokas.2:
udakroshanvipramukhyA vidhunvanto.ajinAni cha |
dRRiShTvA samprasthitaM pArthamindraketusamaprabham
shlokas.3:
kechidAsanvimanasaH kechidAsanmudA yutAH |
AhuH parasparaM kechinnipuNA buddhijIvinaH
shlokas.4:
yatkarNashalyapramukhaiH pArthivairlokavishrutaiH |
nAnataM balavadbhirhi dhanurvedaparAyaNaiH
shlokas.5:
tatkathaM tvakRRitAstreNa prANato durbalIyasA |
baTumAtreNa shakyaM hi sajyaM kartuM dhanurdvijAH
shlokas.6:
avahAsyA bhaviShyanti brAhmaNAH sarvarAjasu |
karmaNyasminnasa.nsiddhe chApalAdaparIkShite
shlokas.7:
yadyeSha darpAddharShAdvA yadi vA brahmachApalAt |
prasthito dhanurAyantuM vAryatAM sAdhu mA gamat
shlokas.8:
nAvahAsyA bhaviShyAmo na cha lAghavamAsthitAH |
na cha vidviShTatAM loke gamiShyAmo mahIkShitAm
shlokas.9:
kechidAhuryuvA shrImAnnAgarAjakaropamaH |
pInaskandhorubAhushcha dhairyeNa himavAniva
shlokas.10:
sambhAvyamasminkarmedamutsAhAchchAnumIyate |
shaktirasya mahotsAhA na hyashaktaH svayaM vrajet
shlokas.11:
na cha tadvidyate ki~nchitkarma lokeShu yadbhavet |
brAhmaNAnAmasAdhyaM cha triShu sa.nsthAnachAriShu
shlokas.12:
abbhakShA vAyubhakShAshcha phalAhArA dRRiDhavratAH |
durbalA hi balIyA.nso viprA hi brahmatejasA
shlokas.13:
brAhmaNo nAvamantavyaH sadvAsadvA samAcharan |
sukhaM duHkhaM mahaddhrasvaM karma yatsamupAgatam
shlokas.14:
evaM teShAM vilapatAM viprANAM vividhA giraH |
arjuno dhanuSho.abhyAshe tasthau giririvAchalaH
shlokas.15:
sa taddhanuH parikramya pradakShiNamathAkarot |
praNamya shirasA hRRiShTo jagRRihe cha parantapaH
shlokas.16:
sajyaM cha chakre nimiShAntareNa; sharA.nshcha jagrAha dashArdhasa~NkhyAn |
vivyAdha lakShyaM nipapAta tachcha; ChidreNa bhUmau sahasAtividdham
shlokas.17:
tato.antarikShe cha babhUva nAdaH; samAjamadhye cha mahAnninAdaH |
puShpANi divyAni vavarSha devaH; pArthasya mUrdhni dviShatAM nihantuH
shlokas.18:
chelAvedhA.nstatashchakrurhAhAkArA.nshcha sarvashaH |
nyapata.nshchAtra nabhasaH samantAtpuShpavRRiShTayaH
shlokas.19:
shatA~NgAni cha tUryANi vAdakAshchApyavAdayan |
sUtamAgadhasa~NghAshcha astuva.nstatra susvanAH
shlokas.20:
taM dRRiShTvA drupadaH prIto babhUvAriniShUdanaH |
sahasainyashcha pArthasya sAhAyyArthamiyeSha saH
shlokas.21:
tasmi.nstu shabde mahati pravRRitte; yudhiShThiro dharmabhRRitAM variShThaH |
AvAsamevopajagAma shIghraM; sArdhaM yamAbhyAM puruShottamAbhyAm
shlokas.22:
viddhaM tu lakShyaM prasamIkShya kRRiShNA; pArthaM cha shakrapratimaM nirIkShya |
AdAya shuklaM varamAlyadAma; jagAma kuntIsutamutsmayantI
shlokas.23:
sa tAmupAdAya vijitya ra~Nge; dvijAtibhistairabhipUjyamAnaH |
ra~NgAnnirakrAmadachintyakarmA; patnyA tayA chApyanugamyamAnaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasmai ditsati kanyAM tu brAhmaNAya mahAtmane |
kopa AsInmahIpAnAmAlokyAnyonyamantikAt
shlokas.2:
asmAnayamatikramya tRRiNIkRRitya cha sa~NgatAn |
dAtumichChati viprAya draupadIM yoShitAM varAm
shlokas.3:
nihanmainaM durAtmAnaM yo.ayamasmAnna manyate |
na hyarhatyeSha satkAraM nApi vRRiddhakramaM guNaiH
shlokas.4:
hanmainaM saha putreNa durAchAraM nRRipadviSham |
ayaM hi sarvAnAhUya satkRRitya cha narAdhipAn
guNavadbhojayitvA cha tataH pashchAdvinindati
shlokas.5:
asminrAjasamAvAye devAnAmiva saMnaye |
kimayaM sadRRishaM ka~nchinnRRipatiM naiva dRRiShTavAn
shlokas.6:
na cha vipreShvadhIkAro vidyate varaNaM prati |
svaya.nvaraH kShatriyANAmitIyaM prathitA shrutiH
shlokas.7:
atha vA yadi kanyeyaM neha ka~nchidbubhUShati |
agnAvenAM parikShipya yAma rAShTrANi pArthivAH
shlokas.8:
brAhmaNo yadi vA bAlyAllobhAdvA kRRitavAnidam |
vipriyaM pArthivendrANAM naiSha vadhyaH katha~nchana
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNArthaM hi no rAjyaM jIvitaM cha vasUni cha |
putrapautraM cha yachchAnyadasmAkaM vidyate dhanam
shlokas.10:
avamAnabhayAdetatsvadharmasya cha rakShaNAt |
svaya.nvarANAM chAnyeShAM mA bhUdeva.nvidhA gatiH
shlokas.11:
ityuktvA rAjashArdUlA hRRiShTAH parighabAhavaH |
drupadaM sa~njighRRikShantaH sAyudhAH samupAdravan
shlokas.12:
tAngRRihItasharAvApAnkruddhAnApatato nRRipAn |
drupado vIkShya santrAsAdbrAhmaNA~nsharaNaM gataH
shlokas.13:
vegenApatatastA.nstu prabhinnAniva vAraNAn |
pANDuputrau mahAvIryau pratIyaturari.ndamau
shlokas.14:
tataH samutpeturudAyudhAste; mahIkShito baddhatalA~NgulitrAH |
jighA.nsamAnAH kururAjaputrA;vamarShayanto.arjunabhImasenau
shlokas.15:
tatastu bhImo.adbhutavIryakarmA; mahAbalo vajrasamAnavIryaH |
utpATya dorbhyAM drumamekavIro; niShpatrayAmAsa yathA gajendraH
shlokas.16:
taM vRRikShamAdAya ripupramAthI; daNDIva daNDaM pitRRirAja ugram |
tasthau samIpe puruSharShabhasya; pArthasya pArthaH pRRithudIrghabAhuH
shlokas.17:
tatprekShya karmAtimanuShyabuddhe;rjiShNoH sahabhrAturachintyakarmA |
dAmodaro bhrAtaramugravIryaM; halAyudhaM vAkyamidaM babhAShe
shlokas.18:
ya eSha mattarShabhatulyagAmI; mahaddhanuH karShati tAlamAtram |
eSho.arjuno nAtra vichAryamasti; yadyasmi sa~NkarShaNa vAsudevaH
shlokas.19:
ya eSha vRRikShaM tarasAvarujya; rAj~nAM vikAre sahasA nivRRittaH |
vRRikodaro nAnya ihaitadadya; kartuM samartho bhuvi martyadharmA
shlokas.20:
yo.asau purastAtkamalAyatAkSha;stanurmahAsiMhagatirvinItaH |
gauraH pralambojjvalachArughoNo; viniHsRRitaH so.achyuta dharmarAjaH
shlokas.21:
yau tau kumArAviva kArttikeyau; dvAvashvineyAviti me pratarkaH |
muktA hi tasmAjjatuveshmadAhA;nmayA shrutAH pANDusutAH pRRithA cha
shlokas.22:
tamabravInnirmalatoyadAbho; halAyudho.anantarajaM pratItaH |
prIto.asmi diShTyA hi pitRRiShvasA naH; pRRithA vimuktA saha kauravAgryaiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ajinAni vidhunvantaH karakA.nshcha dvijarShabhAH |
UchustaM bhIrna kartavyA vayaM yotsyAmahe parAn
shlokas.2:
tAnevaM vadato viprAnarjunaH prahasanniva |
uvAcha prekShakA bhUtvA yUyaM tiShThata pArshvataH
shlokas.3:
ahamenAnajihmAgraiH shatasho vikira~nsharaiH |
vArayiShyAmi sa~NkruddhAnmantrairAshIviShAniva
shlokas.4:
iti taddhanurAdAya shulkAvAptaM mahArathaH |
bhrAtrA bhImena sahitastasthau giririvAchalaH
shlokas.5:
tataH karNamukhAnkruddhAnkShatriyA.nstAnruShotthitAn |
sampetaturabhItau tau gajau pratigajAniva
shlokas.6:
Uchushcha vAchaH paruShAste rAjAno jighA.nsavaH |
Ahave hi dvijasyApi vadho dRRiShTo yuyutsataH
shlokas.7:
tato vaikartanaH karNo jagAmArjunamojasA |
yuddhArthI vAshitAhetorgajaH pratigajaM yathA
shlokas.8:
bhImasenaM yayau shalyo madrANAmIshvaro balI |
duryodhanAdayastvanye brAhmaNaiH saha sa~NgatAH
mRRidupUrvamayatnena pratyayudhya.nstadAhave
shlokas.9:
tato.arjunaH pratyavidhyadApatantaM tribhiH sharaiH |
karNaM vaikartanaM dhImAnvikRRiShya balavaddhanuH
shlokas.10:
teShAM sharANAM vegena shitAnAM tigmatejasAm |
vimuhyamAno rAdheyo yatnAttamanudhAvati
shlokas.11:
tAvubhAvapyanirdeshyau lAghavAjjayatAM varau |
ayudhyetAM susa.nrabdhAvanyonyavijayaiShiNau
shlokas.12:
kRRite pratikRRitaM pashya pashya bAhubalaM cha me |
iti shUrArthavachanairAbhAShetAM parasparam
shlokas.13:
tato.arjunasya bhujayorvIryamapratimaM bhuvi |
j~nAtvA vaikartanaH karNaH sa.nrabdhaH samayodhayat
shlokas.14:
arjunena prayuktA.nstAnbANAnvegavatastadA |
pratihatya nanAdochchaiH sainyAstamabhipUjayan
shlokas.15:
karNa uvAcha||
tuShyAmi te vipramukhya bhujavIryasya sa.nyuge |
aviShAdasya chaivAsya shastrAstravinayasya cha
shlokas.16:
kiM tvaM sAkShAddhanurvedo rAmo vA viprasattama |
atha sAkShAddharihayaH sAkShAdvA viShNurachyutaH
shlokas.17:
AtmaprachChAdanArthaM vai bAhuvIryamupAshritaH |
viprarUpaM vidhAyedaM tato mAM pratiyudhyase
shlokas.18:
na hi mAmAhave kruddhamanyaH sAkShAchChachIpateH |
pumAnyodhayituM shaktaH pANDavAdvA kirITinaH
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tameva.nvAdinaM tatra phalgunaH pratyabhAShata |
nAsmi karNa dhanurvedo nAsmi rAmaH pratApavAn
brAhmaNo.asmi yudhAM shreShThaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.20:
brAhme paura.ndare chAstre niShThito gurushAsanAt |
sthito.asmyadya raNe jetuM tvAM vIrAvichalo bhava
shlokas.21:
evamuktastu rAdheyo yuddhAtkarNo nyavartata |
brahmaM tejastadAjayyaM manyamAno mahArathaH
shlokas.22:
yuddhaM tUpeyatustatra rAja~nshalyavRRikodarau |
balinau yugapanmattau spardhayA cha balena cha
shlokas.23:
anyonyamAhvayantau tau mattAviva mahAgajau |
muShTibhirjAnubhishchaiva nighnantAvitaretaram
muhUrtaM tau tathAnyonyaM samare paryakarShatAm
shlokas.24:
tato bhImaH samutkShipya bAhubhyAM shalyamAhave |
nyavadhIdbalinAM shreShTho jahasurbrAhmaNAstataH
shlokas.25:
tatrAshcharyaM bhImasenashchakAra puruSharShabhaH |
yachChalyaM patitaM bhUmau nAhanadbalinaM balI
shlokas.26:
pAtite bhImasenena shalye karNe cha sha~Nkite |
sha~NkitAH sarvarAjAnaH parivavrurvRRikodaram
shlokas.27:
Uchushcha sahitAstatra sAdhvime brAhmaNarShabhAH |
vij~nAyantAM kvajanmAnaH kvanivAsAstathaiva cha
shlokas.28:
ko hi rAdhAsutaM karmaM shakto yodhayituM raNe |
anyatra rAmAddroNAdvA kRRipAdvApi sharadvataH
shlokas.29:
kRRiShNAdvA devakIputrAtphalgunAdvA parantapAt |
ko vA duryodhanaM shaktaH pratiyodhayituM raNe
shlokas.30:
tathaiva madrarAjAnaM shalyaM balavatAM varam |
baladevAdRRite vIrAtpANDavAdvA vRRikodarAt
shlokas.31:
kriyatAmavahAro.asmAdyuddhAdbrAhmaNasa.nyutAt |
athainAnupalabhyeha punaryotsyAmahe vayam
shlokas.32:
tatkarma bhImasya samIkShya kRRiShNaH; kuntIsutau tau parisha~NkamAnaH |
nivArayAmAsa mahIpatI.nstA;ndharmeNa labdhetyanunIya sarvAn
shlokas.33:
ta evaM saMnivRRittAstu yuddhAdyuddhavishAradAH |
yathAvAsaM yayuH sarve vismitA rAjasattamAH
shlokas.34:
vRRitto brahmottaro ra~NgaH pA~nchAlI brAhmaNairvRRitA |
iti bruvantaH prayayurye tatrAsansamAgatAH
shlokas.35:
brAhmaNaistu pratichChannau rauravAjinavAsibhiH |
kRRichChreNa jagmatustatra bhImasenadhana~njayau
shlokas.36:
vimuktau janasambAdhAchChatrubhiH parivikShatau |
kRRiShNayAnugatau tatra nRRivIrau tau virejatuH
shlokas.37:
teShAM mAtA bahuvidhaM vinAshaM paryachintayat |
anAgachChatsu putreShu bhaikShakAle.atigachChati
shlokas.38:
dhArtarAShTrairhatA na syurvij~nAya kurupu~NgavAH |
mAyAnvitairvA rakShobhiH sughorairdRRiDhavairibhiH
shlokas.39:
viparItaM mataM jAtaM vyAsasyApi mahAtmanaH |
ityevaM chintayAmAsa sutasnehAnvitA pRRithA
shlokas.40:
mahatyathAparAhNe tu ghanaiH sUrya ivAvRRitaH |
brAhmaNaiH prAvishattatra jiShNurbrahmapuraskRRitaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
gatvA tu tAM bhArgavakarmashAlAM; pArthau pRRithAM prApya mahAnubhAvau |
tAM yAj~nasenIM paramapratItau; bhikShetyathAvedayatAM narAgryau
shlokas.2:
kuTIgatA sA tvanavekShya putrA;nuvAcha bhu~Nkteti sametya sarve |
pashchAttu kuntI prasamIkShya kanyAM; kaShTaM mayA bhAShitamityuvAcha
shlokas.3:
sAdharmabhItA hi vilajjamAnA; tAM yAj~nasenIM paramapratItAm |
pANau gRRihItvopajagAma kuntI; yudhiShThiraM vAkyamuvAcha chedam
shlokas.4:
iyaM hi kanyA drupadasya rAj~na;stavAnujAbhyAM mayi saMnisRRiShTA |
yathochitaM putra mayApi choktaM; sametya bhu~Nkteti nRRipa pramAdAt
shlokas.5:
kathaM mayA nAnRRitamuktamadya; bhavetkurUNAmRRiShabha bravIhi |
pA~nchAlarAjasya sutAmadharmo; na chopavarteta nabhUtapUrvaH
shlokas.6:
muhUrtamAtraM tvanuchintya rAjA; yudhiShThiro mAtaramuttamaujAH |
kuntIM samAshvAsya kurupravIro; dhana~njayaM vAkyamidaM babhAShe
shlokas.7:
tvayA jitA pANDava yAj~nasenI; tvayA cha toShiShyati rAjaputrI |
prajvAlyatAM hUyatAM chApi vahni;rgRRihANa pANiM vidhivattvamasyAH
shlokas.8:
arjuna uvAcha||
mA mAM narendra tvamadharmabhAjaM; kRRithA na dharmo hyayamIpsito.anyaiH |
bhavAnniveshyaH prathamaM tato.ayaM; bhImo mahAbAhurachintyakarmA
shlokas.9:
ahaM tato nakulo.anantaraM me; mAdrIsutaH sahadevo jaghanyaH |
vRRikodaro.ahaM cha yamau cha rAja;nniyaM cha kanyA bhavataH sma sarve
shlokas.10:
eva~Ngate yatkaraNIyamatra; dharmyaM yashasyaM kuru tatprachintya |
pA~nchAlarAjasya cha yatpriyaM syA;ttadbrUhi sarve sma vashe sthitAste
shlokas.11:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te dRRiShTvA tatra tiShThantIM sarve kRRiShNAM yashasvinIm |
samprekShyAnyonyamAsInA hRRidayaistAmadhArayan
shlokas.12:
teShAM hi draupadIM dRRiShTvA sarveShAmamitaujasAm |
sampramathyendriyagrAmaM prAdurAsInmanobhavaH
shlokas.13:
kAmyaM rUpaM hi pA~nchAlyA vidhAtrA vihitaM svayam |
babhUvAdhikamanyAbhyaH sarvabhUtamanoharam
shlokas.14:
teShAmAkArabhAvaj~naH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
dvaipAyanavachaH kRRitsnaM sa.nsmaranvai nararShabha
shlokas.15:
abravItsa hi tAnbhrAtRRinmithobhedabhayAnnRRipaH |
sarveShAM draupadI bhAryA bhaviShyati hi naH shubhA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bhrAturvachastatprasamIkShya sarve; jyeShThasya pANDostanayAstadAnIm |
tamevArthaM dhyAyamAnA manobhi;rAsAM chakruratha tatrAmitaujAH
shlokas.2:
vRRiShNipravIrastu kurupravIrA;nAsha~NkamAnaH saharauhiNeyaH |
jagAma tAM bhArgavakarmashAlAM; yatrAsate te puruShapravIrAH
shlokas.3:
tatropaviShTaM pRRithudIrghabAhuM; dadarsha kRRiShNaH saharauhiNeyaH |
ajAtashatruM parivArya tA.nshcha; upopaviShTA~njvalanaprakAshAn
shlokas.4:
tato.abravIdvAsudevo.abhigamya; kuntIsutaM dharmabhRRitAM variShTham |
kRRiShNo.ahamasmIti nipIDya pAdau; yudhiShThirasyAjamIDhasya rAj~naH
shlokas.5:
tathaiva tasyApyanu rauhiNeya;stau chApi hRRiShTAH kuravo.abhyanandan |
pitRRiShvasushchApi yadupravIrA;vagRRihNatAM bhAratamukhya pAdau
shlokas.6:
ajAtashatrushcha kurupravIraH; paprachCha kRRiShNaM kushalaM nivedya |
kathaM vayaM vAsudeva tvayeha; gUDhA vasanto viditAH sma sarve
shlokas.7:
tamabravIdvAsudevaH prahasya; gUDho.apyagnirj~nAyata eva rAjan |
taM vikramaM pANDaveyAnatItya; ko.anyaH kartA vidyate mAnuSheShu
shlokas.8:
diShTyA tasmAtpAvakAtsampramuktA; yUyaM sarve pANDavAH shatrusAhAH |
diShTyA pApo dhRRitarAShTrasya putraH; sahAmAtyo na sakAmo.abhaviShyat
shlokas.9:
bhadraM vo.astu nihitaM yadguhAyAM; vivardhadhvaM jvalana ivedhyamAnaH |
mA vo vidyuH pArthivAH kechaneha; yAsyAvahe shibirAyaiva tAvat
so.anuj~nAtaH pANDavenAvyayashrIH; prAyAchChIghraM baladevena sArdham

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dhRRiShTadyumnastu pA~nchAlyaH pRRiShThataH kurunandanau |
anvagachChattadA yAntau bhArgavasya niveshanam
shlokas.2:
so.aj~nAyamAnaH puruShAnavadhAya samantataH |
svayamArAnniviShTo.abhUdbhArgavasya niveshane
shlokas.3:
sAye.atha bhImastu ripupramAthI; jiShNuryamau chApi mahAnubhAvau |
bhaikShaM charitvA tu yudhiShThirAya; nivedayAM chakruradInasattvAH
shlokas.4:
tatastu kuntI drupadAtmajAM tA;muvAcha kAle vachanaM vadAnyA |
ato.agramAdAya kuruShva bhadre; baliM cha viprAya cha dehi bhikShAm
shlokas.5:
ye chAnnamichChanti dadasva tebhyaH; parishritA ye parito manuShyAH |
tatashcha sheShaM pravibhajya shIghra;mardhaM chaturNAM mama chAtmanashcha
shlokas.6:
ardhaM cha bhImAya dadAhi bhadre; ya eSha mattarShabhatulyarUpaH |
shyAmo yuvA saMhananopapanna; eSho hi vIro bahubhuksadaiva
shlokas.7:
sA hRRiShTarUpaiva tu rAjaputrI; tasyA vachaH sAdhvavisha~NkamAnA |
yathAvaduktaM prachakAra sAdhvI; te chApi sarve.abhyavajahrurannam
shlokas.8:
kushaistu bhUmau shayanaM chakAra; mAdrIsutaH sahadevastarasvI |
yathAtmIyAnyajinAni sarve; sa.nstIrya vIrAH suShupurdharaNyAm
shlokas.9:
agastyashAstAmabhito dishaM tu; shirA.nsi teShAM kurusattamAnAm |
kuntI purastAttu babhUva teShAM; kRRiShNA tirashchaiva babhUva pattaH
shlokas.10:
asheta bhUmau saha pANDuputraiH; pAdopadhAneva kRRitA kusheShu |
na tatra duHkhaM cha babhUva tasyA; na chAvamene kurupu~NgavA.nstAn
shlokas.11:
te tatra shUrAH kathayAM babhUvuH; kathA vichitrAH pRRitanAdhikArAH |
astrANi divyAni rathA.nshcha nAgA;nkhaDgAngadAshchApi parashvadhA.nshcha
shlokas.12:
teShAM kathAstAH parikIrtyamAnAH; pA~nchAlarAjasya sutastadAnIm |
shushrAva kRRiShNAM cha tathA niShaNNAM; te chApi sarve dadRRishurmanuShyAH
shlokas.13:
dhRRiShTadyumno rAjaputrastu sarvaM; vRRittaM teShAM kathitaM chaiva rAtrau |
sarvaM rAj~ne drupadAyAkhilena; nivedayiShya.nstvarito jagAma
shlokas.14:
pA~nchAlarAjastu viShaNNarUpa;stAnpANDavAnaprativindamAnaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM paryapRRichChanmahAtmA; kva sA gatA kena nItA cha kRRiShNA
shlokas.15:
kachchinna shUdreNa na hInajena; vaishyena vA karadenopapannA |
kachchitpadaM mUrdhni na me nidigdhaM; kachchinmAlA patitA na shmashAne
shlokas.16:
kachchitsavarNapravaro manuShya; udriktavarNo.apyuta veha kachchit |
kachchinna vAmo mama mUrdhni pAdaH; kRRiShNAbhimarshena kRRito.adya putra
shlokas.17:
kachchichcha yakShye paramapratItaH; sa.nyujya pArthena nararShabheNa |
bravIhi tattvena mahAnubhAvaH; ko.asau vijetA duhiturmamAdya
shlokas.18:
vichitravIryasya tu kachchidadya; kurupravIrasya dharanti putrAH |
kachchittu pArthena yavIyasAdya; dhanurgRRihItaM nihataM cha lakShyam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastathoktaH parihRRiShTarUpaH; pitre shasha.nsAtha sa rAjaputraH |
dhRRiShTadyumnaH somakAnAM prabarho; vRRittaM yathA yena hRRitA cha kRRiShNA
shlokas.2:
yo.asau yuvA svAyatalohitAkShaH; kRRiShNAjinI devasamAnarUpaH |
yaH kArmukAgryaM kRRitavAnadhijyaM; lakShyaM cha tatpAtitavAnpRRithivyAm
shlokas.3:
asajjamAnashcha gatastarasvI; vRRito dvijAgryairabhipUjyamAnaH |
chakrAma vajrIva diteH suteShu; sarvaishcha devairRRiShibhishcha juShTaH
shlokas.4:
kRRiShNA cha gRRihyAjinamanvayAttaM; nAgaM yathA nAgavadhUH prahRRiShTA |
amRRiShyamANeShu narAdhipeShu; kruddheShu taM tatra samApatatsu
shlokas.5:
tato.aparaH pArthivarAjamadhye; pravRRiddhamArujya mahIpraroham |
prakAlayanneva sa pArthivaughA;nkruddho.antakaH prANabhRRito yathaiva
shlokas.6:
tau pArthivAnAM miShatAM narendra; kRRiShNAmupAdAya gatau narAgryau |
vibhrAjamAnAviva chandrasUryau; bAhyAM purAdbhArgavakarmashAlAm
shlokas.7:
tatropaviShTArchirivAnalasya; teShAM janitrIti mama pratarkaH |
tathAvidhaireva narapravIrai;rupopaviShTaistribhiragnikalpaiH
shlokas.8:
tasyAstatastAvabhivAdya pAdA;vuktvA cha kRRiShNAmabhivAdayeti |
sthitau cha tatraiva nivedya kRRiShNAM; bhaikShaprachArAya gatA narAgryAH
shlokas.9:
teShAM tu bhaikShaM pratigRRihya kRRiShNA; kRRitvA baliM brAhmaNasAchcha kRRitvA |
tAM chaiva vRRiddhAM pariviShya tA.nshcha; narapravIrAnsvayamapyabhu~Nkta
shlokas.10:
suptAstu te pArthiva sarva eva; kRRiShNA tu teShAM charaNopadhAnam |
AsItpRRithivyAM shayanaM cha teShAM; darbhAjinAgryAstaraNopapannam
shlokas.11:
te nardamAnA iva kAlameghAH; kathA vichitrAH kathayAM babhUvuH |
na vaishyashUdraupayikIH kathAstA; na cha dvijAteH kathayanti vIrAH
shlokas.12:
niHsa.nshayaM kShatriyapu~NgavAste; yathA hi yuddhaM kathayanti rAjan |
AshA hi no vyaktamiyaM samRRiddhA; muktAnhi pArthA~nshRRiNumo.agnidAhAt
shlokas.13:
yathA hi lakShyaM nihataM dhanushcha; sajyaM kRRitaM tena tathA prasahya |
yathA cha bhAShanti parasparaM te; ChannA dhruvaM te pracharanti pArthAH
shlokas.14:
tataH sa rAjA drupadaH prahRRiShTaH; purohitaM preShayAM tatra chakre |
vidyAma yuShmAniti bhAShamANo; mahAtmanaH pANDusutAH stha kachchit
shlokas.15:
gRRihItavAkyo nRRipateH purodhA; gatvA prasha.nsAmabhidhAya teShAm |
vAkyaM yathAvannRRipateH samagra;muvAcha tAnsa kramavitkrameNa
shlokas.16:
vij~nAtumichChatyavanIshvaro vaH; pA~nchAlarAjo drupado varArhAH |
lakShyasya veddhAramimaM hi dRRiShTvA; harShasya nAntaM paripashyate saH
shlokas.17:
tadAchaDDhvaM j~nAtikulAnupUrvIM; padaM shiraHsu dviShatAM kurudhvam |
prahlAdayadhvaM hRRidayaM mamedaM; pA~nchAlarAjasya sahAnugasya
shlokas.18:
pANDurhi rAjA drupadasya rAj~naH; priyaH sakhA chAtmasamo babhUva |
tasyaiSha kAmo duhitA mameyaM; snuShA yadi syAditi kauravasya
shlokas.19:
ayaM cha kAmo drupadasya rAj~no; hRRidi sthito nityamaninditA~NgAH |
yadarjuno vai pRRithudIrghabAhu;rdharmeNa vindeta sutAM mameti
shlokas.20:
tathoktavAkyaM tu purohitaM taM; sthitaM vinItaM samudIkShya rAjA |
samIpasthaM bhImamidaM shashAsa; pradIyatAM pAdyamarghyaM tathAsmai
shlokas.21:
mAnyaH purodhA drupadasya rAj~na;stasmai prayojyAbhyadhikaiva pUjA |
bhImastathA tatkRRitavAnnarendra; tAM chaiva pUjAM pratisa~NgRRihItvA
shlokas.22:
sukhopaviShTaM tu purohitaM taM; yudhiShThiro brAhmaNamityuvAcha |
pA~nchAlarAjena sutA nisRRiShTA; svadharmadRRiShTena yathAnukAmam
shlokas.23:
pradiShTashulkA drupadena rAj~nA; sAnena vIreNa tathAnuvRRittA |
na tatra varNeShu kRRitA vivakShA; na jIvashilpe na kule na gotre
shlokas.24:
kRRitena sajyena hi kArmukeNa; viddhena lakShyeNa cha saMnisRRiShTA |
seyaM tathAnena mahAtmaneha; kRRiShNA jitA pArthivasa~Nghamadhye
shlokas.25:
naiva~Ngate saumakiradya rAjA; santApamarhatyasukhAya kartum |
kAmashcha yo.asau drupadasya rAj~naH; sa chApi sampatsyati pArthivasya
shlokas.26:
aprApyarUpAM hi narendrakanyA;mimAmahaM brAhmaNa sAdhu manye |
na taddhanurmandabalena shakyaM; maurvyA samAyojayituM tathA hi
na chAkRRitAstreNa na hInajena; lakShyaM tathA pAtayituM hi shakyam
shlokas.27:
tasmAnna tApaM duhiturnimittaM; pA~nchAlarAjo.arhati kartumadya |
na chApi tatpAtanamanyatheha; kartuM viShahyaM bhuvi mAnavena
shlokas.28:
evaM bruvatyeva yudhiShThire tu; pA~nchAlarAjasya samIpato.anyaH |
tatrAjagAmAshu naro dvitIyo; nivedayiShyanniha siddhamannam

shlokas.1:
dUta uvAcha||
janyArthamannaM drupadena rAj~nA; vivAhahetorupasa.nskRRitaM cha |
tadApnuvadhvaM kRRitasarvakAryAH; kRRiShNA cha tatraiva chiraM na kAryam
shlokas.2:
ime rathAH kA~nchanapadmachitrAH; sadashvayuktA vasudhAdhipArhAH |
etAnsamAruhya paraita sarve; pA~nchAlarAjasya niveshanaM tat
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH prayAtAH kurupu~NgavAste; purohitaM taM prathamaM prayApya |
AsthAya yAnAni mahAnti tAni; kuntI cha kRRiShNA cha sahaiva yAte
shlokas.4:
shrutvA tu vAkyAni purohitasya; yAnyuktavAnbhArata dharmarAjaH |
jij~nAsayaivAtha kurUttamAnAM; dravyANyanekAnyupasa~njahAra
shlokas.5:
phalAni mAlyAni susa.nskRRitAni; charmANi varmANi tathAsanAni |
gAshchaiva rAjannatha chaiva rajjU;rdravyANi chAnyAni kRRiShInimittam
shlokas.6:
anyeShu shilpeShu cha yAnyapi syuH; sarvANi kL^iptAnyakhilena tatra |
krIDAnimittAni cha yAni tAni; sarvANi tatropajahAra rAjA
shlokas.7:
rathAshvavarmANi cha bhAnumanti; khaDgA mahAnto.ashvarathAshcha chitrAH |
dhanUMShi chAgryANi sharAshcha mukhyAH; shaktyRRiShTayaH kA~nchanabhUShitAshcha
shlokas.8:
prAsA bhushuNDyashcha parashvadhAshcha; sA~NgrAmikaM chaiva tathaiva sarvam |
shayyAsanAnyuttamasa.nskRRitAni; tathaiva chAsanvividhAni tatra
shlokas.9:
kuntI tu kRRiShNAM parigRRihya sAdhvI;mantaHpuraM drupadasyAviveSha |
striyashcha tAM kauravarAjapatnIM; pratyarchayAM chakruradInasattvAH
shlokas.10:
tAnsiMhavikrAntagatInavekShya; maharShabhAkShAnajinottarIyAn |
gUDhottarA.nsAnbhujagendrabhoga;pralambabAhUnpuruShapravIrAn
shlokas.11:
rAjA cha rAj~naH sachivAshcha sarve; putrAshcha rAj~naH suhRRidastathaiva |
preShyAshcha sarve nikhilena rAja;nharShaM samApeturatIva tatra
shlokas.12:
te tatra vIrAH paramAsaneShu; sapAdapITheShvavisha~NkamAnAH |
yathAnupUrvyA vivishurnarAgryA;stadA mahArheShu na vismayantaH
shlokas.13:
uchchAvachaM pArthivabhojanIyaM; pAtrIShu jAmbUnadarAjatIShu |
dAsAshcha dAsyashcha sumRRiShTaveShAH; bhojApakAshchApyupajahrurannam
shlokas.14:
te tatra bhuktvA puruShapravIrA; yathAnukAmaM subhRRishaM pratItAH |
utkramya sarvANi vasUni tatra; sA~NgrAmikAnyAvivishurnRRivIrAH
shlokas.15:
tallakShayitvA drupadasya putro; rAjA cha sarvaiH saha mantrimukhyaiH |
samarchayAmAsurupetya hRRiShTAH; kuntIsutAnpArthivaputrapautrAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tata AhUya pA~nchAlyo rAjaputraM yudhiShThiram |
parigraheNa brAhmeNa parigRRihya mahAdyutiH
shlokas.2:
paryapRRichChadadInAtmA kuntIputraM suvarchasam |
kathaM jAnIma bhavataH kShatriyAnbrAhmaNAnuta
shlokas.3:
vaishyAnvA guNasampannAnuta vA shUdrayonijAn |
mAyAmAsthAya vA siddhA.nshcharataH sarvatodisham
shlokas.4:
kRRiShNAhetoranuprAptAndivaH sa.ndarshanArthinaH |
bravItu no bhavAnsatyaM sa.ndeho hyatra no mahAn
shlokas.5:
api naH sa.nshayasyAnte manastuShTirihAvishet |
api no bhAgadheyAni shubhAni syuH parantapa
shlokas.6:
kAmayA brUhi satyaM tvaM satyaM rAjasu shobhate |
iShTApUrtena cha tathA vaktavyamanRRitaM na tu
shlokas.7:
shrutvA hyamarasa~NkAsha tava vAkyamari.ndama |
dhruvaM vivAhakaraNamAsthAsyAmi vidhAnataH
shlokas.8:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mA rAjanvimanA bhUstvaM pA~nchAlya prItirastu te |
Ipsitaste dhruvaH kAmaH sa.nvRRitto.ayamasa.nshayam
shlokas.9:
vayaM hi kShatriyA rAjanpANDoH putrA mahAtmanaH |
jyeShThaM mAM viddhi kaunteyaM bhImasenArjunAvimau
yAbhyAM tava sutA rAjannirjitA rAjasa.nsadi
shlokas.10:
yamau tu tatra rAjendra yatra kRRiShNA pratiShThitA |
vyetu te mAnasaM duHkhaM kShatriyAH smo nararShabha
padminIva suteyaM te hradAdanyaM hradaM gatA
shlokas.11:
iti tathyaM mahArAja sarvametadbravImi te |
bhavAnhi gururasmAkaM paramaM cha parAyaNam
shlokas.12:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sa drupado rAjA harShavyAkulalochanaH |
prativaktuM tadA yuktaM nAshakattaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.13:
yatnena tu sa taM harShaM saMnigRRihya parantapaH |
anurUpaM tato rAjA pratyuvAcha yudhiShThiram
shlokas.14:
paprachCha chainaM dharmAtmA yathA te pradrutAH purA |
sa tasmai sarvamAchakhyAvAnupUrvyeNa pANDavaH
shlokas.15:
tachChrutvA drupado rAjA kuntIputrasya bhAShitam |
vigarhayAmAsa tadA dhRRitarAShTraM janeshvaram
shlokas.16:
AshvAsayAmAsa cha taM kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram |
pratijaj~ne cha rAjyAya drupado vadatAM varaH
shlokas.17:
tataH kuntI cha kRRiShNA cha bhImasenArjunAvapi |
yamau cha rAj~nA sa.ndiShTau vivishurbhavanaM mahat
shlokas.18:
tatra te nyavasanrAjanyaj~nasenena pUjitAH |
pratyAshvastA.nstato rAjA saha putrairuvAcha tAn
shlokas.19:
gRRihNAtu vidhivatpANimadyaiva kurunandanaH |
puNye.ahani mahAbAhurarjunaH kurutAM kShaNam
shlokas.20:
tatastamabravIdrAjA dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
mamApi dArasambandhaH kAryastAvadvishAM pate
shlokas.21:
drupada uvAcha||
bhavAnvA vidhivatpANiM gRRihNAtu duhiturmama |
yasya vA manyase vIra tasya kRRiShNAmupAdisha
shlokas.22:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sarveShAM draupadI rAjanmahiShI no bhaviShyati |
evaM hi vyAhRRitaM pUrvaM mama mAtrA vishAM pate
shlokas.23:
ahaM chApyaniviShTo vai bhImasenashcha pANDavaH |
pArthena vijitA chaiShA ratnabhUtA cha te sutA
shlokas.24:
eSha naH samayo rAjanratnasya sahabhojanam |
na cha taM hAtumichChAmaH samayaM rAjasattama
shlokas.25:
sarveShAM dharmataH kRRiShNA mahiShI no bhaviShyati |
AnupUrvyeNa sarveShAM gRRihNAtu jvalane karam
shlokas.26:
drupada uvAcha||
ekasya bahvyo vihitA mahiShyaH kurunandana |
naikasyA bahavaH pu.nso vidhIyante kadAchana
shlokas.27:
lokavedaviruddhaM tvaM nAdharmaM dhArmikaH shuchiH |
kartumarhasi kaunteya kasmAtte buddhirIdRRishI
shlokas.28:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sUkShmo dharmo mahArAja nAsya vidmo vayaM gatim |
pUrveShAmAnupUrvyeNa yAtaM vartmAnuyAmahe
shlokas.29:
na me vAganRRitaM prAha nAdharme dhIyate matiH |
evaM chaiva vadatyambA mama chaiva manogatam
shlokas.30:
eSha dharmo dhruvo rAja.nshcharainamavichArayan |
mA cha te.atra visha~NkA bhUtkatha~nchidapi pArthiva
shlokas.31:
drupada uvAcha||
tvaM cha kuntI cha kaunteya dhRRiShTadyumnashcha me sutaH |
kathayantvitikartavyaM shvaH kAle karavAmahe
shlokas.32:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te sametya tataH sarve kathayanti sma bhArata |
atha dvaipAyano rAjannabhyAgachChadyadRRichChayA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataste pANDavAH sarve pA~nchAlyashcha mahAyashAH |
pratyutthAya mahAtmAnaM kRRiShNaM dRRiShTvAbhyapUjayan
shlokas.2:
pratinandya sa tAnsarvAnpRRiShTvA kushalamantataH |
Asane kA~nchane shubhre niShasAda mahAmanAH
shlokas.3:
anuj~nAtAstu te sarve kRRiShNenAmitatejasA |
AsaneShu mahArheShu niShedurdvipadAM varAH
shlokas.4:
tato muhUrtAnmadhurAM vANImuchchArya pArShataH |
paprachCha taM mahAtmAnaM draupadyarthe vishAM patiH
shlokas.5:
kathamekA bahUnAM syAnna cha syAddharmasa~NkaraH |
etanno bhagavAnsarvaM prabravItu yathAtatham
shlokas.6:
vyAsa uvAcha||
asmindharme vipralambhe lokavedavirodhake |
yasya yasya mataM yadyachChrotumichChAmi tasya tat
shlokas.7:
drupada uvAcha||
adharmo.ayaM mama mato viruddho lokavedayoH |
na hyekA vidyate patnI bahUnAM dvijasattama
shlokas.8:
na chApyAcharitaH pUrvairayaM dharmo mahAtmabhiH |
na cha dharmo.apyanekasthashcharitavyaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.9:
ato nAhaM karomyevaM vyavasAyaM kriyAM prati |
dharmasa.ndehasa.ndigdhaM pratibhAti hi mAmidam
shlokas.10:
dhRRiShTadyumna uvAcha||
yavIyasaH kathaM bhAryAM jyeShTho bhrAtA dvijarShabha |
brahmansamabhivarteta sadvRRittaH sa.nstapodhana
shlokas.11:
na tu dharmasya sUkShmatvAdgatiM vidmaH katha~nchana |
adharmo dharma iti vA vyavasAyo na shakyate
shlokas.12:
kartumasmadvidhairbrahma.nstato na vyavasAmyaham |
pa~nchAnAM mahiShI kRRiShNA bhavatviti katha~nchana
shlokas.13:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
na me vAganRRitaM prAha nAdharme dhIyate matiH |
vartate hi mano me.atra naiSho.adharmaH katha~nchana
shlokas.14:
shrUyate hi purANe.api jaTilA nAma gautamI |
RRiShInadhyAsitavatI sapta dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.15:
guroshcha vachanaM prAhurdharmaM dharmaj~nasattama |
gurUNAM chaiva sarveShAM janitrI paramo guruH
shlokas.16:
sA chApyuktavatI vAchaM bhaikShavadbhujyatAmiti |
tasmAdetadahaM manye dharmaM dvijavarottama
shlokas.17:
kuntyuvAcha||
evametadyathAhAyaM dharmachArI yudhiShThiraH |
anRRitAnme bhayaM tIvraM muchyeyamanRRitAtkatham
shlokas.18:
vyAsa uvAcha||
anRRitAnmokShyase bhadre dharmashchaiSha sanAtanaH |
na tu vakShyAmi sarveShAM pA~nchAla shRRiNu me svayam
shlokas.19:
yathAyaM vihito dharmo yatashchAyaM sanAtanaH |
yathA cha prAha kaunteyastathA dharmo na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.20:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tata utthAya bhagavAnvyAso dvaipAyanaH prabhuH |
kare gRRihItvA rAjAnaM rAjaveshma samAvishat
shlokas.21:
pANDavAshchApi kuntI cha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
vichetasaste tatraiva pratIkShante sma tAvubhau
shlokas.22:
tato dvaipAyanastasmai narendrAya mahAtmane |
Achakhyau tadyathA dharmo bahUnAmekapatnitA

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
purA vai naimiShAraNye devAH satramupAsate |
tatra vaivasvato rAja~nshAmitramakarottadA
shlokas.2:
tato yamo dIkShitastatra rAja;nnAmArayatki~nchidapi prajAbhyaH |
tataH prajAstA bahulA babhUvuH; kAlAtipAtAnmaraNAtprahINAH
shlokas.3:
tatastu shakro varuNaH kuberaH; sAdhyA rudrA vasavashchAshvinau cha |
praNetAraM bhuvanasya prajApatiM; samAjagmustatra devAstathAnye
shlokas.4:
tato.abruva.NllokaguruM sametA; bhayaM nastIvraM mAnuShANAM vivRRiddhyA |
tasmAdbhayAdudvijantaH sukhepsavaH; prayAma sarve sharaNaM bhavantam
shlokas.5:
brahmovAcha||
kiM vo bhayaM mAnuShebhyo yUyaM sarve yadAmarAH |
mA vo martyasakAshAdvai bhayaM bhavatu karhichit
shlokas.6:
devA UchuH||
martyA hyamartyAH sa.nvRRittA na visheSho.asti kashchana |
avisheShAdudvijanto visheShArthamihAgatAH
shlokas.7:
brahmovAcha||
vaivasvato vyApRRitaH satraheto;stena tvime na mriyante manuShyAH |
tasminnekAgre kRRitasarvakArye; tata eShAM bhavitaivAntakAlaH
shlokas.8:
vaivasvatasyApi tanurvibhUtA; vIryeNa yuShmAkamuta prayuktA |
saiShAmanto bhavitA hyantakAle; tanurhi vIryaM bhavitA nareShu
shlokas.9:
vyAsa uvAcha||
tatastu te pUrvajadevavAkyaM; shrutvA devA yatra devA yajante |
samAsInAste sametA mahAbalA; bhAgIrathyAM dadRRishuH puNDarIkam
shlokas.10:
dRRiShTvA cha tadvismitAste babhUvu;steShAmindrastatra shUro jagAma |
so.apashyadyoShAmatha pAvakaprabhAM; yatra ga~NgA satataM samprasUtA
shlokas.11:
sA tatra yoShA rudatI jalArthinI; ga~NgAM devIM vyavagAhyAvatiShThat |
tasyAshrubinduH patito jale vai; tatpadmamAsIdatha tatra kA~nchanam
shlokas.12:
tadadbhutaM prekShya vajrI tadAnI;mapRRichChattAM yoShitamantikAdvai |
kA tvaM kathaM rodiShi kasya heto;rvAkyaM tathyaM kAmayeha bravIhi
shlokas.13:
stryuvAcha||
tvaM vetsyase mAmiha yAsmi shakra; yadarthaM chAhaM rodimi mandabhAgyA |
AgachCha rAjanpurato.ahaM gamiShye; draShTAsi tadrodimi yatkRRite.aham
shlokas.14:
vyAsa uvAcha||
tAM gachChantImanvagachChattadAnIM; so.apashyadArAttaruNaM darshanIyam |
siMhAsanasthaM yuvatIsahAyaM; krIDantamakShairgirirAjamUrdhni
shlokas.15:
tamabravIddevarAjo mamedaM; tvaM viddhi vishvaM bhuvanaM vashe sthitam |
Isho.ahamasmIti samanyurabravI;ddRRiShTvA tamakShaiH subhRRishaM pramattam
shlokas.16:
kruddhaM tu shakraM prasamIkShya devo; jahAsa shakraM cha shanairudaikShata |
sa.nstambhito.abhUdatha devarAja;stenekShitaH sthANurivAvatasthe
shlokas.17:
yadA tu paryAptamihAsya krIDayA; tadA devIM rudatIM tAmuvAcha |
AnIyatAmeSha yato.ahamArA;nmainaM darpaH punarapyAvisheta
shlokas.18:
tataH shakraH spRRiShTamAtrastayA tu; srastaira~NgaiH patito.abhUddharaNyAm |
tamabravIdbhagavAnugratejA; maivaM punaH shakra kRRithAH katha~nchit
shlokas.19:
vivartayainaM cha mahAdrirAjaM; balaM cha vIryaM cha tavAprameyam |
vivRRitya chaivAvisha madhyamasya; yatrAsate tvadvidhAH sUryabhAsaH
shlokas.20:
sa tadvivRRitya shikharaM mahAgire;stulyadyutI.nshchaturo.anyAndadarsha |
sa tAnabhiprekShya babhUva duHkhitaH; kachchinnAhaM bhavitA vai yatheme
shlokas.21:
tato devo girisho vajrapANiM; vivRRitya netre kupito.abhyuvAcha |
darImetAM pravisha tvaM shatakrato; yanmAM bAlyAdavama.nsthAH purastAt
shlokas.22:
uktastvevaM vibhunA devarAjaH; pravepamAno bhRRishamevAbhiSha~NgAt |
srastaira~Ngairanileneva nunna;mashvatthapatraM girirAjamUrdhni
shlokas.23:
sa prA~njalirvinatenAnanena; pravepamAnaH sahasaivamuktaH |
uvAcha chedaM bahurUpamugraM; draShTA sheShasya bhagava.nstvaM bhavAdya
shlokas.24:
tamabravIdugradhanvA prahasya; naiva.nshIlAH sheShamihApnuvanti |
ete.apyevaM bhavitAraH purastA;ttasmAdetAM darimAvishya shedhvam
shlokas.25:
sheSho.apyevaM bhavitA vo na sa.nshayo; yoniM sarve mAnuShImAvishadhvam |
tatra yUyaM karma kRRitvAviShahyaM; bahUnanyAnnidhanaM prApayitvA
shlokas.26:
AgantAraH punarevendralokaM; svakarmaNA pUrvajitaM mahArham |
sarvaM mayA bhAShitametadevaM; kartavyamanyadvividhArthavachcha
shlokas.27:
pUrvendrA UchuH||
gamiShyAmo mAnuShaM devalokA;ddurAdharo vihito yatra mokShaH |
devAstvasmAnAdadhIra~njananyAM; dharmo vAyurmaghavAnashvinau cha
shlokas.28:
vyAsa uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vajrapANirvachastu; devashreShThaM punarevedamAha |
vIryeNAhaM puruShaM kAryaheto;rdadyAmeShAM pa~nchamaM matprasUtam
shlokas.29:
teShAM kAmaM bhagavAnugradhanvA; prAdAdiShTaM sannisargAdyathoktam |
tAM chApyeShAM yoShitaM lokakAntAM; shriyaM bhAryAM vyadadhAnmAnuSheShu
shlokas.30:
taireva sArdhaM tu tataH sa devo; jagAma nArAyaNamaprameyam |
sa chApi tadvyadadhAtsarvameva; tataH sarve sambabhUvurdharaNyAm
shlokas.31:
sa chApi keshau harirudbabarha; shuklamekamaparaM chApi kRRiShNam |
tau chApi keshau vishatAM yadUnAM; kule striyau rohiNIM devakIM cha
tayoreko baladevo babhUva; kRRiShNo dvitIyaH keshavaH sambabhUva
shlokas.32:
ye te pUrvaM shakrarUpA niruddhA;stasyAM daryAM parvatasyottarasya |
ihaiva te pANDavA vIryavantaH; shakrasyA.nshaH pANDavaH savyasAchI
shlokas.33:
evamete pANDavAH sambabhUvu;rye te rAjanpUrvamindrA babhUvuH |
lakShmIshchaiShAM pUrvamevopadiShTA; bhAryA yaiShA draupadI divyarUpA
shlokas.34:
kathaM hi strI karmaNo.ante mahItalA;tsamuttiShThedanyato daivayogAt |
yasyA rUpaM somasUryaprakAshaM; gandhashchAgryaH kroshamAtrAtpravAti
shlokas.35:
idaM chAnyatprItipUrvaM narendra; dadAmi te varamatyadbhutaM cha |
divyaM chakShuH pashya kuntIsutA.nstvaM; puNyairdivyaiH pUrvadehairupetAn
shlokas.36:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato vyAsaH paramodArakarmA; shuchirviprastapasA tasya rAj~naH |
chakShurdivyaM pradadau tAnsa sarvA;nrAjApashyatpUrvadehairyathAvat
shlokas.37:
tato divyAnhemakirITamAlinaH; shakraprakhyAnpAvakAdityavarNAn |
baddhApIDA.nshchArurUpA.nshcha yUno; vyUDhoraskA.nstAlamAtrAndadarsha
shlokas.38:
divyairvastrairarajobhiH suvarNai;rmAlyaishchAgryaiH shobhamAnAnatIva |
sAkShAttryakShAnvasavo vAtha divyA;nAdityAnvA sarvaguNopapannAn
tAnpUrvendrAnevamIkShyAbhirUpA;nprIto rAjA drupado vismitashcha
shlokas.39:
divyAM mAyAM tAmavApyAprameyAM; tAM chaivAgryAM shriyamiva rUpiNIM cha |
yogyAM teShAM rUpatejoyashobhiH; patnImRRiddhAM dRRiShTavAnpArthivendraH
shlokas.40:
sa taddRRiShTvA mahadAshcharyarUpaM; jagrAha pAdau satyavatyAH sutasya |
naitachchitraM paramarShe tvayIti; prasannachetAH sa uvAcha chainam
shlokas.41:
vyAsa uvAcha||
AsIttapovane kAchidRRiSheH kanyA mahAtmanaH |
nAdhyagachChatpatiM sA tu kanyA rUpavatI satI
shlokas.42:
toShayAmAsa tapasA sA kilogreNa sha~Nkaram |
tAmuvAcheshvaraH prIto vRRiNu kAmamiti svayam
shlokas.43:
saivamuktAbravItkanyA devaM varadamIshvaram |
patiM sarvaguNopetamichChAmIti punaH punaH
shlokas.44:
dadau tasyai sa deveshastaM varaM prItimA.nstadA |
pa~ncha te patayaH shreShThA bhaviShyantIti sha~NkaraH
shlokas.45:
sA prasAdayatI devamidaM bhUyo.abhyabhAShata |
ekaM patiM guNopetaM tvatto.arhAmIti vai tadA
tAM devadevaH prItAtmA punaH prAha shubhaM vachaH
shlokas.46:
pa~nchakRRitvastvayA uktaH patiM dehItyahaM punaH |
tattathA bhavitA bhadre tava tadbhadramastu te
dehamanyaM gatAyAste yathoktaM tadbhaviShyati
shlokas.47:
drupadaiShA hi sA jaj~ne sutA te devarUpiNI |
pa~nchAnAM vihitA patnI kRRiShNA pArShatyaninditA
shlokas.48:
svargashrIH pANDavArthAya samutpannA mahAmakhe |
seha taptvA tapo ghoraM duhitRRitvaM tavAgatA
shlokas.49:
saiShA devI ruchirA devajuShTA; pa~nchAnAmekA svakRRitena karmaNA |
sRRiShTA svayaM devapatnI svayambhuvA; shrutvA rAjandrupadeShTaM kuruShva

shlokas.1:
drupada uvAcha||
ashrutvaivaM vachanaM te maharShe; mayA pUrvaM yatitaM kAryametat |
na vai shakyaM vihitasyApayAtuM; tadevedamupapannaM vidhAnam
shlokas.2:
diShTasya granthiranivartanIyaH; svakarmaNA vihitaM neha ki~nchit |
kRRitaM nimittaM hi varaikaheto;stadevedamupapannaM bahUnAm
shlokas.3:
yathaiva kRRiShNoktavatI purastA;nnaikAnpatInme bhagavAndadAtu |
sa chApyevaM varamityabravIttAM; devo hi veda paramaM yadatra
shlokas.4:
yadi vAyaM vihitaH sha~NkareNa; dharmo.adharmo vA nAtra mamAparAdhaH |
gRRihNantvime vidhivatpANimasyA; yathopajoShaM vihitaiShAM hi kRRiShNA
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato.abravIdbhagavAndharmarAja;madya puNyAhamuta pANDaveya |
adya pauShyaM yogamupaiti chandramAH; pANiM kRRiShNAyAstvaM gRRihANAdya pUrvam
shlokas.6:
tato rAjA yaj~nasenaH saputro; janyArtha yuktaM bahu tattadagryam |
samAnayAmAsa sutAM cha kRRiShNA;mAplAvya ratnairbahubhirvibhUShya
shlokas.7:
tataH sarve suhRRidastatra tasya; samAjagmuH sachivA mantriNashcha |
draShTuM vivAhaM paramapratItA; dvijAshcha paurAshcha yathApradhAnAH
shlokas.8:
tattasya veshmArthijanopashobhitaM; vikIrNapadmotpalabhUShitAjiram |
mahArharatnaughavichitramAbabhau; divaM yathA nirmalatArakAchitam
shlokas.9:
tatastu te kauravarAjaputrA; vibhUShitAH kuNDalino yuvAnaH |
mahArhavastrA varachandanokShitAH; kRRitAbhiShekAH kRRitama~NgalakriyAH
shlokas.10:
purohitenAgnisamAnavarchasA; sahaiva dhaumyena yathAvidhi prabho |
krameNa sarve vivishushcha tatsado; maharShabhA goShThamivAbhinandinaH
shlokas.11:
tataH samAdhAya sa vedapArago; juhAva mantrairjvalitaM hutAshanam |
yudhiShThiraM chApyupanIya mantravi;nniyojayAmAsa sahaiva kRRiShNayA
shlokas.12:
pradakShiNaM tau pragRRihItapANI; samAnayAmAsa sa vedapAragaH |
tato.abhyanuj~nAya tamAjishobhinaM; purohito rAjagRRihAdviniryayau
shlokas.13:
krameNa chAnena narAdhipAtmajA; varastriyAste jagRRihustadA karam |
ahanyahanyuttamarUpadhAriNo; mahArathAH kauravava.nshavardhanAH
shlokas.14:
idaM cha tatrAdbhutarUpamuttamaM; jagAda viprarShiratItamAnuSham |
mahAnubhAvA kila sA sumadhyamA; babhUva kanyaiva gate gate.ahani
shlokas.15:
kRRite vivAhe drupado dhanaM dadau; mahArathebhyo bahurUpamuttamam |
shataM rathAnAM varahemabhUShiNAM; chaturyujAM hemakhalInamAlinAm
shlokas.16:
shataM gajAnAmabhipadminAM tathA; shataM girINAmiva hemashRRi~NgiNAm |
tathaiva dAsIshatamagryayauvanaM; mahArhaveShAbharaNAmbarasrajam
shlokas.17:
pRRithakpRRithakchaiva dashAyutAnvitaM; dhanaM dadau saumakiragnisAkShikam |
tathaiva vastrANi cha bhUShaNAni; prabhAvayuktAni mahAdhanAni
shlokas.18:
kRRite vivAhe cha tataH sma pANDavAH; prabhUtaratnAmupalabhya tAM shriyam |
vijahrurindrapratimA mahAbalAH; pure tu pA~nchAlanRRipasya tasya ha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pANDavaiH saha sa.nyogaM gatasya drupadasya tu |
na babhUva bhayaM ki~nchiddevebhyo.api katha~nchana
shlokas.2:
kuntImAsAdya tA nAryo drupadasya mahAtmanaH |
nAma sa~NkIrtayantyastAH pAdau jagmuH svamUrdhabhiH
shlokas.3:
kRRiShNA cha kShaumasa.nvItA kRRitakautukama~NgalA |
kRRitAbhivAdanA shvashrvAstasthau prahvA kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.4:
rUpalakShaNasampannAM shIlAchArasamanvitAm |
draupadImavadatpremNA pRRithAshIrvachanaM snuShAm
shlokas.5:
yathendrANI harihaye svAhA chaiva vibhAvasau |
rohiNI cha yathA some damayantI yathA nale
shlokas.6:
yathA vaishravaNe bhadrA vasiShThe chApyarundhatI |
yathA nArAyaNe lakShmIstathA tvaM bhava bhartRRiShu
shlokas.7:
jIvasUrvIrasUrbhadre bahusaukhyasamanvitA |
subhagA bhogasampannA yaj~napatnI svanuvratA
shlokas.8:
atithInAgatAnsAdhUnbAlAnvRRiddhAngurU.nstathA |
pUjayantyA yathAnyAyaM shashvadgachChantu te samAH
shlokas.9:
kurujA~NgalamukhyeShu rAShTreShu nagareShu cha |
anu tvamabhiShichyasva nRRipatiM dharmavatsalam
shlokas.10:
patibhirnirjitAmurvIM vikrameNa mahAbalaiH |
kuru brAhmaNasAtsarvAmashvamedhe mahAkratau
shlokas.11:
pRRithivyAM yAni ratnAni guNavanti gunAnvite |
tAnyApnuhi tvaM kalyANi sukhinI sharadAM shatam
shlokas.12:
yathA cha tvAbhinandAmi vadhvadya kShaumasa.nvRRitAm |
tathA bhUyo.abhinandiShye sUtaputrAM guNAnvitAm
shlokas.13:
tatastu kRRitadArebhyaH pANDubhyaH prAhiNoddhariH |
muktAvaiDUryachitrANi haimAnyAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.14:
vAsA.nsi cha mahArhANi nAnAdeshyAni mAdhavaH |
kambalAjinaratnAni sparshavanti shubhAni cha
shlokas.15:
shayanAsanayAnAni vividhAni mahAnti cha |
vaiDUryavajrachitrANi shatasho bhAjanAni cha
shlokas.16:
rUpayauvanadAkShiNyairupetAshcha svala~NkRRitAH |
preShyAH sampradadau kRRiShNo nAnAdeshyAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.17:
gajAnvinItAnbhadrA.nshcha sadashvA.nshcha svala~NkRRitAn |
rathA.nshcha dAntAnsauvarNaiH shubhaiH paTTairala~NkRRitAn
shlokas.18:
koTishashcha suvarNaM sa teShAmakRRitakaM tathA |
vItIkRRitamameyAtmA prAhiNonmadhusUdanaH
shlokas.19:
tatsarvaM pratijagrAha dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
mudA paramayA yukto govindapriyakAmyayA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato rAj~nAM charairAptaishchAraH samupanIyata |
pANDavairupasampannA draupadI patibhiH shubhA
shlokas.2:
yena taddhanurAyamya lakShyaM viddhaM mahAtmanA |
so.arjuno jayatAM shreShTho mahAbANadhanurdharaH
shlokas.3:
yaH shalyaM madrarAjAnamutkShipyAbhrAmayadbalI |
trAsaya.nshchApi sa~Nkruddho vRRikSheNa puruShAnraNe
shlokas.4:
na chApi sambhramaH kashchidAsIttatra mahAtmanaH |
sa bhImo bhImasa.nsparshaH shatrusenA~NgapAtanaH
shlokas.5:
brahmarUpadharA~nshrutvA pANDurAjasutA.nstadA |
kaunteyAnmanujendrANAM vismayaH samajAyata
shlokas.6:
saputrA hi purA kuntI dagdhA jatugRRihe shrutA |
punarjAtAniti smaitAnmanyante sarvapArthivAH
shlokas.7:
dhikkurvantastadA bhIShmaM dhRRitarAShTraM cha kauravam |
karmaNA sunRRisha.nsena purochanakRRitena vai
shlokas.8:
vRRitte svaya.nvare chaiva rAjAnaH sarva eva te |
yathAgataM viprajagmurviditvA pANDavAnvRRitAn
shlokas.9:
atha duryodhano rAjA vimanA bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
ashvatthAmnA mAtulena karNena cha kRRipeNa cha
shlokas.10:
vinivRRitto vRRitaM dRRiShTvA draupadyA shvetavAhanam |
taM tu duHshAsano vrIDanmandaM mandamivAbravIt
shlokas.11:
yadyasau brAhmaNo na syAdvindeta draupadIM na saH |
na hi taM tattvato rAjanveda kashchiddhana~njayam
shlokas.12:
daivaM tu paramaM manye pauruShaM tu nirarthakam |
dhigasmatpauruShaM tAta yaddharantIha pANDavAH
shlokas.13:
evaM sambhAShamANAste nindantashcha purochanam |
vivishurhAstinapuraM dInA vigatachetasaH
shlokas.14:
trastA vigatasa~NkalpA dRRiShTvA pArthAnmahaujasaH |
muktAnhavyavahAchchainAnsa.nyuktAndrupadena cha
shlokas.15:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha sa~nchintya tathaiva cha shikhaNDinam |
drupadasyAtmajA.nshchAnyAnsarvayuddhavishAradAn
shlokas.16:
vidurastvatha tA~nshrutvA draupadyA pANDavAnvRRitAn |
vrIDitAndhArtarAShTrA.nshcha bhagnadarpAnupAgatAn
shlokas.17:
tataH prItamanAH kShattA dhRRitarAShTraM vishAM pate |
uvAcha diShTyA kuravo vardhanta iti vismitaH
shlokas.18:
vaichitravIryastu nRRipo nishamya vidurasya tat |
abravItparamaprIto diShTyA diShTyeti bhArata
shlokas.19:
manyate hi vRRitaM putraM jyeShThaM drupadakanyayA |
duryodhanamavij~nAnAtpraj~nAchakShurnareshvaraH
shlokas.20:
atha tvAj~nApayAmAsa draupadyA bhUShaNaM bahu |
AnIyatAM vai kRRiShNeti putraM duryodhanaM tadA
shlokas.21:
athAsya pashchAdvidura Achakhyau pANDavAnvRRitAn |
sarvAnkushalino vIrAnpUjitAndrupadena cha
teShAM sambandhinashchAnyAnbahUnbalasamanvitAn
shlokas.22:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yathaiva pANDoH putrAste tathaivAbhyadhikA mama |
seyamabhyadhikA prItirvRRiddhirvidura me matA
yatte kushalino vIrA mitravantashcha pANDavAH
shlokas.23:
ko hi drupadamAsAdya mitraM kShattaH sabAndhavam |
na bubhUShedbhavenArthI gatashrIrapi pArthivaH
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
taM tathA bhAShamANaM tu viduraH pratyabhAShata |
nityaM bhavatu te buddhireShA rAja~nshataM samAH
shlokas.25:
tato duryodhanashchaiva rAdheyashcha vishAM pate |
dhRRitarAShTramupAgamya vacho.abrUtAmidaM tadA
shlokas.26:
saMnidhau vidurasya tvAM vaktuM nRRipa na shaknuvaH |
viviktamiti vakShyAvaH kiM tavedaM chikIrShitam
shlokas.27:
sapatnavRRiddhiM yattAta manyase vRRiddhimAtmanaH |
abhiShTauShi cha yatkShattuH samIpe dvipadAM vara
shlokas.28:
anyasminnRRipa kartavye tvamanyatkuruShe.anagha |
teShAM balavighAto hi kartavyastAta nityashaH
shlokas.29:
te vayaM prAptakAlasya chikIrShAM mantrayAmahe |
yathA no na graseyuste saputrabalabAndhavAn

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ahamapyevamevaitachchintayAmi yathA yuvAm |
vivektuM nAhamichChAmi tvAkAraM viduraM prati
shlokas.2:
atasteShAM guNAneva kIrtayAmi visheShataH |
nAvabudhyeta viduro mamAbhiprAyami~NgitaiH
shlokas.3:
yachcha tvaM manyase prAptaM tadbrUhi tvaM suyodhana |
rAdheya manyase tvaM cha yatprAptaM tadbravIhi me
shlokas.4:
duryodhana uvAcha||
adya tAnkushalairvipraiH sukRRitairAptakAribhiH |
kuntIputrAnbhedayAmo mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shlokas.5:
atha vA drupado rAjA mahadbhirvittasa~nchayaiH |
putrAshchAsya pralobhyantAmamAtyAshchaiva sarvashaH
shlokas.6:
parityajadhvaM rAjAnaM kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram |
atha tatraiva vA teShAM nivAsaM rochayantu te
shlokas.7:
ihaiShAM doShavadvAsaM varNayantu pRRithakpRRithak |
te bhidyamAnAstatraiva manaH kurvantu pANDavAH
shlokas.8:
athavA kushalAH kechidupAyanipuNA narAH |
itaretarataH pArthAnbhedayantvanurAgataH
shlokas.9:
vyutthApayantu vA kRRiShNAM bahutvAtsukaraM hi tat |
athavA pANDavA.nstasyAM bhedayantu tatashcha tAm
shlokas.10:
bhImasenasya vA rAjannupAyakushalairnaraiH |
mRRityurvidhIyatAM ChannaiH sa hi teShAM balAdhikaH
shlokas.11:
tasmi.nstu nihate rAjanhatotsAhA hataujasaH |
yatiShyante na rAjyAya sa hi teShAM vyapAshrayaH
shlokas.12:
ajeyo hyarjunaH sa~Nkhye pRRiShThagope vRRikodare |
tamRRite phalguno yuddhe rAdheyasya na pAdabhAk
shlokas.13:
te jAnamAnA daurbalyaM bhImasenamRRite mahat |
asmAnbalavato j~nAtvA nashiShyantyabalIyasaH
shlokas.14:
ihAgateShu pArtheShu nideshavashavartiShu |
pravartiShyAmahe rAjanyathAshraddhaM nibarhaNe
shlokas.15:
athavA darshanIyAbhiH pramadAbhirvilobhyatAm |
ekaikastatra kaunteyastataH kRRiShNA virajyatAm
shlokas.16:
preShyatAM vApi rAdheyasteShAmAgamanAya vai |
te loptrahAraiH sandhAya vadhyantAmAptakAribhiH
shlokas.17:
eteShAmabhyupAyAnAM yaste nirdoShavAnmataH |
tasya prayogamAtiShTha purA kAlo.ativartate
shlokas.18:
yAvachchAkRRitavishvAsA drupade pArthivarShabhe |
tAvadevAdya te shakyA na shakyAstu tataH param
shlokas.19:
eShA mama matistAta nigrahAya pravartate |
sAdhu vA yadi vAsAdhu kiM vA rAdheya manyase

shlokas.1:
karNa uvAcha||
duryodhana tava praj~nA na samyagiti me matiH |
na hyupAyena te shakyAH pANDavAH kurunandana
shlokas.2:
pUrvameva hi te sUkShmairupAyairyatitAstvayA |
nigrahItuM yadA vIra shakitA na tadA tvayA
shlokas.3:
ihaiva vartamAnAste samIpe tava pArthiva |
ajAtapakShAH shishavaH shakitA naiva bAdhitum
shlokas.4:
jAtapakShA videshasthA vivRRiddhAH sarvasho.adya te |
nopAyasAdhyAH kaunteyA mamaiShA matirachyuta
shlokas.5:
na cha te vyasanairyoktuM shakyA diShTakRRitA hi te |
sha~NkitAshchepsavashchaiva pitRRipaitAmahaM padam
shlokas.6:
paraspareNa bhedashcha nAdhAtuM teShu shakyate |
ekasyAM ye ratAH patnyAM na bhidyante parasparam
shlokas.7:
na chApi kRRiShNA shakyeta tebhyo bhedayituM paraiH |
paridyUnAnvRRitavatI kimutAdya mRRijAvataH
shlokas.8:
Ipsitashcha guNaH strINAmekasyA bahubhartRRitA |
taM cha prAptavatI kRRiShNA na sA bhedayituM sukham
shlokas.9:
AryavRRittashcha pA~nchAlyo na sa rAjA dhanapriyaH |
na santyakShyati kaunteyAnrAjyadAnairapi dhruvam
shlokas.10:
tathAsya putro guNavAnanuraktashcha pANDavAn |
tasmAnnopAyasAdhyA.nstAnahaM manye katha~nchana
shlokas.11:
idaM tvadya kShamaM kartumasmAkaM puruSharShabha |
yAvanna kRRitamUlAste pANDaveyA vishAM pate
tAvatpraharaNIyAste rochatAM tava vikramaH
shlokas.12:
asmatpakSho mahAnyAvadyAvatpA~nchAlako laghuH |
