tAvatpraharaNaM teShAM kriyatAM mA vichAraya
shlokas.13:
vAhanAni prabhUtAni mitrANi bahulAni cha |
yAvanna teShAM gAndhAre tAvadevAshu vikrama
shlokas.14:
yAvachcha rAjA pA~nchAlyo nodyame kurute manaH |
saha putrairmahAvIryaistAvadevAshu vikrama
shlokas.15:
yAvannAyAti vArShNeyaH karShanyAdavavAhinIm |
rAjyArthe pANDaveyAnAM tAvadevAshu vikrama
shlokas.16:
vasUni vividhAnbhogAnrAjyameva cha kevalam |
nAtyAjyamasti kRRiShNasya pANDavArthe mahIpate
shlokas.17:
vikrameNa mahI prAptA bharatena mahAtmanA |
vikrameNa cha lokA.nstrI~njitavAnpAkashAsanaH
shlokas.18:
vikramaM cha prasha.nsanti kShatriyasya vishAM pate |
svako hi dharmaH shUrANAM vikramaH pArthivarShabha
shlokas.19:
te balena vayaM rAjanmahatA chatura~NgiNA |
pramathya drupadaM shIghramAnayAmeha pANDavAn
shlokas.20:
na hi sAmnA na dAnena na bhedena cha pANDavAH |
shakyAH sAdhayituM tasmAdvikrameNaiva tA~njahi
shlokas.21:
tAnvikrameNa jitvemAmakhilAM bhu~NkShva medinIm |
nAnyamatra prapashyAmi kAryopAyaM janAdhipa
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA tu rAdheyavacho dhRRitarAShTraH pratApavAn |
abhipUjya tataH pashchAdidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.23:
upapannaM mahAprAj~ne kRRitAstre sUtanandane |
tvayi vikramasampannamidaM vachanamIdRRisham
shlokas.24:
bhUya eva tu bhIShmashcha droNo vidura eva cha |
yuvAM cha kurutAM buddhiM bhavedyA naH sukhodayA
shlokas.25:
tata AnAyya tAnsarvAnmantriNaH sumahAyashAH |
dhRRitarAShTro mahArAja mantrayAmAsa vai tadA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
na rochate vigraho me pANDuputraiH katha~nchana |
yathaiva dhRRitarAShTro me tathA pANDurasa.nshayam
shlokas.2:
gAndhAryAshcha yathA putrAstathA kuntIsutA matAH |
yathA cha mama te rakShyA dhRRitarAShTra tathA tava
shlokas.3:
yathA cha mama rAj~nashcha tathA duryodhanasya te |
tathA kurUNAM sarveShAmanyeShAmapi bhArata
shlokas.4:
evaM gate vigrahaM tairna rochaye; sandhAya vIrairdIyatAmadya bhUmiH |
teShAmapIdaM prapitAmahAnAM; rAjyaM pitushchaiva kurUttamAnAm
shlokas.5:
duryodhana yathA rAjyaM tvamidaM tAta pashyasi |
mama paitRRikamityevaM te.api pashyanti pANDavAH
shlokas.6:
yadi rAjyaM na te prAptAH pANDaveyAstapasvinaH |
kuta eva tavApIdaM bhAratasya cha kasyachit
shlokas.7:
atha dharmeNa rAjyaM tvaM prAptavAnbharatarShabha |
te.api rAjyamanuprAptAH pUrvameveti me matiH
shlokas.8:
madhureNaiva rAjyasya teShAmardhaM pradIyatAm |
etaddhi puruShavyAghra hitaM sarvajanasya cha
shlokas.9:
ato.anyathA chetkriyate na hitaM no bhaviShyati |
tavApyakIrtiH sakalA bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.10:
kIrtirakShaNamAtiShTha kIrtirhi paramaM balam |
naShTakIrtermanuShyasya jIvitaM hyaphalaM smRRitam
shlokas.11:
yAvatkIrtirmanuShyasya na praNashyati kaurava |
tAvajjIvati gAndhAre naShTakIrtistu nashyati
shlokas.12:
tamimaM samupAtiShTha dharmaM kurukulochitam |
anurUpaM mahAbAho pUrveShAmAtmanaH kuru
shlokas.13:
diShTyA dharanti te vIrA diShTyA jIvati sA pRRithA |
diShTyA purochanaH pApo nasakAmo.atyayaM gataH
shlokas.14:
tadA prabhRRiti gAndhAre na shaknomyabhivIkShitum |
loke prANabhRRitAM ka~nchichChrutvA kuntIM tathAgatAm
shlokas.15:
na chApi doSheNa tathA loko vaiti purochanam |
yathA tvAM puruShavyAghra loko doSheNa gachChati
shlokas.16:
tadidaM jIvitaM teShAM tava kalmaShanAshanam |
saMmantavyaM mahArAja pANDavAnAM cha darshanam
shlokas.17:
na chApi teShAM vIrANAM jIvatAM kurunandana |
pitryoM.ashaH shakya AdAtumapi vajrabhRRitA svayam
shlokas.18:
te hi sarve sthitA dharme sarve chaivaikachetasaH |
adharmeNa nirastAshcha tulye rAjye visheShataH
shlokas.19:
yadi dharmastvayA kAryo yadi kAryaM priyaM cha me |
kShemaM cha yadi kartavyaM teShAmardhaM pradIyatAm

shlokas.1:
droNa uvAcha||
mantrAya samupAnItairdhRRitarAShTrahitairnRRipa |
dharmyaM pathyaM yashasyaM cha vAchyamityanushushrumaH
shlokas.2:
mamApyeShA matistAta yA bhIShmasya mahAtmanaH |
sa.nvibhajyAstu kaunteyA dharma eSha sanAtanaH
shlokas.3:
preShyatAM drupadAyAshu naraH kashchitpriya.nvadaH |
bahulaM ratnamAdAya teShAmarthAya bhArata
shlokas.4:
mithaH kRRityaM cha tasmai sa AdAya bahu gachChatu |
vRRiddhiM cha paramAM brUyAttatsa.nyogodbhavAM tathA
shlokas.5:
samprIyamANaM tvAM brUyAdrAjandUryodhanaM tathA |
asakRRiddrupade chaiva dhRRiShTadyumne cha bhArata
shlokas.6:
uchitatvaM priyatvaM cha yogasyApi cha varNayet |
punaH punashcha kaunteyAnmAdrIputrau cha sAntvayan
shlokas.7:
hiraNmayAni shubhrANi bahUnyAbharaNAni cha |
vachanAttava rAjendra draupadyAH samprayachChatu
shlokas.8:
tathA drupadaputrANAM sarveShAM bharatarShabha |
pANDavAnAM cha sarveShAM kuntyA yuktAni yAni cha
shlokas.9:
evaM sAntvasamAyuktaM drupadaM pANDavaiH saha |
uktvAthAnantaraM brUyAtteShAmAgamanaM prati
shlokas.10:
anuj~nAteShu vIreShu balaM gachChatu shobhanam |
duHshAsano vikarNashcha pANDavAnAnayantviha
shlokas.11:
tataste pArthivashreShTha pUjyamAnAH sadA tvayA |
prakRRitInAmanumate pade sthAsyanti paitRRike
shlokas.12:
evaM tava mahArAja teShu putreShu chaiva ha |
vRRittamaupayikaM manye bhIShmeNa saha bhArata
shlokas.13:
karNa uvAcha||
yojitAvarthamAnAbhyAM sarvakAryeShvanantarau |
na mantrayetAM tvachChreyaH kimadbhutataraM tataH
shlokas.14:
duShTena manasA yo vai prachChannenAntarAtmanA |
brUyAnniHshreyasaM nAma kathaM kuryAtsatAM matam
shlokas.15:
na mitrANyarthakRRichChreShu shreyase vetarAya vA |
vidhipUrvaM hi sarvasya duHkhaM vA yadi vA sukham
shlokas.16:
kRRitapraj~no.akRRitapraj~no bAlo vRRiddhashcha mAnavaH |
sasahAyo.asahAyashcha sarvaM sarvatra vindati
shlokas.17:
shrUyate hi purA kashchidambuvIcha iti shrutaH |
AsIdrAjagRRihe rAjA mAgadhAnAM mahIkShitAm
shlokas.18:
sa hInaH karaNaiH sarvairuchChvAsaparamo nRRipaH |
amAtyasa.nsthaH kAryeShu sarveShvevAbhavattadA
shlokas.19:
tasyAmAtyo mahAkarNirbabhUvaikeshvaraH purA |
sa labdhabalamAtmAnaM manyamAno.avamanyate
shlokas.20:
sa rAj~na upabhogyAni striyo ratnadhanAni cha |
Adade sarvasho mUDha aishvaryaM cha svayaM tadA
shlokas.21:
tadAdAya cha lubdhasya lAbhAllobho vyavardhata |
tathA hi sarvamAdAya rAjyamasya jihIrShati
shlokas.22:
hInasya karaNaiH sarvairuchChvAsaparamasya cha |
yatamAno.api tadrAjyaM na shashAketi naH shrutam
shlokas.23:
kimanyadvihitAnnUnaM tasya sA puruShendratA |
yadi te vihitaM rAjyaM bhaviShyati vishAM pate
shlokas.24:
miShataH sarvalokasya sthAsyate tvayi taddhruvam |
ato.anyathA chedvihitaM yatamAno na lapsyase
shlokas.25:
evaM vidvannupAdatsva mantriNAM sAdhvasAdhutAm |
duShTAnAM chaiva boddhavyamaduShTAnAM cha bhAShitam
shlokas.26:
droNa uvAcha||
vidma te bhAvadoSheNa yadarthamidamuchyate |
duShTaH pANDavahetostvaM doShaM khyApayase hi naH
shlokas.27:
hitaM tu paramaM karNa bravImi kuruvardhanam |
atha tvaM manyase duShTaM brUhi yatparamaM hitam
shlokas.28:
ato.anyathA chetkriyate yadbravImi paraM hitam |
kuravo vinashiShyanti nachireNeti me matiH

shlokas.1:
vidura uvAcha||
rAjanniHsa.nshayaM shreyo vAchyastvamasi bAndhavaiH |
na tvashushrUShamANeShu vAkyaM sampratitiShThati
shlokas.2:
hitaM hi tava tadvAkyamuktavAnkurusattamaH |
bhIShmaH shAntanavo rAjanpratigRRihNAsi tanna cha
shlokas.3:
tathA droNena bahudhA bhAShitaM hitamuttamam |
tachcha rAdhAsutaH karNo manyate na hitaM tava
shlokas.4:
chintaya.nshcha na pashyAmi rAja.nstava suhRRittamam |
AbhyAM puruShasiMhAbhyAM yo vA syAtpraj~nayAdhikaH
shlokas.5:
imau hi vRRiddhau vayasA praj~nayA cha shrutena cha |
samau cha tvayi rAjendra teShu pANDusuteShu cha
shlokas.6:
dharme chAnavamau rAjansatyatAyAM cha bhArata |
rAmAddAsharatheshchaiva gayAchchaiva na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.7:
na choktavantAvashreyaH purastAdapi ki~nchana |
na chApyapakRRitaM ki~nchidanayorlakShyate tvayi
shlokas.8:
tAvimau puruShavyAghrAvanAgasi nRRipa tvayi |
na mantrayetAM tvachChreyaH kathaM satyaparAkramau
shlokas.9:
praj~nAvantau narashreShThAvasmi.Nlloke narAdhipa |
tvannimittamato nemau ki~nchijjihmaM vadiShyataH
iti me naiShThikI buddhirvartate kurunandana
shlokas.10:
na chArthahetordharmaj~nau vakShyataH pakShasa.nshritam |
etaddhi paramaM shreyo menAte tava bhArata
shlokas.11:
duryodhanaprabhRRitayaH putrA rAjanyathA tava |
tathaiva pANDaveyAste putrA rAjanna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.12:
teShu chedahitaM ki~nchinmantrayeyurabuddhitaH |
mantriNaste na te shreyaH prapashyanti visheShataH
shlokas.13:
atha te hRRidaye rAjanvisheShasteShu vartate |
antarasthaM vivRRiNvAnAH shreyaH kuryurna te dhruvam
shlokas.14:
etadarthamimau rAjanmahAtmAnau mahAdyutI |
nochaturvivRRitaM ki~nchinna hyeSha tava nishchayaH
shlokas.15:
yachchApyashakyatAM teShAmAhatuH puruSharShabhau |
tattathA puruShavyAghra tava tadbhadramastu te
shlokas.16:
kathaM hi pANDavaH shrImAnsavyasAchI parantapaH |
shakyo vijetuM sa~NgrAme rAjanmaghavatA api
shlokas.17:
bhImaseno mahAbAhurnAgAyutabalo mahAn |
kathaM hi yudhi shakyeta vijetumamarairapi
shlokas.18:
tathaiva kRRitinau yuddhe yamau yamasutAviva |
kathaM viShahituM shakyau raNe jIvitumichChatA
shlokas.19:
yasmindhRRitiranukroshaH kShamA satyaM parAkramaH |
nityAni pANDavashreShThe sa jIyeta kathaM raNe
shlokas.20:
yeShAM pakShadharo rAmo yeShAM mantrI janArdanaH |
kiM nu tairajitaM sa~Nkhye yeShAM pakShe cha sAtyakiH
shlokas.21:
drupadaH shvashuro yeShAM yeShAM shyAlAshcha pArShatAH |
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhA vIrA bhrAtaro drupadAtmajAH
shlokas.22:
so.ashakyatAM cha vij~nAya teShAmagreNa bhArata |
dAyAdyatAM cha dharmeNa samyakteShu samAchara
shlokas.23:
idaM nirdigdhamayashaH purochanakRRitaM mahat |
teShAmanugraheNAdya rAjanprakShAlayAtmanaH
shlokas.24:
drupado.api mahAnrAjA kRRitavairashcha naH purA |
tasya sa~NgrahaNaM rAjansvapakShasya vivardhanam
shlokas.25:
balavantashcha dAshArhA bahavashcha vishAM pate |
yataH kRRiShNastataste syuryataH kRRiShNastato jayaH
shlokas.26:
yachcha sAmnaiva shakyeta kAryaM sAdhayituM nRRipa |
ko daivashaptastatkArtuM vigraheNa samAcharet
shlokas.27:
shrutvA cha jIvataH pArthAnpaurajAnapado janaH |
balavaddarshane gRRidhnusteShAM rAjankuru priyam
shlokas.28:
duryodhanashcha karNashcha shakunishchApi saubalaH |
adharmayuktA duShpraj~nA bAlA maiShAM vachaH kRRithAH
shlokas.29:
uktametanmayA rAjanpurA guNavatastava |
duryodhanAparAdhena prajeyaM vinashiShyati

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bhIShmaH shAntanavo vidvAndroNashcha bhagavAnRRiShiH |
hitaM paramakaM vAkyaM tvaM cha satyaM bravIShi mAm
shlokas.2:
yathaiva pANDoste vIrAH kuntIputrA mahArathAH |
tathaiva dharmataH sarve mama putrA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.3:
yathaiva mama putrANAmidaM rAjyaM vidhIyate |
tathaiva pANDuputrANAmidaM rAjyaM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.4:
kShattarAnaya gachChaitAnsaha mAtrA susatkRRitAn |
tayA cha devarUpiNyA kRRiShNayA saha bhArata
shlokas.5:
diShTyA jIvanti te pArthA diShTyA jIvati sA pRRithA |
diShTyA drupadakanyAM cha labdhavanto mahArathAH
shlokas.6:
diShTyA vardhAmahe sarve diShTyA shAntaH purochanaH |
diShTyA mama paraM duHkhamapanItaM mahAdyute
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato jagAma viduro dhRRitarAShTrasya shAsanAt |
sakAshaM yaj~nasenasya pANDavAnAM cha bhArata
shlokas.8:
tatra gatvA sa dharmaj~naH sarvashAstravishAradaH |
drupadaM nyAyato rAjansa.nyuktamupatasthivAn
shlokas.9:
sa chApi pratijagrAha dharmeNa viduraM tataH |
chakratushcha yathAnyAyaM kushalaprashnasa.nvidam
shlokas.10:
dadarsha pANDavA.nstatra vAsudevaM cha bhArata |
snehAtpariShvajya sa tAnpaprachChAnAmayaM tataH
shlokas.11:
taishchApyamitabuddhiH sa pUjito.atha yathAkramam |
vachanAddhRRitarAShTrasya snehayuktaM punaH punaH
shlokas.12:
paprachChAnAmayaM rAja.nstatastAnpANDunandanAn |
pradadau chApi ratnAni vividhAni vasUni cha
shlokas.13:
pANDavAnAM cha kuntyAshcha draupadyAshcha vishAM pate |
drupadasya cha putrANAM yathA dattAni kauravaiH
shlokas.14:
provAcha chAmitamatiH prashritaM vinayAnvitaH |
drupadaM pANDuputrANAM saMnidhau keshavasya cha
shlokas.15:
rAja~nshRRiNu sahAmAtyaH saputrashcha vacho mama |
dhRRitarAShTraH saputrastvAM sahAmAtyaH sabAndhavaH
shlokas.16:
abravItkushalaM rAjanprIyamANaH punaH punaH |
prItimA.nste dRRiDhaM chApi sambandhena narAdhipa
shlokas.17:
tathA bhIShmaH shAntanavaH kauravaiH saha sarvashaH |
kushalaM tvAM mahAprAj~naH sarvataH paripRRichChati
shlokas.18:
bhAradvAjo maheShvAso droNaH priyasakhastava |
samAshleShamupetya tvAM kushalaM paripRRichChati
shlokas.19:
dhRRitarAShTrashcha pA~nchAlya tvayA sambandhamIyivAn |
kRRitArthaM manyate.a.atmAnaM tathA sarve.api kauravAH
shlokas.20:
na tathA rAjyasamprAptisteShAM prItikarI matA |
yathA sambandhakaM prApya yaj~nasena tvayA saha
shlokas.21:
etadviditvA tu bhavAnprasthApayatu pANDavAn |
draShTuM hi pANDudAyAdA.nstvarante kuravo bhRRisham
shlokas.22:
viproShitA dIrghakAlamime chApi nararShabhAH |
utsukA nagaraM draShTuM bhaviShyanti pRRithA tathA
shlokas.23:
kRRiShNAmapi cha pA~nchAlIM sarvAH kuruvarastriyaH |
draShTukAmAH pratIkShante puraM cha viShayaM cha naH
shlokas.24:
sa bhavAnpANDuputrANAmAj~nApayatu mAchiram |
gamanaM sahadArANAmetadAgamanaM mama
shlokas.25:
visRRiShTeShu tvayA rAjanpANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
tato.ahaM preShayiShyAmi dhRRitarAShTrasya shIghragAn
AgamiShyanti kaunteyAH kuntI cha saha kRRiShNayA

shlokas.1:
drupada uvAcha||
evametanmahAprAj~na yathAttha vidurAdya mAm |
mamApi paramo harShaH sambandhe.asminkRRite vibho
shlokas.2:
gamanaM chApi yuktaM syAdgRRihameShAM mahAtmanAm |
na tu tAvanmayA yuktametadvaktuM svayaM girA
shlokas.3:
yadA tu manyate vIraH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
bhImasenArjunau chaiva yamau cha puruSharShabhau
shlokas.4:
rAmakRRiShNau cha dharmaj~nau tadA gachChantu pANDavAH |
etau hi puruShavyAghrAveShAM priyahite ratau
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
paravanto vayaM rAja.nstvayi sarve sahAnugAH |
yathA vakShyasi naH prItyA kariShyAmastathA vayam
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato.abravIdvAsudevo gamanaM mama rochate |
yathA vA manyate rAjA drupadaH sarvadharmavit
shlokas.7:
drupada uvAcha||
yathaiva manyate vIro dAshArhaH puruShottamaH |
prAptakAlaM mahAbAhuH sA buddhirnishchitA mama
shlokas.8:
yathaiva hi mahAbhAgAH kaunteyA mama sAmpratam |
tathaiva vAsudevasya pANDuputrA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.9:
na taddhyAyati kaunteyo dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
yadeShAM puruShavyAghraH shreyo dhyAyati keshavaH
shlokas.10:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataste samanuj~nAtA drupadena mahAtmanA |
pANDavAshchaiva kRRiShNashcha vidurashcha mahAmatiH
shlokas.11:
AdAya draupadIM kRRiShNAM kuntIM chaiva yashasvinIm |
savihAraM sukhaM jagmurnagaraM nAgasAhvayam
shlokas.12:
shrutvA chopasthitAnvIrAndhRRitarAShTro.api kauravaH |
pratigrahAya pANDUnAM preShayAmAsa kauravAn
shlokas.13:
vikarNaM cha maheShvAsaM chitrasenaM cha bhArata |
droNaM cha parameShvAsaM gautamaM kRRipameva cha
shlokas.14:
taiste parivRRitA vIrAH shobhamAnA mahArathAH |
nagaraM hAstinapuraM shanaiH pravivishustadA
shlokas.15:
kautUhalena nagaraM dIryamANamivAbhavat |
yatra te puruShavyAghrAH shokaduHkhavinAshanAH
shlokas.16:
tata uchchAvachA vAchaH priyAH priyachikIrShubhiH |
udIritA ashRRiNva.nste pANDavA hRRidaya~NgamAH
shlokas.17:
ayaM sa puruShavyAghraH punarAyAti dharmavit |
yo naH svAniva dAyAdAndharmeNa parirakShati
shlokas.18:
adya pANDurmahArAjo vanAdiva vanapriyaH |
AgataH priyamasmAkaM chikIrShurnAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.19:
kiM nu nAdya kRRitaM tAvatsarveShAM naH paraM priyam |
yannaH kuntIsutA vIrA bhartAraH punarAgatAH
shlokas.20:
yadi dattaM yadi hutaM vidyate yadi nastapaH |
tena tiShThantu nagare pANDavAH sharadAM shatam
shlokas.21:
tataste dhRRitarAShTrasya bhIShmasya cha mahAtmanaH |
anyeShAM cha tadarhANAM chakruH pAdAbhivandanam
shlokas.22:
kRRitvA tu kushalaprashnaM sarveNa nagareNa te |
samAvishanta veshmAni dhRRitarAShTrasya shAsanAt
shlokas.23:
vishrAntAste mahAtmAnaH ka~nchitkAlaM mahAbalAH |
AhUtA dhRRitarAShTreNa rAj~nA shAntanavena cha
shlokas.24:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bhrAtRRibhiH saha kaunteya nibodhedaM vacho mama |
punarvo vigraho mA bhUtkhANDavaprasthamAvisha
shlokas.25:
na cha vo vasatastatra kashchichChaktaH prabAdhitum |
sa.nrakShyamANAnpArthena tridashAniva vajriNA
ardhaM rAjyasya samprApya khANDavaprasthamAvisha
shlokas.26:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pratigRRihya tu tadvAkyaM nRRipaM sarve praNamya cha |
pratasthire tato ghoraM vanaM tanmanujarShabhAH
ardhaM rAjyasya samprApya khANDavaprasthamAvishan
shlokas.27:
tataste pANDavAstatra gatvA kRRiShNapurogamAH |
maNDayAM chakrire tadvai puraM svargavadachyutAH
shlokas.28:
tataH puNye shive deshe shAntiM kRRitvA mahArathAH |
nagaraM mApayAmAsurdvaipAyanapurogamAH
shlokas.29:
sAgarapratirUpAbhiH parikhAbhirala~NkRRitam |
prAkAreNa cha sampannaM divamAvRRitya tiShThatA
shlokas.30:
pANDurAbhraprakAshena himarAshinibhena cha |
shushubhe tatpurashreShThaM nAgairbhogavatI yathA
shlokas.31:
dvipakShagaruDaprakhyairdvArairghorapradarshanaiH |
guptamabhrachayaprakhyairgopurairmandaropamaiH
shlokas.32:
vividhairatinirviddhaiH shastropetaiH susa.nvRRitaiH |
shaktibhishchAvRRitaM taddhi dvijihvairiva pannagaiH
talpaishchAbhyAsikairyuktaM shushubhe yodharakShitam
shlokas.33:
tIkShNA~NkushashataghnIbhiryantrajAlaishcha shobhitam |
Ayasaishcha mahAchakraiH shushubhe tatpurottamam
shlokas.34:
suvibhaktamahArathyaM devatAbAdhavarjitam |
virochamAnaM vividhaiH pANDurairbhavanottamaiH
shlokas.35:
tattriviShTapasa~NkAshamindraprasthaM vyarochata |
meghavRRindamivAkAshe vRRiddhaM vidyutsamAvRRitam
shlokas.36:
tatra ramye shubhe deshe kauravyasya niveshanam |
shushubhe dhanasampUrNaM dhanAdhyakShakShayopamam
shlokas.37:
tatrAgachChandvijA rAjansarvavedavidAM varAH |
nivAsaM rochayanti sma sarvabhAShAvidastathA
shlokas.38:
vaNijashchAbhyayustatra deshe digbhyo dhanArthinaH |
sarvashilpavidashchaiva vAsAyAbhyAgama.nstadA
shlokas.39:
udyAnAni cha ramyANi nagarasya samantataH |
AmrairAmrAtakairnIpairashokaishchampakaistathA
shlokas.40:
puMnAgairnAgapuShpaishcha lakuchaiH panasaistathA |
shAlatAlakadambaishcha bakulaishcha saketakaiH
shlokas.41:
manoharaiH puShpitaishcha phalabhArAvanAmitaiH |
prAchInAmalakairlodhraira~Nkolaishcha supuShpitaiH
shlokas.42:
jambUbhiH pATalAbhishcha kubjakairatimuktakaiH |
karavIraiH pArijAtairanyaishcha vividhairdrumaiH
shlokas.43:
nityapuShpaphalopetairnAnAdvijagaNAyutam |
mattabarhiNasa~NghuShTaM kokilaishcha sadAmadaiH
shlokas.44:
gRRihairAdarshavimalairvividhaishcha latAgRRihaiH |
manoharaishchitragRRihaistathA jagatiparvataiH
vApIbhirvividhAbhishcha pUrNAbhiH paramAmbhasA
shlokas.45:
sarobhiratiramyaishcha padmotpalasugandhibhiH |
ha.nsakAraNDavayutaishchakravAkopashobhitaiH
shlokas.46:
ramyAshcha vividhAstatra puShkariNyo vanAvRRitAH |
taDAgAni cha ramyANi bRRihanti cha mahAnti cha
shlokas.47:
teShAM puNyajanopetaM rAShTramAvasatAM mahat |
pANDavAnAM mahArAja shashvatprItiravardhata
shlokas.48:
tatra bhIShmeNa rAj~nA cha dharmapraNayane kRRite |
pANDavAH samapadyanta khANDavaprasthavAsinaH
shlokas.49:
pa~nchabhistairmaheShvAsairindrakalpaiH samanvitam |
shushubhe tatpurashreShThaM nAgairbhogavatI yathA
shlokas.50:
tAnniveshya tato vIro rAmeNa saha keshavaH |
yayau dvAravatIM rAjanpANDavAnumate tadA

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
evaM samprApya rAjyaM tadindraprasthe tapodhana |
ata UrdhvaM mahAtmAnaH kimakurvanta pANDavAH
shlokas.2:
sarva eva mahAtmAnaH pUrve mama pitAmahAH |
draupadI dharmapatnI cha kathaM tAnanvavartata
shlokas.3:
kathaM vA pa~ncha kRRiShNAyAmekasyAM te narAdhipAH |
vartamAnA mahAbhAgA nAbhidyanta parasparam
shlokas.4:
shrotumichChAmyahaM sarvaM vistareNa tapodhana |
teShAM cheShTitamanyonyaM yuktAnAM kRRiShNayA tayA
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dhRRitarAShTrAbhyanuj~nAtAH kRRiShNayA saha pANDavAH |
remire puruShavyAghrAH prAptarAjyAH parantapAH
shlokas.6:
prApya rAjyaM mahAtejAH satyasandho yudhiShThiraH |
pAlayAmAsa dharmeNa pRRithivIM bhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.7:
jitArayo mahAprAj~nAH satyadharmaparAyaNAH |
mudaM paramikAM prAptAstatroShuH pANDunandanAH
shlokas.8:
kurvANAH paurakAryANi sarvANi puruSharShabhAH |
AsAM chakrurmahArheShu pArthiveShvAsaneShu cha
shlokas.9:
atha teShUpaviShTeShu sarveShveva mahAtmasu |
nAradastvatha devarShirAjagAma yadRRichChayA
AsanaM ruchiraM tasmai pradadau svaM yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.10:
devarSherupaviShTasya svayamarghyaM yathAvidhi |
prAdAdyudhiShThiro dhImAnrAjyaM chAsmai nyavedayat
shlokas.11:
pratigRRihya tu tAM pUjAmRRiShiH prItamanAbhavat |
AshIrbhirvardhayitvA tu tamuvAchAsyatAmiti
shlokas.12:
niShasAdAbhyanuj~nAtastato rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
preShayAmAsa kRRiShNAyai bhagavantamupasthitam
shlokas.13:
shrutvaiva draupadI chApi shuchirbhUtvA samAhitA |
jagAma tatra yatrAste nAradaH pANDavaiH saha
shlokas.14:
tasyAbhivAdya charaNau devarSherdharmachAriNI |
kRRitA~njaliH susa.nvItA sthitAtha drupadAtmajA
shlokas.15:
tasyAshchApi sa dharmAtmA satyavAgRRiShisattamaH |
AshiSho vividhAH prochya rAjaputryAstu nAradaH
gamyatAmiti hovAcha bhagavA.nstAmaninditAm
shlokas.16:
gatAyAmatha kRRiShNAyAM yudhiShThirapurogamAn |
vivikte pANDavAnsarvAnuvAcha bhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.17:
pA~nchAlI bhavatAmekA dharmapatnI yashasvinI |
yathA vo nAtra bhedaH syAttathA nItirvidhIyatAm
shlokas.18:
sundopasundAvasurau bhrAtarau sahitAvubhau |
AstAmavadhyAvanyeShAM triShu lokeShu vishrutau
shlokas.19:
ekarAjyAvekagRRihAvekashayyAsanAshanau |
tilottamAyAstau hetoranyonyamabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.20:
rakShyatAM sauhRRidaM tasmAdanyonyapratibhAvikam |
yathA vo nAtra bhedaH syAttatkuruShva yudhiShThira
shlokas.21:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sundopasundAvasurau kasya putrau mahAmune |
utpannashcha kathaM bhedaH kathaM chAnyonyamaghnatAm
shlokas.22:
apsarA devakanyA vA kasya chaiShA tilottamA |
yasyAH kAmena saMmattau jaghnatustau parasparam
shlokas.23:
etatsarvaM yathAvRRittaM vistareNa tapodhana |
shrotumichChAmahe vipra paraM kautUhalaM hi naH

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
shRRiNu me vistareNemamitihAsaM purAtanam |
bhrAtRRibhIH sahitaH pArtha yathAvRRittaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.2:
mahAsurasyAnvavAye hiraNyakashipoH purA |
nikumbho nAma daityendrastejasvI balavAnabhUt
shlokas.3:
tasya putrau mahAvIryau jAtau bhImaparAkramau |
sahAnyonyena bhu~njAte vinAnyonyaM na gachChataH
shlokas.4:
anyonyasya priyakarAvanyonyasya priya.nvadau |
ekashIlasamAchArau dvidhaivaikaM yathA kRRitau
shlokas.5:
tau vivRRiddhau mahAvIryau kAryeShvapyekanishchayau |
trailokyavijayArthAya samAsthAyaikanishchayam
shlokas.6:
kRRitvA dIkShAM gatau vindhyaM tatrograM tepatustapaH |
tau tu dIrgheNa kAlena tapoyuktau babhUvatuH
shlokas.7:
kShutpipAsAparishrAntau jaTAvalkaladhAriNau |
malopachitasarvA~Ngau vAyubhakShau babhUvatuH
shlokas.8:
AtmamA.nsAni juhvantau pAdA~NguShThAgradhiShThitau |
UrdhvabAhU chAnimiShau dIrghakAlaM dhRRitavratau
shlokas.9:
tayostapaHprabhAveNa dIrghakAlaM pratApitaH |
dhUmaM pramumuche vindhyastadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.10:
tato devAbhavanbhItA ugraM dRRiShTvA tayostapaH |
tapovighAtArthamatho devA vighnAni chakrire
shlokas.11:
ratnaiH pralobhayAmAsuH strIbhishchobhau punaH punaH |
na cha tau chakraturbha~NgaM vratasya sumahAvratau
shlokas.12:
atha mAyAM punardevAstayoshchakrurmahAtmanoH |
bhaginyo mAtaro bhAryAstayoH parijanastathA
shlokas.13:
paripAtyamAnA vitrastAH shUlahastena rakShasA |
srastAbharaNakeshAntA ekAntabhraShTavAsasaH
shlokas.14:
abhidhAvya tataH sarvAstau trAhIti vichukrushuH |
na cha tau chakraturbha~NgaM vratasya sumahAvratau
shlokas.15:
yadA kShobhaM nopayAti nArtimanyatarastayoH |
tataH striyastA bhUtaM cha sarvamantaradhIyata
shlokas.16:
tataH pitAmahaH sAkShAdabhigamya mahAsurau |
vareNa ChandayAmAsa sarvalokapitAmahaH
shlokas.17:
tataH sundopasundau tau bhrAtarau dRRiDhavikramau |
dRRiShTvA pitAmahaM devaM tasthatuH prA~njalI tadA
shlokas.18:
Uchatushcha prabhuM devaM tatastau sahitau tadA |
AvayostapasAnena yadi prItaH pitAmahaH
shlokas.19:
mAyAvidAvastravidau balinau kAmarUpiNau |
ubhAvapyamarau syAvaH prasanno yadi nau prabhuH
shlokas.20:
pitAmaha uvAcha||
RRite.amaratvamanyadvAM sarvamuktaM bhaviShyati |
anyadvRRiNItAM mRRityoshcha vidhAnamamaraiH samam
shlokas.21:
kariShyAvedamiti yanmahadabhyutthitaM tapaH |
yuvayorhetunAnena nAmaratvaM vidhIyate
shlokas.22:
trailokyavijayArthAya bhavadbhyAmAsthitaM tapaH |
hetunAnena daityendrau na vAM kAmaM karomyaham
shlokas.23:
sundopasundAvUchatuH||
triShu lokeShu yadbhUtaM ki~nchitsthAvaraja~Ngamam |
sarvasmAnnau bhayaM na syAdRRite.anyonyaM pitAmaha
shlokas.24:
pitAmaha uvAcha||
yatprArthitaM yathoktaM cha kAmametaddadAni vAm |
mRRityorvidhAnametachcha yathAvadvAM bhaviShyati
shlokas.25:
nArada uvAcha||
tataH pitAmaho dattvA varametattadA tayoH |
nivartya tapasastau cha brahmalokaM jagAma ha
shlokas.26:
labdhvA varANi sarvANi daityendrAvapi tAvubhau |
avadhyau sarvalokasya svameva bhavanaM gatau
shlokas.27:
tau tu labdhavarau dRRiShTvA kRRitakAmau mahAsurau |
sarvaH suhRRijjanastAbhyAM pramodamupajagmivAn
shlokas.28:
tatastau tu jaTA hitvA maulinau sambabhUvatuH |
mahArhAbharaNopetau virajombaradhAriNau
shlokas.29:
akAlakaumudIM chaiva chakratuH sArvakAmikIm |
daityendrau paramaprItau tayoshchaiva suhRRijjanaH
shlokas.30:
bhakShyatAM bhujyatAM nityaM ramyatAM gIyatAmiti |
pIyatAM dIyatAM cheti vAcha AsangRRihe gRRihe
shlokas.31:
tatra tatra mahApAnairutkRRiShTatalanAditaiH |
hRRiShTaM pramuditaM sarvaM daityAnAmabhavatpuram
shlokas.32:
taistairvihArairbahubhirdaityAnAM kAmarUpiNAm |
samAH sa~NkrIDatAM teShAmaharekamivAbhavat

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
utsave vRRittamAtre tu trailokyAkA~NkShiNAvubhau |
mantrayitvA tataH senAM tAvAj~nApayatAM tadA
shlokas.2:
suhRRidbhirabhyanuj~nAtau daityavRRiddhaishcha mantribhiH |
kRRitvA prAsthAnikaM rAtrau maghAsu yayatustadA
shlokas.3:
gadApaTTishadhAriNyA shUlamudgarahastayA |
prasthitau sahadharmiNyA mahatyA daityasenayA
shlokas.4:
ma~NgalaiH stutibhishchApi vijayapratisaMhitaiH |
chAraNaiH stUyamAnau tu jagmatuH parayA mudA
shlokas.5:
tAvantarikShamutpatya daityau kAmagamAvubhau |
devAnAmeva bhavanaM jagmaturyuddhadurmadau
shlokas.6:
tayorAgamanaM j~nAtvA varadAnaM cha tatprabhoH |
hitvA triviShTapaM jagmurbrahmalokaM tataH surAH
shlokas.7:
tAvindralokaM nirjitya yakSharakShogaNA.nstathA |
khecharANyapi bhUtAni jigyatustIvravikramau
shlokas.8:
antarbhUmigatAnnAgA~njitvA tau cha mahAsurau |
samudravAsinaH sarvAnmlechChajAtInvijigyatuH
shlokas.9:
tataH sarvAM mahIM jetumArabdhAvugrashAsanau |
sainikA.nshcha samAhUya sutIkShNAM vAchamUchatuH
shlokas.10:
rAjarShayo mahAyaj~nairhavyakavyairdvijAtayaH |
tejo balaM cha devAnAM vardhayanti shriyaM tathA
shlokas.11:
teShAmevaM pravRRiddhAnAM sarveShAmasuradviShAm |
sambhUya sarvairasmAbhiH kAryaH sarvAtmanA vadhaH
shlokas.12:
evaM sarvAnsamAdishya pUrvatIre mahodadheH |
krUrAM matiM samAsthAya jagmatuH sarvatomukham
shlokas.13:
yaj~nairyajante ye kechidyAjayanti cha ye dvijAH |
tAnsarvAnprasabhaM dRRiShTvA balinau jaghnatustadA
shlokas.14:
AshrameShvagnihotrANi RRiShINAM bhAvitAtmanAm |
gRRihItvA prakShipantyapsu vishrabdhAH sainikAstayoH
shlokas.15:
tapodhanaishcha ye shApAH kruddhairuktA mahAtmabhiH |
nAkrAmanti tayoste.api varadAnena jRRimbhatoH
shlokas.16:
nAkrAmanti yadA shApA bANA muktAH shilAsviva |
niyamA.nstadA parityajya vyadravanta dvijAtayaH
shlokas.17:
pRRithivyAM ye tapaHsiddhA dAntAH shamaparAyaNAH |
tayorbhayAddudruvuste vainateyAdivoragAH
shlokas.18:
mathitairAshramairbhagnairvikIrNakalashasruvaiH |
shUnyamAsIjjagatsarvaM kAleneva hataM yathA
shlokas.19:
rAjarShibhiradRRishyadbhirRRiShibhishcha mahAsurau |
ubhau vinishchayaM kRRitvA vikurvAte vadhaiShiNau
shlokas.20:
prabhinnakaraTau mattau bhUtvA ku~njararUpiNau |
sa.nlInAnapi durgeShu ninyaturyamasAdanam
shlokas.21:
siMhau bhUtvA punarvyAghrau punashchAntarhitAvubhau |
taistairupAyaistau krUrAvRRiShIndRRiShTvA nijaghnatuH
shlokas.22:
nivRRittayaj~nasvAdhyAyA praNaShTanRRipatidvijA |
utsannotsavayaj~nA cha babhUva vasudhA tadA
shlokas.23:
hAhAbhUtA bhayArtA cha nivRRittavipaNApaNA |
nivRRittadevakAryA cha puNyodvAhavivarjitA
shlokas.24:
nivRRittakRRiShigorakShA vidhvastanagarAshramA |
asthika~NkAlasa~NkIrNA bhUrbabhUvogradarshanA
shlokas.25:
nivRRittapitRRikAryaM cha nirvaShaTkArama~Ngalam |
jagatpratibhayAkAraM duShprekShyamabhavattadA
shlokas.26:
chandrAdityau grahAstArA nakShatrANi divaukasaH |
jagmurviShAdaM tatkarma dRRiShTvA sundopasundayoH
shlokas.27:
evaM sarvA disho daityau jitvA krUreNa karmaNA |
niHsapatnau kurukShetre niveshamabhichakratuH

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
tato devarShayaH sarve siddhAshcha paramarShayaH |
jagmustadA parAmArtiM dRRiShTvA tatkadanaM mahat
shlokas.2:
te.abhijagmurjitakrodhA jitAtmAno jitendriyAH |
pitAmahasya bhavanaM jagataH kRRipayA tadA
shlokas.3:
tato dadRRishurAsInaM saha devaiH pitAmaham |
siddhairbrahmarShibhishchaiva samantAtparivAritam
shlokas.4:
tatra devo mahAdevastatrAgnirvAyunA saha |
chandrAdityau cha dharmashcha parameShThI tathA budhaH
shlokas.5:
vaikhAnasA vAlakhilyA vAnaprasthA marIchipAH |
ajAshchaivAvimUDhAshcha tejogarbhAstapasvinaH
RRiShayaH sarva evaite pitAmahamupAsate
shlokas.6:
tato.abhigamya sahitAH sarva eva maharShayaH |
sundopasundayoH karma sarvameva shasha.nsire
shlokas.7:
yathAkRRitaM yathA chaiva kRRitaM yena krameNa cha |
nyavedaya.nstataH sarvamakhilena pitAmahe
shlokas.8:
tato devagaNAH sarve te chaiva paramarShayaH |
tamevArthaM puraskRRitya pitAmahamachodayan
shlokas.9:
tataH pitAmahaH shrutvA sarveShAM tadvachastadA |
muhUrtamiva sa~nchintya kartavyasya vinishchayam
shlokas.10:
tayorvadhaM samuddishya vishvakarmANamAhvayat |
dRRiShTvA cha vishvakarmANaM vyAdidesha pitAmahaH
sRRijyatAM prArthanIyeha pramadeti mahAtapAH
shlokas.11:
pitAmahaM namaskRRitya tadvAkyamabhinandya cha |
nirmame yoShitaM divyAM chintayitvA prayatnataH
shlokas.12:
triShu lokeShu yatki~nchidbhUtaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
samAnayaddarshanIyaM tattadyatnAttatastataH
shlokas.13:
koTishashchApi ratnAni tasyA gAtre nyaveshayat |
tAM ratnasa~NghAtamayImasRRijaddevarUpiNIm
shlokas.14:
sA prayatnena mahatA nirmitA vishvakarmaNA |
triShu lokeShu nArINAM rUpeNApratimAbhavat
shlokas.15:
na tasyAH sUkShmamapyasti yadgAtre rUpasampadA |
na yuktaM yatra vA dRRiShTirna sajjati nirIkShatAm
shlokas.16:
sA vigrahavatIva shrIH kAntarUpA vapuShmatI |
jahAra sarvabhUtAnAM chakShUMShi cha manA.nsi cha
shlokas.17:
tilaM tilaM samAnIya ratnAnAM yadvinirmitA |
tilottametyatastasyA nAma chakre pitAmahaH
shlokas.18:
pitAmaha uvAcha||
gachCha sundopasundAbhyAmasurAbhyAM tilottame |
prArthanIyena rUpeNa kuru bhadre pralobhanam
shlokas.19:
tvatkRRite darshanAdeva rUpasampatkRRitena vai |
virodhaH syAdyathA tAbhyAmanyonyena tathA kuru
shlokas.20:
nArada uvAcha||
sA tatheti pratij~nAya namaskRRitya pitAmaham |
chakAra maNDalaM tatra vibudhAnAM pradakShiNam
shlokas.21:
prA~Nmukho bhagavAnAste dakShiNena maheshvaraH |
devAshchaivottareNAsansarvatastvRRiShayo.abhavan
shlokas.22:
kurvantyA tu tayA tatra maNDalaM tatpradakShiNam |
indraH sthANushcha bhagavAndhairyeNa pratyavasthitau
shlokas.23:
draShTukAmasya chAtyarthaM gatAyAH pArshvatastadA |
anyada~nchitapakShmAntaM dakShiNaM niHsRRitaM mukham
shlokas.24:
pRRiShThataH parivartantyAH pashchimaM niHsRRitaM mukham |
gatAyAshchottaraM pArshvamuttaraM niHsRRitaM mukham
shlokas.25:
mahendrasyApi netrANAM pArshvataH pRRiShThato.agrataH |
raktAntAnAM vishAlAnAM sahasraM sarvato.abhavat
shlokas.26:
evaM chaturmukhaH sthANurmahAdevo.abhavatpurA |
tathA sahasranetrashcha babhUva balasUdanaH
shlokas.27:
tathA devanikAyAnAmRRiShINAM chaiva sarvashaH |
mukhAnyabhipravartante yena yAti tilottamA
shlokas.28:
tasyA gAtre nipatitA teShAM dRRiShTirmahAtmanAm |
sarveShAmeva bhUyiShThamRRite devaM pitAmaham
shlokas.29:
gachChantyAstu tadA devAH sarve cha paramarShayaH |
kRRitamityeva tatkAryaM menire rUpasampadA
shlokas.30:
tilottamAyAM tu tadA gatAyAM lokabhAvanaH |
sarvAnvisarjayAmAsa devAnRRiShigaNA.nshcha tAn

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
jitvA tu pRRithivIM daityau niHsapatnau gatavyathau |
kRRitvA trailokyamavyagraM kRRitakRRityau babhUvatuH
shlokas.2:
devagandharvayakShANAM nAgapArthivarakShasAm |
AdAya sarvaratnAni parAM tuShTimupAgatau
shlokas.3:
yadA na pratiSheddhArastayoH santIha kechana |
nirudyogau tadA bhUtvA vijahrAte.amarAviva
shlokas.4:
strIbhirmAlyaishcha gandhaishcha bhakShairbhojyaishcha puShkalaiH |
pAnaishcha vividhairhRRidyaiH parAM prItimavApatuH
shlokas.5:
antaHpure vanodyAne parvatopavaneShu cha |
yathepsiteShu desheShu vijahrAte.amarAviva
shlokas.6:
tataH kadAchidvindhyasya pRRiShThe samashilAtale |
puShpitAgreShu shAleShu vihAramabhijagmatuH
shlokas.7:
divyeShu sarvakAmeShu samAnIteShu tatra tau |
varAsaneShu saMhRRiShTau saha strIbhirniShedatuH
shlokas.8:
tato vAditranRRittAbhyAmupAtiShThanta tau striyaH |
gItaishcha stutisa.nyuktaiH prItyarthamupajagmire
shlokas.9:
tatastilottamA tatra vane puShpANi chinvatI |
veShamAkShiptamAdhAya raktenaikena vAsasA
shlokas.10:
nadItIreShu jAtAnsA karNikArAnvichinvatI |
shanairjagAma taM deshaM yatrAstAM tau mahAsurau
shlokas.11:
tau tu pItvA varaM pAnaM madaraktAntalochanau |
dRRiShTvaiva tAM varArohAM vyathitau sambabhUvatuH
shlokas.12:
tAvutpatyAsanaM hitvA jagmaturyatra sA sthitA |
ubhau cha kAmasaMmattAvubhau prArthayatashcha tAm
shlokas.13:
dakShiNe tAM kare subhrUM sundo jagrAha pANinA |
upasundo.api jagrAha vAme pANau tilottamAm
shlokas.14:
varapradAnamattau tAvaurasena balena cha |
dhanaratnamadAbhyAM cha surApAnamadena cha
shlokas.15:
sarvairetairmadairmattAvanyonyaM bhrukuTIkRRitau |
madakAmasamAviShTau parasparamathochatuH
shlokas.16:
mama bhAryA tava gururiti sundo.abhyabhAShata |
mama bhAryA tava vadhUrupasundo.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.17:
naiShA tava mamaiSheti tatra tau manyurAvishat |
tasyA hetorgade bhIme tAvubhAvapyagRRihNatAm
shlokas.18:
tau pragRRihya gade bhIme tasyAH kAmena mohitau |
ahaM pUrvamahaM pUrvamityanyonyaM nijaghnatuH
shlokas.19:
tau gadAbhihatau bhImau petaturdharaNItale |
rudhireNAvaliptA~Ngau dvAvivArkau nabhashchyutau
shlokas.20:
tatastA vidrutA nAryaH sa cha daityagaNastadA |
pAtAlamagamatsarvo viShAdabhayakampitaH
shlokas.21:
tataH pitAmahastatra saha devairmaharShibhiH |
AjagAma vishuddhAtmA pUjayiShya.nstilottamAm
shlokas.22:
vareNa ChanditA sA tu brahmaNA prItimeva ha |
varayAmAsa tatrainAM prItaH prAha pitAmahaH
shlokas.23:
AdityacharitA.NllokAnvichariShyasi bhAmini |
tejasA cha sudRRiShTAM tvAM na kariShyati kashchana
shlokas.24:
evaM tasyai varaM dattvA sarvalokapitAmahaH |
indre trailokyamAdhAya brahmalokaM gataH prabhuH
shlokas.25:
evaM tau sahitau bhUtvA sarvArtheShvekanishchayau |
tilottamArthe sa~NkruddhAvanyonyamabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.26:
tasmAdbravImi vaH snehAtsarvAnbharatasattamAn |
yathA vo nAtra bhedaH syAtsarveShAM draupadIkRRite
tathA kuruta bhadraM vo mama chetpriyamichChatha
shlokas.27:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktA mahAtmAno nAradena maharShiNA |
samayaM chakrire rAja.nste.anyonyena samAgatAH
samakShaM tasya devarShernAradasyAmitaujasaH
shlokas.28:
draupadyA naH sahAsInamanyo.anyaM yo.abhidarshayet |
sa no dvAdasha varShANi brahmachArI vane vaset
shlokas.29:
kRRite tu samaye tasminpANDavairdharmachAribhiH |
nArado.apyagamatprIta iShTaM deshaM mahAmuniH
shlokas.30:
evaM taiH samayaH pUrvaM kRRito naradachoditaiH |
na chAbhidyanta te sArve tadAnyonyena bhArata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM te samayaM kRRitvA nyavasa.nstatra pANDavAH |
vashe shastrapratApena kurvanto.anyAnmahIkShitaH
shlokas.2:
teShAM manujasiMhAnAM pa~nchAnAmamitaujasAm |
babhUva kRRiShNA sarveShAM pArthAnAM vashavartinI
shlokas.3:
te tayA taishcha sA vIraiH patibhiH saha pa~nchabhiH |
babhUva paramaprItA nAgairiva sarasvatI
shlokas.4:
vartamAneShu dharmeNa pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
vyavardhankuravaH sarve hInadoShAH sukhAnvitAH
shlokas.5:
atha dIrgheNa kAlena brAhmaNasya vishAM pate |
kasyachittaskarAH kechijjahrurgA nRRipasattama
shlokas.6:
hriyamANe dhane tasminbrAhmaNaH krodhamUrchChitaH |
Agamya khANDavaprasthamudakroshata pANDavAn
shlokas.7:
hriyate godhanaM kShudrairnRRisha.nsairakRRitAtmabhiH |
prasahya vo.asmAdviShayAdabhidhAvata pANDavAH
shlokas.8:
brAhmaNasya pramattasya havirdhvA~NkShairvilupyate |
shArdUlasya guhAM shUnyAM nIchaH kroShTAbhimarshati
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNasve hRRite chorairdharmArthe cha vilopite |
rorUyamANe cha mayi kriyatAmastradhAraNam
shlokas.10:
rorUyamANasyAbhyAshe tasya viprasya pANDavaH |
tAni vAkyAni shushrAva kuntIputro dhana~njayaH
shlokas.11:
shrutvA chaiva mahAbAhurmA bhairityAha taM dvijam |
AyudhAni cha yatrAsanpANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm
kRRiShNayA saha tatrAsIddharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.12:
sa praveshAya chAshakto gamanAya cha pANDavaH |
tasya chArtasya tairvAkyaishchodyamAnaH punaH punaH
Akrande tatra kaunteyashchintayAmAsa duHkhitaH
shlokas.13:
hriyamANe dhane tasminbrAhmaNasya tapasvinaH |
ashrupramArjanaM tasya kartavyamiti nishchitaH
shlokas.14:
upaprekShaNajo.adharmaH sumahAnsyAnmahIpateH |
yadyasya rudato dvAri na karomyadya rakShaNam
shlokas.15:
anAstikyaM cha sarveShAmasmAkamapi rakShaNe |
pratitiShTheta loke.asminnadharmashchaiva no bhavet
shlokas.16:
anApRRichChya cha rAjAnaM gate mayi na sa.nshayaH |
ajAtashatrornRRipatermama chaivApriyaM bhavet
shlokas.17:
anupraveshe rAj~nastu vanavAso bhavenmama |
adharmo vA mahAnastu vane vA maraNaM mama
sharIrasyApi nAshena dharma eva vishiShyate
shlokas.18:
evaM vinishchitya tataH kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
anupravishya rAjAnamApRRichChya cha vishAM pate
shlokas.19:
dhanurAdAya saMhRRiShTo brAhmaNaM pratyabhAShata |
brAhmaNAgamyatAM shIghraM yAvatparadhanaiShiNaH
shlokas.20:
na dUre te gatAH kShudrAstAvadgachChAmahe saha |
yAvadAvartayAmyadya chorahastAddhanaM tava
shlokas.21:
so.anusRRitya mahAbAhurdhanvI varmI rathI dhvajI |
sharairvidhva.nsitA.nshchorAnavajitya cha taddhanam
shlokas.22:
brAhmaNasya upAhRRitya yashaH pItvA cha pANDavaH |
AjagAma puraM vIraH savyasAchI parantapaH
shlokas.23:
so.abhivAdya gurUnsarvA.nstaishchApi pratinanditaH |
dharmarAjamuvAchedaM vratamAdishyatAM mama
shlokas.24:
samayaH samatikrAnto bhavatsa.ndarshanAnmayA |
vanavAsaM gamiShyAmi samayo hyeSha naH kRRitaH
shlokas.25:
ityukto dharmarAjastu sahasA vAkyamapriyam |
kathamityabravIdvAchA shokArtaH sajjamAnayA
yudhiShThiro guDAkeshaM bhrAtA bhrAtaramachyutam
shlokas.26:
pramANamasmi yadi te mattaH shRRiNu vacho.anagha |
anupraveshe yadvIra kRRitavA.nstvaM mamApriyam
sarvaM tadanujAnAmi vyalIkaM na cha me hRRidi
shlokas.27:
guroranupravesho hi nopaghAto yavIyasaH |
yavIyaso.anupravesho jyeShThasya vidhilopakaH
shlokas.28:
nivartasva mahAbAho kuruShva vachanaM mama |
na hi te dharmalopo.asti na cha me dharShaNA kRRitA
shlokas.29:
arjuna uvAcha||
na vyAjena chareddharmamiti me bhavataH shrutam |
na satyAdvichaliShyAmi satyenAyudhamAlabhe
shlokas.30:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
so.abhyanuj~nApya rAjAnaM brahmacharyAya dIkShitaH |
vane dvAdasha varShANi vAsAyopajagAma ha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
taM prayAntaM mahAbAhuM kauravANAM yashaskaram |
anujagmurmahAtmAno brAhmaNA vedapAragAH
shlokas.2:
vedavedA~NgavidvA.nsastathaivAdhyAtmachintakAH |
chaukShAshcha bhagavadbhaktAH sUtAH paurANikAshcha ye
shlokas.3:
kathakAshchApare rAja~nshramaNAshcha vanaukasaH |
divyAkhyAnAni ye chApi paThanti madhuraM dvijAH
shlokas.4:
etaishchAnyaishcha bahubhiH sahAyaiH pANDunandanaH |
vRRitaH shlakShNakathaiH prAyAnmarudbhiriva vAsavaH
shlokas.5:
ramaNIyAni chitrANi vanAni cha sarA.nsi cha |
saritaH sAgarA.nshchaiva deshAnapi cha bhArata
shlokas.6:
puNyAni chaiva tIrthAni dadarsha bharatarShabha |
sa ga~NgAdvAramAsAdya niveshamakarotprabhuH
shlokas.7:
tatra tasyAdbhutaM karma shRRiNu me janamejaya |
kRRitavAnyadvishuddhAtmA pANDUnAM pravaro rathI
shlokas.8:
niviShTe tatra kaunteye brAhmaNeShu cha bhArata |
agnihotrANi viprAste prAdushchakruranekashaH
shlokas.9:
teShu prabodhyamAneShu jvaliteShu huteShu cha |
kRRitapuShpopahAreShu tIrAntaragateShu cha
shlokas.10:
kRRitAbhiShekairvidvadbhirniyataiH satpathi sthitaiH |
shushubhe.atIva tadrAjanga~NgAdvAraM mahAtmabhiH
shlokas.11:
tathA paryAkule tasminniveshe pANDunandanaH |
abhiShekAya kaunteyo ga~NgAmavatatAra ha
shlokas.12:
tatrAbhiShekaM kRRitvA sa tarpayitvA pitAmahAn |
uttitIrShurjalAdrAjannagnikAryachikIrShayA
shlokas.13:
apakRRiShTo mahAbAhurnAgarAjasya kanyayA |
antarjale mahArAja ulUpyA kAmayAnayA
shlokas.14:
dadarsha pANDavastatra pAvakaM susamAhitam |
kauravyasyAtha nAgasya bhavane paramArchite
shlokas.15:
tatrAgnikAryaM kRRitavAnkuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
asha~NkamAnena hutastenAtuShyaddhutAshanaH
shlokas.16:
agnikAryaM sa kRRitvA tu nAgarAjasutAM tadA |
prahasanniva kaunteya idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.17:
kimidaM sAhasaM bhIru kRRitavatyasi bhAmini |
kashchAyaM subhago deshaH kA cha tvaM kasya chAtmajA
shlokas.18:
ulUpyuvAcha||
airAvatakule jAtaH kauravyo nAma pannagaH |
tasyAsmi duhitA pArtha ulUpI nAma pannagI
shlokas.19:
sAhaM tvAmabhiShekArthamavatIrNaM samudragAm |
dRRiShTavatyeva kaunteya kandarpeNAsmi mUrchChitA
shlokas.20:
tAM mAmana~NgamathitAM tvatkRRite kurunandana |
ananyAM nandayasvAdya pradAnenAtmano rahaH
shlokas.21:
arjuna uvAcha||
brahmacharyamidaM bhadre mama dvAdashavArShikam |
dharmarAjena chAdiShTaM nAhamasmi svaya.nvashaH
shlokas.22:
tava chApi priyaM kartumichChAmi jalachAriNi |
anRRitaM noktapUrvaM cha mayA ki~nchana karhichit
shlokas.23:
kathaM cha nAnRRitaM tatsyAttava chApi priyaM bhavet |
na cha pIDyeta me dharmastathA kuryAM bhuja~Ngame
shlokas.24:
ulUpyuvAcha||
jAnAmyahaM pANDaveya yathA charasi medinIm |
yathA cha te brahmacharyamidamAdiShTavAnguruH
shlokas.25:
parasparaM vartamAnAndrupadasyAtmajAM prati |
yo no.anupravishenmohAtsa no dvAdashavArShikam
vane charedbrahmacharyamiti vaH samayaH kRRitaH
shlokas.26:
tadidaM draupadIhetoranyonyasya pravAsanam |
kRRitaM vastatra dharmArthamatra dharmo na duShyati
shlokas.27:
paritrANaM cha kartavyamArtAnAM pRRithulochana |
kRRitvA mama paritrANaM tava dharmo na lupyate
shlokas.28:
yadi vApyasya dharmasya sUkShmo.api syAdvyatikramaH |
sa cha te dharma eva syAddAttvA prANAnmamArjuna
shlokas.29:
bhaktAM bhajasva mAM pArtha satAmetanmataM prabho |
na kariShyasi chedevaM mRRitAM mAmupadhAraya
shlokas.30:
prANadAnAnmahAbAho chara dharmamanuttamam |
sharaNaM cha prapannAsmi tvAmadya puruShottama
shlokas.31:
dInAnanAthAnkaunteya parirakShasi nityashaH |
sAhaM sharaNamabhyemi roravImi cha duHkhitA
shlokas.32:
yAche tvAmabhikAmAhaM tasmAtkuru mama priyam |
sa tvamAtmapradAnena sakAmAM kartumarhasi
shlokas.33:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu kaunteyaH pannageshvarakanyayA |
kRRitavA.nstattathA sarvaM dharmamuddishya kAraNam
shlokas.34:
sa nAgabhavane rAtriM tAmuShitvA pratApavAn |
udite.abhyutthitaH sUrye kauravyasya niveshanAt

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kathayitvA tu tatsarvaM brAhmaNebhyaH sa bhArata |
prayayau himavatpArshvaM tato vajradharAtmajaH
shlokas.2:
agastyavaTamAsAdya vasiShThasya cha parvatam |
bhRRigutu~Nge cha kaunteyaH kRRitavA~nshauchamAtmanaH
shlokas.3:
pradadau gosahasrANi tIrtheShvAyataneShu cha |
niveshA.nshcha dvijAtibhyaH so.adadatkurusattamaH
shlokas.4:
hiraNyabindostIrthe cha snAtvA puruShasattamaH |
dRRiShTavAnparvatashreShThaM puNyAnyAyatanAni cha
shlokas.5:
avatIrya narashreShTho brAhmaNaiH saha bhArata |
prAchIM dishamabhiprepsurjagAma bharatarShabhaH
shlokas.6:
AnupUrvyeNa tIrthAni dRRiShTavAnkurusattamaH |
nadIM chotpalinIM ramyAmaraNyaM naimiShaM prati
shlokas.7:
nandAmaparanandAM cha kaushikIM cha yashasvinIm |
mahAnadIM gayAM chaiva ga~NgAmapi cha bhArata
shlokas.8:
evaM sarvANi tIrthAni pashyamAnastathAshramAn |
AtmanaH pAvanaM kurvanbrAhmaNebhyo dadau vasu
shlokas.9:
a~Ngava~Ngakali~NgeShu yAni puNyAni kAnichit |
jagAma tAni sarvANi tIrthAnyAyatanAni cha
dRRiShTvA cha vidhivattAni dhanaM chApi dadau tataH
shlokas.10:
kali~NgarAShTradvAreShu brAhmaNAH pANDavAnugAH |
abhyanuj~nAya kaunteyamupAvartanta bhArata
shlokas.11:
sa tu tairabhyanuj~nAtaH kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
sahAyairalpakaiH shUraH prayayau yena sAgaram
shlokas.12:
sa kali~NgAnatikramya deshAnAyatanAni cha |
dharmyANi ramaNIyAni prekShamANo yayau prabhuH
shlokas.13:
mahendraparvataM dRRiShTvA tApasairupashobhitam |
samudratIreNa shanairmaNalUraM jagAma ha
shlokas.14:
tatra sarvANi tIrthAni puNyAnyAyatanAni cha |
abhigamya mahAbAhurabhyagachChanmahIpatim
maNalUreshvaraM rAjandharmaj~naM chitravAhanam
shlokas.15:
tasya chitrA~NgadA nAma duhitA chArudarshanA |
tAM dadarsha pure tasminvicharantIM yadRRichChayA
shlokas.16:
dRRiShTvA cha tAM varArohAM chakame chaitravAhinIm |
abhigamya cha rAjAnaM j~nApayatsvaM prayojanam
tamuvAchAtha rAjA sa sAntvapUrvamidaM vachaH
shlokas.17:
rAjA prabha~Nkaro nAma kule asminbabhUva ha |
aputraH prasavenArthI tapastepe sa uttamam
shlokas.18:
ugreNa tapasA tena praNipAtena sha~NkaraH |
IshvarastoShitastena mahAdeva umApatiH
shlokas.19:
sa tasmai bhagavAnprAdAdekaikaM prasavaM kule |
ekaikaH prasavastasmAdbhavatyasminkule sadA
shlokas.20:
teShAM kumArAH sarveShAM pUrveShAM mama jaj~nire |
kanyA tu mama jAteyaM kulasyotpAdanI dhruvam
shlokas.21:
putro mameyamiti me bhAvanA puruShottama |
putrikA hetuvidhinA sa~nj~nitA bharatarShabha
shlokas.22:
etachChulkaM bhavatvasyAH kulakRRijjAyatAmiha |
etena samayenemAM pratigRRihNIShva pANDava
shlokas.23:
sa tatheti pratij~nAya kanyAM tAM pratigRRihya cha |
uvAsa nagare tasminkaunteyastrihimAH samAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH samudre tIrthAni dakShiNe bharatarShabhaH |
abhyagachChatsupuNyAni shobhitAni tapasvibhiH
shlokas.2:
varjayanti sma tIrthAni pa~ncha tatra tu tApasAH |
AchIrNAni tu yAnyAsanpurastAttu tapasvibhiH
shlokas.3:
agastyatIrthaM saubhadraM paulomaM cha supAvanam |
kArandhamaM prasannaM cha hayamedhaphalaM cha yat
bhAradvAjasya tIrthaM cha pApaprashamanaM mahat
shlokas.4:
viviktAnyupalakShyAtha tAni tIrthAni pANDavaH |
dRRiShTvA cha varjyamAnAni munibhirdharmabuddhibhiH
shlokas.5:
tapasvinastato.apRRichChatprAj~naliH kurunandanaH |
tIrthAnImAni varjyante kimarthaM brahmavAdibhiH
shlokas.6:
tApasA UchuH||
grAhAH pa~ncha vasantyeShu haranti cha tapodhanAn |
ata etAni varjyante tIrthAni kurunandana
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
teShAM shrutvA mahAbAhurvAryamANastapodhanaiH |
jagAma tAni tIrthAni draShTuM puruShasattamaH
shlokas.8:
tataH saubhadramAsAdya maharShestIrthamuttamam |
vigAhya tarasA shUraH snAnaM chakre parantapaH
shlokas.9:
atha taM puruShavyAghramantarjalacharo mahAn |
nijagrAha jale grAhaH kuntIputraM dhana~njayam
shlokas.10:
sa tamAdAya kaunteyo visphurantaM jalecharam |
udatiShThanmahAbAhurbalena balinAM varaH
shlokas.11:
utkRRiShTa eva tu grAhaH so.arjunena yashasvinA |
babhUva nArI kalyANI sarvAbharaNabhUShitA
dIpyamAnA shriyA rAjandivyarUpA manoramA
shlokas.12:
tadadbhutaM mahaddRRiShTvA kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
tAM striyaM paramaprIta idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.13:
kA vai tvamasi kalyANi kuto vAsi jalecharI |
kimarthaM cha mahatpApamidaM kRRitavatI purA
shlokas.14:
nAryuvAcha||
apsarAsmi mahAbAho devAraNyavichAriNI |
iShTA dhanapaternityaM vargA nAma mahAbala
shlokas.15:
mama sakhyashchatasro.anyAH sarvAH kAmagamAH shubhAH |
tAbhiH sArdhaM prayAtAsmi lokapAlaniveshanam
shlokas.16:
tataH pashyAmahe sarvA brAhmaNaM sa.nshitavratam |
rUpavantamadhIyAnamekamekAntachAriNam
shlokas.17:
tasya vai tapasA rAja.nstadvanaM tejasAvRRitam |
Aditya iva taM deshaM kRRitsnaM sa vyavabhAsayat
shlokas.18:
tasya dRRiShTvA tapastAdRRigrUpaM chAdbhutadarshanam |
avatIrNAH sma taM deshaM tapovighnachikIrShayA
shlokas.19:
ahaM cha saurabheyI cha samIchI budbudA latA |
yaugapadyena taM vipramabhyagachChAma bhArata
shlokas.20:
gAyantyo vai hasantyashcha lobhayantyashcha taM dvijam |
sa cha nAsmAsu kRRitavAnmano vIra katha~nchana
nAkampata mahAtejAH sthitastapasi nirmale
shlokas.21:
so.ashapatkupito.asmA.nstu brAhmaNaH kShatriyarShabha |
grAhabhUtA jale yUyaM chariShyadhvaM shataM samAH

shlokas.1:
vargovAcha||
tato vayaM pravyathitAH sarvA bharatasattama |
AyAma sharaNaM vipraM taM tapodhanamachyutam
shlokas.2:
rUpeNa vayasA chaiva kandarpeNa cha darpitAH |
ayuktaM kRRitavatyaH sma kShantumarhasi no dvija
shlokas.3:
eSha eva vadho.asmAkaM suparyAptastapodhana |
yadvayaM sa.nshitAtmAnaM pralobdhuM tvAmihAgatAH
shlokas.4:
avadhyAstu striyaH sRRiShTA manyante dharmachintakAH |
tasmAddharmeNa dharmaj~na nAsmAnhi.nsitumarhasi
shlokas.5:
sarvabhUteShu dharmaj~na maitro brAhmaNa uchyate |
satyo bhavatu kalyANa eSha vAdo manIShiNAm
shlokas.6:
sharaNaM cha prapannAnAM shiShTAH kurvanti pAlanam |
sharaNaM tvAM prapannAH sma tasmAttvaM kShantumarhasi
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu dharmAtmA brAhmaNaH shubhakarmakRRit |
prasAdaM kRRitavAnvIra ravisomasamaprabhaH
shlokas.8:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
shataM sahasraM vishvaM cha sarvamakShayavAchakam |
parimANaM shataM tvetannaitadakShayavAchakam
shlokas.9:
yadA cha vo grAhabhUtA gRRihNantIH puruShA~njale |
utkarShati jalAtkashchitsthalaM puruShasattamaH
shlokas.10:
tadA yUyaM punaH sarvAH svarUpaM pratipatsyatha |
anRRitaM noktapUrvaM me hasatApi kadAchana
shlokas.11:
tAni sarvANi tIrthAni itaH prabhRRiti chaiva ha |
nArItIrthAni nAmneha khyAtiM yAsyanti sarvashaH
puNyAni cha bhaviShyanti pAvanAni manIShiNAm
shlokas.12:
vargovAcha||
tato.abhivAdya taM vipraM kRRitvA chaiva pradakShiNam |
achintayAmopasRRitya tasmAddeshAtsuduHkhitAH
shlokas.13:
kva nu nAma vayaM sarvAH kAlenAlpena taM naram |
samAgachChema yo nastadrUpamApAdayetpunaH
shlokas.14:
tA vayaM chintayitvaivaM muhUrtAdiva bhArata |
dRRiShTavatyo mahAbhAgaM devarShimuta nAradam
shlokas.15:
sarvA hRRiShTAH sma taM dRRiShTvA devarShimamitadyutim |
abhivAdya cha taM pArtha sthitAH sma vyathitAnanAH
shlokas.16:
sa no.apRRichChadduHkhamUlamuktavatyo vayaM cha tat |
shrutvA tachcha yathAvRRittamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.17:
dakShiNe sAgarAnUpe pa~ncha tIrthAni santi vai |
puNyAni ramaNIyAni tAni gachChata mAchiram
shlokas.18:
tatrAshu puruShavyAghraH pANDavo vo dhana~njayaH |
mokShayiShyati shuddhAtmA duHkhAdasmAnna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.19:
tasya sarvA vayaM vIra shrutvA vAkyamihAgatAH |
tadidaM satyamevAdya mokShitAhaM tvayAnagha
shlokas.20:
etAstu mama vai sakhyashchatasro.anyA jale sthitAH |
kuru karma shubhaM vIra etAH sarvA vimokShaya
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastAH pANDavashreShThaH sarvA eva vishAM pate |
tasmAchChApAdadInAtmA mokShayAmAsa vIryavAn
shlokas.22:
utthAya cha jalAttasmAtpratilabhya vapuH svakam |
tAstadApsaraso rAjannadRRishyanta yathA purA
shlokas.23:
tIrthAni shodhayitvA tu tathAnuj~nAya tAH prabhuH |
chitrA~NgadAM punardraShTuM maNalUrapuraM yayau
shlokas.24:
tasyAmajanayatputraM rAjAnaM babhruvAhanam |
taM dRRiShTvA pANDavo rAjangokarNamabhito.agamat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
so.aparAnteShu tIrthAni puNyAnyAyatanAni cha |
sarvANyevAnupUrvyeNa jagAmAmitavikramaH
shlokas.2:
samudre pashchime yAni tIrthAnyAyatanAni cha |
tAni sarvANi gatvA sa prabhAsamupajagmivAn
shlokas.3:
prabhAsadeshaM samprAptaM bIbhatsumaparAjitam |
tIrthAnyanucharantaM cha shushrAva madhusUdanaH
shlokas.4:
tato.abhyagachChatkaunteyamaj~nAto nAma mAdhavaH |
dadRRishAte tadAnyonyaM prabhAse kRRiShNapANDavau
shlokas.5:
tAvanyonyaM samAshliShya pRRiShTvA cha kushalaM vane |
AstAM priyasakhAyau tau naranArAyaNAvRRiShI
shlokas.6:
tato.arjunaM vAsudevastAM charyAM paryapRRichChata |
kimarthaM pANDavemAni tIrthAnyanucharasyuta
shlokas.7:
tato.arjuno yathAvRRittaM sarvamAkhyAtavA.nstadA |
shrutvovAcha cha vArShNeya evametaditi prabhuH
shlokas.8:
tau vihRRitya yathAkAmaM prabhAse kRRiShNapANDavau |
mahIdharaM raivatakaM vAsAyaivAbhijagmatuH
shlokas.9:
pUrvameva tu kRRiShNasya vachanAttaM mahIdharam |
puruShAH samala~nchakrurupajahrushcha bhojanam
shlokas.10:
pratigRRihyArjunaH sarvamupabhujya cha pANDavaH |
sahaiva vAsudevena dRRiShTavAnnaTanartakAn
shlokas.11:
abhyanuj~nApya tAnsarvAnarchayitvA cha pANDavaH |
satkRRitaM shayanaM divyamabhyagachChanmahAdyutiH
shlokas.12:
tIrthAnAM darshanaM chaiva parvatAnAM cha bhArata |
ApagAnAM vanAnAM cha kathayAmAsa sAtvate
shlokas.13:
sa kathAH kathayanneva nidrayA janamejaya |
kaunteyo.apahRRitastasmi~nshayane svargasaMmite
shlokas.14:
madhureNa sa gItena vINAshabdena chAnagha |
prabodhyamAno bubudhe stutibhirma~NgalaistathA
shlokas.15:
sa kRRitvAvashyakAryANi vArShNeyenAbhinanditaH |
rathena kA~nchanA~Ngena dvArakAmabhijagmivAn
shlokas.16:
ala~NkRRitA dvArakA tu babhUva janamejaya |
kuntIsutasya pUjArthamapi niShkuTakeShvapi
shlokas.17:
didRRikShavashcha kaunteyaM dvArakAvAsino janAH |
narendramArgamAjagmustUrNaM shatasahasrashaH
shlokas.18:
avalokeShu nArINAM sahasrANi shatAni cha |
bhojavRRiShNyandhakAnAM cha samavAyo mahAnabhUt
shlokas.19:
sa tathA satkRRitaH sarvairbhojavRRiShNyandhakAtmajaiH |
abhivAdyAbhivAdyA.nshcha sarvaishcha pratinanditaH
shlokas.20:
kumAraiH sarvasho vIraH satkAreNAbhivAditaH |
samAnavayasaH sarvAnAshliShya sa punaH punaH
shlokas.21:
kRRiShNasya bhavane ramye ratnabhojyasamAvRRite |
uvAsa saha kRRiShNena bahulAstatra sharvarIH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH katipayAhasya tasminraivatake girau |
vRRiShNyandhakAnAmabhavatsumahAnutsavo nRRipa
shlokas.2:
tatra dAnaM dadurvIrA brAhmaNAnAM sahasrashaH |
bhojavRRiShNyandhakAshchaiva mahe tasya girestadA
shlokas.3:
prAsAdai ratnachitraishcha girestasya samantataH |
sa deshaH shobhito rAjandIpavRRikShaishcha sarvashaH
shlokas.4:
vAditrANi cha tatra sma vAdakAH samavAdayan |
nanRRiturnartakAshchaiva jagurgAnAni gAyanAH
shlokas.5:
ala~NkRRitAH kumArAshcha vRRiShNInAM sumahaujasaH |
yAnairhATakachitrA~Ngaishcha~nchUryante sma sarvashaH
shlokas.6:
paurAshcha pAdachAreNa yAnairuchchAvachaistathA |
sadArAH sAnuyAtrAshcha shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.7:
tato haladharaH kShIbo revatIsahitaH prabhuH |
anugamyamAno gandharvairacharattatra bhArata
shlokas.8:
tathaiva rAjA vRRiShNInAmugrasenaH pratApavAn |
upagIyamAno gandharvaiH strIsahasrasahAyavAn
shlokas.9:
raukmiNeyashcha sAmbashcha kShIbau samaradurmadau |
divyamAlyAmbaradharau vijahrAte.amarAviva
shlokas.10:
akrUraH sAraNashchaiva gado bhAnurviDUrathaH |
nishaThashchArudeShNashcha pRRithurvipRRithureva cha
shlokas.11:
satyakaH sAtyakishchaiva bha~NgakArasahAcharau |
hArdikyaH kRRitavarmA cha ye chAnye nAnukIrtitAH
shlokas.12:
ete parivRRitAH strIbhirgandharvaishcha pRRithakpRRithak |
tamutsavaM raivatake shobhayAM chakrire tadA
shlokas.13:
tadA kolAhale tasminvartamAne mahAshubhe |
vAsudevashcha pArthashcha sahitau parijagmatuH
shlokas.14:
tatra cha~NkramyamANau tau vAsudevasutAM shubhAm |
ala~NkRRitAM sakhImadhye bhadrAM dadRRishatustadA
shlokas.15:
dRRiShTvaiva tAmarjunasya kandarpaH samajAyata |
taM tathaikAgramanasaM kRRiShNaH pArthamalakShayat
shlokas.16:
athAbravItpuShkarAkShaH prahasanniva bhArata |
vanecharasya kimidaM kAmenAloDyate manaH
shlokas.17:
mamaiShA bhaginI pArtha sAraNasya sahodarA |
yadi te vartate buddhirvakShyAmi pitaraM svayam
shlokas.18:
arjuna uvAcha||
duhitA vasudevasya vAsudevasya cha svasA |
rUpeNa chaiva sampannA kamivaiShA na mohayet
shlokas.19:
kRRitameva tu kalyANaM sarvaM mama bhaveddhruvam |
yadi syAnmama vArShNeyI mahiShIyaM svasA tava
shlokas.20:
prAptau tu ka upAyaH syAttadbravIhi janArdana |
AsthAsyAmi tathA sarvaM yadi shakyaM nareNa tat
shlokas.21:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
svaya.nvaraH kShatriyANAM vivAhaH puruSharShabha |
sa cha sa.nshayitaH pArtha svabhAvasyAnimittataH
shlokas.22:
prasahya haraNaM chApi kShatriyANAM prashasyate |
vivAhahetoH shUrANAmiti dharmavido viduH
shlokas.23:
sa tvamarjuna kalyANIM prasahya bhaginIM mama |
hara svaya.nvare hyasyAH ko vai veda chikIrShitam
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato.arjunashcha kRRiShNashcha vinishchityetikRRityatAm |
shIghragAnpuruShAnrAjanpreShayAmAsatustadA
shlokas.25:
dharmarAjAya tatsarvamindraprasthagatAya vai |
shrutvaiva cha mahAbAhuranujaj~ne sa pANDavaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sa.nvAdite tasminnanuj~nAto dhana~njayaH |
gatAM raivatake kanyAM viditvA janamejaya
shlokas.2:
vAsudevAbhyanuj~nAtaH kathayitvetikRRityatAm |
kRRiShNasya matamAj~nAya prayayau bharatarShabhaH
shlokas.3:
rathena kA~nchanA~Ngena kalpitena yathAvidhi |
sainyasugrIvayuktena ki~NkiNIjAlamAlinA
shlokas.4:
sarvashastropapannena jImUtaravanAdinA |
jvalitAgniprakAshena dviShatAM harShaghAtinA
shlokas.5:
saMnaddhaH kavachI khaDgI baddhagodhA~NgulitravAn |
mRRigayAvyapadeshena yaugapadyena bhArata
shlokas.6:
subhadrA tvatha shailendramabhyarchya saha raivatam |
daivatAni cha sarvANi brAhmaNAnsvasti vAchya cha
shlokas.7:
pradakShiNaM giriM kRRitvA prayayau dvArakAM prati |
tAmabhidrutya kaunteyaH prasahyAropayadratham
shlokas.8:
tataH sa puruShavyAghrastAmAdAya shuchismitAm |
rathenAkAshagenaiva prayayau svapuraM prati
shlokas.9:
hriyamANAM tu tAM dRRiShTvA subhadrAM sainiko janaH |
vikroshanprAdravatsarvo dvArakAmabhitaH purIm
shlokas.10:
te samAsAdya sahitAH sudharmAmabhitaH sabhAm |
sabhApAlasya tatsarvamAchakhyuH pArthavikramam
shlokas.11:
teShAM shrutvA sabhApAlo bherIM sAMnAhikIM tataH |
samAjaghne mahAghoShAM jAmbUnadapariShkRRitAm
shlokas.12:
kShubdhAstenAtha shabdena bhojavRRiShNyandhakAstadA |
annapAnamapAsyAtha samApetuH sabhAM tataH
shlokas.13:
tato jAmbUnadA~NgAni spardhyAstaraNavanti cha |
maNividrumachitrANi jvalitAgniprabhANi cha
shlokas.14:
bhejire puruShavyAghrA vRRiShNyandhakamahArathAH |
siMhAsanAni shatasho dhiShNyAnIva hutAshanAH
shlokas.15:
teShAM samupaviShTAnAM devAnAmiva saMnaye |
Achakhyau cheShTitaM jiShNoH sabhApAlaH sahAnugaH
shlokas.16:
tachChrutvA vRRiShNivIrAste madaraktAntalochanAH |
amRRiShyamANAH pArthasya samutpeturaha~NkRRitAH
shlokas.17:
yojayadhvaM rathAnAshu prAsAnAharateti cha |
dhanUMShi cha mahArhANi kavachAni bRRihanti cha
shlokas.18:
sUtAnuchchukrushuH kechchidrathAnyojayateti cha |
svayaM cha turagAnkechinninyurhemavibhUShitAn
shlokas.19:
ratheShvAnIyamAneShu kavacheShu dhvajeShu cha |
abhikrande nRRivIrANAM tadAsItsa~NkulaM mahat
shlokas.20:
vanamAlI tataH kShIbaH kailAsashikharopamaH |
nIlavAsA madotsikta idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.21:
kimidaM kuruthApraj~nAstUShNIM bhUte janArdane |
asya bhAvamavij~nAya sa~NkruddhA moghagarjitAH
shlokas.22:
eSha tAvadabhiprAyamAkhyAtu svaM mahAmatiH |
yadasya ruchitaM kartuM tatkurudhvamatandritAH
shlokas.23:
tataste tadvachaH shrutvA grAhyarUpaM halAyudhAt |
tUShNIM bhUtAstataH sarve sAdhu sAdhviti chAbruvan
shlokas.24:
samaM vacho nishamyeti baladevasya dhImataH |
punareva sabhAmadhye sarve tu samupAvishan
shlokas.25:
tato.abravItkAmapAlo vAsudevaM parantapam |
kimavAgupaviShTo.asi prekShamANo janArdana
shlokas.26:
satkRRitastvatkRRite pArthaH sarvairasmAbhirachyuta |
na cha so.arhati tAM pUjAM durbuddhiH kulapA.nsanaH
shlokas.27:
ko hi tatraiva bhuktvAnnaM bhAjanaM bhettumarhati |
manyamAnaH kule jAtamAtmAnaM puruShaH kvachit
shlokas.28:
IpsamAnashcha sambandhaM kRRitapUrvaM cha mAnayan |
ko hi nAma bhavenArthI sAhasena samAcharet
shlokas.29:
so.avamanya cha nAmAsmAnanAdRRitya cha keshavam |
prasahya hRRitavAnadya subhadrAM mRRityumAtmanaH
shlokas.30:
kathaM hi shiraso madhye padaM tena kRRitaM mama |
marShayiShyAmi govinda pAdasparshamivoragaH
shlokas.31:
adya niShkauravAmekaH kariShyAmi vasundharAm |
na hi me marShaNIyo.ayamarjunasya vyatikramaH
shlokas.32:
taM tathA garjamAnaM tu meghadundubhiniHsvanam |
anvapadyanta te sarve bhojavRRiShNyandhakAstadA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
uktavanto yadA vAkyamasakRRitsarvavRRiShNayaH |
tato.abravIdvAsudevo vAkyaM dharmArthasaMhitam
shlokas.2:
nAvamAnaM kulasyAsya guDAkeshaH prayuktavAn |
saMmAno.abhyadhikastena prayukto.ayamasa.nshayam
shlokas.3:
arthalubdhAnna vaH pArtho manyate sAtvatAnsadA |
svaya.nvaramanAdhRRiShyaM manyate chApi pANDavaH
shlokas.4:
pradAnamapi kanyAyAH pashuvatko.anuma.nsyate |
vikrayaM chApyapatyasya kaH kuryAtpuruSho bhuvi
shlokas.5:
etAndoShA.nshcha kaunteyo dRRiShTavAniti me matiH |
ataH prasahya hRRitavAnkanyAM dharmeNa pANDavaH
shlokas.6:
uchitashchaiva sambandhaH subhadrA cha yashasvinI |
eSha chApIdRRishaH pArthaH prasahya hRRitavAniti
shlokas.7:
bharatasyAnvaye jAtaM shantanoshcha mahAtmanaH |
kuntibhojAtmajAputraM ko bubhUSheta nArjunam
shlokas.8:
na cha pashyAmi yaH pArthaM vikrameNa parAjayet |
api sarveShu lokeShu sendrarudreShu mAriSha
shlokas.9:
sa cha nAma rathastAdRRi~NmadIyAste cha vAjinaH |
yoddhA pArthashcha shIghrAstraH ko nu tena samo bhavet
shlokas.10:
tamanudrutya sAntvena parameNa dhana~njayam |
nivartayadhvaM saMhRRiShTA mamaiShA paramA matiH
shlokas.11:
yadi nirjitya vaH pArtho balAdgachChetsvakaM puram |
praNashyedvo yashaH sadyo na tu sAntve parAjayaH
shlokas.12:
tachChrutvA vAsudevasya tathA chakrurjanAdhipa |
nivRRittashchArjunastatra vivAhaM kRRitavA.nstataH
shlokas.13:
uShitvA tatra kaunteyaH sa.nvatsaraparAH kShapAH |
puShkareShu tataH shiShTaM kAlaM vartitavAnprabhuH
pUrNe tu dvAdashe varShe khANDavaprasthamAvishat
shlokas.14:
abhigamya sa rAjAnaM vinayena samAhitaH |
abhyarchya brAhmaNAnpArtho draupadImabhijagmivAn
shlokas.15:
taM draupadI pratyuvAcha praNayAtkurunandanam |
tatraiva gachCha kaunteya yatra sA sAtvatAtmajA
subaddhasyApi bhArasya pUrvabandhaH shlathAyate
shlokas.16:
tathA bahuvidhaM kRRiShNAM vilapantIM dhana~njayaH |
sAntvayAmAsa bhUyashcha kShamayAmAsa chAsakRRit
shlokas.17:
subhadrAM tvaramANashcha raktakausheyavAsasam |
pArthaH prasthApayAmAsa kRRitvA gopAlikAvapuH
shlokas.18:
sAdhikaM tena rUpeNa shobhamAnA yashasvinI |
bhavanaM shreShThamAsAdya vIrapatnI varA~NganA
vavande pRRithutAmrAkShI pRRithAM bhadrA yashasvinI
shlokas.19:
tato.abhigamya tvaritA pUrNendusadRRishAnanA |
vavande draupadIM bhadrA preShyAhamiti chAbravIt
shlokas.20:
pratyutthAya cha tAM kRRiShNA svasAraM mAdhavasya tAm |
sasvaje chAvadatprItA niHsapatno.astu te patiH
tathaiva muditA bhadrA tAmuvAchaivamastviti
shlokas.21:
tataste hRRiShTamanasaH pANDaveyA mahArathAH |
kuntI cha paramaprItA babhUva janamejaya
shlokas.22:
shrutvA tu puNDarIkAkShaH samprAptaM svapurottamam |
arjunaM pANDavashreShThamindraprasthagataM tadA
shlokas.23:
AjagAma vishuddhAtmA saha rAmeNa keshavaH |
vRRiShNyandhakamahAmAtraiH saha vIrairmahArathaiH
shlokas.24:
bhrAtRRibhishcha kumAraishcha yodhaishcha shatasho vRRitaH |
sainyena mahatA shaurirabhiguptaH parantapaH
shlokas.25:
tatra dAnapatirdhImAnAjagAma mahAyashAH |
akrUro vRRiShNivIrANAM senApatirari.ndamaH
shlokas.26:
anAdhRRiShTirmahAtejA uddhavashcha mahAyashAH |
sAkShAdbRRihaspateH shiShyo mahAbuddhirmahAyashAH
shlokas.27:
satyakaH sAtyakishchaiva kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH |
pradyumnashchaiva sAmbashcha nishaThaH sha~Nkureva cha
shlokas.28:
chArudeShNashcha vikrAnto jhillI vipRRithureva cha |
sAraNashcha mahAbAhurgadashcha viduShAM varaH
shlokas.29:
ete chAnye cha bahavo vRRiShNibhojAndhakAstathA |
AjagmuH khANDavaprasthamAdAya haraNaM bahu
shlokas.30:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA shrutvA mAdhavamAgatam |
pratigrahArthaM kRRiShNasya yamau prAsthApayattadA
shlokas.31:
tAbhyAM pratigRRihItaM tadvRRiShNichakraM samRRiddhimat |
vivesha khANDavaprasthaM patAkAdhvajashobhitam
shlokas.32:
siktasaMmRRiShTapanthAnaM puShpaprakarashobhitam |
chandanasya rasaiH shItaiH puNyagandhairniShevitam
shlokas.33:
dahyatAguruNA chaiva deshe deshe sugandhinA |
susaMmRRiShTajanAkIrNaM vaNigbhirupashobhitam
shlokas.34:
pratipede mahAbAhuH saha rAmeNa keshavaH |
vRRiShNyandhakamahAbhojaiH sa.nvRRitaH puruShottamaH
shlokas.35:
sampUjyamAnaH pauraishcha brAhmaNaishcha sahasrashaH |
vivesha bhavanaM rAj~naH pura.ndaragRRihopamam
shlokas.36:
yudhiShThirastu rAmeNa samAgachChadyathAvidhi |
mUrdhni keshavamAghrAya paryaShvajata bAhunA
shlokas.37:
taM prIyamANaM kRRiShNastu vinayenAbhyapUjayat |
bhImaM cha puruShavyAghraM vidhivatpratyapUjayat
shlokas.38:
tA.nshcha vRRiShNyandhakashreShThAndharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
pratijagrAha satkArairyathAvidhi yathopagam
shlokas.39:
guruvatpUjayAmAsa kA.nshchitkA.nshchidvayasyavat |
kA.nshchidabhyavadatpremNA kaishchidapyabhivAditaH
shlokas.40:
tato dadau vAsudevo janyArthe dhanamuttamam |
haraNaM vai subhadrAyA j~nAtideyaM mahAyashAH
shlokas.41:
rathAnAM kA~nchanA~NgAnAM ki~NkiNIjAlamAlinAm |
chaturyujAmupetAnAM sUtaiH kushalasaMmataiH
sahasraM pradadau kRRiShNo gavAmayutameva cha
shlokas.42:
shrImAnmAthuradeshyAnAM dogdhrINAM puNyavarchasAm |
vaDavAnAM cha shubhrANAM chandrA.nshusamavarchasAm
dadau janArdanaH prItyA sahasraM hemabhUShaNam
shlokas.43:
tathaivAshvatarINAM cha dAntAnAM vAtaraMhasAm |
shatAnya~njanakeshInAM shvetAnAM pa~ncha pa~ncha cha
shlokas.44:
snApanotsAdane chaiva suyuktaM vayasAnvitam |
strINAM sahasraM gaurINAM suveShANAM suvarchasAm
shlokas.45:
suvarNashatakaNThInAmarogANAM suvAsasAm |
paricharyAsu dakShANAM pradadau puShkarekShaNaH
shlokas.46:
kRRitAkRRitasya mukhyasya kanakasyAgnivarchasaH |
manuShyabhArAndAshArho dadau dasha janArdanaH
shlokas.47:
gajAnAM tu prabhinnAnAM tridhA prasravatAM madam |
girikUTanikAshAnAM samareShvanivartinAm
shlokas.48:
kL^iptAnAM paTughaNTAnAM varANAM hemamAlinAm |
hastyArohairupetAnAM sahasraM sAhasapriyaH
shlokas.49:
rAmaH pAdagrAhaNikaM dadau pArthAya lA~NgalI |
prIyamANo haladharaH sambandhaprItimAvahan
shlokas.50:
sa mahAdhanaratnaugho vastrakambalaphenavAn |
mahAgajamahAgrAhaH patAkAshaivalAkulaH
shlokas.52:
pratijagrAha tatsarvaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
pUjayAmAsa tA.nshchaiva vRRiShNyandhakamahArathAn
shlokas.53:
te sametA mahAtmAnaH kuruvRRiShNyandhakottamAH |
vijahruramarAvAse narAH sukRRitino yathA
shlokas.54:
tatra tatra mahApAnairutkRRiShTatalanAditaiH |
yathAyogaM yathAprIti vijahruH kuruvRRiShNayaH
shlokas.55:
evamuttamavIryAste vihRRitya divasAnbahUn |
pUjitAH kurubhirjagmuH punardvAravatIM purIm
shlokas.56:
rAmaM puraskRRitya yayurvRRiShNyandhakamahArathAH |
ratnAnyAdAya shubhrANi dattAni kurusattamaiH
shlokas.57:
vAsudevastu pArthena tatraiva saha bhArata |
uvAsa nagare ramye shakraprasthe mahAmanAH
vyacharadyamunAkUle pArthena saha bhArata
shlokas.58:
tataH subhadrA saubhadraM keshavasya priyA svasA |
jayantamiva paulomI dyutimantamajIjanat
shlokas.59:
dIrghabAhuM mahAsattvamRRiShabhAkShamari.ndamam |
subhadrA suShuve vIramabhimanyuM nararShabham
shlokas.60:
abhIshcha manyumA.nshchaiva tatastamarimardanam |
abhimanyumiti prAhurArjuniM puruSharShabham
shlokas.61:
sa sAtvatyAmatirathaH sambabhUva dhana~njayAt |
makhe nirmathyamAnAdvA shamIgarbhAddhutAshanaH
shlokas.62:
yasmi~njAte mahAbAhuH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
ayutaM gA dvijAtibhyaH prAdAnniShkA.nshcha tAvataH
shlokas.63:
dayito vAsudevasya bAlyAtprabhRRiti chAbhavat |
pitRRiNAM chaiva sarveShAM prajAnAmiva chandramAH
shlokas.64:
janmaprabhRRiti kRRiShNashcha chakre tasya kriyAH shubhAH |
sa chApi vavRRidhe bAlaH shuklapakShe yathA shashI
shlokas.65:
chatuShpAdaM dashavidhaM dhanurvedamari.ndamaH |
arjunAdveda vedaj~nAtsakalaM divyamAnuSham
shlokas.66:
vij~nAneShvapi chAstrANAM sauShThave cha mahAbalaH |
kriyAsvapi cha sarvAsu visheShAnabhyashikShayat
shlokas.67:
Agame cha prayoge cha chakre tulyamivAtmanaH |
tutoSha putraM saubhadraM prekShamANo dhana~njayaH
shlokas.70:
kRRiShNasya sadRRishaM shaurye vIrye rUpe tathAkRRitau |
dadarsha putraM bIbhatsurmaghavAniva taM yathA
shlokas.71:
pA~nchAlyapi cha pa~nchabhyaH patibhyaH shubhalakShaNA |
lebhe pa~ncha sutAnvIrA~nshubhAnpa~nchAchalAniva
shlokas.72:
yudhiShThirAtprativindhyaM sutasomaM vRRikodarAt |
arjunAchChrutakarmANaM shatAnIkaM cha nAkulim
shlokas.74:
shAstrataH prativindhyaM tamUchurviprA yudhiShThiram |
parapraharaNaj~nAne prativindhyo bhavatvayam
shlokas.75:
sute somasahasre tu somArkasamatejasam |
sutasomaM maheShvAsaM suShuve bhImasenataH
shlokas.76:
shrutaM karma mahatkRRitvA nivRRittena kirITinA |
jAtaH putrastavetyevaM shrutakarmA tato.abhavat
shlokas.77:
shatAnIkasya rAjarSheH kauravyaH kurunandanaH |
chakre putraM sanAmAnaM nakulaH kIrtivardhanam
shlokas.78:
tatastvajIjanatkRRiShNA nakShatre vahnidaivate |
sahadevAtsutaM tasmAchChrutaseneti taM viduH
shlokas.79:
ekavarShAntarAstveva draupadeyA yashasvinaH |
anvajAyanta rAjendra parasparahite ratAH
shlokas.81:
kRRitvA cha vedAdhyayanaM tataH sucharitavratAH |
jagRRihuH sarvamiShvastramarjunAddivyamAnuSham
shlokas.82:
devagarbhopamaiH putrairvyUDhoraskairmahAbalaiH |
anvitA rAjashArdUla pANDavA mudamApnuvan

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
indraprasthe vasantaste jaghnuranyAnnarAdhipAn |
shAsanAddhRRitarAShTrasya rAj~naH shAntanavasya cha
shlokas.2:
Ashritya dharmarAjAnaM sarvaloko.avasatsukham |
puNyalakShaNakarmANaM svadehamiva dehinaH
shlokas.3:
sa samaM dharmakAmArthAnsiSheve bharatarShabhaH |
trInivAtmasamAnbandhUnbandhumAniva mAnayan
shlokas.4:
teShAM samavibhaktAnAM kShitau dehavatAmiva |
babhau dharmArthakAmAnAM chaturtha iva pArthivaH
shlokas.5:
adhyetAraM paraM vedAH prayoktAraM mahAdhvarAH |
rakShitAraM shubhaM varNA lebhire taM janAdhipam
shlokas.6:
adhiShThAnavatI lakShmIH parAyaNavatI matiH |
bandhumAnakhilo dharmastenAsItpRRithivIkShitA
shlokas.7:
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito rAjA chaturbhiradhikaM babhau |
prayujyamAnairvitato vedairiva mahAdhvaraH
shlokas.8:
taM tu dhaumyAdayo viprAH parivAryopatasthire |
bRRihaspatisamA mukhyAH prajApatimivAmarAH
shlokas.9:
dharmarAje atiprItyA pUrNachandra ivAmale |
prajAnAM remire tulyaM netrANi hRRidayAni cha
shlokas.10:
na tu kevaladaivena prajA bhAvena remire |
yadbabhUva manaHkAntaM karmaNA sa chakAra tat
shlokas.11:
na hyayuktaM na chAsatyaM nAnRRitaM na cha vipriyam |
bhAShitaM chArubhAShasya jaj~ne pArthasya dhImataH
shlokas.12:
sa hi sarvasya lokasya hitamAtmana eva cha |
chikIrShuH sumahAtejA reme bharatasattamaH
shlokas.13:
tathA tu muditAH sarve pANDavA vigatajvarAH |
avasanpRRithivIpAlA.nstrAsayantaH svatejasA
shlokas.14:
tataH katipayAhasya bIbhatsuH kRRiShNamabravIt |
uShNAni kRRiShNa vartante gachChAmo yamunAM prati
shlokas.15:
suhRRijjanavRRitAstatra vihRRitya madhusUdana |
sAyAhne punareShyAmo rochatAM te janArdana
shlokas.16:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
kuntImAtarmamApyetadrochate yadvayaM jale |
suhRRijjanavRRitAH pArtha viharema yathAsukham
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
Amantrya dharmarAjAnamanuj~nApya cha bhArata |
jagmatuH pArthagovindau suhRRijjanavRRitau tataH
shlokas.18:
vihAradeshaM samprApya nAnAdrumavaduttamam |
gRRihairuchchAvachairyuktaM pura.ndaragRRihopamam
shlokas.19:
bhakShyairbhojyaishcha peyaishcha rasavadbhirmahAdhanaiH |
mAlyaishcha vividhairyuktaM yuktaM vArShNeyapArthayoH
shlokas.20:
AviveshaturApUrNaM ratnairuchchAvachaiH shubhaiH |
yathopajoShaM sarvashcha janashchikrIDa bhArata
shlokas.21:
vane kAshchijjale kAshchitkAshchidveshmasu chA~NganAH |
yathAdeshaM yathAprIti chikrIDuH kRRiShNapArthayoH
shlokas.22:
draupadI cha subhadrA cha vAsA.nsyAbharaNAni cha |
prayachChetAM mahArhANi strINAM te sma madotkaTe
shlokas.23:
kAshchitprahRRiShTA nanRRitushchukrushushcha tathAparAH |
jahasushchAparA nAryaH papushchAnyA varAsavam
shlokas.24:
rurudushchAparAstatra prajaghnushcha parasparam |
mantrayAmAsuranyAshcha rahasyAni parasparam
shlokas.25:
veNuvINAmRRida~NgAnAM manoj~nAnAM cha sarvashaH |
shabdenApUryate ha sma tadvanaM susamRRiddhimat
shlokas.26:
tasmi.nstathA vartamAne kurudAshArhanandanau |
samIpe jagmatuH ka~nchiduddeshaM sumanoharam
shlokas.27:
tatra gatvA mahAtmAnau kRRiShNau parapura~njayau |
mahArhAsanayo rAja.nstatastau saMniShIdatuH
shlokas.28:
tatra pUrvavyatItAni vikrAntAni ratAni cha |
bahUni kathayitvA tau remAte pArthamAdhavau
shlokas.29:
tatropaviShTau muditau nAkapRRiShThe.ashvinAviva |
abhyagachChattadA vipro vAsudevadhana~njayau
shlokas.30:
bRRihachChAlapratIkAshaH prataptakanakaprabhaH |
haripi~Ngo harishmashruH pramANAyAmataH samaH
shlokas.31:
taruNAdityasa~NkAshaH kRRiShNavAsA jaTAdharaH |
padmapatrAnanaH pi~NgastejasA prajvalanniva
shlokas.32:
upasRRiShTaM tu taM kRRiShNau bhrAjamAnaM dvijottamam |
arjuno vAsudevashcha tUrNamutpatya tasthatuH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
so.abravIdarjunaM chaiva vAsudevaM cha sAtvatam |
lokapravIrau tiShThantau khANDavasya samIpataH
shlokas.2:
brAhmaNo bahubhoktAsmi bhu~nje.aparimitaM sadA |
bhikShe vArShNeyapArthau vAmekAM tRRiptiM prayachChatAm
shlokas.3:
evamuktau tamabrUtAM tatastau kRRiShNapANDavau |
kenAnnena bhavA.nstRRipyettasyAnnasya yatAvahe
shlokas.4:
evamuktaH sa bhagavAnabravIttAvubhau tataH |
bhAShamANau tadA vIrau kimannaM kriyatAmiti
shlokas.5:
nAhamannaM bubhukShe vai pAvakaM mAM nibodhatam |
yadannamanurUpaM me tadyuvAM samprayachChatam
shlokas.6:
idamindraH sadA dAvaM khANDavaM parirakShati |
taM na shaknomyahaM dagdhuM rakShyamANaM mahAtmanA
shlokas.7:
vasatyatra sakhA tasya takShakaH pannagaH sadA |
sagaNastatkRRite dAvaM parirakShati vajrabhRRit
shlokas.8:
tatra bhUtAnyanekAni rakShyante sma prasa~NgataH |
taM didhakShurna shaknomi dagdhuM shakrasya tejasA
shlokas.9:
sa mAM prajvalitaM dRRiShTvA meghAmbhobhiH pravarShati |
tato dagdhuM na shaknomi didhakShurdAvamIpsitam
shlokas.10:
sa yuvAbhyAM sahAyAbhyAmastravidbhyAM samAgataH |
daheyaM khANDavaM dAvametadannaM vRRitaM mayA
shlokas.11:
yuvAM hyudakadhArAstA bhUtAni cha samantataH |
uttamAstravido samyaksarvato vArayiShyathaH
shlokas.12:
evamukte pratyuvAcha bIbhatsurjAtavedasam |
didhakShuM khANDavaM dAvamakAmasya shatakratoH
shlokas.13:
uttamAstrANi me santi divyAni cha bahUni cha |
yairahaM shaknuyAM yoddhumapi vajradharAnbahUn
shlokas.14:
dhanurme nAsti bhagavanbAhuvIryeNa saMmitam |
kurvataH samare yatnaM vegaM yadviShaheta me
shlokas.15:
sharaishcha me.artho bahubhirakShayaiH kShipramasyataH |
na hi voDhuM rathaH shaktaH sharAnmama yathepsitAn
shlokas.16:
ashvA.nshcha divyAnichCheyaM pANDurAnvAtaraMhasaH |
rathaM cha meghanirghoShaM sUryapratimatejasam
shlokas.17:
tathA kRRiShNasya vIryeNa nAyudhaM vidyate samam |
yena nAgAnpishAchA.nshcha nihanyAnmAdhavo raNe
shlokas.18:
upAyaM karmaNaH siddhau bhagavanvaktumarhasi |
nivArayeyaM yenendraM varShamANaM mahAvane
shlokas.19:
pauruSheNa tu yatkAryaM tatkartArau sva pAvaka |
karaNAni samarthAni bhagavandAtumarhasi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu bhagavAndhUmaketurhutAshanaH |
chintayAmAsa varuNaM lokapAlaM didRRikShayA
Adityamudake devaM nivasantaM jaleshvaram
shlokas.2:
sa cha tachchintitaM j~nAtvA darshayAmAsa pAvakam |
tamabravIddhUmaketuH pratipUjya jaleshvaram
chaturthaM lokapAlAnAM rakShitAraM maheshvaram
shlokas.3:
somena rAj~nA yaddattaM dhanushchaiveShudhI cha te |
tatprayachChobhayaM shIghraM rathaM cha kapilakShaNam
shlokas.4:
kAryaM hi sumahatpArtho gANDIvena kariShyati |
chakreNa vAsudevashcha tanmadarthe pradIyatAm
dadAnItyeva varuNaH pAvakaM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.5:
tato.adbhutaM mahAvIryaM yashaHkIrtivivardhanam |
sarvashastrairanAdhRRiShyaM sarvashastrapramAthi cha
sarvAyudhamahAmAtraM parasenApradharShaNam
shlokas.6:
ekaM shatasahasreNa saMmitaM rAShTravardhanam |
chitramuchchAvachairvarNaiH shobhitaM shlakShNamavraNam
shlokas.7:
devadAnavagandharvaiH pUjitaM shAshvatIH samAH |
prAdAdvai dhanuratnaM tadakShayyau cha maheShudhI
shlokas.8:
rathaM cha divyAshvayujaM kapipravaraketanam |
upetaM rAjatairashvairgAndharvairhemamAlibhiH
pANDurAbhrapratIkAshairmanovAyusamairjave
shlokas.9:
sarvopakaraNairyuktamajayyaM devadAnavaiH |
bhAnumantaM mahAghoShaM sarvabhUtamanoharam
shlokas.10:
sasarja yatsvatapasA bhauvano bhuvanaprabhuH |
prajApatiranirdeshyaM yasya rUpaM raveriva
shlokas.11:
yaM sma somaH samAruhya dAnavAnajayatprabhuH |
nagameghapratIkAshaM jvalantamiva cha shriyA
shlokas.12:
AshritA taM rathashreShThaM shakrAyudhasamA shubhA |
tApanIyA suruchirA dhvajayaShTiranuttamA
shlokas.13:
tasyAM tu vAnaro divyaH siMhashArdUlalakShaNaH |
vinardanniva tatrasthaH sa.nsthito mUrdhnyashobhata
shlokas.14:
dhvaje bhUtAni tatrAsanvividhAni mahAnti cha |
nAdena ripusainyAnAM yeShAM sa~nj~nA praNashyati
shlokas.15:
sa taM nAnApatAkAbhiH shobhitaM rathamuttamam |
pradakShiNamupAvRRitya daivatebhyaH praNamya cha
shlokas.16:
saMnaddhaH kavachI khaDgI baddhagodhA~NgulitravAn |
Aruroha rathaM pArtho vimAnaM sukRRitI yathA
shlokas.17:
tachcha divyaM dhanuHshreShThaM brahmaNA nirmitaM purA |
gANDIvamupasa~NgRRihya babhUva mudito.arjunaH
shlokas.18:
hutAshanaM namaskRRitya tatastadapi vIryavAn |
jagrAha balamAsthAya jyayA cha yuyuje dhanuH
shlokas.19:
maurvyAM tu yujyamAnAyAM balinA pANDavena ha |
ye.ashRRiNvankUjitaM tatra teShAM vai vyathitaM manaH
shlokas.20:
labdhvA rathaM dhanushchaiva tathAkShayyau maheShudhI |
babhUva kalyaH kaunteyaH prahRRiShTaH sAhyakarmaNi
shlokas.21:
vajranAbhaM tatashchakraM dadau kRRiShNAya pAvakaH |
AgneyamastraM dayitaM sa cha kalyo.abhavattadA
shlokas.22:
abravItpAvakashchainametena madhusUdana |
amAnuShAnapi raNe vijeShyasi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.23:
anena tvaM manuShyANAM devAnAmapi chAhave |
rakShaHpishAchadaityAnAM nAgAnAM chAdhikaH sadA
bhaviShyasi na sa.ndehaH pravarArinibarhaNe
shlokas.24:
kShiptaM kShiptaM raNe chaitattvayA mAdhava shatruShu |
hatvApratihataM sa~Nkhye pANimeShyati te punaH
shlokas.25:
varuNashcha dadau tasmai gadAmashaniniHsvanAm |
daityAntakaraNIM ghorAM nAmnA kaumodakIM hareH
shlokas.26:
tataH pAvakamabrUtAM prahRRiShTau kRRiShNapANDavau |
kRRitAstrau shastrasampannau rathinau dhvajinAvapi
shlokas.27:
kalyau svo bhagavanyoddhumapi sarvaiH surAsuraiH |
kiM punarvajriNaikena pannagArthe yuyutsunA
shlokas.28:
arjuna uvAcha||
chakramastraM cha vArShNeyo visRRijanyudhi vIryavAn |
triShu lokeShu tannAsti yanna jIyAjjanArdanaH
shlokas.29:
gANDIvaM dhanurAdAya tathAkShayyau maheShudhI |
ahamapyutsahe lokAnvijetuM yudhi pAvaka
shlokas.30:
sarvataH parivAryainaM dAvena mahatA prabho |
kAmaM samprajvalAdyaiva kalyau svaH sAhyakarmaNi
shlokas.31:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa bhagavAndAshArheNArjunena cha |
taijasaM rUpamAsthAya dAvaM dagdhuM prachakrame
shlokas.32:
sarvataH parivAryAtha saptArchirjvalanastadA |
dadAha khANDavaM kruddho yugAntamiva darshayan
shlokas.33:
parigRRihya samAviShTastadvanaM bharatarShabha |
meghastanitanirghoShaM sarvabhUtAni nirdahan
shlokas.34:
dahyatastasya vibabhau rUpaM dAvasya bhArata |
meroriva nagendrasya kA~nchanasya mahAdyuteH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tau rathAbhyAM naravyAghrau dAvasyobhayataH sthitau |
dikShu sarvAsu bhUtAnAM chakrAte kadanaM mahat
shlokas.2:
yatra yatra hi dRRishyante prANinaH khANDavAlayAH |
palAyantastatra tatra tau vIrau paryadhAvatAm
shlokas.3:
ChidraM hi na prapashyanti rathayorAshuvikramAt |
AviddhAviva dRRishyete rathinau tau rathottamau
shlokas.4:
khANDave dahyamAne tu bhUtAnyatha sahasrashaH |
utpeturbhairavAnnAdAnvinadanto disho dasha
shlokas.5:
dagdhaikadeshA bahavo niShTaptAshcha tathApare |
sphuTitAkShA vishIrNAshcha viplutAshcha vichetasaH
shlokas.6:
samAli~Ngya sutAnanye pitRRinmAtRRi.nstathApare |
tyaktuM na shekuH snehena tathaiva nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.7:
vikRRitairdarshanairanye samutpetuH sahasrashaH |
tatra tatra vighUrNantaH punaragnau prapedire
shlokas.8:
dagdhapakShAkShicharaNA vicheShTanto mahItale |
tatra tatra sma dRRishyante vinashyantaH sharIriNaH
shlokas.9:
jalasthAneShu sarveShu kvAthyamAneShu bhArata |
gatasattvAH sma dRRishyante kUrmamatsyAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.10:
sharIraiH sampradIptaishcha dehavanta ivAgnayaH |
adRRishyanta vane tasminprANinaH prANasa~NkShaye
shlokas.11:
tA.nstathotpatataH pArthaH sharaiH sa~nChidya khaNDashaH |
dIpyamAne tataH prAsyatprahasankRRiShNavartmani
shlokas.12:
te sharAchitasarvA~NgA vinadanto mahAravAn |
Urdhvamutpatya vegena nipetuH pAvake punaH
shlokas.13:
sharairabhyAhatAnAM cha dahyatAM cha vanaukasAm |
virAvaH shrUyate ha sma samudrasyeva mathyataH
shlokas.14:
vahneshchApi prahRRiShTasya khamutpeturmahArchiShaH |
janayAmAsurudvegaM sumahAntaM divaukasAm
shlokas.15:
tato jagmurmahAtmAnaH sarva eva divaukasaH |
sharaNaM devarAjAnaM sahasrAkShaM pura.ndaram
shlokas.16:
devA UchuH||
kiM nvime mAnavAH sarve dahyante kRRiShNavartmanA |
kachchinna sa~NkShayaH prApto lokAnAmamareshvara
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tachChrutvA vRRitrahA tebhyaH svayamevAnvavekShya cha |
khANDavasya vimokShArthaM prayayau harivAhanaH
shlokas.18:
mahatA meghajAlena nAnArUpeNa vajrabhRRit |
AkAshaM samavastIrya pravavarSha sureshvaraH
shlokas.19:
tato.akShamAtrA visRRijandhArAH shatasahasrashaH |
abhyavarShatsahasrAkShaH pAvakaM khANDavaM prati
shlokas.20:
asamprAptAstu tA dhArAstejasA jAtavedasaH |
kha eva samashuShyanta na kAshchitpAvakaM gatAH
shlokas.21:
tato namuchihA kruddho bhRRishamarchiShmatastadA |
punarevAbhyavarShattamambhaH pravisRRijanbahu
shlokas.22:
archirdhArAbhisambaddhaM dhUmavidyutsamAkulam |
babhUva tadvanaM ghoraM stanayitnusaghoShavat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasyAbhivarShato vAri pANDavaH pratyavArayat |
sharavarSheNa bIbhatsuruttamAstrANi darshayan
shlokas.2:
sharaiH samantataH sarvaM khANDavaM chApi pANDavaH |
ChAdayAmAsa tadvarShamapakRRiShya tato vanAt
shlokas.3:
na cha sma ki~nchichChaknoti bhUtaM nishcharituM tataH |
sa~nChAdyamAne khagamairasyatA savyasAchinA
shlokas.4:
takShakastu na tatrAsItsarparAjo mahAbalaH |
dahyamAne vane tasminkurukShetre.abhavattadA
shlokas.5:
ashvasenastu tatrAsIttakShakasya suto balI |
sa yatnamakarottIvraM mokShArthaM havyavAhanAt
shlokas.6:
na shashAka vinirgantuM kaunteyasharapIDitaH |
mokShayAmAsa taM mAtA nigIrya bhujagAtmajA
shlokas.7:
tasya pUrvaM shiro grastaM puchChamasya nigIryate |
UrdhvamAchakrame sA tu pannagI putragRRiddhinI
shlokas.8:
tasyAstIkShNena bhallena pRRithudhAreNa pANDavaH |
shirashchichCheda gachChantyAstAmapashyatsureshvaraH
shlokas.9:
taM mumochayiShurvajrI vAtavarSheNa pANDavam |
mohayAmAsa tatkAlamashvasenastvamuchyata
shlokas.10:
tAM cha mAyAM tadA dRRiShTvA ghorAM nAgena va~nchitaH |
dvidhA tridhA cha chichCheda khagatAneva bhArata
shlokas.11:
shashApa taM cha sa~Nkruddho bIbhatsurjihmagAminam |
pAvako vAsudevashcha apratiShTho bhavediti
shlokas.12:
tato jiShNuH sahasrAkShaM khaM vitatyeShubhiH shitaiH |
yodhayAmAsa sa~Nkruddho va~nchanAM tAmanusmaran
shlokas.13:
devarADapi taM dRRiShTvA sa.nrabdhamiva phalgunam |
svamastramasRRijaddIptaM yattatAnAkhilaM nabhaH
shlokas.14:
