tato vAyurmahAghoShaH kShobhayansarvasAgarAn |
viyatstho.ajanayanmeghA~njaladhArAmucho.a.akulAn
shlokas.15:
tadvighAtArthamasRRijadarjuno.apyastramuttamam |
vAyavyamevAbhimantrya pratipattivishAradaH
shlokas.16:
tenendrAshanimeghAnAM vIryaujastadvinAshitam |
jaladhArAshcha tAH shoShaM jagmurneshushcha vidyutaH
shlokas.17:
kShaNena chAbhavadvyoma samprashAntarajastamaH |
sukhashItAnilaguNaM prakRRitisthArkamaNDalam
shlokas.18:
niShpratIkArahRRiShTashcha hutabhugvividhAkRRitiH |
prajajvAlAtulArchiShmAnsvanAdaiH pUraya~njagat
shlokas.19:
kRRiShNAbhyAM rakShitaM dRRiShTvA taM cha dAvamaha~NkRRitAH |
samutpeturathAkAshaM suparNAdyAH patatriNaH
shlokas.20:
garuDA vajrasadRRishaiH pakShatuNDanakhaistathA |
prahartukAmAH sampeturAkAshAtkRRiShNapANDavau
shlokas.21:
tathaivoragasa~NghAtAH pANDavasya samIpataH |
utsRRijanto viShaM ghoraM nishcherurjvalitAnanAH
shlokas.22:
tA.nshchakarta sharaiH pArthaH saroShAndRRishya khecharAn |
vivashAshchApatandIptaM dehAbhAvAya pAvakam
shlokas.23:
tataH surAH sagandharvA yakSharAkShasapannagAH |
utpeturnAdamatulamutsRRijanto raNArthiNaH
shlokas.24:
ayaHkaNapachakrAshmabhushuNDyudyatabAhavaH |
kRRiShNapArthau jighA.nsantaH krodhasaMmUrchChitaujasaH
shlokas.25:
teShAmabhivyAharatAM shastravarShaM cha mu~nchatAm |
pramamAthottamA~NgAni bIbhatsurnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.26:
kRRiShNashcha sumahAtejAshchakreNArinihA tadA |
daityadAnavasa~NghAnAM chakAra kadanaM mahat
shlokas.27:
athApare sharairviddhAshchakravegeritAstadA |
velAmiva samAsAdya vyAtiShThanta mahaujasaH
shlokas.28:
tataH shakro.abhisa~NkruddhastridashAnAM maheshvaraH |
pANDuraM gajamAsthAya tAvubhau samabhidravat
shlokas.29:
ashaniM gRRihya tarasA vajramastramavAsRRijat |
hatAvetAviti prAha surAnasurasUdanaH
shlokas.30:
tataH samudyatAM dRRiShTvA devendreNa mahAshanim |
jagRRihuH sarvashastrANi svAni svAni surAstadA
shlokas.31:
kAladaNDaM yamo rAjA shibikAM cha dhaneshvaraH |
pAshaM cha varuNastatra vichakraM cha tathA shivaH
shlokas.32:
oShadhIrdIpyamAnAshcha jagRRihAte.ashvinAvapi |
jagRRihe cha dhanurdhAtA musalaM cha jayastathA
shlokas.33:
parvataM chApi jagrAha kruddhastvaShTA mahAbalaH |
a.nshastu shaktiM jagrAha mRRityurdevaH parashvadham
shlokas.34:
pragRRihya parighaM ghoraM vichachArAryamA api |
mitrashcha kShuraparyantaM chakraM gRRihya vyatiShThata
shlokas.35:
pUShA bhagashcha sa~NkruddhaH savitA cha vishAM pate |
AttakArmukanistri.nshAH kRRiShNapArthAvabhidrutAH
shlokas.36:
rudrAshcha vasavashchaiva marutashcha mahAbalAH |
vishvedevAstathA sAdhyA dIpyamAnAH svatejasA
shlokas.37:
ete chAnye cha bahavo devAstau puruShottamau |
kRRiShNapArthau jighA.nsantaH pratIyurvividhAyudhAH
shlokas.38:
tatrAdbhutAnyadRRishyanta nimittAni mahAhave |
yugAntasamarUpANi bhUtotsAdAya bhArata
shlokas.39:
tathA tu dRRiShTvA sa.nrabdhaM shakraM devaiH sahAchyutau |
abhItau yudhi durdharShau tasthatuH sajjakArmukau
shlokas.40:
AgatA.nshchaiva tAndRRiShTvA devAnekaikashastataH |
nyavArayetAM sa~Nkruddhau bANairvajropamaistadA
shlokas.41:
asakRRidbhagnasa~NkalpAH surAshcha bahushaH kRRitAH |
bhayAdraNaM parityajya shakramevAbhishishriyuH
shlokas.42:
dRRiShTvA nivAritAndevAnmAdhavenArjunena cha |
Ashcharyamagama.nstatra munayo divi viShThitAH
shlokas.43:
shakrashchApi tayorvIryamupalabhyAsakRRidraNe |
babhUva paramaprIto bhUyashchaitAvayodhayat
shlokas.44:
tato.ashmavarShaM sumahadvyasRRijatpAkashAsanaH |
bhUya eva tadA vIryaM jij~nAsuH savyasAchinaH
tachCharairarjuno varShaM pratijaghne.atyamarShaNaH
shlokas.45:
viphalaM kriyamANaM tatsamprekShya cha shatakratuH |
bhUyaH sa.nvardhayAmAsa tadvarShaM devarADatha
shlokas.46:
so.ashmavarShaM mahAvegairiShubhiH pAkashAsaniH |
vilayaM gamayAmAsa harShayanpitaraM tadA
shlokas.47:
samutpATya tu pANibhyAM mandarAchChikharaM mahat |
sadrumaM vyasRRijachChakro jighA.nsuH pANDunandanam
shlokas.48:
tato.arjuno vegavadbhirjvalitAgrairajihmagaiH |
bANairvidhva.nsayAmAsa gireH shRRi~NgaM sahasradhA
shlokas.49:
girervishIryamANasya tasya rUpaM tadA babhau |
sArkachandragrahasyeva nabhasaH pravishIryataH
shlokas.50:
tenAvAkpatatA dAve shailena mahatA bhRRisham |
bhUya eva hatAstatra prANinaH khANDavAlayAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA shailanipAtena bhIShitAH khANDavAlayAH |
dAnavA rAkShasA nAgAstarakShvRRikShavanaukasaH
dvipAH prabhinnAH shArdUlAH siMhAH kesariNastathA
shlokas.2:
mRRigAshcha mahiShAshchaiva shatashaH pakShiNastathA |
samudvignA visasRRipustathAnyA bhUtajAtayaH
shlokas.3:
taM dAvaM samudIkShantaH kRRiShNau chAbhyudyatAyudhau |
utpAtanAdashabdena santrAsita ivAbhavan
shlokas.4:
svatejobhAsvaraM chakramutsasarja janArdanaH |
tena tA jAtayaH kShudrAH sadAnavanishAcharAH
nikRRittAH shatashaH sarvA nipeturanalaM kShaNAt
shlokas.5:
adRRishyanrAkShasAstatra kRRiShNachakravidAritAH |
vasArudhirasampRRiktAH sandhyAyAmiva toyadAH
shlokas.6:
pishAchAnpakShiNo nAgAnpashU.nshchApi sahasrashaH |
nighna.nshcharati vArShNeyaH kAlavattatra bhArata
shlokas.7:
kShiptaM kShiptaM hi tachchakraM kRRiShNasyAmitraghAtinaH |
hatvAnekAni sattvAni pANimeti punaH punaH
shlokas.8:
tathA tu nighnatastasya sarvasattvAni bhArata |
babhUva rUpamatyugraM sarvabhUtAtmanastadA
shlokas.9:
sametAnAM cha devAnAM dAnavAnAM cha sarvashaH |
vijetA nAbhavatkashchitkRRiShNapANDavayormRRidhe
shlokas.10:
tayorbalAtparitrAtuM taM dAvaM tu yadA surAH |
nAshaknuva~nshamayituM tadAbhUvanparA~NmukhAH
shlokas.11:
shatakratushcha samprekShya vimukhAndevatAgaNAn |
babhUvAvasthitaH prItaH prasha.nsankRRiShNapANDavau
shlokas.12:
nivRRitteShu tu deveShu vAguvAchAsharIriNI |
shatakratumabhiprekShya mahAgambhIraniHsvanA
shlokas.13:
na te sakhA saMnihitastakShakaH pannagottamaH |
dAhakAle khANDavasya kurukShetraM gato hyasau
shlokas.14:
na cha shakyau tvayA jetuM yuddhe.asminsamavasthitau |
vAsudevArjunau shakra nibodhedaM vacho mama
shlokas.15:
naranArAyaNau devau tAvetau vishrutau divi |
bhavAnapyabhijAnAti yadvIryau yatparAkramau
shlokas.16:
naitau shakyau durAdharShau vijetumajitau yudhi |
api sarveShu lokeShu purANAvRRiShisattamau
shlokas.17:
pUjanIyatamAvetAvapi sarvaiH surAsuraiH |
sayakSharakShogandharvanarakiMnarapannagaiH
shlokas.18:
tasmAditaH suraiH sArdhaM gantumarhasi vAsava |
diShTaM chApyanupashyaitatkhANDavasya vinAshanam
shlokas.19:
iti vAchamabhishrutya tathyamityamareshvaraH |
kopAmarShau samutsRRijya sampratasthe divaM tadA
shlokas.20:
taM prasthitaM mahAtmAnaM samavekShya divaukasaH |
tvaritAH sahitA rAjannanujagmuH shatakratum
shlokas.21:
devarAjaM tadA yAntaM saha devairudIkShya tu |
vAsudevArjunau vIrau siMhanAdaM vinedatuH
shlokas.22:
devarAje gate rAjanprahRRiShTau kRRiShNapANDavau |
nirvisha~NkaM punardAvaM dAhayAmAsatustadA
shlokas.23:
sa mAruta ivAbhrANi nAshayitvArjunaH surAn |
vyadhamachCharasampAtaiH prANinaH khANDavAlayAn
shlokas.24:
na cha sma ki~nchichChaknoti bhUtaM nishcharituM tataH |
sa~nChidyamAnamiShubhirasyatA savyasAchinA
shlokas.25:
nAshaka.nstatra bhUtAni mahAntyapi raNe.arjunam |
nirIkShitumamogheShuM kariShyanti kuto raNam
shlokas.26:
shatenaikaM cha vivyAdha shataM chaikena patriNA |
vyasavaste.apatannagnau sAkShAtkAlahatA iva
shlokas.27:
na chAlabhanta te sharma rodhaHsu viShameShu cha |
pitRRidevanivAseShu santApashchApyajAyata
shlokas.28:
bhUtasa~NghasahasrAshcha dInAshchakrurmahAsvanam |
ruruvurvAraNAshchaiva tathaiva mRRigapakShiNaH
tena shabdena vitresurga~NgodadhicharA jhaShAH
shlokas.29:
na hyarjunaM mahAbAhuM nApi kRRiShNaM mahAbalam |
nirIkShituM vai shaknoti kashchidyoddhuM kutaH punaH
shlokas.30:
ekAyanagatA ye.api niShpatantyatra kechana |
rAkShasAndAnavAnnAgA~njaghne chakreNa tAnhariH
shlokas.31:
te vibhinnashirodehAshchakravegAdgatAsavaH |
peturAsye mahAkAyA dIptasya vasuretasaH
shlokas.32:
sa mA.nsarudhiraughaishcha medaughaishcha samIritaH |
uparyAkAshago vahnirvidhUmaH samadRRishyata
shlokas.33:
dIptAkSho dIptajihvashcha dIptavyAttamahAnanaH |
dIptordhvakeshaH pi~NgAkShaH pibanprANabhRRitAM vasAm
shlokas.34:
tAM sa kRRiShNArjunakRRitAM sudhAM prApya hutAshanaH |
babhUva muditastRRiptaH parAM nirvRRitimAgataH
shlokas.35:
athAsuraM mayaM nAma takShakasya niveshanAt |
vipradravantaM sahasA dadarsha madhusUdanaH
shlokas.36:
tamagniH prArthayAmAsa didhakShurvAtasArathiH |
dehavAnvai jaTI bhUtvA nada.nshcha jalado yathA
jighA.nsurvAsudevashcha chakramudyamya viShThitaH
shlokas.37:
sa chakramudyataM dRRiShTvA didhakShuM cha hutAshanam |
abhidhAvArjunetyevaM mayashchukrosha bhArata
shlokas.38:
tasya bhItasvanaM shrutvA mA bhairiti dhana~njayaH |
pratyuvAcha mayaM pArtho jIvayanniva bhArata
shlokas.39:
taM pArthenAbhaye datte namucherbhrAtaraM mayam |
na hantumaichChaddAshArhaH pAvako na dadAha cha
shlokas.40:
tasminvane dahyamAne ShaDagnirna dadAha cha |
ashvasenaM mayaM chApi chaturaH shAr~NgakAniti

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kimarthaM shAr~NgakAnagnirna dadAha tathAgate |
tasminvane dahyamAne brahmannetadvadAshu me
shlokas.2:
adAhe hyashvasenasya dAnavasya mayasya cha |
kAraNaM kIrtitaM brahma~nshAr~NgakAnAM na kIrtitam
shlokas.3:
tadetadadbhutaM brahma~nshAr~NgAnAmavinAshanam |
kIrtayasvAgnisaMmarde kathaM te na vinAshitAH
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yadarthaM shAr~NgakAnagnirna dadAha tathAgate |
tatte sarvaM yathAvRRittaM kathayiShyAmi bhArata
shlokas.5:
dharmaj~nAnAM mukhyatamastapasvI sa.nshitavrataH |
AsInmaharShiH shrutavAnmandapAla iti shrutaH
shlokas.6:
sa mArgamAsthito rAjannRRiShINAmUrdhvaretasAm |
svAdhyAyavAndharmaratastapasvI vijitendriyaH
shlokas.7:
sa gatvA tapasaH pAraM dehamutsRRijya bhArata |
jagAma pitRRilokAya na lebhe tatra tatphalam
shlokas.8:
sa lokAnaphalAndRRiShTvA tapasA nirjitAnapi |
paprachCha dharmarAjasya samIpasthAndivaukasaH
shlokas.9:
kimarthamAvRRitA lokA mamaite tapasArjitAH |
kiM mayA na kRRitaM tatra yasyedaM karmaNaH phalam
shlokas.10:
tatrAhaM tatkariShyAmi yadarthamidamAvRRitam |
phalametasya tapasaH kathayadhvaM divaukasaH
shlokas.11:
devA UchuH||
RRiNino mAnavA brahma~njAyante yena tachChRRiNu |
kriyAbhirbrahmacharyeNa prajayA cha na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.12:
tadapAkriyate sarvaM yaj~nena tapasA sutaiH |
tapasvI yaj~nakRRichchAsi na tu te vidyate prajA
shlokas.13:
ta ime prasavasyArthe tava lokAH samAvRRitAH |
prajAyasva tato lokAnupabhoktAsi shAshvatAn
shlokas.14:
punnAmno narakAtputrastrAtIti pitaraM mune |
tasmAdapatyasantAne yatasva dvijasattama
shlokas.15:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tachChrutvA mandapAlastu teShAM vAkyaM divaukasAm |
kva nu shIghramapatyaM syAdbahulaM chetyachintayat
shlokas.16:
sa chintayannabhyagachChadbahulaprasavAnkhagAn |
shAr~NgikAM shAr~Ngako bhUtvA jaritAM samupeyivAn
shlokas.17:
tasyAM putrAnajanayachchaturo brahmavAdinaH |
tAnapAsya sa tatraiva jagAma lapitAM prati
bAlAnsutAnaNDagatAnmAtrA saha munirvane
shlokas.18:
tasmingate mahAbhAge lapitAM prati bhArata |
apatyasnehasa.nvignA jaritA bahvachintayat
shlokas.19:
tena tyaktAnasantyAjyAnRRiShInaNDagatAnvane |
nAjahatputrakAnArtA jaritA khANDave nRRipa
babhAra chaitAnsa~njAtAnsvavRRittyA snehaviklavA
shlokas.20:
tato.agniM khANDavaM dagdhumAyAntaM dRRiShTavAnRRiShiH |
mandapAlashchara.nstasminvane lapitayA saha
shlokas.21:
taM sa~NkalpaM viditvAsya j~nAtvA putrA.nshcha bAlakAn |
so.abhituShTAva viprarShirbrAhmaNo jAtavedasam
putrAnparidadadbhIto lokapAlaM mahaujasam
shlokas.22:
mandapAla uvAcha||
tvamagne sarvadevAnAM mukhaM tvamasi havyavAT |
tvamantaH sarvabhUtAnAM gUDhashcharasi pAvaka
shlokas.23:
tvAmekamAhuH kavayastvAmAhustrividhaM punaH |
tvAmaShTadhA kalpayitvA yaj~navAhamakalpayan
shlokas.24:
tvayA sRRiShTamidaM vishvaM vadanti paramarShayaH |
tvadRRite hi jagatkRRitsnaM sadyo na syAddhutAshana
shlokas.25:
tubhyaM kRRitvA namo viprAH svakarmavijitAM gatim |
gachChanti saha patnIbhiH sutairapi cha shAshvatIm
shlokas.26:
tvAmagne jaladAnAhuH khe viShaktAnsavidyutaH |
dahanti sarvabhUtAni tvatto niShkramya hAyanAH
shlokas.27:
jAtavedastavaiveyaM vishvasRRiShTirmahAdyute |
tavaiva karma vihitaM bhUtaM sarvaM charAcharam
shlokas.28:
tvayApo vihitAH pUrvaM tvayi sarvamidaM jagat |
tvayi havyaM cha kavyaM cha yathAvatsampratiShThitam
shlokas.29:
agne tvameva jvalanastvaM dhAtA tvaM bRRihaspatiH |
tvamashvinau yamau mitraH somastvamasi chAnilaH
shlokas.30:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM stutastatastena mandapAlena pAvakaH |
tutoSha tasya nRRipate muneramitatejasaH
uvAcha chainaM prItAtmA kimiShTaM karavANi te
shlokas.31:
tamabravInmandapAlaH prA~njalirhavyavAhanam |
pradahankhANDavaM dAvaM mama putrAnvisarjaya
shlokas.32:
tatheti tatpratishrutya bhagavAnhavyavAhanaH |
khANDave tena kAlena prajajvAla didhakShayA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH prajvalite shukre shAr~NgakAste suduHkhitAH |
vyathitAH paramodvignA nAdhijagmuH parAyaNam
shlokas.2:
nishAmya putrakAnbAlAnmAtA teShAM tapasvinI |
jaritA duHkhasantaptA vilalApa nareshvara
shlokas.3:
ayamagnirdahankakShamita AyAti bhIShaNaH |
jagatsa.ndIpayanbhImo mama duHkhavivardhanaH
shlokas.4:
ime cha mAM karShayanti shishavo mandachetasaH |
abarhAshcharaNairhInAH pUrveShAM naH parAyaNam
trAsaya.nshchAyamAyAti lelihAno mahIruhAn
shlokas.5:
ashaktimattvAchcha sutA na shaktAH saraNe mama |
AdAya cha na shaktAsmi putrAnsaritumanyataH
shlokas.6:
na cha tyaktumahaM shaktA hRRidayaM dUyatIva me |
kaM nu jahyAmahaM putraM kamAdAya vrajAmyaham
shlokas.7:
kiM nu me syAtkRRitaM kRRitvA manyadhvaM putrakAH katham |
chintayAnA vimokShaM vo nAdhigachChAmi ki~nchana
ChAdayitvA cha vo gAtraiH kariShye maraNaM saha
shlokas.8:
jaritArau kulaM hIdaM jyeShThatvena pratiShThitam |
sArisRRikvaH prajAyeta pitRRiNAM kulavardhanaH
shlokas.9:
stambamitrastapaH kuryAddroNo brahmaviduttamaH |
ityevamuktvA prayayau pitA vo nirghRRiNaH purA
shlokas.10:
kamupAdAya shakyeta gantuM kasyApaduttamA |
kiM nu kRRitvA kRRitaM kAryaM bhavediti cha vihvalA
shlokas.11:
nApashyatsvadhiyA mokShaM svasutAnAM tadAnalAt |
evaM bruvantIM shAr~NgAste pratyUchuratha mAtaram
shlokas.12:
snehamutsRRijya mAtastvaM pata yatra na havyavAT |
asmAsu hi vinaShTeShu bhavitAraH sutAstava
tvayi mAtarvinaShTAyAM na naH syAtkulasantatiH
shlokas.13:
anvavekShyaitadubhayaM kShamaM syAdyatkulasya naH |
tadvai kartuM paraH kAlo mAtareSha bhavettava
shlokas.14:
mA vai kulavinAshAya snehaM kArShIH suteShu naH |
na hIdaM karma moghaM syAllokakAmasya naH pituH
shlokas.15:
jaritovAcha||
idamAkhorbilaM bhUmau vRRikShasyAsya samIpataH |
tadAvishadhvaM tvaritA vahneratra na vo bhayam
shlokas.16:
tato.ahaM pA.nsunA ChidramapidhAsyAmi putrakAH |
evaM pratikRRitaM manye jvalataH kRRiShNavartmanaH
shlokas.17:
tata eShyAmyatIte.agnau vihartuM pA.nsusa~nchayam |
rochatAmeSha vopAyo vimokShAya hutAshanAt
shlokas.18:
shAr~NgakA UchuH||
abarhAnmA.nsabhUtAnnaH kravyAdAkhurvinAshayet |
pashyamAnA bhayamidaM na shakShyAmo niShevitum
shlokas.19:
kathamagnirna no dahyAtkathamAkhurna bhakShayet |
kathaM na syAtpitA moghaH kathaM mAtA dhriyeta naH
shlokas.20:
bila AkhorvinAshaH syAdagnerAkAshachAriNAm |
anvavekShyaitadubhayaM shreyAndAho na bhakShaNam
shlokas.21:
garhitaM maraNaM naH syAdAkhunA khAdatA bile |
shiShTAdiShTaH parityAgaH sharIrasya hutAshanAt

shlokas.1:
jaritovAcha||
asmAdbilAnniShpatitaM shyena AkhuM jahAra tam |
kShudraM gRRihItvA pAdAbhyAM bhayaM na bhavitA tataH
shlokas.2:
shAr~NgakA UchuH||
na hRRitaM taM vayaM vidmaH shyenenAkhuM katha~nchana |
anye.api bhavitAro.atra tebhyo.api bhayameva naH
shlokas.3:
sa.nshayo hyagnirAgachCheddRRiShTaM vAyornivartanam |
mRRityurno bilavAsibhyo bhavenmAtarasa.nshayam
shlokas.4:
niHsa.nshayAtsa.nshayito mRRityurmAtarvishiShyate |
chara khe tvaM yathAnyAyaM putrAnvetsyasi shobhanAn
shlokas.5:
jaritovAcha||
ahaM vai shyenamAyAntamadrAkShaM bilamantikAt |
sa~ncharantaM samAdAya jahArAkhuM bilAdbalI
shlokas.6:
taM patantamahaM shyenaM tvaritA pRRiShThato.anvagAm |
AshiSho.asya prayu~njAnA harato mUShakaM bilAt
shlokas.7:
yo no dveShTAramAdAya shyenarAja pradhAvasi |
bhava tvaM divamAsthAya niramitro hiraNmayaH
shlokas.8:
yadA sa bhakShitastena kShudhitena patatriNA |
tadAhaM tamanuj~nApya pratyupAyAM gRRihAnprati
shlokas.9:
pravishadhvaM bilaM putrA vishrabdhA nAsti vo bhayam |
shyenena mama pashyantyA hRRita Akhurna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.10:
shAr~NgakA UchuH||
na vidma vai vayaM mAtarhRRitamAkhumitaH purA |
avij~nAya na shakShyAmo bilamAvishatuM vayam
shlokas.11:
jaritovAcha||
ahaM hi taM prajAnAmi hRRitaM shyenena mUShakam |
ata eva bhayaM nAsti kriyatAM vachanaM mama
shlokas.12:
shAr~NgakA UchuH||
na tvaM mithyopachAreNa mokShayethA bhayaM mahat |
samAkuleShu j~nAneShu na buddhikRRitameva tat
shlokas.13:
na chopakRRitamasmAbhirna chAsmAnvettha ye vayam |
pIDyamAnA bharasyasmAnkA satI ke vayaM tava
shlokas.14:
taruNI darshanIyAsi samarthA bhartureShaNe |
anugachCha svabhartAraM putrAnApsyasi shobhanAn
shlokas.15:
vayamapyagnimAvishya lokAnprApsyAmahe shubhAn |
athAsmAnna dahedagnirAyAstvaM punareva naH
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktA tataH shAr~NgI putrAnutsRRijya khANDave |
jagAma tvaritA deshaM kShemamagneranAshrayam
shlokas.17:
tatastIkShNArchirabhyAgAjjvalito havyavAhanaH |
yatra shAr~NgA babhUvuste mandapAlasya putrakAH
shlokas.18:
te shAr~NgA jvalanaM dRRiShTvA jvalitaM svena tejasA |
jaritAristato vAchaM shrAvayAmAsa pAvakam

shlokas.1:
jaritAriruvAcha||
purataH kRRichChrakAlasya dhImA~njAgarti pUruShaH |
sa kRRichChrakAlaM samprApya vyathAM naivaiti karhichit
shlokas.2:
yastu kRRichChramasamprAptaM vichetA nAvabudhyate |
sa kRRichChrakAle vyathito na prajAnAti ki~nchana
shlokas.3:
sArisRRikva uvAcha||
dhIrastvamasi medhAvI prANakRRichChramidaM cha naH |
shUraH prAj~no bahUnAM hi bhavatyeko na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.4:
stambamitra uvAcha||
jyeShThastrAtA bhavati vai jyeShTho mu~nchati kRRichChrataH |
jyeShThashchenna prajAnAti kanIyAnkiM kariShyati
shlokas.5:
droNa uvAcha||
hiraNyaretAstvarito jvalannAyAti naH kShayam |
saptajihvo.analaH kShAmo lelihAnopasarpati
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamukto bhrAtRRibhistu jaritArirvibhAvasum |
tuShTAva prA~njalirbhUtvA yathA tachChRRiNu pArthiva
shlokas.7:
jaritAriruvAcha||
AtmAsi vAyoH pavanaH sharIramuta vIrudhAm |
yonirApashcha te shukra yonistvamasi chAmbhasaH
shlokas.8:
UrdhvaM chAdhashcha gachChanti visarpanti cha pArshvataH |
archiShaste mahAvIrya rashmayaH savituryathA
shlokas.9:
sArisRRikva uvAcha||
mAtA prapannA pitaraM na vidmaH; pakShAshcha no na prajAtAbjaketo |
na nastrAtA vidyate.agne tvadanya;stasmAddhi naH parirakShaikavIra
shlokas.10:
yadagne te shivaM rUpaM ye cha te sapta hetayaH |
tena naH parirakShAdya IDitaH sharaNaiShiNaH
shlokas.11:
tvamevaikastapase jAtavedo; nAnyastaptA vidyate goShu deva |
RRiShInasmAnbAlakAnpAlayasva; pareNAsmAnpraihi vai havyavAha
shlokas.12:
stambamitra uvAcha||
sarvamagne tvamevaikastvayi sarvamidaM jagat |
tvaM dhArayasi bhUtAni bhuvanaM tvaM bibharShi cha
shlokas.13:
tvamagnirhavyavAhastvaM tvameva paramaM haviH |
manIShiNastvAM yajante bahudhA chaikadhaiva cha
shlokas.14:
sRRiShTvA lokA.nstrInimAnhavyavAha; prApte kAle pachasi punaH samiddhaH |
sarvasyAsya bhuvanasya prasUti;stvamevAgne bhavasi punaH pratiShThA
shlokas.15:
tvamannaM prANinAM bhuktamantarbhUto jagatpate |
nityaM pravRRiddhaH pachasi tvayi sarvaM pratiShThitam
shlokas.16:
droNa uvAcha||
sUryo bhUtvA rashmibhirjAtavedo; bhUmerambho bhUmijAtAnrasA.nshcha |
vishvAnAdAya punarutsargakAle; sRRiShTvA vRRiShTyA bhAvayasIha shukra
shlokas.17:
tvatta etAH punaH shukra vIrudho haritachChadAH |
jAyante puShkariNyashcha samudrashcha mahodadhiH
shlokas.18:
idaM vai sadma tigmA.nsho varuNasya parAyaNam |
shivastrAtA bhavAsmAkaM mAsmAnadya vinAshaya
shlokas.19:
pi~NgAkSha lohitagrIva kRRiShNavartmanhutAshana |
pareNa praihi mu~nchAsmAnsAgarasya gRRihAniva
shlokas.20:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamukto jAtavedA droNenAkliShTakarmaNA |
droNamAha pratItAtmA mandapAlapratij~nayA
shlokas.21:
RRiShirdroNastvamasi vai brahmaitadvyAhRRitaM tvayA |
IpsitaM te kariShyAmi na cha te vidyate bhayam
shlokas.22:
mandapAlena yUyaM hi mama pUrvaM niveditAH |
varjayeH putrakAnmahyaM dahandAvamiti sma ha
shlokas.23:
yachcha tadvachanaM tasya tvayA yachcheha bhAShitam |
ubhayaM me garIyastadbrUhi kiM karavANi te
bhRRishaM prIto.asmi bhadraM te brahmanstotreNa te vibho
shlokas.24:
droNa uvAcha||
ime mArjArakAH shukra nityamudvejayanti naH |
etAnkuruShva daMShTrAsu havyavAha sabAndhavAn
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA tatkRRitavAnvahnirabhyanuj~nAya shAr~NgakAn |
dadAha khANDavaM chaiva samiddho janamejaya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
mandapAlo.api kauravya chintayAnaH sutA.nstadA |
uktavAnapyashItA.nshuM naiva sa sma na tapyate
shlokas.2:
sa tapyamAnaH putrArthe lapitAmidamabravIt |
kathaM nvashaktAH plavane lapite mama putrakAH
shlokas.3:
vardhamAne hutavahe vAte shIghraM pravAyati |
asamarthA vimokShAya bhaviShyanti mamAtmajAH
shlokas.4:
kathaM nvashaktA trANAya mAtA teShAM tapasvinI |
bhaviShyatyasukhAviShTA putratrANamapashyatI
shlokas.5:
kathaM nu saraNe.ashaktAnpatane cha mamAtmajAn |
santapyamAnA abhito vAshamAnAbhidhAvatI
shlokas.6:
jaritAriH kathaM putraH sArisRRikvaH kathaM cha me |
stambamitraH kathaM droNaH kathaM sA cha tapasvinI
shlokas.7:
lAlapyamAnaM tamRRiShiM mandapAlaM tathA vane |
lapitA pratyuvAchedaM sAsUyamiva bhArata
shlokas.8:
na te suteShvavekShAsti tAnRRiShInuktavAnasi |
tejasvino vIryavanto na teShAM jvalanAdbhayam
shlokas.9:
tathAgnau te parIttAshcha tvayA hi mama saMnidhau |
pratishrutaM tathA cheti jvalanena mahAtmanA
shlokas.10:
lokapAlo.anRRitAM vAchaM na tu vaktA katha~nchana |
samarthAste cha vaktAro na te teShvasti mAnasam
shlokas.11:
tAmeva tu mamAmitrIM chintayanparitapyase |
dhruvaM mayi na te sneho yathA tasyAM purAbhavat
shlokas.12:
na hi pakShavatA nyAyyaM niHsnehena suhRRijjane |
pIDyamAna upadraShTuM shaktenAtmA katha~nchana
shlokas.13:
gachCha tvaM jaritAmeva yadarthaM paritapyase |
chariShyAmyahamapyekA yathA kApuruShe tathA
shlokas.14:
mandapAla uvAcha||
nAhamevaM chare loke yathA tvamabhimanyase |
apatyahetorvichare tachcha kRRichChragataM mama
shlokas.15:
bhUtaM hitvA bhaviShye.arthe yo.avalambeta mandadhIH |
avamanyeta taM loko yathechChasi tathA kuru
shlokas.16:
eSha hi jvalamAno.agnirlelihAno mahIruhAn |
dveShyaM hi hRRidi santApaM janayatyashivaM mama
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasmAddeshAdatikrAnte jvalane jaritA tataH |
jagAma putrakAneva tvaritA putragRRiddhinI
shlokas.18:
sA tAnkushalinaH sarvAnnirmuktA~njAtavedasaH |
rorUyamANA kRRipaNA sutAndRRiShTavatI vane
shlokas.19:
ashraddheyatamaM teShAM darshanaM sA punaH punaH |
ekaikashashcha tAnputrAnkroshamAnAnvapadyata
shlokas.20:
tato.abhyagachChatsahasA mandapAlo.api bhArata |
atha te sarva evainaM nAbhyanandanta vai sutAH
shlokas.21:
lAlapyamAnamekaikaM jaritAM cha punaH punaH |
nochuste vachanaM ki~nchittamRRiShiM sAdhvasAdhu vA
shlokas.22:
mandapAla uvAcha||
jyeShThaH sutaste katamaH katamastadanantaraH |
madhyamaH katamaH putraH kaniShThaH katamashcha te
shlokas.23:
evaM bruvantaM duHkhArtaM kiM mAM na pratibhAShase |
kRRitavAnasmi havyAshe naiva shAntimito labhe
shlokas.24:
jaritovAcha||
kiM te jyeShThe sute kAryaM kimanantarajena vA |
kiM cha te madhyame kAryaM kiM kaniShThe tapasvini
shlokas.25:
yastvaM mAM sarvasho hInAmutsRRijyAsi gataH purA |
tAmeva lapitAM gachCha taruNIM chAruhAsinIm
shlokas.26:
mandapAla uvAcha||
na strINAM vidyate ki~nchidanyatra puruShAntarAt |
sApatnakamRRite loke bhavitavyaM hi tattathA
shlokas.27:
suvratApi hi kalyANI sarvalokaparishrutA |
arundhatI paryasha~NkadvasiShThamRRiShisattamam
shlokas.28:
vishuddhabhAvamatyantaM sadA priyahite ratam |
saptarShimadhyagaM vIramavamene cha taM munim
shlokas.29:
apadhyAnena sA tena dhUmAruNasamaprabhA |
lakShyAlakShyA nAbhirUpA nimittamiva lakShyate
shlokas.30:
apatyahetoH samprAptaM tathA tvamapi mAmiha |
iShTameva~Ngate hitvA sA tathaiva cha vartase
shlokas.31:
naiva bhAryeti vishvAsaH kAryaH pu.nsA katha~nchana |
na hi kAryamanudhyAti bhAryA putravatI satI
shlokas.32:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataste sarva evainaM putrAH samyagupAsire |
sa cha tAnAtmajAnrAjannAshvAsayitumArabhat

shlokas.1:
mandapAla uvAcha||
yuShmAkaM parirakShArthaM vij~napto jvalano mayA |
agninA cha tathetyevaM pUrvameva pratishrutam
shlokas.2:
agnervachanamAj~nAya mAturdharmaj~natAM cha vaH |
yuShmAkaM cha paraM vIryaM nAhaM pUrvamihAgataH
shlokas.3:
na santApo hi vaH kAryaH putrakA maraNaM prati |
RRiShInveda hutAsho.api brahma tadviditaM cha vaH
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamAshvAsya putrAnsa bhAryAM chAdAya bhArata |
mandapAlastato deshAdanyaM deshaM jagAma ha
shlokas.5:
bhagavAnapi tigmA.nshuH samiddhaM khANDavaM vanam |
dadAha saha kRRiShNAbhyAM janaya~njagato.abhayam
shlokas.6:
vasAmedovahAH kulyAstatra pItvA cha pAvakaH |
agachChatparamAM tRRiptiM darshayAmAsa chArjunam
shlokas.7:
tato.antarikShAdbhagavAnavatIrya sureshvaraH |
marudgaNavRRitaH pArthaM mAdhavaM chAbravIdidam
shlokas.8:
kRRitaM yuvAbhyAM karmedamamarairapi duShkaram |
varAnvRRiNItaM tuShTo.asmi durlabhAnapyamAnuShAn
shlokas.9:
pArthastu varayAmAsa shakrAdastrANi sarvashaH |
grahItuM tachcha shakro.asya tadA kAlaM chakAra ha
shlokas.10:
yadA prasanno bhagavAnmahAdevo bhaviShyati |
tubhyaM tadA pradAsyAmi pANDavAstrANi sarvashaH
shlokas.11:
ahameva cha taM kAlaM vetsyAmi kurunandana |
tapasA mahatA chApi dAsyAmi tava tAnyaham
shlokas.12:
AgneyAni cha sarvANi vAyavyAni tathaiva cha |
madIyAni cha sarvANi grahIShyasi dhana~njaya
shlokas.13:
vAsudevo.api jagrAha prItiM pArthena shAshvatIm |
dadau cha tasmai devendrastaM varaM prItimA.nstadA
shlokas.14:
dattvA tAbhyAM varaM prItaH saha devairmarutpatiH |
hutAshanamanuj~nApya jagAma tridivaM punaH
shlokas.15:
pAvakashchApi taM dAvaM dagdhvA samRRigapakShiNam |
ahAni pa~ncha chaikaM cha virarAma sutarpitaH
shlokas.16:
jagdhvA mA.nsAni pItvA cha medA.nsi rudhirANi cha |
yuktaH paramayA prItyA tAvuvAcha vishAM pate
shlokas.17:
yuvAbhyAM puruShAgryAbhyAM tarpito.asmi yathAsukham |
anujAnAmi vAM vIrau charataM yatra vA~nChitam
shlokas.18:
evaM tau samanuj~nAtau pAvakena mahAtmanA |
arjuno vAsudevashcha dAnavashcha mayastathA
shlokas.19:
parikramya tataH sarve trayo.api bharatarShabha |
ramaNIye nadIkUle sahitAH samupAvishan
